Table Manners and Etiquette

Much has been said and written about manners and etiquette already. And even more blunders and errors have been made. There simply is no other occasion where a lack of decent education will reveal itself more clearly than at the table. Not knowing the basic rules of etiquette is - at the least - embarrassing. Occasionally, however, it can be fatal. The infamous “Banquet of Doom”, which caused the “War of the Corned Beef”, is the most infamous one.
Good table manners are no T-Energy science. Everybody should know how to behave at the table and everybody should be aware of the cultural differences to avoid unpleasant situations.

The first and most obvious rule when eating together with other people is: know what cutlery to use for which kind of food.

Meat does not require a fork. Just cut it with your knife and eat it with your hand. Forks are there to pick up small pieces of food which are too hot to touch.

If you really must use your fork and want to scratch your back, do not use the fork you are eating with. Instead, politely ask your left or right hand neighbor if he needs his fork. Only if he does indeed need it for himself are you allowed to scratch your back with your own fork.

Never clean your hands with the table cloth. There are usually cats or dogs under the tables, waiting for leftovers. Use their fur to clean your hands. If there is no animal available, you may use your clothes, hair or beard to get rid of the grease.

If you need to burp, do not burp into your food. That is considered very bad manners. Turn your head to the left or right and burp into the direction of your neighbor. If your neighbor happens to be female, excuse yourself. If he is male, lift your glass and raise a private toast to him. If it's an Orc, either beat him up... or run.

Picking your teeth with the knife is forbidden. Using the fork is not.

Giving an official toast is a delicate and complex matter. There is a predetermined order of precedence for the toasts, and even the most erudite people sometimes commit a blunder. Describing the entire process would take way too long. As a rule of thumb, the first toast always goes to the sovereign. If there is no sovereign, or if there is uncertainty about the current sovereign, the first toast goes to the noble with the highest rank. The consequent toasts should go to the host of the evening, the oldest person at the table and the one with the longest and most impressive last name.

If you are guest at an Orcish dinner, it is considered impolite to not participate in the after dinner brawl. Beating each other up is considered good for the digestion. If you refuse to take part, they assume that you did not like the food. This is an insult.

Orcs never eat vegetables or plants in general. If you see something green in an Orcish meal, it is NOT salad, it is decoration. Do not eat it if you want to avoid embarrassing moments.

If you do not like your food, quietly drop it to the floor below the table. Do not put it on your neighbor's plate when he is not watching.

Minstrels singing their silly songs during a meal can be annoying. Still, it is not appropriate to attack them. Only the weak are resorting to violence! The polite person just throws some leftover food at them.

Throwing pieces of bread, grapes or other kinds of food at the people on the other side of the table is a well known and entertaining game. But don't be excessive! Always make sure that the pieces of food are no larger than a chicken or a small duck, and that the consistency is not too soft or too hard. Also, bringing small catapults for this purpose requires a prior agreement.

I don't think so. Probably just an awkward coincidence.
I wish I believed in coincidences. I have to go. Have a great and green day.
Wonderful thank you very much! Would you be interested in another task?
Why don't you say something clever? Or at least try to?
That's great. Do they sell that somewhere?
The military secures the country's safety.
How did you solve your problems before I arrived?
Ready when you are, brother in arms!
Huh, some heroes you turn out to be.
Well, they made a fine mess of that.
Why didn't you just fight to the death? Then they would have been spared imprisonment.
Looking at the speed with which you kill each other, it's a miracle there are any of you left.
We normally drown rats like you.
You're not even suitable as a figurehead.
Maybe we could use you as a fishing lure.
Maybe we'll let you scrub the deck.
Kuan seems to be increasingly impatient! He expects more bloody sacrifices from us, and he is right, isn't he?
We should do better on the battlefield, don't you think? Otherwise Kuan will send us his ban.
Why is Kuan complaining so much lately? Is he expecting us to kill more?
Our soldiers don't seem to be interested in Kuan's will! Why is their fighting so uninspired?
How can we temper Kuan's bad mood? I think the only way is through more blood sacrifices.
When our God keeps on raging against us the next campaigns will be a disaster! What do you think about it?
Kuan said he'll curse the ones who are not willing to kill in his name! That makes sense.
We have to act much more unprincipled in battle! Kuan seems displeased with us.
If our useless fighters keep acting like cowards in battle, Kuan's punishment won't be far behind!
Kuan came to me in a dream! He told me of fires and earthquakes if we dare to lose the battle.

That snotty-nosed pompous fool of a baron! Always bellowing orders and making himself out to be something important!
When the time for fighting comes, he’s full of nothing but aristocratic bluster!
All his son does is stand around and stare!
If you run away, you'll die of exhaustion.

Ah, you're bringing me the Medallion of Wrath. Don't worry, Aurora knew how dangerous her job was. She died serving nature and will be welcomed into its arms. Here take this item as a reward and I wish you good luck on the rest of your journey.
We work crammed into the tiniest spaces.
Oh the things we do, so the family has gold to live on.
I exploit the minerals with my hammer and chisel.
Last week someone here died of exposure to poisonous gas.
I can hardly breathe down here.
Those spiders have destroyed everything. My life has no meaning.
Only weak creatures around here... boooooring.
Magic - so you're scared of a fair fight?
You want to see true magic?
Are you a helpful person? We all are.
Was do you hope to achieve in life?
Is it true that it's important to stand by your man?
Yes, yes, I know: You are much too busy to play with me.
My mother says that one is powerless to oppose the war.

Welcome!
Let me have a look at you. You exude an aura that I haven't felt in a long time. Ahh I remember, back in the days when the Seraphim were on the brink of failure! The object that you now carry with you brought about the turn of events.
Get away from me! That aura is corrupt! It has lost its purity. You must exorcise the demons from this blade, before the wall to the realm of the dead is destroyed forever!
Regular training keeps the combat strength up!
Kobolds, how disgusting! I hate how their blood gushes out...
Corpses are said to have their own very special appeal ...
I wonder what effect rigor mortis has on you, undead one?
I kill Humans like you by the dozens!
Know the power of the Inquisition, Shadow Warrior!
As promised, I've been rewarded with half the stolen gold.
All my brothers dead! It’s so sad, I can’t go on living without my family. Thank you for helping me my friend, but please go now so I can be alone.
A woman is being harassed by brigands. I am going to teach those scoundrels some manners!

Take this message to Shadow Shelly the herb woman!

Hey you! Would you do me a favor? The annual herbalists' conference is taking place soon. I have an invitation here for my old friend Shadow Shelly. She's rather forgetful these days and it would be a shame if she missed the conference. Please take this letter to her.

Kill Rogs, the traitor!

My former “friend” Rogs is an infamous traitor, villain and coward! When I get my hands on him I'll... but he took off of course. He went through this passageway. It leads directly to the volcano island. It's crawling with evil creatures down there. I'm too afraid to go down. Would you be willing to be the instrument of my revenge? Find Rogs and kill the traitor!
This region appears to be very dangerous.
Well then, your life as an adventurer seems to come to an end right here.
There's no need to rush, the spirits aren't going anywhere!

Travel to the Seraphim.

Ah, there you are! Somewhat late, for which you can expect to be disciplined later.
My team was investigating the magical leaks when we were captured by Orcs. Nasty business. Heads on stakes. No tea. Still, we showed them a thing or two - built a proper compound, for one thing - a child could have knocked over the other one.

You’ll be carrying on for us now. We learned the leaks are coming from a network of ancient pipelines. But it’s a complete mystery to this lot. You’ll have to go speak with the Seraphim to learn more. Head north to their Crystal Palace. And do try and be more punctual.
Go on. Bring me some herbs!
Say hello to your Gods from me!
We need to get away from here!
You are good, I have to concede that fact!
Fish again today, if only I had some dill to go with it.
*pained groan* Alright... alright, you win. *cough* Go and get your reward.
Nooses and traps? That's poaching, not hunting!
My arrow may have missed, but I put the fear of the Gods into that rabbit!
Did I miss? No! Well then, I pardon that wood hen!
Good weapons and nimble feet are what one needs for hunting bears.
... and in all the excitement, I mistook that wee Human for a deer...

You are actually trying to tell me you killed 200 crystal monsters? Seraphim Hudelisa only counted 198. Granted, she is very dutiful but also somewhat clumsy. I mean to say ... I don't know any other seraphim who ACCIDENTALLY rode a unicorn into the market of Oreford because she thought the barker was being tortured.
This will be the end of you, Green Skin!

5. Kuthar 129

Sunny
The temperature artifact reads 2 hands and 3 fingers

Purchased an ancient book from an adventurer at the market this morning. He claims to have found the volume buried under a mound of rubble in a remote cave and demanded 20 gold coins for his prize. We bargained and I forced him down to 18. This seemed a fair price to me.

The book - an old manuscript with lots of text and some magical symbols - seems most interesting. At first glance, I believe it to be of Ethurian origin, but I am not quite certain. The bulk of the text seems to be written in some type of code. I shall try to get to the bottom of this as soon as possible.

Bad heartburn from the chicken in pineapple sauce that Cookie served at midday.

Note: Tell Cookie - no more pineapple sauce!


8. Kuthar 129

Windy
The temperature artifact reads 1 hand and 8 fingers

A bad day. Cookie is ill. I have run out of clean goblets - and plates, for that matter! It looks as though I shall have to wash the dishes myself! How I disdain such profane drudgery!
The book is very promising. I had to remove several security runes in order to see the entire text. Unfortunately, it remains encrypted - I had hoped that removing the runes would reveal the clear text.
I have received a letter from the academy in Thylysium requesting payment of my annual membership fees. Those decrepit leeches!

Note : Have opened last bottle of Elven red wine!


9. Kuthar 129

Cool
The temperature artifact reads 1 hand and 3 fingers

Cookie is still bedridden. I have washed the dishes. Have not had time to work on book.

Note : When washing dishes - do not use spells, wands or other magical means to heat water!
Note : Need new burn cream!


12. Kuthar 129

Rain
The temperature artifact reads 2 hands and 1 finger

I have yet to make any progress with the book. The code is proving particularly obstinate - moreover, the text is presumably written in some ancient dialect. This does not make my task any easier.
My Lingua Arcana is quite rusty. Perhaps I should attempt the Galharis decryption method...alas I cannot recall the opening sequence. If only I could find his book in the library!
The "Summer 129 Mage & Druid Catalogue" has arrived! Fantastic!

Note : Ask Cookie to organize the books in the library in alphabetical order. I cannot work in this chaos!


15. Kuthar 129

Mild and cloudy
The temperature artifact reads 2 hands and 4 fingers

Cookie found Galhari's book jammed under the cellar door. Have now jammed a dissertation on "Alternative Approaches to Animal Metamorphosis“ by my former pupil Walter under the door. I hope he can find it in his heart to forgive me.
I can now finally begin decrypting the book. Still plenty of work to do. I had almost forgotten how complex the Galharis method is.
Have ordered new stuffed ravens from the Mage & Druid catalogue. They are a real bargain and the delivery is free of charge! Cookie can dispose of the old raven.

Note : Tell Cookie to order new Elven red wine (the cheap label for 2,95, not that expensive stuff from last time. After all, gold is the one thing I can´t make!).


18. Kuthar 129

Mild, windy
The temperature artifact reads 1 hand and 3 fingers

Mother is visiting. Cookie forgot to remind me of her birthday. Good servants are so hard to find these days! I gave Cookie a good scolding while Mother looked on. Despite (or because of?) this, Mother is still sulking. Cookie is also in a foul temper. Not a good day. Just try making sense of women!!!

Note : Buy flowers for Mother and Cookie!


25. Kuthar 129

Mild and windy
The temperature artifact reads 1 hand and 3 fingers

New raven has arrived - I immediately threw the old one on the compost. New raven is most impressive!

Brought Mother her new flowers - she nattered on about her various ailments. Everything is back to normal then!

Received a letter from the academy... I am to be assigned a new apprentice this year - hopefully not another work-shy dunce!

Note : Tell Cookie to bring the textbooks up from the cellar.


3. Tyrbor 129

Sunny, cool
The temperature artifact reads 7 fingers

Hey presto!
After 36 hours I finally decoded the entire text. It was indeed written in a very ancient form of Ethurian Lingua Arcana.
But what a disappointment! The manuscript is simply a guide to decoding magically encrypted texts! Eighteen gold coins and all that work just to find out that someone discovered the Galharis Method before Galharis!
Perhaps I can sell the manuscript to the academy, or to Galharis - if he is still alive. I have not heard from him for a long time now.

New apprentice arrives next week.

Note : Ask Cookie to clear out the attic!
Note : Ask Cookie to return "Alternative Approaches to Animal Metamorphosis“ to the library and jam Galhari's book under the cellar door!
If you take a break from all this running, you finally get a chance to admire all the detail you otherwise miss. Well, I've got it with detail by now.

Gravestone
Birne
He came, ate and saw there was nothing left...
Do not destroy me! I'm only an android, just like you! Take me to the repair unit so I may perform necessary repairs. There you'll be able to expand your memory.

Project Dragon Nemesis. Nemesis was the plan to finally destroy all of the Dragons which didn't belong on this world. In the event that the Dragons successfully attacked our fortress, the Great Machine, the serum was to be used.
So it has happened. The doomsday machine has been activated. The first ones to die will be the Dragons and the Elves... and then?
Go now, and don’t mention our little deal to anyone!

Anett Boelke
You just keep attacking the little ones and then expect them to grow.

Kill Magmadur, the Dragon!

The Seraphim and the dragons were once allies, but that was long ago. Today we mostly go our separate ways.
Recently the dragon Magmadur has become a thorn in our side. He's been destroying Temples and has devastated the area several times. That alone wouldn't be reason for violence, but he also killed our ambassador, my sister Katharina. That's why Sophia has sentenced him to death. Are you willing to punish Magmadur for his crimes? I'll send you to his cave right away.
Good, I have the hare paws. Let's see, what do I need next.
I'm also happy to see you're alive and kicking.
Please excuse me for not saluting. Unfortunately, you're just a civilian.
It's great to see you. I hope you aren't too desperate.
I greet you as well, and I have time for a chat.
I just finished a maneuver and I'm looking for some company.
It's you! I haven't seen you in a long time due to all this bloodshed.
Great! I'm happy to meet a lively citizen, you know how it is.
It's an honor to chat with you, no one can forbid that.  You are doing well I hope?
What a nice coincidence. We haven't met in a while.
I'm especially happy to see you here.
Press <$ID_CUI_RBBUTTON_INSERT> and select "Summon Mount" to call your mount.

I arrived at the camp of the Prince with the alchemist, where he was forced to explain the ritual. According to him, yet another ingredient is required to evoke the Devil´s Fire: the blood of a Garganthropod. This giant scorpion lives in the desert south of here. The Prince asked me to kill the monster and return to him with its blood.
The creature employs a blue reflective shield. Attacking while this is activated would be futile.
You can see the ice of the crystal region from here.
Alchemist Geroda has run out of reagents for his experiments. I need to bring him five mana stones, so he can continue with his work. The goblin charlatans that roam near here carry these stones.

Seek out the commander in the stronghold!

If you're looking for another worthwhile task, seek out the commander in the stronghold. Speak with him about the “special problem.“

The ‘Dragon’ turned out to be a screeching housewife who had been locked away in the cellar by her husband. I let her out of the cellar so that she wouldn’t starve. Now she won’t stop screaming about her husband, it's enough to give me a headache. I'm definitely too good for this world.
You really shouldn't make light of the subject! Our virtues help us remain in harmony with Mother Nature!
Without virtue there would be no peace! Do you think that we can live in this paradise without having to work for it?
You shouldn't talk like that, child! We were created in the Goddess' own image and we should live like her as well!
What if our fine Goddess were to hear that! She will only protect us as long as we live according to her standards.
But that is what is written, child! And they are the words and wishes of our Goddess! It would be best if you didn't anger her!
What do you think Kybele would do if she heard what you are saying? Do you want to be banished from paradise?
So? What's so terrible about it? In return you get to live in the Goddess' most beautiful garden!
Don't be ungrateful! Kybele is only asking you to give her what she deserves, and you should thank your Goddess for that.
Virtues are our most valuable possession and nothing can replace them! Not even freedom or equality.
That is insubordinate nonsense my child! Don't repeat what our Goddess' enemies say!
Decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Revered Technology and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Maybe I'll find something useful in your debris!
Mawino Barimak, patriarch of the family, mentioned a plan to secure his business.
The strawberries were perfect. Here, take these two healing potions as a reward.
Yeah, undead and happy, I know. But enough of that!
I delivered the stuff now and got my reward. Cassim was very pleased with my find.
Rebound - Adds a chance to reflect magic damage.
Sphere - Opponents within a certain radius around the Inquisitor will be hit and damaged by small streaks of lightning.
Counterblow - Adds a chance to reflect close combat damage.
Perfection - Increases the effectiveness against ranged damage.
Exploit - Each party member receives 5% of the damage intended for the Inquisitor.
The hunter has praised my skills and given me a reward.
I require a weapon with higher physical damage.
You Dryads are my natural enemies!
We would rather die in battle than to wait to be rescued in vain.
Your kind is at the bottom of my list, swamp toad!
Stop the moaning! I wouldn't give up fame and honor for anything, that's for sure!
You're supposed to be the best thing in aeons!
You are the heroine of Ancaria, right?
I would like to learn everything that you know.
Go now. The sooner you deliver the scroll, the sooner the undead souls shall rest in peace.
I have better things to do.

Ah! That's it then! The reason for this battle is a centuries old argument between two mages. And the magical energies released in the fighting practically turned the troops on both sides into undead. That explains why they are still here.
If I want to end this war, I must deal with the souls of the two leaders.
Regeneration Time of all Combat Arts
Hay Highbern has asked me to make sure the landlord's alright. His tavern lies on the outskirts of town.
Well, should we go to the port?
The mine owner's estate? It's back there.
Next we're going to the south east gate? Okay!
The southwestern gate is probably located south west of here, right?
Don't be afraid, I'll help you.
This player has asked you to join the party.

Farmer Ephrahim wants me to kill 20 spiders for him! Those monsters keep attacking his cows. The farmer fears for his livelihood. I'm supposed to get this spider plague under control by smashing 20 of the creatures.
Well then, I'm looking for a criminal who was executed 50 years ago. Sounds like an odd assignment.
The poacher in the next village cut his finger off. Now he can't shoot anymore!
Which cow stepped in my trap over there? It was set for deer!
Ha ha! I outsmarted that hunter well!
Argh! I've lost the animal's scent!
Gods of the sea, help me!
My magic hasn't grown rusty yet! Fight, you maggots!
Think about the materials required like the heart, the liver, and so on!
Cobbler Koller was satisfied and rewarded me.
I have killed all the spiders, and their guards too. Perhaps I'll get an extra rat for my troubles? Now I have to take the strings to the shaman and collect the rat.
Hey, you aren't supposed to hit a lady there!
That's going to leave a scar!
I'm warning you - don't make me mad!
Another blow like that and I'll scratch your eyes out!
You don't really think that I'm impressed by that, do you?
Over already? What a pity, I expected more from you.
I met a girl who showed me one of her mother's letters. She claimed I knew her father. I recognized the handwriting in the letter immediately, but how is that possible after all these years?
This mount looks pretty dangerous. I'd better wait a bit.
Fight any way you want! It will be you in the dust in the end.!
I don't talk to rabble like you. Get lost!

One of the Werewolves collects shrunken heads. He likes to cure and shrink olm heads, apparently it’s a great way to deal with stress. The Werewolf explained that he is a clumsy hunter and tears the olms to shreds when he tries to hunt them himself, so he has asked me to bring him five olm heads.
I was able to accomplish a small wonder today: I managed to make the air smelly out of nothing!
Every day I pray 6 hours for everyone whose soul is not ultimately lost. But will it help?
Tomorrow I'll go to the village and I'll try to talk to the Elves about my watchtower.
I've been with the mob every day and I'm preaching them the words of the Gods. Do you think it will bear fruit?
Tomorrow is the feeding of the poorest of the poor. They'll appreciate what we do for them.
The new school that we built, with the help of the cleric's resources, is finished. Will the children find God there?
My feet hurt! I spent the whole day on the top of a mountain and I preached to a lot of people!
If I could turn water into wine these spoiled Elves would certainly pay attention to me, don't you think?
We plan to organize a camp for the children again. Maybe it'll be possible to convert them when their parents aren't around?
There's an event with all kinds of religious artists tomorrow. Could that convince the skeptics?

Marc Oberhaeuser
...and can I just add: I hate you all and thank no one but myself.
Dragon tongue fetches top prices in the big Elven cities. Did you know that?
You haven't won the war! It was a tie!
Oh, it's just you. I thought you were still digging your well.
We had to stop work on it this morning - something very strange happened.
Stop making me curious, my friend! What is it?
The Elves will turn on us when they hear of what we found - I think it is the very gates of hell.
The gates of hell? How do you know?
There's a fire burning fiercely underground! With terrifying heat, and black shades that drift upward from out of its depths!
You must fill in the hole as quickly as possible, before we all meet our doom!
We did that straight away, believe you me! I shall be seeing you later, my friend!
The soldiers are happy because I followed their instructions.
I knew it. A damn Inquisitor! I will have you burning!
I wasn't wrong about the telling-off. The Seraphim gave him a warm welcome. Figuratively speaking. I think I'll take my leave now.

A landlord has asked me to fetch lumps of soil from Earth Elementals. The soil on his fields has been spoilt by T-Energy and he has heard rumors that these lumps can be used as fertilizer.
I will find Earth Elementals everywhere in the region.

I should avoid this city but I have to restock my supplies.

You?! What do you want from me? No! Get back! I know what you did!

Tear him to shreds my pretties, keep him away from me!
Arachnoids done. Spectral beings done. Detecting strange sounds, commencing analysis.

For the Great Inquisitor!
Even he gets cold in winter.
Let´s go hun, the smell of sulfur in this lair is disgusting.
The demon and his minions are dead. Alethea can now free herself.

Smoothroot the Shaman has asked me to gather seven wreathberries. Apparently he needs the berries to cleanse the well in his village. The berries only grow in areas inhabited by Trolls. Or to be more precise - they only grow in Troll turds.
Oh, pardon me, I am in a rush, and I almost didn't see you.
Where are you going on vacation, you miserable wretch? I'm surprised that you can afford such luxuries.
I'm not going on a trip. I'm leaving this area, and going to the land of the Elves.
Are you trying to kill yourself? You will never be able to make it over that wall.
Anything is better than living here in bitter poverty, believe me!
But at least you are free here.
I don't want freedom, I want meals that can actually be eaten. I would even endure slavery for that.
I hope you are not making a mistake, and that you survive the journey.
The regular reports about faith healers are helping fill up the Temple.
Only my faith can comfort me.
Only the Gods know why they putting me to the test with this poverty.
I grant shelter and comfort to the poorest of the poor.
I praise the Gods for this day!
There is so much evil, and so much corruption.
I should give a service for a good harvest.
One potato cooked in holy water won't fill an empty stomach either.
Servants of the Gods shouldn't have to resort to begging.

Prove your innocence in a duel!

Dryad you are accused of stealing important archaeological documents. You're also accused of killing a number of this expedition's participants. Those are serious accusations! Since you and Holo are the only survivors, it's his word against yours. May fate decide who speaks the truth!
I'll give you the bluescreen of your life!
A school is a great idea! Then you can teach children everything about the Gods!

Drive the Thraconians from the village!

Our scouts have discovered a village not far from here to the east. A strange machine is inside this village. A machine of the kind that even Elves wouldn't use. We would like to find out what this machine is all about. I need someone with combat experience for this task. I would not want to lose my recruits during their first assignment. In order to reach the village you will have to follow the northern pass around the mountain. Good luck.
My equipment doesn't protect me enough from fire damage.
Measure your powers against mine, Seraphim!

We are not there yet
How far must we still travel?
Will we arrive soon?
I'll visit the last family now.

Take the order to my men at the watch tower!

I recently sent a few men to the watch tower. I have now learned that the way there is overrun with Goblins! It is very important that the men concentrate entirely on the upcoming Thraconian attack, I want to be informed as soon as the Thraconians are here! I have a written order to hold the fort at all costs, would you deliver this order?
T-Energy... The source of all evil!
You are not looking too well around the nose...
The Oracle is ready to answer! I can’t wait to hear what he has divined!
How is your band of mercenaries faring, my son?
They are not mercenaries! We intend to field a powerful army against the Orcs.
Your cause is just - I would be willing to bless your weapons if you wish.
Not all of us are believers, Father.
As long as you gave me a share of your plunder, I think I could overlook that fact.
Some of the men won't like that. I don't think it's such a good idea.
In that case, you will surely lose in battle. I can tell you that now.
Our fighting spirit will win the day, you'll see!
Hmm. Waiting for your opponents to die of boredom? Novel strategy, but hardly designed to impress. Perhaps something a little more bloody, darling?

Cleanse your blade to stop the dead from resurrecting!

To clean the blade you must burn 10 undead hearts, 10 swamp herbs and a Rose of the Wind on a large fire. The steel can only be cleansed by those flames, but cleaning it alone isn't enough. You must also speak with the dead.
Go now, and clean your blade!
The mine owner was extremely pleased and gave me a handsome reward.
Busy Nadja has asked me for another favor. She needs 15 crystals from Stone Elementals. I'd love to know if she really needs all this stuff, or if she's just trying to look important.
Ah, there you are again! A man is still a king around here! Yes, indeed! We’ll take care of those troublesome wenches!

Gravestone
Be careful what you wish for - I wished to find a way to solve all my problems, now they're solved but I'm here.

A zombie poet lost ten pages of his trailblazing work on self-deliberation of the undead state. If the pages aren't found, this unique document will be lost for all eternity. I just can't allow that to happen ...
All my bags are stuffed, up to the last leather pouch.
This mount looks pretty dangerous. I'd better wait a bit.
Show my letter to the paymaster of this region. He will reward you accordingly.
I could earn money on this twice by telling the town guard about this case. Then I could add the bounty to the hush money.
This region is asking too much of my skills.

Kill Kraxa the Kobold and bring me his head!

This is outrageous! That stinking little Kobold Kraxa has put his filthy hands all over my sister! What a disgrace for my family! I beg you, kill the Kobold and bring me his head! I'll impale it on a pike and plant it in the village square.
Oh, a Mission... I couldn't possibly imagine anything better!
A memorial for the dead - that's what I call a nice gesture.
I have to learn how to deal with this quickly.
You can’t begin to imagine how horrible this feels. It’s so uncomfortable!
We'll get a fat prize out of this!

Catch the poacher who stole the turtle eggs and bring the eggs back!

Allow me to introduce myself! I am Mekeliel the Gamekeeper. I'm supposed to make sure everything runs smoothly here, but this place is in a sorry state lately. Last night after dark I saw someone moving around the spiny turtle nests on the beach, and sure enough, a few of the nests were empty this morning. All common spiny turtle - turtellus puncti - in Arcania are protected animals! Would you take on this task for me? Catch the spiny turtle egg thief and bring me the stolen eggs!
The secretary was very thankful, and oddly enough he tried to sell me a coffin. Maybe he should go out with living people more often.
I've really been looking forward to you!
I rarely see you at the remembrance of the dead nowadays. Don't you have the time anymore?
I'm sorry, honorable father, but my new hunting techniques are keeping me busy.
New techniques are good. The hunters don't bring home enough meat anymore.
I'm calling it “drive.” The hunters surround the game and then close in on it.
Very interesting. When will you try it?
As soon as we find some beaters who can bark loudly, so that the game is chased to the centre of the hunters' circle.
Why don't you ask the women? They would be perfect.
That's a good idea. I will discuss it with the Elders.
You seem to be born for war. Good luck, warrior!
Okay, I am a bad, bad High Elf. I am insensitive, cranky and a pain in the neck. But does that justify leaving me all alone here?

I spoke with the Prince and he made it clear that he urgently needs the Devil's Fire to claim the throne. There is a caravan transporting an important ingredient for the Devil's Fire to the brother of the dead King. The Prince asked me to attack this caravan and acquire the ingredient for him, in return for his gratitude. Gratitude schmatitude, I want some of that fire for myself! I should hurry, so I can stop the caravan before it reaches the Prince’s uncle.
With nature's force I will help you!
Indeed I am. My fields are dry and barren.
Yes, these times are hard on all of us. Feeding the family gets harder every day.
I've even wondered whether we shouldn't leave our land and cross to the other side of the wall.
Back to the old homeland? But they would make slaves of us! Is that what you want?
What is the point in being free, if we have nothing to eat? Tell me that, won't you?
I can't answer your question, but I won't serve the Elves - that I do know!
Oh, well... Then I guess we'll just have to wait for a miracle...

Difficulty Level: Bronze

Bronze is suitable for players who have never played an action roleplaying game or for players who prefer a casual game style.
Thank you! You’re a good soul. Liosilath must have sent you. Stick with him and you won’t go wrong.

Returned! Returned to the realm of the living. Returned to this miserable world full of weak, pathetic creatures. I was once a proud, courageous warrior, always in search of a worthy opponent. And when I finally found him, I would be able to descend to the Realm of Shadows with a clear conscience. But I was betrayed! I was torn out of death's sweet embrace, damned to life, damned to immortality. But I swear by my lost soul, that the living will pay for my suffering.
Was there something unclear about my plan? You seem a little hesitant.
I thought the dark side of the power would be different...
Quit the hacking and slashing - play with me instead!
I have studied you magicians closely. You are scum.
I think there will be a storm tonight, do you feel it brewing too?
I heard that there have been floods at the seashore. Have you heard anything about it?
Don't you find these these cloudy and misty days depressing?
Do you like winters without any snow?
I wonder how big the sun is, do you know?
There really aren't any more DeElficis around here, so the clergy will take over the trading post from now on. All that's left to do is to "remove" the business manager!
According to the coordinates, I have to find a place on the island of the Dryads.
Thank you for your help. If you would like to assist us further in our fight against the Kobolds, then I have an assignment for you.

Mer-Kil told me that the answers to my questions can be found in the High Temple of the Lost City. Once the capital of the High Elf empire, it's now a deserted place in the jungle. Doesn't sound fun, but I guess life can't be all killing sprees. The old Dragon opened a portal and told me to go through to save a good part of the journey. On the other side I should look out for the sign of the skull.
Thanks to my victorious duel, from now on no one will dare to openly cast doubt on Lady Eldredar's honor.
The opponents in this region use weapons inflicting mainly cold-based damage.
One little Orc in the forest all alone, along came a Shadow Warrior and then there were none
Do I need a pentagram or a hexagram for that?
Just out of curiosity, did you find the treasure?

Sacrifice to Kuan and receive his blessing.

Looks like another believer has found the way to the Rock Temple. You must have come to receive Kuan's blessing. But you have to make a sacrifice first. Bring him clean water and the sword of a stone warrior, and I will bless you.
Where am I supposed to put this?
I am not ready to fight this opponent yet.
A dying Orc told us he saw the gang leave towards the south. He said there's a village there in the mountains. That's where I should look next.
A lonely tomb raider has warned me about a cave where the king of the Minotaurs is residing. Perhaps I should look into that.
Five I say. Get da move on.
I have located the cave. I wonder what I am about to find in there.
This journey will be short. As soon as we reach a quieter neighborhood, I'll get rid of this smug nobleman.

That was the hidden variable? An ancient war with no meaning?
I still haven't progressed. Where do I come from? Where am I going? What was the serum's purpose? What good is a weapon that's not put to use?
Thank you. At least now I know what really happened to my son. Even if the truth hurts. I'll bury these two soldiers in my garden. Then no one will pursue you.

An officer by the name of Rengelwyn is missing one of his scouts. The scout was supposed to explore some caves nearby. Rengelwyn has asked me to find the scout and tell him that he is overdue. If he's still alive, that is.
At the academy, they always told me, Dragons were bigger than this...
Tempting! But I have to refuse.
Our husbands are so arrogant, they believe only men are fit for hunting!
That's true, sister. Yesterday, I got into a fight with mine about it.
We should prove to them that our strength and prowess are more than enough for hunting.
We certainly don't lack the courage, that's for sure.
What do you think? Should we band together to go hunting in secret?
I would enjoy that. Just imagine the look on their faces when we return home with the kills to prove our worthiness.
We shouldn't hunt big game at first. I'm a bit scared of large animals.
Alright then, we'll start with rabbits. They're wild animals too, right?
All enemies of the Inquisition are destroyed in these parts. Were will I find more heretics?

Find the creatures that are making the mysterious corn circles and bring back proof of their existence!

It all happened a few nights ago... I couldn’t sleep, so I went out for a walk. Suddenly I saw these round flying disks whirling about in the heavens and making circles in the cornfields. My father thinks I’ve gone mad, but I’ll prove that they really do exist! Go to the next village and bring me a book called “Irrelevant Ancarian Tall Tales.” Perhaps I’ll find a clue in one of the stories. Please help me prove that these mysterious creatures exist!
A young man named Carlos has asked me to help him slay a monster. He wants to impress his father. I wonder if he'll believe the story of Carlos' heroic deed.
Officer Galdar seems to be at the end of his ancient erutraiean. He wants me to talk to the mage. Maybe he has an idea.

Please deliver the horseshoes to my customer for me!

My, I've got more work than I can handle! Before dinner I have to forge 14 horseshoes plus 85 coffin nails and 8 pastry forks. How will I manage all this by myself? Could you please help me? Take these horseshoes and give them to my customer. He's already waiting for this delivery...
You don't deserve your second life!
Undead? I don't like to do things by half!
You'll make the transition from undead to dead soon!
A Human - and not quite dead. Disgusting!

The things that you're telling me about the world and your goals are scaring me. How can you betray everything we believe in? It's true, I was a thief. Yes, I killed. But I would never plunge the world into ruin!
I need the Troll shaman's heart!
I've reached the site. Let's load the pack animals.
Now you will die properly, undead!
Thank you! You've been a great help.
Oops, how clumsy of me. I've broken this vase. Well it wasn't a work of art anyway, but what's that? A Djinn?
My weapon for magic based damage isn't helping me any further.

Escort me while I search for the Na'Thuaigh!

Have you heard the news? They say there’s a Na'Thuaigh in the forest once again! These are very rare trees, and the Dryads say that they are sentient beings. That’s rubbish! No tree has ever been able to beat me in a game of Halma.
These Na'Thuaighs are quite rare, that’s for sure. The wood is highly sought after, and the snobbish High Elves pay large sums for it. This region is dangerous though, would you escort me?
I have the trollcherries. Now I can return to Fangor.
I freed Mary and took her back to the farmer. He gave me some gold. It's not much to me, but for the people here it must be a small fortune.
Are you a braver person than our soldiers?
I dream of being a good warrior like you.
What does a warrior do in times of peace? How does he earn his living?
Do warriors just fight, or do they do normal stuff too?
How do you know if the enemy sets a trap for you?
Oh man! Maybe we should leave that to soldiers!
This doesn't look so good for us...
Sometimes it's wiser to flee, isn't it?

Temple Servant
Destiny waits alike for the free man as well as for him enslaved by another's might.
Aeschylus
General Denyiw is planning a larger attack on the Undead Legion. He is writing an order to that effect right now.
Attention. Enemy officer within sensor range.
The woman was pleased and rewarded me with her husband's gold.

Ah yes... here it is.
A most tragic story. 100 years ago there was a general by the name of Terus. He commanded his army with an iron fist, and his desire for power was just as great as his strategic competence! In order to obtain his victories in battle even more effectively, he made a pact with the dark forces. But the evil forces betrayed him! The powers of darkness only wanted to gain control of the souls of the soldiers.
Fortunately Terus was interrupted by Lumen Priests during a crucial magic ritual, thus they were able to prevent all of Ancaria from being infested by an army of Demons. But the ritual was already underway so Terus and the soldiers were cursed. Every 100 years - that's what is written here - the soldiers must rise up out of their graves and bring death and destruction to the living. I must admit, I always thought that it was just a scary story. A story that might be told around a bonfire while holding a lantern to your face. Well I guess I was wrong. Please take these documents to Wylmieni.
If all those people come to Crag Rock, then my quiet hermit life will be over. Oh what the heck! I've lived in solitude long enough.
Lumen is the God of Light. His Divine Gift blinds all opponents with a dazzling flash and even ignites Demons and undead creatures.
That should be enough. I'm going to take the water bottles back.

Inquisition Guard
The supreme irony of life is that hardly anyone gets out of it alive.
- Heinlein
I'm not afraid of you, or your nag.
I cannot use this equipment yet.
This is an embarrassing matter and I hope you can keep it under wraps.
What? You want to know what's going on with the eggs? Hahaha! I'm sure you would like that! DIE!
I'm here to destroy the world, not to stand around waiting...
How can a magician be of assistance to you?
Please dismount, the ride ends here!
It's just a wee felon. Not at all dangerous!
What a bold fighter you are, venerable Orc!
I hope you have rabies or something similar...
I've gathered all the essences. Now I can return.
Warrior - you are pretty, but weak.
My lord - you are literally abounding with a need for action.
Remember - Those who want to be heroes, must get an early start.
Dear player. Please look at the help text for this item. What do you see? That's right, it is not meant for a High Elf. Thank you for your attention.
The Gods have made you slaves, so know your place!
The undead have no right to exist.
My magic is at your service.

Once more the runemaster's son stayed playing at the river bank longer than his father has allowed him to. The runemaster asked me to go look for his son. Afterwards he'll provide me with his services.
I need better protection against magic based damage.
I certainly did not expect to see you here. But, well, the more sword arms there are on my side the better.

Wantanor the Magnificent

The world trembled when his name was mentioned.
The Golem I killed seemes to be a giant version of Earth Elementals that constantly spawn from a magic pool. The Orcs use the area as a ritual fighting ground for their young warriors.
You should feed your body with some water.
You are real, aren't you? Reality can be terrible sometimes.
I want to run away but I'm so slow!
I met a little boy who got lost, he asked me to take him back home to his parents. Can't they look after their children properly?
What are you looking at? Do we know each other?
Watch out - people already gossip about you.
How do you like my new outfit?
You like the trees here, don't you? I think I've seen you before.
Fighting doesn't interest me that much.
If it hasn't rained for a long time, the corn pollen can tickle in your nose.  Have you ever noticed that?
I get tired and listless when the weather is gloomy for days, do you ever feel that way?
I like it when the sun shines bright at least once a day, do you like that too?
Does lightening frighten you?  I'm not as afraid during the day as I am at night.
Do you like to watch the interaction of clouds and sun too?
Faith - Reduces casting time for spells.
Fanaticism - Additionally increases attack and cast speed.
Contemplation - Increases the Inquisitor's dodge chance.
Resolve - Increases the Inquisitor's attack value.
Relentless - Increases the duration of Frenetic Fervor.

Hey diddle diddle
you'll be dead like a fiddle
Harpy Queen comes hither
takes your soul to wither.

Ah! That shower did the trick! Have a sniff, that fishy smell is almost gone!
Have you got the spume herb? Excellent! It’s just what I need. Thank you!
I've collected enough tongues. Let's see who won.
We 're missing one of our sisters. She went hunting three days ago and hasn't come back yet. Unfortunately I'm too busy to try to find her, would you please look for her?
Even simple High Elf folk know how to fight.
Conjures a fire demon which enhances the effectiveness of the High Elf’s Arrant Pyromancer combat arts. The demon is also able to cast Incandescent Skin and attack opponents with fireballs.
Hey, great plan! And quite a change to your usual head-against-the-wall tactics.
Damming up a lake like this... Those who try to put nature in chains are my enemies.
That would indeed mean a great deal of progress for everybody.
A bold plan. I wonder whether it will work.
Be honest, how long did you practice before you got up the nerve to deliver this speech?
Water ... it's not good for the joints.
You found the peas! That's great! We're having pea soup tomorrow! Thank you very much.
I don't want to die today!
I gotta get out of here!
If you can't die, then at least you should decay.
I delivered the building material. I doubt that a crystal hut will withstand much, but you can never know. Maybe I will come back later to see what happened to it.

Follow me! I have a lucrative business proposition for you!

Psst! Hey you! You look like you might be interested in taking care of some business for me. We can't talk about it here. Come with me. I'll explain it to you elsewhere.
You showed courage by going up against the Gar'Colossus! Kudos to you!
Your victory over the Gar'Colossus proved that you are a great warrior!
The shaman says you killed the Gar'Colossus.
The Gar'Colossus died through your hand?! How can that be?
There aren't many warriors who can rightfully claim that they defeated a Golem!
Attacking me... is a touching example of overestimating yourself.
What? Who? Leave me alone or else!

That double-dealing little creep! Look at that! That's the gold this rogue used to pay for the adventure tour. Do you see, it's fool's gold! It's not real. He picked the wrong guy to cheat this time. Go and kill that landlubber. I'll pay you well... with real gold.
I found tracks. They are leading towards a cave. I hope those brats didn't...
Right, now I do remember. The lake is over there.

We have to fight our way past the fog to get to the desert

Good! Now it's safe for the villagers to harvest the marigold. There's more than enough here to give the fog a good beating. Thank you again for your help. Your deeds won't be forgotten.
I don't want to delay your journey to the desert lands any longer. Just follow me, I'll show you the way. Be wary, we must fight our way past the fog.
Lianara gave me an artifact which will help protect me from poison when I wear it the right way.
I have to find that poor woman's amulet and take it to her daughter.
Decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Astute Supremacy and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Oh - a fine example of man.
My lord - I hope, that you know what you are doing. It would be a pity for you otherwise.
A razor and some new clothes couldn't hurt.
Jocelyn was very happy that her fiancé came back. Now the wedding can take place as planned.

I found the beer, as well as a survivor, at the site of the Orc expedition. The survivor is injured, but otherwise fine. He asked me to make sure he gets to the beach in one piece. He wants to build a raft for his return to the Orc territories. I've been promised a magic amulet if I can get him to the beach unharmed.
Could we go now please? The stench of the cattle is offending my sense of smell.
I'll go toil a bit more through darkness. Good luck to you.
I'm going to go ahead and go, before I get even more depressed.
It was nice and it was good, but I really must go now.
It was a pleasure to see you and that's no lie.
The passing of time has eaten up our meeting. Good luck to you.
Thanks for your time. I think I'll take off now.
It felt good talking to a brother in arms. Have a happy life if you can.
I hope there will be a tomorrow. I'm looking forward to seeing you again.
I have to go now, before we're completely wrapped in shadows.
Maybe we'll see each other again. Alive I hope!
Come on you wretches, and remember, I need spleen today!
Be careful when you're chopping them up, I didn't bring a cleaning spell with me!

Follow the Unholy Crusade’s mage to the chamber of rituals!

Back on your feet again?
I decided that it's time for you to join the Crusade’s inner circle. You'll learn more about our goals and plans soon. Accompany the mage and my men to the chamber of rituals - all will be revealed to you there!
The blind Lizardman was very pleased with the jade and rewarded me with a handsome sum.
Hurry, there’s no time to waste! Be careful! Pirates can be very nasty people.
If it protects as good as it looks, then I'm invulnerable.
Thylius was delighted by the evidence. He can use it to back up his case against the dead commander. Next we are supposed to seek out the healer in the hope that she can help us further.
I have won the duel and should bring the lady word of my victory.
Excellent! Go back to El-Darrag, I'll stay and flush out the remaining Desert Folk. With this victory, we've defeated them once and for all. Tell Murrat about our success.

Welcome! I am Rinah, Officer of the Inquisitor's Army. We live in an exciting age. The conflict between the clergy and the nobility continues to get worse, we can no longer rule out an escalation. That is why we need capable and loyal people with the courage to take on dangerous secret assignments. If you're ready join us in this matter, then let me know!
Maybe I'll unveil myself in this village, and deliver them all from their mortal existence.

Hello! Good job out there. Rescued the girls, knocked off mud-man, even turned the broker to the good side - although mind you, he’ll still take some watching.
I’ve heard of this place where the Gar'Colossus came from. Raw pools of magic coming right up out of the ground. Breeds monsters of all sizes. It’s where the young Orcs go to prove they can fight. Rite of passage and all that. It’s the one spot where you won’t find them at each others’ throats - they’re too busy killing monsters instead.
You have news from the Baron? Let's hear it then, but make it quick! We're running out of time.
Connection to PlayStation®Network lost. The game will now return to the title screen.
I shall call you by the name of “thing” ... hope that's ok for you.
Connection to Xbox LIVE lost. The game will now return to the title screen.
A duel with this opponent is not a good idea.

Find out what happened to the dead and wounded garema.

Greetings! My name is Mintuck, officer of this outpost. It's usually very quiet out here, far from all the strife and intrigue of the Capital. It's one of the reasons I asked to be stationed here.
Lately, though, I get a lot of strange reports about even stranger events. My scouts reported that badly wounded and even dead garema were found in the area. Some were badly battered.

Garema are a fierce people, but their internal disputes are usually without bloodshed or serious injuries, and they never fought against my troops. It would help me a great deal if I knew how the garema were killed. Would you be willing to look into it? Amradriel, my best scout will accompany you.
A young woman called Madalga is supposed to marry an older man. She hated the prospect so much that she's on the run now. She's asked for my help.
The dagger is rusted but studded with jewels. Maybe Amradriel can date it.

What do you want? You brought disaster on my family. I should kill you right now!
You have safely brought my grandson here though, which lessens my anger. Yes I too do not agree with everything TyBosso does, but we're family and we stand together.
Go in peace, but next time we'll meet it will be as enemies.
The local armorer has asked me to bring back fifteen Goblin swords. He wants to forge some plows and he hasn't got any iron.
Any Hero reaching difficulty level Niob.
You really think that was all of them? Get ready for the next round!
I hope you're not the new religion teacher.
Darn it! My father always said that if I wasn't good, you would come.
You must be a nightmare. I hope I wake up now.
That was certainly a fight for life or death!
Each fight must certainly take a lot of effort, doesn't it?
Did you collect the ingredients that I require? Remember, I need two Kobold hearts, five wild boar tusks and four stones of Earth Elementals.
It was a mistake to fight the Dragons. All we had to do was talk to them.
Hey, player! Stagnation is regression! Keep going!
They have warned me about these enemies.
To the tree huggers? Haven't I been through enough already?
No problem, I know the way.
And all that on foot again? No magic portal? - It was just a question.
At least I get to travel.
How are you good Sir? How is your family?
Life has to be lived, I suppose. Even if you are immortal!
These last tax increases have been crushing. The taxes will make paupers of us yet.
We've decided to grow our own vegetables instead of paying such exorbitant prices. We've even bought a pig!
Where are you keeping it, may I ask?
We've set up a corner for it in our bedroom.
That's shocking! How do you stand it? The filth and the smell... uuurrgh!
Well, I expect he'll get used to it...
I can actually see the grass grow! I can't believe how good I am!
Officer Beniel is worried about his betrothed. I'm supposed to find her and make sure that she's okay.

Stephan Hodes
Concerning performance issues, a wise man once said: Programmers love strings. Love hurts.
I have to admit that I underestimated this creature.
When you're done, I'll come to get their souls...
I have already heard the people speak of your heroic deeds.

May I introduce myself? My name is Hillarp, the trader.  But currently, I'm Hillarp, the soaking wet and bankrupt trader. It happened a few miles from here. I was on my way to this village with my cart, when it suddenly lost a wheel and ran into the river. I couldn't do anything but watch my goods, my cart and horses being flushed away. It's a miracle that I'm still alive. I was supposed to deliver ten boar hides for the local innkeeper, but now I've got nothing. If at least I had the ten hides... they would make enough money to buy a new horse and maybe start a new business. Could you get me the ten boar hides? I've seen quite a lot of wolves right outside the village. They're everywhere.
The Shadow Warrior is able to conjure spectral soldiers to accompany him. These apparitions will remain until they are extinguished.

A letter from Kirich to TyBosso... It says, "Whoever finds this letter, take it to TyBosso DeElfici. There will be a reward." I don't think Kirich is around anymore. Well then, I should look for him in the Dragon territory.

Der Reiter wollte uns töten und die Ware stehlen. Euer Escheinen hat ihn wohl gestört. Gut das ihr mich gerettet habt, mein Freund hat es leider nicht überstanden. Aber ich werde noch Rache nehmen, dieser Bastard.
Starting identification sequence. Five items collected, memory activated. You set the trail yourself! ... BEEP! ... Keep searching for the past ... BEEEP!
Who's supposed to carry all that stuff?

An unbelievable incident!
Jugala's ghost took over the shaman and now she is threatening us all.
Didn't we have an agreement that told you to stay in your trees?
You Dryads couldn't even add up one plus one!
Look, an exotic like you is exactly what my collection is missing ...
Hello, Dryad, welcome to the big wide world ...
Do you Dryads still carry peashooters as weapons?
The gang "parted" with the head. I can return.
The High Elf steps into the shadows and teleports to a different location. There is a chance that nearby opponents remain stunned when the High Elf teleports away.
Well well, the Lord of the castle is behind all this. I should have known. Now we can arrest him thanks to this witness's testimony. Good work.
The demon has been destroyed and Alethea is free.
I found Figmiyen! She's already gathered some information about this place.
Fights have never been won by running away.
I have picked the flowers for Lumen.
Did you get the Goddess' advice in the matter of the Blood Dryads? More and more of us are being senselessly killed in battle against them.
How are you coming along with your investigation of these so-called Blood Dryads? We're counting on your help.
The Blood Dryads are continuing their murder spree and you are looking for Godly advice! When will you be able to tell us more about these creatures?
If you don't help us find the Blood Dryad's nest soon, there will be no one left to defend you!
How do we overcome the dreadful hags called the Blood Dryads? Why is the Goddess still silent?
We need your help in our battle against the hateful Blood Dryads! Why is it so difficult to find their stronghold?
Can't you help us? How are we supposed to defeat the murderous Blood Dryads if we don't know anything about them?
We will only be able to overcome the threat of the Blood Dryads if you reveal your secret Priestly knowledge, do you understand that?
Without help from you Priests we're fighting a losing battle against the gruesome Blood Dryads, don't you see that?
When will you reveal to us how we can defeat the Blood Dryads? They are afflicting us with their deadly power!
The pack animals are carrying as much as they can. I should return now.
We found the robbers and we defeated them! Perhaps I should have a look around.
Any Hero has maximized one modification of one aspect.
I will destroy the entire world!
The Mayor of Tharum wants me to get his horses back from the horse thieves, then take them to his middleman at the port.
Please... you'd be doing me a huge favor.
I always wanted to die at sea...
Not such a stupid landlubber after all...
Gods of the Sea, I'm dying...
Get out of the way, we have to work! What do you want us to do? Clean up? Wrong my dear. We're taking it apart!
The boy has his kite back. I hope his sister likes the amulet!
I have located the Chronicler in a small village. He was very pleased to finally be given the Lost Lorebook of Atherton and rewarded me with an ancient artifact.

Successfully retrieved shrunken head. I must now leave this village. The Demon follows me, I will deal with him some time soon. According to my information, the second key is located in the Dragon realm.

Kill Daloriel the Depraved and his minions!

Help me! Finally, a living soul! I thank Lumen that you are not another one of these dreadful T-Energy creatures. I am a scientist and I was investigating old ruins with the help of my assistants when Daloriel the Depraved and his minions attacked us. I was able to escape but I don't know what happened to my assistants. I presume we have to fear the worst. Please kill this monster and save the lives of others.
Significantly enhances the effects of all potions. Enables the alchemist to detect hidden attributes of usable items.
The Werewolf was very pleased. He has plenty of material for his hobby now.
No, please look for someone else.
Kuan's anger is terrifying! We have to appease him.
That was a hard fight, but this band won't be plundering any more Temples.
Target Focus - Increases the chance that opponents cannot evade or parry incoming hits.
Life Leech - Leeches life from the target and adds it to the caster's life.
Steal Mana - Steals combat art energy from opponents.
Critical - Increases the chance to land critical hits.
Stray Damage - Chance to hit nearby opponents.
Too weak an enemy is bad for the morale... and the droprate.
The farmer gave me a part of his profit from the vein of gold.
Again, something that I have no use for.

Ok, what is in this letter... Bla bla bla... hm... hm... AH! Here it is:
"You have to find as many eggs as possible!"

No really! I knew that much already. Oh, there's more:
"Many eggs mean wealth!"

What is that supposed to mean?! One of these strange guys is just about to enter the cave. I should follow him. Maybe I can learn more.
That's exactly why I'm here for.
A strange decoration for a temple of the Gods...
Gnawing rats ... gnawing rats everywhere! But I think I have killed enough of them now.
The fisherman wants me to visit his competitor and give him a “special treatment,” so off I go.
A group of travelers was attacked, and the men were cut down. A dying man told me that the women were kidnapped and taken into a cave...
The secret lies within nature itself. I also wash them regularly in the blood of my enemies.
It's really simple. Kill your enemy at a full moon and run the sword through his corpse. Then the blade won't dull.
I can only tell you this much: The ancestors have to touch them, that's where the sheen comes from.
I get that question a lot, but I can't reveal my secret.
It's as easy as it is efficient: You need to polish the blades with a paste made from wild boar liver and blue clover.
I'm also surprised by how long the sheen lasts. I only use wild duck droppings as a polish.
Civilians can't understand these things. The sheen represents our bond with the weapon.
I don't really know. Maybe if you kill enough, the blade doesn't dull.
How should I know? Ask the shamans, they bless our weapons.
I only use first-class weapons, as every professional killer should.
You're in my way - what ever you are!
I have all the organs. There are a few less crazy cats now too, that's an added bonus.
You will fall like withered leaves ...
What a surprise! The corpse still has both hands! The hands that the clans bear must be forgeries!
Gods, the things that are expected of me... Alright, I'll do it...

We often give our enemies the means for our own destruction.
- Aesop
Phew... that was a close shave! We are in your debt, and we'll never forget what you've done for us.
The children have got their balloon back.
That scoundrel has taken me for a ride. Wait until I get my hands on him ...!

One of the captured girls told me that another man is behind the Human trafficking. Apparently her sister knows who it is, but she is severely ill and will probably die soon. The girl I rescued begged me to find a Scroll of Release in order to save her sister's soul. I should be able to obtain such a scroll at the local healer's.
The new battle prayers for shamans are useless! Isn't there anything more effective for me?
What am I supposed to do with these new battle prayers? Their effect is barely noticeable, and the enemies just laugh about them.
Why are the battle prayers they teach us so bad? Kuan never even appeared!
I always trusted the battle prayers, but lately they don't seem to work anymore!
What's wrong with the battle prayers? The new series is completely illegible and nothing happens!

Book 6 - Ancient and Foreign Recipes

Countless ancient books and fragments of scrolls are stored in the libraries of the realm; yet only a handful of those books deal with the art of cooking. The only surviving copies are the “Ye Great Booke of Foode” by the Elven Highlord Taurith of Graat - written 829 Old Time - and “What Thou See Is What Thou Eat” by an unknown Human Nobleman, written probably before 600 old time. Both books contain a number of rather odd suggestions for food. Many of the ingredients are hard to come by these days, other recipes are particularly strange and nobody would even consider eating their results anymore. Since both books are written in a fairly arcane language, it is sometimes hard or even impossible to translate the passages into the modern languages of Ancaria. Some parts of the content appear to be completely lost in translation. Still, those books are highly interesting, not only for those who are interested in cooking. They are also contemporary documents and give us insight into the history of our world.

Excerpts from "Ye Great Booke of Foode"
 by Taurith of Graat, approx. 830 Old Time:

Goblin in Mustard Sauce

Kill some Goblins. Remove their heads, hands and feet. Fry them in a big pan, with salt, pepper, garlic and some ham. When the skin turns brown, remove them from the heat. Add onion rings to some water, boil for several minutes. When the onion rings are soft, take the pot off the fire. Take a brush and mustard. Apply the mustard to the goblins, make sure the entire surface is covered with mustard. Take the onion sauce, pour it over the Goblins and serve them. If you like your Goblin a little more spicy, take some pepperoni, chop it into very small pieces and season the Goblin with it.

Scrambled Harpy Eggs

Steal 2-5 Harpy Eggs, beat them lightly, add seasoning. Melt some fat in a saucepan and pour the eggs in. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the egg begins to thicken, then remove it from the heat and let it cool down. Serve the Scrambled Harpy Eggs warm with some bread.

Giant Ravenous Llama Goulash

Gather a few friends and take down a Giant Ravenous Llama.
(As a rule of thumb: one Giant Ravenous Llama serves approximately 8 people.)
Be careful, those Llamas are dangerous creatures. Avoid their toxic spittle under all circumstances, always wear your safety goggles. As soon as the Giant Ravenous Llama is dead, skin it and remove all organs. Place it into an oversized pot with some water and cook for several hours. When the meat turns gray, remove it from the heat. Separate the meat from the rest of the bones and cut it into small pieces. Put those pieces into a pot and set it aside.
Put Onions, Ginger, Pepper, Mace, Salt, Vinegar and some wine into the oversized pot. Add some pints of water, throw in some dried squirrels and boil this mixture for half an hour. Remove it from the fire, then take a huge frying pan and put all pieces of Llama meat into it. Fry for several minutes, until the meat is dark brown. Add it to the sauce. Stir well and serve it.

Basilisk in Bacon Wrap

Put a bag over a basilisks head and kill it. Skin it and remove all organs, fill the chest with onions, apples, salt, pepper and cinnamon. Wrap slices of bacon around the basilisk and fix them with thread. Put the basilisk on the fire and roast it for 15 hours (basilisk meat is quite resistant to heat, so it will take a while). Serve it while it is still hot and remember to avoid eye contact with your dish.

Forens is the Goddess of Philosophy and Wisdom. She is the goddess who inspires men to ask the question “why?”.  She endows people with the power of speech, wisdom, and learning.  She is also elusive, just as the answers to the great questions are elusive.MythologyForens is a constant wanderer between the worlds. She is constantly moving around the universes, back and forth into time, but at the same time, she's omnipresent. Whenever a new universe is created, she is the first one to bring “the word” to it, which is a synonym for enlightenment and speech. Because just like living beings, “the word”needs to be created, it doesn't come naturally. For her, a  world without words, without thoughts and questions is a lost world, empty and without a soul. Living beings need to learn, because that's what makes them living beings. Therefore, Forens is on an eternal quest, trying to evoke the fire of asking in every race and being.AppearanceLike any other god, Forens has multiple forms of appearances. In the elven mythology, she's displayed as a beautiful woman, with black hair and shimmering eyes, which - if you look into them - contain the entire universe. In other regions, Forens doesn't have a human or even physical form and is just a shining halo, talking with a deep, soft voice.The CultThere are temples dedicated to Forens in every bigger town in Ancaria. Especially amongst the intellectual circles, Forens is a very popular Goddess. Every elven University in Ancaria has a small chapel, dedicated to Forens, where students meet every week to pray and ask for blessing and enlightenment. In the rural regions of the world, the cult of Forens is not as popular, although some local groups in certain elven areas are still worshipping her.The symbol of Forens is the candle. It represents the light, that's being ignited to bring knowledge into the darkness of the mind. High priests of the cult wear an embroidered candle on their robes.A side arm of the main cult follows the “Codex Forens.”  It's an ancient manuscript, containing long chunks of philosophical and theological text. The author claims, that Forens herself has insinuated everything to him in long sessions of trance and meditation. However, the main cult leaders don't believe this version, so this sub section of the cult is operating independently.Opponents and SupportersAlthough Forens supports Testa and Lumen, she is actually an independent goddess and does not interfere much in the struggle between the other gods.  She instead prefers to focus on her eternal quest.

Book 3

Two-handed Swords

“ The Gods had their reasons for giving us two arms. Encumbering one with a wooden board was not one of them.”

Two-handed Swords

In many ways, two-handed swords (aka “Great Swords”) are the kings of swords. They are similar to their single-handed counterparts, but yet so superior. A blow from a two-handed sword, unblocked and delivered with full force, is devastating. No armor can withstand such a blow, if it is not magically enhanced with protective or deflecting spells.

Although the weapons are kindred, it is impossible to compare the techniques of fighting single-handed swords to two-handed swords. The mass of a single-handed sword is small enough to be completely controllable by a human arm. However, the two-handed sword is far too heavy for that. Two-handed swords are impact weapons, the edge is usually not overly sharp and all the damage results from the mass. Swiftly swinging a two-handed sword requires intensive use of leverage and the swing momentum of your weapon. Precision is very important, because once the blade is in motion, it is very hard to correct the blow, let alone stop and change it. The two-handed sword fighter can chose from a wide variety of moves and blows and thrusts. As with most melee weapons, the most successful moves consist of the combinations of different blows. A long swing, distracting the defense, followed by a sudden, hard thrust to the face is hard to counter.
Two-handed swords are purely offensive weapons. It is extremely hard to block or parry with them. In a fight against any single-handed weapon, the two-handed fighter will always try to land the first blow, while the one-handed weapon fighter will try to get past the critical range and into close range combat, where the great sword is no longer as effective. Many great swordfighers carry a secondary close range weapon, dagger or rapier, on their belt as a backup weapon.

“Watching a duel between two-handed swords is like watching a dance rather than a fight.”

A mirror matchup on the other hand is completely different. A duel between two masters of great sword fighting is highly aesthetic and exciting to watch. Both sides are constantly trying to anticipate and counter the opponents moves and actions. It is the battle of two minds as well as the fight of two swords, and the win usually goes to the fighter who managed to land the first blow by unbalancing his opponent or tricking him into leaving a gap in his defense.

Polearms

“This wound was delivered by a WHAT?”
Chyriac, field surgeon of King Larenoir, examining a body mauled by a polearm

Although there seem to be many similarities between greatswords and polearms, the fighting style is in fact completely different. Unlike greatswords, polearms concentrate the mass of impact to a much smaller area, making the blow considerably harder, but at the same time more difficult to land.
Unlike the greatsword, which has a relatively small hilt compared to the rest of the blade, the polearm features a much larger part for the control of the weapon. The pole can be up to six feet long. The wide grip means excellent leverage and thus extremely fast motions. A skilled polearm fighter is able to deliver any kind of blow out of a resting stance with no preparation.
For the same reason, blocking is a lot easier with a polearm than it is with a greatsword, leaving the fighter more options to adjust his style. Polearm fighters have no need to be as aggressive if they prefer to fight defensively. Many polearms have a buttspike for close range combat.
However, the same tactical basics hold true for all two-handed weapons: their main advantage is the range. Once the opponent is too close, the weapon is weak.
Without any doubt, the most efficient use of polearm fighters is in battle situations. A group of polearm fighters, protected by a defensive wall of shields is extremely hard to eliminate.

Spears

“I didn't see that coming...”
 Last words of Duke Throidor, who died from a spear in the battle of Ai'Unthain

Spears are pure thrusting weapons. There is no blade, there is no edge... just a spearhead. The shaft of the weapon is up to nine feet long and extremely hard to control. A spear is not the best choice for duels. But in battles, a skilled spear fighter can eliminate dozens of opponents. An incoming spear is extremely difficult to see - by the time you do, it is usually too late. Therefore, thrusts to the face from behind a wall of shields are the most effective tactics in open field battles.
