Ancient and Foreign Recipes

Countless ancient books and fragments of scrolls are stored in the libraries of the realm; yet only a handful of those books deal with the art of cooking. The only surviving copies are the “Ye Great Booke of Foode” by the Elven Highlord Taurith of Graat - written 829 Old Time - and “What Thou See Is What Thou Eat” by an unknown Human Nobleman, written probably before 600 old time. Both books contain a number of rather odd suggestions for food. Many of the ingredients are hard to come by these days, other recipes are particularly strange and nobody would even consider eating their results anymore. Since both books are written in a fairly arcane language, it is sometimes hard or even impossible to translate the passages into the modern languages of Ancaria. Some parts of the content appear to be completely lost in translation. Still, those books are highly interesting, not only for those who are interested in cooking. They are also contemporary documents and give us insight into the history of our world.


Excerpts from "Ye Great Booke of Foode"
 by Taurith of Graat, approx. 830 Old Time:

Goblin in Mustard Sauce

Kill some Goblins. Remove their heads, hands and feet. Fry them in a big pan, with salt, pepper, garlic and some ham. When the skin turns brown, remove them from the heat. Add onion rings to some water, boil for several minutes. When the onion rings are soft, take the pot off the fire. Take a brush and mustard. Apply the mustard to the goblins, make sure the entire surface is covered with mustard. Take the onion sauce, pour it over the Goblins and serve them. If you like your Goblin a little more spicy, take some pepperoni, chop it into very small pieces and season the Goblin with it.

Scrambled Harpy Eggs

Steal 2-5 Harpy Eggs, beat them lightly, add seasoning. Melt some fat in a saucepan and pour the eggs in. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the egg begins to thicken, then remove it from the heat and let it cool down. Serve the Scrambled Harpy Eggs warm with some bread.

Giant Ravenous Llama Goulash

Gather a few friends and take down a Giant Ravenous Llama.
(As a rule of thumb: one Giant Ravenous Llama serves approximately 8 people.)
Be careful, those Llamas are dangerous creatures. Avoid their toxic spittle under all circumstances, always wear your safety goggles. As soon as the Giant Ravenous Llama is dead, skin it and remove all organs. Place it into an oversized pot with some water and cook for several hours. When the meat turns gray, remove it from the heat. Separate the meat from the rest of the bones and cut it into small pieces. Put those pieces into a pot and set it aside.
Put Onions, Ginger, Pepper, Mace, Salt, Vinegar and some wine into the oversized pot. Add some pints of water, throw in some dried squirrels and boil this mixture for half an hour. Remove it from the fire, then take a huge frying pan and put all pieces of Llama meat into it. Fry for several minutes, until the meat is dark brown. Add it to the sauce. Stir well and serve it.

Basilisk in Bacon Wrap

Put a bag over a basilisks head and kill it. Skin it and remove all organs, fill the chest with onions, apples, salt, pepper and cinnamon. Wrap slices of bacon around the basilisk and fix them with thread. Put the basilisk on the fire and roast it for 15 hours (basilisk meat is quite resistant to heat, so it will take a while). Serve it while it is still hot and remember to avoid eye contact with your dish.


Evidently, all those recipes sound rather odd; in fact, some of them are quite extraordinary. Therefore, this book is considered a hoax by some historians. Others are suspecting sloppy translations of arcane language parts. However, even the most renowned researchers choose their words carefully when they are talking about the older book “What Thou See Is What Thou Eat”. The oldest fragments of this book have been found during an excavation at an ancient High Elven ruin site. The condition of the book is rather poor, many pages have been completely destroyed and the rest was heavily damaged by water. In addition, it is written in a very old Human dialect, which has been completely lost for centuries. Still, some parts of the book have been deciphered and copied.


Excerpts from "What Thou See Is What Thou Eat"
by unknown author, approx. 600 Old Time:

Vampire Tarte Flambee

1-2 vampires
1 wooden stake
55 garlic bulbs
3 onions
parsley
absinthe

Stake a Vampire. Leave the stake in his body to paralyze him. Place him in a large pot along with garlic, onions, absinthe and (very little) parsley. Wait until sunrise, then place him into the light for just under a minute (or half a minute if you prefer your vampire medium).

Squirrel Stew

50-60 squirrels
10 gallons of water
3 tomatoes
salt
pepper
mace
thyme

Throw the squirrels into a large pot. Chop the tomatoes into small pieces, add them to the squirrels, then add the water and boil everything for an hour, while constantly stirring it with a large edgar. [translator's note: edgar = ancient term for a large cooking spoon]
As soon as the consistency is getting thicker, add the salt, pepper, mace and thyme. Stir it again with the edgar and finish it with some more salt for seasoning.
Serve the squirrel stew with a bit of cream on top and eat it while it's hot.

Magic Scarabaeus in a Dumpling

20 scarabaeus
wheat
eggs
onions
pepperoni
sugar
salt

Collect 20 magic scarabaeus, remove their wings and antennae. Place the eggs, wheat and some water into a bowl, mix them together until you have a dough. Cut the onions and pepperoni into small pieces, add them to the dough. Take the beetles and wrap the dough around them, forming a dumpling for each scarabaeus. Roast the dumplings on a fire until the surface is brown, then remove them from the fire and add some sugar and salt for seasoning. To soften the rather strong beetle flavour, serve them with sour cream and vinegar.

About the Lore of Anatomy

The lore of anatomy is the study of the structures of living beings. It considers the mechanical functions of muscles and bones as well as the location of organs and their functions. A solid knowledge of anatomy is essential for any kind of healer. Anyone who deals with anatomy needs a keen mind, a quick wit and sharp knives. Not feeling queasy easily is also advantageous.

Although anatomy is one of the basics of the lore of healing, scientists dealing with this branch of science are often sneered at, belittled as "squints" or indeed "ghouls" and some people even imply that they lack the intelligence to cure diseases and that is why they cut open dead bodies instead. Still, despite all the ridicule and the abuse, anatomy is a complex and serious science.


Famous Anatomists of Ancaria

Kyrilath (*561 +352 Old Time)

Kyrilath is without a doubt the most famous anatomist of Ancaria. His works "Fauna Ancaria" as well as "Mechanics of the Body" are standard references. Some of his lesser-known books were written in a more popular scientific way and include "How to Disassemble a Skeleton" and "Sections on Your Kitchen Table - A Compendium for Hobby Anatomists." Least of all known is the fact that Kyrilath even ventured into the field of literature: His novel "Pighead" describes the fictitious conversations of an aging scientist with a skeleton. In his lifetime, Kyrilath went on three major journeys. During these journeys, he carried out extensive examinations and he drew very detailed sketches. At the age of 209 he tragically died during a swimming accident. One of the wings in the University of Thylysium is named after him.

Sebathiano (*1042 +742 Old Time)
 The fact that the science of anatomy is often sneered at and even classed as somewhat disreputable is in part due to Sebathiano and his life's works.
Sebathiano was a mix of researcher, adventurer, mystic and (probably) necromancer. During his extensive travels he visited all known continents and carried out studies in almost all scientific and non-scientific fields. Anatomy was one of his passions. No other researcher ever cut open as many bodies as he did. Some reports say that Sebathiano even ventured onto raging battlefields in order to examine the fallen (and in some cases not quite so fallen) bodies right on the spot. Cemeteries and morgues were reputedly also some of his favorite locations to acquire objects for his studies. Many scholars of his time claimed that he was on the verge of insanity. They also accused him of merely using his anatomy research as an excuse to further his true interest, which was necromancy. However, he always succeeded in rebutting these accusations while he was alive.

Sebathiano died under mysterious circumstances during an experiment while attempting to channel lighting into a dead body.

Enyaris (*15 New Time )
 Enyaris is said to be one of the masterminds of modern anatomy in the academies of Ancaria. He was the first to take the trouble and catalog all known studies and works of this field; he corrected all mistakes and then merged all the knowledge into one resource. The result of years of work is the "Complete Bestiary of Ancaria", which describes in fifteen volumes the body structures of all known living beings. Furthermore, he considered philosophical and anthropological questions. Sometimes, he refers to himself as the "possibly last real researcher."

Bengaresh

Geography and climate: Bengaresh is a surreal land. It is covered by huge sand and gravel deserts that seem endless in the oppressive, shimmering heat. The eye welcomes the rare sight of a small oasis in this monotonous landscape. At the coast one may find rock formations that the sand has shaped into smooth forms resembling animals or demons. The natives tend to avoid these formations. Upcountry it is silent. There is no wind, and the air burns like fire in one's throat. At night the heat turns into a bitter cold only familiar to those who have spent time in the land of the Orcs. Sometimes sandstorms strong enough to rip the flesh from one's bones sweep across the desert. At the coast the constant breeze causes an itching layer of salt and sand on the traveler's skin. It never rains.

Inhabitants: Only a few beings are dumb enough or proud enough to challenge the desert. No one knows why the descendants of Elves are among them. They roam the land as nomads, traveling from one oasis to the next and live off goat meat, dates, cacti, and milk. With Elf merchants who come on ships they trade gems and salt from the mountains and get food, clothing, and weapons in return. The desert tribes are no seamen and tend to remain near the coast when they go fishing in their longboats. They almost never stay at sea during the night.
The tough desert life has changed the Elves' appearance over the long centuries. Most are thin, with dark leathery skin. Their eyes are slitted as if from staring too long at the sun. In contrast to their ancestors they only pray to one God: Testas, the God of science. Every tribe follows their own interpretation of the holy scriptures. During large gatherings this can lead to heated theological debates, but these rarely turn violent.

Strangers are welcome in Bengaresh and are usually greeted with calm friendliness. The desert tribes are always helpful, but never brash. Behind the black scarves that protect their faces from the sun and the sand hides a dry sense of humor that has surprised many travelers. Maybe this is the result of the constant struggle against a land that seems set on killing all life on it. Whatever the reason, a sense of humor is more than welcome around the camp fires of the tribes.

Places of interest: Khorum, the capital of Bengaresh lies in the center of the land, at the hottest, driest, and most silent place in Ancaria. It lies on a hill and is surrounded by rocks and sand. The walls are made from yellow stones that blend in with the desert and seem to almost disappear in the shimmering heat. These walls have protected its inhabitants from sand people attacks for centuries.

Practices: Most practices in Bengaresh are connected to water. Drinking from the well of another tribe is an offense punishable by death. Spitting is considered rude. Spilling water is considered bad luck, spotting a cloud brings happiness. Every meal is prepared with either milk or oil, only the strong tea made from cactus blossoms is cooked with water.

Recommendations: Travelers who despite the climate wish to visit Bengaresh should do so during the Great Gathering when all the tribes meet in Khorum for the year's weddings. The festival only ends when the last couples have been wed by a priest. This can take days, sometimes even weeks. To pass the time more quickly many turn to chewing desert weed. Officially, this practice is forbidden, but during the Great Gathering no one cares.

I have delivered the talisman. The parents of the dead soldier were very upset about the loss of their son. Life can be harsh.
Fiery Demon! I will play a bit with you!
There's no use moaning about it. We can't let them die, even though some of them probably deserve it.
I've been thinking about that. Maybe we're too soft. We should raise prices.
Yes you're right, but I can't just let someone bleed to death. It upsets my stomach.
Unfortunately the Gods have given us the gift of healing. Otherwise we could invent health insurance.
Yes, it pains me too. On the other hand we know that great power comes with great responsibility.
We can't let them lie screaming on our doorstep until they start believing. That's just not doable, we'd never get to sleep with all the noise.
I understand, but this is a gift from the Gods. We can't use it for our own purposes.
I don't know what to say. We should at least help the poor so we can keep up appearances.
I agree, but the rabble just doesn't know the word “gratitude.”
That's a serious issue which also highlights the problems with this whole “faith should be free” attitude.

Uncover the dark forces in Badawi!

I wasn't sure if I could trust you at first, but you've done some good things here in Badawi so I'll take my chances. This is the problem: Trials are conducted here which could be classified as a sort of "selection process." During this process, kidnapped individuals are forced to fight against trained gladiators. The few who survive don't last much longer in the arena, the rest are slaughtered during the selection process.

A selection is scheduled for this very moment and we must stop it. I am in contact with the High Elf agent who wants to reveal the whole scheme. Tell him you have come from me and he will brief you.
Luckily I was able to convince Buckley to give me the talisman. I hope it's not too late.

You found them! Thank you! You bad kitties! Where were you?
I have a reward for you too! My Mommy said that if a hero does something for you then the hero has to get a reward. Here look what I found!
I am happy to accept this assignment.
I escorted the ogre to the coast. He should be able to find his way home from here. At least I hope so.
Summons a protective barrier of earth and stone
Remember: You are playing a High Elf - they cannot do anything with that...
I know what a great exit has to be like ...
Everybody keeps telling me the Goddess herself planted this tree. But how would you know that?
Well, there are a couple of indications. Take a look at the bark. It's much lighter than the bark of the other trees around here.
Yes, but you have to look very closely to see that difference.
You should not doubt my words. By doing that you insult Kybele herself!
Sometimes I miss rationality in these woods!
We are surrounded by wonders! And you're still asking for conclusive evidence?
I could just as well claim that this bush right here is sacred.
Yes, indeed! Its leaves seem to be more serrated than the others. A sacred plant! I must proclaim it!
Mishirla is alive! A bit battered but alive and in a pretty good shape. The monsters imprisoned him here to feed on his blood. Disgusting.
After that massacre, I'll never be able to go back. May I go with you?
Bon voyage, my dear husband! Come back safely dearest.
This forest is the perfect spot for my plan. Oh Master Lathor, wait a minute please!

I have found the site of the gathering.
The Barimaks don't seem to doubt my identity.
You just have to know when the time to retreat has come.
Let's beat it! I hope nobody sees this!
We'll end this fight some other time. I've got something on the stove.
Oh dear, that late already? I have to go!
Here lies Fred. He asked a High Elf general "You and what army?"
And yet another mistake of creation!
Apparently you should NOT jump off a bridge just because your friends do.
Famous last words: "We can trust this Ogre. See? He's smiling."
Seems the whole "faster than a speeding bullet" thing was just a marketing ploy.
Here lie Lady Argyle's first ten husbands.
Here lie the investigators of Lady Argyle's missing husbands.
This space reserved for Lady Argyle's next husband.
Why he thought he could pet a Hellhound, no one will ever know.
Here lies one-handed Joe. His Hellhound bit the hand that fed it.
Here lie Martha Inch and George Myle. The Reaper was given an inch and took a mile.
Never play hopscotch with a mine laying dwarf.
Never ask a flamethrowing Dwarf for a light.
Still waiting for the number 42 bus.
The undead have no sense of humor.
I got the part of the treasure map. The witch... eh, the old woman was pleased.
A mental blow that deals more damage to armored targets and slows the regeneration of their combat arts

Go and talk to the Elves. Let them know that they are free to go.

Well, you really did it. You are not just a warrior, you are a heroine! You bestowed the reputation upon our Clan that it so rightly deserves. I am in your debt. The Elves you are looking for are over there. Your reward shall be to go and free them.
If my animals could talk, I would have a little bit of variety.
I often ask myself who is more stupid - men or sheep?
Rumor has it, that a bear is lurking in this area.
I should count my animals, but there are more of them than I have fingers.
I haven't stopped hiccuping since I made myself a bowl of Gold Bush broth.
What would you recommend I eat for dinner tonight? I've had green chestnuts nearly every night this week.
I feel like a cow some days with all the plants we eat... It can't be healthy, can it?
A big beautiful cut of wild boar with green sauce... wouldn't that be fine? Unfortunately that is not what the Goddess desires of us...
We could eat as much as we wanted in the old days... Now we have to treat the animals like our brothers! How ironic...
There are more than enough animals to eat around here, but the Great Goddess has a cruel heart and has forbidden us to hunt them...
Sautéed bark risotto! And for the third time this week! My diet is just pitiful, isn't it?
What would you serve if you were expecting a dozen guests for dinner? I was thinking about making a box tree gratin.
Not many of our plants taste that good around here. And the best tasting mushrooms are all holy, aren't they?
I'll have moss growing out of my ears one day soon, if I keep eating all these greens...
That's all I can tell you. Let's hope she's still alive.

Lead me to the prince's ghost!

In order to help the prince I must have a vision. Yet I can only have this vision when I am close to him because only there is the ghost's aura perceptible. Take me to him!
The eastern part of the Cursed Forest
Lars' hammer wasn't quite big enough for that last fight.
Never taunt a zombie by saying "Bite me."
My fake plants died because I did not pretend to water them.
Playing Red Ridinghood with a real wolf wasn't a good idea.
Now I have to find the ferryman’s wife and tell her what has happened.
Have you brought me my future wife? Thank you! Here is something for your troubles.
You really found beer? Very good, I'm so relieved! We started brewing our own, but these things take time. Now, everything is ready for the festival. Take this as a sign of my gratitude.
You look very strong and courageous.
Aren't you afraid, that you might lose a fight?
You seem really confident, we don't know what that is here.
Back into the grave with you!

Burga the Shaman is prepared to give me one of his rats. In return for this he has ordered me to kill the spiders worshiped by an opposing tribe of Orcs. I have to bring him their poison stings as proof of their demise. These Orcs like to solve their religious differences in a very down to earth manner.
Come on, cut down the forest! These damn trees are taking all our oxygen...
It's a good thing we ran into you. We need a nice pair of Dryad eyes for our Shaman.
We're still looking for a housekeeper for our Ogre, Dryad!
You? You must be completely nuts to follow me all the way to this place! You won't get out of here alive.
You provided us with some peace and quiet and got rid of this curse once and for all? I owe you my thanks!
Don't tell anyone about our secret.
You Inquisitors are a real pestilence!
So what have we done wrong this time, Inquisitor?
Robe wearers are not welcome here!
You're a disgrace to all the faithful, Inquisitor.
We have reached the beach. The Ogre should be able find a boat to take him home from here.
Go! Trust me, a sea journey is fun!
You have to strike while the iron is hot, but you already know that don't you?
Oooh, I would do anything for your gratitude.
A soldier told me that I'd better take a less direct route if I want to go to the city.
You are extremely loyal. Loyalty is as valued here as bravery, you have shown both. If you want to join our tribe, you are welcome.
Excuse me, my Lord. I was just wandering about lost in my thoughts. I did not wish to disturb you.
You are audacious, but perhaps you could be of some use to me!
If there is anything I can do, your word is my command, oh Elven Lord.
One of the Priests nearby has become a thorn in my side. He is constantly inciting the people against the nobles.
A Priest? A man of the Gods? What could I possibly do to help you?
I shall give you a dagger, and then, under the cover of darkness, you...
Murder? My Lord! I beg you, no! I am a peaceful man with woman and child...
Bah! I thought as much... I am wasting my time with you.
Iron and steel, yuck! I should have been a goldsmith.
I would love to have an apprentice at my side.
It takes time to forge good weapons.
This constant hammering is hurting my ears.
These new non-ferrous metals are making my work colourfully chic.
The field worker's plough needs to be repaired.
Someone recently asked me if I could forge him a balcony.
One can forge steel particularly well by using a fire of ebony wood.
...and the horse dealer told me I need hold my horses...

Inquisition Guard
A cynic is a man who, when he smells flowers, looks around for a coffin.
- Mencken
The commander said he couldn't help me unless the law's been violated. I guess I have to go visit TyBosso all by myself. Luckily the note I took from that attacker told me where I can find TyBosso.
Any Hero completing the main quest in Bronze or Silver difficulty without dying.
Thank you brother. Take care and don't forget to kill one for me.
May you always be victorious. This country needs men like you.
May the Gods of war be with you. You make our troops proud.
May your courage always be with you. I wish you a good and long life.
I'm almost overcome with joy. You are an upright and courageous man.
I second that. Thanks for your inspiring words.
If everyone was like you, we'd set the world on fire.
Farewell! May your blade always find its target.
Your words are true. I have to go too, mustn't keep the enemy waiting.
I hope to shake your hand again soon. Live well and honorably.
Yeah well, size DOES matter...I only like the big boys...
Primary choice evasive lie successfully applied. Task: kill spiders and ghosts. Then retrieve needed item.
You've lost. You just don't know it yet.
Did I happen to mention this decorative statue?
Spider silk and olm bone, muck soup makes your bones as hard as stone!
Tough - Adds a chance to reflect stun effects.
Backlash - Adds a chance to also reflect ranged attacks.
Unstoppable - Adds a chance to reflect root effects.
Antimagic - Adds a chance to reflect incoming spells.
Riposte - Adds a chance to increase the reflected damage.
Idol - Extends the reflective effect to nearby party members.
Thanks, that's great! He'll surely slip on this. Hahaha!
A beautiful warrior. My sister would die to be like you.
I don't think you have time to play - right?
Would you like to be my friend?
I wonder if the pupils are looking forward to it as well?
Acquired splinter. Second key secured. There is a high probability that the next key is located in the swamps.
Where there's a village, there are merchants.
Troll need work! Troll help Orc man? Troll strong!
Well, I could use someone to clean out the pig pen. That work's really cut out for you.
Pigs? Pigs good!! Pigs on stick! Much yum!
Don't you dare to touch any of them! If even one gets skewered, this pig pen will be your grave!
Smell so nice, but OK. Troll work good for Orc man.
I really hope so! When you're done you can keep the dung as your payment!
OK Orc, but Troll like small piggy pay more.
Do you want to ruin me? Get to work!
Oh, that makes one's mouth water.
To be honest, I prefer salad. Lizardmen tongues are not good for my figure.
Yeah, that sounds ... uhm, yummy. Let's not waste any time, I'm already getting hungry.
I generally prefer a more balanced diet.
I agree. I'm also ... eh, not a fan of Human flesh.
I’ve found all pieces of the missing sculpture. Time to go see Mr. Giles, the librarian.
With your face, you'd be perfect for a horror movie.
The medallion in my hands is obviously interesting for the Dryads. If I play my cards right I might be able to sell it for a considerable amount.
Thank you very much, you funny thing. Will you take me back to my daddy?
The quarters are over there. You can't miss them.

After I killed Gar'Colossus, the broker gave me his word that the women in this region would be safe from now on. He said he’d seen a Golem like this before, in a place where the Orcs say “the magic flows from the earth.” That's where the Elven expedition was heading. He also said a strange man was waiting for me at the academy. Sounds like Liosilath is in town.
You did not expect this, did you?
I shouldn't go any further, the creatures around here are dangerous!
<Pain, as if I burnt my finger> ahhhhh
That's it. I survived all the waves. I wonder if I can enter my name in some list? Or get a certificate or cup?
Come to me, this is for real!
Oh, and you can ride as well...
Who or what are you? We don’t need any new members. We only need new... SACRIFICES!
I need better protection against damage caused by fire.
Such a city is nothing but a stronghold against nature. I'm surprised there is life at all...
My storeroom is full and my purse is empty. The Gods have deserted me!
You won't get rid of me that easily!
Behave yourself! We have strict rules!
Don't break anything. We'll be watching you!
Strangers aren't especially welcome here. Conduct yourself accordingly!
Be careful! I will remember your face!
You are welcome here. But abide by the rules and laws.

The desert is south of here. Let us not waste time.

Wow, what a thrashing we gave it! You're a hell of a fighter, I wouldn't want to be your enemy. Anyway let's not waste time, the fog will be back soon. Oh look! Those are some pieces of the machine! We could fix the leak in the pipes with this pieces of metal, that would probably stop the fog for good! Why bother though, it would slow us down and we won't be in this area for much longer anyway.

Stop! What is it that you require?

Oh you have a promissory note! Very well, you may pass.
I returned the necklace to Fumia. Perhaps her spirit can rest in peace now.
I have an idea how this village got its name...
Come here so I can put sand in your works!
How do I make ice with this thing?
You are just another useless gadget!
Let's see if you can feel pain!
That's it, that's the ring! This will definitely fetch a pretty penny on the black market. Now to uphold my end of the agreement.

Jaromir the Quiet.
He was a poet and he didn't know it.
Steal from a priestess - that's just my sort of thing!
Daliel has given me gold for keeping this little secret to myself.
You should really speak with the Prince now.
God, I am returning your dead to you!
This is not part of my equipment.
Welcome to the huge army of dead NPCs...
Mhm... Is it a God? Or a King? No... it's a Dragon!

What do you want here? You claim that I enslave people from the desert and send them to the arena as gladiators? You'd better watch what you're saying, I'm an influential man.

Of course I have legal papers for all my gladiators, but I would still like to make you an offer. Defeat two of my gladiators and then the man shall be free. Do we have a deal?
Any Hero has slain five Dragons.
Alright - but next time you should think about who you pick a fight with!

You? Again! Well you are persistent. All one has to do is count backwards from ten and there you are again. Here however, you won't be able to get past me. Those stup... excuse me, those BRAVE Orcs willingly kill their own families to please me. When they start killing you in a second, I'll go and take care of our beloved Sophia.
You can free us! We've lived too long in servitude. Take our shackles, so we can be free.
Right then! War is my true calling.
Praise those who go to battle with courage.
We are lucky to have him. His deeds of valor are legendary.
Oh courage! Oh bravery! These things I take into battle.
Bravery only grows through true virtue.
My blade is dull, I will have to seek out the blacksmith.
Fleet feet save lives, but they don't bring fame.

The evil poltergeist wasn’t so evil after all. The poltergeist is the ghost of a little girl who claims that her parents were murdered by Wasmut and Daliel. I will report this information to the Town Guard.
I really can't carry that any longer.
The businessman was relieved and paid me a reward.

Get me 13 wolf pelts!

Lately everyone's trying to get their hands on wolf pelts. They are multi-purpose, warm and robust. One of my customers has ordered 13 pelts, but I don't have enough left. Would you help me? There are a lot of wolves around, but I'm a pretty bad hunter. Please get me 13 wolf pelts.

Bring me four portions of zumzumroot!

Step right up! And witness a truly sensational discovery! I am currently working on an invention that will change the world! A potion of amnesia! Well now! What do you say to that?
It’s quite simply really. You just give the potion to someone and they forget everything! That’s right - everything! Who knows? If we gave some to those horrid conservative lizards, they might even forget all about their blasted traditions and ancestors! Just imagine a world without all those ugly roadside shrines!
My first series of tests was a complete success! Perhaps a little too successful really, these old boys here are no longer ‘mentally active’ if you know what I mean. The recipe still needs some fine-tuning. Too much zumzumroot probably, yes that was the problem.
Unfortunately I’ve almost run out of zumzumroot. Could you fetch me some? It grows not far from here. Bring me four portions of zumzumroot!
They never should have taken you out of your crypt, buddy!
What a disgusting pile of mold!
Having your body scarred seems to be all the rage these days! I'll help you out a little in the trend setting department!
The officer was outraged when he heard the whole story. He’ll take care of this problem.
Ah... They would rather die than tell me anything. One of them dropped something. Let's see, maybe I can find a clue to explain what these mysterious eggs are all about.
Very well, you have proven that you have the skill of a warrior. You may continue your journey.
Okay, I know what I have to do!
There is no shame in taking your own life!
It's true! I found the general and he's still alive. Asalive as people around here are, anyway. Maybe he has an idea how I can break him out of this prison cell.
There was another path open to you!
Some pictures are unrecognisable until you turn them around.
My works hang only in the best of houses.
Art reveals its truth only to the initiated.
The Gods gifted me with an intuitive sense of form and colour - something I cannot expect of my beholders.
Abstract, he says? My painting? That Elf is as dumb as a Human.
Eddie was the mastermind behind the whole thing. He certainly got what he deserved!
Gant pods? You want to do fireworks? Yes I still have some. Nobody here knows about them, so I only sell a few. Here's your change.

Gravestone
Stefan Hinz
His last words: Echat, Stein, Schalosch!
Well then, have a nice day your majesty.
I taught Carl and his buddies a lesson.
You're one of the good guys, who like, helps old ladies and crap, right?
I'm going to crack your skull!
Good heroes? Hahahahahaaaaaa! I haven't laughed this hard in ages!
Good heroes are dumb and stinky!
I'll teach you tree-huggers to fear chaos!
What hellhole did you escape from?
I think my master called, I have to go.
I'll go home now. My leg hurts.
I'm sorry I have to stop here, but my family is waiting.
I must excuse myself, I have to take care of something for my master.
I really enjoyed our chat, but I have to move on now.
I have to take care of my kids.
If I don't leave now I won't get my share of the bread. Sorry.
I'll be able to get to sleep a bit easier after this.
Thanks a lot. You've helped me forget grim reality for a little while.
I could talk for hours, but I'm being called.
TyBosso left his grandson when he fled. Now I'm stuck with him and he wants me to take him to the branch office on the Human's side. That's where his relatives live.
An Inquisitor would never climb on the back of such a beast. We have Shroud Spiders!

I delivered the letter, but Meliondor wanted to kill me because it contained some bad news. The soldier wants to break up with his betrothed. I have to make Meliondor come to his senses, I think he's ready to be reasonable now.
HARR! Who might you be? Out with it! Or I’ll cut off yer tongue! You’ll never lay your hands on my treasure! HARR!
An Orc reported that lately their huts are raided by night. He doesn't know who is behind it all but I have an idea. Accompanied by an Orc warrior, I'm supposed to take care of this matter.
Priest, you weren't able to eliminate all Guardians!
I've delivered the information. My task is done.
I am acting on behalf of the DeElfici family. If you have any complaints, talk to them.
Warrior! We owe you a lot.
A warrior! I bid you good day!
I rarely meet one of our splendid warriors. How nice.
Good day, I love to see someone from the fighting class.
I enjoy looking at your brave face.
How nice to see you, child of war.
I'm really happy to see you, warrior.
Ah, not in a battle! How nice to see you're unharmed.
How wonderful! You warriors have my deepest respect.
You, my child? It's nice to see that you are still with us.
I will spit on your grave, oppressor!
Against the likes of us you're feeling strong, huh?
Come on, don't be scared, I'm nothing but a slave!
I'll smack you senseless, slave driver!
I will fight, even if I'll die doing it!
Come and kill us, defenseless ones!
Time is running out for oppressors ...
We're all too familiar with the likes of you!
Great, you've saved the world enough for one day, now it's time to die!
If freaks like you are supposed to save Ancaria, then I'm leaving.
This is a little bit more complicated than helping old ladies across the street.
Yeah, yeah, heroes are noble, but they are also a sandwich!
What do you guys say again? Do one good deed every day?
Okay! They had that coming. Now I'll go have a word with that mayor.
I need a weapon to cause more physical damage.
I'm not finished with you yet!
We will always honor you, and will name our children after you.
You should have had more training.
Human, why do you fight me?
The ghost conjurer is dead and I have his pendant. Now I have to return to the thief. The doors to the shortcut should be open now.
So much for the rat tails. Let's get the branch of the Death Tree now.
The only good Orc is a dead Orc.
The nobles plan to separate state and religion - unthinkable!
I think politics is much too despotic, politicians want to decide everything. What's your opinion?
Rejoice, stranger! Our people didn't invent fees for passing by yet!
They plan to allow these people to use light weapons - that can't be true.
You have to make a decision - aristocracy or clergy. There's no neutral here.
Over the course of time, I have put together over one thousand mixtures for magic potions.
Foul smelling tinctures usually help trees grow well.
I have long been studying the effects of earth rituals.
They are asking me to perform quick spells. I can't conjure miracles you know!
I must ask the witch what the significance of this magic enchanter's nightshade is.
I had the instructions for the fabrication of amulets lying around here somewhere.
The quality of natural ingredients always fluctuates a bit.
The quality of the ingredients is crucial for the effectiveness of a potion.
The Priestesses have requested a fragrant substance for the Temple service.
Fine! Here is your reward. You deserve it!

Count the beetles!

My grandfather taught me an old saying we have around here: “When beetles buzz through autumn nights, summer will be the farmer's delight.”
I know, I know... it’s not the best rhyme... It’s one of our traditional rhymes and the meter hasn’t been readjusted for centuries. I always like to know what the weather will be like in the future. There are three places that the locals visit to count the beetle population. Go and count the beetles for me and I'll revise the saying in the meantime.

Character: Seraphim
Orientation: Close Combat / Magic
Aspects: Exalted Warrior, Celestial Magic, Revered Technology

I am one of the Seraphim, the ethereal beings who have been watching over the fate of the world since the beginning of time. United as sisters under the watchful eye of Sophia we were committed to our duty and proud to serve.

Yet the creator has left this world. Thus we are patiently waiting for the day when he will finally return, the day when our duty will be fulfilled.
Magmadur has eaten Katharina and also tried to kill me. I'll show him that he's bitten off more than he can chew this time.

Aaahh!... Get me... a doctor... QUICK!

That's my bone that's poking out of my leg. OUCH! Quick, get me a doctor. There's one near the beach... ow.

I found the starting point of the hide and seek test. I must look for more tracks from here.


I reached the starting point of the game. Furia left from here. Maybe she left some tracks ...
You humans are all the same. Vermin!

Say nothing of my religion. It is known to God and myself alone. Its evidence before the world is to be sought in my life: if it has been honest and dutiful to society the religion which has regulated it cannot be a bad one.

- Jefferson
From this moment on, may you live in peace .
Politics are for sissies. Stand up and fight!
You are a fighter, I am a simple townsman. If I were a good liar, I would have become a politician.
You have a lot more courage than some stupid politician.
in order to be effective politically, you need a big club, ya listenin'?
Our politics are simple: You are successful or you lose your head!
Wylmieni wants to create potions that are supposed to prevent the fallen undead from rising up again. To do this she needs water bottles from skeleton mages.

Inscription
Anyone know what became of the undead Centurion?

Collect gold from these useless vermin!

Never do business with the poor, it will only bring you trouble! They spend all the gold, and then come up with the saddest stories when it's time to repay it and my modest 25 percent interest rate. As if I care whether they have clothes for the winter, or have to sell their children into slavery! You go and collect the gold coins that they owe me!
You need to be signed into an Xbox LIVE Gold Membership with the correct permissions to join this game.
The opponents in this region generally use weapons for poison based damage.
I'm not far from the destination.

Now that my throat isn't parched anymore, my memories are returning. Years ago I was out hunting and happened to come across a cave full of scarabs. Through sheer luck I escaped from the cave and into the desert.


Aaaah. Now, yes.

I see clearly now. Listen carefully. Years, no, decades ago I came across a cave while hunting. I couldn't stop myself and went inside. There were scarabs there, hundreds of them. Thousands. Millions! Without fate and my catlike reflexes I would never have escaped. I've always stayed clear of the place since then, but I will whisper its location into your ear...
We are the best warriors in our world.
I am cautious of evil forces at all times.
Our territory is well suited for camouflage.
One says that good warriors don't grow on trees. I believe that!
I think I will have to purchase a sword.
A battle is more easily started than finished.
This constant standing at attention is annoying me!
The back-country must always be well protected.
Trees and shrubs are always good camouflage.

The Abishai of Dissension offered me a place at his side. As a servant, so to speak. He told me to make my choice. Hmm ... what should I do? I think my answer is ...

NEVER!
With the exception of one skeleton, the fortress was empty.
May Lumen guide you, fair lady.

Get me 20 crystals from Ice Elementals.

Hm, wha-? Oh I didn't hear you. My name is Nadja, and I'm studying T-Energy interferences. Working on these consoles requires a lot of focus and is very time consuming. I can't get anything else done.
Oh I just remembered, we switched the monsters outside a while ago. I need to study the new ones, but I can't leave my work here. Could you slay a few of the Ice Elementals and bring me their crystals? I would really appreciate it.
Now the Ogre is outcast for all time... from life! The ingrate, after everything I've done for him!
Opponents who are too easily defeated do not bring glory to the Inquisition.

Character: Dragon Mage
Focus: Magic
Aspects: Dragon Magic, Elemental Magic, Mentalism

The magic that runs through my veins is not from this world. I am one of the chosen - one of those who are granted the right to study the magic of the dragons.

Only the best will earn the right to learn the most secret mysteries of these creatures and rightfully call themselves Dragon Mage! This is my goal. And I will give my everything for it.

Apparently I wasn’t the first one to get this idea. A shady guy thinks he knows why the thread rush has been confiscated, and how we can get some of the seized herbs. He wants me to help him attack a small military camp. The apothecary will pay a nice sum for a new thread rush delivery.

Book 2: Dryad Cooking

Of all living beings, the Dryads have the closest bond with nature. Their connection with the trees is of such closeness that they refuse to eat anything that does not live or grow in the woods. Although the range of food supply seems rather limited, Dryad cuisine is far from boring or repetitive. Over the centuries, the Dryads have developed their culinary art to perfection. Dryad cuisine is one of the most interesting cuisines of Ancaria with many nuances, different flavors and exotic recipes.

For Dryads, cooking is a collective and social activity. Since they are living in wooden tree houses, they usually do not have fireplaces inside the house. Instead, there are usually several safe fireplaces in the central areas of the villages, where all the cooking takes place. The Dryads prefer to cook in larger amounts and they are used to preparing their food in big cauldrons and huge pans. There are no exact recipes in Dryad cooking. Mostly it consists of the combination of certain basic ingredients and spices.

Meat plays an important role in the Dryad cuisine. There are many different kinds of animals living in the forests and most of them are edible. Amongst the variety of venison, there are deer, boars, small bears, but also fish, such as wild salmon and pike. The Dryads are hunters and they exclusively hunt and eat wild animals. You will never find domesticated animals in a Dryad dish.
Dryads traditionally do not grow plants. Instead, they reap what the forests have to offer and that is quite a lot. There are all kinds of fruit and berries available. In addition, there are many forms of wild vegetables, such as potatoes, rice and wheat.

The most unique element of Dryad cooking is the variety of spices and herbs. Dryads are using an amazing amount of different herbs and spices for their dishes. Some of them only grow in their homeland regions, some are not even recognized as useful in other parts of the world. The herb lore of the Dryads is unmatched in Ancaria and a skilled Dryad cook is able to create something unique even out of a simple rabbit.

Pike in Wine-vinegar Sauce

1 large pike
1 1/4 cup wine
2 tbl. vinegar
3 slices of bread
1/4 spoon wild cinnamon
1/8 spoon ground white pepper
2 onions
fat
wild parsley
salt

Place the pike in a pan, pour in wine and vinegar and add parsley. Add enough salted water to cover the fish and poach it until the flesh is white. Lift the fish from the pan, then put the bread into a bowl. Add some of the wine-vinegar liquid until the bread is covered.

Skin the fish and take out the spine and other bones. Cut the fish into small pieces to make a manageable dish.

Strain the cooking liquid into a clean pan. Pour 2 cups of it into the bowl with the bread, add cinnamon and pepper and mix it together until smooth. Return the mixture to the liquid in the pan. Fry the onions in a little oil until soft, and add them to the liquid as well.
Taste for seasoning, add the pieces of fish and re-heat gently to serve.
