A fisherman asked me to check on the safety of a couple that he is friends with, and to take some fish to them. The forester Timotan and his wife live on the road that leads to the gates of Artamark.

Well, what do you know! A Dryad! People are already talking about you. They say you caused TyBosso quite a bit of trouble. I like you. I think our goals are very similar. Would you like to work together to put a stop to the tyrant?
No? Ah I see, you don't want to share the revenge with me. That's unfortunate, for I cannot allow anybody to preempt my revenge.
C’mon lady, don’t let this chance go by.

Seraphim Nicole has given me an important assignment. I have to kill a Dragon! Magmadur is an old, despotic Dragon who has been taunting the Seraphim for a while now. Sophia sent Ambassador Katharina to him, but he killed her in cold blood. That calls for vengeance. I will strip the scales from this monster!
Die quickly so that your armor remains in one piece.
This is where research was done over a long period of time
The officer asked me to take his request for assistance to the commander in the next camp.
The officer bought my story! I now have access to the main camp.
That should be everything. I can return to my employer.

Sister Alesia made a wager with another seraphim. Whoever kills 100 animals first, wins. Since Alesia had to abandon the hunt after an accident, she asked me to kill the remaining 31 animals (wolves or bears).
I only have 10 minutes for completing this task.

Bring me a Troll Shaman's heart!

...and I was only trying to help! The farmers wanted rain so the wild grapes that they need to make their lukewarm swill wouldn't dry up. I did a rain spell and then it started to rain. How was I supposed to know that it would actually work!
Now it doesn't want to stop. The farmers are complaining that their wild grapes are drowning. They don't know what they want. I have to stop the rain somehow. I know what spell would help here! I need the heart of a Troll shaman for it though. You look brave, could you get such a heart for me?
What did we trigger here?! Look at that! That's impossible!
No idea... come on, let's run! The next settlement isn't far and we will be able to sell the stuff we looted so far.

Kill the Demons!

I can see that you have no problem coping with one Demon sister. How about several of them? Let's say three?
Oops! There really was a monster in the cellar! At least now I can return the doll to the little girl.
Have the tunnels and canals been freed from the Kobolds? The stench is disgusting!

Lars Berenbrinker
Everything with more than two legs is a bug and must be entered in the database!!!
I won't be able to win this fight without a curative watering place.
Press <$ID_CUI_BTNPAD_SMALL_INSERT> to use the new combat art.

Eliminate the guards in the camp!

Psst! You there! I am here on behalf of the council to observe the Inquisition's campaign. It would appear that the Inquisition is planning to construct a new base in this area. It might even be a training camp for guards. We have to stop this. One of the guards' advance posts is located near here. They've barricaded themselves in the ruins. If you were to eliminate these guards it would be a heavy blow to the Inquisition's plans.
we will use real time filters... no need for special stage directions
An attack! I have to defend myself.

Find the hidden place!

Thank you! I can rest in peace now. I don't have anything to reward you with, I'm afraid. But you will not walk away empty handed, I assure you.
Not far from here is a secret hiding place where I stored a few of my belongings. They were meant as souvenirs for my sword sisters. Since they did not deem it important enough to accompany on my final path, they don't deserve them. I want you to have them, instead.
That's that ... the first focus point is destroyed.

Help us get rid of the rat infestation!

Rats! Rats everywhere! They run over the tables and beds, and the whole floor is full of their droppings. We can't handle them anymore, not since the exterminator passed away. Now they say us guards have to do something about them!
The Count plans to make his annual visit tonight. When the old man sees what's going on here we'll get a pay cut and curfew for sure. Please help us get rid of the rat infestation!
Your combat style is as dry as the whole damn region!
I must return to the place which was once my home. The idea of it fills me with joy and dread at the same time.

Landlord Cemil has come up with a new delicacy - chicken on a skewer with yogurt sauce. He has given me gold for five chickens from one of the local farmers. If I find cheaper meat, I can keep more of the gold.
Hurry! Give me the tongues! Hurry!
I need the tongues! Give them to me!
If you don’t give me those tongues right now, why I’ll... I'll...!
Say hello to your forefathers, orc!
How I would like to use this item ...
See... that didn't hurt, did it? And it sounds much more cooperative.
Where's your big mouth, or is it time for a bubbling fart now?
Alright - but next time you should think about who you pick a fight with!
Okay, I'll spare your pitiful life. Death would be too easy for you anyway.
Could you give me one good reason to keep you alive?

Kill the Tribal Elder!

I want to be the Tribal Elder, but there are two other tribesmen who are older than me - the Tribal Elder and his deputy. Just because they were born a few minutes earlier! I have a plan though, soon I WILL BE THE TRIBAL ELDER! And you will help me! Go to Haggath and Bn’Thoz and take them out for a stroll, a stroll that they never return from! Isn’t that a brilliant plan?

On my way to the brigand camp, I met two of the grateful Orc slaves from the strip mine. They told me that they had no way off the island, but the Dryads won't allow them to live here and the Elves will enslave them again if they're caught. It seems that they would prefer dying in combat to living long in hiding, so they offered me their help. The more swords, the better.
This piece of equipment does not fit into my inventory.
You are leading your people to their death!
I expect to be rewarded for this information. As soon as Geodric is dead, return to me and bring me my gold!
I am so desperate! Please help me get the letter!

Haiku Contest soon
Out by the big city lights
Will you escort me?

Danger in the streets
Monsters, too many to count...
With you I'll be safe!
Slimy work, and downright disgusting. But it's done.
Enemies are slowed and weakened in the area of effect, missiles are slowed
Be careful, you'll hurt yourself with that thing.
What were the Gods thinking when creating you?
Around here, there live very powerful creatures, whom I shouldn't challenge yet.
Opponent's chance to reflect melee damage
Very good! Wait a moment until I'm finished.

I congratulate you. It was a delight for all of my senses to finally see a fight like that after all these years. Thank you for the spectacle and now I'm going to withdraw. Of course you will be rewarded as well.
The slaves have escaped, but Brutus Plutocratio has realized that I've been lying to him.
Greatly reduces the cooldown of the dragon magic aspect and increases the potential spell level without a malus. Allows combat art upgrades in the dragon magic aspect.
Astina told me that Rumbolir has been dead for quite some time now. She said something about 150 years. The observatory still needed the crystals, so I can consider my mission a success.
The cauldron of slimy gobs and goo is ready. I'll take it to Jangletooth.
Magic energy damages and burns enemies in the area of effect
The young Priests are giving me frown lines! They think they know everything better, and they don't listen to Kybele's words!
Priests in training! They're really my greatest worry! They're impatient and inclined to be arrogant, aren't they?
Why do less young people decide to apprentice as a Priest and serve Kybele? The pay is very civilized!
It's impossible nowadays to find serious and devout candidates for the Priesthood! They all just want to realize their full potential!
I can hardly believe that some seriously call for celibacy among us Priests! Do they want to rob us of all our fun?
Where are we supposed to get appropriate recruits for the holy orders? Everyone just thinks about their own well-being.
Good Priest recruits are harder to find than white truffles in frozen earth! How are we supposed to explain this to Kybele?
We Priests are actually well-respected, right? Why is it so hard to find young Dryads who want to follow in our footsteps then?
Being Kybele's shepherd is increasingly losing its appeal! Oh, why can't we find dedicated apprentices anymore?
Sometimes I ask myself why is it so difficult to find young adept people who want to be Kybele's Priests?
I was created to fight Demons like you.
I don't have a good feeling about this..
We'd better get out of here...

Buddix believes that an unknown breed of creatures made the circles in the corn. He has asked me to help him prove their existence. I have to admit that even I’m interested in finding out the truth now. Buddix asked me to get a copy of “Irrelevant Ancarian Tall Tales” and see if it contains any clues about corn circles.
I’ll take my leave now! Farewell!
I should have a look at my vegetables now.
I have to bring the Gods another sacrifice. Excuse me!
I'll spend this fine Gods given day having a nice walk.
It's that late already? I have to prepare a prayer!
When we meet again we'll pray together, but now I have to go.
Our conversation has made my faith even stronger. Thank you!
There's something I have to do now, I can't keep the Gods waiting.
I have to go now. Evangelizing and converting doesn't do itself.
Please hurry, the longer it takes the madder she'll get!
I've taken the medallion to the sailor. I wonder why the Dryads are interested in this thing?
Take the Bull by the Horns
Errteg the lettuce farmer is looking for a wife. He has asked me to hang up posters proclaiming his eligibility in Khorum, Tharum and El-Darrag. It will be a long journey.
That would have been the last chance to issue a retreat order.
I agree. I'm also ... eh, not a fan of Human flesh.
Blood Dryad shamans are holding sinister rituals where the ring is hidden.
Fed the builder wants to drain the swamp so he can develop the land. He needs some more materials, so I need to find ten rat pelts and five branches from a gnarltree.
How pathetic! Instead of accepting his fate, he tries to make excuses. But nothing can keep me from finishing my task!
We did it. Fighting has become like second nature for him. Now I'm going to take him back to his father.

Frank Lunnebach
Aha, and where have you been this time?
Gelminy! You just can't manage without me for very long, can you? You probably have more questions that only I can answer. What's the matter this time?
Leave me alone! I have nothing to say to you! I won't tell you that Ignaz paid us to ambu... Oh gah!
A Troll... Let's hope you can fight better than you can talk.
They probably didn't think their reunion would be quite like this.
I have met a priest at an oasis. He has given me clean water. I can return to the temple.
Yes, I'm leaving - your chatter bores me!
I can't do everything at once!
The troops of the Inquisition consists of female fighters. They are well-trained and fanatic.
At the old bridge we'll continue on to the north.
That's exactly what I think. Let's waste no time.
I concoct my potions for the good of the most noble.
For aeons now, my family has strived to turn water to wine.
Bah, this potion is foul! Woe! It is only fit for Humans to drink, if that!
My oracle says that someone from the other side is watching me even now...
Magical rune stones are my speciality.
Garlic in oil is completely useless, but it does taste quite good.
A universal potion that gifts Trolls with intelligence and turns Humans into diligent workers? I am a wizard, not a God...
Now somebody wants a Spell of Protection for a horse! Pah, my customers are getting stranger and stranger...
Oh, I thank the Gods for my noble birth! I could be conjuring rabbits out of a helmet otherwise.

Take the ointment to Surgeon Lawaon!

Hey you! Could you run an errand for me? It won’t take long, it’s practically just around the corner.
Surgeon Lawaon needs this ointment. He takes care of those poor devils that get injured in the arena. Take it to him and he will reward you for your time.
The greatest of all women warriors - they say that you are the bravest person in ages.
Ah, the heroine! You are more beautiful in person than the legends say.
It is you! No man can hold a candle to you.
The Blood Dryads are getting stronger. Sometime soon we’ll have an open war here!
You won't beat me like that!
It's my turn to hit now!
A Ogre doesn't know the meaning of the word pain!
Hyderia DeElfici recognized the shield and called the guards! My plan didn't quite work. Too bad.

Do you have the lotion? Oh yes, that’s simply wonderful! At long last the inflammation has stopped itching. It still tingles a bit...Oh! It’s starting to burn! Did you really get this lotion from Hizz? Ouch! It’s really burning now! What is this stuff?
Who, who am I? I must be a cultist! Yes, the cult is always right! The cultists have seen the truth! I want to be a cultist too!
I spread the potion on the field and I think something's happening!

Haiku Contest soon
Out by the big city lights
Will you escort me?

Danger in the streets
Monsters, too many to count...
With you I'll be safe!
I am forever in your debt.
You just made a mistake, Dryad!
Okay let's finish this, but I won't go down alone. Renik, the Priest and fraud, is behind all this. He's ripping us off.
Hit all enemies dead - dead - dead!
Bone ... flesh ... brain. Well done! That's it. Let's see what the ghost is going to do with it.
It is a waste of energy to attack these objects.
Christmas Ogre, snow machine, branch, ghosts + tree...

You do not have any items to forge in your inventory (equipped items cannot be forged by the Blacksmith).
 
Some weapons feature a number of sockets. When you visit a blacksmith, you can forge special items into these sockets depending on their quality (bronze, silver, gold):
 
Bronze: Runes and Blacksmith Arts
 
Silver: Rings (in addition to the above)
 
Gold: Amulets (in addition to the above)
 
Additionally, each weapon will feature a gray socket for a damage modifier.
No problem as long as the reward is right.
Well, as the agents say: You die only twice!
Is it true, that you have super powers?
It seems as though you have nerves of steel.
You know, I would like to be invincible.
You deserve my respect warg hunter.
The camp is empty now. There seems to be a prisoner in the back. Maybe that’s the missing nephew!
Good of you to come! I can use every man I can get! Give me a minute and I'll tell you what you can do!
The old mage is now able to summon a new helper.

Careful! It's dangerous here, you better move aside! TyBosso DeElfici has ordered new ships which will enable him to send his goods out all over the world even faster. What did you say? You want us to stop? You're kidding, right?
Oh so that's how it works! Then Varuck paid you too, and now you want to complete your assignment! After all your reputation is at stake here, right? Don't make me laugh! DIE!
The experiment will not escape. Now come along.

Come and assist us in our raid on the field of marigolds.

So you're the new follower? I've heard good things about you. We must talk, but can do that later. We're off to raid a marigold field. The Lizardmen must be prevented from harvesting the crop. It produces the incense that keeps the fog monster at bay. If they're busy fighting it they can't be building memorials that interfere with our worship. We're off now - join us and perhaps I can explain more after the raid.
Everything within range of the maelstrom will be drawn in to collide heavily at its core. Opponents will sustain damage from the collision.
I have far better ways to spend my time.
When I look at you, I get the feeling that adulthood really is like hell.
Do you understand children? Are you a person who can do that?
My - I never imagined heroes would look like that.
Let's see what tourist attractions this town has to offer...
I expected more from this opponent.
Lizard, get out of my way!
You've also managed to get rid of Zatina? Thank you very much. You have helped our people. I cannot give you gold, but I have something else for you. Good luck on your journey.
You have got to be kidding me, right?
Ah finally! The goods I have been expecting are here! These are fine goods, thank you very much. Here, take this for all your troubles.

You got the cherries! Well done! Now there’s just one last...ahem...ingredient missing! A special sauce that gives Fangor’s lumpy swill it's distinctive kick! Let's see, how should I put this, hmm... Take this iron bucket with you. You'll need it to transport the sauce. Go to the nearby Kobold camp, and dip the bucket into the little pests’ cesspit. Fill it right up and come back here as quick as you can. If you're too slow the sauce will go dry, and then we can’t use it.
We found Wentelien. He's an unpleasant fellow but we have to show him the scroll.
You should go. Warm lemonade tastes gross.
Dryad Priestess Tily Fihl needs five holm leaves for a ritual in honor of the Goddess Kybele. I've been asked to collect them.
It's not well advised to keep a dragon mage waiting. I'm in the red! Just know, it's damn dangerous when a dragon mage is in the red.

Thank you! Your victory will finally prove to everyone that the rumors about me were fabricated. Take this necklace as a reward. It is an old family heirloom, but as a token of my gratitude for your courage it is almost insignificant.
There's no room for evil in this world.
Are you scared of a fair fight?
Thank you, I'll will continue my journey at once.
It's done! The Humans made it to the meeting point, let's hope they can find their way to freedom.
What was all this about again?
You Guardians are nothing but ancient scrap!
You will make a wonderful toy!
Yield to my magic, Temple Guardian!
Go back to your Temple, thing!
She will never change... uncourteous and abrupt. At least she seemed pleased. We can continue now.

Psst! Not so loud or they’ll hear us!
Rengelwyn sent you, didn’t he? Yes I know that I’m late, I'm stuck here! This place is crawling with pirates, I was lucky to get down here alive. There’s no way that I can get out of here on my own!

Look for commander El'Duffi in Badawi!

Thank you! I owe you my life. I can go the rest of the way to Teardrop Hamlet alone. You could do me another favor though. Go to Badawi and report this incident to commander El'Duffi. Tell him everything, especially the part about Harun being behind all this.
Phew! You really should take a bath!
Get out of the way! I'm not afraid of you!
Hah! The dark side is a little weak today.
I found Stan at last. Now I just have to find out what he knows.
A party after my own taste!
Would you mind me asking for your help?
If I can help you in any way, I gladly will. What's the matter?
I think one of the waterfalls might be blocked up. Could you take care of that problem?
Why don't you have an expert take a look at it, someone who knows what's what?
With those hourly wages they're asking these days? You must be joking!
Well, you're right. I'll take a look at the problem as soon as I get a chance.
That's very decent of you! I'll see you there!
I'll stop by when I find the time!
Oh these ghosts are just terrible!
I need better protection from fire damage.
*sing* I don't know what it means that I'm so sad...
Talk to the librarian, don´t waste time.
Hey there! It's the forest fairy!

You are a true hero. I thank you in the name of my troops. My recruits have been scouting and they are willing to hand you the most valuable treasures that they found because they are certain: many would have fallen without your help.
We will now be able to hold the fort because the biggest dangers have been removed. Farewell.
Seeing these villagers in agony is simply...exhilarating!
Karduk was impressed! My popularity among Orc hunters seems to be growing.

While looking for the Crystal Caves, I encountered some Dryads and had to kill them. After a while, the Queen of the Dryads showed up and said that enough blood had been spilt. In return for a promise to not kill any more Dryads, she showed me the path to the Crystal Caves. Too bad. I was starting to enjoy myself.
Only lazy girls use long twine
Do you wish to tell me something? Then speak clearly and stop drooling!
I'm not evil, just mean and greedy.
You're not even fit to work in the galley.
Slicing you up will be a pleasure.
Of course I can wear that, but I won't be able to move quickly.

A man at the oasis told me that the local tribes are on the brink of civil war. The old King is dead and his brother took the throne, despite the fact that it actually belongs to the Prince. There will be an election in the near future, and too many of the tribe leaders are favoring the uncle instead of the Prince. If the Prince were to get access to a magical weapon called “Devil's Fire”, he'd be able to put enough pressure on the tribal leaders to just claim the throne. The Prince has the support of the Grand Inquisitor, so I’d better find out if I can assist him get this fire. If a little fell into my pack while I helped, well, I wouldn’t object. Now to find the Prince.
I knew you would make it! Thanks to you, the danger has been averted for now. We are in your debt!
I'll go to the village! I have enough gold. I'd like to buy a pet.
Pet? You want food? Troll like animal. All animal good grilled.
No, no! I don't want to eat this animal. It's a pet. You take care of it and feed it.
Feed animal? Animal food! Troll no like. Not food animal bad.
I don't know which one's the best for me. They have a lot of animals there.
Pigs? Pig good for Ogre. Ogre smell same.
No, pigs are too small for me! I'll have a look at the giant spiders.
Spider no meat. No good pet. Troll go, find food animal.
I'll take the gallbladders. I can make a good claw polish from them.
Those of you who behave can choose their favorite pieces.
Like I said, the outpost is over there.
This is the place Nionake's ghost was talking about. Let's see what she left me.

Take the scroll to Arch Mage Saewald!

This is a very special scroll. This type of scroll conjures a powerful Demon. It is written in the conjurer's blood. We can determine therefore, who is behind all this. I'm not able to do this however, I only specialize in Demonology.
You must take the scroll to Arch Mage Saewald. He has the necessary experience to figure out this mystery.
There is a present for me under the Christmas tree.

Get me five chicken, ma friend!

I got great idea, ma friend. You take da chicken, take anodda chicken and anodda chicken, put dem on da skewer tingie. You bake it like nice and slow, put da yogurt sauce on it. Tasty! I have great slogan for it, ma friend: it nota eating, ita feasting.
So ma friend, here's da gold for da chicken from da farmer. Get me five, yes?
I have no reason to say no.
You really aren't as bad as they all say.
Increases the damage, the critical hit chance and the casting time of the mentalism aspect. Allows combat art upgrades in the mentalism aspect.

We will help you, lead on!

You freed us! Therefore, we owe you. Lead the way. We will help you. Our swords are yours.
Can be forged into Bronze, Silver and Gold sockets of weapons and armor.
Have you ever considered getting a shell?
You won't be able to kill me like that, amateur!
So, you really want to know!
Thank you for protecting me from the undead. They were going to catch me and make me one of them. How dreadful!
OK, it looks like the mission is not continuing. Good, I guess I will expand my vocabulary for the Spanish version of the game: "Hasta la vista, Baby" - Zack! - "Adios, Amigos" - Zong, Klang
I have the shackles. I hope Brutus Plutocratio really does pay well for them.
I will make my superior powers available to you
Orcs ... oh well. Can't be worse than the humans.
Orcs are nature's children too. I don't fear them.
First Humans - and now even Orcs! <i> *sighs*
First Elves, then Humans, now Orcs. This adventure just keeps getting wilder.
These Orcs are supposed to be a very hostile people, but I am prepared.
Well, getting along with these Orcs will probably not be any more difficult than getting along with the Humans!
Any Hero who traveled a distance of 200 miles on a special mount.
Don't disturb me, I have to focus.
Let's see how well your Gods are protecting you!

Destroy the mysterious machine!

Please, don’t hurt us! We were kidnapped, and these people have a diabolical machine that turned us to weak-willed slaves! Please help us and destroy the machine!
There's nothing I can do for you, stranger.

I have spoken to alchemist Rina Boombastic. She is being blackmailed by a gang of thugs for “protection money.” She doesn't have enough money left so she had to purchase inferior ingredients. Therefore, her potions are not their usual quality any longer. I have to take care of this!
Wounding - Chance to cause an open wound (damage over time).
Vehemence - Allows Demonic Blow to inflict area damage on nearby opponents.
Frailty - Temporarily reduces the opponent's armor class.
Poisoning - Adds poison damage (damage over time).
Life Leech - Leeches life from opponents when they are hit.
Trauma - Chance to cause a severe wound.
I’ve eliminated all the cultists I could find. Now I can return to the merchants.

Defend Lady Eldredar’s honor!

I am appalled! My honor was besmirched, trampled on and sullied. A young good-for-nothing is saying the most disgusting things about me, and the rumors are spreading like wild fire. The only way to restore my honor would be to challenge him to a duel. I’m not a fighter, and that is why I am looking for a champion.

Would you care to be my champion?
They're all dead! But they didn't really have a chance anyway.
Better weapons make better arguments. The world is a wonderfully simplistic place!
You're looking sad, dear child. Can I be of assistance?
I can't stop thinking about nature, and how unfairly she treats us.
But why would you think that?
Well, we're almost like lizards, so why can't we lay eggs?
What a strange question. Would you really want that?
Of course. We could just leave the eggs at home and still enjoy life. Pregnancies are so strenuous.
The idea never occurred to me. But don't forget that someone could steal the eggs.
Maybe the problem could be solved by magic. You should think about it.
They won't be robbing anybody anymore, but one of them is still alive. He will most certainly be kind enough to tell me where their camp is.

Fetch me some sticklewort!

There are a few uncontaminated places in the woods. You should be able to find sticklewort there. Please get me one. The soldier mentioned a woman on a hill. That could be a clue! Maybe the herb grows in places like that?!
Unfortunately, I cannot use this item yet.
The Leader of the Unholy Crusade
I have returned the cat unscathed.
I've delivered the customer and received my reward.
You should seriously consider changing jobs. You could make a lot of money with your skills in my line of work.

Chase off the grave robbing Kobolds!

Well since you're already here, I have another teeny tiny task that you could take care of. It's about these Kobolds. You probably met some on your way here. Those sneaky little beasts break in everywhere and steal anything that isn't tied down. Normally that isn't so bad, we know how to defend ourselves. But these Kobolds aren't scared of anything! They keep breaking into the rock tombs and crypts, steal candles and play hide and seek behind the sarcophagus! This must be stopped! Would you take on this task? Go into the burial caves and chase off these creatures!

A mysterious creature that calls itself a Dream Vampire has infested a village. If it isn't stopped then it will destroy all the inhabitants of the village. I must defeat this being, but that is only possible in a dream. I'm going to take a nap.
Do not fret, I am here to help you.

Tell the town guard what Keltar has done!

The town guard must be informed about everything that's happened here. Keltar must be punished for his crime. Go and tell the town guard what you have uncovered. They will know what to do.
Where are all of your friends?
Hmm ... locked? Maybe Galdar has an idea. You should talk to him.

Get goods for Cassandra from the caravan that was involved in an accident.

Rose of the Wind? I'm sorry, I don't have anything like that in stock. To be honest with you, up until now I'd only ever heard about this plant in legends. My grandfather left me a map that is marked with a rose. I never really looked into it, that particular area is crawling with undead. If you want it, then I would be prepared to give it to you. In return though, you would have to get me the goods that I ordered a while ago. They never arrived because the caravan had an accident.
You deserve my respect, Warg hunter.
Are you a real Demon, or just dressed like one.
Scaring poor children. You cowardly woman.
Do all women look as messy as you, where you come from?
Maybe I should stay away from here.

Trollcherries? Yes, I have them in stock. I suppose they're for Fangor, aren't they? You can tell that mongrel to bring me my money before something terrible happens to him. Oh! The cherries are for you, are they? Well then, here you are.
This is really good silk! Quite commendable! Here take these balls of wood spider silk. There's no charge, I have enough silk left over.
The Commander has some more assignments for me. If he thinks it will help...

Look what we've got here ... a camp! Looks like an abandoned military base. Or rather:Like the remains of a base. Pretty run-down, this camp. And its inhabitants look everything but fresh and healthy, too. They are zombies, all of them!
I don't find that AT ALL funny!
All this clicking is bad for your mouse!
If I had any nerves, you would be getting on them right now!

Thank you, thank you very much. This also secures the sales for the next two weeks. Let's hope that our supplier will be back on his feet then so we'll keep getting the desert weed.
Here is your reward, as promised.

Maybe you should pay my daughter Mayita a visit in the jungle. I am sure she could use your help.
Your name will soon be in my quest book as well.
I've met a spirit who seems to have a job for me to do. I'm going to foll... Huh? He's gone!
Hooray to me! You won't find anything moving in here now!
What kind of a monster are you?
You haven't won the war! It was a tie!
Unfortunately, there's nothing more I can tell you. Good luck!
I will only mount that if it turns into a monitor lizard.
Strange things are happening close to this village. Dryads keep disappearing here. I'm supposed to look into the matter and act as a sort of decoy.
Increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Nefarious Netherworld. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Your time as a leader is over!

Ah... yes, I thought so. Loyalty and honor and all that rot. Well then, I guess we need to solve the problem in a different way. You are going to regret your decision very very soon....

KILL HIM!
Now be on your way, stranger.
Go on! My humble parish would gladly welcome some new followers.
Don't make such a fuss! Dragon vapors are much worse. But I'll go.
Thank you for having faith in me, sister. I will not disappoint you.
This stench of brimstone is indeed horrendous. How can you live here for any length of time?
Don't worry. You will soon be able to sleep with the windows open again.

A man who was so drunk that he could barely talk told me that he has a Dragon locked away in his cellar. It sounds like a madman’s tale, but who knows? Maybe there’s some truth to his story. I should go and have a look.
A strong rain shower can ruin the result of several day's work.
Smoke, smoke, smoke. There's smoke everywhere. I hate smoke.
My husband says I should quit this smoking.
This cough will be the death of me yet.
I don't have much charcoal left at the end of the month.
That could have been worse. Maybe I should take a look around.
This settlement of the Orcs is situated within the western mountains.
You come here, all strong and powerful...
What did you play when you were a child?
Us kids like to re-enact your adventures!
How can I get muscles like those?
You look phat, all big and strong!
Return to your swamp, or better still, drown in the lake.

Guardian of Souls
The truth generally hides under a pile of lies.

Take the talisman to my parents!

Please ... help ... me. We were ambushed by goblins ... didn't stand a chance ... I won't make it ... lost too much blood ... Would you honor my dying wish? This talisman ... my mother gave it to me when I left home to ... become a soldier. Deliver it to her, so she has at least something to remember me by ...
Weren't you supposed to deal with this matter?
Why aren't these Elves getting it?
I'm quite a smart fellow, don't you agree?
Thank you for the tusk, now I can celebrate our wedding anniversary appropriately.
The soldiers have already entered the camp! I will kill them all!
Oh! You're back! Very good. Did you get all the materials? Excellent. Keep the change. Oh... and take this too. Maybe you can have a little fun with it.
I think this is just a bad joke! The ancestors have proven their sense of humor once again.
That's the problem with the ancestors! They protect us well, but they are also incredibly jealous!
No, I don't believe this! How will we procreate? In secret and in the dark, like in the old times?
It's hard enough for us already! And if I'm no longer allowed to have a spouse I'll step down.
The ancestors should watch out or they'll feel my wrath! Am I supposed to do the housecleaning myself in the future?
That has to be a bad joke! Are the ancestors planning to do our cooking and cleaning?
Ha! I'm not at all convinced that Priests do need a wife, but I will keep the reasons private for now.
What now? In my opinion the state of marriage is very overrated! There are other ways to find pleasure.
What the ancestors want? I assume the High Priest is behind this, everyone knows he doesn't like women very much!
That's a bad joke! If it turns out to be true I'm going to leave the land and I'll take my 18 wives with me!
Secret negotiations have been taking place between cultists and traditionalists. My mission is to seek out their meeting and kill all of the negotiators.
If you ever feel interested in an adventure tour, don't hesitate to contact me.
<pain, like getting your fingers burnt> Ahhhhh!
I hate these animals! ALL OF THEM!
You were very helpful and you bring us good news, we are in your debt. We hope that the soldiers won't bother us anymore. Please take this as a token of our appreciation.

Seraphim Nadja seems to be pretty stressed out. She's working on a weird looking thing that she calls a console. She is so focused on her work that she forgot to study a few Ice Elementals that were “switched” last week. Apparently the Seraphim are able to create monsters on demand. I'm supposed to kill 20 Ice Elementals and bring Nadja their crystals.
There is no limit to my resourcefulness.
My songs could make stones weep.
Sometimes I deliver one punchline after another.
I am an Orc, but I'm not called Mork.
I dedicate special poems to the heroic deeds of soldiers.
Even if you're not interested in this, please help me with another matter.
In this case I need some solemn advice from you!
I'd like to ask you something else that's quite important to me!
An attack! They haven't seen anything yet...
The instructor asked me to fight against some of his trainees in the arena. I wonder what they are capable of.
Our world is dying - do you want to die as well? Get moving!
You are a veritable fountain of wisdom. Farewell.
Too bad actually, but a promise is a promise...
Well then, have a nice day your majesty.
Dryads are not worthy opponents - killing them is no fun...

Analysis: shrunken head smells pungent. Treatment with perfumed oil scheduled for later.
Data indicates that the second key is located in the Dragon realm.
Unfortunately, I wasn't able to save Tári. The poor girl!
The slaves are still all present, they're too scared to run away now. Here is your reward my friend!
Excellent! Now we can focus our attention on the Golem again.
I have to break the T-Energy's power!
I would take you seriously but you have to give me the opportunity to do so.

Find out what's wrong with our Abbess!

You have been very helpful to us and I thank you in the name of my fellow Sisters. Nevertheless, may I permit myself to ask one last favor of you?
Wilgyrien, our Abbess, has been behaving strangely lately. She shuts herself away in the meditation hall and won't let anyone else in. I sent two fellow sisters to her yesterday, but both of them have disappeared. Please go and make sure everything is all right. I'm very worried!
The Nargutz ball is well hidden. I should go back to Celal now.
Bow your head to the true Gods of Ancaria.
That's done, the cultists will think twice about conjuring here again. I should deliver the good news to the people of the village.
Too many are dead. I have failed.

By the Gods! What have you done? You killed him!

I told you to only use weakened magic! Murderer! I cannot believe it was me who instructed you! You will pay for this!
This opponent is not worthy of an Inquisitor!
I hope, they have a good hairdresser here...
Okay, I'll pull the wool over that creature's eyes!
We'll continue practising to aim, alright?
Mission accomplished? Very good! Then our campaign is now well prepared! In the name of the Inquisition I thank you.
What a battle! The Abishai is dead! Thank the gods he wasn't in full possession of his powers, or it would've been a close call.
Double Attack - Chance to strike twice with one hit.
Hydraulics - Successful hits will inflict more damage.
Efficiency - Decreases the regeneration time of Battle Extension.
Double Attack - Chance to strike twice with one hit.
Intent - Increased chance to land critical hit.
We don't want things like you around here!
Do you want me to tell you something about your mother?
Hello, big shot! How would you like to die?

You know... not many people are left around here who are willing to act. Most of them live in constant fear of the cult. A few have even joined it hoping to be spared. My neighbor, farmer Toby, seems to be one of them. Toby isn't a bad guy, maybe you can pluck him from the jaws of this cult.
<Pain, sharp as if being pricked with a needle> ai!
Incinerate - Increases fire damage within range.
Frost Protection - Reduces ice damage even more.
Energy Efficiency - Decreases the regeneration time.
Sustain - Increases the duration of Fiery Ember.
Robber-knight Runkle is history. I also found the gold.

Trolls are not very bright, uncouth creatures. Their abilities to speak and express themselves are limited. They mostly live in caves, but they also have above ground places of worship, some of them armed. Due to their strength and height (3 to 4 meters), they are terrible opponents as warriors.
Good prey to you! And a long life!
May our forefathers bless you and your weapons.
Thank you for your words, it was a pleasure.
See you soon, and stay as healthy as you are!
I wish you blessing and victory! And I leave as a friend.
Good luck, my friend! It's always welcome in the battle.
May your claws always be sharp and deadly.
See you soon, friend and fellow! And be victorious all the time!
I've rarely enjoyed a conversation that much, but I have to go!
Oh man, that doesn't look good.
Ah, the bravest warrior in centuries! It is nice to see you!
You are the epitome of evil - a nightmare!
Good luck on your journey, paragon for all fighters!

Mynhard sends you? That lazy jer- er... I mean how many milestones did you count?

Four? Hmm... according to my documents there should be five of them! Could you please double check and see if you overlooked one?

This portal leads to the territories north of the southern ocean. Go through the portal and find the Family Grackk.

It is done then... so mote it be.
The answers to your questions can be found in the High Temple of the Lost City. Once this was the capital of the ancient Elven realm, but now it's deserted and has been swallowed by the jungle in the southlands.
It's quite far away, but I can make your trip a bit shorter. Go through this portal, it leads to the lands north of the southern sea. When you arrive, find the hearth of the family Grackk. One such as you will be welcome there.

I finally arrived at Mer-Kil's lair. As expected, the Dragon didn't want to join our side, because he's not interested in mundane squabbles.
If I kill a creature called the Carnach, another etheral entity like the Dragon, he'll reveal the location of the hub as well as allow his slaves to worship Ker.
Wasmut's home is being haunted by poltergeists. I've been asked to take care of the matter, so I'd better get started. What is it they say? I ain't afraid of no ghost.

Talk to the combo master!

Where is Mishirla? When he came back, he stayed only for a short time before he left again to find you. He didn't say much before he left. Only something about a camp to the east. He didn't find you, huh?

Oh ... you ... you had to kill him? How tragic. He probably became one of us after such a violent death. Talk to the combo master. It's too late to save the archaeologist's life, but maybe you can still save his soul.
Book 3: The Poisons of Ancaria: Their Use, Effect, and Attributes
Impact - Increased damage from the nova
Zone - Increases nova's area of effect
Afterglow - Magical damage over time is increased
Experience - Lowers the costs for the combat art
What was the magic word again? Ok, fine, do not say 'please' then.
The seraphim actually believed the yarn I spun her and even paid me handsomely for my heroic deed! Amazing ...
I wonder if I can beat these wannabe forest Elves with one hit?
I know where my stuff is! Come on!
Ophtanar is defeated and the cult is leaderless.
This is the item I require. Curator approaches.

Fetch me an invincibility potion from the village witch!

Are you here for the nargutz game too? I can hardly wait for it! Our team is bound to win! It doesn’t look good for us this year though, too many of our players are injured and those stinking Tharak Orcs have more substitute players! They’ve even brought Kullgard with them, a striker from one of the northern teams! I have a plan though, our village witch Libatta has concocted a potion that will make our players invincible. Go to her and fetch the potion! I can’t go myself, our opponents have agents everywhere.
Wild animals seem to be afraid of me...
Animals always seem to be bigger in tales...
I have to fix the hunting stand - it's best if I do that tomorrow.
Am I just slow, or are the jackrabbits fast today?
As the hunters of old said, "The man who sits up high, sees more".
When There's No More Room in Hell...
It looks very valuable. I better keep it. What's a stupid ghost and her daughter to me...
The Inquisitors are a bunch of murderers!
No one will find you in the swamp, Inquisitor!
You Inquisitors only bring suffering into the world!
The Gods are turning away from you, Inquisitor!
In the tavern? At this time of day? What will people think of me?
Oh a fight! It looks like I've got allies here. I should help them.
I have killed them all. They could have made a braver attempt to resist though...

You're looking for wood blanks? Aaah! Raerrae sent you, didn't she? Here I put some aside especially for that good woman. Whenever she gets the chance, she could give me back my lock of hair. Would you tell her that? Thanks.
The horses need plenty of straw so that they can rest comfortably.
Come, all of you, there is somebody here!
Come on you losers! To me!
Come to me! There is one!
That runemaster is always good for a surprise! The girls are on their way home as well. Mission accomplished.
Excellent! As I can see, you've brought everything. We will teleport to the main temple now so that the ordinations may begin. Goodbye!
The merchants can continue their little expedition, and their pay wasn’t bad either. Everyone’s happy now!

Speak with the Lumen Priest Migenyw!

The situation in Khorum is tense. Three enemies are trying to harm Khorum simultaneously: the Prince and his conspirators, the Stone Creatures from the west and the Sand Marauders from the east.
Now, of all times, the great excavation site in the south east has asked for help! The Sand Marauders there are becoming more aggressive, and are on the verge of defeating the Humans. I guess it's time I played my last trump card: help from the special troops.
If you're up for a challenge and want to perform a great deed, go to the Lumen Priest Migenyw and say the name “Sheik Yerbouti.” He'll know what to do.
This is my final test. I will take on my fellow student… and of course I will observe general rules.
What a joy it is to look at you! All women would like to be like you! Really, all!
I wish I had a little more of your courage and your strength!
You are the role model of all female warriors!
Puh! I hadn't even gotten warmed up.
This is the sacrifice I make...
But, I've never lost! Well, not my life anyway!

Inscription
If I am away, do not worry. I will be back in time to arrange your timely demise.
Sincerely,
Orpheus
Liara was very grateful, she began to groom herself at once. I wonder if I should get her a flea collar?

Never interrupt your enemy when he is making a mistake.

- Bonaparte
A weapon with poison-based damage does not help me here.
Thank you for your help. Take this gold, and this bottle of red here is quite nice too.
Ah! There's our sweetheart again! Good work! Here is your reward.
You see, there's nothing to it!

The village Priest told me that his temple was robbed recently. The thieves must still be sitting on the loot because it's too soon to sell it. He told me to speak with Leifhard who used to move in those circles, so still knows his way around.
This corner of the world can be travelled safely. I'm pleased.
Ha! Stuck-up Hyderia! Now she's begging for her life. Will I spare her?
I’ve found the balloon. I should take it back to the children.
This time, I will be more successful!
Ker's militant warrior - the people are already praying that you will move on.
When you were created, the Gods must have been having a really bad day.
It would be nice if you could strike down an aristocrat from time to time.
I often see owls and field mice while I'm on my watch.
I know a whole host of night-time stories.
A night like this can be a real nightmare.
The night watch is tiring, but it pays very well.
My work is usually quite monotonous - and then all of a sudden it gets very dangerous.
Sometimes I talk to myself, just for entertainment.
It's always the same round. Again and again... Yawn!
I really need to get a good day's sleep tomorrow.
...and then this lout says to me: :Nightwatchman! You?”

North -> Seraphim Monastery
West -> Sloeford Cemetery
Southeast -> Sloeford
Chance to detect secret compartments in chests and hiding places.
We've defeated all the thieves and Shirka has her equipment again.
I escorted Barbara to the camp.
Alright - I guess I will beat some more Humans to death!
Your last Sacred2 local network session was not closed down correctly. Attempt to restore the session?

Ogre warrior Gargaduck has asked me for 25 Troll hearts. He wants to make a sacrifice to Wantanor, the legendary Ogre warrior and Troll slayer. I have to take the hearts to Wantanor's statue and put them down there.
Well at least I've learned a lot of new things. I thank you for talking with me.
Thank you for having patience with a simple warrior.
It was nice that I was permitted to speak with you!
I wish you a good journey - and pray to Kybele for my soul.
Thank you for meeting with me. You have answered many of my questions.
Many thanks for your wise words. I will take them to heart.
It was really nice to see you, and I thank you for your Godly words of advice.
It was nice that I got the chance to talk to you! This is a gift from the Goddess.
I have to go now! My regards to the Goddess, if you should really see her.
I have other things I must attend to now. My thanks for your honest words.
Hunting in secret doesn't bring fame.
Nothing and still nothing. Maybe I should just steal livestock.
I feel right at home on foreign territory.
A lot of people are seeing red these days - especially when they see my work.
I make off with the prey - and the hunter is annoyed.
An outpost of the Inquisition. They might have an assignment for me!
If love was as easy to understand as war, life would be much simpler.
There is only space for one monster here.
The Marketplace is not available in 2-player mode.
Oh, what's happening now? The magic bean's power has teleported us all back to the city.

Find the spot the undead are infiltrating the navel port from!

The situation seems very threatening. It could even be connected to the problems that we've been having here for a few days. Recently a few undead were spotted in the old naval port. It's a dangerous neighborhood that used to be a place of refuge for cutthroats and criminals, but since undead have been spotted not even the meanest thief will set foot in there. Please go to the old navel port and find out where the undead are entering that area from. When you have some information, report to General Denyew in the military camp.
Good work. Ten heads. Let's see... Business isn't good right now... well, there you go. I need to go back to work.
Time hasn't been good to this statue, but it clearly depicts an Ogre. It has to be Wantanor, so I've reached my destination.
And that! And THAT! AND THAT!

Stone Guardian
Ready to serve for eternity.
I’ll go to town and buy a new cow, but I’ll need a while to get over Dulcinea's death first.
I would be willing to marry, but who would want to marry one of us warriors?
I got to the village and found the Orc spy. He told me where to find the Orcs of the Grurag Clan who insulted "my" clan’s honor. The sooner I kill them, the sooner I can put these dimwits behind me.

The inhabitants of this region founded a militia in order to protect themselves from attacks by the Thraconians and the ghosts. I'm supposed to speak the leader of this militia, a certain captain Gabelte.
Chat is disabled on your PlayStation®Network account due to parental control restrictions.
For future reference: Think about who you're joking with.
Give me all that you've got!

So the former husband of my sister's second cousin sends you? Excellent! It's true that my Temple was robbed a few days ago. The burglars must have been professionals because they only took valuables.

They'll probably sit on the loot until this whole thing's blown over. You can't sell stolen goods right away. Why don't you talk to old Leifhard? He was a bit of a rogue in his days. He's not a criminal anymore, but he stills knows his way around.
I can't believe how expensive grain is these days. The farmers might as well be growing gold in their fields.
Aye, that's true. If ever there was a profiteer, it's our merchant.
He blames it on the long dry summer.
I say that if he didn't need to wet his throat at the inn every hour, prices would soon fall.
That may be. But I can hardly afford to his prices.
Well, perhaps it will rain soon. Then everything will be alright again.
I don't think so, but we shall see...

Bring me the heads of the escaped slaves!

This is how the good-for-nothing Humans show their gratitude! The first sign of danger and they run like chickens! We must show the other slaves that running away is a very bad idea; otherwise, they will not obey me any longer. Find the ten escaped slaves and crush them! Crush them all! And bring me their heads! Hurry, before the broker can smuggle them back to their homeland!
My new genie... now I’m ready for the area competitions!
All of you Orcs will die!

Hahaha!
I thought as much. Well then, die! Your blood will make me even stronger!
Is that all I taught you guys?
Hm? Is this a dead end? Strange ... I wish I had something to read.
Shoo! Shoo!  That is the last of the wild Werewolves. My mission is accomplished, the other Werewolves can relax now.
I should be careful, the creatures around here look powerful.
I will go and find the beast now.

Finally the Ogre considers my fighting skill proven, so he'll allow me to buy one of these special mounts from him. I can't wait to see which one he'll offer me. It seems there are specially bred mounts for certain types of battles.
I'm hunting for a band of nefarious Orcs. Have you seen anything suspicious?
No, but I only just arrived. Why are you hunting them?
We suspect they have stolen a number of wagons. One of the wagons was pulled by two prize-winning oxen.
That's incredible! These foul creatures grow bolder by the day.
Ha, I could tell you stories you wouldn't believe! Nowadays, they even have the nerve to loot and plunder in broad daylight!
How on earth can we stop them? Tell me!
Cold steel is the only language they understand.
I wish you good luck! And watch out for yourself, friend!
Unfortunately, Barbara will never be able to say a prayer of thanks for anyone ever again.
Celibacy for us? Do you believe that the ancestors really demand this?
I'm tired of hearing these demands of celibacy for us hallowed ones! As if we don't have enough problems already, don't you think we suffer enough?
What folly! Now the High Council plans to spoil our marriage vows! When I think of it my scales stand on end!
When they’re really demanding that we Priests not marry, I'll give them a personal introduction to my forefathers!
I can't believe that they really demand celibacy for us! Do they plan to ruin the little joy we have?
Unbelievable! Now some of the brothers want to inflict celibacy on us! That idea must have come from one of the really ugly ones!
Nobody's going to do this anymore if the ancestors deny us marriage! You do realize that don't you?
How can anybody be so foolish as to forbid us Priests to marry? We of all people should reproduce!
I don't really care for this reformation of the marriage rules, I don't want to die alone and unmarried!
If the ancestors really think they can condemn us to celibacy, I'll rebel against them!
Attention. Enemy officer within sensor range.

The enemy is preparing to conduct an important magic ritual. My mission is to stop them from completing the ritual, but it won’t be easy - apparently a powerful Seraphim has come to protect the ritual. We’ll soon see what she's capable of.
I already have the wood blanks. Now I'm off to the jeweler's.
You are the warrior from afar, who killed the water creature at the Orcs' place?!
The salamanders are hissing about it in every pond, you are the warrior who defeated the water creature.
It's too dreadful to even think about what would happen, if such a water monster settled down here!
Such glorious deeds! Both Gar'Colossus and Octagolamus!
Tell me about the Gar'Colossus. What does it look like? Is it big?
Sacrifice to Testa to raise your reputation with him.
The life of a High Elf could be really exciting - if only the user would carry on.

I'm going hydra hunting! Come on, let's see who's stronger. Follow me and you might learn something. Don't forget to collect the hydra's tongues! We'll need them later, you know, tradition and all that. Kill three hydras, and get me three tongues from each one, from the left, middle, and right heads.

Bring my teddy bear back!

Hey, you! Can you help me? My Bruno is gone. I lost him when I fell over. He fell into the gutter and the rainwater flushed him into the sewers. I'm afraid to get him myself because there are rats in the sewers. Can you bring him back?
Try and die with honor this time!

No! Sorry! No time for chit-chat. Their ladyships are wanting their tea. Not that I’m one to stand around and blather, as I was just saying the other day to the understairs maid. ‘Sheila’, says I, ‘if one wants to advance one’s position, one must be prompt in all one’s duties’. One can’t be lollygagging around, although I’m sure I wouldn’t know how to gag a lolly if one came up and bit me on the bum. Still, the point is, useless conversation is such a waste of precious time that I don’t permit it in this household. Never. Not a misplaced word. We are parsimonious with our syllables, we are. Now leave me be with all your yammering, collect those pieces, and go see Mr. Giles in the library.
You're such great heroes, you slave killers!
We are the mob you love to torment!
Don't worry. No one would dare to attack us on our ancestors' land. They would be destroyed.
A strange feeling in my scales tells me that an attacker would only find death here. The spirits protect us.
Well, I think we only have to rely on our spears and the courage in our hearts.
Don't worry. No enemy has ever defeated us, and no one will ever dare to challenge us.
We shouldn't be afraid of a few rogue Orcs. We will impale them on our spears.
Rely on the courage and the skill of our warriors. No enemy could ever defeat them.
People talk a lot of nonsense these days. If there was a threat, the ancestors would have warned us.
Have faith in our strength and our intelligence. They've always protected us in times of war.
I don't want to hear that, it has no meaning. Only the ancestors can guide us through this!
Foreign attackers? How silly. We will pluck and slice them like fruit.

Janos Toth
Is the shop of the adventurous hairdresser across the road open yet?
Thank you! You saved my life. That was close.
Get customer service while you're at it!
Your resurrection was the work of false Gods.
You come from the shadows, you go back to the shadows.
Do you really want to thwart the Gods?
The Gods have already cursed you, Shadow Warrior.
This will be your final funeral.
You should feel honored for I will help you.
Nathim set his thugs on me, just as I expected he would. I quickly persuaded them to lie down for a wee sleep.
If you want to stay, I have another topic that we should talk about.
I don't want to seem bothersome, but there is still one thing I would like to discuss.
If I change the subject, it's nothing against you!
Who would have thought! Okay, well then you can tell me something else.
I don't want to spend too much time here, but there's something else that concerns me!
Now I have to end this topic, because something else has been concerning me for some time.
There's something else that I really want to discuss with you.
I have to discuss something else with you, from one warrior to another.
That's how you see things? Then I would like to hear your opinion on this matter:
I absolutely value your opinion! That's why I want to discuss another matter.
What are you trying to do?

Cultist Kelsior is busy with the preparations for the annual Festival of Sacrifice. He's got the virgins and the gold for the sacrifice, but is still missing the third offering - the beer. Unfortunately the cultists have used up their supplies and find it hard to get new beer. They're hoping I'll be able to find some at a site in the Dragon region where an Orc expedition was massacred. If I fail, the cultists will have to face the wrath of the Dragons.
Do not interfere in the Gods' business!

Orc Hero
He probably didn't look that impressive in the flesh.
This would appear to be all of them.
Let the Shadow Warrior release you, Dragon!
Ah! That explains it! That grumpy Dragon was behind all of the problems, and now he wants to start some trouble. He'll get what he wants!
The Priest said we should pray to Kuan.
If into a bog my enemy should wander, I'll walk away and not even ponder.
Oh how heavy my weapons have grown!
I wonder if one of our warhorses will bat his eyelashes at me?
At the next moon, my weapons must go to the blacksmith.
I would like to know the difference between activity and strategy...
There is believed to be a new potion that strengthens the fighting spirit.
All hail courage and the art of war!
The life of a soldier - oh my aching feet! The witches should invent an herbal remedy to cure it.
Hey - I take handouts from legends too...
Take heed! There are many who envy you.
Couldn't you use your reputation to champion for our freedom?
Meeting you personally is probably a twist of fate.
I'd better get out of the way...
I wonder if there is a shoe store in this village...
You should have fled my aura...
I can't remember names... I'll simply call you rotter.
You probably can't afford to be weak, can you?
You probably always have to be on your guard, don't you?
The Gods did a good job when they created you!
You are certainly a person who makes their dreams come true!
Does a hero like you have room for love in his life?
Finally, the boy can take the candies to his sister.

Oh thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Oh here, this is for you. Daddy always says this orb protects him from all the poisons out here, but now he doesn't need it anymore.
He says it doesn't help if you just carry it around in your backpack, but I don't know what that means.

I am one of the Seraphim! The ethereal beings who have been watching over the fates of the worlds since the beginning of time. United as sisters under the watchful eye of Sophia we were committed to our duty and proud to serve! Yet, the creator has left this world. Thus, we are patiently waiting for the day when he will finally return, the day when our duty will be fulfilled.

Little sister! How nice to see you again! Well? Weren't you able to resist the temptation to hunt me down? Understandable! No really, I do understand that!
Catch me if you can! Before I turn this whole bunch here into zombies!
There is no storage device connected to the console. A storage device is required to load and save your game progress.
Don't you dare to stain my robe with your Orc blood!
Are you paid in gold for your services?
Welcome - your reputation is known throughout the land.
The Gods have brought you here. That must be a sign.
We guards admire your fighting abilities.
You seem very real to me for a legend - and very manly!
And which one of you is the little gingerbread man?
You have my gratitude, good man.
Young Annia is persecuted by her husband. I have to return her talisman before everything gets out of hand.
May your ancestors guard you, stranger.
Your entrails are soiling my weapon!
Forens' divine wisdom fills the hero with inspiration and insight. For a brief period all damage taken will be reflected back to the attacker who consequently harms himself.
Crap! I forgot the last words I had prepared!
It wasn't that great being a skeleton, anyway!
Then I'll just go back to my grave!
That wasn't fair! You had healing potions!
Okay, you won. But you got lucky!
You got us to the meeting place safely. I thank you for your deeds. They will not be forgotten!
Say hi to the Gods for me, and go to hell!
Ok, here you go. Wear it wisely, because if push comes to shove this might save your life - for a few more seconds anyway. I wish you good luck, stranger.
I have the three plows and now I have to take them to the armorer. Good grief, these things are heavy!

I have to pose as a member of the Barimak family to take part in their secret meeting. It's important that I uncover what these conspirators are planning.
Another check in the book of quest.

Gather some rain leaf and feed it to the archaeologist.

The archaeologist was badly injured. He will die and become one of us if you don't administer rain leaf immediately. The herb can be found in the area, but it is very rare. If you want to save Mishirla, you should hurry.
Don't hide behind your minions, come and fight me!

HELLO!
Ah here we are. The Priest is relived that the inhabitants of the village can sleep peacefully again.
Dundiel will tell me everything if I let him live. It’s a difficult decision.
I can't say no to this.
Hey Elf! How about we have a go at it?
You're supposed to kill! How hard can it be?
My power, I can feel it!
The little master machinist was delighted and the Christmas Ogre is starting to come out of his cave too.  But what's this, he's still in his dressing gown.
I actually found the murderer and brought him to justice! What a satisfaction!

Equipment
Use the tabs to look at your character's equipment and that of your mounts.

You can place the appropriate items into these slots. When the slot is empty, a tooltip will explain which item type can be put there. The regeneration time varies depending on the equipped armor. Cloth armor offers less physical protection but you will be able to execute combat arts in quicker succession.

Selling

Placing an item on this icon will sell it immediately. You will receive less money than you would at a merchant, but at least you will have room in your inventory again.

Forging
If your character has learned the "Blacksmith" skill you will be able to open the forge menu here.

Overview
This is an overview of all bonuses and penalties that are currently influencing your character.

Set Bonuses

When parts of your equipement belong to a special item set, they can unlock certain bonuses. These will be displayed on this screen.

Orb

You can equip your character in three different areas: the equipment screen, the weapon slots and the orb.
The orb is for relics that offer you protection against non-physical damage types.

Mounts
If you own a horse or a character specific mount you can equip it via the mount tab. Under that tab you can also select, which mount you would like to use.

Free our men from the mine!

They took them all! Our men - they just took them! They dragged them off to the mine to work them like slaves. I beg you, please help us! Free our men!

Officer Mintuck seems to be the highest-ranking officer of this outpost. He told me that wounded and dead garema had been found in the area recently. He asked me to take his scout Amradriel and find out what happened. Let's see what happened to the small people.
Death to all Drya... I mean: Death to you!
Elves all wicked and bad! Betray us, give bad goods then come at night to steal supplies. Say peace but act like want fight!
Oh? Now you expect me to save your backside? I should leave you to rot.
I've seen entire forests of Aspen leaves that trembled less than you, coward!
Calm down! I have fought against worse opponents. I will help you, although, you actually don't deserve it.
You'll do anything I want? Hmm... A few ideas come to mind.
If you tremble you are even easier prey for the monster. So what sense does it make to be scared?

Give Mawino this bag of gold.

Mawino's plans are excellent. I support them whole heartedly.
Muntus please give this gold to Mawino. I want to show my support for his plans.
How do you spend you time when you don't have people to spook?
How is this unbearable life treating you?
I haven't seen you in ages. Maybe it's because of the darkness.
I can hardly believe it - can you? I thought you'd passed to the other side.
It's great to see you're still alive. I was really worried.
You? What a happy moment! I really thought you were dead.
It's great to see that you're still among us.
You're back? Well, how are you doing in these dark days?
Ah, what a great coincidence it is meeting you!
Oh, let me take a look at you! It looks like you've seen better days.
It's been so long since I've seen you, hello!
The Kobold did not offer any resistance when he was ordered to be absorbed by the machine. I can't wait to see what the magician will find out about this device now.
Make sure you don't stumble over this bark beetle.

An extraordinarily tough beast, this Narmuel. No one has seen him for years, and those who hunted him never returned or were in as bad a state as Seraphim Iseult. In any case, I must warn you about going hunting here. Unless ... let's see ... hmmm ...
Maybe you are strong enough to kill the beast after all. Seraphim Sophia promised a reward to the one who brings her the ice phoenix's head. And I'm sure she wasn't talking about honor and glory. If you want to accept the challenge, I don't want to keep you.

Help me find the cursed medallion!

Greetings! Let's not beat around the bush here, I have a problem. A little while ago smugglers stole a medallion from us. The dumb thing is, the medallion is cursed and the thieves completely underestimated the power of it! That thing is dangerous! If used improperly it will kill a person instantly and conjure up evil spirits to boot.
I have to find this medallion again, before the smugglers can do any serious damage with it. Thank goodness I've already been able to pick up a trail. These bent branches have shown me the way. Ha ha, just a little joke that you probably don't understand. Please help me take the medallion away from the smugglers!
Very good! Follow me, my friends!
Wretched magician, now we'll finish you!
Damn slave driver, you're done now ...
Elf, that's the end of that!
What do you think will happen now, Elven witch?
You seriously believe that people still have money to donate?
Are you really going to ask me for a donation to your church? I'm destitute!
How can you send people around to collect donations? Do you think we're made of gold?
Don't ask me for a donation. I can barely feed myself.
If you're asking me for a donation to your church, then your mind must be clouded.
It would be really insensitive to ask me for money, I've got nothing left.
Your donation collectors are getting impertinent. They're even bothering beggars now.
Ask yourself if it's really wise to brazenly ask people for donations in hard times like these.
Well at least you haven't asked for a donation yet. You've no doubt heard about my poverty.
I'll listen to you, if you don't beg for money. What would you like to say?
Grease your joints, you're squeaking while running!
Your fighting skills are almost as good as mine!
I've got the pouch with the emeralds. Now I have to go to Evorey and get the wood spider silk.

Take me to the next village.

My work here is finished for now. Please take me to the next village, so that I can report to my superior.
The Seraphim has relinquished the splinter to me, she thinks I'm good. I am on the right track.
I have reached the dungeon where Bacalio's father is being held.
I will follow you to the dining room in my palace! Lead on!
Where were you when the Gods needed you?
We must hurry! We don’t have much time!
He who fights for the darkness will be purified by the Light!
He has to be somewhere, bring me his head!
Ye Gods, why do you punish me with this plague called 'Kobolds'?
My father's weapons aren't rusty like that.
You're supposed to be a hero, but no one here knows you!
This chicken won't lay eggs anymore.
Invalid port. Please choose a port between 1024 - 32767.
That shouldn't surprise you child! It's strictly forbidden for us mortals to behold the Gods!
Kybele is the force running through all things that are beautiful. She reveals herself in all the wonders of nature that are around us.
Don't ask too much of the Goddess! She lives in the spheres of the heavens that we don't have access to.
It is forbidden for us to see her face! The Goddess doesn't allow herself to be measured according to our standards!
Holy mistletoe! No mortal is allowed to behold her because that is what we were once told!
I'm not trying to discourage you, but the Goddess remains hidden to us all. She has her reasons.
No mortal is allowed to see the Goddess! The punishment for that would be unimaginable.
Our Goddess will always remain a mystery, and her law forbids us to draw pictures of her!
It may be unfortunate that we aren't allowed see her, but Kybele is a Goddess who is hidden from view!
That would be terribly presumptuous! After all, she is a Goddess and will never reveal herself to us mortals.
Your wickedness leaves me with no other choice, but to slay you!
Kybele despises you and your ways!
This is our country - you don't belong here!
I'll show you what we do with your kind!
Bad heroes go everywhere - especially the grave!

WHHHATT ARRRE YOOUUUU?

Geroda was mumbling something about a machine that could destroy every spirit in the proximity. But he also said it wouldn't work yet. Anyway, he has asked me to take the collected signatures to an alchemist in the human territories.
I assume this will be another year of bloodletting and fighting.
Another war! Politics failed! Who will you be fighting for?
Please stay! Nobody cares about our security!
Please be careful not to get between the fronts!
It's advisable to turn around now and then while fighting!

I reached the outpost and spoke to the outpost commander. He made an amulet of protection from the heartscales I gave him, and then told me where I could find the Mer-Kil.
Rumor has it that the evil ghost is hiding in the cellar, but that shouldn’t be a problem for me.
The Orc woman was relieved that she wouldn’t have to spend the rest of her life as a crow.
Sure, try to save your pathetic life!

In this region, all unbelievers have been converted. So I may move on!
Buddy, you have a dandruff problem.
This statue was probably made by an apprentice.
You High Elves will never learn when to take a step back, eh?
There's really no point in staying here any longer. The opponents are just too weak...
Getting slain is the best that can happen to you!
Thank you! Take care of yourself as well!
Everything will turn out, don't give up hope.
Keep your spirits up - that's my parting advice.
I have to go as well. The squad is already calling for me.
So take care! I'm happy to have raised your spirits a bit.
I hope you'll remember me kindly.
Thanks for your frank words, take care!
I'm happy to have met you.
Thanks for your candid words, keep your spirits up.
Stay steady - then we'll see each other again in better times.
What was the middle part again? Hey, just kidding, I'm ready.
Many thanks to all of our fansites! Please check the "Fansites" section on www.sacred2.com to find direct links to all of them.

The Orc leader is dead, but he didn't have a valuable artifact on him. I think the dying Knork was a weakling, but a cunning one. He used me to avenge his death, by tricking me into looking for a magic thing that doesn't exist. That's pretty clever for an Orc.
Thank you! Kybele will reward you, but here's something from me as well.

Bring me 20 bug carapaces!

Greetings friend! My name is Barradei and it is my responsibility to provide our guests at the gladiator fights with anything they might desire. Just as long they can afford it of course.
We are expecting guests from as far as Thylysium to attend the next games. We must be well prepared for such honorable guests. I have much to do and I was wondering if I could interest you in a small business proposition: If you help me to prepare everything for the games then I will reward your generously. Our honored guests like to drink the much renowned “Thunder Gurgler” - a drink so potent that it must be served in a goblet crafted from a bug carapace. The first thing I need is 20 bug carapaces. Well, what do you say?

Go and talk to the Elves. Let them know that they are free to go.

Well, you really did it. You are not just a warrior, you are a hero! You bestowed the reputation upon our Clan that it so rightly deserves. I am in your debt. The Elves you are looking for are over there. Your reward shall be to go and free them.
Sometimes I wish I could settle down in a small place like this one ...

Bring me the heads of 20 Blood Dryads!

The battles against the Blood Dryads are horrible, but unavoidable. If we want to continue to have a chance against these invasions, then we will definitely need some new shrunken heads. Fresh shrunken heads will strengthen our warriors' morale, and it's important that morale is high! Please be so kind as to bring me the heads of 20 Blood Dryads!

Follow me to Deputy Dundiel!

I saw discolored tongues like this years ago when some newcomers mistook the local dreamberries for common blackberries, their tongues turned blue and they became very aggressive. Rabid actually! Afterwards we set fire to all the dreamberry bushes on the island so that it could never happen again. Let’s go to Dundiel and ask him for his opinion on the matter. He is our leader's deputy.
I don't think you'll find peace anywhere.
Some fights really are gruelling. That must be quite exhausting.
Isn’t it dangerous to meet violent resistance?
In times of peace you probably wait for the next fight, don't you?
I've heard that after a battle you smell like burned earth, do you really?

Find the Informants!

So you're interested in a lucrative task? Well then...
Lately weapons are constantly being taken from our armory. These weapons then mysteriously wind up in the hands of the outlaws. We need to find out who is behind this. I appointed someone to this task a long time ago. He's staying in the guest barracks outside of the city. Look for him and find out how far along he is in his investigations!
You'll need this pass from the king as identification!
While active, this aura grants a chance to reflect ranged damage back to its source.

You did it? You really killed that creature? So the tale about the branch from the death tree was true after all?! I must admit I didn't quite believe in it myself. Now that the creature is dead, we have a good cause to celebrate. Uhm ... after I mourned the death of my wife, of course. I'm not a pig.
Here, take this for all your trouble.

Good day! Yes that’s right, my bodyguard has fallen ill and cannot accompany me on my travels. What? Yes I am looking for someone who could stand in for that lazy dog. I pay well - but your pay will be halved if I suffer so much as a scratch. Do you accept my conditions? I shall bid my wife farewell and then we can leave!
Looking at the speed with which you kill each other, it's a miracle any of you are left.
There's the medallion. Even though we were too late and the evil spirits have been conjured up already, all is not lost. Thank you for your help. Here take this, it is very valuable. Honest!
Pine needle flavoured mead - I don't like these trendy drinks.
I am offering my guests fine sawdust brandy.
At my place, each and every guest should feel at home.
They drink more milk and juice at my place than in a nursery.
Honey liqueur - A treat for the taste buds!
Never cross a revenant's path, Human!
I've found a bag with strange herbs. I bet it's poison, but the village doctor will know for sure, if that's true.
Off to the fortress my young hero!
Well done, thank you!  That will deter the poachers for a while.
The customer was happy and says thank you.
Increases armor protection and reduces the combat art regeneration penalty. Also grants the ability to wear higher-level armor.
Attack, that's what I pay you for!
Show the enemy what I pay you for!
You want to go up against the Shadow Warrior?
Not half bad! Take a little break. Let me know when you've caught your breath and we'll raise the bar a little higher again.
TyBosso has been punished. The Circle of Mages requests communications with me.

An undead released ancient spores in a cave. They threaten to spread and poison all male undead in the region which will make them stupid.

I must pray to Kybele now so she'll make it rain. She must be appeased first, though, which will only work with the following reagents:

The Priest was pleased. The artifact still seems to be intact.
