Get me 15 crystals from Stone Elementals.

So you're back, you must be pretty curious. Would you like to help me again? I need 15 crystals from Stone Elementals for my studies. I have to compare the essence structures of their crystals to the ones from the Ice Elementals. Would you bring me 15 Stone Elemental crystals?
<Pain, dull as if being hit in the stomach> ouff!
The taste of your blood is... addictive.
Death... can you feel it coming?
I wish I could feel your pain.
I should take the ten Kobold heads to Boon.
You're back already, and you have the pelts too? Oh very good! I am eternally in your debt!

Turns into a young dragon with strong armor and combat spells. Dragons of this size can't fly but have the power to feign flying. In his changed form, the dragon mage enters a trance and fully focuses on the battle. He is oblivious to other people or objects.
I've got time ... I've spent centuries waiting, an hour more or less doesn't matter to me ...
That should teach you a lesson! Don't mess with the dragon mage!
Orcs... I never could stand them!
So you defeated the elemental. Respect! I didn't think you could do it.
The largest inland lake of the continent.
Well that's done! One of them is still alive, I'm going to go speak with him.
Well done! You are a true hero. Please accept this gift along with the blessing of Ker.
Has my son become a great warrior?
You seem to come from a distant country.
Are you able to jump on one leg like me?
Did you play "Beat the Elf" as a child too?
You are not allowed to run that fast in play streets.
The old Elves think you'll make it far someday, but they don't know how far.
It's really comfy in the lounge, but there was something more than relaxation waiting for me...
What now? First come back, now stay away? Clan means so little? I talk to them!
And where were you when the creator handed out brain cells?
One more time, and I'll string you up.
What else would you like me to carry?

Fangor was pleased with the new order, he had planned to cook a cauldron of swill soon anyway. Fangor needs a few ingredients and he has asked me to fetch them for him. He promised to give me some potions in return.
Fantastic! Rider and horse ... double experience points!

Well, well, look what we have here!
Another one of those brave “Dragon Hunters” who's suffering from delusions of grandeur thinking they can defeat a real dragon. You can't even touch me, let alone kill me! Prepare to die, you absurd waste of space!

Take the dress to my daughter.

Take this dress to my daughter in town. I feel bad for not going myself, but it's a long and difficult journey for an old woman. Please say hello and happy birthday from me!
I'm so full of anger at those overblown Elves.
What good fortune! I found a piece of cheese.

I have the tendons from three hands. I hope he didn’t make a mistake in his calculations.
I knew we would understand each other.

A little city air will do no harm. It'll let me forget the peasants' stench ...

Well, how have you been and how's business?
How nice to meet you! I'd be willing to talk to you for a while.
How are you? We haven't seen each other for a while!
Ah, a familiar face! How's life treating you?
How nice to see you! Finally I meet a normal Elf again!
You? It's been a while, I'd say!
I hope all is well! I'm really happy to see you!

I hope your buyer still has their receipt, so they can exchange you.

I cannot ride that nag yet!
Marys is finished off. Everything is going the right way.
I do have the map now, but I still don't know how to get to that island. Let's see if I can talk the archaeologist into taking me to the island.
Good work. They won't be poaching around here anymore. Here's your gold. And now get lost. We are busy.

What is THAT? Disgusting! Hmm ... on closer inspection though ... that must be skin! It looks like ... Lydia!
Without a body, but still Lydia. Something really stinks! Not even zombies shed their skin like that. I have to tell Glenn what I found.

The Royal Atherton family owe you a debt of gratitude.

General

Most residents of Ancaria aren’t able to distinguish more than four different kinds of herbs. They know that hermit leaves stink and are a good spice for their food, that Celandine can cause the milk of their goats to taste bitter, that shadow moss is good for sprains and that Mandragorum Officinarum (even though most can't pronounce the name) can perform miracles in relation to love. They tend to divide the herbs in three different categories: flavor enhancers for food, medicinal herbs and poisons. Knowledgeable herbalists also know that the herb that can heal is also able to kill, and that deadly herbs are sometimes useful for love - and not just to get rid of an unwanted rival.

Herbalists can be found far away from the streets and villages, in places where no horseshoes trample the green and where the shadowy forest doesn’t have to give way to fields. Their knowledge is passed on from generation to generation but only to those who have proven themselves worthy. Healers, poisoners and cooks seek out these herbalists when they start their training, and the best stay for many years. The herbalists generally don’t care why their knowledge is sought, much as a blade isn’t interested in whether it’s chopping bread or heads. Some of them choose to enter certain guilds, and they offer their services as healers. They have a high position in most villages and towns, because many of the residents owe their lives and well-being to the herbalist's skill. They rarely work for free. Contrary to popular opinion most herbalist aren’t spiritualistic forest goblins who live in mossy huts, they are clever business people who know quite well that some herbs are worth a hundred times their weight in gold.

If you’re interested in this profession you'll need a lot of patience and good eyes. It’s a time consuming business to gather herbs, and the difference between a simple weed and a medicinal herb can be tiny. Beginners in this field shouldn’t worry if their first tries bring about nothing more than a tasty soup or - in the worst case - a potentially fatal concoction (they should plan the testing accordingly though!). In the beginning it’s advisable to concentrate on the sick who are at death's door already, because in these cases nobody will blame the healer when the attempt to heal them fails. Once you pass the first obstacles, there are many doors that will open for you. Everybody needs herbs, from the hunter whose feet hurt in the evening to the prince who wants to get rid of a nasty wart. Over the centuries immoral herbalists with a love of experimentation have been able to increase their knowledge to such a degree that today there’s a remedy for almost every illness and condition. It’s possible to heal shaking plague, speckle fever, yellow blazes, sleeplessness, dream fever and tinnitus as well as unanswered love and bad breath. Of course even the best herbalist can’t know all herbs, because some only grow in deserts, others on mountains or in swamps, and one of them - fire lance, the most valuable in all of Ancaria - only grows inside of volcanoes. So a sick person can count themselves lucky when they find an herbalist who knows what's needed to heal them as well as where to find it. You should turn away from herbalists who ponder for a while and then say: “I haven't tried this myself, but...“ or “Let’s see what happens, when...“

Let me add a word of warning: The life of an herbalist is quite dangerous, as the story of King Halmud the fool proves. A prophet told him that he would die from poison so he immediately ordered that all poisoners and herbalists would be hunted down and killed. Shortly after the last herbalist passed away he died from blood poisoning, because he cut his thumb while peeling an apple.

Guide for a Successful Feast
or “How to not poison your guests”

 Preparing a banquet can be complex. Nothing can spoil a celebration more than a failed banquet and unsatisfied guests. Hosting a banquet is quite a responsibility and should not be taken lightly. But fret not! In this book, we will guide you through the process and make sure you will be able to avoid any obstacles and possible threats.

Preparation

This is where it all starts. In the first steps of planning, you need to answer a number of questions.
How many people do you intend to serve at the feast? Will the kitchen hall and tables accommodate that number? Can you pre-cook anything? Can you prepare everything that day? Who is going to attend your meal? Are there any cultural or racial limitations for the food? Planning is the key to everything here. Only if you have sufficient answers to all those questions, you can safely continue with your next step. Numerous banquets have been spoiled due to lack of preparation:

“But the page said there is enough wood in the kitchen.Whatever made him say that? ”

“What do you mean by ‘The meat looks a bit strange’?”

“Did we really invite those Orc scu... those people of Orcish origin?”

“Where is my recipe book again?”

All those questions are a sure indication of bad preparation. Avoid that at any cost! Eliminate all those possible threats right from the start. Trust nobody but yourself! If you have a question, find out the answer for yourself. Don't ask anyone. And if you have found out the answers, write them down. Papyrus can't forget.

Make sure there are enough tables, benches and chairs available, as well as enough table cloths to cover the tables. Candles and proper lighting are essential as well (“I can't see the meat!” ).


Planning the Menu

Probably the most important step is deciding which dishes you want to serve. For a large banquet, we recommend no more than four courses. It goes without saying, that you should not try to serve dishes you have never done before. Also, keep in mind, that some ingredients might be seasonal and may not always be available.

For the courses, we recommend:

Bread, Butter, Fruits
Soup or Stew
Meat course
Dessert

For the stew, we recommend a chicken thyme stew with cream. This nice little recipe is highly popular in all cultured parts of Ancaria and does not require too much preparation. Yet, due to the rich flavor it is very suitable as a starter.


Chicken Thyme Stew with Cream

15 pieces chicken meat
2 tbl. olive oil
1/2 onion
2 garlic cloves
2 tbl. flour
1 1/2 mug mushrooms
1 mug chicken broth
4 tsp. parsley
1 1/2 tsp. thyme
1/4 mug sherry
1/4 tsp. pepper
1/4 mug sour cream

Cut the chicken into small pieces. Warm one spoon of olive oil in a pot until it's hot, but not smoking. Add the chicken and fry until it is brown. Remove the chicken and pour all the remaining oil into the pot. Add the onion and garlic and cook them, stirring until the onion begins to brown. Stir in the flour and cook until the flour dissolves in the melange.
Add the mushrooms, chicken broth, parsley, sherry, thyme and pepper. Boil until the mixture has thickened. Return the chicken meat to the pot and cook for a minute.
Stir in the sour cream and serve the stew while it is hot.


For the meat course, we recommend:

Wild Boar in Peanut Oil

3 tbl. peanut oil
1 wild boar
2 garlic cloves
1 spoon ginger root
1/2 bunch radish
2 onions

Sauce :

2 spoons crunchy peanut butter
1 spoons soy oil
1 spoons vinegar
2 spoons sesame oil
2 chili
2 spoon sugar
1/3 mug stock

Cut the wild boar into small pieces. Soak the radishes in warm water for several minutes, then drain them and cut them into quarters. Cut the onions into pieces.
For the sauce, cream together peanut butter and soy oil, then add the remaining ingredients. Set the sauce aside.
Add oil to a frying pan. When it starts to smoke, add the boar meat and fry for a minute. Add garlic and ginger and fry for another minute. Put the boar meat into the saucepan and add the peanut sauce. Heat and leave to simmer for 15 minutes. Add the onions after approx. half the time. If the sauce thickens, add more stock.
Add the radish and simmer for another 5 minutes, then take it off the fire to serve it.

You will find a hero chest in some towns and villages. Everything that you store in there will be accessible from hero chests anywhere in the world.

You can also forge runes into weapons or armor. When you wield that weapon the combat art will improve but the regeneration time will not increase.

Some weapons feature a number of sockets. When you visit a blacksmith, you can forge special items into these sockets depending on their quality (bronze, silver, gold):
 
Bronze: Runes and Blacksmith Arts
 
Silver: Rings (in addition to the above)
 
Gold: Amulets (in addition to the above)
 
Additionally, each weapon will feature a gray socket for a damage modifier.

Each weapon has a gray socket for a damage modifier. This will change the weapon's damage type (fire, ice, poison, magic).
 
For example, a weapon that will inflict only physical damage will also inflict magical damage when a pearl is forged into it.

You can remove items from a weapon at a blacksmith. Doing so will remove the item you want to retrieve from the weapon, but at the same time it will destroy all other items which may also be forged into the same weapon.

Relics increase your armor's resistance against fire, ice, poison and magic. Available artifacts can be found under the "Relics" tab in your inventory.
 
If you want to benefit from an artifact you need to activate it first. You may activate up to six relics but only three of the same type.

Every hero can learn up to fifteen combat arts - five per aspect. However, it is not advisable to learn all of them because you can only become a true master of a combat art if you advance it consistently.
 
You should also choose combat arts from several aspects, because each aspect has a different recharge time. Learning combat arts from different aspects will enable you to use several combat arts in succession during a fight.

You can place weapons, combat arts and combat art combinations into the four action slots. Additionally, you can switch the action slots and assign various other actions to them.
 
The potion slots may contain all variations of potions. The most important ones are health potions, concentration potions and potions of the mentor.

How to Deal with Undead? A Guideline

"He moved towards me - swaying, his body oddly twisted and dislocated. His staring, squinting look appeared to go right through me. Some strange and indiscernible green liquid oozed from his mouth while he permanently attempted to speak. I drew my sword but then I realized it was not a zombie, it was the captain who was completely drunk on his way to his cabin."
(from the travelogues of Nayjol the Adventurer)

Every adventurer has heard of them and many have already encountered them: Marauding zombies on derelict cemeteries, erratic skeletons on historic battlefields, vampires in their shape shift forms as wolves or bats or ghosts doing their boring spooking routines; undead come in many shapes and forms.

Undead creatures are not only extremely obnoxious, they are also classed as highly dangerous! Many unprepared adventurers underestimated the danger and lost their lives to the 'un-life'. This guide was written to assist the aspiring adventurer in his dealings with undead creatures. "Know thy enemy!" is our motto. Well then, let's meet the enemy!

The lowest form of undead creatures are skeletons, zombies and mummies. All these forms are reanimated bodies without mind or intellect. Reanimating bodies is the simplest form of necromancy, basically dead easy (pun intended) for any conjurer of death. This is probably the reason why these kinds of undead creatures are encountered more often than the other, more complex variations.

The rules of conduct while dealing with skeletons, zombies or mummies are pretty straightforward: If you wish to avoid them, do not go near any cemeteries or battle fields. Catacombs and dungeons are also preferred habitats of these creatures.

If an encounter is inevitable, your choice of actions is rather limited. Each and any attempt to lead a conversation will be futile; thus, you will have to resort to pure violence. However, do be careful! Zombies, and even more so skeletons, are tough opponents. They are held together by necromantic magic and thus, they are able to regenerate severe wounds and even severed limbs within a short amount of time. The magic will only dissipate when the bodies have been completely dismembered and only then will their remains dissolve.



While skeletons and zombies are rather dumb, ghouls do have some sort of ability to think. Ghouls are creatures, which are half dead and half alive. Trapped in this interstage they wander the world without aim, feed on carrion and human bodies and they are typically timorous. Ghosts and apparitions are bodiless and as such the exact opposite of the bodied undead such as zombies, skeletons and mummies. Here, only the ethereal part of a being has been reanimated. Ghosts and apparitions are thinking beings - often even capable of speaking - created by a complicated focus of necromantic energy.
Despite - or because of - their lack of bodies, ghosts and apparitions are dangerous opponents. Average weapons do not have any impact on ghosts. If you intend to stand your ground against a ghost, you will require magic or at least magical weapons. That is the only way these beings can be hurt.
Vampires are the ultimate form of undead existence. They are free, independent and thinking beings with supernatural abilities and powers. They are not created by necromancy; instead, they create themselves. Nobody knows where they come from, yet they exist. And they are extremely dangerous!
Not many adventurers can claim that they encountered a vampire and lived to tell the story. Evidently, a wooden stake, driven through the heart of a vampire will paralyze the undead creature. Furthermore, beheading a vampire will kill it. Contrary to popular belief the use of garlic, holy water and escaping across running waters are all ineffective according to several sources.

Book 3: Drinking in Ancaria

Many different beverages can be found (and ordered) in the taverns of Ancaria. Unlike food, the different cultures and races of the world seemed to have influenced each other when it comes to drinks. Except for the Orcs, who have a rather narrow range of drinks (actually it´s just beer or water), all races are sharing and contributing to the variety of beverages. For example, tea was originally invented and consumed by the Dryads, but quickly adopted by other races and now, people all over the world are drinking tea in their homes.
Water is the most natural form of liquid and it is the basic ingredient for most beverages. The only exceptions are fruit juices and wine.

Mead

Mead is a brew based on honey. Quite a number of different flavors of mead are known throughout Ancaria, some of them are seasonal, others are just regional variations. However, they all have one thing in common: the combination of honey and alcohol can have devastating effects on the incautious consumer.

Dryad Lemon Mead

This mead variation originated from the southern parts of the world. The Dryads are said to have invented this special form of mead. The fresh taste is a nice contrast to the rather heavy aroma of the honey.

6 wine quarts water
1/2 ounce whole nutmegs
1 lemon peel
1 quart honey
pulp of 2 or 3 lemons
lemon juice

Time to completion: 1 month

To every quart of honey, add six wine quarts of water, half an ounce of nutmegs, the peel of a lemon and the meat of two of the three. Boil these together. When the scum does not rise any more, remove from fire and leave it to cool down. Squeeze the lemon juice into the brew. The lemon mead will be ready in less than a month.

Cloven Mead

A quite simple but tasty mead. The strong aroma of the cloves and ginger grant this mead a sweet accentuation. Cloven mead is especially popular during the winter season when it is usually served hot.

3 lbs. honey
1 gallon water
1/2 ounce ginger root
cloves
mace blades
agrimony

Time to completion: 2 to 3 months.

Dissolve three pounds of honey in a gallon of water and boil it. As soon as it starts to boil, add half an ounce of ginger, some cloves, mace and a small quantity of agrimony. Leave to boil for an hour and keep it constantly skimmed, as there will be plenty of scum rising from the pot. Strain into another vessel and leave to cool down. Wait until it is creamed over with a black cream and leave it to ripen for two or three months.

Ale

By far the most popular alcoholic beverage in Ancaria is ale. From the noble taverns of Thylysium to the quayside bars of the shanty towns, large quantities of ale are being sold everywhere. Ale is relatively easy to brew and - thus - can be sold at a reasonable price. Of course, similar to mead, there are dozens of flavor variations available and they also vary in strength.

Thank you for your help! I'm ready to start working now. My pen is sharp, I'm full of ideas... Oh, forgive me, I almost forgot your reward. Here, this is for you.

An officer in the capital city entrusted me with the task of taking on the criminals in this area. I'm supposed to kill at least fifteen of the outlaws who are causing trouble here. I'll use myself as the bait and simply let them rob me!
By Kybele, the trees have grown well this year.
You should teach your henchmen some discipline.
You have quite an unhealthy skin colour. I recommend carrot juice.
I am unable to use this item at this point.
Where I come from, we eat your kind as appetizers, amphibian!
An interesting technology. I must have this toy!
I owe you my thanks. At least now I have something to remember him by.
Your back will meet my belt soon - and it won't feel pleasant.

In order to reach the key, you must get past the Facetteleon

Felicitations stranger, let me now properly introduce myself! I am Dyria D'Arquelyght, Archon of the Dryads. Forgive me for not revealing myself earlier; I needed to get to back to the safety of my sanctuary as quickly as possible. This abduction was no coincidence. The Inquisitors wanted to force me to reveal the location of the key to them, and but for you they would have succeeded!
I owe you my life, and am grateful for your deeds. Your name shall never be forgotten amongst my kindred.
So - you are looking for the key as well? Alas, I have bad tidings for you. The key rests in the safest possible place, the Crystal Cavern to the north, which is guarded by a fearsome monster, the Facetteleon. I fear that your quest is futile. No one has ever succeeded in overcoming this guardian.
I still need one item from that large Elven settlement. It's not far from here.
There is no way into the tower from here.
I haven't found a way into the tower, yet. I wonder if it has something to do with these lights?
Well well, what's this? A shed. And someone is inside.
The mentor was a woman. Now that I have the spell I can return to the magician.
I guess I will be leaving now.

No pass leads across these mountains.
Geroda sends you? Well, thank you! And how is the old fogey? Haven't seen him in a while. Here, take this for your trouble.
I am satisfied with your performance. You are indeed a real hunter. Here, take this hunting knife. Wear it with pride because it marks you as full member of our craft.
So you want to go for a stroll with me?  How lovely, I’d be glad to join you!
A walk? With you and my friend here? How delightful, but of course!
I'll report back to El-Darrag. The commander will stay and take care of the remaining Desert Folk.
Courage! That is the key! Weapons are only half the battle, we have to become even more fearless!
This army's better than its reputation! It's a nice bunch of guys who are eager to kill, and that's how I like them!
Not at all, it's not the army! That's due to the incompetence of our leaders! They've gotten fat and lazy.
Everything was better in the old days, when brutality and pure willpower reigned supreme! Today we're only relying on mercenaries!
The army's good, because we're good fighters! But Kuan should send some lightning down on our leaders!
We've got one huge advantage, our iron will! No weapon can conquer it!
Ha, no way! Our weapons are merely a symbol of our willingness! And that's what we have to improve!
We've never been good blacksmiths, but we always were good fighters! That keeps the balance!
I can't listen to anymore! That's undermining the military morale! Our army’s better than its reputation!
Without our brave army we'd all be extinct! So what are you complaining about?
Now we have enough on the Lord of the castle. We're going to put a stop to his doings once and for all. I'm going to leave right away. Please accompany me!
Go away, you squeaky green thing, or you'll feel my dagger!
If you prick me, old Orc hag, I'll use my snippity blade!
You are ugly little things, and you act like you were raised by pigs.
How did you know that? It's true, and I ate them all.
Don't be so brash, mite, or you'll end up in my stew.
You wouldn't dare. My brothers would come and avenge me.
I don't fear your cronies. Now off with you, or I'll do what I said.
I'm sure we'll see each other again.
Very good. Go to the library.

Ah! There are the brains. Let's see... they're rather small aren't they? Oh well, they're Goblin brains after all, so you can't really expect miracles. Add a bit of frog spawn now, that's much better. Here try it... oh, you've already eaten? What a shame.
Here's the cauldron for Jangletooth. Give him my regards.

My soldiers have been captured by unscrupulous pirates. Please rescue my comrades!

By Lumen, you are truly a Godsend. I received an order to smoke out a small pirate nest. I swear if they didn't have that cannon we would have... ah never mind. Rinarn and I were the only ones able to escape. Please help me get my comrades out of there!
The opponents in this region use mostly normal weapons.
The smugglers have turned into skeletons, and now ghosts are coming to their aid. This could be nasty.
HA! Those dirty little dung beetles didn't see that coming! I slaughtered them all and I didn't faint! Come on, let's go to father. And I'm hungry! I want some bread with blood-pudding!

Gravestone
Gernott von Ostbrand
Here lies a faithful servant of Lumen. He stood up for the rights of the poor and weak. Which led to his downfall in the end.

We must secure the site where we intend to build the shrine

Well met, child. You arrived just in time. The fog was strong, but fortunately we had enough incense from our marigold flowers to prevail. Marigolds are doubly valuable; if you crush and ingest them they will temporarily boost your powers and make you more effective against the fog monster.
Thank you for the list of names, this is very good! Now we can build a shrine to contain it. That is the only way to send the poor wandering undead souls on to their eternal rest. First we must clear the building site.
Man against machine, I wonder who will win?
How are you, my son? You don't look happy.
My apologies, wise father, I'm just not making headway with the chronology I'm writing.
Didn't you want to write down the names of all the deceased, so that no one will ever forget them and their souls can finally rest?
Yes, but I didn't realize how hard this was going to be.
Well, maybe there are forces trying to prevent it.
There's a prophecy that says the world will come to an end, once all the names have been written down.
That won't stop me. Goodbye, father.

Bring me the ingredients for a new body!

Right! Look at me! Fate cheated me. I failed. I was beaten.
In ... 83 ... right before the battle. I had prepared so well and wanted to come out the victor or die a heroic death. And then the battle began and .. BAM! I stumble over a branch, fell and broke my neck ... dead. Dead and done. No hero, no fate.
Please help me! Find some parts for my new body so I can find my destiny today!
I will need bones from the bloodsucking trees. No bones, no body. And flesh, of course. The harbingers of death would be perfect for that. There must be something to move the bones, you know. And a brain. The flying eyes should have something like that. Without it, it won't work.
If you see a light, just head straight for it.
Ah right, you put the emphasis on honor. Well, then let's go...
Dear Gods, nothing is happening any more! An evil spell must have banned the player!

Find the hideout and bring the ghost to me!

Alright we're ready. Here's the bottle. You have to use the tincture to travel to the plane of the ghosts... what?
Of course it must be you! Did you really think I’d drink this stuff... uh... I mean... I have a lot of important things to do here. Anyway you have to use the tincture to travel to the plane of the ghosts. If you can defeat the ghost it will be banned and it’ll be drawn to our plane at the same time. Then I’ll squeeze it into the bottle and we’ll have the ultimate genie-weapon.
Which toy store did you escape from?
Didn't they pick up scrap iron yesterday?
Hey, junk pile, who taught you how to walk?
I can't wait to see what we'll find when we cannibalize you ...
Come on, take a hike tin can!

Who disturbs my peace? Of course, my worthless family! As if I haven't had enough problems with you in life! Now you have to stalk me in the afterlife too?

Who cares about the land? I can't believe that you're bothering me over such a trifles!

You always were the only family member with reason and talent, therefore I'll leave it to you. Use it well.

And the rest of you: Leave me alone from now on, do you understand?

I found Lydia. More or less. Rather less than more. It was a heap of skin and hair and not much else. But it could've been Lydia. I don't like to repeat myself but: something stinks. Really stinks! Maybe Glenn has an idea.
Airman, salute the sun... even if it's for the last time.
Maybe I'm not a great romantic, but you're looking marvelous today!
I'm happy to meet one of the most beautiful women of our people!
You look wonderfully disfigured! How in Kuan's name are you doing this?
Thank Kuan! Such Orcish beauty is a rare sight!
Wow, you're a buxom Orc lass! May I say that I'm more than delighted?
It's been quite a while since I've seen such an impressive specimen of our people!
With such gorgeous mothers, I don't have to worry about their children.
My dear, would you like me to help you? I'd do it with pleasure!
Oh I'm so excited to see you! May I accompany you?
Am I standing in your way? Well, it might seem so, but I'm quite attracted to you at the moment!
Blimey, that's a way to let the bad mood fade away! You're a delight for the eyes.
Ah, a woman of the world! I knew it at first sight!
That's a really nice coincidence! My mood's getting much better now.
How are you, my dear Orc lady? I'm significantly delighted at the moment!
I'll need all the ears for my ear bucket!
There I've defeated the monster. I can let the Dryad know that she can climb down from her tree now.
Increases the chance to evade hostile weapon attacks and reduces the chance to sustain critical hits.
I demand that you kill them all.
Show me what I pay you for!
Get rid of the attackers and protect me!
Attack - give me a good show.
Finally I get to see battle!

That was probably the most revolting thing I’ve ever done, and the Gods know I’ve done a lot of things in my time! Now I just have to take this mess back to Fangor.
Now that I'm not sad anymore, I will go and gather a new pouch of crystal dust. And I won't lose it this time, I promise!
Can't you see that I am busy?
I don't recall any agreement. Guards!

That rat cheated me! He never intended to give me an artifact at all! His plan worked, and I can't take revenge in front of all these witnesses. We'll meet again though, and I'll find a way to pay him back for his wicked ways.
I hope his fever doesn't get any higher!
Why? How come? Only Forens knows the meaning of life.
My body is rumbling today, it's as if Lumen and Ker are meeting there.
Kuan gives our soldiers strength and stamina.
These days I hear many blasphemous things being said behind closed doors.
Hail to delicacies! Kybele puts forth many a tasty herb!
Hail to the Gods! I bless these days!
An effective ritual could make the nobility devout again.
In these times, true faith has many adversaries.
Let's see how well you will fight without legs...

Magical barrier around the tower ... can only be passed by ... des- ... destroying the four ... focus ... poi...
points.
The seamstress has started working, so the dress for her daughter will be ready in time. I'm supposed to take it to the daughter when it's done.

Strangely clad people in black cowls are apparently meeting at the stone circle outside of the village and conjuring up Demons. The residents of the village fear for their safety. I'm supposed to get rid of that pack of Demon conjurers.
You're not going to turn me into a purse!
I won't allow you the satisfaction!

Find the first fragment of the Brurag Scroll!

Greetings! I am Gelminy, a passionate treasure hunter.
Would you be interested in assisting me in my search for a valuable artifact? My employer promised me a handsome reward if I get him King Brurag El Leigh's amulet.

He was the ruler here a long time ago and his grave was recently desecrated. Since then the Stone Warriors have been lurking around here. I saw one of them earlier with a scroll in his hand. I need it! Let's go look for it together!
Perhaps I should specialize in one line of goods.
Come here ye noblemen! I shall cheat ye as well as any other!
Buy your wares there or here! You'll come back to me in the end...
Now that darn cart is broken again!
I don't like to write bills, but if I want to see some gold I shall have to.
I've bought myself a horse to transport my wares.
No credit and no bartering. Gold coins are what I want to see.
Some folks say that you can use smoke to conserve food!
That was nice but much too quick. I’ll go back to Hermelin now to collect my pay.
A desert? Damn! I should've brought more water skins.
The Grackk family doesn't seem to be exactly small.
Such a large family does have its advantages.
I will find him. Thank you for your hospitality.
It was an honor to stand by your side.
Another brother? My family does not appear to be small.

Keeper of the Shrine
Whoever obeys the Gods, to him they particularly listen.

- Homer
Get going! The Merchant is expecting her.

Take me to the beach!

I’m lost. I was out hunting with some Orcs and then suddenly I found myself all alone. I bet you’re wondering how I ended up here in the desert. I remembered an old story that an Orc shaman always used to tell us. According to his story, if you get lost you just have to keep walking in a straight line and eventually you will reach your home. If you reach the end of the world, the hand of God will pick you up and put you back on the other side of the disk. But the disk seems to be awfully big... I’ve been walking for days, and now here I am! Oh so you'll take me to the beach where I can find a boat home? That sounds like a smart idea! VERY smart.
Don't worry, I can be very convincing.
The Priests have chosen the right side.
You're attacking a man of the Gods?
Only a heathen would attack a Priest!
The Gods will judge you - through me!
I'll show you how I feel about your Gods!
My dad is lot's stronger than you are! And he has killed waaayyy more Kobolds than you have!
My friends say you knocked out a Kobold. I don't believe that.
My Grandpa Durain says that there used to be lots more Kobolds. Before the war.
Why did you kill the Kobolds? My teacher says they are useful. No, wait, maybe he was talking about spiders.
I knocked out a Kobold boss once too. Really! I'm not telling stories here!!
There are no forests for you to save here, missy.
Do you taste different than High Elves?
Even after all these centuries, you are still nothing but... Elves.
Well then, let's see how quick your arrows are.
Hi. I think I'll call you “lunch.”
You? Let's get out of here...
Ancaria is quaking! Nothing can stop you anymore, dark warrior!
I would like to be able to fight like you. But to have to live with that personality?
Thanks and good bye. That wound does not look good by the way, you will likely have a few minutes to live though.
If I get into this area too far, I'll risk my life.
Then I guess I must proceed towards the Humans.
Don't step into the puddle with your pretty shoes!
Player, see to improving my riding skills!

Kill the Ore-Thag Clan leader!

This necklace is made of many Trolls' teeth. Apparently you are a great warrior. Good! Now that you are here, we have use for you. The Orcs of the Ore-Thag Clan are attacking our village. All our warriors are gone to fight against the Tragz Clan. We are hopelessly outnumbered and cannot fight against the Ore-Thag Clan. We are warriors, not suicidal. Kill the leader of our attackers. That will intimidate them.
I found the toy, now I must return to the first dealer.
I will write a poem about your deeds!
I've been asked to get this woman's amulet and take it to her daughter.

The Dragon Nimdruail asked me to find and kill the Human slaves who escaped from his breeding kennel. They're obviously some kind of living food stock. He also recommended that I follow his example and refrain from eating Human flesh, that shouldn't be hard to comply with. Now I should go and find the escaped Humans, I wonder how many different agonizing ways I'll be able to think up to kill them...

Confront Dundiel!

So you have chosen to follow your conscience rather than your sword? I like that, and not just because it will spare an innocent life. I will keep my side of the bargain and tell you what I know. Dundiel and Ophtanar are the cult’s corrupt leaders. They founded the cult not to serve the Dragons, but to fill their own pockets. They ruthlessly sacrifice Humans to the Dragons. They are even prepared to slaughter their own followers, not that they do that themselves. We caught one of the cultists collecting dreamberries on our island. When we interrogated him he admitted that he was acting on Dundiel’s orders. I think I’ve said enough, perhaps you should have a “little talk” with him.
Come and fight, man to man!
I'll take everything to the Queen. She'll be happy with me... oh, excuse me... she'll be happy with US.
Don't worry. I know a thing or two about fire.
Let's go then. Did you remember to turn off the stove?
You can do that experiment any time. Now come along.
Do you have all your little powders and magic wandies with you? Let's go then!
If I may carry something for you, please say so!
It didn't work again! What am I doing wrong?
Flee, from the rage of the Gods!
You saved us, lady with the big wings! Thank you. Take us home quickly now so our parents don't have to worry anymore!
Emeralds as big as my eyes? Aaah! They're for Raerrae! Of course I have some. Here you go. And remind Raerrae that she can return my lock of hair whenever it's convenient for her.
This is the right entrance. I'll start looking for the bag with the stolen Christmas Wishes now. I can hardly wait to meet this Walther guy.
Attention. Temple Guardian within sensor range.
I can't carry that many things.
The folks I run into always have trouble understanding the basic facts of a change in ownership.
Just because I'm an outlaw, doesn't mean I'm lazy.
Night after night I earn my daily bread through cunning and wicked treachery.
I add a little excitement to the life of the lonely wanderer.
Taking things from others - if that's not an ideal purpose in life, what is?!

Liosilath sent you? Very well, hold on a sec. Human territory starts on the other side of this tunnel. Mind your head.
On the other side, go east and you’ll soon come to the village where the expedition set out from.
Shaman Smoothroot can begin his ritual now. My work here is done.
Be on your way! The full strength of the Undead Legion could rise up at any moment.
Have you heard of the gnominative? That's the gnome's death case!
Remember our motto: quantity not quality!
Those who choose not to fight, will be fed to the Trolls!
The cook needs some brains - so don't mangle everything again!
Chop off his head, I need a new ashtray!
You are an example to us all! Your fighting techniques are exhilarating.
Does it make you proud to overcome all obstacles?
Alas. Just a bit of your strength of character would get me a lot further.
This doesn’t look good! They certainly don't look as though they're here for a sing-along and a rousing evening.
My dad says you're the little sweetie that killed the Carnach. What's a little sweetie?
Why did you hit the water monster?
Are there many Kobolds where you come from?
May I call you Auntie Fogkill?
Are Carnachs really made out of fire?
This is unacceptable for a Temple Guardian.

Bring Ayshe to me.

There at the bridge of the oasis stands the woman of my dreams. Her name is Ayshe. We're in love and want to marry, but her father won't allow it. He's a rich merchant and I'm just a peasant.
He has even hired guards to make sure I don't talk to his daughter again. I don't know what to do. Could you help?
Please kill the guards and bring Ayshe to me.
This is too much for me!
I'd better cut and run, before something else happens!
I'm not ready to meet my ancestors yet. I'm getting out of here!
The landlord advised me to talk to the village Priest. He's the brother of his cousin's wife's... well, he's a distant relative of the landlord who recently had an encounter with some brigands.

Great Keeper of the Shrine
It is difficult to say what is impossible, for the dream of yesterday is the hope of today and the reality of tomorrow.

- Goddard
I don't want to rush you, but the store closes at 7p.m.

I don’t have another task for you, but one of my brothers still has a mission you can complete. So please talk to him if you want. I won’t get angry if you refuse to do this though, it's your decision.
That's what I expected, Lupus was no match for me. I defeated him. I guess that makes me the Ore Thag Clan's Master of the Hunt. I wonder if that will look good on my resume?
You think you're morally superior, but you're really just another murderer.
Come, punish me for my deeds!
Why sacrifice yourself for the supposedly good side?
I've come back from the shadows to get you, Orc.
I ran into Shirka at the Great Wall again. She was dismissed from the Guard. After that she wanted to sign on as a mercenary and was robbed. This kid is going to drive me crazy!
High Elves are fairly patient, but I really would have liked to have an adventure or two today.

Go to General Denyiw and report to him!

That's all what I saw. You should hurry. More undead come every night. It'll be too late once they've flooded the city!

Gauron the Confused
He was almost an Philosopher
I would help you, if I could.
I will erase your ugly face from Ancaria's soil!
I'll have a saddle to sell soon...

Get me ten Kobold heads!

Hey you. Come here. You wanna buy the shrunken head of a Kobold? They keep off the mosquitoes, that's a fact. If you don't wanna buy anything, maybe you have something to sell. I could use Kobold heads. I'm selling the shrunken heads so fast, I can't catch those funny little creatures quick enough. Get me a few. I'll pay good money for them.
The Water Elemental was relieved that I was able to clean up the pond. A Water Elemental is a truly remarkable creature.
Improves wielding swords by increasing the chance to hit as well as attack speed. Grants the ability to use higher-level weapons successfully.
Your fighting style is as bleak and dreary as the desert you call home!
The soldiers are dead. Now I can give the money to the bookkeeper.

Temple Servant
Kneels before the face of the Gods.
The Thraconians are in for a treat!
I've been attacked by some Ogres but I was able to beat them off. I think the clan's chief will now be more willing to talk.
Ha ha! The stupid old hag and her hammer nosed husband are dead. Now, I'm the sole heir! Excellent. Here's your pay for an honest job - or a not quite so honest job, ha ha!
Hmm, that really is a problem. I've come up with a way of inquiring that shows what they truly think and believe, it could be called an inquisition! It's not very pleasant!
We've all doubted at one time or another! Don't worry about it too much! The majority of the children are pure and good!
Kybele's name is one of immaculate purity! If we don't confront these doubters, then pretty soon everybody will be believing what they want!
We can't allow that, even if we wanted to! Ultimately we will be judged by the Goddess for it!
No mercy for the doubters! If we don't act decisively, there will soon be some polytheism underway!
My solution would be to deal with it in a stern and consistent manner. With a few carefully selected show trials with all the pomp of nature!
Unbelievable! It can't come to that. One believes this, the other that - and before you know it we're in Babylon, where ever that is!
My motto is the judgment of the Goddess! And with all her might! I'm not a sadist, but a little brutality would be good in this matter!
Scoundrels! Those who don't believe in Kybele's wonders are scoundrels to me! They should just form their own states.
There you have it, that's what we get for being so lenient! It's about time we showed the children that Kybele is capable of much more!

If I wear that, I'll get in trouble with my cult.
I need better protection against physical damage.

I am not a programmer but it surely can't be THAT difficult...
I won't tremble before you, sandman!

Once, the forests were my home. I believed that under the protection of nature I would live forever, far away from the quarrels of this world. Still, I had to realize that this was an illusion!

Thus I decided to leave the forests and to take my stand on the stage of this world. Wherever my journeys will take me, I shall not lose track of my ambitions.
All enemies are grey around here. And not just at night.
Many battles have been fought here and many more are still to come.
Demons belong to hell... not nature!
You have no steel in your spine!
You won't take me for a ride!
I bet you're just as stupid as you are strong!
Now hand over all your gold, and do it nice and slow, okay?
I need to speak with you, child. I hear you still haven't given up your crazy idea of becoming Chief.
It's female Chief or Fe-Chief, father. Please try not to forget that.
You are aware that this will irritate the ancestors?
I'm sure it will, but their end is near anyway. They'll just have to accept it.
Be careful they don't curse you.
On whose authority are you speaking, father?
The Chief asked... ugh, well, on authority of the ancestors, of course.
Really? Then tell your “lost souls” that their reign will be over soon.
I've collected the branches. Now I can return.
A Seraphim in a tavern? And you think nobody will notice?
What? For me? Oh, how generous of you. Of course I won't touch the offerings anymore. I'm going to rest for a bit and then I'll move on. I hope you have a nice day.
The temple has sent you for oblations? Of course, I'll help you. Take the water.
Get me some skin, I feel ready for a change of scene.
If you find children, bring them to me. We're out of lab rats.
Hopefully my losing streak will be over soon!
Apparently scarabs keep attacking caravans. I've been asked to talk to a strange old man named Ompha. He seems to know much about this area.
Time for us to take off!
It's remarkable, how much adversity you have overcome!
What motivates you to keep fighting?
It is commendable that you fight every battle to the bitter end.

Great! There's my microphone! I've got all my equipment now and I can come with you. We still need to get both guitars and the drum sticks. André's guitar is apparently not far from here. Some of the undead grabbed it and disappeared into a cave with it.

A resident of the Werewolf village has asked me to kill eight of the wild Werewolves that are marauding around the countryside. They have been attacking the Lizardmen and endangering the peace between the Lizardmen and the Werewolves.
In this region, weapons are often drenched in poison.
Why are the Seraphim on the side of the oppressors?
You angels mean nothing but harm!
You are stronger than I am, Sera ... But we are many ...
Stay away, Seraphim! You don't give a damn about us!
You are nothing but a lackey of the Elves, Seraphim!
Increases damage of non-weapon based combat arts and reduces the opponent's spell resistance.
Thorns break out of the ground and damage everyone who touches them.
I think the werewolf was more interested in the tongues than the competition. Anyway, it was a draw.
I’ve delivered the spare parts. Nomengalus doesn’t suspect a thing. After all I’ve done for him it would have surprised me if he had.

Witch Raerrae needs new material for her voodoo dolls. I'm supposed to get wood blanks from Merchant Srowoyn, then emeralds from Eoyrea the Jeweler and finally balls of wood spider silk from Evorey the Tailor. I'm off to Srowoyn first.

Bring me jade!

Since the Gods took my eyesight I have lived in darkness for many years. During that time I have lived in a world of memories, in my dreams I often wander through green woodlands collecting jade just like I used to. The smooth cold surface of jade is wonderful to touch.
Perhaps you could collect some stones for me?
Three intact Kobold heads. Severed below the third vertebra.
The mourning man thanked me for my help. He will be able to sleep quietly at night once more.

Book 1

Preface

Since the dawn of time, all intelligent races have spent endless resources studying, developing and perfecting the lore of weaponry. The art and science of weaponry is not only about creating the most efficient ways of killing an opponent. It's also about having the best response to an opponents weapon and especially his armor. Of course, this requires dedicated study of your opponents. Generally, there are four categories of weapons: single-handed, two-handed, pole and ranged. All of them have their very own advantages and disadvantages, and play their role in duel as well as battle situations.

Single-Handed Weapons

This category contains the widest range of weapons. From a simple club to a dagger and all the way to mace, axe and sword. Using a weapon in one hand is the most natural way of fighting, because it emulates the bare fist punch. In addition, single-handed weapons also offer the fighter a good variety of options for the off-hand, thereby determining his fighting style. He can equip a shield to increase his defensive potential, or another weapon to give him more attacking chances.
There are single-handed weapons designed for all kinds of damage, slash, thrust and crush. Some of them are limited to just one type of damage, while other weapons are more versatile in terms of damage output. The most versatile weapon is the sword, which - if used properly - is able to deal all kinds of damage. This flexibility is certainly the main reason why swords and sword-like weapons are the most popular.
A special fighting technique is the Armantin or dual-wield style. Here, the fighter will use one weapon in each hand. There are numerous ideas and tactics for this style. Many fighters are used to wielding two weapons of the same type, others prefer different types of weapons to enhance their offensive abilities.

Two-Handed Weapons

Two-handed weapons are of longer range than their single-handed counterparts. The combined force of two arms in combination with excellent leverage and swing momentum also means that a blow from a two-handed weapon is much harder than the usual one-handed blow. However, there obviously has to be a drawback somewhere. It's very hard (and in some cases even impossible) to fight at close range with such weapons. Two-handed swords and two-handed battle-axes are the most common weapons of this type. Although they seem to be similar, they require a completely different fighting style. While the sword is controlled from a rather small hilt, the axe fighter has access to the whole shaft, which allows a number of additional moves and levers.
Two-handed weapon fighters dismiss almost all defensive options, and are purely relying on their offensive skills. Fighting with those weapons is extremely aggressive.

Pole-weapons

Pole-weapons are basically a special form of two-handed weapons. However, since fighting with these weapons requires a special style, they are classified as a different type of weapon. Pole-weapons are polearms, pikestaffs, spears and halberds. All these weapons have a very long range of effect. On the downside, they are almost useless in close range combat, which is one of the reasons why pole-weapon fighters tend to wear a secondary weapon on their belts.
Pole-weapons are generally considered weapons for mass battles. When operating from behind a safe shieldwall, a polearm or spear squad is a devastating unit.

Ranged Weapons

Bow, crossbow and all other forms of missile weapons are a special, unique class of weapons. They are used for killing at long distances, so there is no direct contact between the combatants. Missile weapons are the perfect choice for siege situations and for large battles. For single combat, they require a special tactics. Good bowmen will not reveal their location until they have fired their arrow.

Armor

Simultaneously to the development of weapons, all Ancarian races have developed some form of armor to counter the effectivity of weapons. The deciding factor of armor is the tradeoff between protection on one hand and encumbrance of the wearer on the other hand.
All kinds of armor offer good protection against certain types of damage, while being vulnerable to other kinds of damage. Plate armor is especially useful against slash and crush weapons, but considerably weaker against thrust. Chain is the perfect protection against slash, but almost useless against crush. Whichever armor a fighter prefers, he always needs to take into consideration that some weapon types will render his suit of armor useless.

Technology

Quality of material and craftsmanship should never be underestimated. The difference between a good weapon and a mediocre weapon can decide a fight, a battle, possibly an entire war. In centuries of research and development, blacksmiths of all races have gained enough knowledge to create long lasting and flexible weapons. Still, it is the High Elven steel that is considered the best choice for a weapon. A sword made of good High Elven steel is highly resistant against rust. It is also extremely flexible and can bend up to 90 degrees before it finally snaps.

Technique

Even the best weapon in the world is just a useless piece of wood and metal if the fighter lacks the skill to wield it properly. The ability to use the weapon is as important as the weapon itself. There are lots of different schools of fighting in Ancaria, some of them more popular than others. But they all have one thing in common and that's the goal of distracting the opponents defense and landing the first and deciding blow. This is mostly achieved by combinations of blows and fast and quick movement.

Book 1

I. Tyr Lysia

Geography and climate: Tyr Lysia, land of the High Elves lies south of the barren Western and Eastern Dragon Teeth and north of the deserts of Bengaresh. It is a fertile and mild land rich in rivers and streams, guarded by fortresses. Village are surrounded by small fields, birds nest in green hedges. The woods offer rich game. Picturesque fishing villages line the coast in the west. The climate is generally mild, but it can get rather hot in summer, except for the west where a constant cool breeze attenuates the power of the sun. During the summer season there is a chance of extended drought periods, although famines are almost unheard of.

Inhabitants: Tyr Lysia is mainly inhabited by High Elves who came here a long time ago from the south. Farmers, fishermen, and craftsmen are governed by both nobility and the clergy who lease land and collect taxes (usually food, goods or money). The villages consist of simple houses, the inhabitants are friendly, but not very outgoing around strangers.
There are altars and small cult sites in almost every village. They are usually decorated with flowers and grain ears. High Elves believe in a large pantheon of deities. Villages show their wealth through the number and sizes of their altars. Poor villages usually only have one altar that all deities must share.
Humans serve the noblemen in their mansions or work as farm hands in rural areas. Only rarely does one come upon a Human craftsman. Most Humans are servile, however some (mostly free Humans) tend to be brazen and rude. One should avoid them as they tend to combine stories about their unjust fate with begging.

Places of interest: When visiting Tyr Lysia one should - of course after seeing the capital Thylysium - also travel to two other places. One is Farview, an unassuming small town blessed with a spectacular view. It lies at the top of a mountain surrounded by smaller hills and plains which on a clear day allow the visitor to see places as far away as the Dragon Teeth to the north and even Bluestone Lake to the east. It's a steep ascent to Farview, but the most spectacular view in all of Tyr Lysia is well worth the exertion. Unfortunately the amount of visitors has also let to an enormous increase in thievery. Keeping a close eye on one's possessions is advised.
The other place of interest is called Sonnenwind. It used to be a simple fishing village at Bluestone Lake, but then aristocrats began building their summer residences there to escape the summer heat. Nowadays nearly ten times as much people live there compared to the time before the arrival of the aristocracy and the village specialty Eye Clam Salad is nowadays renowned in all of Tyr Lysia.

Practices: The harvest festival season in the fall almost guarantees that visitors will have a good time. Every village celebrates the festival at a different date so that one can spend weeks traveling from one festival to the other. Houses and huts are decorated with flowers, noblemen open their wine cellars to the public, jugglers, actors, and bards travel the land.

Recommendations: Tyr Lysia is suitable for travel all year long, though it can get very hot and dry upcountry in the summer. Visitors should avoid areas with burned down villages, as these are often frequented by the undead which make no difference between locals and travelers.

II.Thylysium

Geography and climate: Thylysium lies near a river delta on the west coast of Tyr Lysia, land of the Elves. Because of the Jade Sea the climate is dry, slightly salty, and generally pleasant. In winter there's a likelihood of storms, but floods are rare.

Inhabitants: The population consists mainly of High Elves. The city is governed by the Senate. Among its members are merchants, priests, and noblemen. They are the upper-class of Thylysium and live in large townhouses. Leaving the broad streets one soon comes across an astonishing number of different languages, smells, and faces. People come to Tylysium from all parts of Ancaria, sometimes to trade, sometimes just to satisfy their curiosity. Some are rich, some poor; there are merchants and laborers, fishermen and thieves. Travelers should be aware that a friendly face often hides a drawn dagger. One should also avoid the town guard as its soldiers are known for taking bribes and are often in league with one of the many gangs in town.

Places of interest: Thylysium is a magnificent city. Even simple houses are made of granite (the construction of wooden houses or mud huts is prohibited by law), townhouses and temples are built with white marble. There are many places one should visit, among them the Academy of Magic, the Senate and the surrounding gardens with their exotic flowers, and the Road of the Aristocrats, a boulevard lined with the largest and most opulent townhouses and mansions.

Travelers who wish to experience real life in Thylysium should visit the harbor where they will meet all kinds of people and see an astonishing selection of goods. It has been said that everything in Ancaria will sooner or later arrive at Thylysium's harbor. After spending a day watching the harbor and eating in one of the many cookshops travelers will most likely agree. The sea is covered in white sails and dark brown wood. Barrels are rolled from ships, crates are carried to the markets, bolts of fabric are sold to the highest bidder. Even late in the night one can hear the merchants bargaining and the laborers shouting. Humans, animals, materials, jewelry, food - everything is traded in Thylysium.

Practices: There is only one day without trade in Thylysium. On the Day of Contemplation no ship may enter the harbor and all shops remain closed. From sunrise until sunset the city belongs to the Gods. Pilgrims walk between the temples to honor each and every God. Priests smear ashes on their face or walk by swinging jars with burning incense. The city is filled with the chants and songs of the believers; there is dancing, singing, and meditating. Until sunset no coin may change hands and no business may be conducted. The citizens of Thylysium hold this day in such high regard that even thieves respect it and guards refuse to be bribed.

Recommendations: A clear mind and open eyes are needed in Thylysium. Travelers should be careful when talking to citizens and should trust no stranger.

Travel north and help drive back the Thraconians!

You don't look as if you want to enlist as a recruit, but we can always use experienced heroes such as yourself. These callow recruits drop like flies. The sooner we can end this, the better.
The captain in the harbor will take you to the Northlands. Once you arrive, seek out Battle Master Gambolt. Good luck!
The monster must be near. I can hear it hissing!
The Facetteleon is dead, the entrance to the Crystal Caves is clear.

Take the basket to my wife!

Could you do me a favor? My wife is somewhere over there behind those apple trees, and she needs this basket right away. I'd take it to her myself, but I'm expecting a visitor any minute now. Please take this basket to my wife.

Well... you finished all tasks you were given. Now I’ll finally tell you what this all was about. The truth is that my brothers and I had a bet. I thought that the patience of real heroes like you is endless. My brothers didn’t think that you'd be stup... er... patient enough to do all the tasks we’ve been giving you. I won the bet!

Now that you’ve proven my case my brothers owe me a lot of money, therefore I’ll reward you for your stupi... for your patience. Here take this, you really deserve it!
Finally, I believe I found all pages. I can now claim my reward.
I am truly a master of my trade!

Drogar Ratbreaker is the Orc's master kodiak hunter. According to him, kodiak are the most difficult animals to hunt. If I want to be accepted into the circle of kodiak hunters, then I must kill a kodiak leader and bring Drogar the head for a trophy. First I have to attract the leader. Well then, let's get down to business!
Strike! Uhm...214 - or how many bones does a body have?

Kill at least ten of the boars that are destroying my grapevines!

What am I going to do? These grapevines are all I have! Boars keep coming out of the forest, eating my grapes and then digging up the vines. If this doesn't stop soon I'll be ruined! Please help me. If you could at least kill ten of them that would be a great help.

Gather up the dead frogs!

Frog corpses! Everywhere I look, all I see are dead frogs! A group of Kobolds slaughtered a horde of frogs here a few days ago. Their rotting corpses are poisoning my lovely pond. It’s simply revolting! I am just a Water Elemental and maybe I shouldn’t complain so much, but even the toughest Golem couldn’t live with this stench!

Perhaps you could help me? I promise not to hurt you. Please gather up all the dead frogs.
Maid of Ker - there's a place in our temples for you too.
Halt, fighter! A piece of advice: You emit quite an odor.
You worship Ker? Then cast down a few of these nobles to honur your Goddess.
The excavation supervisor is dead. That's a shame.
Go fight now! Kill or die!
Would you like to say a few last words?
My hate burns hotter than your fire!
The current instance does not support this feature (5)

You already have ten? The little buggers are pretty fast, aren't they?
While trying to decipher the scroll, Arch Mage Saewald triggered a protective spell. A Demon appeared and killed the poor Mage. His last words were "Baron Dem..." whoever that is.
What do you want? TO ME! KILL THEM!
Blasphemer! Nobody takes Gronkor's hands! Revenge is mine!
I can't achieve enough normal damage with this weapon.
I found the gold, just like I was asked to. It was easy. Now I should to return to the usurer
Orc from another clan have insulted us! They must be punished. Speak to the spy in the village north of here.
I have located the Chronicler in a small village. He was very pleased to finally be given the Lost Lorebook of Atherton and rewarded me with an ancient artifact.
You will find warg in the forest, not here.
If I stand around here any longer pondering my existence, I might become soft and sensitive.
Who has revived you? And most of all, WHY?
You should have stayed in your grave. That's where I'm going send you back to right now!
Zombies like you are not tolerated around here.

Whoever gossips to you will gossip about you.

- Proverb
Seraphim Constantia has another task for me. The number of lupans in the area is too low. Now she wants me to kill ursacin so the wolves can recover.
That should be enough scorpion tails for a good strong poison. It’s time for me to collect my reward.
A merchant with whom you can interact is nearby.
Ah, there is a trading house. And this is the Orc region. But what is that racket all about? Has the messenger already been here?
The assistant is dead. The bag with the cogwheel is still there. Apparently the killers didn't think it was valuable. I'll take it to the inventor.
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Mystic Stormite and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
I have to go, revered one! It was an honor talking to you.
Best of luck on your ways, the pleasure was all mine!
Thanks for talking to me, it was a great honor.
It was a pleasure and a privilege! Thank you!
I wish you joy, and the ghosts of our forefathers too!
Thank you for your frank words, revered one! I really appreciate them.
Take my thanks and that of my brave comrades too.
I feel as if the ancestors blessed me! Thank you so much!
Wonderful, you have blessed me with this encounter.
I've come up with a one-handed decapitation move. Should I apply for a patent?
In the old days the soldier's craft relied far more on the individual. These strict formations really take the fun out of it.
I enjoy killing and maiming, but I do prefer medium sized opponents. They're better for my back.
They say we'll be equipped with double-edged swords soon. That will turn killing into an art form!
I managed to impale an Orc with my spear. It was surprisingly messy.
Everyone's talking about the new quick draw scabbard. Will it really make a difference?
Do you throw in a bare-handed kill now and then too, just to keep from getting rusty?
A soldier's life isn't that bad. Normal people would be hanged for what we do.
I'm not gifted or anything, but I can slice a body in half with one hand tied behind my back, if you know what I'm saying...
Sometimes I wonder why I didn't become a lawyer. But then I remember that I like an easy kill more than pen and paper.
An old Harpy feels her death approaching. She asked me to take her to the Feather Halls, the place Harpies go to die.
Now Waton is dead too, and without a new leader the Dragon Cult is robbed of its powers. Maybe now people around here will be able to sleep easily at night.
I collected the four missing lists. I should give them to Lucretia.
A port is always located near water.
What have you brought me there? Ah! Now that IS a nice crystal. Very beautiful. Almost flawless. I can offer you this in exchange for your crystal!
I guess I'll fly a kite.
Where's the remote control for this thing?
No machine can take me on!
I have to admit that I underestimated this creature.
I neutralized the spell of protection!
I should take the book to Dr. Faust. He needs it.
Why are you hesitating? Scared? A hesitating warrior is soon a dead warrior.
The ghost soldiers are now resting. I should have another word with the village elder.
A letter? For me? Oh you’re so kind! Usually Vladimir delivers the letters, where is he now?
Sorry about my rant, don't know what came over me. I won't bother you any longer.

Get me eight pelts from panthers in this area.

You look like someone who appreciates a fair deal. We set up camp here because it's an ideal starting point for hunting expeditions, unfortunately some of those annoying tree-huggers are getting in our way. They call themselves Guardians of the Forest. Anyway there's a shipment we need to deliver, but we're still short some pelts. Could you get them for us?
There are a lot of panthers with adequate pelts in these woods. We hunt for the thrill of the kill, let others worry about quality! That's our motto.

Kill Magmadur, the Dragon!

Hello sister. As you know, the Seraphim and the dragons were once allies, but that was long ago. Recently the dragon Magmadur has become a thorn in our side. He's been destroying Temples and has devastated the area several times. That alone wouldn't be reason for violence, but he also killed our sister Katharina! She tried to reason with him, and he killed her just for that! Sophia has ordered us to end his miserable existence. Are you willing to punish Magmadur for his crimes? I'll send you to his cave right away.
You can put the life back into a tired old nag with a mixture of herbs.
I still have to cut and dry some grass, tsss....
I'll have to speak with the blacksmith, the horses need new horseshoes.
Ha-ha! That old mare I picked up cheap is simply bursting with energy.
I drank a bit too much mead yesterday. All of a sudden I had eight-legged horses!
I sold three horses yesterday. I got a good price for each of them, even though they tire quickly.
These old nags will eat me out of house and home!
My horses are sturdy enough to work in the fields.
A young Werewolf named Liara has asked me to retrieve her shampoo from the wreckage of the caravan. She is having problems adapting to her fur.
When I'm done with you, you'll wish you had never died!
By the way, I managed to get my hands on an urn containing the ashes of a martyr. It's incredibly valuable and almost certainly authentic.
Have you heard the news? They've discovered the skeleton of a prophet at a secret location. Isn't that exciting?
Did you hear? Apparently commandments 21 to 30 have been found. This will change a lot of things.
Down in the valley, the Gods have led the people to several holy stones. Have you been there yet?
A fellow believer told me that a holy blade has been found. I want to see this miracle with my own eyes.
What do you think of the holy belt a fellow believer accidentally found while plowing the fields?
I'm not easily fooled, you know that, but isn't the discovery of a holy foot a sign?
People claim the holy skirt is a forgery! Apparently someone has admitted to it. That's unbelievable!
If we had more powerful relics the people would surely show us more respect.
A golden puppet! That's an incredible find! Have you heard about it?
The Orc wasn't much of an opponent for me, but my comrade-in-arms almost soiled his pants. I can see why his father doesn't think much of him.
Even I cannot carry anything else.

Find my maids and their children and return them to me!

While you were gone several Kobolds waltzed in here and abducted my maids and their children. Please bring them back. I would be devastated forever if something bad happened to them!

A hidden treasure chest is located not far from here. I don't know who it belongs to. My husband would like to recover it himself, but as I always say: Money only attracts thieves, cutthroats and the tax man. It is better to have less and be thankful for it, but maybe you're interested in the chest? Then it would be gone and my husband would stop bothering me. I will draw you a map of its location.
Take care Green Skin, It was a nice couple of hours with you!
What you're saying is outrageous, but it makes sense! We have to act fast. We might have a chance at stopping DeMordrey if we take immediate action.
You have to kill more snakes to prove yourself worthy to the Great Rat. Otherwise, it's wrath will be unbearable!
Maybe your friends will build a sand sculpture for you.
I'll return you to sender - back to the underworld.
The shaman connected the curse to the ring. Apparently, the ring is esential if we want to lift the curse. However the ring is hidden in an evil place.

Deliver the order.

For quite a while now we've been fighting against the Blood Dryads, but we need fresh iron to ensure that reinforcements will have new weapons. We've been waiting for a delivery of raw iron for our blacksmith for a long time now, but Dyr-Laigh hasn't supplied it. We have no choice but to send someone to Slain Athai to buy some iron from the brigands there. Unfortunately I cannot spare anyone for this job. Could you deliver this order? I’ll give you a bag full of gold as a down payment.

It was a tough fight, and now that she is lying before me in her own blood I'm almost inclined to pay her respect. Almost!
I have fulfilled my task, but there are more tasks waiting for me.
So close and still so far ...
I'll put an end to this TyBosso once and for all!

Free Bacalio's father from prison.

The injustice! Oh, the injustice! I could pull my hair out. I know it doesn't make things better, but what am I supposed to do?

My father was tried and sentenced for treason, but he is innocent. The judge has confiscated my father's possessions and kept them for himself. It was a set-up! The target was my father's land. He will be executed soon. My family is desperate. We don't know what to do. Everything has been taken from us. The gold isn't important, I only care about my father, who is rotting away in a dungeon cell.

Will you help us? Please free my father, so we can flee from this town.

They fled to the mountains... Ahhhrg!
Here... I took that away from them... take it.
What a pure soul you still possess.
I almost thought you wouldn't show up again.
You have no more power here, Seraphim.
We're so sick of the Seraphim.
Go back from whence you came.
This is no theological dispute, this is reality my friend.
Another one who won't be in my way again.
Well? You can either fight me and become an outlaw, or you can hand over that basket and cut the last tie that exists between a father and his son!

Ah ha! There they are. And in the same order as the resurrected. And once again signed by this General Winderlich. I'm going to go talk to him.
Why are we stopping here? Why have you drawn your weapon? Are we in danger? Oh no! I have been betrayed!

Ah, there you are and Blackhammer is dead! Well done. However, certain... matters require my full attention now but your deeds will be remembered. Here, take your reward and go have a drink. Go on... I am busy.
You can forget "eating something from my plate" and "drinking out of my little glass."
Want to view the world from six feet under?
The early Orc catches his death!

I have no idea what I should do with this other than sell it.

Marigold against mist monster? I don't know what to say.

The world isn't fair, that's just how it is! Even though I love battle it weakens my morals!
When I retire from the service I'll spend a year in a virtue camp to regain the Goddess' favor.
You know that I enjoy being virtuous before battle! But during a blood-bath I prefer to see heads roll.

Soldiers today are considered scum, you have to get used to that. But on the other hand, the high wages are a good consolation.
They probably think that we will fight better if they cover us in virtue, but that is only a drawback in battle!
I can tell you what I think the greatest virtue is: To rain a mighty blood-bath down on those villainous Orcs!

I would advise you against tasting goods from the distant Eastern lands.

My weapons are the only ones worth buying. The rest are trash!

Trade means change! And I have a penchant for both!
I should order a spell that is effective against shoplifters.
Penny-pinchers are the natural enemies of my profession.
Now we'll beat you black and blue, Inquisitor!
Arrogant swine, we'll beat you out of your robe!
Preach your hate somewhere else, cleric!

I'd rather trim the hedges than join in on his game. I will tell you the way to the Reverend's residence.
