Drink can kill you!
I have no place to put this.
To the humans ... it never rains but pours.
I guess I must proceed to the Humans.
Are there any spiders in the tunnel? No, no! Do not tell me.
Thank you, I think I will be able to find the way.
Good, I will ask my way again when I reach the village!
One could go blind from my fruit schnapps.
My beer is warm and flat.
The glasses need to be washed this year.
These drunken louts! I hate these drunken louts!
Good manners are a matter of luck with my guests, and I'm often unlucky.
One of my children wants to sever the holy bond with his wife. I don't know what to do.
Unfortunately that's quite common these days. Is he aware of the consequences?
He knows about the banishing curse, but he doesn't seem to fear it.
These sinners should know that the spirits won't just sit there and watch.
Shall we make an example of one of them? I don't want to see further demoralization.
Well, we could publicly tear one apart.
Some people may consider that rather barbaric.
The ancestors would surely applaud our actions.
Such a mission spices up an adventurer's life.

Brother Nikolaus
In remembrance of one the greatest keepers of fire.
A Goblin never shows up alone.

Varnar proved to be a rather unsavory companion. He considered Shirka to be his property until her debt was paid off, but he proposed a deal: If I eliminate the commander of a camp south of the city, he will consider the debt paid and release Shirka.
You don' t seem like a great hero.
I learn something new everyday. Today: Demons must have assistants.
I will break your spell with my power.
I should avoid this opponent for a while yet.
My wife's driving me crazy! She wants me to take care of the garden instead of slaughtering!
It was a huge mistake to marry! She always snatches the best of my prey!
How's your wife? Do you suffer from constant nagging too?
If I'd been clever I'd have never married, then I'd be living happily ever after!
I've never longed for peace so much! Why did I ever get involved with women?
Why in Kuan's name did I ever marry? Before that I had a life without worry!
My wife! The last nail in my warrior's coffin, and there's no weapon to get rid of her!
If I could go back and choose again I'd stay single! Do you have any idea what I go through?
I've defeated every single opponent on the battlefield, yet my wife keeps harassing me!
Why do warriors marry? So they don't have to face peace at home?
You will not get away from me!
Ali went one step too far. I admire his tenacity, but I have better things to do than fight assassins all day. I should visit Ali.
We will hold down the fort and await your return! Good Luck!
Give my regards to your men, in the netherworld!
Benewion was pleased. The danger for the Noriath Corner has been averted.
Your black soul will be cleansed by the fires of hell.
Leave the dark path - then maybe we'll let you live.
What terrible fate you must have suffered.
If I want to gain more experience, I should leave this region.
And now we say our good-byes to yet another enemy...
The landlord's brewery is safe, and except for a few casks so are his supplies.
A warrior like you doesn't know the meaning of fear!
Even the children here learn your fighting techniques!
It's time for a new costume, isn't it? We have a good clothier here!
The cobbler would be happy to mend your boots.
You look tired. Are you exhausted from fighting?
That good for nothing soldier still hasn't come back yet! They're only good at two things: drinking and slacking off!
You have found and killed the woman? Thank you very much, this is for you. No one should call the Pasha a miser.
That was the last of them. Let's see what else the Guardsman has for me.
What do you ask of me?
I also found Glydial in the house. He told me that he'll rebuild the store. Perhaps we'll meet again.

Yehaa, now these beasts will consider thrice before coming near my fields again. Here is your gold. Oh, by the way, something else happened while you were gone... Perhaps you would be able to help me out once more?
Good work hunter! You seem to know your craft!

Gravestone
I'm an idealist. I don't know where I'm going, but I'm on my way.
We will hunt down all of the assassins. Thank you for your help.
Mishirla went completely mad! He thought I wanted to cheat him of his success and attacked me like a rabid animal. I had to defend myself.
Family, yes, I must say that's a sore spot for me.  I clench my fist in my pocket and carry on.
Let's not talk about that. It surrounds my thoughts in darkness.
Sometimes I think I should become a hermit. Then all this pain would just be a memory.
Family... it's supposed to be a stronghold but walls also become brittle.
I have to agree with you. Anyone whose never seen this chaos probably lives alone.
I don't want to go into it, but all the trouble that loved ones cause can really be demoralizing.
You really start wondering why you put yourself through all this. Family life is worse than war!
Stop saying that. I don't want to be reminded of my annoying family right now.
Please, we can talk about anything but domestic happiness? I don't have a whole lot of that.
When I want to see a happy person, I go look for someone without a clan. Do you know what I mean?
I always read the last pages first. Too much excitement isn't good for my blood pressure.

Nadja told me that they “switch” monsters on the island regularly, so that they can study all the different creatures. Right now it's Ice Elementals. Nadja asked me to kill 20 and bring her their crystals.

Kill eight deranged Earth Elementals!

I'm Beltario, leader of “Investigation Team Golem.” We're here on orders from the baroness.

The giant Golem that has shown up here is bad enough, but now weird deranged Earth Elementals have suddenly started appearing out of nowhere. We've counted eight so far, and they've even started wandering past the ramp.

They have to be destroyed before T-Energy transforms them into powerful Golems too. Would you take care of this matter?
No, I will not help you.

You... you are too late... I saw them, their torches. They went south into the mountains. HA! That was a fine battle, now I don't have to hide from my ancestors anymore. Go now, make them pay for their deeds.
You... deserve... to take my place.

Ah! My brother sent you did he? Oh did he give you some new bait for me? That’s excellent! The fish aren’t biting much today, but they’ll soon get their appetite back when they see the new bait! Those big green... er, you know.

Here - take this as a sign of my gratitude.
The weapon for fire damage does not help me here.
Analysis complete: Item is extremely rare.
I'll take you with me to TyBosso DeElfici. Remember, don't you ever say one word about what went down here. You'd regret it!
Come on, or is that all you've got!
You have no more appointments today...
These pelts are of very good quality. Rangald has mentioned a giant boar. Talk to him, if you are interested in some more work.
So you call the shots here, yes? Then call out with your last one.

Search the chest!

I must admit that I underestimated you. Your power is equal to mine. You won't be able to kill me, but I yield regardless. Look! You will find my notes in this chest. That should answer all your questions.

Xerxes and Varuck are dead and I'm a few gold pieces richer. Maybe I should go introduce myself to Luzilla, but Orc women are so uncouth.

That's that. Xerxes and Varuck are no longer among us. I'd go introduce myself to Luzilla, but I've heard that Orc women are very insensitive.
Liosilath agreed that the next step is to go to the Dryads and retrieve the key to unveil the cloaked hub.
I don't have the courage to stop you.
Oh - Is it really you, in the flesh? I always thought you were an invention of the bards.
Your reputation precedes you - and now you're here in person!
Is it really you? Fortune has favored me, and allowed me to see you with my own eyes!
All of Ancaria is still talking about your deeds!
Wow! I was attacked by an undead Dragon! This Seraphim has some unbelievable skeletons in her... cellar!
Where's your pitiful husband? I thought he wanted to go to the gathering.
I don't know anything about it. What's with this useless gathering? Are you planning a new fruitless campaign?
Shut up, hag! We're working out a plan to proclaim the GreatOrcish realm.
Well, our neighbours will definitely tremble when they hear about it. You'd better take care of your duties and chop wood!
GreatOrcs won't do any slave labour!
Just wait and see, stupid woman! When I command our armies...
Then they'll be clad much worse, and they'll drink even more than they already do. Now leave me alone!
You will find the wells in the temple ruins.
Those thieves! Just wait until I get my hands on them!
<Pain, dull as if being hit in the stomach> ouff!
I meant to ask you, have you brewed a new potion?
Maybe, but how can I be sure that you won't pass off my idea as your own?
Yes, you're probably right. I have indeed invented a new potion against lichens, for both Dryads and trees!
That sounds like a real breakthrough! We've waited very long for such a double effect!
Don't you make fun of it, I already received quite a few pre-orders!
Well, you haven't convinced me. But just to be on the safe side, I'd like you to set aside a small bottle for me, too.
I'll gladly supply you with one. May Kybele protect you!

Activation successful!

You were deactivated and hidden. Your purpose is to intervene and influence the destiny of the world when the time is right. Go now and fulfill your miss... click... ion ... click ... ion.

Come with me to see Joana!

What? Her nephew's been behind it all? If he meant to kill you for knowing about his plot then Joana isn't safe anymore, after all she's the one who sent you to him! Come with me to see her! I have to make sure she's okay.

STOP! You may not pass. We're at war with the neighboring barony!
We're under strict orders to not let anyone pass without the explicit consent of the baron.
<Pain, dull as if being hit in the stomach> ouff!
Increases the chance to trigger secondary effects (burn, freeze, weaken, poison) of the respective damage types, while also increasing their effectiveness and their damage.
I know the details of the conspiracy and should inform my client.
Life is not always as it is supposed to be. But what do you know about that?
I agree! Sometimes when walking by it's hard to hide my laughter.
If I met one of them at night I'd offer him my throat as a snack.
How they strut: "Look at me, I have pointy ears - but I'm not an alien!"
The other day I almost yelled out "you have stupid ears!"
I prefer our figures even if we should be a bit more well-fed.
And their ridiculous bows and arrows! All they're missing are the tights!
I don't really like their dress code either.
Our people will be ridiculed that subjects such as these overpowered us.
And the clergymen aren't second to the noblemen.
I get sick every time I see them. Thinking about them gives me a rash.

The commander didn't sound very surprised. He said he'll take care of this matter "in due time," whatever that's supposed to mean. Something smells fishy here!
I'm going to speak to Harun personally.
This T-Energy is dangerous. Let's get out of here.
Back to the ghost train with you!
Stay away from me, maggot brain!
Bringing you back to life was a mistake, scum!
You're not welcome here, Shadow Warrior!
You're Human. You have to obey even the lowest of Elves.
My muck soup is simply delicious. I use my mother’s recipe!
Using Dragon scales to fight dragon fire? Let's hope that it actually works...
May Lumen’s blessing lead you to victory. Please accept this gift and the blessing of Lumen.
High Elf Sistan has asked me to take him and his family to the High Elven region. It's supposed to be very far away.
Thank you so much for your help! We are all very grateful.

Eliminate the Spy!

I have another little task for you! My Scouts have reported that a spy for one of those blasted noblemen has taken up a position there. He is observing the entire area and is supposed to have a box of carrier pigeons with him. I'm afraid that as soon as we march out of here he's going to send a message to Thylysium, and then you can guess what will happen. No sooner has the pigeon flapped its wings than we'll have the entire armed force of the high nobility on our backs. Go and eliminate this person!
What was that saying again? Smoke ´em up?
The less smoke the better - that's the key to building a good charcoal stack.
You won't get cold doing this job.
I have a burning interest in charcoal stacks.
The stack is covered with turf and foliage.
I need better protection against damage from fire.
Back to the pew with you!
Well done! You're not bad at all...
You will bleed for my gold, you damned swindlers.
If their ears were practical it would be one thing, but Elves can't fly or hear very well.
What's the problem with the Elves' skin tone? "Tanning salon" seems to be an unknown idea to them!
You have to wonder who the real broken-down slaves are when you take a close look at those Elves.
I wonder if they bleach their skin? I heard that makes noses break.
The Kammhalters' youngest son has suspiciously pointy ears. Are we about to face a scandal?
Who are the Elves trying to impress with their pompous horse carriages?
Do you think the noble Elves also like their own sex? Their language suggests it.
We wouldn't even wrap a dead fish in what the Elves call "clothes."
If only I had pen and paper! None of our descendants will ever believe the story of these Elf creatures...
Do you ever wonder if we could become like the Elves, the oppressed becoming the oppressor sort of thing? Is it so ridiculous?

Seraphim Tussilia lost her amulet. No big deal one would think, only it was a gift from Sophia herself. And Sophia seems to be pretty touchy about such things. A very contrite Tussilia now wants me to find her amulet.
At least that family elder didn't ignore my message immediately. My work is complete.
It doesn't sound very interesting, but I will accept the task anyway.
Please... you'd be doing me a huge favor.
What a poor freak of nature you are.
That doesn't suit me quite yet.
Okay this should be enough Kobold heads to prove to the mayor that there is something you can do about Kobolds.
From which character should the rune come?
Just as I suspected, the Baron wouldn't even consider simply surrendering. Okay then, let's get this over with!
Your head will make a nice addition to my collection!
I shall season the vegetable soup with basil.
Add a little chicken to the salad and..ah, it's just exquisite.
The poacher promised to bring me some wild boar.
You want to see how I fight? Okay then!
During my travels across the Human realm a lumberjack warned me that a wild boar is roaming around not far from him. Allegedly he is Ancaria's most dangerous boar. I have to find out if that is true.
That was your last spell, Elven witch!
You could learn something from my court mage, Elf.
Your spells won't help you here.
This energy - it is trying to take possession of me.
Actually, I don't fancy scrap iron ...
Melted down, you'll be worth more!
You should have your joints greased ...
Did you get lost, tin soldier?
Do you want me to pull your plug?
I'm leaving now. Don't wait for me...
I should have left when I had the chance...
Where's an Ogre when you need one!
The rats are leaving the sinking ship.
I'm supposed to maintain a low profile and follow the weapons dealer and find out where he goes. I guess I'm off then!
Now, look at you Bruno! You are wet and all covered in dirt!
<pain, sharp, like pricked with a needle> Ay!
Find them before they cause any more trouble!
Theodor has thanked me for saving his wife. He's also told me about the moneylender's secret hideout. I need to find it to put an end to all this.
Fangil is dead. Maybe I can find some clues in this chest.
The clergy must be having recruiting problems, if they're hiring somebody like you!
I hope you made your peace with the world!
Have another sniff of incense before you leave!
It's nothing personal, but I despise idolaters like you!
You'll never lose faith, will you?
I can only wish you all the luck in the world.
Looking at you, I assume you constantly long for food too.
That clumsy old fool of a magician has forgotten the spell that can undo his transformation. Now I have to get it from his mentor.
Find him and show no mercy!
Fine then! Let’s finish this. I’ll follow you.
You are used to taking orders, right? Well then ... DIE!
The Grackk family doesn't seem exactly small.
A potion that only works on Dwarves... Tsk, tsk, tsk.
I wish you a good day.
A potion for courage? Bah, an Orc without courage ain´t an Orc.
A defensive spell against those nasty, arrogant High-Elves, now THAT would be a fine thing.
I need ink of dragon's blood to protect our soldiers.
Oho, that's a bit too much incense..*cough*
My potions can create a lust for blood in the calmest of warriors.
I just don't know what to do. I shall ask my Tarot cards.
I should look it up in my "Compendium of Honor".
Spirits and demons, I shall dethrone ye!
I am supposed to brew him a potion against fear...if only I knew what fear was!
Oh, Ancaria's hero. You look good enough to fall in love with!
Good day, sir. Frankly - you are the best.
Alas, hero - If only I was worthy of you!
You can't escape your own shadow!
I do not care about your energy!
I'm going to pull your plug...
I can't cause enough fire damage with my weapon.
It’s a difficult riddle, isn’t it?
I do not understand greed, so be assured that I am immune to temptation.
I can't cause enough normal damage with my weapon.
The reward this time is a little short for an entire camp. Maybe I'll get more for the commander's last assignment.
I know this seems like a strange place to live, but I like the peace and quiet.
May Kybele be with you, stranger.
These crystalline cottages are also referred to as crystal igloos.
Huh? Lydia suddenly disappeared. I should go inside and see if I can find her.
Hey, you! Do you finally have something for our blades to do?
It depends. We still need bold men to add to our border patrols.
Border patrols! That doesn't sound like there's much cutting involved, and even less payment I assume.
These days you should be happy to be able to work at all, you ungrateful beast!
Oh, I'm so sorry that I forgot to thank you on my knees, Mr. Orc.
Do you intend to mock me? That's my best offer at the moment.
Then I'll have to decline, because that's too much marching and not enough slaughtering.
Then begone with you, lazy dog. You're just wasting my time here!
The Grurag Clan leader has been defeated. Now I must go down into the village and free the clan brothers.

Rinah and I taught the heretic's brothers some manners.
The Officer says that I can approach her again when I'm ready for another adventure.
We're in luck! There is only one estate in this area that belongs to an Elf. I suspect that it's the Priest's relative. I'll find out for sure when I get there.

Well... that story may or may not be true. A monster is a monster though, and I'm not really interested in how that monster got to be the way it is. Why make things more complicated than they need to be?
I killed 6 lupan - I think that's enough. I should report back to Juchalti now.
Apparently there exists a concoction of mushrooms that, upon consumption, allows one's ancestors to appear.

Fangor has asked me to bring him a bucket of, er, well he asked me to fill up a bucket from the Kobold’s cesspit. Apparently it gives his swill that 'certain something.' It certainly put me off trying any of the local specialties.
If it bleeds, you can kill it.

Gazza
I never predict anything, and I never will.
The Abbess took the elixir and she will drink it now. She also gave me a reward! That worked out fine.

The Orc Elder was a strange old lady. She acknowledged I was a good fighter and claimed she could somehow look inside my head. Anyway, she made me an honorary member of the Grurag Clan, and now I can travel through the Orc territory without being attacked by Orcs from my clan.

Nathim destroyed my boat! Confront him!

If you want to get to the other side of the river with dry feet, then you’ve got quite a walk ahead of you! It’s a long way to the next bridge. Normally I could take you across in my boat. It’s quite a good little business, folks wanting to cross the river always pass by here. Lazy hunters, busy aristocrats - they’re all glad to pay me a penny or two if it saves them walking to the next bridge.
You know how it is though, if you have a good idea it doesn’t take long for someone to come along and steal it. A fellow by the name of Nathim has been trying to put me out of business for some time now. Once he realized there wasn’t enough trade for the two of us, he destroyed my boat. That's all that’s left of it.
Maybe you could confront him for me? I don’t have a chance against him and all his thugs.
Where do you expect me to fit this in?
If only I could remember how to change water to wine...
Thankless Humans! I shall make them clean the Temple with their bare hands.
Only the light of the Gods can illuminate the void that has no space and time.
I think it would be best if we reinstated the old sacrificial rites.
Morning prayers are becoming more and more laborious.
The Gods must love stupid people, because they created quite a few of them.
The old scriptures are in need of reinterpretation.
The aristocracy mock me - they shall soon see what comes of that!
Kiss the ground of foreign lands? No! I have been told that foreigners are Godless.
Disembodied doesn't protect you from damage. Not all the time at least.
Great! The strong get stronger, and the hungry, hungrier...
You are known in all of Ancaria - for your courage and your frugality.
Oh, if only I were free! Do something about it!
As a woman, I only have one thing to say to you: Keep up the good work!
After a hard fight the Greenclaw is defeated and lying on the floor. It didn’t die in vain, with it’s venom sac the artist will be able to create the perfect green.
Demon, you have to be eliminated.
Increases attack value, defense value and weapon damage.

The Priest has gone to his weekend residence, he seems to be a nasty fellow. I will make sure that he doesn't exploit the villagers' fear any more. And Telwan will pay me well if I solve the problems he is having with the healing potions
What's the matter, what are we doing here? You are not going to...? I trusted you, how can you do this?
Now that you proved yourself in the wolf hunt, you must prove yourself in the next challenge. We have some really nasty bears in the area. Kill 12 of them and hurry, you don't have much time.
What can I do for you?
And there are people following someone like you?
A wealthy landlord named Hermelin has asked me to remove a group of squatters from his house. It’s just the kind of work I love.
My head aches as if a horde of wild boars trampled on it!
Yes, haha! Bad cheap beer, no good for head!
No, I attacked a Human, who seemed to be a promising victim, but suddenly I was surrounded.
Human hurt Orc, haha, Orc bad fighter.
You're absolutely right. I should give up fighting, this pain is killing me!
Orc cry like girl, you bad warrior.
You can talk! If I could heal myself like you, I wouldn't have to worry.
Troll no let hit, kill all! Now go.
These battles against the Blood Dryads are wearing us out! If we could only find their nest!
We won't be able to make up for the losses we've suffered while battling the Blood Dryads! We have to do something!
If I only knew how we could defeat these miserable Blood Dryads! Their powers seem to come from another world.
These murderous Blood Dryads are starting to worry me! Where do they draw their incomprehensible powers from?
It can't be Kybele's will to have these disgusting Blood Dryads wandering around the forest! How can we beat them though?
Our struggle with these terrible Blood Dryads has already cost us many of our best fighters! What can we do?
Isn't there anything else we can do against these dark creatures?  The ones known to the rest of the world as the Blood Dryads.
It seems as though when you kill one of those vile Blood Dryads, two more appear to take its place! That isn't a fair fight is it?
Blood Dryads! You see their deformed faces everywhere in this forest! If only we could find out where this brood came from!
These blood-thirsty creatures need to be removed from the forest! They're threatening our people's very existence!
I'm losing my appetite, and I'm being tormented by strange visions.
That's bad, but you must eat to keep your strength up for the hunt.
I don't even feel like hunting and killing anymore.
It must be something serious then. What kind of visions plague you?
I see the restless spirits of my ancestors. They can find no peace because I've forgotten their names.
You have to remember them, or they won't stop following you.
I'm trying so hard, but I really have forgotten a lot of them.
I hope they'll soon grow tired of appearing to you then.
Alarm! This is not a drill!
Not all the employees are back yet. Please find them for me.

As you know, we created the sword to conquer death. As you also found out for yourself, you are neither really alive or dead. It is necessary to destroy this sword, but before it is destroyed I want you to meet someone. He was the first that we brought back and he fought at our side until the end of the war. He says that he has found a way to be truly alive, and because he has been such a loyal ally we want to give him this chance.
I thank the Gods that I am not a vegetarian...
Buddy, you have a dandruff problem.
Hey you! Are you looking for trouble?
You're dumber than three Trolls put together!
You want to bet, you can't hit me?
You're going to be really mad soon!
The Trolls are going to use what's left of you as a toothpick!

After a hard journey, I reached the Great Wall. When I showed the Grand Inquisitor’s ring to the guard, he allowed me to pass and told me I would find a spy in the village to the east. This man is supposed to know where “The Broker” lives.

You defeated Ogan, he was probably too old and too slow. That is the way of the world, one life comes and another goes. You are the new master of the hunt, until someone defeats you. You are the rightful owner of the Amulet until then.
Sorry, I can’t give you any more detailed information about where to find him. Scorpions tend to roam around a lot. Creatures that fierce can usually go wherever they please.
The snowman is finished and it looks good. It's a little crooked, but that gives him a bit of an expressionist feel.
Move back into your miserable mud huts!
Haven't I seen this thing in one of the 'Terminator' movies?
Back into the grave with you! And don't forget your rusty rattle-chain!
Have you consulted Kybele's great Oracle yet today? I place great stock in his prophecies, that's for sure!
I actually have to visit the Goddess' Oracle, but the journey is so exhausting for me.  Do you have that trouble too?
What do you think of the Goddess' Oracle? I often find his prophesies confusing, but they are almost always true.
Do you think that the Goddess' Oracle is an instrument of her wisdom too? I don't leave my house without his advice!
What do you think of Kybele's new Oracle? He mumbles a bit, but he has a good quota.
I think the world of the Oracle, but he often speaks in riddles. Can you decipher his prophesies?
Why can't the Goddess' Oracle speak plainly for a change? You can hardly understand his visions!
I really appreciate the Goddess' Oracle, but he speaks in riddles too often! What the heck are the buds of Godly expedience?
If I didn't know that the Oracle was appointed by Kybele herself, I would have thought he was mentally challenged!
The new Oracle seems to be a bit overwhelmed, he told me in advance that I was going to be reincarnated as a berry!
This will be your last breath!
Makallus got the rings and I got my reward.

That’s right, I’ll give you my lotion for free and I’ll even pay you to give the lotion to old Zizhar. Just remember, don’t tell him where you got it from! I like to look at this as a scientific experiment!
You shouldn't waste any time. You don't fool around with shifty characters like Blackheart.
Great! You've done it! Now I can till the field. I'll start right away!
By the ghosts of the ancient dragons ... how can that be?
I have brought my peace to this region.
The brewery has been saved and the village has beer again. I have received my reward as well.
That doesn't sound interesting for someone like me.
You're so ugly, you could be a modern art masterpiece!
I met Heiko tom Felde in the lobby of an office building. If I see any of his employees on my way, he asked me to let them know that development of Sacred 3 is supposed to start.
This has to be a fearsome weapon.
You should not waste any time. The Kobolds are increasing in numbers as we speak.
I have to get out of here!
Gods, they will kill us all!
Hurry, out of here, the player is running amok!
I think it's a wicked rumor! Who would want to rob the tithe of our forefathers? That would just enrage them.
I can't believe it's true, because no one living is allowed to touch the things that have been given to our forefathers.
I won't believe it before I see the culprits with my own eyes! What kind of person would take part in a sacrilege against our forefathers?
That would be a disaster! You know how unforgiving our forefathers can be when you deceive them!
It doesn't make sense, what would be the point? The thieves would have to expect a lifelong curse!
If that's true I hope that the thieves' scales rot away while still on their bodies.
I find it alarming that such rumors arise. How can I... I mean... how will anyone prove it?
I can't believe this, there's nothing more disgraceful than robbing our forefathers!
Shh, don't talk so loud! Can you imagine the commotion if the faithful hear of this?
Gossip, nothing but gossip! I don't think that our brothers would be capable of such a heinous deed!
If we don't go to battle, I will try to kill off the poachers.
What more do I need than a good sword and a sharp dagger?
Bow and arrow are impractical in close combat.
I wonder if our blacksmith would be a good armorer as well?
Maybe I will have fame and glory after my death.
Kuan and Kybele are our mightiest allies.
I practice caution in battle: Stand, see, duck.
I don't like fighting in swampy areas.
For deeds of particular bravery, one should get their own tree house.
So this is the mysterious crypt. Looks busy down here.

Stranger, let me tell you about my terrible fate!
In the old days, when the palace still stood here I was a young and arrogant prince. On my wedding day I had an old beggar killed because she gave me a worthless ring made of tin and then I threw away the ring. Little did I know that this old woman was the powerful witch named Jugala. Before she died she cursed me and all my guests. My life turned bleak and miserable: My wife died at a young age, and I became lonely and bitter. Yet the worst part of this curse is the fact that we now have to haunt these ruins.

What do you mean you want to go in there? There is nothing but the storage area, private individuals are not allowed to enter it. That's what the museum's rules say. Besides there are ghosts and spiders, there's no way I'm going in there.
A good fighter needs steadfastness. And you look to be a good fighter.
Effortlessly and happy I do my day work. How about you?
You fight well but our men fight better.
Bold. It was really bold to come to our land.
Where's your big mouth, or is it time for a bubbling fart now?

You again! I already told you everything I know! I ...


Oh, you aren't with those people from last week, are you?
Phew, Glydial DeElfici certainly didn't exaggerate. The parcel is really heavy. I should hurry and leave right away.
Thank you so much for your help. We will take over the farm now.
We found Marcus' guitar. Now all we're missing are the drum sticks, then we'll have all the instruments back.
I see that you guys aren't really lacking reasons to beat each other to death here, are you?
They do not seem to be having any other worries...
They insulted us? Well, that's a serious problem, of course.
Right, time I restored our honor then.
Ah right, you put the emphasis on honor. Well, then let's go...
<pain, like getting your fingers burnt> Ahhhhh!
Tily was glad I could help and has rewarded me well.
I need better protection from poison damage.
That's what I thought. Lupus didn't want to accept defeat and challenged me to a duel. Well let's just see what his old bones are made of.

Alright, alright! I’ll tell you everything! Ophtanar let me in on the secret. It was all his idea! We have amassed more than enough riches to leave the cult and live a life of comfort, but that’s our problem! We can’t just take the gold and disappear - our followers would never let us! So we collected the dreamberries and gave them to a few of our followers. That way they would all be kept busy defending themselves while we made our escape. Ophtanar is preparing to conduct a final ritual at the Dragon statue that will secure us a safe journey. Please spare me! Take me to Waton, he will tell you that I wouldn't hurt a flea!
So much for Hattmir. Let's see if I can find any clues as to where the archaeologist went.
That's not the right horse for me.
I must concentrate! This foe is strong!
Wait, oh noble one! I realize my mistake now, and if you show me mercy, I will not spread any disrespectful stories about the lady ever again.
A warrior knows what needs to be done!
May Lumen guide you, kind sir.

What? A clown like you wants to get involved in my affairs? I won't allow it! Rikal make sure this... person doesn't leave. Afterwards we'll meet at the Temple outside the town. We have a lot of work to do.
I will still try ... if I may.
I would at least like to give it a try though!
I have not been here before!
So far, I was able to sneak by every guardian creature. So, if you'll allow me, I will give it a try.
Pardon me for thinking that you were a child. But with your permission, I would still like to confront the monster.
In which case, I will be the first one to succeed!

One of the patrol's scouts actually came back and reported to me that a ritual is supposed to take place somewhere near here. There is an incantation spot somewhere out there where large numbers of crusaders are lurking about. It would appear that they were just about to conjure up a Demon. Let's see if we can locate this place. Maybe we'll be able to destroy some of the crusaders.
Mission accomplished, pig dead. Now I just have to put an apple in the boar's mouth and return to Guntha with my trophy.
These Goblins are merely a caricature of life.

This portal will take you to the territories north of the southern ocean. Step through it and find the mark of the skull.

It's done then... so mote it be.
The answers to your questions can be found in the High Temple of the Lost City. Once this was the capital of the ancient Elven realm, but now it's deserted and has been swallowed by the jungle in the southlands.
It's quite far away, but I can make your trip a bit shorter. Go through this portal, it leads to the lands north of the southern sea. When you arrive, find the mark of the skull. One such as you will be welcome there.
The Humans want to meet a shady smuggler who's supposed to show them the way to freedom. I am supposed to accompany them to the meeting place.
You're a sight to behold, my dear brother in arms!
Wonderful, we fighters don't meet as often as we should.
How nice to see that you're unharmed!
What a great day! How are you, fighter?
You smell good, like death and victory!
I'd like to see you more often! You're a rare sight!
I bid you good day, brave brother.
It's a great honor to shake the hand of a worthy fighter.
Incredible! You look wonderful, scaly and unharmed!
I suspected that you'd become a ghost of the ancestors too.

Unbelievable! Simply unbelievable! You even outperformed Seraphim Milrinda! How did you do that?!
With this result, your name will be entered into the best-of-all-times list. I pull my diadem to you! I can't reward you properly. But maybe I can give you something even better! There is a cave nearby. You might find some interesting items in there. I will mark the location on your map.

You have...? I... I understand. The agents of the nobles are onto me. Killing me would have been too scandalous, am I right?
Well, I understand the message. I won't give the Inquisitors any more information. You have my word on it, now let me go!
If the Gods loved hunters, they'd have made jackrabbits slower.
I shall sacrifice a portion of my prize to our ancestors.
I'll never understand how something with four legs can run that fast.
Even when I'm out hunting, there is always enough time to pray to the ancestors.
...then I drew my bow and cried out: "Keep still!" - but it just ran off...
A woman to look up to - that's a rare sight.
You seem to be kind. Please help us with our troubles.
Generous warrior - don't you have some alms? We are starving.
Why don't you Humans understand when to step back?
Your beauty outshines even the light of our divine stars.
Oh, it's you, my dear! I heard your lovely wife is away at the Orkenbrandt baths.  You must miss her terribly.
I should miss her, but it is hard because she hasn't really understood me for such a long time.
Oh, I am sorry to hear that.
I think a fine woman like you would understand me very well, if we spent some time together. Would you do me the honor?
You cannot be serious! Do you want me to call you a lecher from now on?
I would let you call me anything you like!
Please, do not misunderstand. You have a blessed day, my fair lady!
Even though you are able to walk on two legs, you are still not an adequate opponent.
Search successful! Data analysis indicates fifth key is located in the jungle.
Oh please, a High Elf will not mount that!
Oh, what I would give to have just a piece of your courage.
Your fighting ability is admired throughout the land.
It seems to me, you were born to fight.
We've cornered a deer, but there are also some wolves lying in wait for it. I'll step in as soon as they attack. There's no sign of the pack leader yet. I wonder where he is...
Who uses something like this? I sure don't.

You can purchase horses at horse traders.
They are depicted by a horseshoe symbol on the minimap.

You do not need to learn the skill "Riding" to use a horse, but it will give you certain bonuses. You may only own one horse at a time; therefore, you will have to sell your old horse before you can purchase a new one.


In order to switch between the horse and the character specific mount, open your inventory , click on the "Mount" tab and then select your horse or the character specific mount.


If you click on the button at the bottom right next to the buff slots, you will summon your active mount.

Clicking that button when your mount is already present lets you mount or dismount.
This is going to be one heck of a party!
I've collected the borrowed money. Now I shall bring it to Viola.
The huntress is too weak to continue hunting. Now I must find the remaining oblations, three branches of raging Forest Spirits.
Serve me or cease to exist!
This should be enough. Now I can collect my reward from Voralion.
What a pitiful and desolate life I lead.
I yearn to be free, but how could I ever escape from this drudgery.
I wish I owned a robe as beautiful as those of the noble lords.
It's my lucky day - I found some bread!
A potato! A whole potato! I'm on a lucky streak!
A few alms might help me.
This world is so cold and unforgiving - life is no fun.
The smell of frying meat is making me hallucinate.
My hunger could make a thief out of me yet.
Splish, splash, you took your last bath!
So this is the place where the Dryads are disappearing? There's something in the bushes at this very moment! I'm going to go have a look.

Go to the Du'Rach camp and kill twenty of them.

A few soldiers and I will accompany you. We'll march to the Du'Rach camp and kill twenty of them so that the way to the archaeologists is cleared again.
Forward march!
Do not revolt against the Seraphim!
Rest assured, I do know the way to the palace of the Seraphim.
Is this a malfunction or why am I not getting any more orders? This is so typical for an organic player. Demo programmes just keep on going!
I shouldn't get into this too deeply just yet, the enemies are too strong.
The merchant is pleased that his reputation remained unsullied.
It's nice and cool here under the earth, I think I'll stay in the shade a little while longer.
When you orcs can't tussel, you don't feel well, do you?

The Stone Anchor
The landmark of Artamark's Gate. In honor of all the victims of the Great Flood. May the gods have mercy on you.

Galdukar the Wise
He fell for Tyr Lysia. He will forever be remembered.

A Water Elemental has asked for my assistance. A bunch of Kobolds massacred the frogs in his pond, and now their rotting corpses have contaminated it. The Elemental has asked me to collect all the dead frogs. It’s not my normal line of work, but how often do you get to work for a Water Elemental?
Yeah, you hit me, but don't pride yourself on it.
I can't use that, yet. I'd better wait a bit.
Ecological fanatics don't deserve anything better!
Down into the dark maws of the netherworld!

Mhmm ... what a pleasant scent! I haven't smelled something for so long I can't even remember, when the last time was. And this plant feels so soft, even though I don't remember what a feeling is. Life? Oh, I think it was beautiful. I vaguely remember the wind in my hair. Please leave me and come back later. I wish to enjoy this moment for a while.
Maybe I should go into the Ngrunz cave and collect the garnets. It would bring me a lot of honor.
This area won't cause any more trouble.
I will go to the tavern! They've got work for me, and I will get food and gold for it!
Tavern! Tavern good. Troll no let in.
I have to keep an eye on the patrons. When they drink too much I'll throw them out.
Yes, Orcs drink much. Then sing! Then fight!
They're nasty when they drink too much. But I'll do a good job there.
Crack Orc skull, yes! Good work! Much fun.
I have to go now! The innkeper is always impatient, so will be waiting.
Troll wait outside! Troll eat only what Ogre throw!
You probably have the pope on your side ...
Ok, I feel much better now! Thank you!
I've arrived at the camp, now I have to decide whether I want to murder five Bedouin, or talk to them first.
Activation process complete, unlocking your application, please wait...
Just as I thought, the necklaces belonged to the murdered child's parents.
In the end, you're nothing but Human scum.
Dead or alive, you're nothing more than a slave, Shadow Warrior.
No Human will stand in my way! Into the dust!
My slaves deal with rabble like you, Shadow Warrior!
That alchemist has lost his marbles, but at least I have the elixir and I can return to the ghost hunter now.
I will help you, you are too weak to prevail yourself!
I’ve dropped my cover, now it’s time to arrest these rogues!
Oh a brave hero on his way! How are you doing, my child?
I'm happy to see you as well. I always have a sympathetic ear for you.
What a lovely sight, oh you protective child of the Goddess!
Praise be Kybele that she's brought us here together!
Thanks be to Kybele that I meet you here!
My child, what a pleasure! Kybele loves the brave.
My joy knows no boundaries! I wish you a good day!
Meeting you here! But I don't really believe in coincidences.
You appear to be decisive and determined in faith! That's just what the Goddess likes to see!
I hope you're having a wonderful day in or Goddess' name.
I-- I have to do it.
This could get a little dicey.

Free our wives from the clutches of those disgusting Orcs!

They really did it! Those dirty descendants of mangy otters have kidnapped our wives! We have one basic rule: kill an Orc, scalp him, burn down his house, burn his livestock and drink his beer supply. But! Never... NEVER mess with his wife!
I'm sure the assistant Shaman is behind this. He thinks he can impress us with his cheap tricks!
Go and kill the leader of the enemies! Free our women! You will be richly rewarded!

Take this plan of action to Senator Nimorean!

Okay then! My plan is as follows: We will approach the undead in a series of waves. We probably won't be able to destroy all the undead with the first one, but if we focus on starting from several sides at the same time, then we will be successful.
A plan of this magnitude needs the approval of the Council though, would you take this plan of action to Senator Nimorean? I will give the order to set out as soon as it is approved!
I always thought you were a fairytale, until today.
When I grow up, I will probably be even mightier than you!
It's too bad that you don't have any time to tell us a story.
My friends will never believe that I really saw you.
Do you ever have any time to play?
In this region, I must be prepared for enemies that inflict  fire damage.
I've slain enough cultists. Even the thickest farmer should be convinced now. So back to farmer Toby.

The future king is summoning me? I am ready!

The provisional King wants to see me? Oh how exciting, I wonder what he wants, perhaps he’s heard of my theories and wants to ask me about them! I really should finish this experiment, but we can’t keep the king waiting I suppose. Ok, I'm ready. Let´s go.
Let us go and pull some teeth from those Trolls! Little joke, you know? Oh well, forget it.
Come on, let's visit Aaron. He won't bite, as long as I am with you.
I assume you are not interested in a conversation?

Accompany me to Teardrop Hamlet!

Bodyguards, ha! Whenever you need them, they get sick on you! I just can't count on my bodyguard anymore. Apparently he's got "indigestion," what nonsense! He just drank too much. What now? I have a very important appointment in Teardrop Hamlet. I'm a member of the Coffin Maker's Association Palmwedel and Co. These days you don't dare leave the city without an escort! Would you escort me? We have to pick up someone along the way, and then we can travel to Teardrop Hamlet together.
Only a dry swamp is a good swamp
Show me what you've got, protector of the forest!
A Dryad... A man of my own taste! And I mean that literally!
Dryads... High Elves that happened to stumble upon a forest
What should I serve as a side dish with you? Maybe some sort of leafy green vegetable?
Ambul prepared the stone. Now we're going to the ruins together, so that the spirits of the mages can finish their ritual.
What do you mean Blackhammer is still alive? WHAT did he tell you? That’s a pack of lies, now die!
It's hard to believe we were once comrades, filthy Elf!
Could you tell me one reason to keep you alive?
Increases defense value and close combat attack values significantly.
Any Hero reaches the Deserts of Bengaresh and accepts a quest there.
In this place, we smile at each other when we meet.
Are you in a bad mood, or is it just your character?
Please don't talk to me, I don't trust you.
Hey, the damn forest is dying and I'm hanging out here doing nothing.
I've got the egg. Hope it won't break on the way to the next oasis.
This item I could only turn into money, at best ...
As I respect your advice, I'd like to ask you something else.
I almost forgot to ask, and that would have been tragic.
There's something else that bothers me.

Travel to the crystal planes!

Greetings! My name is Seraphim Failitia! You look like someone who won't turn away from a challenge. We seraphim are used to honing our body and mind in the hunt. Continuous training is the only way to keep up combat strength. And there is the sportswomanship to consider, too. The hunt is perfect for competing with others. However, it is dangerous in our hunting grounds! What do you say? Do you want to try?
Talk to the captain if you are ready!
Are you one of those muesli freaks? Ah, no, you're one of those tree-huggers ...
From the looks of your figure, you could just as well work in St. Pauli ...
You may keep your seedlings, Dryad ...
Well, Dryad ... if you're not poorly skilled, then I don't know who is ...
We don't need eco-activists like you!
I'm sure the simple folk in this village here need my help.
And how are you going to stop me, treehugger?

Keeper of the Temple
Go to Heaven for the climate, Hell for the company. - Mark Twain

I met a treasure hunter by the name of Gelminy. She is looking for an amulet that belonged to the legendary Elf King Brurag El Leigh, whose grave was recently discovered and desecrated. Now his stony guards are making the desert unsafe.
One of these guards was seen carrying a scroll and we need to get it from him.
I've found the herder, and there are the wolves!
I'll mop the floor with this one!
If they all had organ donor cards this carnage would make sense, but this?

What do you want?
We won't budge! Thisss placcce isss oursss!
OURSSSS!!
Isn't that a kick in the tree?
Don't you have berries to pick, Dryad?
The Golem! It is attacking the village! Kill it!
Connecting to wireless ad hoc network ...
I need a weapon to cause more physical damage.
I need better protection against physical damage.
So this is what a superstitious undead looks like. I expected something like this. I should hurry back to Amantha before he talks my ears off.
I'll bash in your skull Mage.
Our allegedly faithful children are getting cheaper! Perhaps we should collect the donations with the sword!
Why do we receive so much less donated gold? Wouldn't it be better to collect it by force?
Kuan will give us an extremely hard time, don't you think? The faithful are getting cheaper from day to day!
It says that Kuan's entitled to a tithe of every booty! What are we going to do with the ones who withhold it?
Our treasury is getting smaller. Is the cheapness of the believers that bad?
We'll be impoverished if the donations for Kuan's well being decrease any further. What are we going to do?
Maybe some people don't understand that the donations for the temple are their duty! I wonder how we can best clarify it?
I could just cry when I see these insufficient donations! Maybe we should guide Kuan's wrath to these misers!
Penny pinchers! The last donations were a disgrace! I'm going to do the next collection with my dagger in my hand!
How will we get by with the pathetic people scrimping this way? Something must be done!

Gravestone
Here rests a ... Uhm... Darkelf? Who is he when he's at home and where did Orpheus find him?

Did you say a cave? Hm... yes there was something! I heard of it in old tales. A few generations ago the Baron's family tried locking something evil up in the cave forever. Squire Tallin is probably the only one with the key to this cave.
Good the well has been poisoned, now back to Wargstriker quickly before the Orcs here notice anything.
Now there is only one dangerous creature here... ME!
Obviously, the village elder has a problem on his hands. I should go and talk to him.
Leave me alone and get lost!
I have to get out of here!
I have to be rescued! I am important!
My stomach feels strange. It's rumbling.
No, I only had what I always have - anything I can find.
Maybe you accidentally swallowed an Orc. They're hard to digest.
Ugh, no Orc. They reek of rot. Just some colourful mushrooms.
Red mushrooms with white spots? You're a fool. They're poisonous.
But they looked so tasty! Will I die now, brother?
No, only weak Humans die from this. Tomorrow you'll feel much better.
My plans don't allow any time for that.
A bit heavy, but I will be alright.
We will put you in your place, Inquisitor!
Convert and I will spare you!
You turn against us? Then die!
We know about your betrayal, Inquisitor.
A scroll? Written in the conjurer's blood? Let me see...
Thank you! This should help the lupan population to recover!
I am ready! Let's put an end to this!
I have picked up the stolen items.
You eco freaks are the same everywhere. You act the big shot at home, but when push comes to shove, you play possum.
Seraphim Mara is head gamekeeper and very serious about her duties. She warned me of a dangerous ice phoenix that makes trouble in the region. Sounds interesting!

Inscription
It is better to be hated for what you are than to be loved for what you are not.

- Gide

They left me alone in this world, completely at the mercy of even the lowest monster ... How thoughtless ... Maybe I should dispose of some things from the inventory ... Let's see how they'll like that ...
Senator Lilath was actually pretty happy when I gave him the bag and accepted the papers. Nityahel will be very pleased.

Assist with the conjuration and answer the question about the legacy once and for all.

Finally I found you! You have to help me, dear aunt. I think I'm going crazy.

You remember that your granduncle Namiel recently died? He was well-off and he left a piece of land, but his will didn't say who inherits it! Now they're fighting about his legacy.

We decided how to clear the matter up. We plan to conjure Namiel's ghost and ask him, but to do it we need three magicians from his bloodline present. Will you help us? Otherwise the fighting will never end.
I'm not saying anything wrong am I? When the Demon is dead we won't have to guard this head anymore, right?
You have accepted the invitation. Please exit the game and return to the title screen. The player accepting the invitation must then press "START" to proceed to the main menu.

Zizhar was very grateful and put on some lotion at once, all of a sudden he developed a passionate interest in the beliefs of the Cult of the Nameless. It's certainly a peculiar lotion, I’m sure the Inquisition would find it very helpful.
OK, so the capital it is!

Take me to my uncle at the branch office on the Human's side!

So it's you! It's your fault that my grandfather left me here! We were waiting for my grandmother, but when we received word that you were coming he just fled without me. Now I'm here all by myself!
At least, take me to the branch office on the Human's side. That's where my uncle lives.
I won't let myself get finished off by you!
Resurrects the souls of the fallen, reanimating their corpses to fight alongside the Shadow Warrior for as long as their dwindling life energy can sustain them.
I gave the medallion to a Guard. She thanked me for the valuable object.
Ha! That's a crystal! Perfect? Hmm ... well, I think it counts.
I have nothing against rats you know. Intelligent beasts they are. Have you done away with the dratted pest yet?
There seems to be a lot of olms here. Hopefully it’s nesting time, otherwise I won’t be able to find any eggs.

Find my buried treasure and rescue my daughter!

Look at me! My name is Clement. I am a man without honor, family or home. I was once a famous juggler, I even represented Griffinborough in juggling competitions! Then I was ruined by that unfortunate incident with DeMordrey... He offered me a fortune in gold if I let his juggler win a competition. In a moment of weakness I accepted his offer. It all came out and I was banished from Griffinborough.
Perhaps you could do me one small favor? My daughter lives with her aunt and I'm not allowed to have any contact with her. She is soon to be married, not for love, but because she has no possessions of her own. Many years ago I buried a big part of my fortune between the roots of a tree behind my house. I beg you! Dig up my fortune and give it to my daughter, so that she is not forced to enter into such a soulless marriage.
I don't care about your heroic deeds!
Well, what's this? Now that's cute!

Speak to Blackhammer, the leader of the freedom fighters.

Thank you, you saved our lives!
It’s not a pretty life down here, the only reason we’re alive at all is to feed the Dragon. Too few of us are lucky enough to escape, and join the freedom fighters led by Blackhammer. Talk to him if you want to know anything about the Dragon territory, he knows this area inside and out. You can find him in the maze.
Go on! Fight the evil! You didn't come here just for the fun of it, didn't you?
Courage in the flesh - I thank destiny that I was able to see you with my own two eyes.
Beautiful, brave, and strong. I hope you are still single.
Thank you for helping me! In return I shall give you all the coins I still have.

Collect herbs for me and take them to a witch!

I can't seem to lower my fever, stranger. If you don't help me, I fear I'm done for. Please collect a few of the herbs growing in the nearby mine, then take them to the herb woman in the village. She's the only one who can help me now!
You should've become a baker. It's less dangerous.
Don't bother me. I have to make sure that no more slaves escape. Come back when you have all the shackles.
This rabble knows no bounds! How can you kill a creature just for its trophy? May his body rot here to make the worms happy, it'll be a good lesson for the other one.

I will meet you in the capital

You claim my gratitude kind stranger, for you've saved my life. I deeply regret that I don't have time for extended conversation at the present time. Please meet me in the main borough, where I will be able to properly express my appreciation for your courageous deed.
Would you be interested in some Elf skin shoes? Lizard skin vests? Jackets made of Seraphim wings? Oh you don't look like you would be interested in buying something like that.
If you wait a little longer, maybe a meteor will come along and take care of everything.
I am honored by your request.
This quest is not yet playable
Run as long as you can.
No, I don't want to talk to you about my salvation.
The Cult of the Nameless? That's interesting. Do they have parties and things? With games?
The cult must have an extreme manpower shortage if it has to hire people to preach for them.

Gravestone
Good humor is the health of the soul, sadness is its poison.
- Lord Chesterfield
Do you belong to the faction that is constantly screaming for brains?
You have the nerve to attack your equals?

I met a crazy scientist. His name is Kragik and he wants to create Zombie Orcs and with their help conquer the world. I'm supposed to get him a few Orcs that he can conduct his research on.
The guy is crazier than a Seraphim in a modern dance class, but at least he knows what he wants. Well, I'll go get him some research material then ...
This won't be easy for you ...
Oooh, you sure know how to look grim ...
You and me, what a devilish team ...
The bad guys always smoke ... and smoking is hazardous to your health ...
Harun seemed to be pleased, very pleased in fact. He has regained his control over the coffin market in Badawi. His reward was very, very generous.
Honor the Dragon. His power and wisdom exceeds that of mortals.
Say your last prayers, warrior of God!
I'm curious if preparing the potion will work. Not because I care, but because Amantha still owes me a reward.
I'm thinking about importing new vegetables from overseas. What do you think about it?
I can't stand wine anymore. When will someone finally invent some ale?
My roses bloomed beautifully this year, would you like to see them?
I found a strange herb in brother Pentarion's garden. He seems to inhale it!
The Gods made every plant perfect. *whisper* But... aren't you interested in genetic engineering, too?
I thought about hiring foreign helpers to harvest the asparagus a lot faster. What is your opinion on this matter?
Next year I'll try to plant some vines too. Or do you think it's too risky?
I tried to plant coins to multiply them. Are you as interested as I am in the result?
My strawberries are so red and juicy *whisper* one might even think I'm in league with the Demons.
Once I brewed an interesting drink out of corn. Would you care to try it some time?
Well then, the gold belongs to me.

I met a Dragon Cultist today by the name of Jarofein. He told me an interesting tale about a group of insane cultists. They are like a horde of wild berserkers and attack anything they see. They have even become a danger to their comrades. They all have blue tongues! Waton, the leader of the cult, has ordered Jarofein to bring him five tongues, but the young cultist is too afraid and has asked me to fetch the tongues for him. As far as I know there's only one way to get a tongue.
Jarofein has given me his ring of honor so that the cultists will recognize me as one of their kind.

Kill my husband!

I hope you can help me. My husband is a horrible tyrant, a real monster of a man! A traveling mage once stayed with us for a few days and I asked him for help. He was supposed to teach my husband respect and manners by turning him into a dog for a little while. Unfortunately it went very wrong and my husband turned into a Minotaur instead. He fled but must still be close by because I hear him creeping around the house at night. Please find him and silence him, forever!
Hegiman couldn't bear his apprentice recognizing me as the true master which was why he challenged me to a duel. I let him live.
Milrinda's hunting rate was considerably higher than mine. I should talk to Seraphim Milrinda.
I think we can call this a victory for me.
I bid you good fortune, for you shall need it to attain your goal. Farewell.
We have to stay calm now...
That man looked important, you should not let him wait.
The rats are leaving the sinking ship.

Guardian of Souls
I was married by a judge. I should have asked for a jury.
- Groucho Marx
Wait, I'll put you out of your misery!
Ha! Just as I suspected! The novice was furious at his father’s reply. I guess he is ready to leave the past behind him now. Manipulation is such a satisfying game.
We will finish this fight another time!
I... I left something on the stove...
I'd better just leave! Some one will only wind up getting hurt!
Just as I thought. The “scientist” is a con man and only wants the merchant's gold. Well, I won't allow that.
An error eccoured when receiving data from the activation server. Please try again.
The Lich is dead, I can leave the dungeon again.
If we only knew where they came from! It's not possible that the Goddess sent them to punish us!
I believe they're a heavenly plague that is supposed to lead us back to the path of righteousness.
Their true selves remain hidden to us, but I suspect that they came here from another world.
I truly understand your fear, but we need time to find those who command them!
We Priests and all brave warriors are doing everything in our power to rid us of this evil, believe me!
If we only knew where these creatures originate from! That's really causing me great concern!
No matter which unholy place they came from, they were definitely not sent by the Goddess!
They are deadly and gruesome creatures and only faith and determination can stop them!
Many believe they are a test from the Goddess, but I suspect they come from another dimension!
We won't be able to defeat these evil creatures with traditional methods! But you're right, something has to be done about it.
The wife has her jewelry back. Her unfaithful husband had a lucky escape.

Inscription
Name Generator Bloopers: Energetic Energy Weapon of Energy

I've reached the forest Temple that's being besieged. Provost Julius has asked me to search for two young novices he sent out for reinforcements more than a week ago. Now he fears something might have happened to them. It wouldn't surprise me in this neighborhood.

Thank you! Your victory will finally prove to everyone that the rumors about me were fabricated. Take this necklace as a reward. It is an old family heirloom, but as a token of my gratitude for your courage it is almost insignificant.
Those villains are threatening to harm the hostages, so hurry up.
What a wonderful world this could be - without goblins!
The Master was grateful for my services. At least I think he was. Either way, he gave me a nice reward...
You - prove your strength in battle!
No one enters our territory and lives.
Don't stand around staring like a buffoon!
Do I have to do EVERYTHING myself?
There is probably no other way to repel the attack.
It should work. Without a leader, they'll be quite headless!
I gotta say, I really like the way you guys handle conflicts.
If I kill the leader I will save many other Orcs from death on both sides.
When I have a craving for mince meat, I go to the butcher...
What do you want here? Get lost, there's nothing to see!
You have learned that you must be merciful to reach your goal.
Now you know that you must treat others as yourself.
Listen only to your inner voice. Do not be distracted by others. Only you know the correct path.
If you want my advice: Do it yourself!
I don't think that would be good for me! I prefer to live alone and answer only to the ancestors.
Tempting! But I have to refuse.

The broker’s business partner... *breath* ... north of here, in the gambling den.

*cough* Thanks, although you *pained breath* might be too late. * breath* Chest wound *breath* might not stop bleeding. *cough* *choke* Broker’s pal in gambling den. * breath* North of here. * cough* Take this vial. *breath* Captures essence of defeated foe. *cough* No damn good to me now.
Jeraff Spirits and Beverages has been family owned and operated for five generations. You're impressed, aren't you?

The baron couldn't give me a permit because he's been dead a long time. What a strange situation!
I took his signet ring. Maybe that'll help me.
An amulet made of dragon scales...I see.
Everywhere I look, I see riff-raff. It's a sore sight for the eyes.
Oh, today is such a dull day.
I wonder if there is a potion against boredom?
Must this riff-raff always dress so horridly?
I don't like to brag, but living wastefully is such fun!
I love spending my gold on new clothing.
If there is one thing that gives me a headache, it's deciding what to do with all my gold.
I recently discovered the most delightful little cloth merchant!
All the uneducated masses can think about is food!

I caught the librarian drooling over a bunch of dirty etchings. Pathetic. He said an amulet made of Dragon heartscales is the only protection against a Dragon’s fiery breath. I’ll have to try and get one of those on my way to see the old Dragon.
What's this you're bringing me? A dangerous criminal? Yes leave this motherless tadpole here, we'll take care of him.
The commander sent you? Very good. I've been following the deserters' tracks and they can't be far. Just head in that direction. Once you have dealt with them, report back to the commander.
The young ones have to be introduced to the art of warfare much earlier. How else is their courage supposed to grow?

Kybele - Goddess of Nature

Kybele is the Goddess of nature, fertility and motherhood, flora and fauna. She is worshipped by people of all races all over Ancaria, especially by farmers, hunters and in small villages in the countryside.



Mythology

The mythology says that after the creation of the world, Kybele wandered through the empty and sparse lands, looking for life and a worthwhile, friendly place to be. Deeply saddened by the lack of life and the hostility of the place, she rested below a dead tree and began to cry. The tear dripping from her eye fell down to the earth, trickling into the soil. When she continued her journey, a bud grew from the dead tree. Before long, the desert turned into a green meadow. Since then, every tear lost by Kybele created life or fertile lands.
Therefore, she is also known as the “Crying Goddess” or the “Tear of Life” in some languages and dialects.

Appearance

Although Kybele has many different shapes, she is most commonly displayed as a feathered, snakelike being with a sad but friendly face. She can change the colour of her feathers at will, and often lets her feathers shine with iridescent lights.

The Cult

Followers and priests of Kybele have erected countless memorial shrines all over Ancaria, although many of them are difficult to recognize as one. The church of Kybele does not emphasize grandiosity. Instead, they prefer chasteness and humility, which is consequently reflected in all her shrines. Worldly possessions do not mean anything to Kybele, for the only real and most valuable treasure in the world is life.
The symbol of Kybele is a bead. All her priests wear a bead made of stone or wood as a pendant. It represents the life bringing tears of Kybele and the blessing of her sympathy.
Members of her cult will occasionally gather around the shrines for collective meditation or celebrations. It is not surprising that spring is commonly considered the time of the year dedicated to Kybele. When plants reach up toward the first beams of the warm spring sun, the followers of Kybele all over Ancaria bring all kinds of sacrifices to her, welcoming her back from her long absence and trying to convince her to stay for a while to restart the cycles of life.
The second high feast of Kybele is in late summer, when the fields are harvested and the grapes of the earth are stored for the upcoming winter. This time, they are celebrating their thankfulness and their hopes to see her again next year.

Opponents and Supporters

In the Ancarian Pantheon, Kybele supports Lumen, the God of Light in his eternal struggle against Ker. She is also opposed to Kuan, the God of War.

I want to be free like you when I grow up.
You're probably not afraid of the aristocrats.
Kill ten Trolls and bring me their teeth.

This is where we go our separate ways again for the time being, Shadow Warrior. I have to report back to my native land. Your path will undoubtedly take you into the desert. I hope we will meet there again.
Oh damn! I wasn't able to save the alchemist. Apparently this adventure is over now.
As badly as you fight, you may pass for a disguised High Elf.
Not being able to die can be a curse...
You'll have a tough time with me!
Well, have you fought yet today?
Your head will look great once it's shrunken!
This will be a good warm up exercise!
They say, that you're afraid of the dark...
I've already heard all the jokes there are about scales.
I'll rip off your thin skin!
Do you think that this is just a game?
A weak spirit in an even weaker shell!
I invented something really wonderful that will be very useful in the kitchen!
Please forgive me for not believing a single word! You're just trying to get the better of me.
No! Please believe me! My invention will change your life!
What did you invent anyway? A Goblin swatter would be really handy right now!
It's even better! It's a self sharpening blade! Isn't that fantastic?
Uh, no? That's not fantastic. My claws are sharp enough! I don't need your blade!
Why don't you just try it once?
Begone with you, fraud! Otherwise I'll use your neck to test how sharp my claws really are.
Evidently, the fisher has been murdered. I will take his dagger as proof back to his wife.
Yeah, just run. I'm still going to catch you.
Move it, I don't have forever!
As intriguing as you might be ... this is where your existence ends.
Carrot, snowballs, coal, scarf and hat. You're good! Now you can have the honor of finishing the snowman.  I've already started over there.
I will help you. And trust me: Gold is of no value to me.
...I was offered the worst trash! As if my customers were Humans!
The Dark Cult has been defeated! Somebody else will have to take care of its scattered followers.
Do you have sand in your boots too?
Oh look what we have here... My dinner!
You are blocking my sunlight, slave!
Scores of Du'Rach just showed up. I must destroy them!
I remember the place. I'm sure of it!

Bring three hands of inside cords!

Akebono ill. Inside hand cord broken and me have no more! Akebono angry when no inside hand cord. You bring me inside hand cords from tiny Orcsies... Goblinses. Need three hands of cords. Hurry you!
Is there a construction kit for you?
Several enemy soldiers are still lurking around the village. They're also ghosts, but they're still attacking the village. I have to destroy them.
I hope you'll keep your promise. For your OWN good!
A place where "magic flows from the ground"... that's very strange ...
Fine. You can stop trembling now.
I'm pleased to see that you have come to your senses.
Try being a good guy just for once. I guarantee you it won't hurt!
I heard the stupid Humans believe that there is a better life after death.
That's possible. Why do you mention it?
Because I don't understand why they don't want us to send them to their afterlife.
I don't think about them much. Mostly I just kill them. At least they seem to believe in something. Not like you!
Nonsense! We do believe in some things!
Really? What do you believe in?
We believe in life before death. And in well sharpened blades.
Very profound. But I should have expected that kind of answer.
We were watching you. You have stolen OUR eggs! Hand the eggs over or else!
Now we'll chop you up into small pieces, traitor!
Maggot carrier, now we'll do you in!
I'll have to speak with the horse trader - I need an old nag to transport my wood.
I have to chop up the logs for firewood.
I think I've been bitten by a tick!
The charcoal burner wants more wood.
Time for work! Time to chop down trees!
It gets easier once you get started.

Hey you! I saw you leaving the hut. I suspect you are carrying a letter for the young novice. I know the evil ways of that cult and how they try to drive a wedge between the novices and their families. Give me the letter.

Alcander's letter:

Captain, I thank you for your discretion. Please understand that my reputation is being targeted. It pains me to disown my own flesh and blood, but I have no choice. If it became known that I have a daughter, a daughter born out of wedlock, my many enemies would exploit this knowledge.

Take my daughter to safety. Please do everything in your power to help her. My purser will make sure you have enough gold to provide for all her needs. I wish you a safe journey. Thank you once again for your help.

Alcander
"The dryad was better" will be engraved in your gravestone.
How about an Orc? I'm sure it would qualify as a monster.
Any Hero has forged something into an item for the first time.
Your gamer profile has changed. The current game will be terminated.
We hear the stories of the great deeds done by our heroes long ago.
Betrayal! Here comes one of them!
Find someone else to do that.
This looks like a suitable place. I'm going to scatter the ashes now.
Some weasels want to take my money from me. Needless to say, they won't get a penny!

Fenrir, Plague of the North

Woe is me! A day without inspiration!
Only the noble-minded can understand true art!
My last work was called "Twisted Realities".
These days they even hang the most priceless works of art in public buildings!
The arts are the soul of our world.
Now don't get carried away, child of the Goddess! It's nice to hear that you are doing well.
Oh, I'm glad too. And I greet you in the name of the great Kybele!
You are truly one of our Goddess' children. It's a pleasure to run into you.
A child of our Goddess' taste. I wish you good day!
Kybele herself speaks through me and would like to send her regards!
It's nice to meet a devout creature in a time of unrest.
Kybele is with you! She told me so herself, faithful child.
The Goddess walks with me! You most certainly have our best wishes.
Kybele sent me, and I'm happy that we ran into each other.
It is Kybele's will that we meet each other on this wonderful day.
So, you don't want to die. Then I will make sure that for the time being, you can't afford that luxury!
Dryad Priestess Tily Fihl needs five thread rush for a ritual in honor of the Goddess Ker. I've been asked to collect them.
And another one because it was so much fun!
I require better protection against magic-based damage.
Hopefully the robbers will not smell so bad.
I have brought Romdreal and Judriel together.
You're all next in line to die!
Praying to Forens leads to happiness.
If I may carry something for you, please say so!
I have the amulet! I'm anxious to hear what Lupus has to say about it.
Significantly increases the defense value while using shields. Additionally grants a chance to block close combat attacks. Grants the ability to use higher-level shields.

Right then. Now we’re better organized than we are letting on, but there’s more problems than people to throw at them. Top of my list are the Orc territories. Clans there are always at feud with each other, which is just as well because it keeps them from attacking the rest of us. The problem is the Ore-Thag Clan. Nasty lot, they are, and they seem to be getting the upper hand. It’d be bad for everyone if they did, so I sent an expedition to the Grurag Clan to offer our help. Never came back. We’ve got to try again, though, so it’s up to you. It’ll probably be easier if you follow the expedition’s trail, so go to the Elven wall. We’ve got a secret tunnel that they used to enter the Human territory.

Take this bag of worms to my brother!

Hey you! Are you traveling to Sloeford? If you are, perhaps you could do me a small favor? This bag full of worms here is for my brother. He is a very keen fisherman. Fish just love the worms from around here, or at least that’s what he says. So I’ve collected a bag of worms for him. The nice big... well, you know... anyway, I need someone who can deliver the worms to him. Could you take care of that for me? You’ll find him at the fishing pond in Sloeford.
The Lizardman seems to be terribly distressed about the death of his friends. He has decided to end his life in battle. Well, you know what they say: Never stop a man on a mission.
Can't you see that I'm your fate?
I can't give you gold, I haven't got any! We don't capture enough for everyone.
You want another donation for Kuan? I just gave you half an ox!
Your greed for donations seems to be endless! Why are you that greedy?
Kuan is indeed a greedy God! Do I really have to pull out my purse again?
I can't give you anything! My purse is empty! I hope Kuan doesn't think I'm greedy.
If you are going to ask me for another donation I have to say NO! There's nothing more I can give you.
Before you ask me for another donation you should know that my family eats me out of house and home, you can understand that right?
It's not that I'm unwilling to give Kuan what he deserves, but my bags are as empty as the head of my wife.
Please don't ask me to give you gold again! Just last year I gave Kuan a part of my booty.
If you're going to demand more gold for your shaman you should reconsider. I have nothing more for you than bare steel, and Kuan likes blood!

Collect five tooth leaves.

We're planning a service in honor of Forens, but I've run out of a few ingredients. Would you help me and collect five tooth leaves? I would collect them myself, but I'm needed here. Would you help us?
One of the surviving soldiers will come with me. It seems he's still wet behind the ears so I should keep an eye on him.
