Isn't it a special honor to be allowed to serve the country?

Take me to the abandoned library!

Farek has asked me to come with you. He's been obsessing about this book for quite a while now and keeps talking about it. Unfortunately no known copies of this book remain. Not far from here lies an abandoned monastery and library. Maybe we'll find a copy there. Are you coming?

Wine? Of course I can give you wine. After all, I am a wine merchant.

The really good wine is in the cellar though, and we have a little problem with vermin. I'll tell you what, get rid of the vermin and you can have two of my best barrels of red wine!
Are you on your way to initiate the new hunters?
Indeed, I am. This important ritual is one of my tasks.
Have you already met the chosen ones, father?
Of course not. Only the elders may choose new hunters.
I know, I was just curious about who was chosen.
Why? What interest do you have in the hunter initiates?
Well, I have a daughter who's old enough to marry, and I thought that maybe she could find a handsome young man among the new hunters. Could you keep an eye out for... you know.
No, I don't know. I'm on my way to a consecration, not a wedding market.
Someone told me that you have been hiding the enemy.
You can't be serious! I would never do such a thing!
That's what you say. But I heard that you provided lodgings for an entire band of Orcs, in exchange for a handful of coins.
That was a misunderstanding! It was dark, and I mistook them for my brothers-in-law.
Go on, keep talking! I'll inspect your house very carefully, and if I find anything suspicious - you'll pay for it!
My conscience is as clean as my hut.
I've nothing to hide. See for yourself!

The magic that runs through my veins is not from this world. I am one of the chosen - one of those who are granted the right to study the magic of the dragons. Only the best will earn the right to learn the most secret mysteries of these creatures and rightfully call themselves Dragon Mage! This is my goal. And I will give my everything for it.
You were able to destroy five ghosts? Well done! Lumen will be pleased.
An Orc woman told me about an ice elemental, which seems to be quite dangerous. That sounds interesting.

Take me to my home!

This area isn’t what it used to be, in the old days you could wander about in the swamps without being attacked by anything or anyone. It’s different nowadays. I’m here to collect a few ingredients for my delicious muck soup. It’s only a few hours walk from home and I’ve already been attacked by swamp mudpuppies three times! Those horrid little beasts! It’s just too dangerous out here! Could you escort me home? I will give you three magic potions in return.

You can open the trade window at any time to access the available wares.
If you want to trade with another player, you must initiate player trade and place your item in the lower window.

Your trade partner will place the items that he is offering in the upper window.
If you agree to the trade confirm by clicking the appropriate button.

As soon as both trading partners confirmed their trade, the contents of the respective windows will be exchanged (your offer will be in their window and vice versa). Goods that have not been placed in the inventory before the trade window is closed will fall onto the ground.
Amethyst and Ruby, Emerald and Diamond - buy your jewels at Finebond. Mhm... I might have more work to do on the meter here...
Well, it is a pity. But you can set your mind at rest: nobody will remember you.

I didn't mean that personally, honestly.

I hope all I drop for you is junk!

That disgusting little toad! He'll pay for this.
That rat! But I'm sure our paths will cross again.
That scoundrel has taken me for a ride. Wait until I get my hands on him ...!
The guy took me for a ride. For that, I'll pay him another visit.
If he ever crosses my path again, he'll wish he'd never been born.
A very cold Kobold pinched some coal. I'm supposed to get him some firewood in exchange for the coal.

Go and visit my husband. He will reward you for your noble deed.

Oh, thank you so much. I am so very glad that your journey has led you here and I will always remember you as a hero. Visit the winery on the outskirts of the village where my husband and I live and he will reward you with everything that we can spare. We will remain here as I have to recover from this shock first.
The ravages of time have left their mark on some of my wares.
I informed the commander and will now go on with my journey.
By the gods! What kind of thing ARE you?
You all take guilty pleasure in the existence of Crazy Frog!
A few troublemakers attacked me near the weaver's cave, but I managed to get rid of them.
I would rather walk than ride that.
Bringt dem Ewald seinen Dolch zurück.
I have collected all the gold. Now I am supposed to deliver it.

A rich nobleman has asked me to escort him to the Baron's estate in order to cash in a note of hand.
He is rich and the Baron owes him money. The nobleman carries a note of hand and we have a long journey ahead of us that will lead us through deserted lands where you do not see a living soul for hours.
I am sure that there will be plenty of opportunities for me to make some money.
You’re back! It’s good to see you again! I’m sure you’ll be glad to tell me why you have drawn your weapon and what that determined look on your face means... WHAT? ARGH!
I won! I won! I guess I'll use the magic bean!
Monsters only have one purpose, so give me the XP!
Whatever keeps you afloat, I will destroy it!
There'll be an end to your magic soon!
They say you're a coward, magician!
An Elven woman wants to take me on?
I'll feed you to the Trolls this very day!
Let's go! Let's show the fog what we're made of.

Follow the weapons dealer!

Good that's done. Now follow the weapons dealer and see where he goes. But be careful - don't arouse his suspicion!
Finally, we got one of them down!
That's how it goes when you underestimate your opponents ...
We've been enslaved long enough, now we'll turn the tables!
This is an ambush! Kybele, stand by us!
Attention. Target area within sensor range.
Not far from here you can inspect a coffin.
My employer was thrilled by the prospect of new, fresh swampfish. I also received a nice reward from him.

That was a close call, but they are alright.
My paints are made from natural minerals.
I would love to paint the cover of the new prayer book for the Priest.
I like the idea of using a pseudonym.
Wood carvings make me feel positively rapturous!
"The Forest Spirits" is such an impressive painting.
Thank you for your hospitality. I'm sure you will rule the land with wisdom and goodness.
Now the soldier can return to his fellow tribesmen with his honor saved.
Thank you very much for your support! It's not easy around here when you're just starting out as a mage.
Oh, you look really bad today!
How many bad deeds did you do today?
We could really use your sinister mind, your evilness!
Let's see what else Wendelin has to say.

They came for Fangor! There were three of them, and they took him! My poor Fangor! I followed them and tried to save him, but they threw him into the river with a stone tied to his feet! What will happen now?

Not surprisingly, the winner is the selector.

We hope that the Lizardman's fighting abilities will make for a more exciting fight. The next fight is against the frightful hydra charming and father killing Lizardman! Get in the arena you giant salamander!
Say hello to the Gods for me, angel!
What did you ever do for the poor?
Winged creatures are not welcome here!
My family is in your debt. You have returned this cretinous, ahem, delightful child to our clutch. May the Gods be kind to you!
I'll give you the bluescreen of your life!
I need better protection against damage caused by ice.
Water! Please do you have some water for me? I've had nothing to drink for two days, my supply is gone.
Hilmi was right. I had to slay 10 kodiaks before the leader showed up. And he's a big fella!

Execute the traitor's clan and bring him back!

There is a traitor among us. A young Acolyte repaid us for taking him into our midst with treachery! He wrote to his clan that he would rather return to them. We were able to intercept the letter, but now the doomed one has fled. Bring him here and let his entire clan pay for his crimes!
May Lumen’s light shine on your way!
A vase that you can inspect is nearby.

We won the fight, the Elves gave up. Kirich fled and the Elves who are still here promised to manage the business house differently.
I'll try to find Kirich now.
Where do all these Goblins come from?
Don't question your faith! We promise your paradise - even in writing!
Just relax and follow the right path. Then you will see a light.
Of course things will be more colorful and bright in paradise. You only have to believe.
Your pointless doubts are keeping you from the path toward a better life.  A life where the Gods will care for you.
How can you doubt the holy words? Everyone knows that there's a tavern in heaven.
Be patient and faithful. Then our just Gods will show you a glorious path.
Your problem is a lack of faith. Every child knows that justice awaits us.
You really doubt that there's a heaven? Don't worry, salvation awaits you.
Don't waver and doubt, child. The great halls of the Gods will house us until the end of time.
Only the faithful will witness the miracles of the Gods. I can't tell you anything else, it's up to you.
I gained Drogan's respect, and he is going to tell the Master Hunter of my deeds. He is the best hunter in the entire clan and he can be found in the capital city of Ore Thag Orcs.
Hurry... I feel ... I feel dizzy.

A squad of High Elf soldiers asked me to assist them in their fight against the Kobolds. The little monsters have lain siege to the tower, in which the commander of the Elves and a handful of his men are trapped.
Way to go! Good women are always sought after.
A heroine with character! Well - get back to work!
Ah, it's you! Please keep an eye on the thieves; they tend to spread out everywhere.
A fountain is nearby. Perhaps a potion is hidden in there.
Even though it doesn't really affect me, did you hear the newest whispers?
What's new in our noble community? Please tell me, I leave the house much too rarely.
There's a lot of whispering lately. Do you have something to say too?
Well then, you'll have some interesting tales to tell too? I'd love to hear them.
You know I don't like to gossip, but we have to stay informed after all.  Are there any interesting things you can tell me?
It's been quite lonely lately, and so little ever reaches my ears. What's the newest talk in town?
We haven't invented them yet, so the newspapers don't bring any news. What's being whispered on the streets?
Am I right to assume that there's a lot of talk these days? Do you know any details?
Rumor and gossip are evil sisters, but I really would like to hear your news!
What news is talk of the town at the moment? Speak freely if you've heard any news!
If only we had those peas...
The other day someone came here looking for a tree-climbing horse! He obviously can't hold his mead, that...
Joseffa won't like this. The soldier's dead, but he's holding a farewell letter and a ring in his stiff fingers.
I will show you what kind of a warrior's heart my chest harbours! Take a close look, you may learn a thing or two.
I won! Yahh! So much water! It's really true!
I want to see blood, lots of blood!
All people improve the gene pool, some by birth, some by their demise.
Do chickens think rubber humans are funny?
Do Roman paramedics refer to IV's as "4s"?
Do poker playing dogs own paintings of Humans playing "fetch"?
Is it legal to run into a crowded fire and yell "Theater!"?
A bend in the road is not the end of the road ... unless you fail to make the turn.
A day without sunshine is like, well, you know, night.
If life had to be unfair, why couldn't it have been unfair in my favor?
She was only a moonshiner, but I loved her still!
Old kings never die; they just get throne away.
The world's full of apathy, but I don't care.
I'm still not sure if I understand ambiguity.
If a parsley farmer is sued, could they garnish his wages?
Never try to out-stubborn a cat.
Two silkworms were in a race. They ended up in a tie.
Egotist: One who is me-deep in conversation.

Is it possible to have too much moderation?
If you stand on a fence in the middle of a field, which side is greener?
Does the name Pavlov ring a bell?
I could still use some trophies ...
Go! Leave me alone with my pain!
Then I will be the first one to succeed!
Don't let any of them get away!
Show them what we're made of!
Forward! We will destroy them all!
I'm not going to sit on it just yet. My spurs aren't big enough.
Did your mum never teach you to be kind to strangers?
Get out of my sight, village idiot!
Do not get on my nerves you walking waste of oxygen.
Die? Me? You mortal fools don't really know what you want, do you?
Who are you and what do you want from me?

The lu ... lu ... lupan took me by sur...p...rise
Aah, power is a great thing to have...
The child's father has handed me a small reward for saving his daughter.
In the mornings when I'm cold I like to get warm near the holy stones, you know?
It's sometimes hard to get the scales warm. Don't you agree?
Sometimes I envy the Humans their skin. It would be easier to get warm, right?
I don't consider my scales a curse, but heat exchange is kind of difficult.
The scales protect us, but I'm often quite cold. How about you?
How do you keep a body that would be better suited for a reptile warm?
I'm so cold lately! How do you get rid of this inner cold?
Sometimes I think we're closer to reptiles than Humans. Do you also suffer from the cold all the time?
How do you heat a body that's covered with these inconvenient scales? Can you tell me that?
We are a glorious species, but those ice cold claw feet can really ruin one's day.
Turol and the zombies were pleased. The danger to the village has been averted for now.
All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.
O Ruler, may I kill you?
You dare to come here, Elf?
I thank you for the demonstration of true art, master of the fight!
Haven't they taught you not to hit women?
I see ... So Mr. Giles is the one I should NOT talk to. Understood.
I understand. I will not, UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES, speak to Mr. Giles.
So .. DON'T turn to Mr. Giles. OK, then I WON'T do that.
Mister Giles?! How interesting. Don't you worry, I will never go see him. Absolutely not. I swear.
You got it, lady. Thanks for the warning.
My desire to kill is growing...
Sparkling refreshments are all I will drink.
I am seldom alone in times of peace.
Simply delightful - a noble drop, indeed!
He offered me beer - as if I were a Human!
I am sure to get some pleasant company when the watch has changed.
Are you the leader of this miserable band?
We'll continue practising to aim, alright?
I will not take this enemy down with just a wave of my hand.
When I'm done with you, I'll go after your family...
The attack is over. Lathor survived and is going the rest of the way on his own. I should go to Badawi and tell Commander El'Duffi that Harun was behind the attack.
Oh look, it's one of Santa's little helpers!
This is where you get off, Elf!
It's time for you to perform your last magic trick, Elf!
Nice ears. Do you like carrots too?
Mages! I didn't like them when I was alive either!
Kodiak live in the forest and in the hills.
I meant to ask if you feel safe under our protection.
There is no reason for me to complain, I've always felt safe enough.
I'm glad to hear you say that. I was afraid the little mishap might have rattled you.
Mishap? I don't know what you're talking about.
Last night, two guards attacked each other by mistake and almost killed themselves.
Well, they each thought the other was an Orc poacher.
Maybe you should have your senses examined on a regular basis. I have to go!
The gods? I highly doubt that they are hanging out at the other side of the wall.
Ha! My leg! It doesn't tingle anymore! So you destroyed the focus points. Well done. And you won't leave empty handed. Here, take this.

Orcish Cooking

At first glance, Orcish cooking seems pretty plain and simple. There are not exactly many detailed and elaborated recipes to be found in the Orc cuisine. Maybe this is one of the reasons why Orcish food has become increasingly popular in the civilized areas of Ancaria during recent years. People are fed up with sophisticated, strange dishes and they want to experience the taste of nature and wilderness. Back to the roots! Or should we say: Back to the meat?

In every bigger town, there is at least one Orcish restaurant these days. More and more people seem to enjoy the unusual and exotic taste of Orcish food in combination with real event gastronomy like bar-room brawls, eating with hand and scimitar and beating up the cook after the meal. Of course, the food in those restaurants is slightly tweaked and adjusted to civilized standards. Orcs are occasionally eating things that many people would consider inedible. Many of them do not even have a name in our language, some not even in Orcish. This book has been written to give you an overview of the Orcish way of cooking and we would like to make you curious about this very special kind of food.

There are a few basic principles for Orcish cooking. The grand Orcish chef Gkratulak once described the philosophy of Orcish cooking in his (admittedly rather short) book “Orc Food for Every Day” (3. Ed.)

“Kill living being and cook it.”

Note, that in the Orcish language, there is no specific word for cooking. The corresponding word “hthak” describes the general process of preparing food. The condition of the food when it is being eaten does not really matter, neither does the type of animal. Also, the removal of skin, fur, feathers or scales is optional.
Although the above quote is - in the true charm of the Orcish tongue - a little short-spoken, the principle still holds true: Orcish cookery requires meat. Lots of meat! The more the better. There simply is no Orcish dish without meat. Or the other way round: it is not easy to find something in an Orcish dish that's NOT meat. There is an Orcish saying. They say: Karukh nah erak. Karuki toptzak an erak. (translation: If it doesn't move, eat it. If it moves, hit it. Then eat it. )

When it comes to beverages, the Orcish cuisine is even more straightforward. Orcs are drinking beer or - if they are too young for beer (1-3 years) - water. After a good feast however, they sometimes enjoy a liquor called "Chuke", but the recipe for this drink seems to be a secret and it is generally considered venomous for non-Orcish beings.

Now, without any further ado, here is a typical three course Orcish dinner for your cooking pleasure. The following recipes are all taken from Gkratulaks famous book. As most of them are usually quite simple, we decided to make adjusted versions for each dish. You will find the adjusted version for refined palates below the original recipe.


Starter: Long-eared fast-thing

Original: Kill long-eared fast-thing and cook it.

Adjusted:
1 rabbit, cut into pieces
1 onion
2 ¼ cup flour
salt
pepper
cooking oil

Brown onions in cooking oil. Dredge rabbit pieces in flour, salt and pepper. Put oil, onions and rabbit pieces into a frying pan and cook until the rabbit pieces are browned on all sides. Take out the meat and make a sauce from the oil and onions by sprinkling in flour. When the gravy is brown, add some water and return the rabbit meat into the mixture. Cook until sauce thickens.


Main course: Bristly Grunting Thing

Original: Kill bristly grunting thing. Remove teeth. Cook it.

Adjusted:
1 wild boar
50 onion
10 garlic
20 l beer

Remove the boar hide and let the boar bleed dry. Open it and remove all guts and organs. Fill with onions and garlic. Place on a spit and over a fire. Spin around for 9 -10 hours. Baste with beer frequently during the roasting process.
The wild boar is ready when the eyeballs begin to drop out.


Dessert: Cackling thing

Original: Kill cackling thing. Remove beak and feet. Cook it.

Adjusted:
1 chicken
1/4 cup sugar
1/2 cup honey
1/2 cup mace
1/2 teaspoon cloves
1/2 ginger
1/4 cup almonds

Pluck the chicken and remove all guts, head, feet and organs. Put honey, mace and sugar into a bowl and stir well. Apply the mixture to the chicken. Put the chicken into the oven and leave to roast until the skin is gold/brown.

Book 2

Testa - God of Science

Testa is the God of science. He is the God who defines the rules that govern how things work. His is the spirit that animates mechanical things and causes machines to operate.



Mythology

Being the God of science, Testa works hand in hand with Forens, the Goddess of philosophy and wisdom. However, while Forens is focusing on the aspect of “the word”, Testa is responsible for technical and mechanical knowledge. From the simplest laws of physics, to complex machinery, Testa is the spirit and the force behind it. Testa always follows a clear path of cause and effect. All events are triggered by other events and can be backtracked. That's the decisive difference from the rather elusive and obscured answers to the questions of philosophy.
The theological descent teaches us that shortly after the creation of the world, Testa himself built a huge machine, which is now known as “the great machine,” and animated it. Then, he created replicas of himself to maintain the machine. Replicas, which are in fact partly machines themselves.

Appearance

Testa is commonly displayed as a dog head made of steel on a mechanical apparatus in the shape of a human body. His ribcage is open and one can see the complex machinery with gears, bolts and pipes inside.

The Cult

Since every culture has at least some form of Science, Testa can claim temples and followers in virtually all regions of Ancaria. However, it is obvious that his influence is stronger in the more industrialized regions of the world.
Reflecting his focus, the science, many of the followers of Testa are intellectuals, or at least educated people. Many people consider Testa as both, a God, but also an inspiration. They are not just worshipping him, they are trying to emulate his spirit and let themselves be guided by his ideas.
Testa's symbol is the gear wheel, representing one of the heart pieces of mechanical animation. This symbol is displayed in all his temples and memorial shrines and it's considered the perfect shape amongst the believers of Testa.

Opponents and Supporters

Testa is closely related to Forens, the Goddess of Philosophy and wisdom. Otherwise he takes a neutral position in the Ancarian pantheon, especially in regards to Ker and Lumen's battle.

There was only a boy left at the camp. He told me that other thugs came, and that this time they took the women and children. He avoided they kidnappers by hiding. Looks like I need to pay the mine owner a visit.
I know it doesn't smell nice down there. But someone has to get rid of them.
That accursed ring! Finally, I see it again after all this time. My misery started with this ring.
There’s no sign of that spy here.
Look! Strange footprints! But the spy seems to have moved on.
What was that rustling sound in those bushes? It must be the spy!
The first fight is starting. My opponent is an inexperienced Human from the north.
Where am I going to find Shirka?
Well the Goddess knows who she chooses as the Oracle. Even though you have to shake your head a little from time to time.
Lately I've been avoiding the Oracle a little. He speaks in tongues sometimes and that really confuses me.
Hmm...It was Kybele's choice, and we have to accept the Oracle even if some of his sayings seem to be terribly hackneyed.
The Oracle seems to like adages about nature. He advised me to be fruitful and multiply! Well, what can I say?
Well, that's the Oracle for you. He is supposedly Godly like Kybele, but his sayings sometimes seem really pathetic!
Lately I get the feeling that the Oracle likes to give advice that makes him look good!
The last time I got a bran cookie with a note in it! The cookie and the prophesy were both unpalatable however!
Yes I do think that Kybele chooses her Oracles carefully. But the new one constantly misspeaks and isn't very nice!
I get by just fine without this Oracle, you know what I mean? A lot of what he says seems a little stale to me.
The Goddess' Oracle - a familiar topic, but I have to wonder about the person currently occupying the position! Odd.
I found the mother. She was standing at the entrance to a cave that probably serves as the cult's hiding place.
The scholar gave me the map as promised. Well now let's see where it takes me.
Man, you are ugly! Have you considered case modding?

My fight against the cultists seems to have been pretty impressive. Farmer Toby is willing to reconsider his silent membership in the cult. He will even join the fight against the cult, if I mange to slay twenty cultists.
Ah, here comes Ancaria's master magician!
You're in for a beating now, Elf!
You'll make us quite a bit of money at the slave market, Elf!
The Great Maker has left. But he'll be back. He'll definitively be back some day ... for sure ... I hope ...
No'Delski is never around when you need him.
This is it, we're in Eloeth-Sun!
Player, this is a divine mission, so continue! Or could it be that you're questioning either the Gods or the mission?

Waton and I have reached Ophtanar. He is surrounded by bodyguards and believes that he is safe from us. He has even admitted that it was his idea to distract the cultists with the dreamberries while he and Dundiel escaped with the cult's treasure. What a despicable villain! But his time will come, NOW!

Have Kratos analyze the scroll!

He had a scroll with him? Let me see...

Hm! This does not bode well. We have to analyze the scroll as soon as possible. Who knows what this Unholy Crusade has up its sleeve. Go to Kratos. He is one of the best demonologists in the land. Take him the scroll so he can decipher it.

Greetings!
We don't see many strangers around here nowadays. Ah Maweran sent you! Is that old guy still sitting at the creek bathing his worms? He's probably told you everything already, the ghosts and Thraconians forced us to create a militia. This post here guards the entrance to Crag Rock Valley, the place we plan to retreat to. Unfortunately the valley is no longer safe.
Thank you for your help, you selfless soul! Now I can finally rest in peace.
Alright, you know what to do. Your first destination lies to the east. A little fort with real soldiers. The rest is written on this note here. Have fun!
The leader of the smugglers has already gone off to unleash the medallion's powers. We have to get to the statue as soon as possible.

I know the way to the desert but we have to get past the Swirling Mist of Miasma first.

Hi ho! I'm Lieraz. I watched you fight the Lizardmen and your skill is amazing! I want to leave the cult and head south seeking adventure, do you mind if I join with you for a while? I'd love to learn from you, and I could teach you things too. For example, did you know that before you can get to the jungle you'll need to cross the desert? I know the way! To get there we'll have to fight our way past the Swirling Mist of Miasma.

Another Dragon lives east from here. Go and try your luck there.

Woohoo, was he annoyed! I've never seen him in such a grumpy mood, and obviously never will again.
Sorry hun, hope you don't think this was a trap just to try to get you killed. At least you got your heartscale. There's a more trustworthy Dragon east of here, who needs a similar service. He's a friend of the old Dragon, so if you help him out, there's a good chance he'll send you to the big one.
I found a Kobold encampment. They had captured the old lady and wanted to fatten her up before roasting her for dinner. Thank the Gods I found her in time!
A Kybele priest at the Rock Temple has asked me to fetch oblations for the goddess. She needs clean water and a harpy egg. Then the priest will bless me.
I am prepared to furnish proof of my abilities.

Get me 15 small and 25 large crystals!

I lost everything. Everything!
”Risk something,” my business partner told me. “Explore new markets,” he said. “There is potential in the Seraphim,” were his words! And look at me now! Cart broken down, goods gone, and I am freezing my butt off standing here. Fantastic!
If I at least had some building material, I could erect a small hut and open shop. But building material is scarce around here. Unless ... I build a crystal hut! I will offer you a deal: you will bring me 25 large and 15 small crystals, and after I opened my shop, you will get a special discount! Well? What do you say?
Devastating attack with the equipped ranged or close combat weapon.
A letter from my parents, addressed to the DeElfici family's branch office. I should take it there, it's not far from here.

You've done well. I heard it wasn't easy, but justice prevailed at last. I can't give you much, but maybe this will help you. Lumen's blessings.

You should also know that the council has ordered a highly skilled agent named Thylius to look into the gladiator trade and the racketeering behind the arena in Badawi.
The village doctor believes me. Now no one suspects Keltar of killing his brother.
I should help the shepherd Gildor to drive away the wolves.
And that's how it all ends...
Why are you stomping around here like a mad bull?
Go look for some other playmates - we don't want you around!
Those are dangerous enemies... maybe too dangerous.
This attack will be thwarted too.
At least TRY to fight back, human!
For all those years, a horde of Dragons lived down there. It seems like peace didn't really work out.
Amantha wants me to find a superstitious mage. He could be anywhere. I wonder how I could recognize him.
Hello, I am Doris, 54 years young, and full of life. I'm looking for a husband. Would you like to be my chosen one?
So you're that great hero in shining armor...
You're not even close to being mighty enough...
My wet washcloth has more backbone than you!
I'm not interested in your good deeds!

I have an ancient and very secret recipe. Bat brain lotion can work miracles in cases like this, and it doesn’t have any side effects either!
You can’t use just any old brains, you have to use the brains of a particular type of bat. Bring me some brains from the bats that live near the big tree.
This creature will certainly throw me, I have to practise first.
So you're one of those idiots who give their money to the poor?
Pirate law says you have to die.
Hey you, pure soul. Help me out and kill yourself, okay?
Heroes... there's one born every minute.

Hmm ... just a heap of skin and hair? That's all? Weird. It reminds me of an old story. It tells about creatures that can assume the form of others. It sounds mad, but that's what it said. If a creature like that was around ... that would be horrible! You must find out more! But be careful! A creature like that can change into anything it saw and killed.

Deputy Leader Wargstriker assigned me the task of poisoning the neighboring enemy Orc's village well. This will decimate the population of the neighboring Orcs and sooner or later they will be so weak that the Ore-Thag Orcs will win the war. If his plan works then I'll eat a Dryad's long bow. Crosswise.

Recover my past!

Greetings, living being!
I don't know for how long I've been dead. Did someone tell you how long it has been? They always tell me they don't remember anymore. And I actually believe them. After all, I can't remember it myself, either. I remember nothing. I don't miss eating, drinking, feeling and loving. I also forgot what I did before I became what I am now. But I would like to know. Would you look for signs and clues that might tell anything about my past existence?
Let us now waste any time!
I must be damn careful or this region will be the death of me.
%1 is still reserved for another player.
My storage space is at capacity.

Find out, if Retga was really killed by his brother!

Murder? Well, a letter like this is not enough evidence on its own. Retga was in agony when he wrote it. Maybe his mind was already clouded. Why don't you visit his brother Keltar? Who knows, maybe you'll find some more evidence there.

Ask the other alchemist for some advice!

By all the eternal swamp gases! I just hate that darned alchemist! He used to conduct experiments that were useful, but these days...
Now you say he's turned himself into a mental amoeba?! Fantastic! Brilliant!
Go to the other alchemist and tell him what happened. Maybe he’ll know what to do.
The thief Figmiyen is awaiting my return.
My fingers! If only they would give me a thimble!
There's not a job easy enough that I couldn't mess it up!
I sit here in my rags and sew the finest garments.
A stitch in time saves nine!
This thread just doesn't want to go through the needle's eye.

A traveler has asked me for help. Muggers attacked him and stole his luggage, he barely escaped with his life. The thieves have taken all his equipment and money. Worst of all, they stole his father’s sword, shield and breastplate. These items are family heirlooms and he promised at his father’s deathbed that he would carry them with pride. He offered me a magic ring if I could retrieve these items for him. There is no way that I could deny his request.
That tingling feeling? That's my blade.

The Grand Inquisitor explained the situation in the Orc region.

Several Orc clans are at feud with each other, and lately the Ore-Thag-Clan has gained the upper hand. He told me to find the leader of that clan and offer to help him win. In return, once the Orcs are unified, the Grand Inquisitor will call upon the support of the Ore-Thag Clan in our battles to come.

He also told me something about a lost Elven delegation. He wants me to find them, and learn what they know about magic leaks in the Orc regions.
Nityahel sent me to bribe Senator Lilath. I was told that for a bag of white powder, he will issue the papers necessary for the gladiators to legally fight in the arena.
It's said that ghosts haunt the mine. I've been asked to clear the tunnels of this menace so that the laborers can go back to work.
The apprentice was very impressed. He said he has never seen such fighting skills, not even from his master.
You are about to die a hero's death.
She stopped going out because she was afraid of what might happen, so she stayed at home and died of boredom.
So my idea of a dragon-flamed burger restaurant didn't work out. What are you, perfect?
Don't make fun of dragons, you aren't big, you aren't clever & you most certainly aren't flame-proof.
Don't ask for whom the bell tolled, it tolled for me.
This was rather harsh for a speeding ticket.
"What's the worst that could happen" he asked.
I wish I'd checked the wind direction before the 'bigger they are, the harder they fall' challenge.
Hal - gutted by his own razor sharp wit.
Sorry, Ma, how was I to know "step on a crack, break your mother's back" would lead to this?
This tomb previously raided by L. Croft.
There's nothing here but a weathered fedora hat, looks like that Jones fellow beat you again.
Poor Nero, he was done in by a Wolfe.
How did you ever pass the admission test?

Now Seraphim Lutetia wants a trophy made from perfect crystal. For the contest I won for her! Pretty audacious. Whatever. There are more crystal monsters here than there is sand in the Bengaresh Desert.

Slay five giant spiders!

Those spiders were no match for you. The next task is a little bit more difficult. Kill five giant spiders! If you manage that there will be a surprise waiting for you!
Do not give me any dents!
I require better protection against physical damage.
I'm supposed to bring you back in, Warrior!
Next time we'll pay more attention, Warrior!
The reward was very acceptable. I am pleased, definitely more pleased than the Trolls.
I found the ashes. I doubt they will calm a cursed armor, but if it makes the zombie happy ...
Can you fight too - or just bark orders?
You Inquisitors are the true scourge!
What have we done wrong now, Inquisitor?
Gownsmen are not welcome in these parts!
You can keep your religion for all I care!
You are a disgrace to all believers, Inquisitor!
Gartor was pleased and rewarded me well.
I was successful, Fedel Raa has been defeated. If what they say is true then I was also able to ban him. I should talk to him now.
Shouldn't you be barefoot and pregnant or something?
You're nothing but a cheap imitation of a High Elf!
I like chicks who fight back!
Come here! You want it too!
You're going to get it now, skank!

A sharp dagger can be so persuasive...
With a brazen attitude and a little brawn, you can get what you want so much faster.
A robbery swift and bountiful, is better than a day spent in labour and toil.
A single ring was all I got for my efforts. Just a single ring!
Trees are good cover for waylaying travellers.
The burglars have been punished and the loot retrieved. That made Hay Highbern happy.
Wasn't that nice? Someone finally came to visit me, I hope I see you again soon.
Move it, I don't have forever!
Well how is it? Can you do it?
The archaeologist has asked me to take him to his nearby camp. The dig site is also there.
I will have to smash a few skulls...uhm...I mean - I will have to help a few souls to reach the netherworld before I can use this wonderful item.
The nameless Priest was very happy and gave me a generous reward. They executed the boy. Pretty cold-blooded... Oh well, that's a cult for you!
If I say "no" that will mean failure to give assistance.  Got it? Then - NO!

Speak with Ligien, the First Priestess!

Your good deeds have not escaped Ligien's notice. She is our First Priestess, and she asks that you pay her a visit.
That thing is like Aunt Doria's birthday present: Nice but useless.

Stop TyBosso's lumberjacks.

Hello there. You are a Dryad, aren't you? Listen, it was decided a while ago that the woods around the village should be reafforested. But TyBosso prevents us from doing so. In fact he forces his slaves to lumber all the trees. Please make him stop.
You dare to attack a magician?
This injury does not bother me!
I can't even feel that scratch!
Nobility, waste of space that they are, plan on attacking a base of the inquisition. The commander of that base needs to be warned so she may prepare for the onslaught.
Thanks! The punishment was just, even if it seemed a little severe. Here is your reward.
What do you call such a thing? And what does it do?
Thankfully, Shirka Alana doesn't know the whole truth. Yes, I knew her father, but that was a long time ago.
Built on an island in the Skookumchuck.
Go on! Take Fellir his rat!
I hear you are a kind and brave woman.
People talk about you - but I never hear anything bad.
If only I could be a little more like you...
Who are you trying to scare in that costume?
Your evilness is literally written all over your face!
Terrible stranger - move on, so that I won't have to have nightmares about you!

Destroy the source of the spider plague!

Those 20 spiders that you killed were a good start. But I'm afraid that it's not a longterm solution. We have to get to the source of this evil. I suspect that the spiders' main nest is in the nearby forest. Could you look into this matter? It won't bring Sieghilde back, but would you do it for me and my other cows please?
Begone mechanical creature of the underworld!
What do you want, Temple Guardian?
The Swamps - Height of Mother Nature's Destruction
A little brain mass is not enough to turn a machine into an intelligent being.
Hey, hurry up! We're under attack!
My power is too great! These opponents are not worth my while any longer!
I'm bringing shadow into the desert, sand man!
They say that we weren't really successful in the field. Is that because of our bad weapons?
That last battle against the Elves can be called a fiasco, right?
We supposedly can't afford any more troops. How can we possibly win like this?
Back in the old days we could pay for the best soldiers! But now? Look at these old men!
What used to be a dreaded army is now the ridicule of the continent. Doesn't that hurt?
Just look at the condition of our active troops. It's a pathetic image.
When I was a soldier we went from victory to victory, but nowadays? Just take a look around.
We can't even win the smallest fights against the Orcs. Isn't that sad?
What they call army here wouldn't even be allowed to watch a haystack somewhere else!
Everything is going downhill! And our formerly mighty army is going first, can you see it?
Damage Conversion: Weapon Damage to Poison Damage
I am looking forward to the day when I can use that piece of equipment.
No! Leave me be! I see death in your eyes! Talisman, save me!!!
Did someone order 100 kg ground Kobold?
Go! Leave this place! The Dark Cult cannot be stopped. No one can. It's too powerful with too many followers. They will be here soon and then you will suffer. So for the last time: LEAVE!

Slay five tree ghosts!

The jungle cats were only able to scratch you a few times, hmm? Next up are the tree ghosts! Slay five tree ghosts! Return to me afterwards as usual!
He's leaving me? Why is he doing this to me?
Trolls aren't made for stopping me.
I would be lost without you.
You won't wake anyone else from the dead!
Orcs ... almost as bad as humans.
To the Orcs? *sighs* That's all I needed!

Kill the Carnach

What do you want from me? Assistance in your “battle”? Don't be a fool! Why would I care about you or your goals? I come from another dimension, outside of this creation. The religious squabbles of this world do not interest me. Nothing and nobody from your dimension can compete with my power.
There is however one other creature also from another dimension... it's the Carnach. He has learned to use the magic energy that flows through this world. With this additional knowledge his power could one day rival my own. I have lived to my ripe old age by never letting that happen, so I'll offer you a deal. If you kill the Carnach, I'll tell you where you can find the answers to your questions. As an added bonus I'll even release the slaves in the breeding kennels. Animal flesh or Human - it matters not to me after so many years.

We found the bandits and killed them. The little girl thanked me and told me to meet her in the main Dryad city. After that she just vanished! It was very strange; I felt as if I knew her, yet I’ve been gone from this place for longer than she's been alive ...
I need to make my way to the main city now.
Hey, you! Don't you Orcs have some hacking for us to do? We're terribly bored.
Indeed, I have a job for you. We plan to attack a little fortification. There's good booty to find there.
Oh, that's promising! When will the fun begin?
Sometime tonight. Our scouts are gathering information about their strength and defences now.
They have defence? That doesn't sound like fun anymore!
What did you think they'd have at a fortification, you little coward? Did you think they'd just hand over their treasure?
Defence is a bad sign. I'm going to look for something else to do.
Of course, you're not interested if actual effort is needed... Begone, you stupid coward!
Well, brave savior. Is your faith strong enough for martyrdom?
Turn around now, or I'll put your false doctrines to the test with my blade.
Don't expect to be welcome here. I despise your religious equability.
You want to tell the people how to handle this crisis? Just leave that to the weapon wielders.
Don't tell the people to stop fighting, or you'll experience your afterlife first-hand!
Be on your way, or I'll have you arrested. Your false promises about the Gods only confuse people.
Your pious self-righteousness doesn't impress me. If things were left to you, we'd all be slaves.
Please keep the faith somewhere else. We don't like pacifist agitators like you.
Your peacefulness is just a ploy. All you care about is worldly power.
This country is going downhill. There's a cleric at every corner now.
What can I do for you hypocrite? End your miserable life with my sword perhaps?
I have nothing to say to you. The church is bad for the morale of our troops.
Your half-hearted prayers won't protect us from our enemies. Think about that.
Go! This is your only warning. Next time I'll have your dishonest, pious head.
Man, it's a good job that us High Elves are patient and relaxed...
Anything is better than being a software developer in Germany!
The lighthouse keeper is peeved! Even after five years of service, he still hasn't received a pay raise. He has drawn up his written notice and asked me to deliver it to the mayor.
You have fulfilled your task. Forens thanks you for the sacrifice. I bless you in her name and wish you all the best on your search for inner peace.
Did Stan send you? Then welcome to our little club! As long as you can afford to pay the stakes, you’re welcome at our table!
So all you have to do is help them feel strong, then they'll treat Mother Nature nicely all by themselves. I wish we could teach the Kobolds to do that.
I have reached the settlement. Maybe the inhabitants need my assistance.
Further decreases the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.

Check on the machine's progress.

Greeting! I'm an investor and am constantly looking for new projects. My latest investment is in a machine that turns sand into water. It would sell well in the desert I guess, but I haven't heard from the scientist in a while. I've given him a lot of gold, but I don't have time to check on him. Would you do that for me? Find out the project's progress, how long it will take until completion, etc. Return to me with a report and I shall reward you handsomely.

The soul of a powerful mage came back when the souls were coming back from the realm of the dead. He was constantly calling the undead to the Island of the Dryads. I'm supposed to climb into the mage’s grave and kill the Lich.
Damn it! I think I caught mold.
We will torture you with pleasure!
I will drink your blood from your skull!
This bloody matter has been dealt with. I should be proud, well, at least prouder than the heartless Trolls.

The path to the Crystal Cave is northbound. Follow it!

Hold! Desist! Too much blood has already been shed. You want to go to the Crystal Caves? Very well then, give me your word you'll refrain from killing any more Dryads and I'll show you the way.
That's it for now. I got a couple of commanders. It looks like we opened up a can of worms down there. I'm going to report to the General.

Who do you think you are? You are in my realm. You can't scare me and you'll be better off not starting a fight with me. You might be able to kill me, but if you did that you wouldn't stand a chance in these parts of the world. Think about it. Influence goes beyond death!
Our church used to have ways of pressuring people, but nowadays they would be called barbaric.
Things were a lot easier in the old days. If someone didn't pay, you'd just block his way into paradise. But today?
I'm thinking about holy bearer bonds, unfortunately the stock exchange hasn't been invented yet.
You're right. Everyone wants to believe with their heart, but not with their wallet!

Testa is the god of Science. He is the god who defines the rules that govern how things work.  His is the spirit that animates mechanical things and causes machines to operate.MythologyBeing the god of Science, Testa works hand in hand with Forens, the goddess of philosophy and wisdom. However, while Forens is focusing on the aspect of “the word”, Testa is responsible for technical and mechanical knowledge. From the simplest laws of physics, to complex machinery, Testa is the spirit and the force behind it. Testa always follows a clear path of cause and effect. All events are triggered by other events and can be backtracked. That's the decisive difference from the rather elusive and obscured answers to the questions of philosophy.The theological descent teaches us that shortly after the creation of the world, Testa himself built a huge machine, which is now known as “the great machine,” and animated it. Then, he created replicas of himself to maintain the machine. Replicas, which are in fact partly machines themselves.AppearanceTesta is commonly displayed as a dog head made of steel on a mechanical apparatus in the shape of a human body. His ribcage is open and one can see the complex machinery with gears, bolts and pipes inside.The CultSince every culture has at least some form of Science, Testa can claim temples and followers in virtually all regions of Ancaria. However, it is obvious that his influence is stronger in the more industrialized regions of the world.Reflecting his focus, the science, many of the followers of Testa are intellectuals, or at least educated people. Many people consider Testa as both, a god, but also an inspiration. They are not just worshipping him, they are trying to emulate his spirit and let themselves be guided by his ideas.Testa's symbol is the gear wheel, representing one of the heart pieces of mechanical animation. This symbol is displayed in all his temples and memorial shrines and it's considered the perfect shape amongst the believers of Testa.Opponents and SupportersTesta is closely related to Forens, the goddess of Philosophy and wisdom. Otherwise he takes a neutral position in the Ancarian pantheon, especially in regards to Kali and Lumen's battle.

Dwarves

Do they really exist?

For centuries, reports and legends about the race of the Dwarves have existed all over the world. Countless stories, songs, poems and make-believe ‘facts’ have been told and written about this race. However, the race of Dwarves appears to be like a deep-water monster that rears its ugly head only once every few years. Nobody truly believes in it - but what if it were true after all? So everyone travels to that location and buys mugs with an image of the monster, uses those mugs as presents for relatives and they end up gathering dust on the shelf.
Still, do they really exist, those Dwarves? Or are they indeed simply a myth - created in order to scare little children, conjured as creepy stories by the campfires? In this book I will attempt to solve this puzzle - I will uncover rumors and name facts and certainties.

Origins, Initial References

Two historic sources allegedly prove the existence of Dwarves. Both are of the same age and derive from the same regions:
First, the “Hailstone Songs” - a collection of ancient texts and poems, dated back to the year 1500 (Old Time) by archaeologists. Very few pages still exist, and one of them features a song with the words:

Little man, long beard and hammer
Whacking iron with a slammer.
Wearing coat and helm from chains,
Eating well ‘ til none remains.
Belly’s bulging, nose is knobbly,
Drinking stout that makes him wobbly.

This song - as well as the entire book - was written in Old-Eruthrean. Thus, numerous varying interpretations and translations of this text exist. Many historians have expressed doubts about the accuracy of the translation; however, they have failed to offer convincing alternatives. Therefore, this fragment is regarded as the initial reference to Dwarves. Still, even if the translation were correct, it would not necessarily mean that the described person was indeed a Dwarf. Visit any village inn throughout the Human territories and you will find dozens of people matching this very description.

The discovery of the “Hailstone Skydisk” in 242 (New Time) added fuel to the fire of the Dwarf-theory supporters. This strange arcane artifact consists of copper and brass rivets and it puzzled researchers for years. Finally, the historian and scholar DeNiken discovered that you have to connect those rivets in a certain order, which revealed this picture:



This revelation was a scientific sensation. Even the most passionate critics of the Dwarf-theory had to admit that the Hailstone Skydisk was yet another indication for the existence of Dwarves in this region.



Popular Belief and Legends

“Eat your food, it ain't so tough,
or Dwarves will grab you by your scruff”
 Nursery rhyme, traditional

Many myths, legends, ideas and theories about Dwarves are floating around. The fact that nobody has ever seen a Dwarf does not convince anyone that they do not exist. Quite the contrary - the common people regard Dwarves as even more mysterious due to that fact. There are many legends about Dwarves entering houses of Humans at night and cleaning them (the houses, not the Humans) while consuming enormous amounts of beer and singing merry songs. Elsewhere, stories are told about an obscure Dwarven cult taking in exiled aristocratic ladies and nursing them. Additionally, the myth “Dwarves” was widely used as a sanctioning tool for children’s education: In the northern regions a terrible threat was issued to children that they would be cooked and eaten by Dwarves if they did not behave. A much less sinister approach in the southern regions offers the vision that Dwarves come to pick up baby teeth once they have fallen out, and turn them into diamonds.

Dwarven technology is yet another endless field for vivid imaginations. Supposedly, Dwarves are able to build extremely complex machines. The technological and mechanical capabilities of this race are allegedly very far advanced, and even enable them to build flying devices! These claims prove yet again the absurdity of the stories about Dwarves that are told among the common people.

Another skill associated with Dwarves is the art of blacksmithing. According to common belief, Dwarven steel is supposed to be the hardest and most sturdy material known to mankind. Swords forged at Dwarven anvils, ornate with runes and other magic signs, are apparently the ultimate weapons in the hand of any warrior; there are even claims that they are superior to High Elven blades.

Approximately 250 years ago, strange circles appeared in corn fields around Urthak’s Moxie. Rumors were spreading at the time that the circles were the result of Dwarves having gotten lost in the fields during the night when they were drunk.

More reputable researchers are adamant that the Dwarves did in fact exist but that they are extinct. A possible reason for this extinction could be the impact of a huge meteorite, which caused the Dwarven mines to collapse. Others assume that a change of climate and the resulting shortness of food resources could be responsible for the extinction of the Dwarves. Finding a reason for an entire race to have apparently dissolved into thin air seems to be even more challenging to scientists than answering the question of whether this race did indeed exist or not.

Do Dwarves exist?

During all my years of research and studies I have never encountered a single solid proof that the Dwarves really existed. All traces and findings such as the bone samples of Urthak turned out to be forgeries or misinterpretations. Even studying ancient history books did not facilitate a final judgment. Therefore, my approach to this theory is still skeptical. If Dwarves existed, where would they be? How could they conceal their existence from the world, where are they hiding? Do mines and tunnels exist which are deep and long enough to hide an entire race of people?

Frequently, sightings of Dwarves are reported. However, upon further investigation you will find that usually the probability of such a sighting is closely connected to the amount of alcohol imbibed by the reporter, which does not render these statements very believable. Can you trust these sources? Personally, I highly doubt it.

It remains difficult to prove the existence of a race that has never existed...
