Combos are a succession of combat arts. They offer you the opportunity to execute several combat arts in succession without having to select them individually each time.
You can also execute several combat arts of one aspect in a row, which would be impossible to do if you used them individually. All combat arts in a combo must be fully charged before you can use the combo again.

In order to create a combo you just have to click on a combo symbol...

...and place it into the "Edit" slot.


Click on the desired combat arts in the overview screen and place them into the respective slots. Each combat art can only be used once in any given combo. Buffs may not be used in combos at all.

Just like a combat art, you need to place combos into an available slot to the right of the compass and then you can execute them by right-clicking.


Learning the skill " Combat Discipline " will enable you to use up to four combat arts per combo instead of just two.
This region is full of weaklings.
The followers of this hideous and grotesque idol must be eliminated.
May the blessing of Testa, God of Science and Guardian of Wisdom, be upon you.
The commander sent two of his soldiers with me. Accompanied by them, he wants me to go back to the trader and confront him.
An energy field which partly absorbs incoming damage for as long as energy is available to maintain the field.

Get rid of the Kobolds in the sewage canals!

Damn it! Kobolds are all over the sewage canals. The little creatures are not really dangerous, but workers refuse to go down there and clean the canals. And I don't have enough people to get rid of the pests.

You look like an experienced fighter. Want to fight for honor and glory? Well all right, there is gold in it as well.
The zombie was overjoyed. He can now be cut down like everybody else.
You have changed, son. What's going on?
I found a bush in the mountains. The leaves have magical powers.
Magical powers? I can't believe that. Surely I would know about it.
Why don't you try it? If you chew the leaves, a great power flows through your body making you invincible.
But you look terrible! Are you talking about the coca bush?
I don't know its name. I grind the leaves into a powder that the Elves in the city are measuring in gold.
Fool! Your so-called magic is a dangerous poison. You'll get yourself and others killed.
You know nothing! I have to go.
A very scared Human prattled on about a huge monster in a cave. I think I should investigate that matter. Monsters mean fighting - and fighting means loot.
The trees have been whispering into my ear telling me that you are not using an original version. I will curse you, if you don't buy an original version of Sacred 2!
I have not sold any armor for a long time now.
Only the truly great can appreciate the quality of my cloth.
You can buy nothing but the best of the best from me.
The light fabrics from the South and the heavy furs from the North sell excellently.
Coats of chain mail made for the noble Elves are rare.
Good weapons are essential in these times.
I shall have to polish these pieces of armor - people aren't even looking at them.
I have fine robes for fine lords.
This scaled armor is always coated in dust!
Officer Rengelwyn has asked me to eliminate Captain Bloodmouth, the leader of a band of dread pirates.

Bring me the head of a Boar Pack Leader!

I am Guntha, the Master Hunter of my clan. Only the best warriors are qualified to hunt. In a duel the opponent runs when he is beaten, in the hunt the opponent is beaten when he can no longer run.
Hunting for boar is the most difficult hunt! Boar are smart and fight as a pack. You must be a true hunter in order to hunt boar.
I've been told you are a good warrior. If you're that good, then prove it. Bring me the head of a boar pack leader. Kill lots of boar and then the leader will show up to defend his pack.
Bring me the head!
No time, no interest, no need.
Hey you, hero! Here I am!
You are no match for us!
You are nothing but a murderer!
Cemil has the milk. Now he needs one last ingredient, this brand new spice from Dyr-Lain called “garlic.” I hope one of the merchants has something exotic like that.
The opponents in this region use weapons inflicting mainly cold-based damage.

Expel the squatters from my house!

Hey you! A word my friend!
You look like a competent problem solver, if you know what I mean. I have a problem with three squatters who have set up house on my property and refuse to pay any rent. They are nothing but miserable parasites! If you could “persuade” them to move on, I’d happily pay you a tidy sum for your troubles.
May the Gods be with you!

Find the door guard!

Who are you? Did this idiot Margathon sent you? Took him long enough ... 500 centuries to be precise! You can't accuse him of not thinking things through thoroughly.
You must get me out of here! The door has no lock so there are no keys. There seems to be a guardian for the portals. The guards call him Pilgrim. See if you can find him!
You are shooting at a Seraphim!
Why doesn't the game continue? - Malfunction - Malfunction - Why doesn't the game contunue? - Malfunction - malfunction...
Who or what may have created you? It definitely wasn't nature.
Come on and fight, you hero!
Most people would rather die than think; in fact, they do so.
How almost generous. I got to keep the change and I got a doll. I would have expected a little more for all that running around.
The time will come for me to use this item.
Program verified: Inquisitors are all the same!
If I stuck all of you in a sack and hit it with a club, I couldn't go wrong!
1000 Inquisitors lying on the ocean floor would be a good place to start.
Just keep spouting out that religious nonsense!
Thanks, but I don't need you or your Gods!

Take me back home!

Hey you! Please help me! I am lost. Can you take me back home to my parents?
I found the notes, now I'm going to take them to militia captain Gabelte.
In honor of the great Chronicler Physitrian.
The Lizardman warrior has fallen and his tribe is dead. I love stories without a happy end!
The moneylender's thugs won't bother anyone for a while. Correction: they won't bother anyone ever again.
Poor Mother Bear, she probably thought my teddy is her baby. But now I'll take care of the little one.
If he ever crosses my path again, he'll wish he'd never been born.
I've chased off a couple of Kobolds as well as collected the six hearts. I should take them to Lienhart now, so he can get the soup started.
The food is marvellous in my tavern.
You can have your weapons repaired by our smith.
Your last fight was really extensive, right?
You probably feel as strong as a Giant!
I would have never thought that you really existed!
I will deliver the scroll in person.
Follow your men down into the netherworld!
This time, I have to kill some bears. And I have to hurry again.
Why do I have to put up with something like this?
Phase Shift - Decreases the cooldown of Shadow Step.
Escape - Chance to break all rooting effects while teleporting.
Vanish - The caster remains invisible for a brief period after the teleport.
Sanctuary - The caster is briefly invulnerable from physical damage after the teleport.
Explosion - Inflicts area damage while teleporting.
Mend - Heals the caster during teleport.
A scratch ... it's just a scratch.
My magical powers and me are at your service.
The best weapon is no good when being used by an amateur.
This is a waste of T-Energy...
Take their blood! I love light skin!
Let them feel our comforting cold.
They are a real pain, those Humans!
How can they live among this stench!
If all Dragons are like the last one, their population will be drastically reduced after I'm done here.
Back to the forests you go!
If I was your size I'd worry about frostbites on my nose when the frost sets in...
The coat of a camel driver would suit you better.
Your flower picking and tree-hugging days are over.
The situation here is hopeless. You can't change anything about that.
You know, the people here die earlier than anywhere else.
My greatest wish is to be free of this misery.
A zombie with brains? No way...
I am a warrior, and you are dead!
Back to the netherworld, undead one!
I hope you feel better soon, I will light a candle for you in the next temple.
I'm already feeling better. Why don't you come back later? I would be glad.
Any Hero has talked to 200 NPCs.
The blow went straight through me!
The origin of all magical power is still an unsolved mystery.
Time has taken its toll from this statue. Praised be the gods.
Out of range for quest reward
Are you surprised that the masses are looking for revolution with all this starvation?
The sentiment is getting worse! The people are tired of it, and many are prepared to turn to weapons!
It's a known fact that the situation could escalate. The people have been starving for way too long, right?
What do you think? Could there really be revolts because of hunger? Tell me!
The complaining soon turns into a storm, understand? People are just really hungry!
I hope you'll develop a new living space for us. If that doesn't happen then there will be revolts.
What do you think about rumors that the starving want to fight for their cause by themselves?
Many don't want to hear it, but poverty and hunger could soon turn into an uprising.
What if we experience a civil war? Poor against really poor? That would almost be ironic.
Do you believe the voices that foretell a planned insurrection by the impoverished masses?
This is the end for you, adept!
So you have some good news and some bad news do you? Let me guess. The good news is that Varuck is dead, but then what could the bad news be?

Stefan Maton
Pour ma femme Christelle qui me comprend, qui me soutient et qui ne rouspète pas trop quand je passe mon temps jusque tard le soir devant l'ordinateur pour travailler... Stefan Maton
My battle plan isn't really working here. The enemies are too strong.
Ah! The invitation! I'll attend with my wife and my clutch. Here, take this for your troubles.
We stand for law and order!
We'll stand watch here and keep blocking the way.
That's not enough to be the champion shot of the village. You'll have to practise a bit more.
Maybe there is something to do around here...
My goal must be really close...
A vast battle must have raged here.
You don't have enough gold. You have %1 <$ID_CUI_GOLDICON_INSERT> but you need %2 <$ID_CUI_GOLDICON_INSERT>.

Lupus Coldhand is the Orc's Master Hunter. If I want his title, then I have to get the hunting amulet from the Grotto of Death. He deposited it there a long time ago, so that it wouldn't be easy for the competition to find it. I think I'll give it a try. Not that the title means anything to me, but I'm tempted by the challenge. If I am successful, then Lupus will step down. The chance to humiliate that arrogant bozo is worth the risk.
Khormynth will need some time to perform the ritual. He told me to wait at the entrance of the Bloodlake Grotto to keep the monsters at bay. I hope he won't take too long.

So that's the way the wind blows. The mayor sends the cows to be slaughtered so they won't fall into the Kobolds' hands. He also wants me to bring him a few Kobold heads, so he can show them that his people are not defenseless.

Look for my missing daughter and wife!

I don't know what to do! First my daughter disappeared, and now my wife is gone too! It all started a few days ago. My daughter Gilminga was seen with three members of a cult that calls itself “Shadows of Life.” She never returned home after that. I assume that this cult had something to do with her disappearance.
My wife didn't want to wait any longer so set out in search of our daughter. She should have returned a long time ago. Help me, I implore you! Find my wife and my daughter!
I would really like to see a picture of our Goddess! She must be infinitely beautiful!
What do you think Kybele looks like? I have lain awake many nights, but I haven't been able to find an answer to this question!
If the Goddess created us in her own image then she must be truly beautiful, can you imagine that?
Why doesn't the Goddess ever show her face to us? Is it possible that she's not as beautiful as we all believe her to be?
If Kybele is the epitome of all things beautiful, why doesn't she ever let us see her face?
I already believe that Kybele is the measure of everything that is beautiful, but what does she look like? What do you think?
My one true love is the great Kybele! Will she ever reveal herself to me, though?
Although I truly worship our Goddess, I wonder why she never reveals herself to us!
You are very wise. Could you not describe Kybele's face to me? I'd really like to know what she looks like.
I'm surprised that Kybele, who exemplifies everything that is beautiful, never reveals herself to us in all her splendor!
Very nice! Good quality! We'll be able to make splendid shrunken heads with them. Here this is for you!
Gant pods! That's what's used in High Elven fireworks. There are almost unknown here. No demand, cheap price. Great! 150 gold for me.
It is nice to meet you. You distract our attention from our sadness.
It's you? What an evil trap...
Do you know how to help us fight this poverty?
Gisbert’s leg is infected. He asked me to fetch a doctor from the nearby military garrison.

The superfluous, a very necessary thing.
- Voltaire
Fallen in the line of duty...
Aren't you the warrior who defeated the scorpion?
People talk about you. They say you defeated the Carnach!
People say you killed the scorpion with your own bare hands.
Even if the Gar'Colossus came from the earth, it was right to kill him. His existence was unnatural!
The power of nature resides in you! That's the only way you were able to overcome an opponent such as the scorpion!
This will be a witty conversation ...
Finally someone who knows how to die.

What did you bring me? "Greifenburg after Midnight?“ That sounds pretty good! I'm anxious to find out who the murderer is!
Take this book as a token of my gratitude. I've finished it already.

Take the cloth to the seamstress.

All done. It was a real pleasure to work with such wonderful wool. Please give my regards to the seamstress.
Help yourself, I am entrusted with more important tasks!
Mother wants to destroy me? How could she? Well first I'll help this poor creature, and then who knows? Maybe I'll find out something.

Bring me Kobold heads!

The cows? Yes I'll have them slaughtered. Why not? It doesn't make any difference anymore. The Kobolds are everywhere, attacking everything that gets in their way. As long as they are around I can't take the cows to town. If they found out that there's tons of beef they'd never leave. Since you know and do everything so well... why don't you kill a few Kobolds and bring me their heads?

I...please, I surrender! I'll tell you everything I know! The Seraphim... spoke of a strange magical presence that she sensed. Something ancient... she said. Something otherworldly... She told us to conduct the ritual in order to weaken its evil powers... so that she could then destroy it. That... that is all that I know. I beg you... put an end my suffering...
Further increases the chance for critical hits.

You really want to help me? Well there is one thing... When I died I lost my most important piece of jewelry, my amulet. Please find and take it to my daughter. She will be very happy when she gets it and I will finally be able to rest in peace.
Wylmieni can now begin making the potions.
Names shall never have any power over us!
You'll do everything I want? Now that's what I call a basis for negotiation.
I have no business with you.
There is talk that the Orcs have begun stealing cattle again - as if our situation wasn't dire enough.
Crying about it won't help! We'll have to defeat them in battle.
Sometimes it seems as though we are fighting against phantoms who make fools of us in the dark of night.
We mustn't lose heart, my friend! If we don't fight back, they will overrun the land.
God knows, I have stood in battle against them often enough. Don't you dare call me a coward!
I didn't, good friend! Fight on, my friend, fight on!
My bones ache and the blade of my sword is jagged and pitted with holes.
Fear not! We are Humans and we will always fight on! Never forget that!

I knew there was something big behind all this. Why else would a Seraphim have traveled all this way to protect the ritual? The Seraphim seem to think that the Unholy Crusade poses a threat to our world, which means that I'm in danger too!
I'm already implicated in the crusader’s plot, and the soldiers in the Central Region have put my face up on their wanted posters. I'll have to find a way to extricate myself from this dreadful affair!
First I'll find out if the leader of the Crusade has more for me to do.

The nerve! The little rascal claims that I cheat children? Why are you looking at me like that? You are not going to...? Wait! Here are the candies! I merely wanted to do that boy a favor. Sweets are bad for your teeth!
I think this is the place I am looking for.
One more hit like that and I'll take you seriously.
No storage entry for private individuals. Search registry for other ways to proceed. Primary choice: evasive lie.

You have done me a great favor! Now I'll inherit my father’s barony. I never particularly liked his plans.
You look skeptical, my friend! I am young, but my father’s plans were truly wicked. I have enjoyed the privilege of a good education, and one day I shall drive the Orcs from our fair Empire.
Before you take your leave, do you remember my father’s words? The instrument of his power as he called it, you will find it in the basement. Please go, and destroy it if you can!
The task given to these creatures by the Gods seems to be more of a curse. Maybe I'll be able to release them from this curse by taking their heads off.
Don't you dare to try that again!
Hey, maggot food! Time for the second funeral!
You look kinda worm-eaten to me!
I wouldn't date you, not even if I was dead too!
Maybe the gardener will be able to give me some more information.

Find my son and bring him back to me safely.

I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. My son went to the river bank to play and should have been back already. Now I have to go and get him, although I still have so much to do.

I'm the runemaster in this beautiful little place. You want to know what runes are? Magic talismans, able to improve innate or learned abilities. I have an idea. You go and look for my son, allowing me to get on with my work so you can fall back on my abilities afterwards.
You have been polluted by the world outside this forest!
What a shame - but you had it coming.
You shouldn't have turned your back on Kybele.

Bring the coach the hearts of ten Orcish athletes!

Those bloody beasts! They attacked us like a pack of wild animals - which is exactly what they are!

We had agreed upon a friendly game of rag doll ball, and we were clearly the better team. Is it my fault that our positioning and techniques were better? Well okay, I’m the coach, but still... Anyway, the Orcs are sore losers. After they were defeated, they started to beat up our players. I broke it up, but our forward was already lying on the floor - dead!

Get me the hearts of 10 Orcish athletes, and I will make you an honorary member of our team! They are hiding in the forest.
I don't know how to use that yet.

Collect five shuffle weeds.

We're planning a service in honor of Testa, but I've run out of a few ingredients. Would you help me and collect five shuffle weeds? I would collect them myself, but I'm needed here. Would you help us?
The opponents in this region generally use weapons for ice based damage.
The one who came from the desert - and died there too.

Kernforce, the High Elf Mage, is also a successful novelist. She's working on a new novel right now and is conducting research for it in this area. Her dog foolishly ran away. I'm supposed to look for it with her.
It has to be here somewhere.
You successfully traded with another user.
That exceeds my current riding skills.
Any hero reaching the Dryad island Dyr-Lain and accepting a quest there.
I am supposed to collect money.
I have collected all the money that is owed to the shylock.
This scorpion will break its stinger on me.
Garlic? Yes, I have this rare and valuable spice for sale. And I'm the only one around who sells it, so you're lucky.
I guess I don't have to get married then.
One has to "sound" things out once in a while with you fanatics, eh?
How was I to know that the outdoor plane toilet was a joke?
Little did I know that the boomerang would not come back alone.
What do you mean they haven't invented parachutes yyyyyeeeeeettttttt?
Poor Jack always got it backwards. It's look then leap.
Hey! Could you move two feet to the side? You're standing on me! Now your standing on my husband! Just go away already.
Ascaron will not be held responsible for your starting grave-opening as a real life hobby.
So Ron thought to himself "this is a grave development."
Oh, are your knees shaking already?
I know your user, you're as good as dead!
How did you get that far?
Blasphemers like you have to die!
It is our job to hunt down and destroy the likes of you!
It's really you! Heavenly happiness fills me!
What a miracle! How are you?
That's like a piece of heaven on earth. Good to see you.
Blessed be your days. I prayed for this encounter.
I remember you with pleasure. You're a true believer.
It's you? What a wonderful surprise in these dark hours.
Is this coincidence or the will of the Gods?
Crossing your path is a most wonderful fate.
I'm also happy. My heart is overflowing with pious joy.
Wonderful! Meeting you is a Godsent coincidence.

The first part of my plan is accomplished, that farmer is now an old widower. What bad luck, it's a tragedy really. Now for the second part of my plan. I have some important information for the Town Guards.
Run, for I'm on the hunt!
Come my child and receive your gift.
I just left the inn! Now they serve the cursed outlandish beer there too.
Beer! Beer good! Troll like much beer!
Your taste buds are lousy indeed.
We have purity requirements here, but the outlanders don't stick to it so they can sell it cheaper.
Drink good! More drink, same gold, gooder!
I should have expected that from you, you'd also drink swill if it was served in a mug! I have to go.
Note to self: never stop to ask an Orc for directions.
She was young and she was fair, until the Orcs cut off all her hair.
Here lies Dr. A. Cula, died of a heart attack during a visit to the local bloodbank.
Lazy by nature, he finally finished something he started.
Here lies the town clockmaker, he ran out of time.
I came into this world without my consent and left in the same manner.

There's nothing more to be said,
as we only speak well of the dead.

Beneath this stone my wife doth lie,
now she's at rest and so am I.
She cooked me a meal to die for...
You are in a queue, please wait as we value your business.
Sheesh, NOW they take me seriously.
At least my art is worth something now.
Here lies my beloved husband - I miss him a lot, especially since he never told me where he hid all his money.
This grave is currently being tested by gravetester # 517.
A weapon with cold-based damage does not help me here.
You need thin glue? I've got a whole bucket I left standing in the rain. Can't use it anymore, looks almost like milk. You really want it? Take it, no need to pay me.

Christian Grunwald
This ain't in the concept but it goes without saying. It's like in Sacred 1, obviously!
The healer was happy that it was me picking up the parcel, not Hegiman. It seems I'm not the only one who can't stand the sword trainer. No wonder, the way he acts...
Make sure the kids haven't swapped your real sword for a toy one, BEFORE you go adventuring.
Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.
Note to self: The messenger said: "Dragons don't need dentists", not "don't eat dentists."
Hunter's note: "Duck" means head down, not the animal you're hunting for.
Never bite that what might bite you back.
Playtime's over. I must protect the priest and the hunter.

Talk to the dragon!

Well then. Looks like this is goodbye. I must admit that I envy you. But I always knew that you'd have your chance before me. You were always the better adept between us right from the very first day at the academy. Who knows, maybe it'll be my turn next year. And I sincerely hope that I don't have to take your place.
So, off with you! I can't be bothered with long, sentimental farewells! Talk to the dragon and be on your way! I'll keep my fingers crossed!

Farewell!
We live from hand to mouth.
Mocking the poor is hardly original now, is it?
I don't even have enough money to buy some food.
I have nothing - not even a shelter for the night.
My dreams will remain forever unfulfilled.
I would love to own a new dress, but I will probably never wear anything but this robe full of holes.
Now I'll have to wait until my player returns to the land of the living.
I found the ring, now it’s time to get out of here! The air down here is old and stale.
I acquired two barrels of a very good red wine. That should make Melantion happy.
Ah just as I thought! These fellows are playing with forged cards, but I'll shuffle their decks for them!
Did you take care of everything, of my lord? And what about my money? Stop! What are you doing? Noooooo...

Gravestone
Women are wiser than men because they know less and understand more.
I cannot protect you any more, sinner!
I hope that you are just passing through, warrior.
A warrior of the dark path! I think I'd better buzz off...
You seem to be very inscrutable.
Congratulations, player! The quest compass has led you to your target!
The Royal Atherton family owe you a debt of gratitude.
My son... Dead? By the Gods, what have I done to deserve that?

A farmer discovered a vein of gold in his field. Now he wants me to deliver a letter to his brother so that he can officially apply for the mining rights. I'll find a way to profit from this, too. I bet there's other people, people with gold, who would find this letter interesting...

Once I was a soldier. I proved myself in many battles, I never failed, and I never avoided a fight. But I was betrayed. An unnatural force robbed me of my final dues, the peace I had earned, and brought my body back into this world. This is how I was damned to continue my existence as a creature of the shadows.

We need reinforcements! Take this message to Nimonuil, the Grand Inquisitor in the capital!

Well fought! Your bravery is an example to us all. However, we lost quite a few men and I'm sure this wasn't their last attack. Go to Grand Inquisitor Nimonuil's mansion in the capital and deliver this message to him. Only to him, mind you, and no other! Good luck.
Ambul is preparing the ritual that the mages will finish afterwards! I wonder if I should cover my ears?

I met an Orc by the name of Hilmi Crookedtooth who specializes in hunting kodiaks. They are apparently the most challenging prey for a hunter. Why does every hunter think that his prey is the summit of creation? He assigned me the task of slaying a kodiak leader and bringing him the head. I'll have to attract the leader first, and the best way to do that is to threaten his group. I'm going to look for some kodiak to slay and hope that the leader comes to see if everything is all right.
You owe me some pack animals.

We need the blood of the Garganthropod. Kill it and bring me its blood!

Hmm... it looks like we’re not quite ready. The alchemist said that we must have the blood of the Garganthropod for the ritual. You will find such a giant scorpion south of here. Do be careful, it's a horrific creature. Go kill it, then bring it’s blood to me.
I can't do anything else but stand around here. Nice programming!
How do you like my magic?
You still have the chance to surrender!
Mission accomplished! The new citizen has arrived at the village safely.
Troll hearts, 25 of them I said. Now go.

I surrender! Spare me please! I ... I'm only a small fish. The Lord of the castle is behind this! Get me out of here, then I'll testify and help you convict him!

But take heed. The arm of the Lord of the castle is long and his henchmen are lurking everywhere!
I've successfully completed this portion of my mission. Let's see what this officer wants from me next.
I found a large cave with a small landing for boats. It would appear that no one has entered this cave in years. I wonder if there is still pirate treasure here?
Don't worry. You will soon be able to sleep with the windows open again.
You're going to have to practice your evil look a little more.
Oops, I walked right past you. You are so inconspicuous though.
You seem like a big chicken to me.
Hmm .. I hate to admit it, but my image of that librarian was really off.
Sounds like you've found your dream job.
What have I gotten into here?
How ever did you get into this position?
If I'd had to guess these people's job, I would have been way off the mark.
One of us is about to die. And it won't be me.
13, 14, 15! Super! You have gained us a great advantage over our enemies. You will not go unrewarded. Here, thank you.
You may invite up to 3 users in your game.
How does the saying go: Work and pray. But I don't want to work.
Requiem for the dead! Again I'll have to fake sympathies and condolences.
I wonder if I should secretly seek out a bar maid ?
I will beat faith into them, with a club if necessary.
I will substitute the altar wine with berry wine. It gets quicker results! *chuckle*
I shall bless the cattle, perhaps it will do some good.
Time and time again I preach about solidarity.
The Gods are powerful. And I will take my axe to the skulls of those who don't believe this.
The confessional is very entertaining to me. Oh, the things I hear!
The shooter, the shooter, he'll get a showing off!

Blacksmith Lobotomer sent me to deliver a bag full of nails to Cobbler Koller in the city of Tharak. The nails are for the legendary Nargutz player Gunter "the smasher" Loprog's shoes. This game just keeps getting more interesting by the minute.
Cities are always great to find out the latest gossip... Or to start a rumor yourself...
I accept this honor ... uhm ... quest!
So it was them after all.
Yes you're right, but they're difficult to defeat and serve a source of power whose origin remains a mystery to us.
They're not from this world, I'm certain of that! But no one seems to have a clue how to beat them.
Where could they possibly come from? And why are we only ever taking on women? Only Kybele can help us!
They're brutal opponents, you're right about that. But we can't lose heart! We have to come up with something.
They're completely merciless on the battlefield, and that is their strength. Our warriors are starting to have doubts.
We can't give up! The Goddess and the land are counting on us. We have to overcome them.
If we despair, then the people of the forest will soon do the same! We definitely have to find out where they're coming from.
They certainly are a terrible threat, and many think they're a scourge of the Goddess. I can't believe that.
They are brutal fighters and they don't fight fair! That makes them a nightmare to battle against. Where do they come from?
They are more horrible than the tree spirits' deepest abyss! We simply have to overcome them!
There you are! It's nice to see you.

You're looking for Davim and Mettrick? Yes, I also wondered where they were. They are always plotting something, those two. Mettrick mentioned the grave of the Dragon hunter Caling. Maybe they planned to go there and get a Dragon’s claw for the upcoming wedding. That is a silly old tradition. You give a Dragon’s claw, the symbol for fertility and a long life, to the bride. But there are no Dragons in these parts anymore. Caling slew the last one, and that was a long time ago. I’d visit his grave if I were you...

Take me home so that I can undo the spell!

Baaa!Baa! I mean... Helloooo!
Stop looking at me like that! I'm not a sheep... or a lamb! I am Mathirius, Senior Magician at the Academy. When those blasted Orcs attacked me I had to use a rescue spell which teleports my spirit into the nearest animal. Now I'm trapped in this sheep's baaaody! Please take me home so that I can change baaack into my normal form. Baaa...
There is no room left for this in my baggage.
Land another hit like that, and I'll be inclined to take you seriously.
It wasn't easy, but I have passed on Judriel's message to her beloved Romdreal.
Seraphim Amicia asked me to fix a malfunctioning generator, a machine that controls the population of the T-Energy creatures. The malfunctioning one produces too many wolves.
Yes, Father. It's my stomach! I either ate something bad, or the Goddess wants to punish me!
What do you think it could have been? What did you have today?
Nothing I'm not used to. Maybe my raw fish had been cursed?
Cursed? My guess is that the problem is simply that it was RAW! How can you eat raw fish?
A travelling man from the Far East taught me how! Can you help me?
Take this potion, and stay away from raw fish from now on.
I'm lucky that you know so much about cures!
I delivered the message. The Inquisitors are very satisfied.
My chickens lay many large eggs.
I would like to acquire white sheep with brown ears tomorrow at the market.
I must refill the cattle's water.
I have heard that pigs can find truffles.
I lost five animals to the local plague.
Any Hero reaching difficulty level Gold.
No problem as long as the reward is right.
I reported to the magician. Now I can go and see the machine myself.
Eww! Those weaklings are fighting for good! There was nothing good in my life, why should I fight for it? I'm going to dedicate myself to the General.

Bring back the stolen artifact!

One of those crazy mages stole a valuable artifact from our Temple. Those quacks are always trying to extract the magic from any magical objects! It's blasphemous! Please find that mage and get the artifact back from him, before it is totally desecrated and useless! There's a cave not far from here. The villains may be hiding there.
Everything points to a major assault. I should tell Turol about it so the zombies have time to prepare.
A fisher's wife has asked me to find her husband. He did not return from a fishing tour.
The genie business is going well this year. Maybe I should specialize in supplies for the bottle fights.
Connection to PlayStation®Network established. The hero has to exit the game.

Prove that you are a warrior and kill the Earth Elementals

Who are you? What are you doing here? This is the "place where magic flows from the Earth."
You don’t look like a warrior. If you want us to take you seriously, show me how good you are at fighting. You find elementals over there. Go and fight against them! Maybe you have the heart of a warrior after all!
Connection to Xbox LIVE established. The character must exit the game.
You're not making a lot of sense, but if you believe in it ... well, I'm ready.
You really believe this cra...er myth?
You are absolutely right! That must not happen, we have to do something!
That's how it works? Really? I wish someone had told me that earlier.
I think I might have overreached here.
I have reached a village. Maybe they need my help here.
As far as battles are concerned, my motto is: "Cash is king!"
Some folks have been whispering about new salary brackets.
Why can't arms and war machines come in more fashionable colours?
Invocations and prayers of intercession are hardly good pay.
I serve the Gods most gladly - but I prefer to serve my purse.
Do you want to sell "%1" (stack of %3) for %2?

I didn’t want to break the law, so I decided to hand over the basket to the Priest. But the Priest said that some things are more important in this world than the law. I will take the basket to the novice now.
Watch out for the outlaws. They're trouble.
I did it! I have slain two Lich Princes and one undead mage. They were carrying the jewels. Now I can take them to Barti Slartfass, so that he can put them back in the amulet.
My mother isn't as brave as you are.
Is that a dagger or a kitchen knife?
Gambolt rewarded me regally for my success.

Hahaha! The shaman lost all his rats? That serves him right! And he always said that his rats were the biggest! That arrogant fool. No, I won't help you! I’d rather come and watch that shaman die! It’s just what he deserves!
Well, perhaps I should take up yodeling - you know, something worthwhile...
The shaman performed the ritual of name giving. He wrote my name down on a scroll which was placed with the other family name scrolls. I am now officially a member of family Grackk.
A scratch ... it's just a scratch.

What did you say? Brigands who pose as soldiers? Unbelievable!
Thank you for your help. I’ll forward this message at once, and I’ll send someone out to collect those uniforms so they can't be misused again!
Here, take this as your reward.
The list serves as the minutes of the traitor's meeting as well as ensures that they don't bad mouth each other. They were stupid enough to sign the bottom. That makes it their death sentence too.

One of the greatest victories you can gain over someone is to beat him at politeness.

- Billings
Amazing - you are still alive and kicking.
Well done - you have achieved more than me after all.
Could it be that you've been here before?
Your aggressiveness still seems to be unbroken.
Do you really enjoy this constant running around?
Blast! I couldn't save him! I wish more people knew how to defend themselves.
They say you're still sitting in trees...
Dryad, off you go to your own territory!
Dryad, give my regards to the Gods!

I have the eye. It really didn't take long. Nimble know what he's doing. I don't know many others who could make a mechanical eye in such an amazingly short amount of time. I had to pay extra for the express manufacture, though. That cost me 6 gold.
This will happen to you all!
Thank you, you restored my honor!
That one is already well aged!
Go ahead, jump over your own shadow, Warrior. HAHAHAHA!
Oh boy, he looks like shi... ah, crap.
May I hear your opinion about a different matter too?
There's something else we should talk about!
No offense, but I'd really like to change the subject!
What's the hurry?! Is someone hunting you?
Yes, that's it exactly! I paid the innkeeper with bad gold, and the old hag saw through it!
Bad gold? But how can beautiful gold be bad?
Are you really that stupid? That's not real gold! We produce it with feldspar and laburnum.
Are you joking? You pay with real gold because it's valuable, not because it's beautiful!
I prefer the splendour! All gleaming things are valuable!
There's no point in discussing it with you. I have to go, you never saw me.
Thank you very much for your help.
I'm too good for this world. I think.
At least I get to travel.
Great idea, let's plug the leak!
The faster we fix this machine, the better.
I'm glad you're familiar with such things.
Defeat the monster? That's worth the delay - let's do it!
You are right, the machine needs to be repaired.
Go ahead and wave your magic wand around. It won't help you!
I don't have the heart to do that yet.
Thanks again for retrieving my father's bow!

I met a farmer who told me that one of his maids was taken by a strange, dark cult. The cultists don't seem to be the most peace loving people under the sun. If the rumors are true then they are killing people by sucking the life right out of them.
I hope can find Mary in time.
Take care! I hope we'll meet again alive.
I hope to see you again soon and in good health.
Have a good trip and take care!
I have to look after my comrades. Thanks for the conversation!
See you soon, and stay victorious!
I have to go, but I'm reluctant to leave you!
It's about time to go! I hope we'll continue our conversation soon.
I hope we meet again soon! Farewell!
We'll meet again soon, I feel it in my claws.
It was a pleasure and an honor. See you soon!

Alright alright... I see that my arguments won't convince you. I'd better give in before you decimate my workforce even further. Here take this money.
Understand one thing: no one... NO one takes on Ali. As long as you're in this region, you should have one foot in the stirrup.
The faster we fix this machine, the better.
Heals the Dryad over a brief period.
A place where "magic emanates from the ground"... that's very unusual ...

Kill the Undead, which was once my wife

Maybe you can help a poor soul? Or rather... two poor souls! I know it´s a strange story, but believe me, it´s true. My wife passed away two winters ago. It was a huge loss for me and I´m still missing her. But sometimes, death isn´t the worst. Recently, I´ve heard rumours that there´s an Undead walking around the cemetry. I didn´t pay much attention to those rumours, but one day, when I went to the cemetry to visit her grave, I found it opened. And then, I saw her. Or rather... what´s left of her. She seemed to recognize me, came to me, begging me to kill and end her restless life. But I was too weak. Yes, I was not man enough to do it. Please, if you´re a good soul, help me. Go to the cemetry and kill her lifeless body. End her pain for me. I don´t have much to offer you, but I`ll give you all the gold I have. Will you help me? I`m begging you.. on my behalf and in the name of my poor wife´s soul.

Ah you found one of my little sheep? They are poor wretches, but at the same time they've earned some peaceful time. We grant them this during their last few years before they turn into dust forever. Unfortunately those who oppose resurrection are always kidnapping them. They could use a good thrashing. What do you say? Can you rid us of these trouble makers?
Don't fall over right away! That was only the beginning!
I don't believe in many things any more, but I'm convinced of the fact that the Elves will be our demise.
I always told you we should've killed the pointy-ears when we had the chance.
It's hard to say. I don't think we should trust them though.
I think there are plenty of reasons to hate them. And yes, those ears make me shudder over and over again.
Nothing is as satisfying as a big helping of hate, and this snobbish pack deserves it.
I won't be able to rest well until they have been eliminated from the face of the world.
Our decline is their fault. They'll pay for all this one day.
I often wonder how our world would look if we made them all go to hell.
The only good Elf is a dead Elf! Feel free to quote me on that one.
Elves! They strut around like dandies and oppress us. Such misery!

Rid the Temple of the cultists, and destroy their cult!

I need your help. I don’t know who else to turn to. I made a terrifying discovery a few days ago. Something strange is going on in the temple at the south end of the city. I overheard two priests talking about a blood sacrifice. So I snuck into the temple at night and observed a sinister ritual. Apparently the priests have become corrupt and now serve other powers!

That is not the worst part, though. I recognized one of the cultists. It was my superior, the high priest Anrajos! I don’t know how deep this corruption goes, but this must be stopped!

No one must get word of this however, otherwise the reputation of the priesthood would be ruined.
Did you really think you could win?
Good to see you, honorable father. I hear you will soon perform a concert in the Glade of Shadows?
Well, news travels fast, it seems. What a small world we live in.
I would love to come. The last one moved me deeply.
It will still be a little while. My opus is not quite finished.
Does it feature melodies to honor the moon disk again?
No, I'm working on a willow flute requiem for the nameless souls of the ancestors.
That sounds wonderful and very mystical.
Just wait. I think you'll like it, child.
Frog's eyes, Kobold's ears, bat poop and thread rush - that should make a very refreshing drink!
I have to take the book and the student back to Farek. Then he'll be able to continue his research, and I'll finally be rid of Heribert.
Get out of my way, I'm leaving!
I'll grant you a new perspective...
The shaman is dead you say? Then the Humans are doomed to die! That is called natural selection...
The Guard wants me to slay a few of the Goblins. Those aggressive creatures are keeping them from their real orders.
Unfortunately the mage no longer lives here. A zombie has settled in and killed the mage.

Hardcore

 If your character dies in this mode, he or she will be no longer playable.

The list of heroes doesn't correspond with the list of those who were resurrected. That's strange. The names have all been signed by a General Winderlich. I'm going to have a look at the list of criminals. I should be on it.
Are you trying to threaten me? How pitiful! They'd make short work of you in the gladiator arena. Now get out of my sight!
The ghosts have been destroyed. I can tell the woman about my success.
Armament - The animated corpses will receive an armor bonus.
Dark Realm - Increases the effective range of the conjuration.
Vivification - The animated corpses live considerably longer.
Demand - Chance to animate an increased number of corpses.
Contagion - Adds a chance for the animated corpses to infect their victims, turning them into undead servants.
Furor - Animated corpses inflict more damage.
If I collect on this bill, then the aristocrat's money will be mine.
The Gods have created our world so magnificently.
Oh Gods - no matter what path you take, I shall follow you.
Only the Gods know what will become of Ancaria.
A peaceful life is only bestowed upon those who serve the Gods.
My rituals convince even the doubters.
I shall light candles to gain favour with Lumen.
In these times, Kuan never sleeps.
How does it feel? Does it still hurt?

Kill the wolf that attacked Dulcinea and retrieve her collar!

My Dulcinea! The poor animal! She's dead! Only yesterday she was standing here in the meadow, chewing her cud and ruminating. Now she’s gone! Vanished! A wolf must have attacked her! There’s nothing left of her but a few scraps of leather. I loved her so much that I even had a special collar made just for her. That wolf must have swallowed it! The wretched animal!

Could you hunt down the wolf and cut it open for me? Perhaps we can still save her collar! Then I would at least have something to remember my sweet Dulci by.
There are many wolves around here.
No worries, your flunkies will take care of your bones.
There it is! Well it's not big, but when it comes to treasure it's the inner values that count. At least that's what they say.

No set armor items are currently equipped. If you equip set items, the set will be displayed here.

Each set offers different bonuses which are also shown here.

The more set items you have equipped, the more bonuses you will receive.

Accompany me to the King's burial chamber!

Finally we can enter the burial chamber of the great King Burag El Leigh.
Once we are there we must interpret the cryptic text properly and then the King or whatever became of him will appear. His valuable amulet is what we are after!
Amantha wants me to find out what she did before she died. Like many others, she can't remember what she did and for how long she has been dead now.
Is it Goblin harvesting time again?
While I am standing around doing nothing I might as well read a book. What have we got here..."The Elves", "The Fairies", "The Orcs", "The Dwarves", "The Trolls" and - best of all - "The Humans".
I could  resurrect two brains. The other three are a lost cause. Wouldn't even want them to feed the fish ...
You've done well. Wantanor will be pleased. Take this and leave.
You are wearing an exceptional garment. Very becoming.
Do you have a minute? Then tell me, where you are from and what you are doing.
You are a pleasant apparition. Who are you?
The potion is ready. I should take it to Dumbutz now.
The plan worked so far. Let's see if the potion actually works.
Henry’s sister was upset about the news. Well, it's not surprising surprising. The poor woman...
There you are again, and I see that you have been successful. Don't you just love it when a plan works?
I'll hold down the fort here! Don't worry! We won't let any attackers into the city! You can bet your life on that. Or... maybe that's not such a good idea.
... and here's number three. These should be fine. I hope the magician agrees.
Summons stone spirits that attack nearby enemies and explode
You have to abide the law as well, renegade!
Old Ompha is suffering from temporary memory loss. Apparently the only thing that can help him is a bottle of “miracle cure.”
Don't you ever have the time to fight for something different?
You have a lot of scars. The wounds that left them must have hurt.
You sure have a lot of adventure stories to tell.
Would you help me? I am so hungry!
Are you rich? I've never seen a rich person.
Let's go. The sooner I'm free of my debts, the better!
If only you could sell one or another for experiments!
For us, every spermatozoa is holy. The evangelic are better off.
Pretty soon this will be one big kindergarten, but one surrounded by a thick wall.
Maybe we should keep the boys away from the girls.
I heard that the nobles distribute strange little hats made from goatskin.
The other night I was startled to hear the neighbor's son say "It's me Caspar." They're not young children anymore.
I think that's the way it's supposed to be. The children help us with work after all.
I know what you mean, two more kids and I'll break my record from last year!
Children! You love them and you hate them, but above all you beat them regularly.
Maybe we could stick pointy ears on some of them so they can lead a better life.
Joana was happy that there was nothing blocking her future with Omero anymore. Although I'm sure she's secretly disappointed by her father's actions. She'll run the business with her lover's help.
I cannot feel my legs anymore...
I understand. I will not, UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES, speak to Mr. Giles.

The innkeeper in the Human village gave me some valuable information. According to him, the Elven expedition started out from this village several months ago. They hired a man called Jaftar as a guide. He lives in a small village not far to the west. I should go there and see if I can find out something more.
Pray to Kuan to learn the true secrets of combat.

I will help you, but you have to kill the Carnach first

What do you want from me? Assistance in your “battle”? Don't be a fool! Why would I care about you or your goals? I come from another dimension, outside of this creation. The religious squabbles of this world do not interest me. Nothing and nobody from your dimension can compete with my power.
There is however one other creature from another dimension... it's the Carnach. He has learned to use the magic energy that flows through this world. With this additional knowledge his power could one day rival my own. I have lived to my ripe old age by never letting that happen, so I’ll offer you a deal. If you kill the Carnach, I’ll tell you where you can find the answers to your questions. On top of that, I might even allow the Humans in my pantry to worship your precious Ker. It matters not to me what these creatures believe.
What a strange place! These seem to be the souls of the dead. They look harmless enough. Maybe I can talk to them.

Cowardly as his people are, the Kobold is just crouching down while the skeletons prepare to finish him off. They don't seem to be afraid of his fire. If I don't save him I'll never find out about it...
I hate artificial gardens. They are supposed to be nice, but all of the things wild and free are cut down!
Dead people belong in the graveyard!
Don't get too close to me, undead thing!
You should have stayed in your grave!
Shadow Warrior, you have no business being here!
Have you forgotten that you were a Human once?
Who do you think you are?
How dare you come close to me.
You're not even worth being killed by my guards.
Make way, or I'll throw you in the dungeon.
Don't you know who I am?
You smell worse than a polecat! Does the word “soap” mean anything to you?

Here is a copy of “Irrelevant Ancarian Tall Tales”!
Mysterious flying machine disappears in the mountains! Would you like to read more? I can give you a sample if you like.
How could this have happened? What shall I tell my children?
It seems some criminal elements are using children as slaves. The poor kids... I have to do something.
What will I do without him?
I'll loose no sleep over killing the likes of you.
I struck a deal with the rabbit. I gave him an apple for the carrot. Now I can get the other things.
If you want to take this with you, carry it yourself!
The grass is poor this year, and the horses are undernourished.
Maybe the lord has a crust of bread for my little ones? Or perhaps some gold?
Please keep moving. You are a nice guy, but I don't consort with poor fellows.
You have a good heart, I can see that.
Ah! Yes, thanks! Now that I have the heads, I can get to work.
We Seraphim do not carry items like this.
Ker? Pfff - she can't calm storms either.
Has Ker taught you to swim, Inquisitor?
There's no room for pious Hypocrites on this ship.
We will use your robe as canvas.
Well, I got the branches. There's a little blood left on one of it, but I don't think that counts as desecrated.
The rustling of the trees in the night is like music to my ears.
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Astral Lord and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
The woman's dead. May she rest in peace.
Five heads of cultist shamans, as asked. This one's got a strange nose, but that won't matter. I'll take them to the commander now.
Even if you are well known - I don't think too highly of you.
Spare our children, mistress - I beg of you!
You really are as beautiful and appalling as the stories make you out to be.

T'Pargan, the Orc shaman needs a fat rat, so that it can be sacrificed to the Great Rat by his clan. If he doesn't get a rat for the sacrifice, the clan will sacrifice him instead! Some sort of ritual thing. Anyway, he seems pretty distraught.
I have something important I have to take care of...
I'm not ready to die yet!
There is no escaping my wrath!
I don't want any of them to get away!
Let them have it - you get to choose what “it” should be!
Kelsior was happy and has rewarded me handsomely. He's really looking forward to the festival now.

Find my fiancé in the desert!

I'm desperate! My fiancé Salomer hasn't returned from a dangerous mission. His commander has already called off the search, but I won't give up so easily. Could you look for him? I'm sorry but I don't have much to give you in return.
Couldn't we try to confuse them with an escape attempt?
I have to take the wool to the weaver who lives nearby.

Did you take care of everything, of my lord? And what about my money?

Stop! What are you doing? Noooooo...!!!
I am satisfied with your performance.
I tell it like it is. We can't afford any whiners, it's affecting morale.
Don't talk about pain, please. My head is still ringing from that big ogre club.
Nobody ever said war was easy, better get used to it.
There are worse things than a few gaping wounds. At least they remind you of your mistakes.
Stop moaning. As long as our enemies can't moan everything is fine.
I used to have really romantic ideas about the life of a soldier, but that was 215 wounds ago.
What can I say? Every bone in my body has been broken at least once by the enemy, yet here I am.
Sure it's bad, but like they say: You have to break a few heads to make an omelet. That's just how it is.
Wounds are the icing on the cake. They make you realize how much pain your enemy is in.
I don't worry about the price we pay for our bloody craft. No risk, no reward.

My plan worked out, she fell for that story about the other love. Thendra wants me to kill some slaves working for Omero's family. That's good! I prefer woodcutters dead too. Two birds with one stone!
Wow, thanks a lot! Those wolves looked really dangerous.
I am resistant to the tricks of magical experts.
This is your chance to teach your men a new lesson: dying.

Inside the “Drunken Elf”, a man named Liosilath told me the so-called taxes were really just a bribe and that the entire government is corrupt. He said if I wanted to do some good, I should give the jewels to some teachers on the northwestern edge of town. He also hinted at more adventure if I meet him at the Academy afterwards.
A magic blade for the one who brings me the head!
That's a good opponent ... maybe too good.

Keeper of the Temple
A problem well stated is a problem half solved.

- Kettering
I have to capture twenty escaped Humans and return them to the Dragon. Will you help me?
I read the message. The only secret in it refers to a daughter of Lord Alcander who was born out of wedlock. I will take the letter to the captain, just as Lord Alcander asked.

Lieutenant Taen gave me an important mission. I have to eliminate the bodyguard of Lady Delyme. The Lady's not playing fair and she's secretly working for the Inquisitors. The death of her bodyguard should be a warning for her.
The two will arrive by ship soon...
You're so ugly, you could be a modern art masterpiece!

Gather 15 identity disks from the undead soldiers and take them to the ritual master in the village south of here!

A long time ago there was a huge battle in this area. Lizardmen against Humans or something, who knows. Nobody is sure anymore. There are hordes of undead soldiers that roam this place, and their identification disks would be perfect for memorial shrines! The dead will find their eternal peace if we commemorate them. Please go and take 15 identification disks to the ritual master in the south.
This must be the place. There's nothing here that looks like it's worth studying, but who cares. Fangil still doesn't seem to be here. I better wait for a while.

Farmer Spirli asked me to find out why he's having trouble with one of his fields.  The few things that grow at all are rotten. I should talk to Old Lebbart, he's been living here for almost a hundred years so might know something about that land.
A speaking gecko? Can you fetch also?
Be quiet, so the guards won't hear us.
What are you doing here? There are no forests in this place!
A High Elf that lives in trees - how cute!
Come here and defend yourself, you Elf mongrel!
Even after all those years in the forest, you are still nothing but a High Elf!
I know you, you hussy! You work in one of those vile bawdy houses, don't you?
Good Father, what else could I do? I have five hungry mouths to feed!
Well then, you should have been more careful who you consorted with! God's punishment awaits you, sinner!
He already has punished me, oh good Priest!
Ha! Just wait and see what tortures await you in hell!
It can't be much worse than the treatment I get from the innkeeper and my guests.
Burning hot irons and endless tortures await! And that's just the program for the first year entrants!
I will suffer my fate bravely. Farewell.
What business does an Elf have in our territory?
We won't kill you right away, Elf...
Elven witch, now you're in for it!
We already know your magic tricks, Elf!
We'll throw you into the dungeon!
Remember that toad eyes or snake eggs are sought after by alchemists in the swamp region.

Take the head to Saerdna El!

Ah! Back already? Good! It will be a hard game for us this year. Brockul has broken his nose and Hatzur is still lying in a coma at the inn. Four of our defenders have diarrhea and haven't been seen for days. We'll have to field a skeleton crew. Luckily, the shaman and I have come up with a cunning plan! Take this Troll head to our shaman Saerdna El. He will dye it green and make a real Nargutz ball out of it.
If only I were a little more like you - then I'd already feel better.
Surely you have some alms for me, fighter of the light.
You seem to be quite modest.
You won't get a monument in your hometown at this rate.
The healer was satisfied and went to work right away. He should be able to save many of lives now. He paid me with a poison cleansing artifact. A just reward.
That one looked tougher than he was.

Gravestone
I have a new philosophy. I'm only going to dread one day at a time.

Bring me five olm heads!

I don’t know about you, but I adore shrunken olm heads! In fact I’m a passionate collector! Shrinking olm heads is such a wonderful way to relax, when you’re pulling their brains out through the nose you just forget everything else around you. It’s almost transcendental.
Unfortunately I’ve run out of olm heads to shrink. I could hunt them myself, but as a Werewolf you tend to tear everything you catch to shreds! Perhaps you could give me a helping paw, ahem, hand? Bring me five olm heads.

Ah the letter! Thank you very much!

This is your parents' promissory note for your entire inheritance. They owe us 50.000 gold pieces for your education. That's a fair price for accepting the note instead of gold I'd say.

Of course you could buy the promissory note. For oh, let's say... 250.000 gold pieces. A special price for a friend. Oh I see you've even got a down payment with you. This is your baptismal necklace, isn't it?

Daily Round

Orc merchant Kales has made some enemies. His adversaries claim that he has been doing business with rivaling Orc clans. Now they have sent an assassin after him. He has no intention of being intimidated though and has asked me to escort him during his daily round.

Kill ten undead at the old port!

We rarely hire mercenaries, but in this case it's necessary! We have a small problem with some waterlogged bodies that keep rising again. They're undead you see. My men aren't brave enough to take action against them, but if they saw you kill ten of the undead creatures I'm sure it would stir up their courage. If you do this task well, it won't be the last job I have for you.
I will turn you off now!
The weapon for fire damage doesn't do me any good.
It's you! I've heard about you. I am Monwarion and it is my job to manage this facility. Let's see, perhaps I have another assignment for you.
Well, that uniform really suits you!

The cursed Elves have set a price on some of our heads! Perhaps I should try to earn it?
I feel like a lousy brigand since they put a price on my head. But what can you do?

Did you hear that the stinking Elves pay anyone who kills our brothers?
Those cursed Humans and lousy Elves! Now they're even offering a bounty for our heads!
As if we were nothing but murderers! There's a reward for everyone who kills one of our brothers!
What will the future bring now that they're hunting us like regular murderers, and pay rewards for our heads? That's unworthy!

Nionake's ghost told me a hiding place where she kept a few things. Originally, they were meant to be gifts for her sisters. However, they missed their chance. It looks like I am an only heir now.
I know it's not polite to speak ill of the dead, but these men didn't deserve to be called guards.

Take Glydial with you, then you'll be able to worm your way into the DeElfici family. From now on, we'll be better prepared.
You don't want to? The Elves aren't robbers? Then you have to die!
No! What did you do! How terrible!
I must admit I underestimated you. Most novices would have been well acquainted to the ground by now. But don't get your hopes up too soon! It's not over yet!
This mission is now complete. The guard was happy that vengeance had been served.
Go back to your Temple, or you'll regret it!
The novelty has almost worn off, thing!
Once you have found out who it is, please let me know. This is a small village and we all know each other. It would be interesting to know...
I can't handle this creature yet.

So you made it? Great! I knew I could count on you. Here's your reward, take it, it's well deserved. I'll have to prepare the cattle for the trip now. Thanks again, bye!
I'm a warrior, so don't bother me Kobold!
Don't you dare touch me, disgusting lizard!
We continued our journey after we found the sarcophagus. The archaeologist is relentless.
They are really fast when running away is required.
A copy of the book might be somewhere in the library of an abandoned monastery. The disciple has asked me to accompany him there.
Listen, behind the Temple there's a wonderful place to relax in the setting sun.
Did you hear that there will be special winds in the mountains?

When the winter has been mild, there are lots of insects in the summer.

The fool is dead. His gold is mine now.
You've got nothing on me, you mutant!
I think we should be much more tolerant! That's the only way to prevent the conflict!
Don't make me laugh! We should fight against the heretics by all means necessary, and I do mean ALL means.
I think this conflict is making a mountain out of a mole hill! I really hope that we'll find a peaceful way to reconcile!
There's only one faith, and our forefathers have set the example for a long time - you know that!

We have to avoid a separation, that's my opinion! The ancestors would never forgive us!
Without the unity of the faith we'll all go down, and I tell you that as a true believer!

My carrot! I have 170 children and more are on the way. They want to eat. Do YOU have any idea how hard it is to feed so many mouths? Bring me a replacement, then you get the carrot. Otherwise no deal.

Thus, we are patiently waiting for the day when he will finally return, the day when our duty will be fulfilled.

Well there’s the money. Like the Inquisitor said: It is better to give than to receive. Here is your reward. You can earn even more, if associating with that kind of vermin doesn't bother you. I have to go to my daughter’s birthday celebration. In the meantime, go to the debtors and collect my gold!
I'm going to suck up your energy!
Nature or not, you shall not block my way.

The trader was suspicious at first. He wouldn't give me any trollcherries until I lied to his face and told him that the cherries were for me. That swill brewer seems to have a lot of debts. Turrus certainly didn’t have much good to say about him.
Oh, a Kobold, I'm so afraid ...
I'm in a little hurry right now!
Thousand Gods! I nearly forget the time.
This was a nice conversation, but I have to take my leave now.
I'm reluctant to leave you, but I've got no other choice.
This meeting was very inspiring, but my time's come and I have to go!
I've got to hurry now because there are a lot of things that need my attention.
I'm already looking forward to seeing you again! Please excuse me now.
I have to keep an eye on the time. Oh, the normal course of life draws me in again!
May all Gods look fondly down on you! Farewell!
This conversation was very uplifting. Please excuse me now.
The witch has paid me well. And who cares about a dead hermit anyway?
Thank you, thank you very much. I'm happy that I was able to help you.
Talk to the captain to initiate a sea journey.

Bring me some Hydra tongues!

Please... bring me... tongues... Hydra...! Or... have to...
Hurry!
Alright... Ali will never set his thugs on anyone ever again.

Fetch me a perfect crystal!

I have another task for you, if you are interested. The winner of this contest will get a trophy. This time, I decided to get a crystal. They can sometimes be looted from one of the crystal monsters but my ankle is still swollen. Would you get me a perfect crystal?
Someone has to do something against that foul odor...
I have killed 200 crystal monsters. Nice round sum. Maybe it's something special to the seraphim.
I have given the oblations to the priest. He and the huntress then teleported away.
Lizards like yourself are way low on the evolution scale...

Defeat five Blood Dryads!

Very well. There’s one last task I have for you! Kill five Blood Dryads! If you succeed you can come back to me.
Well well, what do we have here? It certainly looks interesting!
A portion of these bloodthirsty barbarians have been defeated, but the battle is not won yet.
Ogril lives in the neighborhood. It's not far.

So that’s what it was all about! The Werewolves in these parts use Hydra tongues to stop themselves from transforming into wild and uncontrollable beasts. Perhaps this piece of information will come in handy one day.
I will await your return, my champion. Defend my honor!
I am so glad that I am merely passing through.
