Go to the fortress of the dead and seek out the Sheik!

I take it the commander doesn't know what to do anymore? So it's finally come to this.
Well the Sheik was once the leader of an allied tribe, but when his help was desperately needed he let the king down. As a result, a curse turned him and his warriors into undead until they have made up for this disgrace. The person who wishes to set them free must say this ancient saying to the Sheik's face: “Fulfill your obligation, Sheik Yerbouti!” Then the undead will obey! There's also a test, which no one has been able to pass yet.
Go to the fortress if you want to try your luck!
Damn ... looks like you are a serious opponent!
Do you wish to tell me something? Then speak clearly and stop drooling!

Ralph Roder
Coach, what can we do?
A fight broke out and we had to slay the mummy. We found the amulet while we were doing this.
Do I really get points for you, weakling?
My voice is not what it used to be.
My instrument and I are not in tune today.
I sing songs about the meaning of these meaningless times.
Singing is not an art that will make you rich.
A cheerful dance tune now and then raises the spirits.
Women are always are the losers in war - and it doesn't matter which side they are on.
Do you think this constant fighting could make a person to lose their mind?
The fearful don't even need to bother going to war, do they?
One has to be very brave and strong to face mighty adversaries, right?
They say that one who's a clever speaker is also a clever fighter. Do you think that's true?
So I WAS right! I knew it! But..urgggh! It’s revolting! I’ll get nightmares from this! I don’t care what my father thinks anymore, I just want to forget the whole thing!
You are nothing but a murderer!
We have more in common than you would like to admit!
You are a slave to evil!
“Drunken Elf” ... the clue is in the name.
I find taverns distasteful... but oh well.
To the tavern? Among the drunken mob? Disgusting!
A Seraphim in a tavern? And you think nobody will notice?
In the tavern? At this time of day? What will people think of me?
What do you mean by bribing? I won't bribe anybody!
Thank you! I am eternally in your debt. Take this. It's not gold, but it's not worthless either.
I'm glad you're familiar with such things.
He wants to tell ME how to protect myself from dragons? ME? Ha! That's going to be fun!
The librarian, again! They're pulling out all the stops for me!
It is because this librarian ... It does not matter. I am already on my way.
I was afraid that I hadn't seen the last of that Mr. Giles.
I had a feeling that it wouldn't be that last I heard from Mr. Giles.
I will try to talk to him even though he speaks in incomprehensible metaphors.
What are you chewing, fellow? You seem to like it very much.
Yes, good. Dried Human. We cook on stick.
Humans? No, I don't like them. They're fat and taste bitter.
Humans? Humans yum! Stupid Orc stringy. No good food.
Your tastes are quite strange. I'm losing my appetite.
I hungry all time! Troll needs eat. Much fight make hungry.
Don't look at me so greedily! I have to go now, and I've got no time for you!
Oh, sad! Nice Ogre no eat with Troll.
Oh, I guess that means I'm an honorary Orc now.
Dryads, you are not above order!
Any Hero has sold 30 magic items.
Decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Source Warden and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Several conniving lumberjacks have sold inferior wood to the poor merchant. He wants me to teach them a lesson. Well, I will show them that I am anything but inferior!

We come to the first stage of our journey: the pitiful remains of an old stone bridge.
That tells me that we're going in the right direction. This bridge is mentioned in the ancient text.
Go, dogs! There's company on its way!

There's a Human settlement not far from here. You will find someone there who knows how to create a protective amulet.

Well done. My master is extremely satisfied. He told me to bring you your reward. Unfortunately, he doesn't know the direct route to the old Dragon Mer-Kil's lair. Dragons have their own secret paths for visiting each other.
There's a small outpost near here. The people there know the path to the old Dragon. I see you have a heartscale, they also know the ritual of creating an amulet of protection from it. They might not be exactly cooperative, but I'll wager threatening to reveal their location to the local Dragon would change their minds. Most people don't fancy the idea of being the main course in a Dragon's dinner.

Thank you for your help. They wanted to slit my throat.

There is more for you to do down in the basement.
Go to the trader and clear up your business.
Morning draws near, and I grow more tired by the minute.
I don't want anything from you. Get lost!
Get all your energy out in battle - then you won't have to bother any innocent people.
Concentrate on your mission, and leave me in peace!
I beat back the attack of the enemy troops.
Lately killing doesn't make me completely happy anymore.
Why no happy? Goblin kill good, why no like?
Maybe I've been doing this for too long. Once blood meant a lot to me, oh yeah.
Kill good! Always work, and much kill make fame.
Be that as it may, there has to be something else beyond the slaughtering.
Eat! Eat good too! Kill, eat, live good!
I think you're the wrong person for this kind of conversation. If we had clerics, I'd talk with one of them about this.
Troll go now! Kill, eat dinner.

Gravestone
Gene Roddenberry
RIP and thanks for boldly going where no man went before...
Ok if everybody's ready we can go ahead and start! You're our guest of honor of course. Have a good time at the concert!
You should watch your blood pressure.
Village is a euphemism for this ridiculous collection of huts.
Is it possible we know each other? All joking aside, you block my way. Yield to my might!
In order to use that thing, I'll have to separate a few more heads from their necks.
Cemil agrees and has started cooking. He's asked me to tell his family.
The spirits are the Goddess' children! I think that they often take care of us for her.
They're good spirits you know! They're often a bit mischievous but they are always there when we need them.
The plant spirits are the reincarnation of the Goddess! That's why we must treat them with respect.
Many doubt that the spirits' intentions are good, but they have a great sense of humor.
I have met a few of these spirits myself! Even though I don't share their sense of humor, they are still our friends!
In any case they are good spirits that dwell in all living things in nature. No one needs to fear them.
Unfortunately they rarely reveal their true selves, but I can assure you that their intentions are good.
The plant spirits are good beings through and through! They form the core of our nature!
They are misunderstood creatures that were sent by the Goddess herself to protect her creations.
They exist, and that is a miracle in itself! We should rejoice in their Godly existence!
Wealth is nothing to be ashamed of.
A sunny day such as this does indeed lift one's spirits.
We live in such wicked times! One always has to be on the lookout for those thieving scoundrels!
Perhaps I could drop by the inn for a thimble of wine or two?
I mean honestly, would you ever want to be poor again?
Can gold make people happy? Yes, indeed!
I am more interested in philosophical matters than questions of religion.
That's enough laziness for one day! Now I need a break!
A new gown would please my dear wife.
Welcome to Dyr-Lain. Please feel free to have a look around.
You seem to have had hard times lately...
I have to go - but I wish you good luck!
Do I know you? But from where?
You found our balloon! Thank you very much!
Peace has been restored. Who knows how long it will last...

Kill five cultists.

That cult is simply intolerable! We’ve let them have their way for long enough! Half of my tribe has run off to join them so far. It’s got to stop I say! Blood! I want blood, and lots of it!
In the name of our families and hallowed traditions, kill five cultists and bring me their heads!

Well... where do I start? My life has always been difficult. I was raised by my mother and I never met my father. Mother always said that he was a big nosed weasel, but she wasn't really very objective on the subject. I think.
What are you doing here? We only seek justice and I want my poor husband back. You don't need a weapon here, we can settle this with words and come to an agreement.
The people here have lost their hope.
How do you find the strength to not lose hope, in times of need?
Do you swing between high and low emotions often too?
Do you rule your emotions, or do they rule you?
Welcome to our lands, beautiful woman.

Kill Marin, one of Goldman's guards.
So you want to get your hands on Goldman? Very well. One of his guards owes me money. He's waited too long to repay me, so now his number is up. I lend money and I expect it back on time with interest! Go and kill Marin.
Ah you're back! Did everything go ok? Very good! Here, this is your reward!

Dundiel sang like a bird. He admitted that Ophtanar was only using the cult to make himself rich. Ophtanar plotted to trick his followers and escape with his riches. I will take Dundiel to Waton so that he can judge things for himself.
Good work! I'm pleased with you.
Marin is dead and Aaron is satisfied with my work. I think I have made some friends among the thieves now.
Warhorses - these horses are for warriors, not the frying pan!
Calm and formidable-looking horses sell best.
I haven't sold so much as a donkey today.
Witches' Light Water gives horse's teeth a younger appearance.
Even an old nag will earn a few gold coins if she's well-groomed.
A little pepper up the backside will put some spirit into any horse.
The horses are well-trained and good-natured.
The competition never sleeps - unlike my slaves...
As far as some of these horses are concerned, I will be happy if they bring in enough gold to pay for their food.

Excellent!
There is nothing I can teach you anymore. You have learned all that can be taught. It is up to you to uncover the remaining secrets of magic.

You may leave this academy, I am discharging you. Go, magician, and bear this title with pride!
The next settlement is not far from here. Perhaps you will find an opportunity to use your abilities to benefit the Elves in that village.
I'm preoccupied with other things at the moment.
Indulge yourselves, I cannot use this...
Mission accomplished. Let's hope the brigand's plan works.
I accept the challenge. You can count on me.
Mirshirla wants me to escort him to the next base. An attack is imminent. Maybe the undead in the base know how the souls of the mages can be destroyed.
Even though I never said “I'm bored,“ the officer assigned me another task. I'm supposed to kill a mutated Black Bear that is living in a strategically important canyon nearby.
I haven't seen you in a long time. You must be very busy.
Oh yes, since I started selling my jewellery to the Elves, I can hardly keep up.
That's interesting. Do they like your jewellery collection that much?
That's an understatement, my dear. The women just love it.
May I ask what materials you use?
Well, mainly the heads and wing bones of turkeys and vultures. The Elves call it “wild fashion.”
I wish you many more sales.

I can return to Ademaya now that I have convinced five townsfolk to take up the faith.
What a great idea! Schools are needed everywhere.
Wendelin sent you? What do you have for me? Oh... a scroll! Hm... this looks very interesting, that's about all I can say for now. Give me a little time, I will analyze the scroll.
The hunters have finally acknowledged my talents! They've given me a hunting knife which marks me as one of their own. What an honor!
Fine! Will she also read my palm and tell my fortune?
My destiny ... I've always been interested in that.
Puh! I hadn't even gotten warmed up.
My destiny? I don't think there's really any doubt about my destiny.
That's how fast an opinion can change.
He will need my help. So what are we waiting for?
Further decreases the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.
The field surgeon arrived safely at Gisbert's home. That's my good deed for today!
High Elves...! The most degenerated creatures of Ancaria.
The wounds on the dead garema are the same as on the first corpse. I also found a dagger. Maybe the scout can tell me something about it.

Back from the angels, are you? Did you get some good advice? They’re always tight-lipped when the likes of us are near them. Well, nevermind. It’s the dragon territory you’re bound for, eh? Dangerous plan. No armor strong enough to withstand a dragon’s fire, you know. What you need is an amulet made of dragon heartscales. Hard to come by, but before I faced an old Dragon in his lair, I’d be sure to be wearing one of those.
Weapons and equipment keep disappearing from the armory lately. I'm supposed to find out who is behind it. First I have to go meet an informant.
You appear to be an interesting opponent.
You see, that wasn't sooo bad after all!
I will teach these swines that you do not lay hands on children!
How much is the bet that this Goblin will make an excellent rocket?
We have to hurry and leave this cemetery before more undead start to show up.
Get into the shadows, you little rat!
I hate cities! How can you possibly exist here?
The assistant was here. I sent him to the archives down in the catacombs, because he was looking for a very old book.
I found the assistant. He is lying dead on the floor, but has the book in his possession. I should take it to Dr. Faust.

Talk to Milrinda!

Well, well! I thought so! Milrindas results are wrong. Looks like the little rat ... uhm, sister ... made a mistake. Please go and talk to her, so I can correct her error.
The main things is to be healthy! That's what I say. What do you think?
Warning: all other items will be destroyed.
Well I never, I lost again! I'm having terribly bad luck!
If only I had listened to my wife...
You turn your back for one second...
This had to happen three days before my birthday...
I see a bright light. I think I'll move towards it.
I think I'm going to barf.
Look! It's the holy goblet! And the holy water vials! Almost everything is even undamaged. Thank you! Take this as a sign of my gratitude.
No, I don't really have any special plans today. Take your time.
A few Temple Guardians tried to stop me but they failed. Proceed to path into the desert.
For one meal, I would even marry you.
My fate is bad enough - and now you show up...
I don't think that I like you...
Time to make your final exit, ghost!
Thanks for the information and have fun with your orc friends.
Good, is that everything? Or is there anything else you would like to say to me before you rot away here.
That's all I wanted to know. Take care and stay away from bad company.
The Seraphim ...! *sighs* Well, it's worth a try.
I hope the rest of your life will be pleasant.
That's all I need to know. Have fun with your green friends here.
Next time, I will heal you.
Oh the little fuzz ball has turned into a full-grown bear.
The leader of the Iron Blaze Gang is dead.

Order some lukewarm lumpy swill from Fangor!

Hey you! I need some help here! We’ve run out of lukewarm lumpy swill. It’s all gone! What am I supposed to serve with the slimy gobs and goo? You can't serve gobs without swill! Go to Fangor the swill brewer and order a few barrels. Tell him to put it on my account.
What do you want here machine?
Stupid machine, it will get dark soon.
You have to obey a lady, machine!
I order you to lay down your weapons machine.
You never should have left your Temple, Guardian.
I have defeated the poltergeists, it was child’s play really.
This water is contaminated. No wonder those sheep turned into beasts.
Now small Simon is off to gather a new pouch of crystal dust. Maybe this time, he will be successful.
Hey you! Getting old is inevitable, but stopping play is optional.
Yes! That’s my shampoo! Fantastic! I can hardly wait to have a clean and shiny coat again!
Please take this letter to TyBosso DeElfici!
It would be better if you looked for things that I can use!

I need sulfurous ashes!

I'm afraid we are not done disposing of the cursed armor. The remains must be thrown into a pit and covered with sulfurous ashes. This is the only way to prevent suffering the wrath of the destroyed armor. Whatever that means. I read it in an old book, and I think I don't really want to know.
There are a few grottoes nearby. You should find sulfurous ash there. Would you ..?! It's the last time I ask for your help! Promise!
Blast! The field surgeon is dead! Now Gisbert will get gangrene and the commander will lose at poker.
The squire was glad to receive the lumps and he will fertilize his fields with them. Time will tell, whether they will save his crops.

Get me jade from the mine in the mountains!

What will these highborn fools think of next? They've grown tired of rubies and diamonds, and now they want jade. Jade, jade, jade! So the baroness tells me: “Jeweler Finebond, make me a jade collier. It's embarrassing for a baroness to be seen without one.” What's next? Jewelry made of pachyderm teeth or hardened resin? And where am I supposed to find jade? The only place I know is a mine in the mountains, but I've heard that outlaws live there. Maybe you could get me some jade from the mine.
You eco freaks are the same everywhere. You act the big shot at home, but when push comes to shove, you play possum.
I've finished these off now too, I wonder if that was the last of them?
Warmth and heat damage my magic wand's strength.
Confound it! The merchant stuck me with an inaccurate scale!
Upon my soul! Some mixtures make funny popping sounds.
My studies have shown that alchemy is hogwash.
I know how to mix salves.
I'm writing an encyclopaedia of love spells.
I can create mixtures out of my many herbs.
I'm working on a mineral potion for our warriors.
The neighborhood witch teases me incessantly by calling me a bookworm.
There are moments in life when you wish you had more control over your own actions - and I think this is one of them.
You kill enemies, me make you strong!
How rude! You could've waited for me.
Couldn't they have waited for me before they started the slaughtering?
Yes, sure, now get out of my way.
Well, why did you fools have to start without me?
Good, I'll slay a few more folks along the way.
They have started without me? How rude!
Ambul, or rather what was left of him, and his spirits have been destroyed. Who am I supposed to tell about this? Maybe it's best if I don't tell anyone, the important thing is that it's over.

I have been reading books and listening to senile men while pretending to be interested for far too long. I have achieved what I wanted to achieve - learned what I was eager to know.

My time has come, I have the world at my feet. My powers are great and I am not afraid to use them.
My task is to get the "uninvited guests" out of Lord Alcander's summer residence.
I will be right with you!
I hope you have more talent than courage...
We will continue this some other time!
I... have to go to... a parent's conference.
Today is that scientist’s lucky day. I will spare his life.
We are the guardians of the Temple, but we won't try and stand in your way, my lord.
The dark forces have a name - yours.
Your arrival does not bode well, warrior.
Mage rewarded me, now preparing for examination of TyBosso's possessions.
These new tree parasites keep worrying me more and more.
How bad can it be? So far our Priests have always found an effective cure.
True, but this case calls for quick action. The damage is considerable.
Calm down. Do the little beasts really eat that fast?
Little beasts? That's just the problem, their shoulder height is a good eight feet.
Holy Goddess! Let's call all the Priests here! Quickly!
I've already done that. Just calm down!
I hope these monsters can be stopped before we all lose the roofs over our heads.
You're not bad, but you are still an amateur!
You might have killed just one too many ...
The wickedness is written all over your face!
The blood on your hands is still wet!

I can give you the goods. Before I do I have a little assignment I'd like you to take care of. Please find my mangy mutt and kill him. He just bit me and he's going to pay for that! Bring me his teeth as proof!
It would appear that some of their accomplices are hiding out in that cave over there.
I told the archaeologist the good news. The wild sand people have been dealt with. In return he gave me a strange but surely valuable artifact.

The ghostlike village elder was glad to hear about my success. He asked me to go south to find the reason for this eternal night. Whatever killed this people came from there. There might be a connection to the darkness.
Cities are nature's defeat carved in stone!
Shall we seal it in blood ... I mean ... ink?
Uh oh! What a bad atmosphere! Maybe I should talk to Khormynth again.
Where can you get that XXXXL-armour?
If you carry on like this, you'll be a legendary hero sometime.
Move on, sir! You'll find your way without me.
Oh, it's you? I really like potential heroes.

Find my brother!

My brother has been missing for several days, I hope nothing has happened to him. Could you look for him for me? He is wearing an amulet with three jewels, an heirloom from our father. That's how you'll be able to recognize him.
Only fleeing enemies are good enemies.
Next time you muck out the stables, even a nobleman should be able to eat from their floors, slave woman!
I was in a big hurry, noble Elven Lord! My children were sick and called for me impatiently.
Why do you slave worms have to reproduce yourselves so quickly?
We love our children like you love yours, Elven Lord! You'll never have reason again to find fault with my work.
I hope so, for your sake, you lazy thing! I want my farm to be the cleanest of all of them!
I'll get the stables cleaned real good today!
Crawl away already and get to your work. You disgust me!
Thank you, oh kind hearted lord!
I have killed all the men. Hopefully the women will follow me willingly - they will if they know what's good for them!
Take a good look at what your brothers taught me.
Keltar is now the sole heir of the family fortune. And I will finally get my reward.
A nice day for the ceremony, don't you think?
As if our forefathers planned it this way! How nice to see you!
Oh, spiritual brother! I'm so happy to see you!
Wonderful, wonderful! We don't see each other as often as we should, brother!
That's the way to spend a day! How are you?
A true brother in faith! The forefather's greeting!
It's really a pleasure, my brother!
A believer meets a believer! What a wonderful coincidence!
This is a great pleasure! How are you?
Thank the ancestors that we meet again!
Warning: Do you really wish to reset your quest progress?
Please I beg of you. Help me and get those things for me!
Book 5: Guide for a Successful Feast
Book 3: How to Behave Around Dragons
Book 2: How to Deal with Undead? A Guideline
