We have to fall back and get reinforcements.
Retreat - the enemy is too powerful.
Run, sisters - we have been defeated.

Thank you for the medicine! You have arrived just in time. Now we can cure this plague! Would you be willing to take care of this? To contain the disease we have moved all the ill villagers to the waterside. Please give each of them some of the medicine.
I... I'm to weak to continue the hunt. You... must take over from me. Here, take the oblations I've so far collected... You still need to find three branches of raging Forest Spirits.
The nobles have fancy parties without paying tribute to the Gods! Did you hear that too?
The Elves must be really poor, how else can you explain the scanty clothing of their females?
The schools teach that the Elves descend from the apes. Isn't that unbelievable?
Now there's even an idea being passed around about a being made out of strings of durum wheat semolina. What's next?
Just yesterday I heard the noble Elves sing one of their slippery songs. They would do better to sing praises!
I can't stand this game that's so popular nowadays. Don't the Elves hold anything sacred anymore?
Instead of spending the whole day watching plays in the theater, the nobles should be spending their time praying, don't you agree?
Can't this degeneration be brought under control? It seems to be hopeless!
When I see how happy the nobles are the whole day long - that can't lead to their salvation, can it?
To do nothing but get drunk, eat without end and fornicate - where is the future in that lifestyle?
Be careful. Strange people are lurking about here.
Don't ask me any questions. I have to work!
Hey - be careful here! And behave yourself!
Keep going - you're only in the way!

Gangith gave me some herbs that are supposed to help. Unfortunately he can't come himself because he is desperately needed in Hissil'Ta. I'm to take the herb to the Lizardmen, but this doesn't guarantee that they'll be healed.
Gleaming Plate Armor from Ahil Tar
Fight! Show me what you've got!
I heard that old Flintstone was killed on the street!
Yes, I was called to him, but there was nothing more I could do.
I knew that old Casanova. How could it have come to this?
Well, He wanted to go to a masked ball that evening, and had created an orc costume.
That nut! He always did have a strange sense of humour. What happened next?
He ran into a patrolman, and before he could identify himself, they'd already made him a head shorter.
His evening of fun was cut off quickly then... A tragic end.
I must start making funeral arrangements. Farewell.

The librarian said The Great Machine is a huge network of pipes, constantly draining magic energy from the world. Unfortunately, the location of the hub is lost. Maybe Sophia, the leader of the Seraphim, can tell me where it is.
Your license will expire in %d minutes.
How much longer will it take until animals are finally extinct?
I need better protection against physical damage.
It's none of your business, but I'm going down to the hill. Someone saw some big spiders there.
Well, that could be quite a banquet. Shall we go together?
Stay where you are, stupid! You'll only think of eating.
Why? What are you going to do with these beasts?
I'm going to catch a big one, then I'll train it as a mount.
What? These monsters are that big? Then I'll stay here. I've got some work to do.
You always were a pathetic coward! I'm only wasting my time with you!
Damage Conversion: Weapon Damage to Magic Damage
I'm sure you are a spoiled brat from the west-forest!

Orcs from another clan have insulted us! They must be punished. Speak to the spy in the village north of here.

You are the first sister-in-arms who is not of Orc origin. That is remarkable. I know you came to speak to our leader. Before we can allow that, you will have to prove your worth.
When we made our way here, Orcs from another Clan insulted us. We were in too much of a hurry to deal with them there and then. Go and kill them. But first, talk to our spy in the village north of here.
I should take care of the slavers, just as the mine owner asked me to.
The Pasha's bodyguard has been defeated, now let's get the boss of the arena!
Don't lose any more time please! Each grape I lose feels like I lost a drop of blood.

Did you really think I'd leave all the glory to you? I've always been your friend... well... at least I pretended to be your friend! I've always lived in your shadow, it's always been you who took all the glory. It's always been you who had the better grades in natural history, voodoo and hunting class! Always you, you, you! That's all over now, it's time for me to step out of your shadow!
I need better protection from frost damage.
The lists must be here somewhere.
Say hi to the Gods for me, and go to hell!
The weapon for magic damage does not help me here.
As long as the fighters agree, peace will reign! The Goddess relies on our resoluteness!
There's no need to worry! We will preserve unity and peace - with violence if necessary!
Dissenters? I eat them for breakfast, I can assure you! They should watch out for our arrows!
We've always resolved dissent about unity and peace with the blade!
Those who have the Goddess on their side have the power! Those cursed dimwits should remember that.
Lunatics and blasphemers! And you can believe one thing, we know how to keep the peace!
It won't come to that! We'll smoke out their compounds like wasp nests! You can be certain of that!
Even though I'm not interested in politics, I'm sure of one thing: Our leaders will find a way to give them a suitable answer.
Well, let me put it this way: Those who favor a different path than ours should avoid our blade!
Hah, the path of delusion is always paved with death and misery. We make sure of that!
I'm in the pirate's treasure chamber!
The ruins of the Lady's former villa apparently contain some of her husband's notes that document his plan for recapturing Crag Rock Valley. I'm going to get them.
Dying feels good doesn't it? Here's your antidote.
The moneylender deceived Thea, and now she can't pay him back. His thugs are already close. I will not stand for such an injustice!
That is supposed to be my mount? No way!
Let's take a look at your innards, Gnome.
A focused, forceful weapon attack directed against one target.

I'm supposed to chase the Kobolds out of Lienhart's pumpkin patch. He would also be happy if I could get him six Kobold hearts, so that he can whip up something delicious for his guests again. He makes pumpkin Kobold heart soup with them.

Bring me Elemental Essences!

It's pointless to hope for reinforcements now, so we have to protect ourselves. We need to cast a protective spell, but for that we must have the essences of the Elementals that are besieging us. Get four essences of each element, then we'll be able to cast a relatively stable protective shield.
Activate the monolith and heroes will reappear here when they die.

Causes ice damage and decreases opponents’ ice resistance within a certain radius. Allied players receive a bonus to fire resistance. If the combat art "Fiery Ember" is active within range, the spell with the higher level will cancel the weaker one.
Beautiful Orc woman, you're very strong and big. Have a nice day.
What do you want from me, nasty creature? I don't own anything that's worth stealing.
No, oh no! Not stealing. We are honest warriors, and you know that!
Are you trying to amuse me? You're nothing but sneaky fellows who want to make a killing. I don't trust you.
Oh, that's so sad. I just want to please the beautiful Orc woman, and she doesn't trust me.
You want to please me? Then cut yourself in two pieces.
Oh, how evil. Very evil. To cut myself! That hurts.
Now shove off, or else I'll clout you with my broom!
Your son doesn't take part in group hunts? Why is that?
Please don't start. I'm having enough trouble with him as it is.
Do you want to talk about it? Maybe I can help.
He doesn't hunt, he doesn't want to eat meat. What should I do?
Strange. Have you talked to him?
More than once. He claims a spirit told him to follow a path of non-violence.
That's a deadly path! He will fall prey to our enemies.
That's what I worry about. Well, I hope he'll come to his senses soon. Goodbye.
I get two hours per tree. And now I'm supposed to work faster!?
Where brutal strength has its way, neither branch nor bough shall longer sway!
At least I'm powerful and strong, that makes me popular with the ladies.
The poplar trees start to quiver and shake as soon as they see me.
An oak is real tough work...
Just a sip and you feel better.
Pieced together... Of course nothing could become of you.
Thank you. I've got my gold back. It won't bring my companions back to life, but at least something was saved. Well... here's the reward I promised.

Take Judriel's message to Romdreal, her beloved!

His tantalizing voice calls for me in darkest night and brightest day. I wish I could be with him and he with me. But fate's cruel claws have torn us apart. Him a servant of greater powers and me, a child of high blood. Will you be my love's messenger and sweeten my harem? Hurry, take him the words that I have written on this page.
That was close, but the Seraphim is safe.

Guardian of Souls
Why are there 5 syllables in the word 'monosyllabic'?
There are those who dance to the rhythm that is played to them, those who only dance to their own rhythm, and those who don't dance at all.
Prince Ross of Atherton is WATCHING YOU SLEEP.

Rumbolir has been dead and buried for over 150 years! His great-great-granddaughter Astina might still be able to vaguely remember him. At least they were glad to have the navigation crystals, even if they weren’t expecting them!
Kuan, the God of War, fills all opponents within reach with a blood rage. They are unable to distinguish between friend and foe rendering them easy prey for a true warrior.
The desert-dwellers were happy about TyBosso's generosity. I'll let him know.

Gravestone
I always wanted to be somebody, but now I realize I should have been more specific.
He could have fought a bit longer.
There, 10 Kobolds down. The commander will be very pleased with this victory.
We have to look for the Stone Warriors! We can stand up to them together.

And by a prudent flight and cunning save A life which valor could not, from the grave. A better buckler I can soon regain, But who can get another life again?
- Archilochus
I have to say one thing: You do know how to dispose of problems once and for all.
Curses he got away for now. Let's deal with Commander El'Duffi then.

The local nargutz team’s doctor, Floyd Blantis, has asked me to fetch an invincibility potion from Libatta the Witch

Entruag wants to make doubly sure that it will win the coming nargutz game. Libatta, the village witch, has concocted a potion that will make Entruag’s team invincible. Floyd asked me to collect the potion and deliver it, as inconspicuously as possible, to Dumbutz.
Hey player! The lifespan of a High Elf is approximately 580 years - far too short to be standing around doing nothing.

Bring me the elixirs that were ordered from the witch!

Greetings. Before you stands Hegiman the Mighty, master of the seven strikes, keeper of the twelve tactics. I am the last true sword champion of Ancaria, so do not anger me, otherwise you'll be lying in your own blood faster as you can say, "Yes, you're right, Grand Master Hegiman!"

I don't mean you any harm though, why would I? You surely aren't an opponent worthy of me. I'll even do you the honor of letting you do a service for me, you can pick something up from the healer witch. A while ago I ordered a few elixirs from her. They are meant for that new volunteer I'm training. We'll make up for his lack of talent with those elixirs. Hurry! Go and fetch those potions.
Elves - always getting in the way.
Prove that Inquisitors are really as good as they say.
A fight one on one - you'll lose!
All Elves are equal in death.
We're going to burn you, you Elf witch!
We are the masters of this land, Elf!
You are doomed, you sneaky Elf!
I've gotten involved in a family intrigue. The son of an assassinated Count asked me to take revenge on his father's murderer. The scoundrel took the throne after his bad deed.
The opponents in this region will not advance me further.
Pssst! Keep everything hush hush, alright?
T-Energy... It gives life and it destroys life.
You can't see me cause I closed my eyes! Haha!
Back to the pew with you!
My back only hurts when I move. Know what I mean?
Now that I have gathered enough mistletoe, I can take it to Charolus’ wife.

I’m really happy that you made this decision! My brothers thought you’d be much more patient. That’s a topic we’ve been arguing about for years now. We were wondering how patient heroes like you really are! My brothers thought they could occupy you with all kinds of different tasks for all eternity, but you’ve proven them wrong so I won the bet. I’m really happy about this so I’ll reward you well. Take this, and enjoy your stay on our island as long as it lasts!

According to the Inquisitor I met, the key mechanism is located on top of the hill. The troops of the Grand Inquisitor have conquered this hill and they are now defending it against the troops of Liosilath. The Inquisitor told me to fight my way through the battlefield and climb the hill.

Temple Servant
He who follows Ker follows the true faith.
What are you? And for how much longer?

I am accompanying a band of free Werewolves on a campaign against the Orcs. The Orcs have invaded the swamps and are killing all the Hydras. It's strange but these Werewolves really seem to like the Hydras. Everyone has different tastes I guess. Onward! To war!
I'll take this item to TyBosso, maybe he'll let me have it.
You were our last hope - what have you done. Now, they will kill each other. And all that because you failed...
Let's go. Let's not waste any more time.

Gravestone
Grimmhild
We will never forget her happy laughter. It happened on a bank holiday.
Thanks for your help! You sure know how to handle yourself in a fight. I could use someone like you.

Zumzumroot? Even I could have told him how dangerous that stuff is! Now I’m supposed to fix everything again, am I?
I’m not sure, but I think this tincture of rye-juice and rot mud should lessen the effect of the zumzumroot. Well, I think it will... We’ll soon see once you’ve given it to him.

Who? What? Aha!
Who are you? I’m sorry, but I’m rather busy. I’ve just had a brilliant idea and I must start work on this new creation immediately!
A potion of amnesia... it's a brilliant idea! Based on zumzumroot! Oh I’m such a smart fellow!
You won't get a monument in your hometown at this rate.
Oh, if only he could be here!
What are you? And for how much longer?
Mission accomplished. I collected my reward.
You Humans are rather primitive. And just as easy to kill!
I will marry him, but I definitely won't love my new husband!
Take pity on a poor woman.
Please give me some bread for my children - that would be very kind of you.
A beggar woman's life is depressing, I tell you!
Who are you? Are you generous?
Those who wind up here, will soon be able to put it behind them...

Temple Servant
Help us spreading Ker's fire.
According to page 37, section 2 of the instruction manual, this would exceed my maximum load.
Off to fight - even at night!
I found Theminius. Let's see what he has to tell me.

Right, you are supposed to prove yourself? Well, go and kill the prisoners then!

Here to prove you can fight, hmmm? Well then, let’s have a look at you. Turn! Oh my, yes! I’m thinking something in a green. Perhaps a Lizardman? The two of you would look lovely in the arena together. He’s not a forest green, you understand. More of a chartreuse? with just a hint of blue? Trust me, darling. I’m never wrong.
Not everything has been destroyed. You won't follow Mother Earth. Ahhhh.
Your mentor is demanding to see you.
You will pay with your life, heretic!
Lizards are not on my list of endangered species...
These Humans are resistant to learning...
The trail leads to Renik, the village Priest. Something sinister seems to lurk behind his pious facade. I have to find him, so I can solve Telwan's and Rina's problems.
In the academy I have learnt how to deactivate Temple Guardians.

Kill Warlady Darwagon and bring me her ring!

These dungeons are called the “Rooms of our Forefathers.” It is a fairly old building and consists of three blocks. The living quarters and prayer rooms are found in the main part. The leader of this band, a certain "Warlady Darwagon," resides in this large room in front of us. I've already managed to get ahold of the key that leads to the west wing of this facility. All you need are nimble fingers, quiet soles and someone attentive to keep watch. I'm prepared to give you the key... if you could do me a favor. The Warlady is wearing a very interesting ring, a ring that I would like. Bring it to me and the key is yours.

Get rid of the wolves that plundered our stocks!

Damn those beasts! Damn them all! They plundered almost my entire stock, those stinking ba... err beasts! Wolves! I saw them running with the expensive ham still dangling from their muzzles! Find them and get rid of them for me... all of them!
I have found the victims of the abduction but the Kobold leader does not want to let them go. Let's see who is more stubborn...
This path is not for your kind. This tree belongs to the ghosts, and the ghosts are going to keep it!
This region does not need a Guardian any more.
You mortal ones shouldn’t be traveling this plane, this is the realm of the ghosts and the deceased. We’ll correct that little problem right away...
The one who came from the desert - and died there too.
I could kill less than 16 monsters in the specified time. I wonder if that's enough.
I wonder how many of you I can kill with my combat art.
Curses! She got away from me again. She told me that she is on her way to see Sophia. I have to get to the highest Seraphim quickly to warn her.
In this region, I must be prepared for enemies that inflict poison damage.
Smoke from certain burned herbs can cause one to have visions.

Bring back our torches!

Welcome to Kuan's Temple. I’m Bee'Ter and this is D'Oright. We are Priests of this Temple. We plan to have our traditional torchlight procession in a few days, but we've got a problem!
Barny, our torch merchant, was attacked and robbed. We think that the fanatical Testa disciples are behind it, that they want to ruin our torchlight procession.
Please go and try to get our torches back. If you succeed Kuan's blessing awaits you!
It seems that eating dreamberries turns your tongue  blue and turns you into a berserker. The last dreamberry bushes on the island were all burned following a similar episode some years ago.

There are some things lying around here. I'd better take it all, account books, his amulet, some money. It can't hurt.

I'll return to the Temple to inform the Priests there... I'm sure they'll take over the trading post.

Go talk to TyBosso!

A Dryad? Here? Well you could help us and earn a lot of gold while doing so. TyBosso is interested in trees. The thicker the better. With your skills it should be easy to find the thickest trees in the woods. Just talk to him! I'm sure he'll welcome a real expert like you.
The Priest was happy, and I hope Lumen will be happy too.
Ha! As soon as I appear on the scene, my opponents run away!
We have annihilated the spiders. I will speak with the farmer again now.
I have to admit that my explanations were a bit complicated. In a nutshell: go and slay a flaming horse.
Good news: you don't have to wait for the man with the scythe...
Pious servants such as you bore me!
The Lizardmen have thanked me. It's an uplifting feeling to save the live of innocent people.
Your carpace won't save you, creature!
Like I predicted. A few good arguments were sufficient to make him talk. Well then ... let's see ...

I've paid Kendrel's neighbor Timplo a visit. The old fool wants me to bring his wife a basket. Hmm, I wonder what would happen if Timplo's wife was the victim of a mysterious murder and someone claimed to see Kendrel at the scene of the crime. It's a perfect plan!
Help! The guards intend to kill us.
I'll have to pay a visit to a merchant first.
You will not have the triumph!
My existence is about to end!
My sensors indicate that you are an Elf, no matter what you say!
How do you survive without your bonsai to keep you warm at night?
So you are a Dryad. I expected you to be taller.
The stars are not in your favor today!
All you need are some sandals and a burlap sack, then your look will be complete.
Thank you. Barbara was on her way to the chapel when the trouble started.
Face me in a hand-to-hand fight, almost-Elf!
Dryads, Elves... I don't see a difference there...
Bloody demon! Return to your spehre!
Even the fires of hell won't burn that black soot off your soul.
Wow! What an evil, evil... moron you are.
Are you proud of your misdeeds?
The guards should throw out scum like you.

Go to the arena and prove your fighting skills

A message from that idiot commander? She wouldn’t need reinforcements if she’d learn to fight better. I´ll attend to this when I return to the temple.

I can use someone like you, if you can fight. Go see my head gladiator and tell him I want you checked out. You’ll find him in the catacombs under the arena. If you survive, come back to the temple and perhaps I’ll have a chore for you.

Go! Now!

Fetch me a sample of the rare Gantiar Copper Ore.

Isn’t that fascinating? Just look! These stone samples contain traces of gantiar sulphate, a mineral that is extremely rare in this region! A second sample could confirm the presence of an underground lode of copperore. If we can prove that there is enough copperore, it would be worth establishing a mine here. The council would gladly send troops to protect the mine and then we could finally deal with those Kobolds! All I need is one more sample! Would you be willing to enter the mine and retrieve another sample of copperore? I would go myself, but I get terrible claustrophobia!
I met a pompous sword trainer in Badawi today. His name is Hegiman and he wants me to pick up some elixirs from a witch. Using them, he means to make up for his apprentice gladiator's lack of talent.

Bring me back my sword!

Those villains! Sons of scabby coyotes! We were patrolling when some desert raiders attacked and robbed us. They took all our gold, but I mostly grieve that they took my sword! To deprive a warrior of his sword is to destroy his honor! Please help me to save my honor!

Great! Thank you very much. Let that be a lesson to him... Hopefully word will get around and nobody will borrow any more money without paying it back!
Here is your reward, 1000 gold pieces. Would you like to do one more thing for us? There is a job. Just talk to TyBosso.
Ouch, it still hurts so much.
That's all you have to offer?
There's no place you can run that I won't be able to catch you!
So the shaman doesn't have a solution for the rain problem?
I must insist - the small ones to the front...
The opponents in this region use weapons inflicting mainly magical damage.
I will try to talk to the kobolds. Maybe they will tell me why they came.

The Grand Inquisitor said that my job is over and demanded the key. I refused to give it to him, telling him that I'm no longer his servant.
He attacked me and I killed him, while his guards were running away like frightened little rabbits. Now nothing can stop me from achieving my destiny! It's time to enter the Great Machine and see what power awaits me...

You can read all about your adventures in the logbook as well as find out about your current quests.
If you want to know what you have accomplished for a quest or what you still need to do, click on the name in the list on the left.

Chapter
On the left edge of the logbook you can switch between the chapters.

The Compass

The compass helps you with accomplishing your quests.

The large arrow always points in the direction of the main story's next step.
The small arrow always points towards the next target for side quests.

If you want to change the side quest target, open your logbook and click on another side quest.

What else is in the logbook?
You can switch between the respective areas by using the tabs at the top. Here you can read books that you found and memorized in game.
You're late! Come on, let's go!

I met a rather communicative ghost in the ruins of the palace. He claims that he used to be a prince and that he was cursed by a witch along with all his friends. Apparently, it all began when he received a ring as a wedding present.
Oh! Wonderful! I am a true huntress now! Thank you so much!
The death of me would mean a setback for the Inquisition!
It is done. The wolves will not cause any more problems and I can give Lord Gemma the good news.

I thank you for this most valuable of treasures.

You should know that your deed will repay you a thousand times over, although such rewards may well be reaped beyond your lifetime. Fear not, proud warrior, I have a very fitting gift to bestow upon you. Consider this a more immediate reward and a show of my genuine gratitude.
Mrs. Crumbagle told me that there is supposed to be a treasure chest hidden not far from here. She drew me a map of the location. It sounds mysterious!

There is no moral dimension to science. Science is like a knife. Give the knife to a surgeon or a murderer, and each will use it in his own way.

Yes that sounds very sensible. It was a mistake to doubt the truth of Testa.

Curiosity is the key to solving each and every problem.

That is one of the nine truths from the Catechism of Testa! How could I have turned my back on Testa for so long? My thanks, good friend!

He who destroys in order to understand has wandered from the path of wisdom.

Your message has rekindled my faith in Testa! Thank you!

Science without faith is lame, faith without science is blind.

I am nothing without Testa. You have opened my eyes again. I shall pray to Testa once more.

The wheel, the forge, the house - where would we be without Testa’s blessing?

I am an unworthy soul. Oh Testa! Forgive me my erroneous ways! I shall pray to you once more!
Haven't they taught you not to hit women?
We should try that again later...
Ulof was hit hard by the news, but I’m sure he’ll get over it. At least he still gave me a reward.
Yeah, that sounds ... uhm, yummy. Let's not waste any time, I'm already getting hungry.

Hm... well...I'm not really in that line of work anymore, if you know what I mean. There aren't too many who would dare to steal religious objects though. Maybe Two-Eye, he's the only one I can think of. He used to have a secret camp not far from here. Be careful! These are some down and dirty brigands.
I have one thing to say: chop-o-matic!
When I go to market on a fine day, I really notice how sensitive I am to sunlight.
I have some lovely new drinking horns to sell today. By midday, my purse will be full!
Customers love my deep, throaty voice.
I sell fashionable robes for our hard working women.
I make a tidy profit with my shop.
I stock honey mead - a nice strong drink!
Selling wares under the table is a lucrative sideline!
First I have to pay at the town gates. and then again for the market stand!
According to that stupid law, we have to keep the market peace. Not I, I say!
Please bring my children back to me.
Which guard was dreaming this time?!
The clerk was standing right there. He will soon tell me what I have to do.

And the winner is the selector!

My High Elf is next on the list. He's a horrible tyrant who flayed slaves and didn't care about anyone or anything else. He was also known as the spineless one! Come on pointy-ears, get in the arena!
I've collected all five herbs. They smell really good. I should take them to the Priestess now.
I totally agree! It's not well advised to leave a king waiting.
Quite so! You should never make kings wait. Let's get on with it!
Good. Take your coat, it looks like it will rain.
We could already be on our way if you weren't so slow, old man!
You said it. Punctuality is the politeness of kings, or something.
Go on, wrinkly! You are being expected!
The smaller ones are most malicious!
If I get into this area too far, I'll risk my life.
They're dead, all but one. Maybe he can tell me who is behind all this. No doubt a little ‘encouragement’ will help him talk.
I wonder if I just helped a couple of murderers.
The opponents in this region use mostly magical damage weapons.
Increases the chance that a spell hits the target with full force. Magic staffs and spells will additionally increase the damage output.
I've seen worse things than you.

Gravestone
Common sense in an uncommon degree is what the world calls wisdom.

Travel north and speak to the Seraphim if you want to know more.

What do you want from us? We don't know much, those stinking Orcs captured us before we were able to find out anything. Maybe they'll at least give us the mercy of a quick death. The magic leaks derive from a network of pipelines, that's all I can say. Probably only the Seraphim understand their origin. You should head north and seek them out in their Crystal Palace.

The deputy leader of the Dragon Cult, Dundiel, claims that the notorious Blackhammer is behind it all. He has often tried to harm the cult in the past, but he was always more of a nuisance than a real danger. Dundiel has sent me to deal with Blackhammer once and for all.
Your word is your honor. Go now and fulfil your promise to the Royal Atherton family.
Judriel has asked me to take a letter to her beloved, the Priest Romdreal.
Great! Now hurry and decorate the tree and we can start Christmas!

Kill some Mutants!

Did you see those dreadful mutants too? They look strange, like mutated mutants if you know what I mean. The sight of them gives me chills. They were spotted really closed to here too. Would you... I mean... unfortunately, I can't leave my post at the moment. Do you think you could kill a few of the mutated mutants? That would be great.
What do you ask of me?
So you have returned! Thank you! Please, take this as a sign of my gratitude.
Let's see who has the most stamina.
Apparently the witch set off three days ago to gather herbs. Perhaps I should try and find her...
So, it's time to ask these warriors what they want from me.

The zombies in this outpost worry about a new attack. Such an assault might change the centuries old battlefront and this would mean the destruction of the village. I was told to go to the four vantage points and watch the enemy troops to see if the rumors are true.
Who rides on something like this?
I could beat the enemies in this area with one hand tied behind my back.
What do you need, my Lady? Can I lend you my support in any way?
Indeed, you can. My husband disappeared. Have you seen him?
Well, all men look alike to me. What do see in these rude fellows?
I've got better things to do with my time than listen to your smug words, green dwarf!
Then let me help you, please!
You can count on my reliable nose.
Well, it can't get much worse. Please inform me as soon as you find any trace of him!
If I'd failed at school, I would've become a guard, too.
Thank you, that little rat got what he deserved! I think I'll nail it to my front door... Or better yet, I'll make it into an ashtray!
Do you really want to be a warrior? Me too!
I'm so lonely. You have time to play, don't you...
Are you going to come back - after you become a hero? Can you take me with you then?
Among these are Human robbers, thieves, rebels, etc. Their education is of the lowest level.
I was able to recover the letter. Now that it's recovered I’ll deliver it at once.
Have you found the sticklewort, yet?
Semil is looking for Shirka. He'll go to the Orcish Byway first.

Please! Spare me!
You wouldn't want to do anything rash now, would you? After all, there’s no need for us to quarrel! I tell you what, take this gold as compensation for Charolus’ boat. Or, oh never mind, just take the entire pouch! Good day to you!

Accompany me to Sulinar!

I made an incredible discovery while I was putting together the pieces of a shattered stone tablet, and I decoded the inscription!
There is an enormous cult site here, where you can worship a God that is bigger and older than anything Ancaria has ever experienced. He has countless tentacles and is just waiting for his followers to awaken him.
The best part is: the entrance to the cult site is located close to the ruins of Sulinar! Maybe in a gulch, or maybe even in the city itself.
I'm going to set out for there at once. Would you like to accompany me?
It's not well advised to keep a dragon mage waiting. I'm in the red! Just know, it's damn dangerous when a dragon mage is in the red.
Would it be possible that you are a little ... fixated? A cold shower might help with that, or so I have been told.

Thanks for saving us, strangers. We were forced into drudgery because we couldn't pay our debts to TyBosso. We'll hide out in the mountains and emigrate to the Human realm as soon as the dust of our escape has settled.
The ground and vegetation look like they are soaked in blood.
The witch doesn't seem to be home. There's a raven sitting on the fence outside her house, perhaps it can help me?
Elven blood suits my blade well!
Are my sows suffering from swine fever?
My cattle are first class animals. They provide milk and meat - and I can sell their horns, as well.
One cow you may spoil, but a herd of cows is just toil. (Farmers saying)
I have to sharpen my scissors or they will tear the cloth.
Let's have a look around here - who might have a purse positively overflowing with gold coins?
I am a friendly bandit. First I ask politely and when that doesn't work, I use violence.
A nice ambush could turn this into a really good day.
By my ancestors - a generous pile of loot would be more than welcome today.
There's a big bounty on my head - perhaps I should rob myself.
That object wasn't exactly great, but never mind... maybe I can use it for something or sell it.
Great! Let’s go! I can hardly wait to be  a hero!
You have seen better days, haven't you?
They're willing to take me back? That's fantastic news! I am so glad my family hasn't deserted me. Let's leave right away, I'm ready to go.
What's on your mind, if you will allow the overstatement?

Very good, the recruits will take care of the village's security from now on. I hope they are capable enough for that task. Meanwhile, we will inspect the machine. I will go ahead and you can fetch the magician. He is the only one who might know something about these strange gadgets.

Have no fear of perfection - you'll never reach it.

- Dali
I bared my teeth to them!
Yes, yes, the charm is here. Bring me the potion and it's yours.
Find someone else to do that.
Testa has accepted my sacrifice. He's pleased. And the priest has blessed me.
Does anybody know what happened to the Undead Centurion?
Leave that to me. We, not the others, represent the true faith!
Don't falter! The stronger Gods are on our side.
Don't worry about these renegades and infidels. We'll deal with them!
Yes that is a problem, but it's also the reason why we invented something called crucifixion.
Don't let lies blind you. The true faith is your only hope for salvation, believe me.
False prophets, that's all I'm saying. We will baptize them with their own blood.
The Gods will strike down the heretics and send an earthquake to destroy their counterfeit church.
They will be punished, believe me. The Gods are with us!
You mean this silly faith in a single God? Believe me, it won't last.
You're right but we won't be this lenient much longer. Soon they'll all end up on the scaffold.

Maximilian Mantz
Where's a way, there's a will. If there is no will, there's a reason.
The first fight is starting. My opponent is an inexperienced Human from the north.
Just as I expected, both of the clans are proud to own one of Gronkor's hands.
Yes, sure, now get out of my way.

Keeper of the Temple
There is a wisdom of the head, and a wisdom of the heart.
Be prepared to pay the price for this deed ...
The Priestess rewarded me with the sacred blessing of Kybele - and a ring.
I always complete my missions successfully.
Excellent! So our task is fulfilled! The Gods may relax now, the Demon won't be a threat to the shrunken head! Here take it. Just between the two of us, I never believed in this nonsense.
If we don't make any progress some time soon I will format your harddrive with a spell!
Oh no. We can't move the shipment without pack animals. What a shame.
Just be careful so you don't put yourself out...
Where were you when we needed heroes?

Improves armor rating and resistance against spells. Slightly increases the regeneration time of all combat arts within the aspect Mystic Stormite while the buff is active. Crystal Skin cannot be used in conjunction with Incandescent Skin.
For you, everything comes full circle now ...
I think it's sad that we aren't allowed to fly Kybele's banner during battle. Why are you so strict in these matters?
A God's banner! This is what our troops want and we want to adorn it with Kybele's visage! Don't you think that is a good idea?
We warriors want the great Goddess' face to waft over us in battle. Will you permit it?
Why can't we carry Kybele's banner during battle? That would strengthen our warriors' courage!
I don't understand it, we fight for and with the Goddess, but we can't carry a Godly banner! Why not?
Kybele's golden banner! Why don't you give it to us fighters? Actually we deserve it as a sign of courage!
If you Priests weren't so stubborn, you would relinquish Kybele's banner to us. It would give us courage in battle!
I want to ask you why we aren't allowed to carry the great Goddess' banner to the battles! It surprises me.
Don't you think the we warriors would be better and even more courageous if we were allowed to carry Kybele's banner on the field?
I was entrusted with the task of asking you for permission to carry the Goddess' banner. What do you think about that?
I've always dreamed of hunting down an Inquisitor!
I've heard Ker is your favorite ...
People like you destroy our entire race!
What do you gain through your crimes, Inquisitor?
You were once been a man of faith!
I met Ligien. She asks that I come to the cloister!

A local farmer told me that a strange mage is living in the area. He has always been peculiar, but lately he's become even worse. First several cows and sheep disappeared, and now even a little girl is missing from the village. Rumor has it that the mage has gone mad, and the farmer has asked me to find and save the girl if possible. I can find the mage's house in the forest to the northeast.
Increases the damage, the critical hit chance and the casting time of the elemental magic aspect. Allows combat art upgrades in the elemental magic aspect.
Watch out, the people on the jetty are ill. Whatever you do, don't catch the disease!
I have received a letter that I need to show to the paymaster of this region. He will then pay my bounty.
Any Hero has executed a combination for the first time.
You’ll find him easily enough, just follow the river.

The forester's wife doesn't even want to step out of her house anymore because her property is supposed to be haunted. The Arch Mage ghosts are apparently the worst. I'm to slay four of these Arch Mage ghosts.
Being a Seraphim, I don't have use for this.
The pigs are dead! Hmm... I’ve always wanted to use that line. Nomengalus will be pleased with my work.
I'm not afraid of the fog. Let's go!
And where were you when the creator handed out brain cells?
Only I can tame T-Energy, Dryads!
Ah now she wants me to unearth the treasure all by myself. I guess the lady's even too good to do that herself. Well I do wonder what the treasure is going to be, so I'll just do it.
Go away... the doctor... he has to treat me... ow!
I heard them call me a beer slinger. *tsssssssssssssss*
A young stud to talk to would be nice.
This new dress will attract the men like bees to honey.
One of them called me a tavern wench...
Over the hill? I look like I'm over the hill? They don't know what I'm capable of!
I have been asked to kidnap Mehmet's fiancée. Well that's what it amounts to. First I have to get rid of the guards. Then I can take Ayshe to Mehmet.

You have traveled far.
Your courage is impressive, but we were more impressed by your heroism. You performed so many selfless deeds... and that deserves recognition.
We selected you to correct a mistake that we Seraphim made a long time ago. Your knowledge from the realm of the dead combined with the way you handle the rituals make you the perfect instrument. Don't worry, I'll explain everything to you.
Like I say to my customers, "What's gone is gone..."
Most people don't like me - but that's just because of my job.
Things got a bit ticklish the other day and I had to take to my heels.
Folks get scared stiff in this forest - and all because of me! *smile*
The enemies of this region mainly use weapons for magic damage.
How are we going to proceed? I have to think!
I cannot lose the next fight now! Thank you!
Pakmarah was glad to finally escape his master's wrath.
What is that? Apparently the Cult got word of the meeting and wants to eliminate the traitors.
I was given the potion and must feed it to Mishirla. I was told that knocking him out would be the safest way to accomplish this.
I have the meat. Now I need to return quickly before it starts to rot.
Try the mealworm marinade. It's delicious!

Sacrifice to Kybele.

Praised be Kybele, as without her there would be no life. You should show your gratitude by sacrificing to her. She likes simple things, so go and fetch her a harpy egg and clean water from a spring. Then I will bless you in Kybele's name.
It was a pleasure meeting you. Farewell.
May your paths always lead you to your destination.
Kudos to you for your honor. Good bye!
Your loyalty is exemplary. Farewell and good luck on all your ways!
Your valor does you credit. Farewell!
Your loyalty honors you. Take care - may the Gods bless your paths!
Don't bother me with THAT right now!
The smith's old mother is getting on my nerves. She wants me to perform the last rites on her every week.
I like to talk to myself in the still of the night.
Afraid of daylight - me? I just work nights, that's all.
I blow my horn every hour, that reassures the citizens.
It's always very dark in the corners!
I get scared at night, I just don't show it.
That does it! From now on I'm charging a mileage allowance!
The night harbours too many shadows.
There's a storm brewing in the skies. I'll take shelter in the watchhouse.
The night is long, yet I know no fear!
BEEEP! Hello, big brother, I will come with you.
You are lucky, I have nothing better to do at the moment.
The machine runs on Kobold heads. Who would have thought that? I must find three intact Kobold heads. That means that just for once I must not crush their skulls when I kill them.

Ensign Zahar was proud to have fought at my side. I couldn't bring myself to tell him that his feelings were not reciprocated.
The Priest said something about a relative. I should stop by the registry office.
I'd very much like to tell you what I think about you, but I prefer to keep my mouth shut...
Between us women - life is easier when you're bad, right?
Move along! Otherwise your dark path will end here.

Activates a special protective energy shield for a brief period. Incoming damage will be reduced and fully absorbed until the energy is depleted or the shield's duration has come to an end. After use these energy shields need to be recharged for a considerable period of time.
<AlignH Value=Center/><b> Direction to the next step of a side quest

Looks like I'm supposed to be a target of vengeance for these tortured souls. The Seraphim apparently just wiped out these high elves when they made this region their hunting grounds. Anyways, he and his fiery friends want to beat me to death. But I don't think so!
You have to concentrate hard if you don't want to lose the thread.
My eyes are getting worse and worse - just threading a needle is torture.
Brimmed felt hats are all the rage this year.
Darning socks is the most tedious job there is.
I should move on, this is just boring slaughter!
The second focus point is destroyed.
I should hunt you down and stuff you alive!
Hurry please! There's no time to be idle when the forest is dying.
Black Fever? Of course I have a remedy for the Black Fever! Take this vial - it contains enough medicine to heal the entire village.
Here we are, thank you for your help. Go to my wife and tell her I sent you. She will give you a reward. You will not be disappointed!
He can’t be far away! Finish him off once and for all!
The merchant created a reward for me out of the components.
I can't think of anything now but I will consider it...
I was wounded in battle, and the wound won't heal! What can I do about it?
I need your advice as a healer, shaman! There's an open wound on my leg which is bothering me!
Can you heal the wounds that trouble me since the last battle?
My right arm is killing me! Please help me and make the pain disappear!
You shamans are healers, aren't you? Could please take care of these cuts on my chest?
I need your healing hands! In the last fight for Kuan I got severely wounded!
What can I do to make these arrow wounds from the fight against the Elves disappear?
I suffer from an old wound that I got in the fight against those Human scoundrels! Can you heal me?
Lend me the healing powers you got from Kuan! My warrior knees are hurting badly!
I won't complain, but I suffered badly in the last fight and I really need a reliable remedy!
Thank you for all the trouble you went to.
Most money is tainted: 'Taint yours, and 'taint mine.

Keeper of the Temple
Peace is not an absence of war, it is a virtue, a state of mind, a disposition for benevolence, confidence, justice.

- Spinoza
You may not like what I have to say next.
Please let me tell you something, even if it does sound bleak.
Good, then let me add one more thing.
Windows and Xbox 360 are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.
Two children have been kidnapped. I'm supposed to find a certain Elodriel in the next village. She might have further information.
You think you'll get away with this? You killed my sister's fiancé and with that deed you destroyed two lives! I challenge you to a duel! Here and now! En garde!
The cultists must be foolish to fraternize with such powers.
In the name of Kuan: Die, undead!
Even dead, you're still just a Human!
So this is all just hysteria? Why do I hear then that more and more evil spirits are roaming the swamps?
Evil spirits! Of course, I don't believe in them, even if people say that they haunt the swamps.
I'm really no coward, but it seems that there are apparitions haunting the night.
I've heard talk of ghostly lights in the swamps. I wonder, if that's true.
Illuminated discs in the sky, strange visitors... I don't know what to make of this.
There are a lot of rumors are going around. Are evil spirits really among us?
I don't know if that's true, but many talk about evil creatures that walk the night.
Should we be more careful at night? There's talk about evil spirits.
I don't believe every rumor, but it seems that demons are haunting us.
Strange apparitions seem to be visiting us. Have you seen any?

In order to prevent the destroyed armor from rising again, it must be burned. The fire must not be fed by desecrated wood, though. Now I must find eight branches that were not contaminated by blood. That won't be easy in these woods.
We need more heroes who are willing to fight against the forces of evil.

Ha, just mentioning the Dragon and the outpost's location in one sentence scared them witless. They gave me what I wanted in return for my word to not tell Mer-Kil where they are. The fools should have chosen their words more carefully, the Dragon isn't the only danger here today ... I'll find Mer-Kil to the west.

Here in Tharum they have really strange customs. The people enjoy bottle fights. They conjure the genies in the bottles and then the genies duel. It seems that an alchemist managed to produce an incredibly strong genie, or would you say he bottled it? I have to seek him out to buy the genie.
I wonder whether the people in this place still remember Seraphim.

I have passed on the Oracle's message.
At least the cultists know what to eat in the evenings in the future.
I think the opponent is more than a match for us ...
I liked what I heard, friend. Till we meet again...
It was such a delight to meet you! Farewell!
May the Goddess protect you, always.
I hope we meet again soon.
May the lofty canopy always shade your path.
Thank you. May the Goddess protect you from all harm!
In the name of all the forest spirits - happy wanderings!
I shall retreat again to the depths of the forest. Good luck!
Once again, nature is calling me! Farewell, friend.
I look forward to meeting you again, good friend!

NO?
You’ve gotten rather full of yourself on your little journey, eh? You think you're tough now because you killed a few monsters? Sorry to spoil your delusions of grandeur, but you've never been anything more than a pawn in my game. I never lied you know. I needed all kinds to accomplish my goal, but the end is near and I don't require your presence any longer. Take pride in the role you have played in bringing about my success. Now you die.
Further decreases the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.
That's how the hunter turns into the one being hunted. If you pretend to be all-powerful you'll learn at some point how fast things can change.
Paralyze - Considerably decreases target's movement speed.
Weaken - Significant chance to decrease the target's attributes.
Intent - Chance to land a critical hit.
Shelter - While Archimedes Beam is active, incoming damage is reduced.
Annul - Considerable chance to dispel beneficial spells (buffs) from the target.
Commander Iskari asked me to kill five cultist shamans to help the defenders in this area. He wants me to bring back their heads as proof.
A couple of poachers who are interested in Urzi are hanging around in front of the entrance to the cave. We can defeat them together though.
I found the huntress. She is being attacked by mutants, I have to help her!
My bags are bursting at the seams!
Look at that! A fighting thundercloud!
All other trademarks and copyrights are the properties of their respective owners. All rights reserved. NOT FOR RENTAL.

Find the Brigand Cave.

While we were held captive, we overheard conversations mentioning that the brigands are occupying a cave not far from here. Apparently they're supposed to meet up with someone in there to sign a contract of sorts.

Could you find out who the brigands have dealings with? You are far more inconspicuous than we are in our uniforms.

The brigands are outlaws and they always will be, so make sure they will never do any criminal business ever again. Supposedly the cave is south of the village. Go and find it.
Looks like the shaman isn't among the living anymore. I found his dead ... or undead?! ... body. The villagers won't like this.
You Orcs did take a wrong turn during the process of evolution...
I guess I'll fly a kite.
Well, that was a short appearance...
This item is of no use for my character class.
I delivered the ingredients to the leader.
What now, Human? Are you going to attack me?
My weapon for ice based damage isn't helping me any further.
My wounds have been attended to.

Thank you for freeing us! You've slain the leader of the cult and hit them at their weakest spot. Cut off the snake's head and the body is also finished. Without their leader, the cult won't last long. The baron will take care of the remaining followers. They still pose a danger to us.
They're trying to desecrate the Temple. Protect it!
Show them we're not rusty yet!
We might grant you a quick death.
Hm, should I kill you? ... Yeeesss!
Love! Bah, how stupid. Feelings are a luxury the weak allow themselves when they're running out of goals and ideals! I will teach those children a lesson.

You should go back home too.
Don't mention this to anyone except your father.
You don't look healthy, and that's a fact.
I'll do it, even though I can't stand alchemists.
Where is a maid when you need one? I cannot carry any more.
Get lost... there's nothing left to say.
Five thousand eight hundred and four
I'll be happy to do so!
The last piece has fallen into place. Maker, when I have completed this task, will I then finally be allowed to go home?
I have been asked to deliver a secret message from Lord Alcander to the captain of his ship “Unsurpassable Justice.” Maybe it contains the information Priestess Lerana is after.

And the winner is the selector!

But the next opponent is the Crusher. He's the Ogre even the Trolls fear. He's as big as a tree and as strong as a Dragon. Why he killed nine people with his bare paws during his arrest! Let the fifth fight begin!
I had crustaceans for my last birthday - and I cracked them all...
Now only the Inquisitor, the brains behind this whole outfit, remains. I'll find him outside of town.
This is slavery! I haven't even got my own charcoal.
My future is as black as my fingernails.
I dreamt that a charcoal burner became the highest statesman in the realm.
The charcoal burner needs a new chimney.
I'm in awe! These guys really know their trade!
A gamer profile has changed. The current game will be terminated. The game progress for %1 will be saved.
My parent’s house is near Sethiaz.
And how do I reverse the spell?
The cleansing phase begins with the new moon.
Snake's eyes and lizard's tails, will make a soup that never fails.
I just have a sixth sense.
I need sunnier places in the garden for my herbs.
I used a flying ointment yesterday. First I hallucinated, then I fell asleep.
The women in the fields should take some of my parsley mixture.  It helps against mosquito bites.
Oak is my favourite tree, it is just as strong as our soldiers.
I should write that down in the Book of Shadows.
The first commander thanked me for the information and sent me to the next camp right away.
Why are you so keen to die, Dryad?
I always thought, you Dryads had honorable goals!
Flowers! Is that all that interests you?
Dryad, keep out of our business!
Why did you have to turn against the Gods?
I think I have killed enough highwaymen now. That should teach them a lesson!
Be careful, it could be an ambush!
Everyone, get up! We are under attack!

Take these fish to Timotan and his wife!

Oh! Travelers are becoming very rare in this neighborhood. The mood in this part of the Barony is quite gloomy. Part of the country south of here has become home to a horde of ghosts and Thraconians are looting their way through the settlement to the north of here. It seems like the Barony has written us off. A good friend of mine, Timotan the forester, lives in a little house along the road to the gates of Artamark. I'm worried about him, I haven't heard anything from him in a while. Would you mind going there to make sure he's okay? Please give him these fish. He and his wife don't have much right now. This food will make them very happy.

My husband has disappeared in the forest. Please go and look for him!

I've been waiting in vain for days for my husband to return. He went into the forest to collect mushrooms. I'm so worried that something has happened to him. Please find him for me!
I think the soul essences I gathered are enough for the zombie's studies.
Don't waste any time. Next winter's collections needs to be prepared.
My daughter's coming home? Thanks be the Gods! I'm overjoyed. Here take this as a reward.

The general rewarded me with a piece of his equipment. And it looks valuable, too! He also told me that there should be a platform nearby which I can use to get back to the cave entrance. How convenient.
<Pain, hard as if being hit with the hammer> au!
Sage beer makes loose teeth firm. *grin*
I serve my beer in cups made of burned clay.
Sometimes the artist paints in my tavern.
Honey beer in a honeycombed pitcher. Excellent!
Some of us have murdered out of greed.
All my magic... cannnot... save me now
My healing spell... does not work...
You will be next soon enough...
I hope the smell of these wild boars will disperse soon.
Well, if it has to be! With or without Kuan's grace.
It's all right with me! My God is always with me.
Whatever you've got to say! But remember who you master is!
Without Kuan's guidance you'll stumble, you know?
If Kuan leaves you, you are lost. Never forget that.
Well, good travels and a huge booty for you!
Think of your God when you're fighting, and everything will be fine!
I don't have all day. With Kuan's greeting...
I wish you the right path under your warrior's legs.
Without Kuan there's no victory! With this in mind I bid you good day.
I love her and I am ready to fight for her!
The shaman has advised me to cut down a bit. I've got bad circulation, you know?
Lowers all attributes of the target for a brief period. Enhanced effect against opponents who correspond to an equipped shrunken head.
I'm not finished with you yet!
Hear hear ... a bone flute would've done the trick, too. But the swell prefers the harp. Well, whatever ... the mage is working on the instrument now.

Damn it! The Seraphim saved me. I am caught between life and death and die every second, only to be brought back in the next. I need the three resurrection artifacts, otherwise I will suffer this fate for all eternity. Will you give them to me? I... I'm begging you!

You're looking for the Reverend? I'm sorry, he's not here and His Excellency does not like to be disturbed when he has retired. My memory isn't what it used to be or I would be able to tell you of a nice little lake where the rich like to spend their weekends... you understand?
The Kobold chieftain is dead. I will let Thelal know.
I must upgrade before I can use this item.
I have a new apartment for you, Human. Six feet under the ground floor...
Oasis? This is a lake. Well we're here at least.

I don't think necessity is the mother of invention. Invention, in my opinion, arises directly from idleness, possibly also from laziness - to save oneself trouble.
- Agatha Christie
Another small chunk of cell clots...
A bunch of screws can't intimidate me.

Quick! Fetch the doctor from the local military garrison!

Just look at this wound, it doesn’t look good at all! I cleaned it once already, but it still got infected. I’ll get gangrene if a doctor doesn't tend to it soon.
There's a military garrison close by that has a doctor. Could you do me another favor? Please go and fetch the doctor!
New Goblin skin for my books!
The Gar'Colossus has been dealt with. Time to focus my attention on the broker again.
Those people should not be listened to who keep saying the voice of the people is the voice of God, since the riotousness of the crowd is always very close to madness.
A soldier along the Artamark border saw the Priest. Apparently they've separated. Some are still in Artamark and the others have moved on to Nor Plat. I'm going to deal with those in Artamark first.
A dubious High Elf assigned me the task of acquiring some blue orchids. He suggested that I be on the look out for a huntress.
Personally I can't say anything about it, but try to see it this way - things just can't get any worse!
Ah, try to think positive. We've lost battles but we'll win the war!
All's well that ends well! Let an old warrior like me tell you that.
I wouldn't necessarily bet my pay on it, but I firmly believe that better times will come.
You know, things have actually been worse before! This will change nothing about the final victory.
We'll just have to march close to win against the dark shadows.
I'm just a soldier, but I have a feeling that our fate will soon take a turn for the better.
No matter what you believe, where there is life there is hope.
If we stick together we can win against any enemy, especially against the Elves!
Desperation is our sharpest blade. Oh that has a nice ring to it, maybe I should write it down.
I think only a sorcerer can help you now.
I really hope that you're not the new nanny.
Kuan is with us! They should just try it! The only heads they'll get are their own! Down in the dust with them!
A reward? A great idea! Will they also pay if I decapitate one of them?
How nice! Well, if your reputation's down the gutter - I think that's the only motto we should have!
They are nothing but cowards! Instead of challenging us themselves they let others do their work!
I really hate them! They are too cowardly to face us themselves, and they pay others to fight for them!
That doesn't bother me! Everybody who's after my head has to pass my blade first! And that's going to be bloody...
Yes, a reward! The proof of their own cowardice! I'd like to spit at this lousy crowd!
If they want to throw their money down the drain let them! My head's safe and secure on my sturdy neck!
That's ridiculous, but if they like to pay for heads I'll be more than happy to lay some of their own at their feet!
I don't fear the headhunters! I'll be more than happy to drown them in their own blood!
I should practice a bit longer for this opponent.
Attack, you useless bunch of dog bones!
Our regiment needs new recruits! Slay them!
Don't pretend that you have arthritis! GET THEM!
The settlers now have a secure future under the watchful eye of the Dryads.
You traveled too far. Your journey ends here and it ends painfully!
Patrick Morin, Mathieu Page, Benoit Parize, Sebastian Saint-Charles, Julie Vieira
Now I'm supposed to wait until the witch has brewed the potion, then I finally get to try it. I hope it works! Then I'll know what the weather will be like tomorrow.
Yes... I saw it in my visions. I... I should never have instructed you. That was an unforgivable mistake. Your cruelty and unscrupulousness... perfect attributes for the Inquisition.
Who is about to stop his ride so late through the windy night?
The Goddess wants me to change the subject now!
With your permission we should discuss something else, to honor Kybele.
There is still one topic we both need to understand!
May your path be free of pain.
I have to learn how to handle that first.
OK fog, let's fight! Eh, can you understand me at all?
They say the borders aren't safe. But who would dare to attack us?
Have you heard the rumors that the Orcs are after our scales? They can't be that stupid, right?
We've always been safe here. Should we be scared of another war now?
Do you think it's true that foreign enemies are threatening us and the memory of our ancestors?
I think that as long as the spirits of the ancestors roam the land we will be safe.
Many of us fear that foreign powers might attack us. Do you think it will come to that?
What is going on in our sacred lands? More and more strangers appear with dark intentions on their minds.
I would like to know if the ancestors' home is in danger. There are so many rumors going around.
Everyone is talking war and destruction these days. Are our enemies really threatening our borders?
I sense a foreign power right outside our borders. Does this mean war is coming?
It’s a really warm day today, isn’t it?

The Prince was obviously very pleased to receive the ingredient. Now I find that evoking the fire isn’t that easy, you need an experienced alchemist. There's only one in this region skilled enough to perform the ritual. Unfortunately he's a loyal follower of the Prince's uncle so won’t come willingly, and we don’t dare risk his life by using force. The uncle has sent an envoy to the alchemist. If I can kill the envoy and assume his identity, I might be able to trick the alchemist into following me.

Chaos is the origin of all life! My goodness! When I think of the state of my son’s room...

You are right!

Evil might not have the answer to every question, but unlike goodness and purity it doesn't even try to give an answer!

Well, that’s true...

If goodness is only a disguise for evil, then it follows from this that evil is in fact goodness.

It sounds a bit complicated, but I’m willing to think about it.

All these other Gods really get on my nerves! It’s always the same - justice, order, honor and compassion!

Praise be to Ker!

You pray to all these Gods for years on end, and then where are they when you need them? Ker and chaos are all we can depend on!

How to Beguile Aristocrats

 Princes

“Oh, my hero“ or “How to beguile noble men“

Farmers, herders, farmhands - girls in the country don’t have much of a choice. Perhaps they wouldn’t even notice if it wasn't for those aristocrats in their nice clothing with golden embroidery, riding their noble horses or taking their women for a drive in their carriages. Every girl starts to dream of a better life when she sees one of them in the distance while herding the goats, but only a few try to realize their dream. For those who have made the decision to flee their boring life in the country there are only three practicable things they have to think about: Who? Where? How?

1. Who?

This question mostly depends on how far you are willing to go. If you are a girl who doesn’t look like if the bull sat on your face there are several possibilities: an old noble widower, a fat and unimposing one or a young and good-looking fellow. They all have their advantages. The old aristocrat won’t live much longer, but you shouldn’t underestimate the intrigues his descendants will start to get rid of an unwanted rival for the expected inheritance. In these circles people don't think twice about hiring poisoners or skilled assassins. The unimposing noble will certainly live longer, but he could turn out to be the right choice and it’s also quite possible to meet him in the tavern next door - but keep in mind that this man usually doesn’t have much in the way of coins in his pocket. Of course you don’t long for riches, but for a young aristocrat who will pour gifts upon you and whose sight you can stand the whole day without having the impulse to close your eyes.

2. Where?

Most country girls know which taverns the nobles meet in before or after their hunting trips, to drink and to boast of their deeds. At first glance this looks like the perfect place for a meeting, but that’s not true: All girls who sit in these taverns hope for the same, and all these nobles know that. They have the free choice, which is not good if you think you’d be the right choice for that man.

It’s much better to go into the forest where they are hunting and act as if you’ve sprained your ankle. A feigned attack is also quite helpful to attract the attention and the mercy of some nobles. The exact details of this made-up situation depend on your fantasy and on your acting talents. The most important thing is to look helpless, but not stupid. Should you be lucky enough to descend from a simple, but intact family (that maybe even owns a little farm), you should ask the noble to take you home on his horse. Aristocrats mostly descend from families in which the sons kill each other to get the inheritance for themselves. A friendly family and a house in which the knives just lay on the table without being used for deadly deeds will soften the heart of most nobles. If you live in a stable with the goats and the pigs by your side it's better to invent a stern father and to keep the noble away from your home.

3. How?

Simplicity, naivety and honesty - these are the three characteristics a noble doesn’t see in the women of his social circles. If you possess these traits, or can even fake them convincingly, your journey into the castles shouldn’t take very long. Don't overplay it though, a noble with good intentions could come to the opinion that it would be better to deny love because otherwise this innocent and simple girl would have to endure the intrigues of the rich. You’ll need some good instincts in this area. You should leave all praise to the noble and you should blush when he compliments you. You can practice turning scarlet in front of a mirror or a smooth water surface. It’s much easier than you think. Once you've finally arrived at the castle you should be very careful: When you are insulted (and you notice it) you should just smile, and if you’re unsure if you just heard a rude remark you should just gently bend your head. Always be nice to the housemaids and servants, because they know a lot more than anybody else. Aristocracy is like a snake pit: Only snakes can survive here - and the mongoose that jumps in briefly to catch what it wants.

Every girl should decide for herself if she wants to be a snake or a mongoose.

Book 4

Dyr Lain

Geography and climate: The island of Dyr Lain lies in the middle of the Jade Sea. It has often and quite rightfully be described as paradise. Waves roll gently over white beaches, colorful birds sing in trees that carry all kinds of fruit. The water of the many small rivers is so clear that it is almost invisible if one is more than a few steps away, and the dark blue surfaces of the lakes and ponds sparkle in the sunlight. The climate is generally pleasant and slightly humid. There is a short rainy season in spring and a longer one in the fall.

Inhabitants: The Dryads are descendants of the ancient Elves of the south, but have long since developed their own distinct and independent culture. They live as one with nature. Their settlements consist of tree houses, their gardens are renowned in all of Ancaria. Especially the citizens of Thylysium value the sweet fruits that grow there and are willing to pay quite extraordinary prices for them. The Dryads don't care about money. They only grow as much as seems appropriate to them.

For a very long time the Dryads lived alone on their island, shying away from contact with the outside world. But after monsters started attacking them, they allowed a few Elves to build a settlement called Aerendyr in the south of the island. They have come to regret this decision because Aerendyr seems to poison the whole island. Maybe this experience is responsible for the reserved manner with which the Dryads approach strangers. They welcome them to their villages, but engaging a Dryad in a conversation beyond a simple greeting is quite difficult. One can only get to know them better by sharing their belief in Kybele, Goddess of nature and by helping them take care of the fauna and flora of the island. Travelers who have sufficient time should not miss this opportunity as the Dryads have a lot to say. Their wisdom will come as a surprise to those who dismiss them as “plant whisperers” and “fruit huggers”.

Places to see: There are no places to see on Dyr-Lain, the whole island is worth seeing. One can spend weeks admiring the beauty of the many gardens and the gracefulness of the animals that inhabit them. A visit to the capital Dyr-Laigh is a must. No other place in Ancaria shows such a perfect harmony between nature and architectural artistry. There are no sharp corners in this city, no straight lines, no right angles. Everything is smooth and rounded and the colors of the building and even those of the Dryads' clothing is reflected in the surrounding plants. Dyr-Laigh is a fascinating city, unfortunately the night life leaves a lot to be desired.

Practices: It is customary to plant the stones from fruits one has eaten and to take care of the plants that grow from them. Visitors are expected to give these stones to Dryads, so that they can take care of them instead.

Recommendations: It is considered extremely rude to cut off a woman in mid sentence. Some people claim that Dyr-Lain is the chattiest place in all of Ancaria.

Welcome my dear sister. If you are holding this guidebook in your hands, your time to hunt on this plane and to prove your hunting prowess has come again. And even if you already know this guidebook by heart, read it again! It's for your own safety. It is also mandatory.


The Origin of the Crystal Plane

After the Creator banished us to this world, we managed to keep the warlike races of the world in check for a long time, and we hoped that he would welcome us back with open arms. Over the years, though, we began to become negligent and - admittedly - somewhat bored. Thus, we weren't sufficiently prepared when the Great Dragon War broke out and were almost wiped off the face of the world.

That taught us a lesson. To prevent another such failure, Sophia has created a new hunting ground as a challenge every young Seraphim has to face at intervals: The Crystal Plane.


the Crystal Plane

Once upon a time, the Crystal Plane was a largely uninhabited territory where only wild animals and a very few retreats for elementals existed. After Sophia was finished using our T-Energy to rework the territory nothing was as it had once been anymore. No greenery, no flowers, no lake - only ice and crystals. And this is how the Crystal Plane is today: An inhospitable and barren region where no natural life exists. Frosted trees, frozen rivers, ice crystals and biting cold do not encourage anyone to linger.

But that isn't the worst of it. A hunting ground needs prey, and the kind of prey Sophia banished to the Crystal Plane differs a lot from the usual game. Where once lived wolves and boars, trolls and elementals, the T-Energy turned them into soulless and powerful crystalline creatures that are formidable enemies even for Seraphim.

The Crystal Plane is inhabited by three different groups of creatures: The Ten-An, the Cin and the In-Lar. They were created and settled there, specifically for our purpose. Occasionally, other creatures wander about the Crystal Plane, but their chances for survival in this barren world are pretty slim. Still, it is an interesting diversion to quick-heat the odd orc and see it shatter. This will take an average of 27.2 seconds using a Pillar of Light ... but I digress. It is possible to encounter other creatures here, but they won't survive for long.


The Task

It is common knowledge that the purpose of the task is not only combat training but also the claim to the title “Queen of the Hunt”. The title will be awarded at the end of the hunting season - which is one year - to the huntress with the highest score. Therefore, you must take care to properly register at the counting stations. Your achievements must be confirmed by a second sister or they won't count. Irregularities will be punished with a one-year stay at the convent at Sloeford (yes, with the High Elves).

The Ten-An

The creatures newly created by us to inhabit the Crystal Plane are distinguished into three groups. This chapter describes the Ten-An.

The term Ten-An is the generic term for non-crystallized mutants that can be found in the first regions of the Crystal Plane. Their pronounced hunting instinct and a total lack of fear are characteristic for those creatures. Each Ten-An has its own way to keep prey from escaping. While some possess outstanding speed which makes flight almost impossible, others use their poison to slowly weaken and kill their victims. The following creatures are found among the Ten-An

Yeti
Basically, they are soft trolls. Stupid and strong and perfect foot warmers.

Lupan
Their lupine ancestry is almost indiscernible. T-Energy made them tougher and more dangerous and the crystalline armor on their backs provides protection. Like their natural counterparts, they usually roam in packs.

Felon
Once, Felon were black panthers - quick and deadly hunters. Today, they have become our prey. A lone Felon is not great danger, but more often than not, they accompany Saxenor, which is a deadly mix.

Ursaron
When Sophia released the T-Energy in the region which is known today as the Crystal Plane, bears, the lords of the woods, mutated into the formidable Ursaron. Watch out, huntress! A bear is dangerous, but compared to an Ursaron with its protective armor and formidable tusks, it is nothing but a cuddly teddy bear.

The Cin

The creatures newly created by us to inhabit the Crystal Plane are distinguished into three groups. This chapter describes the Cin.

The term Cin categorizes all crystalline mutations. They need the cold of the Crystal Plane to survive and to defeat their opponents. It is said that the purer the Cin's structure, the stronger the frostiness within them. Some even radiate enough cold to freeze an enemy by their mere proximity. The following creatures are found among the Cin:

Aracin
How does the saying go? No true hunt without a truly big spider! This specimen is something very special, though: they underwent a complete mutation and rumor has it that Sophia fought her own arachnophobia hunting that prey. So, don't be afraid of these little creepy-crawlies!

Lugalacin
Lugalacin are merciless. These crystal wolves often roam in packs and hunt their prey until it lies defeated. There's one advantage though: The so inclined huntress needs not hunt down her prey, since she becomes the one being hunted.

Percalacin
Percalacin also roam the expanse of the Crystal Plane. In former times, they simply were boars wandering happily about the woods. Today, they are icy cold crystalline creatures that do battle against the Seraphim. But who is afraid of a transparent pig?

Ursacin
While Ursaron lurk in the first regions of the Crystal Plane, the Ursacins live deep in its heart. Compared to the Ursaron, Ursacin are fully mutated and therefore decidedly more dangerous and quite a challenge. A Queen of the Hunt should be prepared to hunt more than one of these crystalline beasts.

Hucin
Sadly, the region which has been turned into our hunting ground was not wholly unpopulated. It seems there had been a few small villages inhabited by High Elves. But it is how they say: Sometimes you have to weigh necessity against cost. In this case, the cost was obviously worth it. In short: The Hucin once were elves that were at the wrong place at the wrong time. Now they add to our hunting experience.

Skelacin
In the places where the elves lived, they had graveyards. Inhabited by corpses. Corpses and T-Energy make Skelacin. Skelacin are not unlike reanimated skeletons with one significant difference: They shine a lot prettier in the evening sun when you hack them to pieces. .

Phylithos
The Phylitos plant is a somewhat bizarre opponent. Well, it isn't a real plant anymore, but it proves that Sophia also thought about the small things in life. Once a 9 feet crystalline plant has descended upon you, you will view potted plants in a completely new light.
