The Cin

The creatures newly created by us to inhabit the Crystal Plane are distinguished into three groups. This chapter describes the In-Lar.

The In-Lar are not mutants but where settled here by us in order to “add zest” to the hunt. The Saxenor and the Dracolin fall under this category. Both creatures are perfectly adapted to the freezing cold in the region. In addition, you will also find frozen T-Energy in the form of Lithos.

Saxenor
These creatures emerged from elementals. They are tough and powerful but should not pose much of a problem to a Seraphim - after all, we play with elementals on a daily basis. Admittedly, though, this is only true for the smaller ones. Larger Saxenor are often in the company of a pack of Felon and this team can pose problems even for one of us.

Dracolin
The Dracolin is a sub-species of the dragonfly. It is extremely quick and aggressive. This is where you can prove that you learned your lessons well, because these creatures don't bear the name “dragon” for nothing.

Lithos
On the Crystal Plane, the term Lithos represents pure T-Energy that manifested in crystals. Therefore, it should be self-explanatory why a confrontation with a Lithos is rather unpleasant.

How to Behave Around Dragons

They are without a doubt some of the most fascinating creatures of the world. Dragons in all their various shapes are not only truly impressive, they are also intelligent, sentient beings. Their stature is awe-inspiring and demands respect. Dragons can measure up to 500 Ancarian cubits in length and 350 Ancarian cubits in height. It is impossible to obtain any definite information about their weight. Nobody has been able to persuade a Dragon to step on scales (well...weighing machines, they do step on other scales fairly frequently!). Several adventurers have already paid for their curiosity about a - female, no less - Dragon's weight with their lives.

Their origins as well as their motivation to settle in this universe are unknown. We do know, however, that they have found refuge on Ancaria and now they are shielded from the rest of the mundane world. They are a very rare sight, which makes it even the more important to be prepared for such encounters. Dragons are not necessarily hostile towards other creatures. Yet, they are bizarre creatures with somewhat eccentric characteristics. A seemingly insignificant remark or an unobtrusive gesture may arouse their anger. Those mistakes are usually avoidable - and more often than not lethal.

Dragons are undeniably vain. They are susceptible to flattery and compliments. On the other hand they perceive any kind of objection or criticism as a personal insult. Anyone conversing with a Dragon should bear that in mind. We highly recommend a positive choice of words! Patronizing remarks, even if they are not intended to be condescending, should be avoided at all costs.

All Dragons naturally display an aura of arrogance. They deem themselves as generally superior. Usually, they do not regard other beings as adequate counterparts. When dealing with Dragons you should always be aware of that fact and tread carefully.

One of the biggest weaknesses of Dragons is their curiosity. They are always interested in the unknown and you might be able to use that to your advantage.

Body odor - a very sensitive subject. No matter which way you look at it, there is no denying that Dragons stink! Generally, they are surrounded by a stench of decay, sulfur and burnt flesh. You will have to be able to control your body very well in order to suppress the naturally occurring retching reflex. Still, it is essential that you do so. You should also refrain from holding your nose as that would be perceived as an insult.

Dragons feed on Humans. Many Dragons keep Humans in kennels. These poor creatures are typically not a pretty sight as they are left to vegetate in their own excrement for years. However, you should never refuse an offer of a snack, as Dragons detest rejection of their food or invitations.

Dragons expect to be treated with respect and courtesy. They do not appreciate it if you attempt to curry favor or chum up with them. Although Dragons are certainly not Elves, they are aware of their conduct and they have adapted it for themselves.


"Beltorak awoke with a start when his corporal entered the tent. He needed merely a second to be aware of his surroundings.
'Is it time yet?' he asked.
The corporal nodded.
Shortly after, the small delegation was ready to leave. Beltorak checked that the dispatch, which he was supposed to relay to the Dragon in the name of the empire, was safely tucked away in its document case and fastened to his belt. Finally, the small group began to advance up the hill.
Beltorak had not been born a diplomat. Once again he asked himself why he had been entrusted with that task. Negotiating with Dragons about small adjustments of borders was not commonplace for him. He was certain there were people better suited to that task than him.
Once they arrived at the designated meeting point, they saw the Dragon who had settled on an elevated rock. He rested his head on one arm, scratched symbols into the stone with the claws of the other arm and peered intently at the group of five Elves coming up the hill, panting.

Beltorak, flanked by his corporals, took a moment to compose himself. He fumbled for his document case, opened it, took out the scroll of paper and unrolled it. He cleared his throat and then raised his voice in order to read out the government's dispatch.
"Through unspeakable dangers and despite uncountable difficulties I have made my way to this castle on the outskirts of the Kobold city..."
Beltorak froze! His thoughts began to spin around while he tried to analyze the situation. Whoever was responsible for the bad joke of switching the dispatch, he would pay for it. He quickly scanned the faces of his corporals and then he spotted a faint grin on one of them. Telthoe - he should have known! He never forgave him for taking his wife away from him.

The Dragon raised an eyebrow. Despite his naturally rather limited options for facial expressions he produced a surprised look.
Beltorak's brain was working frantically. He had to improvise. Quickly! A drop of sweat trickled down from his temple while he attempted to come up with an appropriate salutation. It took only fractions of seconds to discard "my dear" or "pal" as suitable options. He was under pressure and the situation was on the verge of escalating so he decided on a desperate attempt. He drew a quick breath and began his address with a simple:

"Hello!"

(Ancarian Heroic Sagas, Book 4)

Book 1

General Conspectus of Magic

For more than five hundred years I have been studying the secrets of magic and I am walking the thin line between the thirst for knowledge and the realization that even an immortal existence would not be sufficient to unveil every last secret concealed by this arcane power.

1. Essence

All magic within this world derives from magical Essence. This mysterious power saturates everything, it never stagnates and it cannot be caught nor explained. Every race and each person in this world uses the Essence one way or another. From the more primitive shaman spells of the Kobolds, to the complex conjuration rituals of High Elven magic lore - everyone everywhere on this world utilizes the Essence... some knowingly, some blissfully unaware.

Many cultures have begun to divide magic into fields and disciplines. Even the most extensive research did not spare us from having to use this kind of aid. Therefore, we are using terms such as Fire Magic, Ice Magic, Conjuration Magic... even Poison Magic is being regarded as an independent discipline these days. Still, by now we know full well that all these divisions are nothing but feeble attempts to categorize something that is simply beyond categorization. In fact, these categories even prove to be impediments when it comes to transforming Essence into new spells.

The Essence is ubiquitous in Ancaria, albeit its presence appears to be stronger in some areas than others. Nobody has been able to explain this phenomenon though. The terms ‘Essence accumulation’ and ‘Essence dispersion’ are widely used for these occurrences. If a magician is in an area with high Essence accumulation, the desired effects will require considerably less transformation energy than in area with Essence dispersion. As yet a location with a complete absence of Essence is unknown; however, persistent rumors exist that the Dragons are aware of such locations (which allegedly is the reason for their move to Ancaria). In all my years of research I have been unable to confirm these theories.


2. Transformation

Discovering and researching magic spells is not the true art of magic. The art is using Essence according to your own will and transforming it. That, of course, is far from being easy. Only very few people have been blessed with this talent; most people do not have the ability to influence Essence. Surveys have revealed that only one in three thousand High Elves is capable of it. Those who do have this ability face a long and arduous path before they are able to use their magical powers purposefully and efficiently.
Magic results from the perfect combination of two powers: Essence and the individual power of the spell caster. That is the only way to invoke magic!

Having said that, even this profane approach does have its limits. There will always be fields that cannot be accessed successfully by merely combining Essence and the talent of transformation. The most distinctive example would be necromancy. Although it is possible to reanimate dead beings with relatively little effort, it is impossible to create new life by magic means. Essence always implies the change of a status quo. Delaeniel described this factor in his standard work “Lex Magica” in the year 974 (Old Time) as ‘re-creational principle’.

3. Lex Magica

“How inadequate the thought that magic should be divided into categories. How pathetic to hide behind such a construct. How deplorable this naivety that will inevitably lead to failure!”

Delaeniel the Elder

 The Lex Magica is arguably the most extensive work about magic. Its author, Delaeniel the Elder, created a systematic list of all known magical aspects. The central part of his work is the transcription of all the laws of magic. Although the Lex Magica is now more than 1.200 years old its contents are still as valid as ever. Delaeniel was the first to recognize that magic is not a priori divided into aspects, and that the categorization is merely a figment created by its users. This was a revolutionary thought at the time.

If we Elves want to work less we'll have to hire more foreigners!
What do you think? Should we really allow more foreigners to come into our country?
Any hero reaching the Dragon region and accepting a quest there.
We've reached the tribe they're feuding with.
I will head off right away and stand by his side!

A thieving beggar made off with the food that was brought as an offering to the Gods. I'm supposed to take him a parcel with food, and tell him that in the future he should leave the Gods' offerings alone.
A nice child of Kuan! Why don't I see you more often at the rituals?
I haven't seen you for a while. Kuan's temple is missing you.
Hey! I didn't even know you were still alive! Can't you spare a minute for the prayer?
You are an infrequent guest in Kuan's holy house - but why? In the past I got to see you more often.
You are a worthy Orc woman! But why don't you come to the temple of Kuan more often?
You? Kuan told me that he hasn't seen you at his memorial prayers for quite some time!
Why are you making yourself scarce, dear lady? Is it a lack of faith?
I'd be happy to see you at the sacrifice rituals more often! It's Kuan's will!
I'm glad to see you again! You're an infrequent guest in Kuan's house.
Why won't you come to the rituals more often? Kuan is displeased.
Are players liable to recourse? Can I take legal steps? I have no qualms about getting legal advice in this matter!
I killed a whole bunch of the little beasts. The farmer's carrots can now look forward to their future.
This is how the Elves have rewarded you?
You served the Elves. How can I respect you?
Come back when you've polished your armor, Shadow Warrior.
You've been dead before. Care to have another go at it?
Out of my way, Elf creature.
Oh, how I hate this wretched bar...
And now we add just a little fresh water to the wine - done.
I'm equally unfriendly to all of my guests.
Suggestion: Sales are down again - I don't understand it, I only raised the prices just last week!
People are most likely to notice it, if you dilute the mead or the beer.
All I can say is WE are the people! Ah well, maybe not...
What the nobles don't see, the heart doesn't grieve over. Camouflage is the keyword!
It's just a question of viewpoint, is it really us locked in or are others locked out? OK, so things seem to point to us...
I'd rather not know what would happen around here without this wall!
I just stay away from this stone wall and that's it.
I don't waste any thoughts about what's happening outside these walls at night.
Nobody deserves to be enclosed like this no matter how many advantages it may bring!
Hmm, maybe we could embellish it a bit? With flowers and such...
Between you and me: *whisper* I remove one stone every night. We'll be free in 50 years!
Direction to the next step of the main quest
What imbecile taught you how to fight?
Some highwaymen are harassing the neighborhood. I should take care of them.
I now see you through different eyes, Priest!

Find my child and free her from the Kobolds’ clutches!

May the Gods have mercy! How could this happen? My little daughter... she ran away. I tried to catch her but she was too fast for me. She headed straight for the Kobold camp, which lies across the bridge. Please, you must help me! Save her from the clutches of these disgusting Kobolds. I am beside myself with worry. Will you save her? I am begging you!
Just as I thought, they knew I killed their brother. That knowledge won't help them anymore.

You are a tough man, my friend. I could use somebody like you.

You want Claressa? Well okay, then take her with you. She isn't worth much anyway. Too rebellious. Don't worry, we won't bother the family. Such disputes are bad for business.
You did your job and we're pleased with it. Here, take this map.
I have enough problems of my own.
This zombie seems to be extremely eager for knowledge. He wants to know the reason for the fights. For this reason, he needs me to gather soul essences.
Don't despair. I will do everything in my power.
There's no rest for the wicked.
I have heard of more profitable jobs, but why not?! I'll do it.
Exit game and return to Windows?
The betrothed received the bad news. Oh, well, that's life.
Magnificent! They will make perfect shrunken heads! Thank you for your help.
I am supposed to speak to a wise female. Hopefully, she will be as wise as they claim her to be.

Accompany Esra and Ayna northwards!


Esra and I have a bet going: Esra bet that somewhere in the north there is an oasis so big that you can't even see the end of the water! I think that's nonsense, there isn't even that much water on the whole planet! The one who is right gets to eat the magic bean that the runemaster gave us. Would you please accompany us northwards? People say that it takes a long time before you find water... so shall we go then?

I’m a poet and your judge the same,
You will serve me, your life I claim!
The mines await you, that’s your sentence,
begone now and find repentance!
Skull Smash - Chance to stun opponents upon impact.
Magma Rain - Increases fire damage of the meteors.
Continuance - Prolongs the duration of Incendiary Shower.
Smoldering Boulder - The meteors inflict more physical damage.
Devastation - Increases the chance for critical hits.
Copious Shower - The meteors rain down faster and with shortened intervals.
Grease your joints. This squeaking is intolerable!
The children Ayna and Esra made a bet with each other about whether there is a giant oasis in the north and they asked me to accompany them there.
I don't think I've ever seen someone run that fast.

Guardian of Souls
The wisdom of the wise and the experience of the ages are perpetuated by quotations.
Benjamin Disraeli
I ignored the three bandits on the bridge and now they're attacking me. I have to defend myself.
My Gods will protect me, arrogant warrior. Get out of my sight!
Your lack of faith is a weakness, and your threats only serve to open the doors to damnation.
Don't rely too much on your sword arm. The Gods could tear it off just like that.
You're threatening me? It seems you're underestimating the power of my faith.
I'm under the protection of my Gods. I hope you're not too blind to see that.
Stop your silly accusations. I prefer preaching hope to blind hatred.
Warriors will not decide our fate. Only the Gods can do that.
How dare you talk to me like that? The punishment of the Gods will be harsh.
I am a humble servant of the forces of heaven, against which all swords must fail.
You're just a uncouth loudmouth with no respect for the Gods. But one day you'll see...

Grammbrain’s magic sword has turned out to be a rusty old iron rod, and it doesn’t look very magical either. Oh well. I’ll take it to Ulof and present him with the bitter truth. Perhaps he'll learn to take the old sagas with a pinch of salt in the future.
Hurls a ball of magic fire.
Things won't get done by themselves. I accept the quest.
I will lift this terrible curse!
Let's see what Daliel has to say.
If you're looking for me: I'm up here!

Find out more about the permanent darkness!

We haven't seen a stranger in a long time. You must have realized that things here are not as they should be. The whole village, everyone in it - we've all been dead for a long time. Only our spirits are still bound to this place. The people here don't know that they're dead. It took me a long time to accept the truth. It's hard to face the fact that you are no longer alive. You could tell my people that they're dead, but they wouldn't believe you.
So we're trapped here in this eternal darkness, this never ending night. It's almost as if time itself had stopped.
If only we had daylight...
An elixir of eternal youth would make me even richer.

I found the broker scared witless. A Golem was attacking the town, and he said if I killed it, he’d stop the slave trafficking.
The creature is surrounded by a T-Energy shield. The magical blazing stones must surely hold the key to victory.
A piece of art. Far too beautiful to rot out here in the wilderness.
Looks like he didn't feel good enough. Now he's got what he wanted. An honorable death on the battlefield.
I was told to defeat the ice phoenix. I wonder what awaits me.
Finally, a city. Now I need to find a street cafe with a nice Latte Macchiato...

Memorial
Take no thought of who is right or wrong or who is better than. Be not for or against.
- Bruce Lee
With your face, you'd be perfect for a horror movie.
The negotiator is dead. What should I do with the lamb? I'll leave it to its own devices.
What do you mean 'they are dead'? Oh, you know everything. Please, do not tell anyone. Oh no, put your weapon away. No, please don't!
Mission accomplished. The merchant has given me an artifact as a reward.
That was close! But the alchemist did survive. I'm eager to hear what he has to say.
This is what you think in your wisdom? Well, what do you say?
I don't understand you, but we have to discuss another topic.
That's really a great answer! And now to something completely different.
Ah well, perhaps you've got something to say to this.
I am none the wiser, but perhaps you've got something to say about this?
There's something else we should discuss.
As we are already talking I'd like to mention another thing as well.
So, there's something else I'd like to know.
Ha, if you think so! But what do you have to say regarding this matter?
Before I go I need another bit of advice from you.

Ah! The zumzumroot! Oh very fine indeed! I’ve concocted a new mixture in the meantime. Would you like to try it? No? Aha...don't trust me, eh? Bah! Then I’ll try it myself...

Hmm not bad. Yes that’s... well... urgghhh...
I have gathered the tobacco leaves. You couldn't pay ME to chew on it, but everyone’s different.
Off to the underworld with you!
I believe that everyone does what they have to do. And you are certainly a good soldier.
In the end, it's you who has to make a decision... Even if it's one that might be unusual for a soldier.
Well you know how much I like modern warfare. I'm already convinced.
You seem very wise for a soldier, if you don't mind me saying so.
I see the art of war interests you too. We have that in common, comrade.
I don't care either way, you know my motto: If head and body are still connected, it's sloppy work.
I don't really care about that. I just attack forcefully with everything my blades have to offer.
I can't tell you much about that. I fight best when I focus completely on the blood in front of me.
Say what you want, but I won't reconsider my fighting style. Everything gets smashed up, that's all that matters.
I believe you, but I don't really think about that much when I'm busy killing my enemies.
Excellent work! Now we can prepare a targeted attack. I will draw up an order to that effect.

Tell the guards what happened!

Brigands, you say? And they captured Adrien? Thank the Gods that he's safe now! That’s unbelievable. At least I have some thread rush in stock now.
Please go and tell the town guard what happened, so that nothing like this can happen again. Thank you!

The ritual worked! The Abishai should be much weakened now. Khormynth is too exhausted to accompany me.
The ritual caused the cave entrance to collapse but Khormynth will open a teleporter-portal.
Everything seems to be in order. My hunting rate was about as good as that of Seraphim Milrinda. Lucretia worried over nothing.

Well that was quite successful, at least it's satisfied my curiosity. I can definitely say now that one shouldn't mix rotten rat meat with glue and gant pods. The landlord and his family have paid quite a price for this knowledge, but I got a lot of gold.
In nature, it's the law of the jungle!
You weak? Go! Fight! No leave until you or things dead!
Gelminy says we have to go back to the dead languages expert.
Enemies in this region mainly use normal weapons.

Find goldworms for my customer!

Hey you! You look like someone who's traveled a lot. Have you ever seen any goldworms? There's no better fishing bait, I tell you. You throw the fishing pole in and the big fish start biting, just like that. No idea why. One of my customers is desperately looking for... what?
YOU HAVE SOME?
That's incredible!. Take them to my customer. He lives not far from here. He should offer you a good price. Make sure he doesn't shortchange you.
My stats are not high enough yet for this wonderful item...
This statue is too weathered to know whom it depicts.

Bohemi Gardella
Ancaria never saw the likes of him again... Fortunately.
At this point, the canyon is so deep that you can't see the ground.
Patriarch Yator is really investing in this feud. My payment was excellent.
What do you want? What do I care about my good for nothing neighbor? There's nothing he could want from me!
What do you think? Will the souls of the plants see Kybele's otherworldly garden? Sometimes, I doubt that!
I know the Goddess puts us on the same level as our plant brothers and sisters, but aren't we superior to them?
What will Kybele's realm look like, when we reach it after death? Do you think it's as well-regulated as it is here?
What happens to us mortals when we die? Who is allowed to see Kybele's eternal garden, and who will simply serve as a seedling?
The Goddess' mercy is certainly infinite, but the thought of coming back as a plant scares me!
Kybele's gardens - a fabulous vision of the afterlife! But I hope we'll be able to do more than plant and water there!
How will it be once we go to the Goddess? I'm not afraid of death, but withering scares me a little!
I wonder if it's really true that we Priests serve as seeds for a new generation after death. That doesn't sound very nice.
I will always bow down to Kybele and tend her heavenly garden after death - but that job is probably in high demand!
I've submitted myself to the mercy of the Goddess, that is very true! But I don't want to think about my reincarnation as a seedling!
You're going to have a hard time. The good and the peaceful are often defeated by the powers of evil.
You want to go to battle. Take heed. Trolls like tender women.
I can't tell you which way to go. But I would like to drink a mug of wine with you.
A small grave for a small Kobold!
These Orcs are supposed to be a very hostile people, but I am prepared.
Greatly decreases the regeneration time of the Divine Gift and unlocks additional item attributes of the artifacts.
Porr-TUAG! Enogh u'Artha... what? I'm practicing the spell, don't bother me.
Meliondor has fallen. Now I have to tell his sister who is the soldier's fiancée the bad news.

The Octagolamus must be defeated.

Welcome, warrior! You are the first among us who is not of Orcish blood. These are unusual times. The Clans have agreed to a truce because we are facing a higher threat and need to fight it.

The large river that belongs to all Clans does not flow any longer. A water monster - the Octagolamus - has blocked it and dammed up a lake. Many brave warriors from all Clans have died. Too much blood has been shed. Too much blood! The water monster must die. All Clans have agreed. We fight each other, but we will close ranks against a mutual threat.

We will be the Clan that defeats the Octagolamus. The honor will be ours! OURS alone! There is something that the other Clans do not know. Without water the monster is like a sitting duck. Weak and vulnerable. Run the river’s well dry. Once the ground is dry, you will be able to kill the monster. We will be able to build houses and cultivate fields. Who knows? It might mean the end of the Clan wars as well.

Escort this shaman to the river. He will run the well dry.
By my ancestor's Elixir of Toad Corpse - a Spell of Protection is what I want!
The weapon for ice damage doesn't do me any good.
By all Gods, what's going on here? Those Demons took on the shape of children to attract me. I destroyed them.
Even the nicest fight comes to an end at some point.
The Village Fool was amused about my news. He gave me a real funny hat.
I will deactivate you extra fast.
Let's see what you can do!

Inquisitor Ortlewyn assigned me the task of delivering a message in his name to the troops who are camped out at the ruins. The Inquisitors seized the remote region of Noriath Corner and have stationed troops near there to smoke the defiant Lumen Priests out of the Temple.
Do you have a little something for me to do?
Listen, I'll smack you in the kisser!
I brought the cultists the good news of the shaman’s death. He gave me some magic potions, but unfortunately shamanic potions are worthless.
This region does not need a Guardian any more.
Thank you for sparing our lives. Can you take us to the surface now?

Thyssus Feinohr
His biggest enemy was his cook
The  Kobold Schmucker needs material for the snowman. Apparently, they somehow got misplaced. He needs a carrot, snow balls, coal, a scarf and cap.
Blood stains everywhere! I hope my laundrette can get rid of them...

He's dead? By the Gods! What's going to happen now?
Please leave me alone with my pain.
Here comes the next task. This time, the opponents will obviously be bigger.
You are a real live hero. My knees are shaking...
Hero of Ancaria - donate bread to our children.
I would really like to have a man like you.
He's put this life behind him!
Whoever created animals wasn't in his right mind.
Analysis complete: Item is extremely rare.

Bastian Rolf
Why is this still jerky?!
Perhaps I should go on a journey and ply my dishonest trade somewhere else for a while.
Speed, agility and a malicious attitude are the secrets of my success.
I hide in a cave in the forest.
An ambush close to the border would be lucrative.
A cape of green felt would help disguise me in the undergrowth.
My hunting results? What about them?
I'll put and end to your miserable existence.
The bookkeeper is being harassed by soldiers. They want to arrest him. I shouldn't let that happen.
I will take care of your malfunction, Guard!
Brother, we should think about how we can take the power out of the hands of the Orcs.
They won't like that. What do you hope to achieve?
It's time for us to build an autonomous nation. The regime of these blockheads has to end!
And who shall rule over us? You? I don't have time for that rubbish. A nation is a lot of work, and I barely have time for killing!
Be that as it may. But we are better than the Orcs!
Go and tell them that when they're trampling on your skull!
So you won't join the uprising?
No. I don't have time for that. Manage your uprising alone!
The man is in the next village.
It would be better if you prayed regularly.
You're looking for the truth, aren't you? But only the Gods know what the truth is!
It is not only about fighting! Serve the Gods!
Well then, keep going, with Kuan's blessing!
Stay on the path and don't trample all over everything. Otherwise you will feel Kybele's wrath!

Take this secret message to Lord Alcander's captain!

I have another mission for you, but this time it's a rather delicate one. Take this message to the captain of my ship, the “Unsurpassable Justice.” You'll find the captain at the port. He's expecting you.
Fine. Your memory seems to be working. I hope this will also apply when it comes to keeping your promises.
And Captain Smith is the last to leave the ship...
What have you done? The shipment is lost, and it's all your fault! Why did I give this task to such a loser?
Pick up the shipment while it's still fresh.
You should stick to being slaves to the Elves!
I'm sure you don't mind me helping you out of the saddle?
I found Timotan's house. The forester and his wife are doing well, despite their difficult circumstances.
I'm not going to help you. Seek out Dromg!
So, you want to be a fighting machine?
Yeah, you're a Temple Guardian, so what?
We're going to beat the temple out of you, Guardian!

Hussian the Historian is interested in a battle that took place here many ages ago. Unfortunately few records of the battle exist. Apparently the Cult of the Nameless has ways of communicating with the undead. Hussian has asked me to make contact with the cult.
The legs are extremely fragile, but I have found five that should be just perfect. Barradei will be pleased with them.
What's with this nonsense? Really, only someone who doesn't have to look after a household could ask a question like that!
I don't have to answer to anyone! After all I am keeping the stables clean for Kuan's terrible children.
I don't know whether to laugh or cry! And who is going to clean up the house while I'm away? God Almighty perhaps?
What a joke! I've got a pack of useless children and a lazy husband to cook for.
I'm not listening to this rubbish! Do you want to swap places with me? I'll pray to Kuan and you can take care of my household! It's unbelievable!
Well you can tell your almighty Kuan that if he misses me so much, then he should think about saving me from all this housework!
Well prayers certainly won't get the cooking and the washing done. I can tell you that! Pah!
Then perhaps you shamans might like to give me a hand with the laundry!!! Not that you ever would...
Well maybe Kuan doesn't have a household to take care of! Perhaps you should think about that before opening your big mouth!
Where is this God when I need some help around here? I've got 12 of his children to take care of, you know? Now get out!
An unknown warrior from long lost times. Presumably, the Dryads wouldn't raise a memorial for him.
Judd G. Turpin - One close shave too many.
I had a feeling that it wouldn't be that last I heard from Mr. Giles.
I wouldn't take these things seriously; there are too many rumors nowadays!
That's rubbish! The ancestors cast a magic barrier around us, and nothing evil can ever penetrate it!
I won't call you a liar, but these are nothing but superstitious stories from people trying to cause trouble.
I don't believe in these rumors! I am not willing to accept that the ghosts of our forefathers aren't able to protect us.
What are you afraid of? So far we we've been able to end these ghost stories in a timely manner.
You're not serious, are you? I won't believe it, not even if you could prove it.
Strange ghosts in these parts? In this case I'd be more than happy to prove myself as a ghost buster.
That's nothing but nonsense, my dear! Something that is very mundane seems to trying to gain power over us!
I assume that these ghostly spooks have a mundane origin, and I'm going to find it for you!
The power of dark ghosts? Here? That seems to be impossible, because the magic bane of our forefathers is strong!

Find Sister Furia!

Have you seen Sister Furia by any chance? About this tall, blond with wings? No?

Hmm ... damn! Oh, pardon me. I know I'm not supposed to curse. But Seraphim Furia hasn't been seen since our last round “Hunter and Hunted”. You don't know what “Hunter and Hunted” is? Well, it's very simple. Us Seraphim don't use this area exclusively for monster hunting but also to train our tracking skills. One of us plays the hunted. She gets a few hours head-start, then the rest of us try to track her down. The winner gets a sizable reward from Sophia herself!
Well ... Seraphim Furia was the hunted in our last round. And now she's been missing for two days. Why don't you try and find her? Maybe you will have more luck than us. Try to pick up her trail at the starting point of the hunt to the north of here.
A terrible feeling is compelling me to go back to the archaeologist's camp.

Another corpse. My sketches should help me to identify it.





This means the creature must still be in the village.
People like me are even welcome in hell!
And this is only the beginning!
This little rascal was spreading lies about us again wasn't she? Dragging us through the mud, was she? Well miss, you just earned yourself a good hiding and three days in the cellars!
The village Priest Rufus gave me a vial with a "potion of cleansing.”  I'll pour it on the former cemetery. Hopefully it will make the souls that are lingering move on!
There are currently no items available.
Nothing more to see around here.

A hunting guide has lost a cow. It was attacked and killed by a wolf, which probably also swallowed the cow’s jeweled collar. He has asked me to kill the wolf and retrieve the collar from the wolf’s gut.
Life was just a game to Ender, now it's ended.
Uh-oh... I hope I haven't overestimated my capabilities here!

Bring us Gronkor's hands!

This is an astonishing turn of events. Now we know the truth, and now BOTH clans will be able to bear one of Gronkor's hands with their standard! We shall have his right hand, and they can have his left hand! Would you enter the grave once more to fetch Gronkor's hands? We will reward you of course, one hand washes the other as the saying goes.

This is a reaching quest test. Reach the following items in the specified order:

  • bla
  • foo
  • bar
I have to slay five Kobold shamans to take the fight out of the other Kobolds.
Why do you attend prayer so rarely, son?
I'm very busy, a lot going on. This and that... you know.
Have you heard about this new cult? Apparently, a few crazies have begun praying to a golden monkey God.
We're not craz, uh, I mean, no, father, that's news to me.
Listen to me. Don't stray from the path of the one true faith, or the forgotten ancestors will come for you.
You have only threats for me. The new God at least promises to make me rich.
You're a fool if you believe that. Only the false Priests will get rich.
I don't know what you mean. I have to go.

I'll beat your skull and make it even more flat!
There you are. You have served quite well, and your job is almost done. The last task for you as my pupil is to hand me the key. Now!
I was successful! I've collected enough dog tags.
It's a tragic fate, but who am I to complain about it!
The Temple Guardian fires up jet nozzles, which help him to cover distances fast. While he is levitating, the jet nozzles cause severe area fire damage.
I only need the heads! The heads can tell me everything I need to know.
Live by the sword, die by the sword!
I think I need a cold compress...
I don't have time to die...
Brothers and sisters, don't let me die!
Die from the hand of the Inquisition, Gnome!
Go on, you should not let the Grand Inquisitor wait! That is inappropriate.
A troll teeth trophy. That sounds ... becoming.
The teeth from ten Trolls for a single victory trophy. Wow, that thing must be huge!
Let us go and pull some teeth from those Trolls! Little joke, you know? Oh well, forget it.
First it was one, now there are ten. I hope that's it then!
A necklace made of Trolls' teeth? How unhygienic!
What will they come up with next?
Thank you! The woodsmen will set to work soon. Good day!

Lumen

Lumen is the God of Light. He makes all things visible. He is a healer and knows what has been and what will be.



Grants: Dazzle

Divine lightning blinds all those who are near. Dazed by its glistening light they are briefly unable to move. The effect is even more severe against some powers of evil. They will combust instantly and burn in the cleansing light of Lumen!
No! A real, live, mighty warrior! Nobody will believe this!
You're all the grown ups ever talk about.

I do have an idea of who that monster might be! So it continues. Nobody can find out that it is one of my sisters. What would people think about Seraphim?
This means that the bounty will have to remain uncollected.
Do you have what it takes to be a leader?
This savegame is linked with another User or Online-ID. The savegame can be used, but Trophies cannot be achieved and scores will not be submitted to the leaderboards.
If you serve me you serve the Gods!

I have a terrible feeling about the archaeologists at the excavation site.
I feel that they are in grave danger. The Du'Rach will definitely not pass up an opportunity to attack the camp when the garrison is weak.

The Dragon is dead! I got a few of his heartscales and released the Human slaves. They told me to use the underground railway to get to the next outpost. I should be able to get more information there about the location of the old Dragon Mer-Kil.
Nicole has thanked me on behalf of Sophia, and given me a handsome reward.

A member of the nameless cult asked me to take care of an old battlefield. A lot of undead linger there, and they still have their identification disks. The nameless cult fears that the conservative Lizardmen will start building memorial shrines if they acquire the disks. The cult wants to prevent this! I should take at least 15 disks to a high Priest.
Profit is the salt in the soup of every businessman.
The barony is significantly safer without this plague of spiders.

You have to help me.  The lever is a little stuck, could you give it a try?
Lidwien is glad that the heirloom has been returned to her.
You act against the will of the Gods.
He went across the sea to the Seraphim.
Tinctures against lice, fleas and bedbugs are very popular.
I wonder if one can cast a spell on an arrow head, so that it meets its mark by itself?
One can make Orcs ill with this elixir. It will make them as gentle as lambs.
Today I shall consult the runes.
I shall sit down at the crossing and wait for inspiration from within.
Today I'll collect stones for the health ritual.
An evil magic potion shall make the warriors even more aggressive.
Astrology helps me with my decisions.

I have found an envelope on the ground. Unfortunately, it is empty but it seems to be from some "Easter Cult." Maybe I can learn more about that. Something must drive these people to gather Easter eggs. But what?
As a magician I really don't have to put up with this!
It's not easy to hunt deer.
No worries, your flunkies will take care of your bones.
A businessman has given a scientist money to build a machine that will make water out of sand. He has asked me to find out how the scientist is using his money.
Kybele is the Goddess of Nature. Her soothing hand heals the hero and his allies and renders them invulnerable for a brief period.
Thank you. Now I can finally get to sleep. How I will welcome the quiet...

Go to the center of the island.

Ah, you're back! Very good, now hand me the potion....
Fortunately, there are neither Golems nor water monsters here.
Somebody should write a song about the woman who killed the Gar'Colossus!
Golems are said to be evil creatures. I believe you might be able to confirm that.
Greetings, woman from afar who has slain the Gar'Colossus!
Orcs are nature's children too. I don't fear them.
It´s all done. The soul of the adept is free now. So, there's nothing more for me to do here. I'll be on my way.

Fight my servant!

You?! I already heard stories about you. And I must say I didn't expect you to get this far. But you know the saying ... if you play with fire, you get burned! Let's see if that's true. Are you a match for my servant?

Calm down, Dryad. That wasn't Mother Nature's revenge, it was just a little spider. There are tons of spiders, and who cares whether there's one more or less? It would have been worse if it had eaten you.

Fetch me two sacks of trollcherries!

Good, good! We’ve got the birdgrapes. Now we need some trollcherries. No trollcherries, no whoosh! In which case you might as well drink Zero Swill. Bring me two sacks of trollcherries. I’ll stamp the birdgrapes in the meantime. I always like to do that myself. As the owner of a leading swill brewery, I have a reputation to look after. Supposedly it’s good for varicose veins too! Turrus sells trollcherries at his market stand. I still owe him some gold, so it might be better if you pick up the cherries.

Scatter Nionake's ashes on the crystal planes!

Have you heard about the tragic accident? Nionake is dead. Stumbled over a root and fell into the tusks of a crystal boar she was about to stab. Bam! Dead! Gone! The end of a truly great huntress! After all, Nionake holds no less than four records in different hunting disciplines. Tragic!
Luckily, Nionake left a detailed will in case of an early death. Her will specifies that she wants her ashes to be scattered on the crystal fields amidst her favorite prey - the crystal boars.
The problem is ... we are all very busy at the moment. And ... and also very out of sorts after this loss! Would you mind escorting Nionake's remains on her final path?

I met Clarence, a jester who is down on his luck. He buried a treasure in Greifenburg, but he no longer has access to it. I'm supposed to recover the treasure for him and take it to his daughter. The good child has consented to a marriage for money and her devoted father wants to spare her from such a fate!
I searched the whole area, and I found a small ritual site for Kuan. The people there took one milestone, and are now carving a statue of Kuan from it. Of course I won’t betray my fellow believers.

Building Site for the Ladolath School
Unauthorized people keep out!
We will hold parents responsible for their children's behavior!
For ... ! Oops, where did that come from?
That’s the village Charolus meant. I wonder where the carpenter lives.

I finally found my "treasure." Unfortunately it wasn't a treasure at all, it's just a chest full of gold worms. A Lizardman fisher would be really jealous, but I had hoped for something else. Well, maybe it'll be worth something in the future.
This fighting is getting a little monotonous - I'll take the potion!
Thank you for saving me, sister. Now that the demon is dead, I can return to the monastery
Thank you! Ker will reward you, but here's something from me as well.
Let's not waste any more time.
What do I care about the fog? Let's keep going.
That's exactly what I think. Let's waste no time.
You're right. We've already wasted enough time.
I totally agree. It's not our job to repair that stupid machine.

The path to the Crystal Cave is northbound. Follow it, sister!

Oh sister, what have you become? I know you've been long from our lands, but has the outside world really corrupted you so much that you would slay your own kin so wantonly? Desist! Too much blood has already been shed. You seek the Crystal Caves? Very well, give me your word you'll refrain from killing any more of your kind and I'll show you the way.
I'm here to save the world, not to wait around here.

Hm... HARR...
We're supposed to chase the Thraconians out of the valley? For 30 gold bars? That doesn't sound like a good deal! HARRR!
I'll do it for 40 gold bars. That's my final offer! What do you say?
I assume you just stumbled into that. It's no secret that you Temple Guardians are somewhat gullible. TyBosso is a criminal. Here read this letter, it explains everything.
I slew them all. It was a bloody deed. Let’s get back to the Priest now.
Uses Kynapse. © 2003-2008 Kynapse, Kynogon is a registered trademark.
This energy - it attempts to change me.

Find my scout and confront the deserters!

Several of my soldiers have deserted. Cowardly scum! I must punish them or else the rest of my soldiers will run away too. Unfortunately I'm tied up here. Could you take care of that for me? Find my scout. He's been following their tracks and should be able to tell you where they're hiding.
Who do you think you are?
To the ground, I am the governor!
My guards will take care of you!
Move, or you'll end up in the pillory!
Who do you think you are talking to?
Don't you dare lay hand on me!
You stink like a polecat ... Try it with soap sometime ...
You found the book? Excellent! Then let's get out of here.
Hoi stranger! Information ain't fer free 'round here. You better order somethin' ta drink first ...
Maybe I should pay a visit to a merchant some time soon.
In the name of all Kobolds I wish you a merry Christmas!
The undead man carried a letter containing the last words of one of the villagers. I wonder whether the village doctor knew him...
My riding skills aren't quite adequate to break in this horse.

Find the spy and bring us the information he has collected!

Bless you, friend. We often discuss the affairs of the monastery while strolling in the gardens, but we're sure that a spy has been eavesdropping on our conversations recently. We are not sure exactly what information he might have gathered by these means, but we would prefer that our affairs remained a secret. Find the spy and bring us the information he has collected.
One more hit like that and I'll take you seriously.
You are good, I have to concede that fact!
Thank you. Hopefully our efforts will not be in vain. Perhaps a woman will soon pass this way. When she does, I'll charm her with a nice, big, green lettuce.
I've still got just enough strength left to cut down birch saplings.
My conscience is always nagging at me for making all those birds homeless.
The trees seem to be afraid of me.
You learn to curse when you have to cut up old beech trees.
The door is locked. Maybe it has something to do with all these totems?!
There you are, finally! Here are the goods. Now get out of here before someone sees us together!
TyBosso and his companions have been terminated. I should search the post. Preliminary analysis indicates that TyBosso owned some valuable things.
May Kybele be with you, stranger.

The Orc chieftain Gintonik has given me a scroll from his brother’s estate. The deceased Orc was a keen varguz player, whatever varguz is. Maybe Cen hid his fortune somewhere? Let’s see what this scroll says:

Between two ponds
Behind three stones
Through the gate
And remember!
The path to victory!

What an extraordinary riddle.
The weapon for magical damage doesn't do me any good.
Gangrene - Targets do not need to be as severely injured before the damage output of Viperish Disease increases.
Relapse - Increases the duration of Viperish Disease which leaves more time for opponents to become infected.
Transmission - Increases the chance to transmit the disease even with no shrunken head equipped.
Headhunter - Increases the chance to receive a shrunken head when the victim dies.
Gouge - Chance of inflicting a deep wound on first target.
Contaminate - Extends the range of Viperish Disease.
The spiders are all dead. It's time to fetch the wine now.
This is getting a little too risky for me...
This fight doesn't look good for me!
Spirits of the forest, stand by me!
Look for these herbs in the meadows rather than in the jungle.
I will stand guard while the others search the site for valuables.
There! That’s six heads and three guts, all I need. Now I can return to the Orc woman.
Radius - Increased radius of Gust of Wind
Squall - Gust of Wind spreads faster
Good! Very good! That will teach them. Thank you!
Do you have something to eat for me? I am so tired and hungry from killing.
Troll have small, no can give to green dwarf! Dwarf catch own food.
Ha, you Trolls are greedy. Really greedy!
Green worm rude! Green worm be nice or go squish on ground!
Why won't you give me anything? I am incredibly hungry.
Troll need food or no can fight. Human there, Dwarf catch eat human!
Bah, Human flesh! No, I don't like it!
Then Dwarf stay hungry. Go from Troll now!
Let's see what we can get for your remains!
Since when can metal scraps talk?
Don't you have a Temple to guard?
I don't see a Temple here. So you're obviously in the wrong place!
Ah! They talk about you every now and then, warrior!
One day you'll be a hero! But don't forget to ask the Gods for their blessing every day.
Well fought, combatant. But did you also pray enough?
Note:  Your character's and the server's quest progress are incompatible. In order to preserve your character's progress your quest progress will not be saved on this server.
The lumberjacks have their amulets now, and the young mage is also happy!

A long time ago, a battled raged between the armies of two mages. The magical energy released when the armies met turned this area to an eternal battleground. The undead troops of both parties are cursed to fight each other until the end of time.

One day during a foray, the garema must have encountered the fighting troops in this area and killed some of the undead. That's how they got the weapons. Since garema love nothing better than weapons, they went deeper into this region. A grave mistake, as it turned out! The garema blood that was spilled expanded the borders of the battle ground and now the battle threatens to spill over from this remote valley into the rest of the continent.

Unless the souls of the battling arch mages are destroyed, the danger to the rest of the world remains!

Escort me to the next safe base. I could listen into the conversation of two of these creatures, and they said something about an attack on a nearby camp. Let's go.
Joana said her nephew is the driving force behind this family row. I'll talk to him. Maybe there is still hope for the young couple.
I would at least like to give it a try though!
Hello, hero. They're already talking about you!
I want to be like you.
The things you do must be dangerous.
My shadow is longer than yours!

AH! What have we got here? A dragon mage!
What? A message from my old friend N'kioam? Well ... give it to me! I'm eager to see what it says!
It amazes me, that you try to pass yourself off as a hero!
By the Gods, you can't truly be proud of your deeds.
Honor - that seems to be a word you are not familiar with.
You may be powerful, but the Inquisition is even more powerful!
I'll never take this ring off again.
Tolerance has no place on the battlefield.
Someone has to say it - this armor really doesn't emphasize your femininity.
You certainly have fought some hard fights. Just relax for a while.
Ah, it's you. Sorry, but I don't have time for you, the merchants are already waiting.
The wind, weather and dangers don't seem to bother you much.

Kill Lady Delymes bodyguard!

Psst, hey you! Can you spare a second for me? I'm lieutenant Taen, and I've got a really important and very delicate mission for you.

It's about Lady Delyme! This Lady appears to be a loyal member of the noble class, but we found out that she's secretly working for the Inquisitors. The High Council doesn't understand and is continuing to provide her with confidential information.

We have to eliminate the risk she poses. We can't kill Lady Delyme, the scandal would be enormous, so we'll intimidate her instead!

She'll be arriving soon by ship, and will immediately go to the courthouse to attend a secret meeting. That's our opportunity! If you can kill her bodyguard it should give her a sign that she can't misinterpret!

Will you accept this task?
That was the fifth and last focus point! Let's hope this works.
I wouldn't phrase it that way, but the fight is tiring and it can deafen parts of the soul.
Personally I'm very religious, but killing follows its own rules and you have to recognize that.
We still fight for the people and the ancestors. I don't think there's anything we can be accused of.
We take a lot of risks when it comes to defending the country, and I think the ghosts of our forefathers know that.
You know the motto of our warriors: “To the ancestors and favor from them!”  Everything is alright!
You shouldn't assume that! We are the bravest of the brave and we fear no foe!
Then do us the favor of joining us on the battlefield! Then you can see what it's like to feel that the ancestors have left you, I can assure you it won't take long!
We still are full of belief and confidence, those are our standing orders for the war!
I understand, but I can assure you that there's a firm belief among the troops! In any situation!
I do strongly and without a doubt believe! And that's what I'm going to tell my comrades too!
It's only for nature's mercy that you haven't become extinct yet!
I want to be able to catch swampfish again.

Bring five blue tongues to Waton!

Hey you! I’m in a bit of a, well, in a bit of a pickle. I thought you might be able to help me. Lately some of my comrades have started behaving in the strangest manner, they have even gotten violent! They're a rough bunch at the best of times, but some of them have started going berserk, they're like madmen! They attack anything and anyone! I noticed that they all have blue tongues now. I told our leader Waton about this and he ordered me to bring him five tongues, but I can’t just walk up to my comrades and kill them! Could you do it for me and take the tongues to Waton? Take this ring, then he'll know that I sent you! It is our ring of honor.
It's my good fortune to meet you here, my dear! Tell me, why do you look so sad?
Oh, venerable Priest! The man I tried to give my heart to has refused my love, so now it weighs heavy inside me.
Well, if you will excuse my bold words - that man has no eyes for beauty!
I don't understand him! Everyone knows that I am the most beautiful girl in all the nearby villages.
Don't be sad. I know how to soothe a heavy heart...
No, something much better! Visit me tonight and I shall tell you more over a chalice or two of wine!
Yes, I shall! Farewell for now!
Wait, don't! I yield! If you spare me, I'll tell you who our leader is.
I will follow you wherever you go.
You no mercy, me no mercy!
Only one bad one here - that me!
Imagine that. The customer has paid the captain with counterfeit money. The captain is pretty angry right now and has asked me to kill the customer. For a fee, of course.
A ship that carries women is a cursed ship.
Elves seem so fragile. I wonder if they really are.
I've never kissed an Elf before. So how about it? I might let you live.
Don't hide behind your magic, Elven witch.
Slowly Wackar seems to be realizing what his problem is. Good for me!
I shall not be part of such foolishness.
It seems the Lizardmen chose a picnic spot that was a little too close to a T-Energy field. They are all horribly mutated and it’s not a pretty sight. I’ll have to put them out of their misery.
Hurry! Maybe it's not too late.

Oh my wood, thank you. Well now you know more than before. I hope you gathered branches from the ground and didn't break them off the trees. The Guardians of the Forest would have all our heads otherwise.
WAA! Very good! Give! Take! Go!

After we killed all the Lizardmen at the Marigold field, the cult leader offered to perform the ritual of immortality - or rather killing me and using the leaking magic to turn me undead. As if I'd give up my future just to turn into one of those things that the nameless wackos worship! I declined the offer and continued on to the jungle.
The trader denied everything. Well that was to be expected.
When I got to the business house right on the border of the Human realm, I received a package addressed to Marys DeElfici. I don't think he'll have much use for it once I'm through with him though!

Don't forget that your hero has a Divine Gift. The nature of this spell depends on the deity that you selected when you created your hero. In any case, it is very powerful. You should only execute it in emergencies as it requires a long time to regenerate.
From a certain level you will be able to combine several combat arts into a combination using the combat art screen. You can assign this combination to a combat art slot just like normal combat arts.
During multiplayer games you can teleport directly to any other hero using the world map.

Two skills are available for each combat art aspect respectively to increase the efficiency of the entire aspect.
 
The more skill points you invest into any given aspect, the more modification points will become available for it. These points can be used to modify an aspect's combat arts.

The glowing circle around opponents indicates their level in relation to your hero. Examples:
 
Gray circle: that opponent is considerably weaker and will not yield much experience.
 
Red circle: That opponent's level is higher than your hero's.
Using the world map you can teleport to any active portal and to the resurrection monolith that you last activated.
Equipped items must be unequipped if you want the Blacksmith to forge them.
Where would the people of the world be without Kybele?
The enemies of this region still mainly use normal weapons.
Please go and look for the milestone, I have to do some calculations now.
Chance that opponents cannot evade attacks.
Those were the three watering holes. Now we should probably go back!
You are the proof that size doesn't matter.

I found four piles of skulls arranged in the form of a square on the beach. If the corners are connected it forms a cross. I found a stone at the point of intersection. An old key was located beneath the stone which was adorned with a skull and engraved with tiny runes. The runes were difficult to decipher, but I figured it out and they specify the location of a cave. How convenient!
What is the Inquisition doing here?!
Inquisitor, I'll tear you to shreds!
The office is more important than the man!
Fantastic! That should be enough for a few good plows. Oh before I forget, here's your reward!
Are you as clumsy as me when it comes to the aspects of love? I always know what to do when I'm fighting, but the opposite sex makes me nervous.
Young lady, was it your voice I just heard singing songs of praise as clear as a bell?
Oh no, you must be mistaken! I never sing!
Oh, I disagree. I'm sure it was you!
Ok, it was me, but please don't tell anyone. I'm not someone who likes to be the centre of attention.
I will accept your wish. However, it is a shame to let a voice like that go to waste.
I prefer it this way. Everybody who hopes to find fame and fortune with their voice nowadays will end up bitterly disappointed.
Such wise words. We shall leave it at that then. Go with the Goddess!
I thank you from the bottom of my heart!
So that’s done! I can return to Eldran now.
I won! I won! I knew there had to be that much water, isn't it great?
Treachery! The slaves have been freed.

A Dryad couple's young daughter disappeared. She probably fell into the hands of a dubious cult that calls itself the “Shadows of Life.” The mother left to look for her daughter some time ago and has disappeared as well. I'm supposed to find them both.
Brutus Plutocratio will never catch and sell slaves again.
Why ... do you test me like this, Keeeer ...
Gernott was really angry that he didn't get a part of the legacy but that's life - or death as the case may be. I'll give my inherited land to Andreala. She will be overjoyed.
Enough with the haunting! Now you die.
I bow down to you, sister!
Is there anything else you need?
Leave me alone! You won't get any information from me! You certainly won't hear it from me that Varuck paid us to find you g... Oh no!
I'm not sure if warriors should even have families. We lead quite dangerous lives!

Right, you are supposed to prove yourself? Well, go and kill the prisoners then!

Here to prove you can fight, hmmm? Well then, let’s have a look at you. Turn! Oh my, yes! I’m thinking something in a green. Perhaps a Lizardman? The two of you would look lovely in the arena together. He’s not a forest green, you understand. More of a chartreuse? with just a hint of blue? Trust me, darling. I’m never wrong.

An old Kobold shaman said the chef put something in the soup that drives the Kobolds mad, and makes them only want to destroy everything. Could it really be just the soup? I'll go have a talk with this chef.

Kill some holy snakes for Dromg!

Not far from here is a village full of creepy snake worshippers. The Great Rat hates snakes more than anything else. Kill a few snakes, then the Great Rat will agree to let me give you one of my little critters for T’Pargan.

Go to these snake lovers, kill their holy beasts and I will give you a nice firm juicy rat!
I've been waiting for this moment, I knew that one day it would come down to a fight between us. Well let's get this over with, only one of us is leaving this room alive!
Apparently this poacher wasn't just marked for death because of his fishing. The Cult is also interested in his demise. I don't care, I got my reward.

NO?
You've gotten rather full of yourself on your little journey, eh? You think you're tough now because you killed a few monsters? Sorry to spoil your delusions of grandeur, but you've never been anything more than a pawn in my game. I never lied you know. I needed all kinds to accomplish my goal, but the end is near and I don't require your presence any longer. Take pride in the role you have played in bringing about my success. Now you die.

The scholar has an old map with a rose drawn on it. It's not a great clue, but at least it's a start. If I find the caravan that was involved in an accident and recover Cassandra's goods, then I'll be given the map.
Back to the woods with you!

Past! Hey you! Yes, you! Come here.
I have good ears so I know what you’re looking for and I know how you could make a little money on the side.
I happen to know a trader who is looking for, um, volunteers. Voluntary testers, if you know what I mean. His lotion is absolutely free. In fact, he’ll even pay you to choose his product. So if you’re interested you’ll find him close to town. You can’t miss him!
Thank you! Thank you very much! You’ve been a big help!
I have completed my assignment with the help of the Gods.

Kill five cultist shamans and bring me their skulls!

Welcome! I'm commander Iskari.
My troops are worn out by the constant attacks of the cultists who roam this area. We won't be able to hold out much longer. I could give you some gold if you'd be willing to help us. It's not much, but it's all I have. If you kill five cultist shamans, and bring me their skulls as proof, the gold will be yours.
That really wasn't easy. All those enemies, and always having to watch out for Shirka. I managed it though, Shirka's alive.
Head eye-mechanic Nimble was a bit embarrassed. He didn't get to finish the mechanical I for Gareth, yet. And to make matters worse, he is out of lenses. He wants me to collect ten bandit eyes.

Show the traveler around.

You there, a word. Have you seen my business partner, a blond High Elf, about this tall? No... too bad.
We organize adventure tours, you know. Quite a good business. People pay a lot of money to get chased through the sand by some wild bugs. Real desert atmosphere. Campfires, shivering in the freezing cold in your tent at night. Plus, they get a “I survived the desert” certificate. But if I can't find that no good Elf, then... how about you? Would you like to show my customer the adventurous world of the desert?
Even your deadly energy won't help you.
Even after my death, I will remain one of our people's heroes.
This object is for a Shadow Warrior, but I can't use it yet.
Phew! What a drudge! But this was the last one. It should be enough for a small hut.
Hey, player! Stagnation is regression! Keep going!
A jet of molten fire burns everything in the Temple Guardian's path.
You are wearing a dress ... and men in dresses make me nervous!

A present for me?

Oh, it's from my mother! How wonderful! And what a GREAT dress. What kind of wool is that? I really don't know what to say, Here, take this. It's of no use to me, but maybe you'll know what to do with it. A strange old mage claimed it contained “inhuman powers.”
I heard that some of our donations have been stolen! Do you know anything about it?
What's about these rumors that some donations disappeared? I hope they're nothing but a mistake.
How could our brothers steal donations from the ancestors? That seems a bit fishy.
I hope it doesn't prove to be true that our brothers took some of the donations for themselves!
Did you hear that some alms for the ghosts of our forefathers, that were intended for a place of worship, have been stolen? That’s scandalous!
I just heard that the alms collectors have been robbed! Who would dare do such a dreadful thing?
The alms collectors have been attacked? Who is so bold that they'd take things belonging to our forefathers?
If it's true that some alms meant for our forefathers have been embezzled, some of our brothers will have very serious explaining to do!
I don't want to believe it! I heard that recently donations for our ancestors were eaten by some of us instead! Do you have any thoughts about this?
What will I do? I'm almost certain that some of our brothers put a part of the donations in their own purses!
I will never be a slave again!
Should I be scared of you now?
Do not revolt against nobility, priest!
Thank you. The next fight will be easy now.
You should be on your way already!
I wish I was ready to use it.
You have several weapons in your inventory. Open your inventory with <$ID_CUI_RBBUTTON_INSERT> in order to assign new weapons to the appropriate <$ID_CUI_BTNPAD_SMALL_INSERT> - slot.
Fine! Then let's go, my fellow clan member!

Fetch me a lotion for my skin complaint!

Hello kind Sir, or is it Lady? I can never tell with you folks. My eyes are poor and on top of that I've got this blasted inflammation! I’m itchy all over! It keeps me up all night sometimes and it’s enough to drive me around the bend! If only I could go to the healer, but I can’t go out with this inflammation. I wouldn’t want anyone to catch it. Would you go to Hizz for me? He mixes lotions and I’m sure he’ll have something for skin inflammations.
TyBosso trusts me and thinks it's Dylaith who's behind it all. I should pay this Dylaith a visit.

The apothecary is out of thread rush. There’s an epidemic in a barony nearby, and the local count is confiscating all thread rush stocks. The apothecary asked me to look for his nephew, who left to get some new thread rush.
You didn't even pass your O-levels!
Yelling at Dryads is stupid. If you insult them you always insult yourself.
I'm going to take the boy along on a campaign. Let's see if this exposure therapy is successful.
We never sleep! We are always on guard, always ready!

Find the undead man who is harassing the village!

You won't believe it! An undead has been roaming around outside the village for some time now. This has to be related to the T-Energy outbreaks, I have no other explanation. Do you think you could deal with that issue? Who knows, you might even find out who the undead man is... was.
You have to keep active! Let's get a move on so my joints stay flexible!

You want coal? But I got just so that I would have some nice warmth. It was a fortunate coincidence that the coal was just lying in the village square, usually you can only get wood for your fire around here and that tends to smoke up the whole house. Let's make a deal: you bring me firewood ... nice, dry firewood! And I'll give you the coal.
You'll have to look for someone else.
The Inquisition is said to be heartless. I will prove to you otherwise ...
Profits have declined by 20%. Could this be because of the ban on smoking?
I found the microphone. Back to Hansi.
Be careful! The war results in many crimes.
I am vigilant, and you should watch out too. You know - the war...
The war is everywhere - watch out for your head!
I prefer standing guard duty over being in the field, that's for sure.
These are weird times! Someone like you never seems to put down their weapons.
I sell the best honey wine. Do you want to try it?
You seem very uncertain. That is not good...
I don't have any time for you, I must go to the seamstress.
You can purchase clothes and weapons at the merchant's, food and drink at the tavern. Is that everything?
One piece of advice from a woman to you: Never travel without healing potions and long underwear!
I am so glad you are here! Can you see them? Over there. The gray predators are coming again. We must drive them away!
What are you doing to us? We are good people. What did you say? My mother wasn't...
You can't run from me. Just accept it.
Grants the ability to ride better horses, reduces the regeneration penalty and increases the movement speed while mounted. Additionally, special abilities may be unlocked.
The priest wants to use the holy water to keep the dead from rising. In my opinion, steel and magic are far more effective, but to each his own.
Our fate is in your hands!
I don't care about the colour. His blood is red for sure, and it will flow like water.
About 83.5% of all statistics are put together spontaneously. Who would have thought it?
I'm the only one who knows the secrets of T-Energy!
Ah!  A vial of ointment from my colleagues in the cellars I presume? Great, thank you for your help! Take this as a token of my appreciation.
Weird! Whenever I see gnomes, I feel like killing!
I will do my best to defeat the creature!
Increased chance to detect hiding places, traps, and stealthed creatures.
A dead soldier is a lousy soldier.
He was very pleased when I gave the gold back, in fact he was generous enough to let me keep half of the gold. I should return to him later, to see if he has any more tasks for me.
Dead is dead, we'll help you with that!
Shouldn't you be lying in a stone coffin somewhere, wrapped up in bandages and mumbling curses?
The undead are not only an abomination of nature, they are just plain disgusting!

Forbidden Magic

For more than forty years I have been devoting my studies to Forbidden Magic. Of course, officially and by request of the academy and for investigation purposes only. It is not easy to deal with the dark sides of magic day in and day out - to study all these repulsive rituals and monstrosities and to concern oneself with the scum within these dark circles.

Little is written about Forbidden Magic. The essays you may find in libraries are few and far between, typically incomplete or they are based on assumptions and speculations. This is understandable since Forbidden Magic is... well, forbidden. How does one report about something that is not meant to exist officially? When I began my research for this book, I was facing this problem myself; however, owing to my position I enjoy certain privileges and those opened the doors to several secret documents. Otherwise, this book would have been unthinkable. Now, however, I hope to present to my readers a reasonably correct and comprehensive treatise about the subject, although this scroll is not meant for everyone’s reading pleasure. Let me begin without further delay and let us delve into the realm of darkness.

The seemingly most harmless variation appears to be the Curse Magic. At first glance, this branch of magic would not seem very dangerous. However, appearances can be deceptive! Curses can be extremely dangerous and it is almost impossible to lift them.

Then, of course, there are necromancers. They are abominable scum, obsessed with everything connected to death and reviving the dead. These people will not stop short of anything, they animate dead flesh and turn the mortal remains of creatures into mindless puppets. Semi-decayed bodies aimlessly amble through the night screaming for brains, despite the fact that their bodily functions have ceased to exist. The more advanced the decay, the more repugnant these monsters become. Even skeletons may be reanimated by Necromancy. They wander about although they cannot see where they are going - obviously, as they lack eyes - and they will lash out at anything that crosses their path. An experienced necromancer is able to create entire armies like this. Hordes of mindless warriors who do not know fear. This is repulsive and condemnable. And unhygienic!

Alas, this does not satisfy every necromancer! In an extremely repulsive incident, a necromancer attempted to create a body from many parts of corpses by sewing them together. However, he had to break off his experiment without being successful, sold his memoirs for an obscene amount of money and moved abroad.

In comparison to Necromancy, Curse Magic is much more subtle. Curses are almost impossible to lift once they have been activated. Unfortunately, there are no limits to the minds of curse magicians. Curses can be hexed to individuals, to groups of people, families or tribes. The probably best-known incident involves sword master Crauthain, who apparently incurred the wrath of a dark magician during a seemingly insignificant dispute. He spent the rest of his life with a rain cloud over his head. Even inanimate items can be subject to curses, such as corn fields, for example.

Another aspect of despicable Forbidden Magic is the Demonology, which deals with the conjuration of creatures from hell and other frightful spheres. Once brought into this world, these creatures of chaos can only be controlled by an immense amount of magic. If this magic falters, they break free and then, they are able to roam around the world freely, which is equivalent to a major disaster. Something like that will happen eventually; maybe in a thousand years, or even two thousand years, but it WILL happen.

Beware of Forbidden Magic, for all it breeds is disaster.
Beware of cursed hags, necromancers and demonologists and bring them to the attention of the authorities. Baneful are their deeds and nefarious their desires.

Lumen - God of Light

Lumen is the God of light. He makes things seen, he heals, he can see the future and he can see the past. Lumen represents the good side, benevolence and care.



Mythology

Lumen and Ker... the Yin and the Yang. The fire and the water. The light and the darkness.
Lumen is fighting an eternal battle against his arch-opponent, Ker, Goddess of darkness and evil. A battle, which he both wins and loses every day. It is obvious to both sides that neither of them can win, and that they cannot even exist without the other. But this battle is their destiny, their fate, which they seem to have accepted.
The two opposite entities Lumen and Ker play a special role in the Ancarian religion. Being the extreme sides, all other Gods have to take a stand in their battle, or remain neutral, which is just a third position in the divine equilibrium. There are many different theories about the relation between Lumen and Ker or the origin of their antagonism. In some cultures, the two Gods are considered twins, who hate each other, because they can not stand the idea that they are not unique. Consequently, they took the most contrarious positions against each other.
In other cultures it is being said that both Gods are claiming a deciding role in the creation process of the world. Lumen says, that the essence of the world is actually light and that darkness is just a by product, while Ker claims, that the opposite is true.

Appearance

Lumen is commonly displayed as a male human. Despite his long, white hair, he has a young face. Another identifying feature is the bright halo that surrounds him, merging his entire body into a silhouette.

The Cult

There are temples dedicated to Lumen all over Ancaria. Since the cult of Lumen represents one of the extreme sides of the eternal battle of good against evil, he - as well as Ker - are the Gods who can claim the most followers.
Lumen is not only the God of light, he is also the God of healing. Therefore, many of his temples have become some sort of hospitals as well. Sick and injured people often visit his temples, seeking cures and remedies. Priests of Lumen are said to have have the ability of channelling the divine powers of Lumen through their hands.
In the church of Lumen, the cycle of the day is very important. Sunrise is a very special moment for all his followers, because it represents the arrival of Lumen. On the opposite, every sunset is bemoaned, and in their prayers the believers express their hope and confidence that the night - the reign of Ker - will soon be over.
