Goblinoids

The Goblinoid classification not only covers Goblins, but also Orcs, Ogers, and Trolls. Some (usually older) books on anatomy also refer to Kobolds as Goblinoids, but this is obviously wrong.

Anatomically speaking, Goblinoids differ only insignificantly from Humanoids; every major anatomical characteristic is shared by both classes. The anatomical separation of Goblinoids and Humanoids is however not based on science, but rather on history. The famous anthropologist and naturalist Kyrilath was the first to classify every living being in Ancaria (published in “Fauna Ancaria”). His hatred of Orcs and Goblins was so intense that he couldn't bear the thought of belonging to the same class, so he simply created a new one. His classifications are still in use today and are accepted as true by many.

Eccentric chauvinisms aside, one can find a number of anatomical differences between both classes:

Goblinoid beings - just as Humanoids - possess a pair of arms and a pair of legs which are connected to the torso. The head (with two eyes, two ears, a nose, and a mouth) sits on the shoulders. They usually walk upright using their two legs.
If one takes a closer look, it becomes obvious that Goblinoid skulls are broader and more compact than Humanoid skulls. Their jaw is strong and prominent, their canines are long and thick. The neck tends to be short and much thicker than a Humanoid neck; sometimes the head seems to rest right on the shoulders with no neck visible at all. Goblinoid arms are very long when compared to legs and torso. Goblinoids also tend to be bow legged with outward pointing feet.
Shoulders are strong and muscular. Goblinoids are overall very brawny. To compensate for this added mass their bodies tend to be quite short. Goblinoids, especially Orcs, are physically well suited for fast and powerful movements; however, they do not cope well with longer stretches of physical exertion.

As mentioned earlier, Kobolds are not members of the Goblinoid class, but shall be described here anyway as they are often mentioned in this context.

Kobold anatomy is characterized by extreme disproportions. The head seems much too large for the body, the arms are long and thin, the legs short. The most prominent feature of a Kobold is the long, crooked nose. Many myths and legends have sprung up about this olfactory organ. In the southern desert regions dried and ground Kobold nose is still being used as a cure for certain “male problems”. Because of this superstition Kobolds have become almost extinct there.
The weight of the Kobold head leads to a shortening of the spine which causes a chronic disease with an unfavorable prognosis called Kobold Back. Nearly all Kobolds from a certain age on suffer from this condition. Statistics claim that almost 26% of all Kobolds die of Kobold back. The numbers for heroes who die trying to perform heroics and the number of adventurers falling victim to their adventures are almost as high.

Ancaria’s Herbs - Their Effects, Use and Special Features

Thread Rush* - grows in high grass and on the edge of fields. Cooked and thickened you get a sticky spread that can be applied to aching eyes or any kind of bruise, where it should remain for up to one day. It can also lessen the after-effects of too much alcohol when applied to the temples and forehead. It’s a staple supply for any healer that lives near a tavern or barracks.

Purple Coneflower - can be found on dry and sunny plains, but never in the shadows. If you chew it, it can dispel bad breath so can be used to counter the effect of hermit leaves. As a spread it can protect the skin from the sun, and in it's liquid form has a calming effect on the stomach and digestion. If the dosage of the liquid is too high, it can occasionally lead to a blue discoloration of the skin. There’s no known antidote against this state.

Shadow Moss* - grows in damp and shadowy places, mostly in caves and swamps. You can cut it out of the ground and immediately apply it to contusions, sprains and broken bones without any preparation. Bandages with shadow moss should be changed on a daily basis. It’s not advisable to eat it, even if you cook it, because it can lead to delusion, fever and death.

Hermit Leaves* - can be found in almost every deciduous forest of Ancaria, where they grow between bushes and under old leaves. Hermit leaves can be eaten raw or cooked, and they ease the pain of all kinds of sores. Applied on the skin they reduce pain in neck and ears, but afterwards the skin smells awful for several days. Eating it leads to bad breath, but this can be countered with purple coneflower. It makes a nice seasoning for all kinds of hearty meals, but eating hermit leaves with large amounts of alcohol can lead to flatulence and diarrhea.

Mandragorum Officinarum* - is also called the “herb of lovers“ and grows in rocky and sandy areas. This is one of the herbs every man and woman in Ancaria knows. The flowers have no scent, but when mashed and mixed with food will cause the person who eats it to fall in love with the first person they see. The responsible herbalist will make it clear to all interested buyers that the feeling cannot be removed by eating the herb again, so extensive planning should be used when considering serving it in food. The Mandragorum Officinarum stems can enhance potency, and it's possible to remove unwanted body hair by using a spread made with this herb.

All-Herb - grows in stagnant water and swamps. Cooked with water and consumed hot it can help with colds and internal organ problems, especially the lungs and liver, and the same liquid is good for polishing tarnished silver. All-herb can induce a deep slumber with pleasant dreams, warts will disappear when it is applied to them, it can reduce pain in the head and teeth and speed up the healing of wounds when the bandages are soaked in the liquid. You can also use it to sweeten food, but you should never use it uncooked because when consumed raw it can cause hair loss, cardiac arrest and even death.

Fire Lance - this is the rarest plant in Ancaria, because it only grows in the craters of active volcanoes. It should be harvested with extreme caution because the stems contain a potent acid, one that can corrode skin, leather and even metal. The recommended harvesting method is to dig them out with their roots, and cook them in a huge tank of water before trying to transport them. This impressive long and red plant was used only as an exotic spice at the tables of Princes and Kings for a long time, then it was discovered that its roots can heal dream fever and the dreaded yellow blazes.

Celandine* - an unimposing plant, it grows near brooks and other running waters as long as the temperature doesn't get too warm. A Celandine draught is good for your digestion, but the effect kicks in after a few minutes so the timing and place it's taken should be considered well.

Speckle-Moss - grows on the trunks of old broad-leaved trees, but only on their northern side. When applied to the skin or scalp it can reduce dandruff, dry skin, skin irritation, rash and athlete’s foot. After eating it you have the temporary belief that you're a llama. Nobody knows why this happens.

Desert-Herb* - a rare plant that can only be found in the places where ocean and desert meet. Chewing the fresh or cooked leaves triggers a state of euphoric happiness that can last for several hours, but being prepared as a tea clearly reduces the effect so you’ll only feel a pleasant contentedness. Desert-herbs help the patient cope with the grief of losing a loved one or similar situations. It should not be eaten for long periods of time, as prolonged use can lead to paralysis of the legs and stultification.

”May the cleansing flames not only burn your bodies but also your sinful souls.”
(Concluding sentence of the prophecy of doom in Piotar's Tribunal)
From the beginning, the barony Nain-Carthas enjoyed a special status in the High Elf Empire. Remote from the other parts of the realm and isolated from the other peoples of the world by a thick jungle, Nain-Carthas resembled an island rather than a barony. For centuries, the barony kept its freedom and independence ... until the portentous events that would bring it to the very brink of destruction.
The death of Grand Inquisitor Jaquenor marked the turning point in the barony's history. Officially, he died fighting a wild boar during a hunting trip, but the true circumstances of his death were never resolved. No physician was allowed to examine his lifeless body and the corpse was burned during a hastily organized ceremony one day later. For religious reasons, they say.
In the days following his death, a new Grand Inquisitor was elected behind the closed doors of the Palace of the Inquisition. To the surprise of the general public, the favored high-ranking inquisitors did not prevail. Instead, the young inquisitor Piotar from the lower ranks was elected the new Grand Inquisitor. Only one week later, he took over the official functions of his new position. The populace of Nain-Carthas was indifferent towards these events but this shift in power should not remain without consequence for the barony.
Already the first tribunal Piotar's was concluded with a bang. A High Elf accused of fraud was sentenced to death by the Grand Inquisitor himself and executed the very same day. Only a few days later, Piotar decreed in an edict that the inquisitors would pursue any violation of religious duties relentlessly. This edict was nailed to every wall and door and was also proclaimed in public places on an hourly basis.
”The flames fight for humbleness and purity where our words fall on deaf ears. The flames are our weapons, and they will strike our enemy where it hurts him most.”
(Piotar in a letter to Inquisitor Phreyax)
It did not take long until the edict claimed its first victims. In the first week after the decree, no less than 13 tribunals were held. In the second week, the number increased to 25. Piotar convicted people for various kinds of offenses. Even late payment of the sacrificial offering was considered a criminal act as were extramarital liaisons, heathen views, failure to appear for sacrificial ceremonies, false testimony or quarreling. The list of sins grew ever longer and more ambiguous. Those who were convicted by Piotar were never seen again. A few hunters and shepherds reported that they had seen figures that were ablaze and were being herded along the river towards the woods by elves. However, no-one dared following them. And many covered their ears until the desperate screams of the damned were swallowed by the dark.

Lumen is the god of Light. He makes things seen, he heals, he can see the future and he can see the past. Lumen represents the good side, benevolence and care.MythologyLumen and Kali... the Yin and the Yang. The fire and the water. The light and the darkness.Lumen is fighting an eternal battle against his arch-opponent, Kali, goddess of darkness and evil. A battle, which he both wins and loses every day. It is obvious to both sides that neither of them can win, and that they can not even exist without the other. But this battle is their destiny, their fate, which they seem to have accepted.The two opposite entities Lumen and Kali play a special role in the Ancarian religion. Being the extreme sides, all other gods have to take a stand in their battle, or remain neutral, which is just a third position in the divine equilibrium. There are many different theories about the relation between Lumen and Kali or the origin of their antagonism. In some cultures, the two gods are considered twins, who hate each other, because they can not stand the idea that they are not unique. Consequently, they took the most contrarious positions against each other.In other cultures it´s being said that both gods are claiming a deciding role in the creation process of the world. Lumen says, that the essence of the world is actually light and that darkness is just a by product, while Kali claims, that the opposite is true.AppearanceLumen is commonly displayed as a male human. Despite his long, white hair, he has a young face. Another identifying feature is the bright halo that surrounds him, merging his entire body into a silhouette.The CultThere are temples dedicated to Lumen all over Ancaria. Since the cult of Lumen represents one of the extreme sides of the eternal battle of good against evil, he - as well as Kali - are the gods who can claim the most followers.Lumen is not only the god of light, he´s also the god of healing. Therefore, many of his temples have become some sort of hospitals as well. Sick and injured people often visit his temples, seeking cures and remedies. Priests of Lumen are said to have have the ability of channelling the divine powers of Lumen through their hands.In the church of Lumen, the cycle of the day is very important. Sunrise is a very special moment for all his followers, because it represents the arrival of Lumen. On the opposite, every sunset is bemoaned, and in their prayers the believers express their hope and confidence that the night - the reign of Kali - will soon be over.

What? Rizzil wants to come back home? Well that's just typical isn't it? That good for nothing brat! He snuck out in the middle of the night and took all the mealworm paste with him! I've had nothing but trouble with him since the day he hatched. Oh well, what can I say, he IS my son...

My kinfolk! The Gods know that I'd like to kill each one of them with my bare hands!

Relatives! I'm telling you, they can be worse than famine. What do you think?
Those who don't have enemies go and get a clan. How are you doing with your family matters?

My uncle! He drives me insane with his craziness. Family can be torture can't it?
How's the family? Do you have any news you'd like to talk about?
What a punishment! I'd love to give my family into slavery if that was allowed.
What bothers me more than the whole situation is the fighting with my clan. Crazy, right?
Artrak had already been informed of my success. Either I was watched, or Artrak is somehow in contact with the creature. I'll discover the truth sooner or later.

I'll send you back to the Gods!
Something must be wrong! Progress and activity has come to a halt for too long! Dear Gods, somebody must have switched off the player!
You did it, thank you! Our village is finally safe again. Here, take this amulet as a token of our appreciation. It will serve you well.

Find out which clan possesses the true hand of Gronkor!

We need your help. The Clan of the Bloody Scythe and the Clan of the Steeled Fist are fighting, and no Orc can settle this disagreement. Both clans claim that they possess Gronkor’s true mummified right hand. It is a kind of relic, which they worship and revere before they go to battle.

Gronkor was a mighty warrior, a hero among the Orcs. 450 years ago when the accursed Elves attacked the stronghold in the north, Gronkor remained there alone and defended it against a horde of Elves while the rest of the Orcs stole away and joined forces with other clans against the pointy-eared vermin. Gronkor fought from sun up to sun down, he was hit by many arrows, and killed many Elves. Those sneaky pointy-eared devils were only able to overpower him as night began to set in. But their victory was short lived: The Orc army descended upon them and drove them out. When they found Gronkor, he had 45 arrows stuck in his body.

As you can clearly see, Gronkor was a great hero. Of course, he had only one right hand. So one of the hands must be a fake. Unfortunately, no Orc is allowed to enter the cave where his body rests, otherwise they will feel the wrath of the Gods. That is why you must go. His hands are tattooed, and the pattern starts at the forearm... this is how you will determine which hand is Gronkor's true right hand.

What do you mean? Yes, I'm well, thank you for asking.
Your scales don't seem very shiny to me. How do you groom them?
With a lotion from a healer. It's made of some plants.
Some plants? That's typical male attitude! Always cheap when it comes to caring for scales.
Well, yes, I rarely worry about that. What would you recommend?
Nothing beats my marigold essence. Soothing for head and shoulders.
Maybe I'll try that. Thanks for the advice.
Hurry! I'm certain that the terrible cult is interested in the recipe, too!
A weapon with magic-based damage does not help me here.
All my courage left me... A long time ago.

Theminius doesn't have enough gold stashed away either. A long time ago he discovered a treasure chest containing a crown in a cave though. If I could recover this crown, then that should give us enough gold to pay Blackheart and his men. I should speak with the swordmaster's daughter. She goes to the area near the cave often.
Jana's contacts will be able to assist me further.

I ran into Shirka again as I expected I would. She's even managed to make something of herself. Well... more or less at any rate. She became a sort of mercenary, what we used to call soldier of fortune.
Now she has to slay a Dragon that is holed up in a cave. I think I should help her, it sounds a bit dangerous for her alone.
Any hero who explored 40 % of the map.
There is a spot at the old naval port where undead have been entering the city from for some time. This could be connected to the appearance of the Undead Legion. I am supposed to find the spot.
My equipment doesn't protect me enough against damage from cold.

Inscription
We are made wise not by the recollection of our past, but by the responsibility for our future.-
- G. B. Shaw
I hope this village has a merchant.
I hunt for my offspring most of the day now. I've got nothing but problems with these half-wild kids!
Well, we weren't known to be very decent when we were young either.
Yes, but at least we had a little respect. My father flailed it into us.
Is that always the best thing? Sometimes I wish we were a little less bloodthirsty.
I am content with the way things are.
Generally I don't mind the bloodshed, but it could also be combined with a little bit of culture.
Why not, as long as it doesn't get out of hand?
Give your trouble makers my love. I've got work to do.
You came quite a long way my dear sister. Well I had my share of fun, now I'll erase you from the face of this world in order to keep the balance.
You're an evil swine, leave me alone! Find your own damn way to the center of the island.
Greatly increases armor protection and reduces the combat art regeneration penalty. Also grants the ability to wear higher-level armor,
What's the matter with you, brother? Why are you yelling like that?
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to disturb you. But my task is not an easy one. IN THE NAME OF THE GODDESS, THE GREEN PART UP!
Well, what kind of task are we talking about? And do you really have to shout like that in order to get it done?
It's a challenge, even with yelling, believe me! I have to supervise a bunch of stupid work slaves in the forest over there. They're supposed to be planting some seedlings.
Oh, I see. Well, I pity you.
I'll survive. THE GREEN PART UP, DAMMIT, OR DO YOU WANT A TASTE OF THE WHIP?
Well, I'll leave you to your work. I'll see you, brother.
A businessman outto make some money ran aground here. His cart broke down and he can't go back. Now he wants to build a makeshift hut. He wants me to get him 25 large and 15 small crystals.
They're both dead, Nityahel will be pleased.
You are an interesting creature. I am looking forward to dissecting you and getting to the bottom of your secrets.
Door’s open. Tunnel’s waiting. Good luck.
There’s plenty of mudfish around this year! If only they didn't taste so moldy.
I've made a decision, brother! I'm going to be Chieftain.
You? The others won't be very happy to hear that. How are you planning to accomplish it?
With your help! We'll creep up in the night and butcher him!
The Chief? You're really going to slaughter the Chief?
Yes, he's not a good leader. He's constantly ordering us around. I can do that much better!
Are you sure? If your plan fails, they'll skin us!
Nonsense! I've planned everything. I'm going to convince them with a speech.
Oh dear, will that work? But you are my brother, and I'll keep my blade ready.

Anyone who dares to insult us deserves to die. Make the Orcs pay for their insolence!

You are the new warrior! They told me about you.
You can find the Orcs who insulted our Clan to the north. Go and make them pay for their audacity! May the sword be with you!
I am protected by the Gods!
Officer Beniel and I agree. We must put a stop to the Undead Legion's activities.
My weapon's fire damage won't help me here.
Back into the fire from which you were born!

Find the marauders!

A group of marauders has been seen in the area for quite some time. They roam around looting and plundering to their heart's content. So far, we have not been able to track them down and arrest them. Maybe you could help us out there.
The local farmers might be able to give you some information about their camp. As soon as you find them, take them out. Of course, you will receive a reward if you do.
My death should not... Oh crap, I forgot my last words!
I'm ready to carry on my existence in a new form.
My time in this dimension has run out...
So this is what death feels like...
The Kobold camp is in the northwest on the other side of the river!
Now that I have the blood of the eyes and the sulfur, I should go to the cave.

Kill Bloodclaw!

Greetings! Are you here to collect mushrooms? Some tasty ceps and toadstools grow around here. Unfortunately the area is infested with werewolves. And what's more, their leader is also lurking around. He's a really dangerous beast. Bloodclaw they call him. Mind you, he does his name proud. You would do us all a favor if you were to get rid of that creature once and for all.
Just between us women - do you really have to be that malicious?
I don't think that you will receive an invitation to the next tree root tea.
Please move along - you're scaring the children.
Don't tell me! Their actions fill me with a pure and holy rage. But resistance is growing.
All true believers agree with you. But rest assured, soon the Gods will strike the soldiers down.
They don't know what they're doing, that's why their path will lead them to ruin. But their weakness is our strength.
If only they believed in the path of the righteous, then the Gods would fight on their side. But the way things are...
What you say is true, but don't worry. Resentment is rising among our followers.
Yes, a state of the Gods right here on earth! Nothing else can give our country back its glory - with me as worldly regent!
That's what I think. Their arrogance will be their destruction, and if not we can always give them a push in the right direction.
I can't stand it anymore! They think they're the pride of our people, but many are in league with demons.
They better not think that no one watches them, because the spies of the Gods record all their bloody misdeeds.
Death and destruction await those who question the will of the Gods! They will find that out soon enough.
Powerful blow or stab that will inflict heavy damage on an opponent.
Nature bestowed a lot of strength - but obviously skimped on the gray matter.
The voice inside of me tells me not to help here.
So that's what Dryads look like...
You only get out what you put in, Dryad!
Ooooh, a blowpipe. I'm so scared...
No, please look for someone else.

Blind Guardian is scheduled to give the last concert of their Ancaria tour. They were robbed by undead metal fans on the way and their instruments were stolen. I'm supposed to go to the undead and find Hansi's microphone and stand.

No clan likes us in love, we go, banished!
You talk to clans? Will not help, but talk if you want.

Take this message to the Officer of the Inquisition's task force.

I see that you're on our side. I can speak freely to you then. This remote area here, the Noriath corner, is perfectly suited as a training area for our armed forces. It could serve as our base of operations, as soon as we get it under control. Any resistance is systematically being expelled from this region, but these Lumen Priests aren't easily intimidated. I have ordered a smaller unit of the Guard to go there. They are supposed to advance to the Temple and get the rest of the resistance out of their hiding places. The troop is waiting in the ruins close by for their assignment orders, but right now I'm still a little hesitant. I don't want to make a mistake. Please go to the troops for me and tell the officer that the troops will have to be patient a little while longer.
I have to expect enemies that know how to use magic.
There's no point in hiding. We'll find you...
A High Elf does not lower herself to riding something like that!
At least, I have freed Bacalio's father and saved his life.
The bucket is full now. I'll take it to the boys.
You can't tell me that the wind blows stronger in the mountains or near the sea than it does here sometimes!
Fresh snow in winter - it’s like a fairy tale, don't you think?
Did you know that I give every single wind a different name?
Tell me, is it possible to give away ice flowers?
Can you tell me what the sun is doing at midsummer's night?

What do you think you're doing?
Where do you expect me to put that?
You were very helpful. Thank you very much.
What? Those Elves don't mean to shoot the deer for its meat, they only care about the trophy it'll make?
Mission accomplished. Now, I will look for new assignments.

Lure the Kobold chief from his hideout and kill him.

Greetings! My name is Thelal and I am here on behalf of the senate to take care of the Kobold menace. We have had reports that a mighty chieftain of these little creatures has appeared in the area. We assume that the Kobolds are scheming something... a large scale attack for example. We must eliminate the chief before the Kobolds reach their full man... pardon me... Kobold power. Already, more Kobolds than usual are in the vicinity.

I could do with your assistance! How about it: You go and kill several Kobolds in their own village. Once enough Kobolds have fallen, their chief will emerge from his hideout. We will hold the fort here and secure the area.
You're always holding those glorious services, aren't you?
Yes, and you would know that if you chose to attend one once in a while.
I'll do that some time, certainly, but I've got a different reason for asking right now. Where do you get all those candles from?
Well, I'll be seeing a nice Dryad tomorrow, and I hoped I might be able to do a little romantic decorating.
If you want to, you may stop by my place later and pick up some candles. All right?
I'll really owe you one for that. I'll see you later then.
I'll pick out a couple of very nice ones. May the Goddess be with you!
I'll show you how I feel about your Gods!

Unfortunately, the Elves didn´t learn very much about the magic leaks before they were captured. All they could tell me is that the leaks are coming from a network of ancient pipelines. The only ones who might know more about this are the Seraphim. I suppose I will be on my way to the angels then.

Fetch my shampoo from the wreckage of the caravan!

This fur is driving me mad, I can't stop itching! I probably caught fleas somewhere, I haven't been a Werewolf for very long. I used to wash my hair twice a day, now I’m covered in so much hair that I don’t know how to keep it clean!
I miss my shampoo! It must be in the wreckage of the caravan. Would you could fetch it for me? You can keep anything else that you find there, all I need is my shampoo.
You must hurry, the protective barrier of the spell is rapidly dwindling!
Increases damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Nature Weaver's combat arts. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
You are a shame to our nation!

Go and see my brother!

He said he wanted to discover something really significant and then turn our village into the most beautiful village of all. He found something about a unique breed of mounts in some old documents.

If you're interested in mounts you should go and see him. He must be somewhere near "Urthak's Moxie."
Press <$ID_CUI_RBBUTTON_INSERT> and select "Dismount" if you want to stop riding your mount.
And what do YOU want? Lydia? Do I look like a WOMAN? No, I'm not Lydia. Lydia is over there.
Apparently, El'Duffi wants to be the sole ruler in Badawi. For this to happen however, one man must die: the Pasha Barazi...
And I'll tell you one thing in advance... If the reward isn't right, you're done for!
Horse and rider ... a perfect team, or so they say.
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Nature Weaver and increases the maximum spell level without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
The gladiator trade is a terrible thing.
Now that's interesting! They offer self-expression courses for Dryads in their best years. Binding Macrame-owls. Crocheting. Shaman dancing. I think I'll go for that!
...Knight c4? What's that supposed to mean? Oh, what do I care? These dragons are really strange. But I had better keep that to myself.
So it is peace you want? Why should I believe you? You could just as easily destroy all of us. I will come with you.
I will smash you, puny Human!
Come on sisters. Cut it into pieces!
Let's see if it can bleed!
Wha...? Sacred 3? Me go home from holiday?
You carry several potions in your inventory. You can assign potions to the directional pad <$ID_CUI_DPAD_SMALL_INSERT>.
That was quite invigorating! Now I just have to convince this cultist to follow me.
Hansi is already headed for Sonnenwind. I wanted to go alone.
The goods have reached Robert unscathed. The reward was very handsome.
Khan Warka asked me to get both of Gronkor's hands for the tribes. This is definitely an unsavoury task, but Gronkor has been dead for hundreds of years...What could possibly happen?
Ah, we've reached the city at last. Thank the Gods! I couldn't have listening to that gobbledygook much longer...
I should be thankful but I'm not!
I won't wish you a good day as Kuan wouldn't like it.
Yes, at least I've heard some new ideas. I'll go now.
I've had more rewarding arguments, but I still thank you for it.
May Kuan be with you and watch over me.
Now then, brother. I've got better things to do.
In the name of the almighty Kuan! Go forth in strife.
May we meet again. If that's Kuan's wish.
There were nicer conversations, but not with you.
Then I thank you for nothing, but in the name of the bloody God!
I can hardly wait to see the pyramid.
I wish I was ready to use it.
I brought Kernforce and her dog to the camp. She can look for material for her new book here.
The village elder - blessed be his wisdom - has asked me to collect firewood to start a bonfire. I will probably find wood in the forest.

So it's not just the Dragons that are supposed to be destroyed, it's all life? I like this idea! As soon as all of the other Temple Guardians are destroyed I'll be the absolute ruler. And since mother is not mother, the monster will also be terminated.
Farewell! And thank you for everything!!
I admit, I didn't trust you. But I was wrong.
You are a truly wise creature. Thank you for your help.
Take care and thanks for your help, worthy Dragon creature.
This news is not good, but at least we found their entrance to the port thanks to you. Let me think for a minute about how we are going to proceed.
Located noise from outside. Will analyze situation.
I've been asked to visit all the debtors in this neighborhood and get Hartruins money back.
I have avenged that poor woman’s murder! Soon there will be nothing left of her assassin but a pile of dust. I can tell her husband that his wife’s death has been avenged.

Uh oh! Seraphim Symontia says that Huteranum claims to be a researcher. Trading in furs of any kind is forbidden in any case. Good thing I didn't know that, because - as we know - ignorance is an excuse.
The Seraphim will now probably just give this Huteranum a good telling-off.
Do you have to badger me?
Well, as the agents say: You die only twice!
The mission was a success.  Brombar was very pleased with my work.
One day, I will be able to use this item.
Dundiel acted in a strange manner. He was grateful but at the same time he was nervous and I can't help but feeling that he wanted to get rid of me. Odd.

Some Elves wanted to take the blade from me. They paid for their undertakings with their lives.
Now I'm going to end my mission.
You are a true heroine! Not even the bravest ones among our soldiers were able to hold their own against the Kobolds!
Why did you kill those cute Kobolds?
Was the leader of the Kobolds more dangerous than a wolf?
Just between us women, how does it feel to kill a Kobold?
I wouldn't be able to do that, that Kobold business. I can't stand the sight of blood!

What's the matter? What's stopping you? Ah, well, I'll just leaf through the bible of Ker. Let's see, what am I gonna read? First testament? I read that already. Second testament? Finished that as well. Ah, here, third testament, Day of Reckoning. Yes, that sounds good!
The informant and the dealer agree.
I should avoid this city but I have to restock my supplies.
Oh shut up, otherwise I'll cast you down! The talk of the clerics is unbearable!
Just leave me alone with the false promises of these church mice! They're nothing but a disgrace.
What do you think, that their stories are really true? They're nothing more than a product of their imagination!
Don't be led up the garden path my dear! They just want a cheaper replacement for their arrows.
Are you crazy? If you side with them I'll decapitate you!
You can't be very bright! These so called pious ones aren't interested in your well-being, just your sword!
Don't be ridiculous! This Holy War is nothing but an excuse to oppress you.
How can you believe the ones who are just trying to bring you under the thumb of the Gods' will?
Ha! You're following the ones who'll hang you one day. They won't need your sword forever!
Do what you want and run after their skirts! The Gods just laugh about you!
Come back once you have grown stronger.
Your hideout in the lava caves wasn't good enough!
Miracle cure? I have some, but it's not cheap. 100 gold per bottle. Shall I gift wrap it? No? Then have a nice day.
This should be enough moss for everyone. I hope it lasts until the vendor brings them a proper cure. Now that I have the moss, the itching has stopped - a good sign.

Please don't kill me! I'll tell you everything you want to know!
The camp is located in that direction! Go that way and you can't miss it! Can I go now?
All that remains is dust in the wind!
Bread and circuses for the people and gold for me!
I knew, one bucket wouldn't be enough. Looks like I have to get another one.
Now you look TRULY dangerous. I'm starting to shake... or something.

Banish the poltergeists!

Help! Oh it’s horrible, horrible! There are poltergeists in our house! Just two nights ago they smashed Aunt Labilie’s porcelain tea set to pieces! She’ll never forgive me!
I had hoped that our village witch would be able to banish the poltergeists, but she was powerless against these ghostly creatures - in fact, she ran away! Could you help us perhaps? Please!
A man of God - how nice! I hope you can take more of a beating than the last one.
You Inquisitors think you're something special, don't you?
I hope you wrote your will!
You picked the wrong guys to mess with this time!
You won't make it to see another day!
There was a burglary at a widow's house last night. I have to find and kill the thieves. If I follow and pick up the stolen goods they've dropped, I should find them.
You are no match for me. Don't even try.
So you want me to take the curse of the ghost off you? Very well I will help you, but if you try anything funny I will kill you.
You must be a miserable gang, if someone like you is the leader.
Now I only need to figure out what to tell the village doctor. Maybe Keltar can give me some advice.
I have all the cats. These stupid animals are scratching up my entire inventory! Just wait you guys, you'll get yours!
The alchemist asked me to get a book from the library for him.
I'm no match for the enemies in this region.

Observe the behavior of the ghosts!

Welcome! I have a task for you, if you are interested. The ghosts in the region are very aggressive of late and attack everything that moves. I want to know what's behind this behavior. Please go and slay some ghosts while observing them. Maybe you will find out something.
I hardly believe in ghost stories anymore ...
Good, but there's something else I'd like to say.
Something else has been bothering me.
There's another matter we should talk about.
While we were talking, I just remembered something else.
There's something else I would like to talk to you about.
We're getting a bit carried away here. Still, there's something else.
It's great that you always come up with more topics to talk about.
I've been wondering about something else.
Knowledge is power they say, so tell me this.
Could we talk about one more thing?
Everyone is speaking very highly of you.

Thank you very much, now I can process these goods, rework them and maybe even sell them.
Take this from me as a reward. I'm sorry that I don't have any more to offer you.

I found the remains of a destroyed caravan by the wayside. Three Lizardmen are still alive and one of them asked me to get Gangith the Healer from Hissil'Ta. Without his help they won't live to see another day.
Not even a wafer thin peppermint will fit into my backpack any more.
Admirable! Your conquest of the earth elemental is just admirable.
If it's right what they say, you really gave it to that fog monster.
Just between us women, do you really want to spend the rest of your days fighting against earth elementals?
Aren't you the warrior who defeated the earth elemental?
Aren't you the heroine who conquered the fog monster?
Hey, you are the warrior who killed the Octagolamus, aren't you?
Which one of the monsters was the strongest? The Golem? The thing in the water? Or the fog?
I wish I had your skills. Then I would fight Golems, too.
Do you agree that the upper echelon only strives for power?
Did you hear? They plan to raise fees for owning shoes.
Beware of these unspeakable fee collectors!
Good day and goodbye! I have to attend a demonstration against the rising sewer fees.
Now they plan to help the poor. I think they should all be sold to the Elves.
Do you have the ingredients? Good!
If you take a break from all this running, you finally get a chance to admire all the detail you otherwise miss. Well, I've got it with detail by now.

Bring me a replacement for the broken cogwheel.

This will be awesome, no, INCREDIBLY awesome. I'd be inclined to say that this will be the epitome of awesomeness, but I don't want to brag about the revolutionary invention I made. It's a machine that can be used to walk underwater without having to come up for air. Someone could cross the whole lake with it, isn't that great? I've called my invention a “diving bell” because when the idea came to me the bells of the Temple were calling the faithful to service. I want to test the diving bell today, but I need a new cogwheel. I sent my assistant for one, but he must have gotten lost somewhere. Would you go and look for him? Something might have happened.
Do I first have to make it clear to you who I am?
Wow! To the Grand Inquisitor's home? I should have shaved more thoroughly.
Sister Florentina is experimenting with crop seeds. She wants to make the crops bigger and more resistant. I'm supposed to test her new pumpkin seeds. For that I will have to sow them in a field.
This region does not challenge me.
The metal in question is only nickel. I'll give the all-clear signal in the village.

Kindle the beacons!

Thanks! I wouldn't have made it here so soon without your help. You saved me a lot of time! I could use your help with another thing, though. Do you see the four beacons? They must be kindled. I can only note the correct distances if I have the beacons for reference. Please go and kindle the beacons. When you are done, return to Seraphim Quitana and tell her that the surveying is under way.
A lady like yourself surely has a crust of bread to spare, right?
Your good soul will be your saving grace, kind woman.
Let me suffer alone - please keep moving.
Every little helps but these creatures here are TOO small. Attacking them would be against nature.
The smuggler has asked me to take him to a cave. He wants to cast the medallion's spell there. If all goes according to plan he will then be able to control forest spirits.
Don't die on me, I haven't finished with you yet!
I killed the nameless Priests in the village. I can already feel it, her dark presence!
Gather now! That is an order!

Yes, it's true. I was dead. I traveled though places that one shouldn't return from. No mortal should see what I saw.
But I don't remember anything about my life before my resurrection. Maybe this list will help me. It could possibly be suffering comrades. Is my name on the list? I'll consult the military registry. Maybe they'll believe that I'm still a dedicated soldier.
"On to battle!" How I love that cry!
Program analysis completed. Copy detected. Request immediate purchase of an original version in order to guarantee full functionality.

For security reasons, trading between heroes is only allowed after an online verification of the save game. The verification process could not be performed. Please try again now or quit the trading option and try again later.

Defeat five strong jungle cats!

Great! It’s a delight to see heroes like you doing what you do best! The next task is to defeat five strong jungle cats. The difference between them and regular jungle cats is that they're, well... stronger. Good luck!
Well let's see if we can put the plans into action.
I've collected all five herbs. They smell really good. I should take them to the Priestess now.
You! You still owe me gold. I fought in the great battle.
You must be confusing me with someone else. I've never seen you before.
I could hit you on the head. Maybe that would help your memory.
Listen, monster. I have eight brothers, and we all look alike.
That many? But I remember your smell. You're trying to cheat me.
Leave me alone, or I'll call for my family.
I'm not afraid of them. Pay me before I get really angry.
Ugh... I'll ask my brothers if they know you. I'll be back soon, really.
In this region, I must be prepared for enemies that inflict magic damage.
Your accent is dreadful! Are you from the south part of the wood?
You seem to be in the worst mood ever! How amusing!
These are Godless and bloody times. But I bid you good day!
Yes, let's talk if we must.
I don't want to talk to you but our God unfortunately tells me to.
Actually my time is limited, but tell me what you have to say!
I've seen better days! But let's talk since you're already here!
How did you find me? Never mind, just tell me what you want brother!
As we proceed we can even talk!
Ah, it's you? I thought you'd already sit at Kuan's side by now. But you never know.
You look ill-tempered, brother! As always!
Running is followed by ransacking. Both begin with “r”.
I have the herbs! Now I have to find the witch.
The village elder Thiraz'Shir asked me to clear the street to Hissil'Ta of all undead. The walking and decaying things are blocking the streets.

Who dares to disturb my slumber?
Ah, my depraved sons. I told you that you will not get your hands on my treasures.
I watched you fight and I have decided that you, , are worthy of my inheritance. Take this as a sign of my admiration and now - will you all just leave me be!
That was a good start I think, at least they didn’t throw me out right away. I wonder how much I will be able to find out?
Brutus Plutocratio has seen through my little ruse. Now he wants to kill me. I should make sure he doesn't get the chance.
Ready for round two of death?
Defend yourself if you can, weakling!
You look even unhealthier than I do.
Great eyes. Can you read with them in the dark?
I'd put on even more eye shadow.

I am an Inquisitor, one of the high priests of the High Elves. Vested with all of the privileges of my rank, I pursue my own goals, independently and freely. The affairs of the lower beings of this world do not concern me. Let them call me evil, may they wail and curse me. They are lacking the mind to understand the true principles of my existence, the unrestricted exercise of the power I am entitled to for the higher good of the Inquisition.

A single lamb? How dare you bring us this pitiful animal? The lamb my ancestor should have received from you would have given us 20,000 descendants by now and an ocean of milk! And you show up with one lamb?
You will pay for this insult with your life Simir! But your blood won't be on my hands. You there, cut him open. You won't regret it.
The village elder is happy. He can finally see the sun rise again. He gave me his diaries as a reward. With them this part of history can finally be proven. I should take them to Farek.
Every guest is more tolerable after a few beers.
Hopefully someone buys me something good soon.
The fly in my glass is moving around quite amusingly.
Some days I really hate this dive.
I have given the Troll's head to the shaman and he is making a Nargutz ball from it. He will tell me about the plan when he's finished.
The balloon flew off in this direction!
Unleashes a small tornado that moves toward the enemies
I have helped Romdreal and Judriel escape. Now the two lovers are safe.
Abdullah mutated into a horrendous T-Energy creature - I had no choice but to kill him. Poor Abdullah
I feel only disgust and loathing towards you.
You are only capable of biting sarcasm and caustic remarks.
You are trying to divert all the attention to yourself with your demeanour, eh?
What a weakling! The Queen was right to entrust me with this task. Now he's meddling with my mission, thinking he will win the laurels? I'll put a stop to that!
Hello, my beer is the best.
Increases damage dealt by equipped weapons as well as the chance for critical hits. Enables the use of modifications for weapon-based combat arts.
I have no use for this piece of equipment.
Greetings, noble sir! I see that you are wearing an especially fine fabric today!
I also think it suits me, and brings out my noble figure even more.
Let me guess, it's been made by the great Karroll Lagerelf.
Well, I wouldn't want to brag about it, but yes, I am a regular customer to the best of our tailors.
To me, his creations are unaffordable dreams.
You should not moan, your simple garments are perfectly suited to your rank.
Well, that is true. I am not allowed to be liked by anyone but the Gods anyway.
The seamstress' daughter was very happy about the dress and gave me a magic amulet to thank me for my help.
The enemies of this region mainly use weapons for magic damage.
Well ... let's see. Where is the branch? Ah! Let's get started ...
Of course! I should have known that.
Nature is only one side of the balance!
If you think that I'm upset about you being afk you ... you ...  YOU ARE COMPLETELY OFF THE TRACK!
It's over for Kurt the Cunning. Now the jade is mine. I should take it to the jeweler.
I don't know how to use this.
Wait a minute! I presume that you take a size 3, or is it a size 4? Hmm... I’ll make it a size 3. You're welcome to try it on when I'm finished!

You're a good fighter and ally, I like your spirit. As you know, I perform the ritual of immortality. It's a simple thing really... I kill you then use the magic energy of this land to transform you from a worshiper into one of the worshiped. Are you ready to receive immortality?
You consider yourselves morally superior, but in the end you're nothing but a murderer too!
Come here and punish me for my deeds!
Why do you fight for the oh-so-good cause?
I'm sure you'll soon go to your reward ...
You are a dignified ruler. Farewell.
The port facilities in this city were built under the former High Elven government.

Have a look around the ruins and find out where the strange noises are coming from.

My name is Lilly, I often come to the ruins to remember the past. These old walls give me peace and strength. Lately strange noises have been coming from the corners. To be honest with you, I'm a little frightened. Could you find out where these noises are coming from?
That's it. I've finished the task. It wasn't as hard as I expected. Maybe I should retire and spend my remaining days herding cattle. Or maybe not.

Julian Pies
Wind you neck in, pal!
Reflective aura with a chance to reflect close combat damage back to the attacker.
Creatures like you destroy this world...

Go and find the broker beyond the Great Wall in the Human territory

The world you see around you has become profane and corrupt. The people have strayed from their belief in Ker, the one true Goddess, and the result is a blight upon the land. Our only hope for salvation lies in purification. All who fail to acknowledge Ker must be converted or killed. Our destiny as a people cannot be fulfilled until we are one, with no impurities within or around us. If you agree, you may join our holy cause, if not, be on your way!

Bring me four olm hearts.

A Dark Seraphim? Yes I have heard about her, and I might be able to locate her. All I need are four olm hearts. They will enable me to find out where she is.

Hey! It's nice to see you again!
By Ker, you were right! Since our last meeting, I've been having trouble making ends meet. This isn't exactly the best place to get rich. Anyway, I'm hunting a small Dragon right now. It's holed up in a cave together with some lava elementals. Things could get rough, but maybe I'll get something out of it. What do you say? Do you want to help me?
A Priest asked me if I’m interested in a different kind of job. Sure! Why not? I should talk to his brother Learchim.

Greetings!
Are you ready to visit Aaron, King of Thieves?
If you want my help against Goldman, you will have to escort me to Aaron. He always knows how to handle such issues.
My mission was a complete success! I have heard enough. That should help the historian with his research.
I reported the success of my mission to Gabelte. He probably has more assignments for me.
May Kybele's blessing guide you safely on your journeys.

Get me some slimy gobs with goo!

I have a problem, my friend. Read what's on the menu. Well okay you can't really read it, but it says: Slimy Gobs and Goo.
But I'm out of gobs and goo. It's all gone! My slimy gobs are renowned even beyond the borders of our village. Everyone wants to eat Jangletooth's slimy gobs. Jangletooth, that's me. But I don't actually cook them myself. Old Gnarl does that in his cave. Visit him and get me a cauldron of gobs to go.
But -pssst!- no one can find out that I don't cook the slimy gobs myself.

Find the book in the library!

I sent my assistant to the library. He was supposed to fetch a book for me, but he has not yet returned. That lazy bugger is probably sitting in a tavern somewhere. Could you bring the book to me?
I've delivered all the materials. Now I'm allowed to build the snowman.
So this is Sulinar! This place is crawling with Du'Rach!

What have you done Dundiel? I always thought there was a warm heart beating somewhere deep behind that rough exterior, but it seems I was wrong. You deserve to die, you piece of Elven scum! Take that!
The mother of the deceased thanked me. She's going to bury both of the soldiers in the garden. That takes care of that problem.

This is the blood lake. I need some time to perform the ritual. You must remain outside and keep the monsters at bay. Can you do that?

Keep the monsters at bay while I perform the ritual!

This is the blood lake. Impressive! But we must not lose any more time. The performance of the ritual will take some time. My concentration must not be broken under any circumstances! You must keep the monsters from me. Go through the passage over there and keep everything out until I have finished the ritual.
Way to go! Ancaria needs men like you!
That's the man who's able to do just about anything!
It would be nice if we could have a keg of mead together someday in the tavern.
Another proud son of the desert!

Well, okay, you've found me. And yes, I've whacked my idiot brother - so what? You don't care about that, you only care about your reward, right? So how about a deal? I'll double whatever reward you would get for my capture. In return you will think up a story which will prove my innocence.
There isn't a forest dense enough to stop me.
Are there spiders in the wood? Hang on, don't tell me!
Thank you, I'll be able to find it.
A flying guardian?! Cant you be a little more precise? Oh, I'll find out for myself anyway!
I can hardly wait to see the pyramid.
Error in one or several input fields
Let's see what been left behind to plunder...
Hey you, I need your crank...
Good grief ... only a mother can love a face like that.
Begone, demon! You can't hurt me!
Well they don't look like the usual tramp rabble. Ali must have spent some money on them. Let's see how good they are.
I find it difficult to carry the full armor.
The waters are peaceful now. We can start fishing again soon. Thank you!
Hurry! Kill these villains before they can do even more harm!
Oh, you saved Mary! Thank you so much. Take this gold. It's not much, we're poor people. Still, you deserve it.
I'll take the banner from the caravan and show it to the merchant.
Everyone that I have ever loved has left me. Who can I turn to now? Only death. Maybe in it I will find the happiness that I was unable to in life.
Are you trying to stop me, soldier? You and whose army?
If I want a Seraphim, I'll buy myself one ...
Don't you have anything better to do? Like your nails?
You Seraphim are so good that it makes me feel like throwing up.
You have failed, Guardians of the Light!
Leering Goblin, I have you know that you would not survive a night with me!
I'm sure they had pictured this differently. Now they all lay here in the dust. Let's see what the Ogre has to say.

The truth is rarely pure and never simple.

- Wilde
The Priest of Testa was happy to receive the data crystal. The ceremonial ritual can take place now.

There were just too many of them. Don''t think I''m a wimp! I know how to defend myself. But against all of those kobolds, I didn''t have a chance. They attacked me from behind, just as I was sneaking up on a deer. I had no choice, but run away. But I had to drop my bow. You know... I had to drop my fathers bow! I''ll never forgive myself if it''s lost. It means more to me than my life. Or maybe that''s not quite true... but it DOES mean a lot to me. Please, can you help me? Go to the wood southern of here and find out whether the kobolds are still there. And if they are, kill them and get my bow back. I would love to come and join you, but without my bow, I''m almost useless in combat.
Wackar fainted again! This is going to be a tough job.
I do like those small villages where people peacefully see to their business, unaware of the larger world's turmoil.
Every Priest in this Temple is in your debt. We would have died without your help. I'm sorry that we can't offer you more than our gratitude and our prayers.
You have managed to save your soul, but remember to live by Ker's commandments or your soul will suffer! For now, Ker has accepted your sacrifice. I will bless you in his name.
Attack, and pay attention to formation!
Fight to the death, preferably theirs!
Kill all enemies of the Empire!
I hope I got my shot for that...
Waton will put in a good word for me!
Then we shouldn't waste any time. Time is precious? For the living it is, at any rate.
An outpost of the Inquisition. Maybe, I should have a look around.
Great you did it! The Christmas Ogre will start to come out of his cave soon and Christmas can begin. I have to get back to work. This isn't like planning a party, no sir!!
You have nothing to gain, Orc!

She likes me. Foolish brat, if she only knew. She wants me to meet her at TyBosso's in the desert. If I help her to kill everybody she plans to take over the business house and give me 10 percent of it.
Darn! That's the last animal. Stupid cow! Now I can kiss my reward goodbye.
Grants the ability to ride better horses and reduces the regeneration penalty while mounted. Additionally, special abilities may be unlocked.
Go on! Those beetles won’t count themselves!
Time to come down to earth!
I have to grow into this first.
Diaanja's servant is dead. Let's see if the mage has had a change of mind.

Woe be to him that reads but one book.

- Herbert
Now let me show you how the bad guys handle these things!
So you are one of those dirt bags?
Your halo won't do you any good now either.
Your good deeds do not make you any more likeable ...
Now that you need help, there's no one here ...

Hello father!
Yes I'm with the Dragon Scholars now. I've had a lot of time to think here. I can't forgive you, but I am happy to not be alone in the world.
You found Semil? HE'S ALIVE? Where is he?!
The Dragons will accompany me.

...and father...

Thanks!
Lash Out - Increases the range of Raving Thrust.
Bedaze - Adds a chance to stun opponents briefly.
Relay - Opponents near the targeted opponent will also be knocked back.
Lesion - A successful hit greatly reduces the target's base hitpoints for a brief period.
Tumble - Adds a chance to disarm opponents when they are knocked back.
Exactly! Get lost! We don't tolerate people digging on our patch!
If you want to know about the side effects just ask me!
Oh, the Ghost of Canterville! Where are your chains?
Restraint is a good life insurance policy.
Many have gained glory and lost their lives.
Don't lament, fight! That is what my father always told me.
Obedience is the virtue of soldiers.
Apparently, there exists a blacksmith who can forge nearly indestructible swords.
I will defy cowardliness for the rest of my life.
Is victory just a matter of positive thinking?
Do fighters celebrate every great victory?
What do you think about soldiers without any morals?
I think wars and fights are incredibly cruel. Don't you agree?
Is you motto for fighting: Strike before you get hurt?
Please give this letter to my betrothed as soon as possible. I've already made her wait long enough.
This will strengthen me for battle. Thank you!

Bring me four yellowfoot herbs from the Kobold camp!

Do you have a moment? I am Galia, adept to the mage Hanthar. My mentor assigned me the task of collecting yellowfoot herbs. Don't you think that's a stupid name for an herb? It normally grows like a weed close to the river, but now that I need it I can't seem to find any. Those Kobolds probably picked it all. I think they eat the stuff. In any case, they have a small camp on the other side of the river. Would you venture into the camp for me and get me a few of these herbs? Four of them would be perfect! I would be so grateful!
Chance to reduce the cost of combat arts by 50 %
I have to kill the real pirate captain. He calls himself “Telines.”
Thank you so much! You were of great help! I will immediately start to evaluate the lists. The Sword Sisters are really looking forward to hearing the results.
A bit more dynamics, Mr. Demon!
Whoever created you, beast, your perverse existence must come to an end! Today! Now!

A word, TyBosso!
These are heavy accusations against you! Supposedly you have plans to undermine the empire with the clergy's help? What do you have to say?

How did you manage to find me? Oh my sweet Azrael sent you, what a good raven!
A letter for me? Ah, yes. The invitation to the herbalists' conference. That is good news indeed. Thank you!
Don't take it personally Human, but you're in my way!
Raw violence usually helps things along - it can be so persuasive.
Travellers always run away from me. I seldom catch up with them.
When it comes to ambushes, I'm just too slow.
For some types of robbery you really need to work in a group...
We should organize ourselves and demand a minimum wage for outlaws.
Right now, everything is going fine for me!

Slay 20 spiders!

This has been going on for weeks! Those disgusting spiders keep attacking my cows! One morning I found Sieghilde in a tree. She was all wrapped up and sucked dry. Those beasts don't even bother to drag the cows to their cave any more, they eat them right here on the spot. If this keeps up I'll be ruined! Please help me! Kill 20 of these spiders.
Ah! An undead Ogre! Well that's something a little different than these Goblins or skeletons.

Keeper of the Shrine
The greatest griefs are those we cause ourselves.

- Sophocles
The news of the death of his two students has hit the Temple provost hard, but I suspect that deep down inside he already knew.

Close ... we were so close. But then ... the fight. Fought about the loot ... as always. A battle. I managed to kill the attackers but ... see for yourself. The wound is deep. Then the monsters found me. They ... they even tended to my wounds, then they locked me in here. I lost ... too much blood! I ... will ... die.
A good leader follows his men ... into death!
Stand still, Goblin. This is my last warning!
Any Hero completing the Shadow Campaign.
I have given the poisoner all her ingredients. She was very pleased with my work and gave me a generous reward.
If the Reputation is Down the Gutter...
Increases the chance for double hits.

You lucky guy! Sophia is expecting you for an audience!

I can tell why you’re here - same as me, I’ll bet. Terrific, those Seraphim, aren’t they? Them with their lovely great ti..i-i-itles and their nice firm... ass..s-s-stral projections. Makes it hard to concentrate, know what I mean? Course you do! So what did you bring me? Ooh, it’s a sculpture of the machine, isn’t it? Used to be on a pedestal in the village square? Lost for centuries? Cleavage down to there? That sort of thing? Course it is. Interesting, that machine - network of pipes, drains magic energy from the world, stores it up, naked showers at dawn, I’ve studied all about it.
Well, the location of the hub was lost during the great war, wasn’t it? Sophia might know where it is. Oldest of the Seraphim. You should go talk to her. Very wise, whipped cream, scented candles, baby oil. Please excuse me, I have to go now.

Migolo Fernal, a public servant to the King's court, thinks the Barimak family is involved in a conspiracy to gain power.
This must be stopped at all costs, so he's asked me to talk to his clerk Malsen who will have further instructions.
I must climb the southern hill first!
Wonderful! The Goddess must have brought us here together.
I salute you in the name of the Goddess! I am happy to see you here!
I'm overjoyed! Meeting you here is almost a Godly miracle!
A Goddess' greeting! You look absolutely splendid.
What a miraculous meeting! I am very happy to see you.
Our belief in and our love for the Goddess must have brought us together.
What joy the Goddess has brought me with this meeting!
It's wonderful to see you here! I feel as if I'm being led by the Goddess.
If can't be a coincidence that we meet! This is Kybele's wonderful work!
I owe my thanks to the Goddess who brought us here together.
It appears that Kirich fled across the sea to Seraphim territory. I'll go look there for him!
Perhaps the witch should mix me a beguiling scent.
Oh what delectable beverages - shall I seek out a noble benefactor?
High lords are my favourite patrons!
A captivating garment will entice my patrons.
Oh, you Gods - the patrons here are becoming more and more common.
The old shaman is dead. With his last breath he implored me to finish his task. The Inquisitors in the outpost know about our arrival. They will not attack me.
The Lost Sword of Grammbrain the Mighty
Go ahead and run. You won't get far.
I will stay one step behind you as befits my class.
Go ahead. I'll cover your back.
Weak foes, few xp ... this just won't do.
Do you have time to play?
I'm afraid of strangers. Leave me alone!
You're pretty brave to show your face around here.
Yeah, yeah. These noble lords. No sooner are you sick than you are considered the dregs of society. Humph!

Seraphim Lucretia suspects that there's something wrong with the hunting results of Seraphim Milrinda. She wants me to kill as many monsters as possible in five minutes. Afterwards, she will compare my results to those of Milrinda.
Mort!

Any more questions? No?
What are you waiting for then?
Of course they were sent by him too. Soon it'll be his turn!

Fetch some medicine from the town!

The Black Fever has plagued our village for days now. Our Herb Woman has tried to help, but she doesn't have enough medicine. Could you fetch some medicine from the town? Hurry! We're desperate!
The hunting guide was glad to at least have something to remember his cow by.
Dead, they're all dead! They deserved it! I'd better talk to the captain again, to serve him up some story so I'll get away unscathed.
You dragons are so easy to read ...
Well, I don't really think that Ker wants to listen to their whining.
To kill such inferior enemies is against the law of the jungle!
This must be the sought after stone. I'll bring it to Ambul!
The man gave me some oil! It’s not much though. I will have to use it wisely.
Conjures a spectral hand to strike the target opponent.
I have no time for that at the moment

This is a fine mess I've gotten myself into. As a sign of her gratitude she wants to tell me about her past. What did I ever do to the Gods to make them inflict the babbling of a teenage girl on me? Oh I suppose I'll let her keep talking if it makes her feel better. I'm definitely too good for this world.
Kuan is angry that only a few people attended his celebration. I have to take the Priest eight wolf hides so that he can sacrifice them to appease the God.
You Dryads are supposed to be quite tender...
What could you possibly do to me, little Dryad?
At least the farmer knows what happened to his chicken now.
Father says the slaves are always nagging, and that they are lazy.
My mother thinks all Humans should leave our land.
You are like all grown-ups - you think of nothing but war and fighting.
I won't say a word. Nobody listens to children anyway.
Mother says the great Troll should come after the Priesthood.
Tyr Lysia! Finally - solid ground under my feet. I must admit that traveling by sea is not my method of choice. Well then, I must go see Fangil.

The law of harvest is to reap more than you sow. Sow an act, and you reap a habit. Sow a habit and you reap a character. Sow a character and you reap a destiny.
James Allen
A magician by the name of baa... Mathirius turned himself into a sheep to escape from a horde of Orcs. He asked me to escort him safely to his home, where he might be able to undo the spell.
There are many Goblins around here. TOO many!
At best, I could use this for trading.
Again we diminished the troops. I hope we find some thread rush here, otherwise my effort was wasted!
I'm also thinking about marriage. Would the spirits bless this union?
If I wanted to marry after all, would I need the ancestors' approval?
Do I still need your consent to marry?
This thing, you know, marriage, the eternal union... I think, I'm ready for it now.
I want to tie the knot. Do you think the ancestors would bless me?
Would you accompany me to my wedding if I asked you?
Do you think I'm ready to tie the knot?
I'm thinking about marrying. Do you believe this union would be blessed?
I want to have a wedding soon. Could you ask the ancestors to bless us?

Some blathering fool I met outside the palace let slip that there used to be a sculpture of something called The Great Machine on the pedestal in the village square, and that some pieces are still in a closed wing of the palace. Finding them shouldn’t be too hard, and then it sounds as if I should pay a visit to the local librarian.

Well... we've had enough fun now. Give us the sword. We forgive you for killing Orkus, after all an Orc is easy to replace but the sword you carry with you is not. We cannot allow you to destroy this artifact, it's power is too important.
You refuse?

ATTACK HIM!
Don't mention it. But don't tell anyone or I'll get in trouble with the guild.
Tell the Hammer I said hello - farewell!
Good bye! And do pass on my regards!
You are fighting for a noble cause.
You do that. I'm sure Blackhammer can use each helping hand.
I won't give up that quickly!

Guardian of Souls
Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are something to do, something to love, and something to hope for.
Honorable Sister, I am having problems with a new healing spell.
I bid you welcome. Tell me, how can I help you?
The wounds of this poor injured wretch failed to close after I cast the spell on him - instead he grew a third leg!
When you cast the spell you must make the sign of the three waves with your hand.
Of course! You are so right! Oh, this is just unforgivable - I made the sign of the jagged peak.
I hope you are still able to help this poor wretch.
I fear that will be rather difficult. The weight of the leg that grew out of his chest was simply too much for him.
Do not ponder this sad matter for too long. It was your good intention that counts.

Bring me seven wreathberries!

Those cowardly Ore-Thag Orcs have poisoned our well. We need an antidote, before all the water in the area is poisoned and our people start dying like flies. Your presence here is most fortunate. Perhaps you can help these idio... um... warriors to find some wreathberries? We will need seven wreathberries to neutralize the poison. Oh and before I forget, wreathberries only grow in Troll turds! Go now! Bring me some berries.
I should return now. The preparations for the festival need to be finished.

Unearth the treasure!

Great! There's the key. Good work. Well then go ahead and unearth the treasure. We'll keep an eyes on our things here in the meantime. Don't worry, I'll pay you generously.

You did a good job. I hope that beast burns in hell now!
Here is Jin's order. Take it to him.

Find the reason for the pollution of the river and do something about it.

Look at this! All the fish are belly-up. They're swimming in dishwater, not real water. I can't fish in that, and I can't feed my family. I'm getting sick just from the smell. Something is poisoning the water and killing the fish.

Will you find out what's going on?
The people in the Temple should now be able to cast the protective spells they need.
Rikal and his thugs are finished. They won't deceive anyone again.

A Dryad huntress did not return from hunting. The other huntresses fear she might be dead. A Dryad also spoke of a monster trying to invade the city. A guard was able to chase it away, but now she's in shock and won't come out of her tree anymore. I'm supposed to make sure everything is okay and defeat the monster, whatever it is.
My Hellhound would eat that for breakfast.
The soul stone - I feel much safer now.
Not everybody would be able to achieve this...
My employer was satisfied and gave me a generous reward.
The Oracle is an old hermit! Before he will reply he has given me a task to complete.

Get the results from the focusing station!

Oh you’re back already! That was quick! I have another task for you. I have been studying a particular problem for many years and I believe I am close to solving it. I believe that the “Flaming Lance” comet, which has circled our planet for a number of years now, may be the cause of the recent fluctuations in levels of T-Energy. We built a focusing station nearby to measure the fluctuations, go and collect the latest results from my colleague Welkahr!
Your bad manners are as legendary as your reputation.
A strong man like you makes me go weak in the knees.

What the hell do you want? Looking for those damn fool Elves? Didn’t anyone tell you it’s dangerous to go poking your nose where it doesn’t belong? Like into my little operation, for example? I guess you’ll just have to learn the hard way.
Who would have guessed! The cloudcuckoo weed wasn't the right ingredient. The shaman thinks I should go and speak with the chief of the clan.
He sure wasn't pleased with my news. I didn't receive a reward but at least I gained some experience.
Well ... I'm really reluctant to do this ... but tradition is tradition.
Looks like your adventure was pretty short, my friend.
Well, it is a pity. But you can put your mind at rest: nobody will remember you.
Well then, your life as an adventurer seems to come to an end right here.
Would you like to say a few last words?
Well my friend - I guess that's it!

Namiel wasn’t happy at all... He complained about the family disturbing his peace. He thinks I'm the only one who succeeded in life so he left me the land. What should I do with it? The best thing would be to give it to Andreala. She's a reasonable child and will know what to do with it.
The job is done. We’ve returned to Slain Athai.
A tricky question indeed! I will answer your question, if you bring me something in return!
Thank you sister. Maybe you could use some gold for your journey.
Go back to your tree, Dryad monkey!
Whoa, blowpipe against fireball. I am soo scared now.
You cannot always fight with your muscles, you need to use your brain as well - I will explain what that is some other time.
You withstand wind, weather and dangers, I hear.
You fight in any weather, I see.
The air is very nice today, don't you think?
It will be winter soon. You should buy new clothing!
Do you think my skin would look better if I went out into the sun more often?

There you are. Very good, this amount should be sufficient for my purposes. Here is your reward. Wait a moment, while I take the shadow herb to my alchemist.

If you are interested, I have another offer for you.
Well, then that's the way it has to be ...
I've killed enough old jungle cats now and you can make a very impressive necklace from seven fangs. I'm going to take them back to the huntress.

Good work, but I doubt that they are gone forever. These creatures are not only tough, they also like to hide in the smallest spaces.

Here's your money for now.
I'll increase your odds of making mistakes with magic.
Great! Now you only need to convince the village doctor of my innocence.
A lonely Ogre has lost his way in the desert and can’t find his way home. I will take him to the beach so that he can find a boat to take him home.
Argh! I faint at the sight of blood!
I will have to have that wound stitched up!
That's going to leave a mark!

The Priest has gone to his weekend residence, he seems to be quite a nasty fellow. I will make sure that he doesn't exploit the villagers' fear any more. And Telwan will pay me well, if I solve the problems he is having with the healing potions
A demon like you does not worry me.
The Gamekeeper was very happy. He's going to put the eggs in the nests right away.

You... you're sure the murderer isn't there anymore? Why can't you tell me who or what it was? There wasn't even a body to be found?
Well I guess I just have to trust you...
I'm supposed to destroy a camp where the Kobolds have been getting their supplies. I'm slowly turning into every Kobolds worst nightmare.
I really should clean up in here sometime!

Go to the servants' quarters and make sure everything is alright!

Apparently, there were several incidents in the servants' quarters last night, although I don't know what exactly happened. Maybe you could check on the servants' quarters on your way to Lord Gemma? Would you do me that favor?
They should enact a law against hunger.
Is it correct that the big ones enact the laws and the small one have to follow them?
My father says politics is just immoral.
Politics should provide security, that's what my father says. Does it?
All the people are railing against politics. How about you?
You don't just have a big mouth, you are one!
You should watch your nutrition. That's at least three gross registered tons too many.
Your blood is too old and rank for drinking.
Dead blood... I wonder what color it is.
Feeble Human. Your end has come!
Displays item prices even when not at a merchant. Merchants will offer more favorable prices as well as better items, while quest givers will offer better rewards.

I made my way to the priestess' hut and found the Potion of Bedevilment. I also found some vials filled with poison and one with an antidote. That's exactly what I need to teach the old fool a lesson.
One of us is about to die. And it won't be me.
The golden arrow on the minimap points in the direction of the next campaign destination.

My brother's amulet? He always wore it to bring him luck, but it looks like his luck ran out. My poor brother, I will mourn for you for all eternity. Thank you for returning the amulet. This trinket affords me at least a small reminder of him.
Have you found out more about your friend's whereabouts yet?
Your save game is corrupt and could not be loaded. Your game progress will not be saved. To enable saving, delete the save game.
Might I dare to speak with you?
Well actually it is against my beliefs to speak with a non-Elven creature - but I shall make an exception.
It is about a matter concerning my sister. She is pursuing a secret affair with one of your kind. I am trying to talk her out of it.
One of our Priests together with a primitive Human wench! If they are caught they will both face the fury of the cleansing fire!
He forced her into this affair, I swear!
That's preposterous! She must have bewitched him, there can be no other explanation!
In that case, it is better if I remain silent.
Indeed! You have said too much already. Hurry - be on your way now!
I wonder why so few patrons come here these days?
Sometimes I wish I had a different job - the atmosphere here is terrible.
In the old days you could still find a real man at this bar - and today?
I don't have to work tomorrow, thank goodness!
Bah, it's full of smoke in here. I should let in some fresh air.
Be careful, you'll hurt yourself with that thing.
Sometimes I wonder what would happen if our fighting skills were as bad as our pay. It's really a sad state of affairs.
If we dropped our swords every time our pay ran out, we'd have been invaded long ago.
The treasury is empty again, we earn less than beggars. If I didn't love this land so much...
They've cut our pay again, what a disgrace! Just consider all the long hours.
Will our pay ever match our work? We're putting our life on the line and are treated like beggars.
What's a soldier's life worth? Based on the pittance they pay us, not very much.
I don't know what to say. They even want to tax our miserable pay now!
Why are we always the ones who suffer when there's not enough money in the treasury?
That's not fair, right? We risk our lives and don't even get a pension. What a world we live in.
Maybe I should moonlight as a beggar? I sure can't make ends meet on my soldier's pay.
If you kill them, the Gods will reward you.
If your faith is strong, you can't be defeated.
Ah it's you again. If you want something done right... Haven't you ruined enough already? Curse you, may your bones forever burn in hell.
Maybe I can sell it? In any case, I have no use for it.
I think we were all probably like this when we started out, but with Kybele's guidance we became serious warriors!
Nonsense! They may be a bit impetuous, but they are good and brave children who would do everything to protect the garden.
Don't make them out to be any worse than they are! They may be a little immature, like young berries, but they firmly believe in themselves.
