They should especially beware of the dark side of the force! I don't think that anyone here really wants to listen to that though.
They're greenhorns, just like we were once! Back then I couldn't even draw a bow without hurting myself!
We should give them some time, just as Kybele did with us! Or were you born a fighter?
We have to improve their sloppy camouflage! When I was their age, the enemy couldn't tell the difference between me and an olive tree!
They'll shape up! We are old trees who carry a few battle scars in contrast to them.
Well I think that it's the thought that counts! With Kybele's help we will plant the seeds of our knowledge and experience in them.
Don't be unfair! What's important is their desire, and I'm pretty sure that they'll start feeling their warrior roots soon.
The Ents didn't want to talk, so I had to resort to violence. Now I have the decorations and can return.

Talk to the librarian again

The world is the work of one Creator? Hogwash!

But whether Ker is a Goddess in her own right, or merely one aspect of the supreme being, there is no denying that her time has come, and no philosophical drivel will change that.
The important find is the sculpture. We never knew what The Great Machine looked like, only pieces of it. Now we must concentrate on finding the location of the hub. Even a fool such as you must know that the Seraphim won´t tell us anything. But we don´t need them. There are creatures even older than War Angels - the Dragons. Although he lost the Great Dragon War, the old Dragon Mer-Kil still lives and he is certain to know how to find the hub. You must find him and persuade him to tell you. Who knows, he may even be willing to fight for our cause. It will be a dangerous journey, however. Visit the librarian again before you go - that man knows more than he admits, and perhaps he will tell you how to protect yourself in the land of the Dragons.
Hurry up, orc! I don't have all day!
I can shift and shift all I want, it just won't fit.
Bloodlust - Further increases attack and cast speed.
Reprisal - Increases the Seraphim's damage output when she is injured.
Delay - Increases the duration of Dashing Alacrity.
Ardor - Decreases the regeneration time of all aspects.
Impatience - Reduces the regeneration time of Dashing Alacrity.
I found the Lost Lorebook of Atherton by the corpses along with an ancient weapon, which is called the 'Flaying Glaive of Atherton'. Now all I have to do is deliver the Book to this Chronicler.

Please get the dowry from Ayshe's father.

The bloodbath seems to have shocked Ayshe, but I'm sure it won't last long. As I mentioned earlier, we want to marry so we need a dowry. Please go to Ayshe's father and negotiate one with him. It won't be easy, he's a merchant if you know what I mean.
Attention. Wild animals within sensor range.
Have you found a perfect crystal, yet?

Drive the Kobolds from the canyon.

Greetings!
We have a small problem here in the canyon. It’s the Seraphims’ problem actually, but the senate has asked us to appease the Seraphims' followers by taking care of it.

Report to the sentry at the garden of the Seraphim and kill a few of those blasted Kobolds while you are on your way.
Hardened - Increased resistance against side effects
Experienced - Reduces the cooldown of the trance
Hardened - Increased resistance against side effects
Energy Flux - Markedly increased regeneration rate

Ceremonial rats? Yes, I have some. Good quality rats, they all weigh a minimum of 45 stones, 2 years of best-quality maggot feed in them. So fat they'll positively screech when you give them a jab! I’d be happy to give Fellir one of them. But I must insist on adequate compensation. You know what they say: Quod pro qui! Or something like that.
There is a tribe of Orcs nearby that worships the Spider God. Their rituals are filthy, disgusting and intolerable! They must be stopped! Kill eleven of their ceremonial spiders and bring me their spider stings as proof. If you accomplish this, I will gladly give you the rat.
I heard you destroyed the Gar'Colossus.
You are the Golem killer, aren't you?
Everybody who kills a Golem deserves respect.
It takes courage to attack an earth elemental. And strength to defeat it!

The Prince was glad to have the last crucial ingredient for the Devil´s Fire in his hands. After a most enlightening demonstration I see that this weapon really is incredible. It will create enough fear among his opponents that they won’t dare vote against him in the upcoming elections. My work here is done. I should now continue my journey and enter the jungle.

You want to know where the Pasha disappeared to? The good Schehera can help you, yes indeed. I took some of the Pasha's hair years ago. Now all I have to do is say my personal localization spell and then I can tell you his whereabouts.

modderamm, sutteramm, Nimra, Nimra!

Ahh I see a cave not too far from here. But he's not alone, so be careful!
I'd love to put a curse on every single one of those despicable blade swingers we call soldiers.
If only I could put a holy hex on those blasphemous soldiers!
Should we really subject ourselves to military rule? They will ruin the country, I tell you.
These soldiers show no respect! They even fight on consecrated ground, can you believe that?
I hope that we'll get rid of this so-called army of the people soon.
You know, someone should teach these infidel soldiers a lesson.
Do you think that we can still rely on this shabby army? These men have no faith whatsoever.
The army will be the death of all of us! They're show-offs with no regard for the Gods.
These arrogant soldiers honestly believe that they are the protectors of the people. Have you ever heard such blasphemy?
As long as men in uniforms rule us, the true faith doesn't stand a chance. Isn't that terrible?
Indeed! The children are locked in here. Hmm, didn't the farmer only mention two children? There are five here! Of course I'll take all of them with me back to the farmer's house.
Uh-oh... I hope I haven't overestimated my capabilities here!
The poet was delighted to get his lost pages back. He was very generous.
My work is toilsome and hard.
We have to cut a firebreak through the forest tomorrow. It'll be an exhausting day.
My axe is so blunt I could ride to town on it.
Cutting wood is not the easiest of trades.
The charcoal burner has been wanting new wood for days.

You can get more with a kind word and a gun than you can with a kind word alone.

- Capone
Ahh excellent. Thanks to those blueprints I was able to restore my memory blocks. I do remember.
How could the Creator create something imperfect like you?
I don't like killing animals. But you seem to be insisting.
Goblin eyes are good for my pale complexion!
Tily was glad I could help and has rewarded me well.
The task sounds interesting. I accept.
I've seen blind Trolls that shoot better than you!
If I take this along, my back will start giving me trouble.
I'm not far from the destination.
Brothers! We should be struggling together! We are!
Carl accepted his situation and swore to leave Mechthild alone. We could have come to that agreement without me having to give him a black eye.

Decision making potion? Never heard of it. I can offer you this tasty concoction. It doesn't really have any effects but sometimes faith can move mountains. It's yours for only 100 gold pieces including this decorative bottle, with no deposit.
The time of the Temple Guardians is long gone...
You have proven your worth. There's another small problem. A gang of brigands is roaming the region. Would you help us to get rid of them?
Rinah sent me to Inquisitor Monwarion. He's a little bit higher up in the food chain than Rinah.
Don't count on me being merciful!
You magicians have no idea what true power is.
The villagers were very pleased with my work and gave me a considerable reward. What more could you ask for?

Start forging
The forged item can be remobed afterwards
Providing I haven't miscounted, that shoule be it. 35 furs, as ordered. I'll go and deliver them.
Just who do you think you Gnomes are dealing with here?
I was right. They were about to sign a contract with the Kobolds. I wonder what commander Erestor will make of this.
Water ... it's not good for the joints.

Destroy five ghosts to honor Lumen.

This is a catastrophe! A pack of wild boars invaded this area last night, and they made a terrible mess. They were about to topple Lumen’s statue when I came, I was barely able to drive them away in time. We have to offer Lumen a sacrifice to appease him. Go and destroy five ghosts. They roam this area.
One of the larger settlements in the Human region.
Towns mean to me wine, women and more wine...
Trapsetter Angar asked me to go to the traps that he set and collect the wolves' furs that are lying in them. He's afraid to go there himself because of the Thraconians.
I've killed a couple of boar, now let's see if the pack leader shows up! Oh speak of the devil, there he is! The boar, not the devil
I want to rise to this challenge!
On behalf of the house of DeElfici, I'm supposed to deliver a load of spices within one day.

Procurator Langhanns
Hm... never heard of him. They put memorials up for all sorts these days...
Your life will be credited towards my experience!
Once you had a purpose - not anymore!
You are messing with the wrong person, priest!
I didn't do anything so please leave me alone!
I have to go and take the children to safety.
Show some generosity in life, and just go away!
The dying soldier is clutching something in his hands. Looks like an amulet. He's almost dead, right? So I guess he doesn't need it anymore ...
The pipeline is damaged. I must seal it.
Your manner of dress is about the only thing that is frightening.
It's still not too late to choose the right path, my lord!
Move on - the sight of you is scaring the children!
You're still alive aren't you? The way I see it, I'm ahead of schedule!
Don't be so harsh! Our men are always brave and they don't even get paid for their courage.
That may be true, but our soldiers are still brave and they're giving all they have.
As I always to say: The opposite of done well is meant well. This is especially true for the army's leaders!
Fish starts rotting from the top! And if I take a look at at our clueless army leaders I can see it's not limited to fish.
I hear that now they even call children and old men to the weapons.
I don't know, I think that what matters is that they haven't lost their spirit.
Well, what else can they do? They make swords from the best plowshares!
Quite honestly, I'd kill some of these deserters. That might help!
Don't complain about our brave warriors! It's the useless commanders' faults.
I suppose. They won't terrify our enemies armed with toothpicks and wooden helmets.
I have cast my lot with a fool! Did I not tell you to go speak with the librarian?
Energy source successfully confiscated. Will commence detailed analysis of the cave now.
Where are you going? Are you going to the village?
Yes, I have to speak to the smith. He has to build something special for me.
Something special? You want to get a suit of armor for the fight?
A suit of armor? I don't need that nonsense. Only cowards and women wear armor!
Why are you going to visit the smith then?
I want him to forge some blades for my hands! I'll be able to kill much faster with them!
But you won't be able to shake anybody’s hand anymore. Just think about it!
Who would want to shake my hand? Get out of my way!
How about a game of Gnome ball?
Can you guys catch flies with those tongues?
It's done, he's on the ground. The commander will be pleased.
Thanks. Very nice. Let's hope that this is going to last for a while
Two hundred and fifty years ago.
We marched from the empire of sand.
Attack, an attack in the dead of night!
I was unprepared, my weapons in disarray!
Death and destruction! They slaughtered every last one of us! Run!

Enrico Ausborn
The day has 24 hours, that means it contains three working days!

The Oxen were loaded with gun powder! If they had all gone off together, then...
I have to find Officer Willybald now.

Kill the Kobold builders!

These Kobolds have become a real plague! The little pests are everywhere. They're taking over the countryside! The hill nearby has already fallen into their hands, and they've started erecting watchtowers to control the roads. Once they control the roads we'll have a real problem on our hands. You look as though you are just the right person to solve our problem! Go and kill the four Kobolds working on the watchtowers! That should slow them down for a while.
Lord Colin wasn't willing to just cough up the money, he won't resist anymore though.
What do the Humans call you? Green Skins? Well, bring it on ...
Now they will all think that this meeting was a trap set by the opposing side. The feuding will continue.
No problem, I'll just go and look for a couple of lonely soldiers. They'll have a pretty stupid look on their face when they go where I've just come from. Muwahhahahaha.
A strike that will damage and slow down all opponents within a half-circle in front of the Inquisitor.
Go! Show your inferiors how real leaders die!
Priests are boring. Bad orators and even worse fighters.
At least you can't bring them back to life after.
You are a man after my own heart.
You'll have to look for someone else.

Bring me a construct's helmet!

What do you want? The bucket? No! It's mine now! My old bucket is in pieces, and I have nothing to catch rainwater with. How am I supposed to clean myself? Then I found this bucket here and took it. Not my problem if someone leaves their bucket lying about unattended. Finder's keepers I say.
If you want this bucket, I need something else to catch rainwater with. Like the helmet of a construct.

I’m Dranaigh, the Priestess of this village.
Welcome back, sister. You have been absent for too long and are contaminated by the outside world. In case you wonder about the Elven village, they are permitted to live here by the Queen’s decree to fight back the repeated naval invasions from the Wasteland. Many of our kind are not happy about them, saying their farming, mining and tree cutting is destroying the land. What can I say, at least they’re doing their job. Let’s get back to you now, shall we? You know our rules. If you have been away for too long, you are considered a foreigner and need to regain the trust of our family. For a start, you could prove your loyalty by shutting down the strip mine that sends clouds of smoke into the sky, day and night, poisoning the clean air of the island. You can find the mine west of here.
A strange captain wants me to steal some horses from some horse thieves. Stealing from thieves, that's a nice touch. Let's get to it!
The Trophies could not be initialized. Please restart the game.
Rizzil is ready to go, we can leave at once.
I'll cast out your religious drivel!
Here's your thanks for bringing me back from Elysium, Priest!
Talks have failed and the feud is worse than ever. My employers are very happy.
Rabies? Foot and mouth disease? Bird flu?
You slave to the authorities - you boot-licker!
I implore you to move on.
Are you trying to scare the chickens with that outfit?
With you, one must pose the question of whether you were born like that, or if you embody evil of your own free will.

I should have signed the contract for "Terminator 4" four weeks ago. Then I wouldn't have to wait around here but could be killing some Humans. OK, Humans only but that's better than nothing. But I wanted to serve the Gods. I wish I had known before...
It is well-known: The crueler the ruler is, the smaller his, ahem, self-esteem is.
If we worked less and ate more we'd be on the same level as them. Too bad they know it.
I have to say that my lord has mercy. He only beats me once a day.
I'm waiting on my master hand and foot. Otherwise, he'd chop them off...
When I'm disobedient I have to go to the "Silent Stairs." Oh the barbarity!
I keep a secret diary. I'll be in deep trouble if the lord's brother catches me!
Unfortunately we don't have any chances to rebel against the rulers.
If only I could be locked in a room alone with the lord - it wouldn't even have to be for five minutes!
There will be a time when wishes come true again. And then I will wish for him to get the plague.
He who laughs last laughs loudest. Too bad we have nothing to laugh about.
Hicks gave me a book as a thank you present. "Barry the Otter and the Herring's Secret" - I can hardly wait.

Reward Test

Talk to me and receive some items, gold and experience points.

That zombie's got it bad. Not only is he constantly being cut down by a ghost, this ghost seems to have it in for him. He mocks and insults the zombie. After 50 years or more of this anyone would feel depressed. He asked me to kill the construct to free the zombie from his curse.
Good good, wife dere, you dere. Not hungry ma friend? We'll dat up to you. We will eat now.
Thanks for your help. Here's the amulet I promised you. I think it saved my life, and I hope it will protect you just as well. Goodbye.
I have no time for religion. Goodbye.
That's enough now. I have more useful things to do.
That's more than enough, or else I might really lose my faith.
I don't want to continue this talk. Thanks and goodbye.
Enjoy your faith, my friend. I'm off.
Maybe religion wasn't the best topic. Have a nice day.
Take care then, I have to go now.
Please forgive me for not continuing this conversation.
I don't want to talk to you anymore. Let me go in peace.
Our talk was fun while it lasted, but it's over now.
Stan gave me a key for the cellar and told me to ask for Eddie.
I hate these cowardly ranged fighters...
The archaeologists have been saved and Limise was very grateful to me.
Very well, just a moment, please.

Dead? Woe! Poor Abdullah! He was always a bit slow, but he certainly didn’t deserve THAT. Better him than us though, eh? I suppose I must have added a tad too much T-Energy... Never mind. Here is your reward.
I have been reactivated. My first destination is the Elven settlement.
Good, I accept your promise. Follow the path leading to the north, it will take you straight to the Crystal Caves.

Seek out the Oracle and bring us the answer to our question!

We have an important decision to make that will affect our entire future. A decision of such consequence that I can barely fathom its many implications. This decision is so fundamental that we are cannot make it alone. We must decide whether to continue eating our traditional evening meal of toadquark, or to move with the times and adopt spider ragout as our traditional evening meal. Only an Oracle can answer a question of this magnitude. I beg you, for our sake, seek out the Oracle and bring us his reply.
Is gnome the comparative of small?

Go find Assim, the alchemist, and bring him to me

So you’re bringing me the Scroll of Devil's Fire? I appreciate your effort. Before I accept your gift, I want you to trust me, to believe that my intention is not to acquire the Devil’s Fire. Instead, my goal is to prevent anyone from manufacturing it. The Prince will do anything to gain power, but he who rules without the consent of the governed is doomed to fail. Now, if you truly believe in my intentions, hand the scroll to me.
You Priests do not understand anything!

She's right, we will each build our own business house... She's wrong if she believes that hers will be a success!
Go now, we don't need you to do that!
I would rather walk, than ride that horse.

Find the medallion!

Hey you! You have to do something for me. I'm being watched by Dryads and can't leave. Find the medallion that's been buried beneath a palm tree and take it to my minions near the beach.

Thank you for your help! Vengeance is mine at last! Here! Take this. It has always served me well. May it now serve you even better. I will return to my men now. I've got 500 years of paperwork to do. There is a teleport platform over there that will take you back to the entrance.

Dismissed!
You have avenged our deaths and retrieved my parent's necklaces from the hands of those murderers. Thank you kind friend, now I can leave this world and join my parents in the next.
What are those creatures asking of me? How dare they order me to do something like that! They are no better than the Elves. Quite the contrary! I am going to teach them a lesson!
Thank you so much! You saved us. We will name our first child after you so that we never forget who made all this possible.
I have slain every cultist I could find.

So the scientist tried to set me up. That's interesting. It should have been obvious, but the prospect of a machine that transforms sand into water was just too tempting. Thank you for opening my eyes. Take this for your troubles.

I have to capture twenty escaped Humans and return them to the Dragon Ordaurcil. Will you help me?

What are you doing way out here? You don't look like a hunter and you're definitely not a Blackhammer rebel. A heartscale? Forget it. It's way too risky to attack a settled Dragon, and only theirs are true heartscales. The roaming ones you can kill, but if you want any chance of surviving in this region, you better be on good terms with the settled ones. Those are the old nasty buggers.
Listen, today is your lucky day! This “Blackhammer” guy just freed a bunch of Humans. If we can catch and deliver twenty of them to the settled Dragon Ordaurcil, alive, he'll give us a nice reward. They’re not worth anything dead. You see, Dragons like their food warm and wriggling.
Here’s the tricky bit: They know they’re supposed to be Dragon chow, so they’d rather die than come back. I have a way to change their minds though. Just touch them with this and they’re magically compelled to do whatever we say. We can go twice as fast too, because I’ve got two of them. Here, you can have this one. *leer* You never know, there might even be some handsome hunks in this batch...
I am eternally grateful to you, fighter. The people in the Temple are awash with fear.
The dark warrioress. Ker's right hand of Ker. Spare me please.
So evil is a woman. I knew it...

Good!
Now go to the village! There you will find the man who will hand the weapons over to you!
He came to his senses and wants to accompany me to his sister so he can comfort her.
Poor bear! She probably thought my teddy is her baby. I hope you didn't hurt her too badly.
We should prepare for the next invasion! Right now we're much too immobile, does it strike you that way too?
What's your opinion? Should we prepare our fighters for the next invasion? That's our fate!
It's Kuan's will that we conquer new countries! What's nicer than a wonderful bloody invasion?
Is it true that we're preparing for a new invasion? I really love the looting and pillaging!
It's about time that our army moved again! In the old days we were always attacking other countries, right?
We've become much too immobile. Why aren't we preparing the next invasion yet?
Once our troops were a dreaded invading army! What's become of us?
Have we become lazy or fearful? Why are we attacking other countries so rarely nowadays?
Once we were the terror of the continent! When will we finally attack another country again?
Our army was formed to invade other countries! Why is it so inactive lately?
Go on. I’ll carry on with my work here in the meantime.

Prove your innocence in a duel!

Dryad you're accused of stealing important archaeological documents. You're also accused of killing a number of this expedition's participants. Those are serious accusations! Since you and Delia are the only survivors, it's her word against yours. May fate decide who speaks the truth!
Improves usage of fist weapons by increasing the hit chance enhancing hit speed. Superior use for high level weapons. Furthermore, the chance for double hits increases.
Why are you sneaking around like this? We don't own anything that's worth stealing!
No, no. I just wanted to ask you something, but I don't know how to begin.
By God, just speak up. I don't have all the time in the world.
I know. It's about a romantic matter. I'm really insecure about this.
A romantic matter? Are you mocking me? Since when do Ogres have a heart?
Well, I have one, and it belongs to one of your noble ladies. She lives at the edge of the village.
You should give up now, Ogre! No Orc would tolerate such a relationship!
What a pity. But I'll pick a tree for her anyway. I have to go now.

This Njari doesn't seem to be the most welcoming of people. At least he finally believed me when I told him that I'm not with the people who paid him a visit last week. Let's see if I can find out more about them.
That doesn't suit me quite yet.
I met a wandering preacher at an oasis who gave me some water. Now I can return to the temple.
Just between us girls: Cellulite is very unappealing.
How can a woman leave the house dressed like that?
I massacred things like you by the dozen during the dragon wars.
If you stop struggling, it won't hurt as much!
Do you always dress like that?
Do not confuse bravery with madness!
Well? Have you found the map yet?
We have been looking for you for quite some time now, traitor!
We are quite able to handle a magician!
Why do you stab your people in the back?
Oh, the magician child is about to cry!
I am too late. They have declared peace.
I came, I saw, I conquered.
We are sick with worry. Please make haste!
Very good, I'll start working right away. Here's your reward. What kind of scarf would you... oh, none? Very well.
I can offer my assistance in this affair.
Your future looks promising! Honor the high Priests! Honor Ker!
Don't talk about your pay, buddy! King and country are the only currencies that matter to me.
It's not about money, it's about everlasting glory.
Don't be sad. There are good things too, like camaraderie and travels to foreign places.
That wouldn't be a problem if they let us plunder and pillage more... well, officially.
You're right of course, but serving our country will be rewarded by the heavenly warriors one day.
I don't think much about gold. My wife earns a little bit too.
Just be glad you're not married yet! If you were, every thaler you earned would only be worth a sesterce.
Of course I understand, but if we soldiers fail we'll lose more than just our pay.
Don't be so negative. Just think of the nice bonus we'll get if we kill some Elven merchants again.
There's more to this life than gold. Blood and honor, that's what you should be thinking about.
When I grow up I want to be a scorpion skewer, too.
Did the fog do you any harm? Or why did you kill it?
Scorpions are pretty dangerous, aren't they? How big was the one you fought?
How many Carnachs does one have to kill to be considered a great warrior?
My uncle once fought against a water monster, too. But it was smaller, I think.
It's going to be dusty in a minute...
The Sister sent me to the burial cave to chase off the Kobolds that are apparently threatening to rob the graves of deceased nuns!

You remember me, don't you? Good, then it's not over yet. I don't know what happened among the Seraphim, but it went terribly wrong. More and more undead are coming out of their graves. It seems as if the wall between life and death has been torn down, and the dead are swarming back to the living. I don't know how we should proceed, but the Dragons are old and wise and can probably offer some advice.
Okay okay! All right, you found a few things. But we hid the Ogre's beard. It is heavily guarded. If life has no meaning for you, then go look for it in the cave!
This region can be declared pacified ... and rightly so.
You won't land a husband dressed like that.
You are truly an appalling woman.
You want to be a fighter? Get to work!
Cool frock. But mine has more fleas.
You get props for walking around here alone...
A word to the wise ain't necessary - it's the stupid ones that need the advice.
Take the wool to the weaver
Oh great master, what can I do for you?
I don't have any time right now!
You're going to get it soon!
This time it'll be you that burns, Inquisitor!
Stand still, outlaw. I will kill you anyway.
I will also defeat someone like you!
Delia, that snake in the grass, made it here before me. She blamed me for stealing from the expedition and killing its participants. Why is she doing that?
You don't have your gang under control my friend.
That was just a little prick! Come on, keep going!
Heavy Damage - Increases direct damage output.
Chain Reaction - 80 % chance that the lightning will hit an additional opponent.
Electrify - Increases the chance to reduce the opponent's attributes.
Chain Reaction - 80 % chance that the lightning will hit an additional opponent.

Kuan - God of War

Kuan, God of War. This is the God who protects the warrior and fills him with the raging spirit he needs to succeed in battle.



Mythology

 Kuan is the divine personification of the perfect warrior. For him, fighting is the ultimate reason behind all things. All beings must fight and struggle for superiority. As soon as they stop fighting, they have lost their reason to live and deserve death. Because only fighting ensures the survival of the stronger, and the elimination of the weaker side and - thus - progress and evolution. Just like a gardener has to remove the dead branches from a tree and the surgeon has to burn out an ulcerating wound, war is there to cleanse the world and constantly eliminate everything that's not strong enough. All contrary aspects such as mercy, compassion and love are just symptoms of diluted weakness, leading to stagnation and poisoning the natural flow of things. There is no alternative to war! Kuan disdains sacrifices or pleas for his favor before battles. He will support the side that is strongest unto itself, without the aid of deities, although his spirit will encourage all warriors.

Appearance

 Kuan is a tall warrior, wearing black, heavy armor, a black cloak that goes all the way down to his ankles and a full helmet that covers his entire head. Although his shape is obviously humanoid, it is impossible to tell what race he is.

The Cult

 Kuan is omnipresent in Ancaria. There is literally no part of the world where he is not known, and where his word and doctrines are not being spread. Since Kuan does not emphasize prayers, sacrifices or being worshipped, the followers of his cult strictly focus on sharing his ideas of the world, war and the reason for living. For them, war is a religion and a God in itself. And Kuan is the driving force behind all this. This is a remarkable difference from all other churches and Gods.There are no holy days in the church of Kuan. Amongst the believers, every battle is automatically considered a religious event. The symbol of Kuan is a sword sticking in a skull.

Opponents and Supporters

 Although Kuan is in some ways related to Ker, he is actually a separate, isolated deity with his very own, hedonistic views, which does not leave much space for other philosophies.

The last few days the sun has been really burning down on the streets, have you noticed?
On hot days you can relax in the shadow of the inn.
I knew it! The first raindrops are falling!
Did you know that I slipped on the ice last winter?
Could you please explain to me what politics is about?
When I grow up I'm going to be a politician.
I see - you are not a follower of the peace movement.
You fight a lot. Do you have to pay fees for that too?
Tell them all that they should forbid wars.
The market stall alone costs three coins.

Recently a number of adventurers who relied on the healing potions that they bought from merchant Telwan have died. His supplier is obviously selling goods of poor quality, and I am supposed to find out why.
I knew that Nityahel would be reasonable. Not only did he set Heglie's husband free, he freed all the other unlawfully enslaved men too. I was rather convincing.
Six feet under and pushing up daisies!

A woman by the name of Heglie apparently followed the guards here from the desert in order to free her husband. A Lumen Priest is hiding her, but Nityahel found out where they are from an old Ker Priest friend. There can be no witnesses...
Your friend and mentor is awaiting you. Go and talk to him
If you're looking for Fangor you should ask his wife!
The Christmas Ogre gave me a present. That was nice of him.
I will have to make room for this first.

Kill the mutated Black Bear!

Did I just hear you say you were bored? Then I have a little task for you. Our scouts have spotted a mutated Black Bear in a somewhat remote canyon in the Noriath Corner. He's one strong Bear! Usually a Bear like this wouldn't bother us, but this canyon is important in case we have to, unlikely as it is, retreat. Would you kill this Bear for us? You understand that we can't leave here. We are going to be deployed at any moment now.
I need to take the gold I received to Mehmet and Ayshe.
Well done! Not that we wouldn't have beaten those numbskulls anyway, but better safe than beaten!

You got some nerve, killing my men and then showing your face here! I'm sure that mollycoddled blacksmith's apprentice sent you because he's got a bad conscience. He didn't tell you that he sold those things to me, did he?

Come here and receive your just punishment for daring to bother us!
You know something? I am going to accept this mission!
Let us get started! There is much to do. Blood and sulfur ...
Go on! Kill them now, before they can attack any innocent and law-abiding citizens.
TyBosso is dead! Finally! I won't shed one tear for him. He's got a lot of trees on his conscience, and just as many animals.
Reduces the cooldown of the mentalist aspect and increases the potential spell level without a malus. Allows combat art upgrades in the mentalist aspect.
I have escorted the magician back to his home. I wonder if there is anything else I can do to help him?
That was a difficult fight! But I was victorious! That Demon won't enter this world so quickly again.
These people are slaves of the High Elves. They are completely oppressed, do nothing but common work and most of them are uneducated. When they fight as a mob, all of their pent-up anger erupts.
My hatred doesn't know the difference!
Aaah! Now that’s what I call a rat! Mine were bigger of course, but you should never look a gift rat in the mouth... hahaha. Thank you! Here is your reward. Now I can prepare for the ritual!
You must be a miserable gang, if someone like you is the leader.
Don't be sad. Maybe you'll be reborn as a bird of paradise.
You think you're safe when running off the screen, eh?

What? They were all dead? How can that be? Perhaps now you realize that it's not the DeElficis who are evil. It's a conspiracy! You were courageous. I would like to hire you to find the DeElfici's murderers. I'd wager that Dylaith and his gang are behind this!
Fantastic! With all these enemies down here, I'm sweating now.
You just graduated from the academy, right?
Just between you and me: Your make-up is terrible.
And I thought all the Elves were safely hidden behind their walls!?
You have come to challenge me? How pathetically naïve...

A boy from a farm has told me that a Golem keeps attacking his village. Now he wants to pour water on the path the Golem always takes. He hopes that the water will soften the Golem's clay feet. Smart plan. I'll help him with it.

Maweran sent you? Thanks be the Gods! The world hasn't completely forgotten us! Maweran is truly a good person. He keeps watch on the bridge over the trout stream and warns travelers about the danger. My wife and I are hardly able to leave the house.

Pick five birdgrapes!

Aha! So Lappsess wants some more swill, does he? That old mongrel! Well I had plans to brew up a new cauldron anyway. I still need a few more ingredients though. I can cook faster if you’ll fetch them for me, and I might make you a few potions too. I’ll need some unripe birdgrapes for starters. They help to infuse the lumps with alcohol, and everyone knows the lumps are what makes a swill taste good. Bring me five birdgrapes from the vines on the riverside meadows.
I won the contract to paint the Temple pillars! That will be an exciting new challenge.
I love to write poems about life and people.
The pottery kiln is broken. It will have to repaired.
The poet lives next door. I like him.
You're asking the impossible! I'll be leaving now!
The laborer was pleased and rewarded me sufficiently.
I think I'm going to barf!
Two Elves want to shoot a deer but have no idea how to do it. I'll have to teach those "hunters" a thing or two.
So you did survive that! Well then let's see if you can survive THIS too!
One day I'll be ready to use it.
This is more like a massacre. It isn't even worth the effort...
We have the Dragon’s claw. Now we should leave here at once!

Teach me how to hunt!

Hello! It's nice to meet you again, as you can see we were able to escape. We can't return to the city though. TyBosso's eyes are everywhere and he'd abduct us again right away. We have to live off of what the woods provide us with. Unfortunately we aren't good hunters, perhaps you could teach us a thing or two to make our lives easier?
Garlic? Holy water? Silver balls? Ah well, I'll just try with the good old force of arms!
A catastrophe is heading towards all of us! The moon of Ethara has left its orbit and is plunging now towards the planet!
You dare to disturb me because of such nonsense?
Well, only the ones who are pure will survive the impact of the celestial body! Using this sacred scrub brush will be a great help to you.
You better keep your brush, or else I'll return your contribution with my blade.
Your arrogance will be your downfall!
You had better be careful with declarations like that one, my good man! And now go!
Unbeliever! You'll have to answer for that in the face of the Gods!
Give them my regards when you see them!
Thank you! Lumen will reward you, but here's something from me as well.
You are about to begin a single player campaign using a multiplayer character. Therefore, your quest progress will not be saved in order to preserve your multiplayer progress.
Slave, it is prohibited to pass a noble such as myself so closely.
Please forgive me if I have broken the rules, great mistress. I mistook you for someone else.
Mistook me for someone else? My extremely wonderful appearance could hardly be mistaken for that of someone else!
I beg your pardon, but from a distance, you look like my beloved mother-in-law.
Me, an immortal, a blue blood, mistaken for an ordinary mortal woman!
Crawl away, ingrate! If this should ever happen again, I will make your whole clan pay - that is a promise!
Your generosity will be richly rewarded one day, oh great and noble mistress.
Sure, go ahead and let me wait... I'll be rusting quietly...

Please accompany us to the next village!

The axle on our cart is broken. Would you escort us to the next village? We will certainly find someone there who can repair our cart. You saw what sorts of creatures are lurking about here.
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Astute Supremacy and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Welcome! Allow me to introduce myself, I am Lady Mirwiell.
A powerful item - I can see that!
Ah to finally see the sun again after so many years...

Kill the mortal and destroy the spirit.

You have brought new life to a love most foul, how touching. Honestly, it fills my heart with joy! I'm afraid I can't let you leave though. I mean, what would all the other Demons say? I could do you one small favor, I could reunite you forever... in death.
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Devout Guardian and raises maximum spell levels without penalty.
Oh, I guess that means I'm an honorary Orc now.
Yes ... uhm, thank you. This ... this is ... uhm, nice, really.
It would be my privilege, my lady.
Honorary member of an Orc clan. I wouldn't have imagined that in my wildest dreams...
I need a weapon to cause more physical damage.
Mechanical creature of the netherworld - off with you!
What do you want here, Temple Guardian?
You are not a man of many words either, are you?
Can I have five minutes peace please?
The ghost will follow me to the alchemist now.
Back to the librarian? (sighing) The things I do for my cause!
You? I didn't expect to meet you again. I see you've been successful. Well maybe there is still a chance for us! I'll talk to my farmers. Maybe we can get something on its way together.
You're about to wish that you'd never crawled out from under your stone.
Don't throw away your life, you are far too young!
What are you doing here at this time? Shouldn't you be frightening little children at midnight?
After my striking success the commander wants me to do another job for him.  He wants me to find the nearby camp of the cultists and kill all but one, and then bring that one back to him.
Didn't they warn you about me in the netherworld? It's about time they did!
The magician is dead. You could say that his mutton days are over... Perhaps that's a bit too disrespectful...
Be careful. The fog numbs your senses.
I hope he will learn from that!
Repent and I shall make your death a swift one!
I'm slowly losing my patience with our building slaves! The new temple is more crooked than ever.
What will Kuan say about his new temple of blood? Architecturally it's a catastrophe.
Have you seen our new temple? It looks like it was built by toddlers!
Kuan will burn down this new temple with his mighty lightning! Such a warped building is a joke,and not the funny kind!
The faithful ones are a failure when it comes to buildings! Look at this awkward new temple.
How can it be that Kuan's new temple of the fallen warriors ended as such a pathetic shack?
Unbelievable! This new temple looks as if the construction design was made by idiots, what do you think of it?
Kuan will curse us all when we inaugurate the new temple. He doesn't deserve this eyesore.
Why aren't we able to build some marvelous temples for Kuan? It's ridiculous!
We should burn down this ugly ruin our builder calls a temple! In Kuan's name!
The Soldiers were happy that no important information fell into enemy hands.
Nice place you've got here, Dryads!
In the jungle, the mighty jungle, the Dryad sleeps tonight!
Would you look at her! It's the green giant's wife!
Alright let me take a swig and then listen to me. Cheers!
A high Priest! I am honored! Tell me, how can I help you?
We are looking for brave warriors willing to fight for a just cause. You slaves should be at the ready as well.
My Lord, enlighten me - what is this just cause?
We are marching into battle against the heretics, for the glory of our Gods!
For the Gods you say... but I was taught that the Gods loved only the Elven folk and had nothing but scorn for Humankind.
The Gods smile on any man who draws his sword in their cause.
I doubt they would smile on a woman who draws her sword in their name...
All you Humans ever want is alms. Your own freedom is of no interest to you, is it? Go on then, live your life in poverty .
You are nothing but slaves! Some things will never change.
<Pain, sharp as if being pricked with a needle> ai!
Click somewhere else. Nothing is going on, there's nothing to see here! Click somewhere else!
By the Gods, what is it?
All this clicking is starting to get on my nerves!
Does it make you feel good or something? What already?
Throws a fireball at a target
You are abusing the sacred powers, charlatan!
I find that bad people are often spiteful.
You're probably one of those who like to cause others harm.
Undead creature - I am here to grant you eternal peace.
The village must be to the west of here, whichever way that is. People should have a compass that always shows them the right way. THAT would be awesome!
Lurana rewarded me with the sacred blessing of Lumen - and a ring.
What? What the... the medallion is robbing me of my strength!
I took the key to the chest holding the stolen goods from the robber chief. I hope Michel's things are in there.
I’m not an Elf. The Elves are over there.
Saving content... Please do not turn off the system.

Some nomads are troubled by sand fleas that just won't leave them alone. Maybe a curse of the Gods? Anyway, they need help. Shadow moss is supposed to repel the sand fleas. I'm already starting to itch as well.
Forget it! I won't let you in here. Anyway, I told you, the Grand Inquisitor is over at the holding cells.

Go to the Temple and deliver my message.

Tell the member of our glorious Life Guards who is currently on duty that the gold is flowing again, and there is no need to worry any longer.
What his wife wants to do to him is terrible. If he does get bored with her, tell him he's welcome at my place any time day or night.
Not just the harvest, but also the whole life, fills me with woe.
Hah! Jab! Take that! Die, dandelion..
My greatest dream is of having a horse for ploughing.
The next thing that tramples through my field will feel my pitchfork!
I wonder if sheep can really think?
Only my crook is keeping me from falling over.
Bleak fields mean lean livestock, and a poor shepherd.
If I don't count sheep tonight, I won't be able to fall asleep.
If I get lonely at night, I snuggle up to one of my little sheepies.
Oh, I haven't seen you for a long time! How is your good family?
Things couldn't be worse, to be honest. My youngest one is nothing but trouble at the moment.
What's wrong with him? Is he becoming a little troublemaker?
If only it were that! He's decided that he wants to be a bard. Just imagine! God help us!
A bard? Now there's a penniless trade! Those travelling scoundrels.
That's what I say! Whatever should I do with him?
A good smack upside the head might knock some sense into him.
I'll just have to try and talk him out of it. But thanks for your advice anyway.
I don't think I want to trade with you.
We went to the same rag dealer, didn't we?
I would rather starve, than follow your path.
Seraphim Lucretia seems to be somewhat scatterbrained. She forgot to collect four hunting lists. Now she wants me to get them.
I can hardly wait to see the sea.
You are spreading a foul stench, best!
I wonder where war will lead me next?
I need wine and plenty to eat - that's how to keep my fighting spirit up.
I eat rain worms for breakfast sometimes.
My body is covered in scars.
My gut instinct tells me to refuse.
Okay we discussed that already, but there is still another small matter.
Well, you are entitled to your opinion. But there is something else I wanted to discuss with you!
I have to say, you have an interesting way of looking at things. What do you think about this:
Something else has occurred to me that I wanted to discuss with you.
You're not a fool! What do you think about this?
Well, maybe you're right, but there's still one other important subject.
I don't want to take up too much of your time, but there's something else that I would really like to discuss.
Don't hold this against me, but there's something else I have to say.
Very interesting! There's something else I'd like to discuss as well.
If you're so sure, then there's another important matter that I would like to discuss with you.
A tailor needs cats for a cat fur coat. I just have to bring him a few stray cats, he'll skin them himself.
I know it's dangerous, but you look like you know how to take care of yourself.

Farek? Yes, I remember him. I was already old when he was still young. Elves aren't the only ones with the gift of longevity. Farek has been here often. He wanted to know about the Gods and the world. Let me guess, he's looking for a book from an old library again. What a fool. There are much nicer things to discover in the here and now. Anyway, he's probably referring to the old monastery. It used to have a well-stocked library if I'm not mistaken. You'll find it near Artamark's Gate in a clearing not far from the road.
I will be on my way soon.
Elodriel will take the children to the farmer.

Cookie has returned! Thank the Gods! It certainly took a lot of chocolates this time! She has returned just in time - I had run out of clean laundry.

The apprentice is improving! Perhaps we can begin studying Fire Magic next week?!

Will have to look at the library again - I was attacked by a T-Energy Goblin while reading! Luckily, I had my wand close at hand! That could have turned very nasty! Perhaps the alterations were not such a good idea after all?

Red wine arrived today. Very good!

Have sent the apprentice to the academy with a message. Perhaps someone from the Inner Circle knows a solution to this quandary.

Ordered new shelves. Outrageously expensive! This world is just full of leeches!

If I could only locate the dimensional tear in space, I could close it with a few simple stabilization spells.

I shall have to enter the library again some time in the next few days.

Preparing to enter the library and search for the leak. I cannot let this matter rest.

I shall now open the door.
Don't worry, the scroll will arrive safely.
I am a fragile High Elf. How am I supposed to carry that?
You are no match for me. Don't even try.
Cleanse the world of all living beings with his help, so I can create my own creation.
Humidity is not good for my hairstyle...
The maggots have taken out their napkins already.
Uhh, you are really scaring me...
I got the hearts. I should take them to the statue now.
It's not an easy task to relate news of a death. At least the woman knows of her husband's fate now and can mourn him...

There's a lot of commotion in Lizurath. They stumbled upon a shiny metal while working on the well. In the worst case scenario, it could be silver. I'm supposed to take a sample of the metal for analysis to a scholar.

Gravestone
Masteff - Lost in the drink with his boat on the rocks, while on his way to a drink on the rocks in his boat.
Yes, very good. Isn't the quality of this pelt amazing?

I am relieved to hear that old Lahrian is doing well, we all feared the worst. I am glad that you were able to put my mind at ease. As a sign of my appreciation I will grant you special discounts whenever you purchase wares from me in the future.
Only %1 relics of the same color are allowed.
A wall full of trophies at home - how delightful!
The best way to hunt jackrabbits and rabbits is to step on them.
The SSS Method - stalk it, slay it and stuff it in yer gob!
The cook said I should stop using my club to kill birds - I wonder why?
I require better protection against fire-based damage
Those who stand in the Seraphim's way will die!
You messed with the wrong guy, dragon!
Dragons...! *sigh* They're all the same, devious and greedy!
Your breath stinks to high heaven, and your deodorant is also failing, you filth.
I always thought Dragons to be a little smarter.
I thought you only ate live food!
You don't just have a big mouth, you are one!
Buying a victory is such a lovely way to win.
What sweet victory. Bring me some wine!
I have no use for this.
Excellent. Now freedom has returned to the forest. Why don't you venture deeper into it. You're more than welcome.
If I kill the leader I will save many other Orcs from death on both sides.
We're on the same page, you and me, but there's something I'd like to add.
True, very true, and well put.
Would you lend me your ear again? There's something I'd like to say.
What do you say? Shall we chat like heroes for a bit longer?
I have something on my mind, brother.
Would you like to give me your opinion on another matter?
Oh, I just remembered something important.
I don't want to keep you, but I just remembered something.
You have a sharp tongue, if I may say so.
I'd like to hear your opinion on something else.
What are you doing here, Dryad?
I have killed enough Earth Elementals. Let’s hope that the Orc is satisfied now.
Dryad Priestess Tily Fihl needs five milk weeds for a ritual in honor of the God Kuan. I've been asked to collect them.
I have found and killed one of the wolves. Now I only need to deliver the pelt.
Everyone can see that you are wicked, just by looking at you!
Leave me in peace! People have only bad things to say about you!
You look like you are only capable of evil.
How did you fare in battle my friend? Smashed open some Orc skulls, did you?
Smash them open? Certainly not! I collect them as trophies. I already have quite a nice little collection.
A collection! How interesting! I'd like to see it sometime if I may.
Yes, certainly! I've got over two dozen already. My wife dusts them for me every day.
Very impressive! Did you kill them all yourself?
But of course I did! I chopped every one of them off with one clean cut.
Ha! You are indeed a true master of arms! I congratulate you!
Oh well, I'm only doing what has to be done... Until later, my friend.
It was good that we had a chance to talk. I hope you come to no harm today!
I thank you for this honest conversation in the name of our beloved Kybele.
It was wonderful to see you, but now I really have to go!
I'm glad we had a chance to get everything out in the open.
May Kybele protect you in battle! That is what I hope for you!
I wish you all the best in your journey, see you soon!
Thank you for this conversation! It was very enlightening.
There's nothing like a good chat. Thanks for it!
It's nice that we were able to talk under Kybele's roof. It was a great pleasure!
My thanks, I'll commit everything you'veve told me to memory! It was very stimulating.
A rather angry ex-groom is determined to ruin his ex-fiancés wedding day. I have to collect 10 portions of rankweed and take them to an old witch - she will use the herbs to summon rain.
I have received my reward. This man is indeed a generous citizen.

Deliver the scroll to the patriarch of the family branch in the settlement.

Welcome to our family, child. Now that you're part of the family, we have an important mission for you. This scroll contains the names of the undead from the nearby ruins. We recovered their names and we will now build a shrine, so they can stop walking the earth. We need to take this scroll to our brothers in the settlement. Please deliver it to Thazziz, he is the head of our family there.
You want to see my documents? I can show you my fists!
People have been seeking my advice for thousands of years. Maybe I should start intervening in the history of the world.
I've got the feeling that something really evil is passing through our world.
Do you mean me? I just arrived here.
No, for once I don't mean an Ogre. It's something bigger, something absolutely evil.
Maybe a Troll? They're big and evil, that's for sure.
There are plenty of Trolls here, but I don't mean them. It's a kind of impure evil ghost - yes, that's it!
I'm not afraid of ghosts! It should just dare to attack me!
Why should it do that? Anyway, this is about the things it brings with it, which must be really evil!
Oh, a ghost that brings presents! I'll search for it, so that it doesn't miss us.
Elves are wicked and bad! They betray, send bad goods then come at night to steal supplies! Say want peace but don't show!

Oh there you are again. Were you successful? Excellent! Real jade, as green as clover - and look at this unusual red grain... oh, that's bloodstains. I hope they'll come out.

Here's your reward. I hope the ring fits.

Ogres are very much like Orcs. They are neither dumb nor clumsy and they know how to express themselves rather well. Sometimes they live in small communities, however, they can also be found in Orc villages. They are very strong fighters and heavily armored.
Okay good, I have the Kobold paws. Now it's time to return to the shaman with them.
A clod of earth on two legs. How inventive ...

Travel to the crystal planes!

Greetings! My name is Seraphim Failitia! You look like someone who won't turn away from a challenge. We seraphim are used to honing our body and mind in the hunt. Continuous training is the only way to keep up combat strength. And there is the sportswomanship to consider, too. The hunt is perfect for competing with others. However, it is dangerous in our hunting grounds! What do you say? Do you want to try?
Talk to the next captain if you are ready!
Who would have thought that fishermen face the greatest dangers on dry land?
What do you want? I saw how you killed everybody. As you can see, we took advantage of the distraction you provided and kidnapped Glydial. I think you'd make a good member of our family!
Some days I find it hard to pray. What can I do on those days?
Sometimes I wish I could escape the eyes of the Gods for one day. Is that a mortal sin?
Brother Theaton has lost his faith. Are we in the same danger?
A traveler told me there was one sole God! He was crazy... wasn't he?
If we don't get a sign from the Gods soon, I'll have to seriously ponder.
What if the ones we evangelize to every day are right and we are wrong?
I had NO manifestation last night while I was sleeping. How did I incur the wrath of the Gods?
How can I convince others of our message, when I'm not really convinced myself?
I tried to walk on water, but I failed. Is it just a hoax?
Oh Gods, why have you left me? I feel so alone!
Your magic is as boring as your combat style.
Oh, look at that bag. Its contents are almost odorless. And this color ... Now I remember what it is. It's shadow herb. It's often used to get rid of old enemies or in this case friends and family.
What are you doing here at this time? Shouldn't you be frightening little children at midnight?
Do you have everything I need?
I'm about to pull something out of my hat! And - no, it won't be a bunny rabbit!

Bring me back to the village!

Crap! Mom says that I shouldn't say crap, but I think this is an exception. HOLY CRAP! I'm lost and I can't find my way back to the village. Can you help me?
I have a feeling where she might be. Come!
This magic boost comes in handy.
Improves usage of fist weapons by increasing the hit chance enhancing hit speed. Superior use for high level weapons.
Well done, sister! Sophia will be glad to hear the good news. Take this for your trouble.

The Art of Trapping

Hunting is said to be noble and refined, but anyone who has spent days in a rainy forest only to return to their village wet, ill and without any prey knows that it's not always accurate. Why should you endure the dangers and the boredom if you can make use of traps made of shroud-spider-silk and sharpened logs?

Of course many hunters eventually have the idea to set up traps to make the whole hunting business a little easier, but if they were all successful it wouldn’t be possible to take a step into the forest without falling into a pit full of spears or getting caught in a sling and dangling from a tree by your feet. Luckily the art of trapping is complicated. The secrets of this profession are taught in the trapper’s guild but it’s very selective and there are difficult entrance examinations, for example you’ll have to catch a Dryad monitor lizard or a similar unpleasant animal alive. If that doesn’t frighten you, just ask the furriers or the people in the taverns about the members of this guild. You can find it in almost every city and near the profitable hunting areas.

If you pass the entrance examination you will begin your training. Training can last up to seven years, depending on your skill and your thirst for knowledge. Nobody knows exactly what they teach, but according to rumors you only practice binding and placing slings in the first year. Squirrels and rabbits are mostly caught this way. Afterwards you practice how to hunt with nets, which are hung in trees and activated with a mechanism on the ground. With nets and with slings you are able to catch living animals. Apprentices allegedly have to kill all animals that get hurt in those traps, and set the rest free.

After this skill is mastered, the apprentice moves on to the deadly traps. Pits full of sharpened logs are quite laborious, but with them the trapper is able to kill larger animals which they could otherwise only hunt in groups or at great danger to themselves. The most important part of this trap is the material the pit is covered with. It has to be cleverly disguised and look robust enough to fool the animal, but it can't be too solid so it will burst when the animals walks over it. It also can't be too light because it shouldn’t cave in when a rabbit hops across it. A perfect cover collapses at the moment the animal reaches the middle of the pit, too soon or too late gives the animal the chance of reaching solid ground instead of falling. Good trappers build those covers with such precision that a whole herd of deer can pass by and it only collapses when the first stag steps on it.

It’s obvious that these traps can't be built in most areas. In populated places it’s strictly forbidden, as is the setting up of so called spear throwers - wooden gates with spears that quickly come out of the ground or a tree. When hunting predators these traps are quite common though, so most hunters stay near these traps to warn unsuspecting people who may be passing in the area. But of course there are also hunters who prefer to spend their days at the tavern and to trust the mercy of the Gods. If you should happen to meet one of these trappers, it would be advisable to not take the shorter way through the forest...

Fishing

How can I catch a fish? That’s the question every boy and girl asks when they see the glittering scales in the village pond. A fishing rod with a hook can be built in no time, but the bait is the first obstacle you have to overcome. Will the hook alone be enough, or will it work better if you attach a worm or a bloody piece of meat to it? The latter is indeed suitable for fishing sometimes, but you rarely find fish that are attracted by blood in a village pond. If you find it helpful in your village's pond, you should tell someone that the pond isn't safe for swimming anymore!

The basic requirements are simply something that covers the hook and moves in the water. Some fish eat plants, others mosquitoes and some even eat smaller fish or crab. With a little patience and some training you’ll soon learn which kinds of fish like what kind of bait, and what kind of water you're likely to find certain kinds of fish in. You'll also figure out which is the right moment to give the rod a tug, so the hook pierces the fish's mouth allowing you to pull it in rather than gets pulled out of it. You’ll also notice that most of the people you started your fishing adventure with will soon get bored, and begin to herd goats or watch the tanner at work instead. If you find yourself enjoying being alone in a boat in the middle of the pond, making bait out of feathers and small stones, you should seriously consider fishing as a profession.

There are many large and small fishing guilds in Ancaria. They’ve divided the fisheries along the seashores and in the huge lakes among themselves. Guild members show that they belong to a special guild and that they are allowed to fish in a certain lake or part of the sea by wearing specific colors. At especially desirable fisheries, like the ones near cities, there are often fights between competing guilds. Sometimes you can even witness a siege by hostile fleets. When the fighting subsides and the fishing is occurring it's mostly accomplished with nets. The nets are thrown out from boats, or are bow nets. You can learn how to use them easily enough, but it takes much longer to find out where the good fisheries are located and which fish to catch there. An apprentice being trained by seasoned fisher shouldn’t need much more than one year to learn which areas their guild can fish, how to read the weather and to learn the basics of seamanship.

On rivers and lakes most fishers reject and distrust each other, but at sea they share the camaraderie of soldiers who have to face a common enemy every single day. Especially those who fish the Jade sea, with it’s numerous shallows and sudden unpredictable changes in the weather. Every fisher knows that one day it could be the boat of another fisher that saves their lives.

But then there are the ones who are respected by all fishers from the lakes, rivers, shores and oceans alike: the master fishers of Ancaria! They don’t belong to a guild, they won’t ever fight and they wear white scarfs to show their independence. Only other master fishers are allowed to train them. You call for them when you have to catch enormous fish, the ones that will tear apart each and every net and are able to shatter the boats with one single whip of their fins. Only armed with a harpoon will the master fishers fight them. They lead a very dangerous life, but they know that they are the best of the best. Becoming one of them is the dream of every fisher who sits in his boat in the middle of the pond.

Inventory
 Everything that your character is carrying around is in the inventory. Collecting items in the world will place them into the inventory immediately.

Exception:
Quest items will be placed in your logbook to prevent you from inadvertently selling them. If your inventory is full, items will be placed on the ground. Items that your character cannot use will be displayed with a red background.


CTRL + LMB will sell items instantly and below value. You will NOT be able to buy them back!

Equipping Items
 You are able to equip items from your inventory. Right clicking will automatically equip that item in the appropriate slot.

You can also left click the item and then drag it to the appropriate slot. Valid slots will be marked green.

NOTE:
You might have to clear your weapon slot before you can equip another item. This will be the case if you want to equip a two-handed weapon and the slot is taken by a sword and a shield.

Gaia is the goddess of nature, fertility and motherhood, flora and fauna. She is worshipped by people from all races all over Ancaria, especially by farmers, hunters and in small villages in the countryside. MythologyThe mythology says, that after the creation of the world, Gaia wandered through the empty and sparse lands, looking for life and a worthwhile, friendly place to be. Deeply saddened by the lack of life and the hostility of the place, she rested below a dead tree and started to cry. The tear dripping from here eye fell down to the earth, trickling into the soil. When she continued her journey, a bud grew from the dead tree. Before long, the desert turned into a green meadow. Since then, every tear lost by Gaia created life or fertile lands.Therefore, she is also known as the “Crying Goddess” or the “Tear of Life” in some languages and dialects.AppearanceAlthough Gaia has many different shapes, she is most commonly displayed as a feathered, snakelike being with a sad but friendly face. She can change the colour of her feathers at will, and often lets her feathers shine with iridescent lights.The CultFollowers and priests of Gaia have erected countless memorial shrines all over Ancaria, although many of them are hard to be recognized as such. The church of Gaia does not emphasize grandiosity. Instead, they prefer chasteness and humility, which is consequently reflected in all her shrines. Worldly possessions don't mean anything to Gaia, for the only real and most valuable treasure in the world is life.The symbol of Gaia is a bead. All her priests wear a bead made of stone or wood as a pendant. It represents the life bringing tears of Gaia and the blessing of her sympathy.Members of her cult will occasionally gather around the shrines for collective meditation or celebrations. It's not surprising that spring is commonly considered the time of the year that's dedicated to Gaia. When plants reach up again toward the first beams of the warm spring sun, the followers of Gaia all over Ancaria bring all kinds of sacrifices to her, welcoming her back from her long absence and trying to convince her to stay for a while and restart the cycles of life.The second high feast of Gaia is in late summer, when the fields are harvested and the grapes of the earth are stored for the upcoming winter. This time, they're celebrating their thankfulness and their hopes to see her again next year.Opponents and SupportersIn the Ancarian Pantheon, Gaia supports Lumen, the God of Light in his eternal struggle against Kali. She is also opposed to Kuan, the God of War.
