He’s gone too far, that wretch needs to be punished! Go and kill him for us! I will give you some magic potions in return.

Who dares disturb my eternal slumber?

My good for nothing family, of course! As if I didn’t have enough problems with you when I was alive, do you have to bother me in the afterlife too?

What do I care about this piece of land? Why are you making such a fuss over such a small thing? Sell it and split the money!

You, my child, were always the only one with at least some common sense and talent in this family. That is why I leave this to you. Use it wisely. As for the rest of you... leave me in peace from now on!
Alright I've killed a couple of boar, let's see if the pack leader shows up. Well speak of the devil, there he is now. The boar, not the devil!

Take my son with you to battle and show him what it means to be a true Orc!

We're alone now. Okay, it's about my son Wackar. A worthless boy! He is a good warrior. Well... what I mean is he knows how to fight. If only it wasn't for that teeny tiny problem with the blood. An Orc that can't stand the sight of blood! I've never heard of anything like that before! At home we only eat meat that is well done because even a bloody steak makes him drop to the floor. And he's supposed to be my successor one day. Impossible!
Someone has to show this boy the lie of the land. Direct exposure is the only method that will work here! He has to keep slaughtering the enemy until he no longer cares! Bloody enemies have to become second nature to him. Well... metaphorically speaking of course. None of my people can find out about this, otherwise my reputation will be destroyed. Go with him on a campaign and destroy enemies until he is finally cured!
Greetings ! Everything is fine at my post, nothing out of the ordinary.
Did you face the Ngrunz-Narsch yet?
Good day, kind Priest! A neighbour told me that the coming of the Chosen One draws near.
The Chosen One? Do you mean that cheap conjurer and charlatan from the West?
But they say he comes to lead us into a Golden Age.
Just how naive are you, woman? The only Golden Age is the one in his pocket!
But they say all of his predictions come true!
Well of course they do! But all his predictions are so vague that anything might fit - not that you peasants would notice.
And I, for my part, will welcome him with my flail!
Watch out. The Desert Folk are everywhere.
If prices keep on falling like this, there'll be Humans shopping here soon!
Only the best! My wares are only the best!
You call it expensive - I call it premium quality.
My business is built on top quality wares.
You will find only the finest of arms here in my shop.
New suits of armor is what the realm needs.
Trade means change! Hear me oh Gods, and change my wares to gold!
Misers are wiser! I shall write that on my gate.
Third generation importers and exporters. And proud of it!
My weapon's frost damage won't help me here.
Fried Goblin is my little doggie's favorite dish...
I'm no match for the enemies in this region.

Guardian of Souls
Some days you lose and some days the others win.
The Officer was very relieved with the outcome of this revolt. I think I'm in good with the Inquisitors and the armed forces.
Charting the land is an important task, that helps us calculate the taxes and the average population per square kilometer...
Joana thanked me for clearing up this entire intrigue. If she only knew that I'm the one who engineered it in the first place!
Waton wants to bring me to his superior, Dundiel, together with the tongues. Let’s go.
Thank you again. But now please leave me alone to grieve.
This should be enough to buy the town some time.

Prevent the sale of women and children to the Elves.

STOP! I admit everything. I lost a few workers when a shaft collapsed. Those cheap laborers showed up just in time.
About the women and children... well, these are difficult times. I wanted to earn some extra money by selling them as slaves. I know that I'm a horrible and despicable person.
My people are negotiating with some Elves about the slaves right now, maybe you can still save them.
Connection to PlayStation®Network lost. The game will now return to the previous menu.
My charme knocked their socks off!
There is nothing for me in this region.

Well there’s the money. Like the Inquisitor said: It is better to give than to receive. Here is your reward. You can earn even more, if associating with that kind of vermin doesn't bother you. I have to go to my daughter’s birthday celebration. In the meantime, go to the debtors and get my gold!
Everybody come to me! Right now!
Get your things and come here!
You are living proof that age has nothing to do with wisdom. Or rather, you're STILL living proof.

Bob the zombie is worried about his skin. The damp poses a real problem. He wants to fashion a cape from the skin of a flaming horse to protect his skin from rotting. He asked me to get him such a skin as well as a leather cord from one of the living armors.
Do you have the hands? Hurry up, before the warriors discover that Gronkor's hand is not protecting them.
You can spare yourself the hocus-pocus!

The experiment didn't work? Hm... That's too bad. Very bad! The part about the Humans is tragic too I guess.
It's time to go back to the drawing board.
That's the arena. I wonder what to expect.
I have to go too! May the forefathers be with you!
Thank you! Also in the name of the ancestors who speak through me.
May the blessing of all good ghosts be with you!
I bid you farewell in the name of our forefathers.
May the best wishes of me and the ancestors accompany you!
Go, and don't forget to think back in the name of our forefathers!
Have a blessed time, my faithful child!
I look forward to seeing you soon and in good health.
So venture forth! We'll meet again soon.
Soon our forefathers will bring us together again.
Fangil doesn't seem to be here. I'd best just wait for a while. Maybe he's going to show up soon.
The mummified body still has both hands. So, both hands are fakes!
Fresh country air is said to be healthy. The villagers look fit indeed.
I'm looking for Kurt the Cunning, master of the jade. Maybe I can buy some from him.
As a reward, I was given the little doll and a new ball. Now he wants me to take the competitor who slandered him so badly to court...
One of the soldiers drowned in the river. What a miserable death.
Swampfish medley with freshly poached slime algae. It's pure poetry!
Far be it from me to doubt your good taste.
The sooner you end your babbling about colors, the quicker I'll be finished here.
I don't care about the color. His blood is red for sure, and it will flow like water.
Whatever. Only the dead want to listen to your nonsense. Well... Maybe not even them.
Who cares about the color of a corpse?

Halt! What are you doing with that scroll case? That’s army issue - officers only! Hand it over, you little thief!

Surrender it, or die!
You should've become a baker. It's less dangerous.
Invisible opponents, coming out of thin air all of a sudden. That was a true challenge. Hopefully this was the last fight.
You can't fool a follower of Ker with this fog. I will hunt you down and find you.
You don't have your gang under control my friend.
Would you mind me asking you for a piece of advice?
I'll be glad to be of any help that I can. What is it about?
I want to ask you if you have any ideas to make this uniform more becoming. After all, a girl wants to look her best.
Yes, I have noticed that these clothes do not exactly flatter the female figure.
But what can I do about it?
I would try some tulle, and a few flower appliqués.
Thanks for the advice, I'll give it a try as soon as I have a chance! I'll keep you posted.
I can't wait to hear how it turns out. I'll see you!
I regret nothing. You, on the other hand, will soon be deeply sorry for this matter.
Soon, I will be your lord and master, Demon!
Gods, I put myself in your hands...

Although Marys DeElfici hasn't exactly welcomed me with open arms, he doesn't seem to agree with TyBosso's wheeling and dealing either. He even almost thanked me for bringing his nephew back to him.
I will continue my journey and keep looking for TyBosso.
I saved Barbara from the undead.
You're about to wish that you'd never crawled out from under your stone.
I have no business with you.
Higher tasks are waiting for me.

Help me kill a dangerous monster!

My name is Carlos. You look like someone who might be able to help me with my problem. You see my father is an old veteran, all he cares about is the army and fighting. I'm different. I like to sing and dance. My father doesn't understand. He thinks I'm just a long haired loser because I never joined the army. Maybe he would leave me alone if he thought I was a great warrior. So would you help me kill a monster?
Ancaria is declining due to increasing atheism.

Inquisition Guard
Familiarity breeds contempt. But without a little familiarity, you can't breed anything.
The Orcs attack the DeElfici's business house. I'll fight on the Elven side.
Sure, give it to me! Want to throw in a tent for eight people too? Or a boat?
We must get rid of these wolves!
That's just the one I'm looking for!
That should do for a start. There are obvious holes in the ranks of undead. I'm going to go back to Officer Beniel.
Robbers, thieves, soldiers- they're all the same...
Only one man in the whole world? I bet he doesn't come cheap.

Help us pour a bucket of water on the path of the Golem.

You look really tall and strong. When I grow up, I wanna be just like you. Then we'll show this Golem! This... this Golem! He keeps attacking our village. Stupid Golem!
But right now another idea might help. The Golem is made of clay. If you mix water and clay, the clay becomes soft. My dad showed me that. That's why we want to pour water on the path the Golem always takes. When he gets there - BAM - he'll fall flat on his mug... err, face. Will you help us?
Who sent you? The person you seek no longer exists. Now leave me in peace, before I have you thrown out!
You come from the village, you say? Yes I remember the village. That must be 20 years ago! Those were the days.
My parents brought me with them when they joined the cult . I don’t want to have anything to do with the village.
My father was a good-for-nothing slacker and my mother was killed by an olm. The cult gave me what I needed, a real family. I don’t want to return to the village.
Oh yes my family, I wouldn’t mind seeing my old homestead again. I wonder what my wife looks like nowadays? Oh well, there’s no point in looking back!

Take this secret message to Lord Alcander's captain!

I have another mission for you, but this time it's a rather delicate one. Take this message to the captain of my ship, the “Unsurpassable Justice.” You'll find the captain at the port. He's expecting you.
Nadja needs 15 crystals from the stone creatures on this island. I'd better get started.

I've met Gnarler, an aspiring Orc hunter. He is looking for the hunting dagger he lost in the woods. His career is on the line. He's asked me to come with him because he doesn't dare enter the woods alone. What a hunter.
You there! You're probably one of those fanatics who hate the undead, aren't you? You're under arrest!

You did an excellent job. You're probably wondering where all the undead came from. Our sister Sophia really loves animals, she brought all sorts of animals back with her from her travels. Be that as it may, we thank you for cleaning up! Don't forget your actual task. Take this weapon and destroy it at the hub!
I have completed the task, the tenants are gone.
You will never play God again, Priest!
Coooeee, my green beauty! I haven't seen you for a long time! I trust your blades are as sharp as ever!
You look fantastic, good brother in arms. With any luck it won't be long before our blades taste fresh blood...
It's a good thing I ran into you! How is the war business? I hope you have plenty to do and kill?
What good fortune to meet you! You look fantastic, good friend - and so murderous...
Well isn't that splendid?! I've been looking all over for you! Been to any good massacres recently?
Well, if this isn't just the best thing since fried Elf! You look greener and meaner than ever!
Now that's what I call luck! We've heard much of your evil ways, my friend...
There's nothing like getting together with a bunch of bloodthirsty warriors. I hope you're well, good brother?
Now that's what I like! Bad company - and worse news! You're looking wonderfully green!
Holy Goblin Garglebaths! What a stroke of luck to meet you here! It's been ages since we last met!
My feelings get physical quite swiftly. How about you?
Luck and bad luck are never far apart.
Women should show patience and humor while dealing with us men.
My, today I've really got a case of spring fever!
Do serendipitous events also make you happy and grateful?
Freeze - Slows movement rate of opponents in close combat range.
Glacial Mirror - Increases the chance to reflect incoming detrimental magical effects.
Feel Cold - Reduces the opponent's resistance against ice damage.
Focalize - Increases the spell intensity of all aspects.
Mystic Stormite Expertise - Decreases the regeneration time for the Mystic Stormite aspect.
Frosty Breeze - Additionally increases ice damage.
Dragon slayer wasn't really the best career choice for you, was it?
Have you heard? The last concert of Blind Guardian's Ancaria tour is in Sonnenwind!  I tried everything I could think of, but wasn't able to get tickets.
Merchant Schangan has asked me to look for a caravan that's been missing for days.

Kill the Trolls on the playing field!

It's time for the big game! This time we're going to thrash those Dryad-loving numbskulls from Tharak! You don't play Nargutz, do you? You should try it some time - it's a great sport! The aim of the game is to carry a Troll head into the opposing team's end zone. There aren't really any rules. The playing field is the ground between Entruag and that stinking slum Tharak.
The match between our two villages is an annual event and people come from miles around to watch! Unfortunately we've had some problems this year. A handful of Trolls have been causing trouble in and around the kick-off area. We can't start the game while they're hanging around there. It's a catastrophe. What do you think? Have you got the courage to take on the Trolls? And while you're there, perhaps you can collect a few Troll heads for the game.
You sure make an awful lot of noise, thing!
Be careful! You don't want to rust!
Is that one of your screws back there?
You're short circuiting or something, right?
Why did you leave your Temple, machine?

Peter Kullgard
You can send anyone... but Rente!
How could the Creator create something imperfect like you?
Causes direct damage using T-Energy. Also gives the chance to transform an opponent into a harmless animal - or a T-mutated enemy!
Thank you for saving us. Chuck Latbar is father to all these children. Now he has had enough of them, so he sold us to the Kobolds. This scoundrel should pay for this! Please, lead us to him.
What? The pack animals are dead? How could you let this happen? Argh. It's so difficult to find good employees these days. Now leave!
I met a mage who is after TyBosso too. There must be quite a story behind that. It seems that there are still a few good souls among the High Elves, but I still prefer Humans.

Bring me some thread rush from the apothecary!

Help me, please! My husband... He's got this terrible fever. I'm afraid he won’t survive the night if he doesn’t get a certain thread rush essence. Would you get it for me from the apothecary? Please help me! I don’t want to leave him right now.
Here, take this ring. We don’t have much money, but this ring is bound to be worth some silver. Trade it for the herbs!
He looked more dangerous than he was!
Grab your weapons! The enemy is coming!
Fight properly! You bring shame to our nation!
How nice to meet you. Do you have time for a little chat?
Would you please tell me which colour suits me best?
I am a herder. What do you do?
So, I need dragon scales to protect myself from dragons? Very well.
I should ask the prince's ghost whether I can help him to lift the terrible curse.
I bid you farewell now and wish you happy looting.
I'm glad we talked. I feel ready for new battles now.
Thanks for your opinion. I feel even stronger than before.
My best wishes for your battles. Kill them all and make them suffer!
I have to leave now, but I hope your blades will always be sharp.
I'm feeling much better now. Our little talk has given me new strength.
I must go. My sword arm is itching for new battles.
See you soon, friend. It was a pleasure.
Thank you for your time and kind words. The next battle awaits me.
It was good meeting you, you're an honorable warrior.
I cannot be impressed with these magic tricks!
Here lies Basil - he mentioned the war.
Here lies the parts of Mario we could find - he exploded after eating too many cookies.
I'm not afraid of you, or your nag.
Never pray for justice, because you might get some.
I haven't evolved to the point that I could survive in this area.
So this is Diaanja's refuge. Looks well guarded.
Ohhhh! These pigs ... uhm ... unclean zombies around here!
Further reduces the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.
I have all the ingredients for the wish. Tension's mounting!
Increases run speed as well as attack and defense values with all weapons.
Howdy, stranger! I bet you're a sissy and don't dare to cross the bridge because of all the monsters there! If you make it, my friend will give you 1000 pieces of gold...
A new tombstone for the unknown NPC.
This is not very exciting, but I will do it anyway...
The captain seemed to be surprised by the trader's criminal intrigues. He gave me a letter he wants me to deliver to the general in Thylysium.
You have to be more merciless.
Keep moving. I'm in a bad mood.
Stay for supper. We're having dead chicken, in a feather dressing.
That's asking too much from me. I'd better go and kill some more orcs.
Worry not, I never regret my decisions.
I've been working for days in this seam.
It's going to be tedious. Tomorrow I'm supposed to work on the new cross-cut.
I'm mining for ore, and my bones ache to the core.
I think the next time I see the light of day, it will burn my eyes!
Sometimes these pits are a little creepy.
And what now? Have the Gods lost interest in this game? Or the player his true faith? Hey, player, do you have to be purified? You do risk your soul's salvation!

Find out what has happened to the lost caravan.

I've been waiting for days. The caravan should have arrived a week ago. Darn! I need that shipment. Maybe I should send someone to look for it. How about you? Would you search for the caravan?
Alright, I am not going be successful with fire, but I still have other tricks up my sleeve.
Oh! You've returned alive and well? Uhm ... did you find the rings? Excellent! Good quality. This one is a bit scratched but that doesn't matter. It's second hand after all. Here is your reward.
Get started, my humble community needs more disciples.
Master Merryl might be a very busy man, but at the same time he is very generous. Even if I don't intend to use this item, it will still fetch a good price.
I have a nice house for rent, right next to the senate. Would make a nice secondary residence for a senator.
You still got a chance to run, poser.
Death is but another part of life ...
Ye Gods, why... do you put me through harsh trials...?
An army scout told me that a massive Ogre is living in a large cave not far from here. Maybe I should look for him.
Stay right were you are, I need a new pair of boots!
I must be careful. The enemies look tough.
Well, okay. The more swords the better.

Keeper of the Shrine
No sword bites so fiercely as an evil tongue.

- Sidney

This is a tragedy! I'm supposed to prepare a large banquet and today my supply of scorpion meat for the scorpion ragout ran out! Scorpion ragout without scorpion meat! Unthinkable!
I am a master chef and my reputation is at stake! I use only the best ingredients and the best meat for my ragout. And you can only, and I mean ONLY, get the BEST meat from particularly strong specimens of the species Scorpio desertis! Get me scorpion meat!
The gardener has asked me to fetch a bunch of roses from Ogril, as his roses don't grow fast enough.

Memorial
If I were you, I'd rather be me.
Without Kybele the world is doomed.
You are absolutely right! That must not happen, we have to do something!
I won't put on something like this.
I informed the seraphim that the works on the maps have begun.
You are nothing but a traitorous shrew!
Being a High Elf, I can do nothing but feel ashamed of you!
Magician, you are a disappointment to our entire race!
Regret what you have done, magician! Maybe I'll spare your life then!
I searched the commander's house and found some incriminating scrolls in the process.
The senile old fool is dead. I am free at last!
This city is in need of my moral integrity, and my guiding hand!
The empire needs a lot more heroes like you!

Bring me back my lost map!

Oh man! That would have been the discovery. Mounts, really dangerous mounts. Bred by a mystic order on Mount Island. That's where you can find them. Where did I leave that blasted map? It must be around here somewhere...

I'll tell you something, I don't even want that map anymore. Go and look for it if you like. I'll show you how to read it.
You're not afraid of the dead, I can see it in your eyes. You're already dead! No matter, dead or alive I'm going to crush you!
How nice! A lonely Ogre. I appreciate any smart conversation.
Do you mock me, little one?
Ah, how could I? I really admire your race. Two of my best friends were Ogres.
Really? How come they are not your friends anymore?
They chose to become Goblins. I wasn't able to talk them out of it.
How is that possible? Your tiny shacks are much too small for them!
I knew it from the start: You are a very clever member of your race!
I think you are only mocking me. I'd better go before I get mad.
I'll stay calm. I'm not going to get upset. I don't mind waiting around here like a total idiot. I DON'T CARE! IT'S JUST A GAME!... Ooops!

A *cough* a living being? Here?
Are you sure! No sooner is undead riff-raff walking about here than *cough* this neighborhood becomes interesting for the fine gentlemen up there. It could affect their safety, right? *cough*
The undead creep out of this cellar entrance at night. *cough* It's actually been sealed, but they've somehow managed to do it anyway. *cough*
Once they get into the sewer system, *cough* then it's good night Thylysium.
They leave me alone. Probably because I look like one of them already. *cough* Who knows? Maybe I'll be the only survivor in this city soon! Haha*cough*haha!
I think we can call this a victory for me.
Since I'm already talking nonsense hear this:
I don't think you're interested in this, but I'd like to talk about it nevertheless.
Actually I don't give a damn about your opinion, but there's one other thing I'd like to talk about.
I'm already wasting my time, so we can also discuss this matter.
Actually it doesn't matter but perhaps you're still interested in this?
Ah what rubbish! What do you think about it?
Then I'm going to dig out another useless subject for you.
You seem to like a little chat. There's something else I have for you!
You don't have to ask, I'm telling you this willingly!
There's another thing that should be quite boring for you:

Take Munx's head to the seraphim!

The seraphim found our tracks? That's bad. We should have been more careful. But I have an idea how to solve this problem.

At the foot of the mountains to the west, one of our tribe, good old Munx, died during our last hunting trips. A big wild sow killed him! Take his head and bring it to Seraphim Emiliane as a trophy and a proof that you killed the kobolds. Tell her that you hunted down and killed a single wandering kobold. We will cover our tracks better in the future.
Oh, and when you are at the spot where Munx was killed, look around closely. I left a small treasure chest when ... uhm ... when we had to retreat from the wild sow. It is yours!
My mother says that I shouldn't talk to strangers.
Do you have time to play with me?
My parents are always telling me "noblesse oblige" - can you explain it to me?
Aren't you afraid just to walk around here?
You remind me of myself... when I was younger.
The Orc hunter was impressed by my deed. I am now officially allowed to carry the title of "Orc Hunter." Something like that probably looks good on a resume.
Dear Gods - this is an action game and I'm an action game character. The emphasis is on action and action means action. Do something player! Wake up, hellloooo!

Keeper of the Shrine
What is food to one, is to others bitter poison.

- Lucretius

Gather some mistletoe!

It's not just herbs that I have run out of - I haven't got any mistletoe either! It grows in a clearing in the woods. Fetch some and I'll see what I can do for you!

Greetings!

Stay away from the jetty. Our plague victims lie there - you could catch the Black Fever if you go too close.
Garlic? Holy water? Silver balls? Ah well, I'll just try with the good old force of arms!
The seraphim wants me to win a hunting contest. First, I have to kill wolves. She told me to hurry because I don't have much time.
This village mob is insulting my intelligence...
I would like to sneak off and take a nap, but the corn has ears and the potatoes have eyes.
Even my ancestors were cabbage and grain farmers.
My field is well tilled. My ancestors would be proud of me.
We are the eight hundred and thirty fourth generation of farmers.
Everything is growing so fast this year, that it almost makes me dizzy.
Decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Celestial Magic and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.

I've met Badaruck at an old statue. He's an Ogre and has asked me for 25 Troll hearts. He wants to sacrifice them at this statue in honor of Wantanor. Apparently he was a famous Ogre warrior and Troll slayer. Badaruck has promised a generous reward so why not?
I'll do you a favor, you do me a favor...
T-Energy... It gives life and it destroys life.

A bet? I did all this because of a BET? This fellow and his brothers are lucky that I really am patient! Otherwise I’d clobber them right now good and proper! At least Fiandral thought that this bet was worth a reward, it was even substantial.
That must be the manor. The place is really crawling with monsters. I will go and search for the souvenirs.
I am not a storage facility, you know.
Your Light/Shadow alignment does not match that of the server.
Do you know how much the soldiers earn?
Take care! The negotiations have failed - the war will presumably go on.
Some good advice: Don't interfere with the aristocracy and the Priests; you're better off that way.
We guards and soldiers have to suffer from all kinds of politics.
I have to inform you about the regulations for traveling the streets, which have been updated in the new seventy-seventh version.
The village's tax levy has been stolen! The principal has implored me to find the thieves and return the tax money to Senator Gracchus in Thylysium.
You mean to scare us, stupid brat? That's ridiculous. We'll be back in a few months and take over the council! The Temple will do away with that rabble!

Kuan

Kuan is the God of War. He protects the soldiers and grants them the determination necessary to persist in battle.



Grants: Kuan's Breath

All creatures on the battlefield feel Kuan's Breath. Their recklessness causes them to kill everything in their path. Friend or foe, there will be no distinction - they all will be annihilated.
Hello? What's this supposed to be?
Well, that doesn't suit me at all ...
Thank you! I think I am speaking for the entire village when I say thank you so very much!
I really don't have time for this.

I found Blackhammer. He told me that they know secret passages which they use to smuggle people out of the Dragon territory. Unfortunately, the path to the next outpost is blocked by a Dragon. I’ve been asked to kill the Dragon to clear the way. Maybe I can get another scale.
Thanks! You brought me back home. Now I have to wait for my mommy. She'll be here any minute. So long!
You... have earned... take... my place.

Drive the Kobolds from the canyon!

Greetings!
I’m sure you’ve noticed that the canyon is infested with Kobolds. More and more of those horrible little beasts turn up here every day. Even the Priestesses of the Seraphim can't stroll through their gardens untroubled.

If you visit the gardens then please kill as many Kobolds as possible on your way. Report to the sentry at the garden entrance when you arrive.
Look what has become of me!
Did you go and see my brother?
Barricade - Increases the length of the barrier
Vengeance - Chance to reflect ranged damage
Barricade - Increases the length of the barrier
Solid - The barrier has a higher duration
Vengeance - Chance to reflect ranged damage
Runes - Chance to reflect magic damage
Give me a challenge! This area is getting boring.
Dead! All my pigs are dead! I am finished. I will have to sell my farm. Don't destroy anything that might still be of use...
Some fighters have earned their fame and glory, don't you agree?
Did you hear about the glorious victory in the last battle?
It's war. Will you take part in it?
You wouldn't refuse to take part in a fight to gain honor, would you?
How can you bear the endless fighting and killing?
Let's see what the little angel carries in her bag ...
Would you like to see my collection of butterflies, Seraphim?
Honorable? You must be joking! I bet you're as sly as they come!
What's a Seraphim doing here? You're bad for business!
Ever seen a real man, assistant angel?

Jens Eischeid
It could be worse, it will be worse!

Life isn't easy as a computer game hero. You're always directed, and you have pretty much no opportunity for self-expression. And if something comes up - phone call or taking the trash out - Poof! You find yourself on the sideline. Forgotten, abandoned,... *sigh*
It's time for you to do something, player! Even a Temple Guardian cannot win a mission by simply standing around!

You're back! Well? What news do you have for me?
Ah then Timotan and his wife are doing well, I'm glad to hear that. I was really worried about them. Oh a letter for me? Let me see...

I arrived at the place where “the magic flows from the earth”. An Orc told me to enter the fighting area and prove my skills by killing the Earth Elementals. Maybe they will accept me when I am successful.

In honor of Sophia, the Seraphom

You look resourceful, willing and able to help out a poor old dragon for a price. I`ve lost a clawful of Humans. They broke the locks to the pantry gates, knocked out the overseers and vanished. I want you to get them. No need to return them, do anything you want to them, as long as it's painful and fatal. To tell the truth, I'm done with Human flesh, and I advise you to follow my example. The young ones are too skinny and the older they get, the more they taste like fried jellyfish. Nothing wrong with fried jellyfish mind you, but at least jellyfish don't have bones. I'm expecting a delivery of fresh Lizardmen soon and I can't wait to try the new creations of my overseer chef. Hm.... Lizardman tongues in vinegar sauce... sounds delightful, don't you agree?
Not bad ... not bad at all.
I don't have room for that.

Mistress, your gracefulness and elegance are unsurpassed on this fine morning.
Don't sweet-talk me. I'm not in the mood.
I would love to lay down my heart at your feet.

Then I will go right now, and bring back the biggest boar you've ever seen.
If you insist. Strange what some men are willing to do to satisfy their need for reproduction.
Nothing. What are you waiting for? Get us dinner!
From back here, the interface looks strange. The back of it isn't textured!
You warriors don't attend the commemoration ceremonies as often as before! What's wrong, is your faith weakening?
Why aren't you attending the ceremonies of the ancestors as often as before? That's not a good sign of unwavering faith!
I'd like to see more warriors at the commemoration ceremonies. You make yourselves scarce, and I don't like that.
Why do you attend the forefather’s commemoration so rarely? It's important for your morale!
The ancestors don't like it that you honor them less and less! Even the fighters have to show some piety.
How is it that I see less and less of you at the commemorations? Isn't your faith strong enough anymore?
I wonder why only a few of you worship the honor of the ancestors. What's the reason for this lack of devotion?
I'd wish that your fighters would come to the commemoration ceremonies more often. It can't go on like this.
Are you warriors renouncing your faith? So few weapon wielders are attending the ceremonies of the ancestors.
Why are you repeatedly avoiding the ceremonies for the ancestors? That won't bring you any luck in battle!
I cannot wait - I haven't killed anyone for a while.
I showed up just in time to put an end to this terrible act of Human trafficking. The mine owner's henchmen and those Elves won't be oppressing anyone again.

Help me obtain the candy that the merchant owes me.

Find out the project's progress, how long it will take until completion, etc. Return to me with a report and I shall reward you handsomely.

May the Maker be with you.

Once I was a soldier. I proved myself in many battles. I never failed and I never avoided a fight. My enemies feared me and I was respected long after I was gone. But I was betrayed. An unnatural force robbed me of my final dues, the peace I had earned and brought my body back into this world.

This is how I was damned to continue my existence as a creature of the shadows. And so I set out on my way in faith and honor hoping that one day my path might lead me to eternal peace..
Nityahel was very pleased, and once again gave me a generous reward. It's unfortunate that he doesn't have any more assignments for me.
I will free you from your sad existence.
Dragon tongue fetches top prices in the big Elven cities. Did you know that?
I'm about to knock these mean tricks out of you. And that's so unmagical.

Very impressive! And the color scheme was perfect! Run along now! Back to the Grand Inquisitor. Tell him I gave you a gold star - just don’t tell him where!
They say you're a bad one!
There's no honor in your body. And soon, there won't be any body left at all!
Soon, I'll eat your black heart!
Let's not waste any time. Attack them!
It seems as though my husband does not think too highly of my cooking skills lately. Could you give me some advice?
Ah, I have just the thing! Stewed wild boar tripe will definitely please his palate.
Oh yes, that sounds downright delicious!
Give the boar fine wine for about a month, instead of plain water. That will make the intestines taste exquisite.
The slaves should catch a boar! That will be a feast my husband will be ecstatic about. How can I thank you?
Oh thanks are not necessary, I like to help those in need.
I wish you a pleasant day, my worthy friend.
I hope that you have a pleasant time preparing it, and that it turns out well.

What do you want? If it wasn't for me you wouldn't be here! You are my creation, Shadow Warrior. Whether you like it or not!
You can get that idea about recovering the three Ritual artifacts out of your maggot infested head too! I don't have the pyramid any more. The Orcs stole it and now they're probably going to flood the whole world with undead Orcs. But that doesn't bother me, and you won't bother me anymore either... HAHAHAHA!
You’re wasting time. Those Orcs aren’t getting any more peaceful. Hurry!
The ferryman’s wife has sent me to the woods to gather some herbs.
The inventory of your hero is full. The item could not be transferred.
I should fetch the magician. Apparently he knows something about these strange machines. I wonder if he learned that at the academy. A lecture on the subject of "Strange Machines" or something?
Talk to Squire Tallin. He's the only person who can help you.
Well, what's this? Now that's cute!
I thank the Gods for this new chance.
The evil mage won't listen to reason. I guess, I will have to get rid of him.

Hurry, hurry, the party is going to start soon. How am I supposed to create my ragout without the right ingredients?

Hurry up! The first guests will be arriving soon and the meat isn't even on the stove yet!

It's true ... smaller towns don't have their own treasury. That's why several villages and small towns have joined forces. Regions that don't have treasuries to pay off bounty hunters are being overrun by criminals. I'm glad that we have one. Here's your reward.

No, I haven't. When I'm wearing this uniform, it doesn't matter if I'm male or female.

Sometimes I wonder if I should try going on guard duty.

The surveyor does not know about my fellow believers. I even got some gold for my troubles.

Kobold go and power machine.
Kobold can do what he is here for.
Do you know who you are talking to?
Well done. We knew that someone was eavesdropping on our conversations. Don’t worry about the corpse, the Kobolds that plague this canyon will soon take care of it. We offer you this modest reward!
Those were no ordinary wolves, I also had to slay the shepherd. I should tell Mahtan about this.
Thank you very much for your help! Now I can conjure up an Air Elemental to protect our village!
Me happy joy too. Almost smile so happy, even now in bad times working for nasty, mean Orcs.
Hate Orcs - hate all Orcs! Worse than enemies. All push, yell and orders! Nasty Orcs.
Me good, fine fine. See much blood and death. Destroy many enemies. Feel good in battle!
You good too? Big joy when meet friend here, and meet Ogre from great family.
Me just want go home. Orcs nasty, loud and always want battle.
Lots of battle, lots of screaming Orcs. They not treat us good, think us dumb!
Orcs want Ogres always obey and stay dumb! But Orcs knowing nothing about Ogres.
Me joy that brother alive and looks so strong, mighty. That good.
Also big joy seeing brother Ogre safe and strong.
Good Ogre! Joy to see you and hope that Orcs not be mean to us!
All enemies are grey around here. And not just at night.
Go or else my horses will be admired as salami at some bazaar soon!
I am very satisfied with your achievement. However, I have no further assignments for you at this time.
This looks like a tavern. I should speak with the innkeeper. Perhaps he knows something.

Bring me jungle cat kidneys for my fighting Monitor Lizard!

Well? What do you think of Shiro? A fine specimen, wouldn't you say? He is the strongest and most beautiful animal on the entire island. He also has the worst breath, which is fitting for a fighting Monitor Lizard! This is because I only feed him the best available meat! Smell... no? Suit yourself.
But while you're here could you do me, or Shiro rather, a favor? I need fresh jungle cat kidneys. That's Shiro's favorite food! He'll even fetch a stick for a good jungle cat kidney! Would you get me five kidneys?
Everyone around here is converted by now, I should move on.
Come closer and let yourself be converted!
You have opted to begin the 'Shadow Campaign' with this character.
My songs are about brave warriors, wild battles and sometimes love is mentioned.
From now on, I will call my new style "heavy metal".
I can be so wonderfully immoral in my profession!
I wrote a murderously good ballad.
The basket with the fruit is at the back of the house. I have to take it to the fruit seller.
I don't know what to do with that.
The task sounds interesting. I accept.
You think you're a smart trickster, don't you!
Grandfather would turn over in his grave.
Get out of my way or I will scatter your bones everywhere.

Oh a Dryad! All the Dryads I've met so far were outcast. I'm sure you are too, aren't you? Well I have a task for you. It's about... what did you say? NO? You do not want to work for me?
Ah I see. You're one of those Dryads who put nature above everything else. Well my business puts food on the tables of thousands of Elves! That's much more important than a few trees and deer!
Guards! Throw her out!
Hey, you! If you intend to dig here you can forget that right away! We were here first, this is our excavation site!
The opponents in this region are definitely too weak. I don't want to stay here.

Don't worry, the scroll will arrive safely.

Don't take this the wrong way, but the uniforms around here used to look a lot more magnificent!
What I'd like to know is if you really believe your dusty uniforms command the respect of anyone?
If your sword thrusts are as inaccurate as the size of your uniforms, then something isn't right.
Back in the days, you warriors wore shiny armor. Today, you look like street-robbers!
Where did you get this uniform in the first place? Did you steal it from a sleeping Orc?
You can say what you like against the Elves, but at least they wear modern uniforms.
Don't get upset when I say that your uniform seems a bit old-fashioned and used!
When I think about the proud guard of former days! That almost makes me cry.
How can you walk around in such shabby tunics? That doesn't make a good impression.
Even the army is impoverished! Are you wearing your younger brother's uniform?
Malte who? Oh the merchant! He's worried about me? That's very kind of him. I could indeed do with some help.
I'm beginning to understand why they didn't walk all this way themselves.

Nionake's ghost appeared to me and revealed two more wishes. She wants me to get a sapling of a silverleaf tree and plant it where I scattered her ashes. She also wants me to decorate her final resting place with a crystal boar's tusk.
The leader of the Dark Fairies told me that they hid the beard in a cave. It is being guard there. I can hardly wait.
Halt! You're not one of the smugglers. Girls, protect Zatina!
Get out of my way, soldier, or you will regret i.
Off with you, to your magician tower!
One dead monster, as requested. You say it, I slay it. Now let’s see how the clanleader reacts to the good news.
Just as I thought. The chicken farm is actually a zombie farm. The remains of failed resurrections are collected here.
I think that's the area I was looking for.
Good or evil... You will not get past me.
Preliminary analysis of the fight: The righteous hero will be victorious!
Preliminary analysis of the opponent: Big mouth and an ample supply of healing potions!
I do not care what your goals is ... I'm pursuing mine!
An old sailor has asked me to find a buried medallion. Apparently Dryads are also interested in it.
So this is how you look after 10 years under ground.
Ha! Old witch gone! No more thread rush, she said. Fetch thread rush, she said. Look for thread rush. Stupid hag, stupid! Gone for three days now! Left me to starve!
I wonder how much this old book is worth.
Do penance and live piously, I tell you!
Guide souls? As if I would care about other people's souls...
There are worse jobs than being a Priestess...
No! My Temple was broken into!
I am a good listener, and many come see me to complain about their problems.
I pray the entire day, morning, noon and night
In hard times, the Temples should actually be fuller.
Divinity is in all of us. Well, in most of us anyway.
It's time for me to bid you farewell!
Why can't our Goddess ban the horrible Blood Dryads from the forests?
The Blood Dryads! I'm terrified of them. My faith can't even help me sometimes, can you understand why?
Where do these terrible Blood Dryads come from? And why can't we manage to defeat them?
It can't possibly be Kybele's will that creatures as horrible as the Blood Dryads walk among us!
How can our wise Goddess allow the Blood Dryads to walk around in her gardens?
I ask myself how we can defeat these blood-thirsty creatures, the ones that everyone calls the Blood Dryads.
I believe my greatest fear is the Blood Dryads! They don't seem to obey the warriors or the Goddess!
Since these horrible Blood Dryads are among us, I hardly dare to walk through the forest anymore!
Don't you think it will take more than just your prayers to destroy the Blood Dryads?
When will you finally have some prayers that will be effective against the terrible Blood Dryads? They are a menace!

Further decreases the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.
Riders always make a welcome addition to the killing statistics
We'll continue practising to aim, alright?
Good work! On behalf of the Inquisitors, I thank you!
Turn about... he's stronger than us!
Let him sail, he's too strong.
A storm is coming. I feel it in my peg leg.
They are already waiting for you, in the hereafter!

Defend Lady Eldredar’s honor!

I am frantic! My honor was besmirched, trampled on and sullied. A young good-for-nothing is saying the most disgusting things about me, and the rumors are spreading like wild fire. The only way to restore my honor would be to challenge him to a duel. I’m not a fighter, and that is why I am looking for a champion.

Would you care to be my champion?

Stone Guardian
Santa's helpers are subordinate clauses.
That's right, run, you pathetic mortal!
It's no wonder that my face is getting wrinkled, with this sour wine.
I would like to marry a prosperous man, then poverty and this work would find an end.
I should steal from my customers, then this poverty would be behind me quicker.
The men don't want what I want. We need an aphra...aphri... A love potion!

Varnar really let Shirka go. What am I supposed to do with her? Ah, I have an idea. She is supposed to learn a respectable trade, so she'll join the Inquisitor guards. Let's go to the recruiting place!
Take the worms to my brother! He’ll be waiting already.
All right, I'll see to it.
What, it's over already? It just started!

Wait, I'll go get my can opener!
I have to go! I hope you were able to learn something from me.

Kuan is calling, and I've got no time for you anymore.
I've talked enough. Until we meet again!
It's time to end our conversation. I have to go.
Before we start gossiping I'd better go.
The conversation was interesting, but mediocre! Farewell!
I can't chatter any longer! Kuan's calling me and he's getting impatient.
In Kuan's name! A bloody life, and see you soon!
I have to go now. I don't have anything more to say anyway!

You want to kill me, puny mortal? This is the place where the ritual once took place. No one could have performed it but me. NO ONE!
It worked brilliantly! They're all dead, and I will guard and preserve the site of my triumph until the end of time! You won't defeat me!
Go on! Bring my doggie back or I will scream as loud as I can.

I went to the Dryad island and found an Elven settlement. The priestess told me that the Elves are tolerated on the island because they are repelling the repeated invasions from the Wastelands with their ships. She also said that the Queen’s decision is not really popular among the Dryads. Many of them think that the Elves are destroying the island by farming, mining and cutting down the trees.
I have been away from the island for too long, so according to our laws I'm now considered a foreigner until I regain the trust of my family. The priestess gave me a task to prove my loyalty. I must shut down the strip mine west of here, because it's polluting the air by constantly belching clouds of smoke into the sky.
My offspring are driving me nuts. All they can think about is horseplay.
Occupy them with hunting games. That will sharpen their instincts.
Aren't they a bit young for that?
Nonsense. All the great hunters started young.
Like you? Your success rate isn't exactly impressive.
You're right, but that's because of my parents. They insisted on teaching me how to read and write, instead of honing my hunting skills.
Well, maybe I should teach them soon.
Yes, you should. They'll thank you for it one day, and for now it will help you stay sane.

There are player's chests available in some cities and villages. You can access them via any player's chest in other places.
Reading a rune will upgrade the respective combat art but it will also increase that combat art's cooldown.
Each weapon has a gray socket for damage modifiers. Use them to convert part of the physical weapon damage to fire, frost, poison or magic damage.

In order to activate relics necessary for protection against fire, frost, poison and magic, put them in the “orb” to the bottom left. You can prepare up to 4 sets of relics, but only the one at the top will be active.
You can unlock combat arts by reading runes. Place them in one of the slots next to the bottom right next to the compass in order to have them at the ready immediately.
The quest log also lists the special achievements of all your characters.
Each combat art aspect has two skills. “Lore” increases the damage and the speed of all the aspect's combat arts, “Focus” reduces the cooldown and increases the maximum level.
Use the world map to jump to discovered teleporters and to your currently active soul stone.
You will find runes in the course of the game. You can read runes for your character class by righ-clicking them in order to enhance your combat arts.
Any hero reaching the jungle region and accepting a quest there.
It's a fine day to die, don't you think?
What are you missing? Nagging and crying? No, I really prefer the silence of the peaceful night!
I have the rat's tails. Let's see if the shaman can do something with them.
According to the captain's note we first have to get to the fort in the east, then we go to Scorpion Island where a treasure awaits us.
Lotions made with consecrated waters are especially effective.
Only the powers of the Gods are mightier than my magic.
Thanks to the powers of the ginseng root, I am blessed with a long life.
Light Water taken from the depths of a volcano - such a marvellous elixir with a myriad of uses.
Mullein blossom has to be collected at the summer solstice.
Garlic? It protects the noble, but makes one ever so lonely.
I can concoct an elixir in minutes - speed is not a question of magic!
A spider-silk cape will ward off evil forces.
The old rites were much better than today's.
I can't fight magic-resistant armor with this weapon.
Thank you so much! These villains will not scam anyone else ever again... Knock on wood!

May Kybele's blessing be with you.

Convert five unbelievers - teach them to respect Kybele again.

Nowadays most people do not adhere to the faith as strongly as we do. There were five less townsfolk at today’s mass. I beg you, go to them and convince them to renew their faith in Kybele.
The Orc is dead. His wounds must have weakened him too much.

Destroy five spirits and trap their energy in the mana jar!

Well, here it is. A ... ugh, mana jar, or something. It still needs to be charged. And tested ... by you because I have a spirit phobia. So you'll take it to the cemetery and catch a few spirits with it. This will trap their essence inside the jar and their signatures ... ugh, their energies ... this is way too complicated for you. Just catch a few ghosts, at least fifty ... no, wait... five ...

Bring glory back to the Royal Atherton family!

Ho, warrior! These are grave times indeed. The very breath of Ancaria becomes more ragged with every twist of fate. Such a perilous time demands our attention. From one warrior to another, I bequest you locate the Lost Lorebook of Atherton, and to deliver its message to a trusted Chronicler. He will know what to do. Now go, and carve your own place alongside the Atherton family in the midst of Ancarian myth. May the Atherton spirits be with you.
Phew, it stinks down here! At least I killed enough Kobolds! Now I need to get out of here! By the Gods, this stench is unbearable!
I've delivered the ragged group of prospective Gladiators to the arena, now I can collect my well-deserved reward.

The zombie is not just forgetful - he's also completely nuts. He wants me to mix his brain in with the ingredients because he can't remember the formula for the spell any more. Oh dear, this is going to be disgusting...
Do you want to help us? You're very welcome of course.
Inquisitor, this is your final destination!
You have nothing to hold against my magic, Inquisitor!
Save Akebono today, tomorrow make rain. Or something...
High Elves are a race of orators and intriguers. Now an Elf is going up against me in the arena. Let's see what he's got.
I'm sure you're busy with important research again, aren't you?
Yes, you could say so. I'm working on a new insect powder which is supposed to erase the entire pest in one go.
That sounds pretty dangerous. Are you sure that it won't harm any other creatures?
Are you worried that I haven't tested that aspect of it enough?
How did you do that, if you don't mind my asking?
I had a couple of Orcs captured, and did some experiments on them.
That's cruel! Did they come through?
At first, barely. Since then though, the losses have been reduced to a tolerable level. I must get back to my research now.
I've defeated the strange creature. The village is safe again. I can wake up. Go ahead! Wake up... hello...
Don't wait for a miracle to happen. This is all because of those damn Elves!
If you ask me inept leaders only make it worse. The country is in a state of decay.
I'd love to leave this damn country, but where could we go?
I haven't given up hope, but my sense of humor has suffered  tremendously.
Yes, you are expressing a sad truth. Thin root soup instead of wild boar. That's the reality.
Take comfort in the fact that things would be even worse if we had parties and a parliament.
This situation is unbelievable! If you ask me the Gods are laughing at us.
That's a tough task indeed. I can't even afford a new cart.
Look on the bright side, at least we have part of our health left.
If we had social insurance it certainly would've collapsed by now.
You're fighting against a Human here!
Do you want to fight a duel?
Now it's getting serious for you!
So this is where it ends!
The Gods are on my side!
I was top of the cadet academy!
Now be on your way, stranger.
Hey, I think you have sand in your shoe!

The villagers told me more about the battle. Obviously, the armies of the two mages have been fighting for centuries. If that's the case, they are pretty persistent.
The archaeologist was here as well. He wanted to do some research in the center of the battle. The zombies don't believe he's still alive. I will try to find him anyway. I don't have a choice.
Take care and thanks for your help, worthy Dragon creature.
Just as scummy as the Elves!
You have the crystals? Oh yes, I see. Very good. Here's something for your trouble. Now please let me work.
I might be a bit too weak for the monsters of this region.
I have completed the task. Lawaon will take care of the rest.

Look for the missing milestone!

It was your assignment to count the milestones? Well how many are there?
Hmm... That’s strange because my documents say there should be one more, it looks like one of them is missing. Please go back and try to find the missing stone!
You should have left this world.
Good day to you! May your scales always shine as brilliantly as they do today.
You? I haven't seen you for a while.
I recognize friends from the way they walk. Good to see you.
What a coincidence! And look at your snout!
How are you? Look how my eyes shine!
You? How lovely. I could bite your neck, I'm so glad to see you.
Finally we meet again. It's been too many moons.
I'm glad that you are in good health.
You're looking wonderful. Well fed and full of vigor.
Ancestors! It's good to see you again.
I knew it! That villain! I didn't kill him... and now he's going to talk!
Hey, shall I set you up with that pink fluffy bunny?  Then you kids can share a battery at the drugstore!
I will support you - with magic!
So you are the one leading this crowd!
You Inquisitors seem to think you can get away with anything.
You have no power here, Inquisitor.
Elves - you just don't know your limits.
You're even worse than the rest of the Elves.
Thank you for your help, I felt very safe in your presence! This is for your efforts.
An impressive speech, even if I have a different view.

A Revolutionary Idea

-But what's it good for?
-Good for, good for. Why does everything always have to be good for something? Besides: have you never asked yourself how that would be?
-Hmm .. don't know. Maybe sometimes. But never for long. I guess ... you can't turn a blind eye on reality.
-That's not what this is about. And anyway...
Poldina, the beautiful waitress put two full tankards on the table between Milan and Golros and put the empty ones on her tray without saying a word. Ignoring them, she turned on her heel and went over to the bar.
 -... and anyway: look at us! I. Dropped out of the Mages' Academy, got two illegitimate kids to pay for. Now I am earning my living with the writing of short manifestos and speeches for the high-and-mighty council members whose brains are too small or too lazy to produce a thought worthy of the paper it's written on. And what about you? A small-time crook who can barely survive on what he makes with semi-legal odd jobs. And if you don't hit the jackpot during one of your burglaries and find the damned dragon's treasure in a golden chest soon, nothing will change for you either. That's fact! Is it really so surprising to try and ignore it, even for a little while?
-Nah, 'course not. But you should stay realistic. Let's take my aunt Hannahfee for example ... they nicked her ...
-Nicked her?
-Yeah ... took her. Nicked her. Locked her away. 'Cause she thought she was Seraphim Sophia herself and started preachin' on the market place.
-And they nicked her for that? There's always one preacher or another on the market place.
-She preached to the chickens in the cages and called them “winged sisters”.
-Oh ... I see. But that's something completely different. Your aunt wasn't cognizant. She couldn't help herself. But us ... we are free. What I'm saying is: we're not bonkers!
-Aunt Hannahfee didn't go bonkers! She's just got ... an alternative perception of reality.
-Whatever. The result remains the same. They wanted to nick her either way. The point is: she didn't have a choice! We do. It's like a dream, only you're not sleeping.
-Fine. One imagines one's someone else. What then? And what's so special 'bout it?
-Simply this: You tell the others.
-Huh? The others? Which others?
-Well, the others who also imagine they are someone else.
-I'm tellin' others I'm not the one I am, but I'm someone else? And they tell me the same? Forget it! No way! That'd be embarrassin'.
-How do you know it's embarrassing? You haven't tried it, yet.
-I do know what's embarrassin' and what's not, thank you.
-But if everyone is doing it, it can't be embarrassing anymore, right? And besides ...
The waitress strode past Milan and Golros with a full tray and put it down on the table next to theirs. While she blew a lock of hair from her face, which had loosened from her bun, she put the tankards on the large table. When she turned, she glanced at the two men's tankards. Golros looked at her, and their eyes met for just a moment. He spontaneously and unsuccessfully tried an easy smile when Poldina turned around and disappeared in the direction of the bar. Golros' eyes followed her - his face still frozen in a strained smile.
 -Golros?
-Huh?
-... and besides: it's a lot of fun!
-But why others? If I want to imagine bein' someone else, I don't have to tell others 'bout it! I can do it all for meself.
-That's not the same! If it's all only in your head, everything will happen the way you want it to happen! There are no surprises, nothing unforeseen.
-I thought that was the idea ...
-No! The idea is that different people react in different ways. You won't know what will happen. Everything else would be unrealistic.
-'Bout as unrealistic as imaginin' to be someone else.
Milan sighed but decided not to give up so quickly and try once more.
 -What about when you were young? Did you never play Warriors and Orcs when you were a kid? With wooden swords and all that?
-Sure did!
-See! You weren't embarrassed then, were you?
-Kids are never embarrassed. Kids don't know what embarrassed means. Discoverin' embarrassment happens when you grow up.
-But you had fun whacking the evil orc with your wooden sword as a kid, right?
Golros stared at his tankard in silence.
 -RIGHT?
-Yeah ... sure!
-Well! What would you like to be? What did you want to be when you were a kid?
Golros considered the question for a while.
 -A supermage throwin' lightnin'. With robe and staff. Who fries everythin' in his way!
Milan nodded appreciatively.
- I would like to be a barbarian warrior. You know, one of those with a two-handed double axe who ... BAM ... hacks his enemies in pieces before they know what hit them.
-Not bad! We'd be a good team, the two of us. You at the front, me in the background throwin' lightnin' and fire.
Milan imagined how a lightning-throwing mage and a raging barbarian fought against a legion of orcs.
 -The orcs wouldn't even touch us!
-And afterwards, we could loot 'em. Orcs'll surely have lots of gold, arcane magical artifacts and healin' potions.
-And we would share the loot fairly of course. Just like brothers in arms do!
-Right ... fairly and under consideration of the performance. Two third for me, the rest for you.
-Oh, and why is that? My ax would have killed at least as many orcs as your stupid lightning bolts, if not more!
-Don't be ridiculous! A supermage is a deadly weapon. You can't kill enough orcs to keep up with him.
-You wouldn't stand a chance against me.
-Bah! You'd have a fireball in your face before you could raise your ax!
-Before you’d be done with your mumbo jumbo, your brain halves would only be able to communicate via long distance signal!
Golros and Milan looked at each other in silence.
 -Hm ... looks like imagination alone is not enough. Someone should invent a way to determine the winner of such battles.
-If you think we’re going to the woods now to fight it out ... you with a wooden ax and I throwin' grain sacks ... you're barkin' up the wrong tree. We could go an' join aunt Hannafee right here and now.
-No, no ... nothing like that. Something different. Maybe tossing a coin. Or ... or we could simply toss dice.
-Toss dice! It's really becomin' more ridiculous by the minute. You say we're sittin' around a table, thinkin' we're someone else and if one doesn't like what's what, we're tossing dice to see who's right?!
-Oh well ... all right. I admit, it would be a bit strange. But there must be something we could do. I'll think about it some more.

You want to take on the old guy? Well I don't really care. Mazzagon used to be a competent dungeon master, but now he's gone completely insane. I think it would be better for him AND for us if he was dead. You can't quote me on that, though.

Can't you come up with a new game? This one is always so difficult...

An Orc by the name of Karduk was bragging about being the master hunter of his clan. According to him, hunting boar is the supreme discipline of an Orc's hunting skills. He wants me to bring him the head of a boar pack leader so that I can be accepted into this elite circle of hunters. It's amazing that an Orc can pronounce such a long term without making a mistake.
To get the leader to come, I have to kill as many boars as possible in a short amount of time. That is supposed to attract the leader. It's time for me to get to work!

I wonder if miniature paintings of the Gods would sell well?

Exquisite fabrics are more popular than ever.
Honored customers, I present to you my wares!
Two big, cold snowballs should be enough. Now I have to find some coal.
Forens is the Goddess of Philosophy. Her divine wisdom fills the hero with inspiration and insight and reflects all attacks.
Great! These glands are really big. You're a very good hunter. Thank you, here is your reward.

Defeat Qungar and his henchmen!

The Thraconians have raided a small island off the western shore of Urthak's Bay. Two supply boats that left for the island last night have disappeared. Fishermen have reported seeing a number of Thraconian boats near the island in the last few days. Qungar the Terrible has long sought to bring the island under his control. He seems to have finally succeeded, but there's nothing on the island except for a leper colony!
If only somebody could put a stop to that Qungar! Perhaps you could help us? You look like just the type for this job!
If they scream, you're doing it right!

Forgive me - I just never have enough time. You are also a master in the art of healing, are you not?
I suppose you could say that. Where does it hurt?
Oh, I'm not actually hurt - I just have an itch in rather a strange place... How can I explain?
Aha? You will have to show it to me, otherwise I can't help you.
Now? Here? I can't do that - someone might see us!
Then all I can do for you is pray...
I thank you for that, but will it really help?
No need to get so bent out of shape!

Seek employment with Lord Alcander and expose his secret!

Are you discreet and willing to serve the Gods? Good.

Lord Alcander is our worst critic, and his words carry a lot of weight with his peers. He pretends to be a virtuous man but we think that he is using this facade to hide something. Why else would he keep refusing our modest requests?

Go and offer him your services. Find out what this lord is up to, and tell us about it. You will receive a handsome reward for your services.
Hello there! Great whiff of fresh air today, eh?
Hurry! The longer it takes you, the more children are in danger.

Varmin can be found near Wargfels!

Ok ... ok ... I surrender. You bested me. I will tell you everything you want to know.

We were hired by a guy named Varmin to “remove” the dragon mage and all the information he had on our client's person. When we found out that the dragon mage had his texts deciphered by this sage, we had to visit him as well and get the data crystal. We couldn't kill him. That would have been too dangerous. Luckily, that old guy's memory is pretty much gone, and he can't remember what he read or translated. Well, we did what we were hired for, and we got our reward from Varmin. He disappeared into the human realm afterwards. He's probably somewhere near Wargfels. That's all I know! Let me go! I'm an honest criminal! I swear!

Kill a real Giant Spider!

I need your help! First we have to calm the sisters in the village down. Otherwise they will send out their hunters and I won't be safe anywhere. Please kill a giant spider. Book 5: Guide for a Successful Feast or “How to not poison your guests”

Preparing a banquet can be complex. Nothing can spoil a celebration more than a failed banquet and unsatisfied guests. Hosting a banquet is quite a responsibility and should not be taken lightly. But fret not! In this book, we will guide you through the process and make sure you will be able to avoid any obstacles and possible threats.

Preparation

This is where it all starts. In the first steps of planning, you need to answer a number of questions.
How many people do you intend to serve at the feast? Will the kitchen hall and tables accommodate that number? Can you pre-cook anything? Can you prepare everything that day? Who is going to attend your meal? Are there any cultural or racial limitations for the food? Planning is the key to everything here. Only if you have sufficient answers to all those questions, you can safely continue with your next step. Numerous banquets have been spoiled due to lack of preparation:

“But the page said there is enough wood in the kitchen.Whatever made him say that? ”

“What do you mean by ‘The meat looks a bit strange’?”

“Did we really invite those Orc scu... those people of Orcish origin?”

“Where is my recipe book again?”

All those questions are a sure indication of bad preparation. Avoid that at any cost! Eliminate all those possible threats right from the start. Trust nobody but yourself! If you have a question, find out the answer for yourself. Don't ask anyone. And if you have found out the answers, write them down. Papyrus can't forget.

Make sure there are enough tables, benches and chairs available, as well as enough table cloths to cover the tables. Candles and proper lighting are essential as well (“I can't see the meat!” ).

Planning the Menu

Probably the most important step is deciding which dishes you want to serve. For a large banquet, we recommend no more than four courses. It goes without saying, that you should not try to serve dishes you have never done before. Also, keep in mind, that some ingredients might be seasonal and may not always be available.

The lands of Ancaria have flowed with T-Energy since time immemorial. This mysterious power is the root of all life, the source of all magic, the origin of all thought.

Aeons passed, and the Seraphim continued to watch over the fate of the world while races formed into civilizations. In their wisdom the Seraphim chose to share their knowledge, bestowing magical secrets of the Energy upon the favored High Elves.
Alas, power breeds fear, anger, and jealousy. The perilous energy became the centre of all disputes. Finally a terrible war raged through Ancaria, erasing all order in its wake.
An even more advanced High Elven civilization arose from the ashes of the dead, deriving their power from abusing T-Energy.

Yet the war has left a bitter legacy for all of Ancaria. The beautiful cities and the people are threatened by the T-Energy that has escaped its confines. Hideous, mutated creatures now rampage through the lands, destroying everything in their path.
Ancaria needs fortitude and a strength of will to determine its future.
Will you strive to prevent Ancaria from plunging into chaos, or will you hurl it into the fiery abyss?

Order to Hold Down the Fort

Fresh Fruit and Vegetables! Straight from the fields and not from the greenhouse!

I'll show you what honor means.

Thank you very much. Now we will finally have some peace. That's definitely worth a few coins, take your reward!

So this is the core of the Great Machine. My journey here was long and arduous. Still, it was successful. I will now switch off the machine for good.

Destroy the huge monster!

Run! A huge monster is inside that cave. Run like hell!
Only you could talk that kind of nonsense, shaman! You've obviously never done the slightest bit of housework in your life!

Does Kuan know that he'll be doing my housework in the future? He'll be thrilled about that, I'm sure.

Our clan leader is very worried about the resurrection of the dead in this area. In the west, the chief of the Blood Orcs is trying to gain power over the undead. He had one of the objects for the ritual stolen. We have discovered that it was a small pyramid. If you get a hold of it, get it out of this area!

I will guide you to the pyramid temple of the lost city, let's go!

Do you want to try and reach the site? I can show you the way. Maybe you can even kill the guardian, then I... uh, we could find all the secrets it holds! That path over there leads right to the pyramid.
You won't take anyone from our clan, we would rather all die!
That's nothing special. I prefer my personal mount...

They are as good as dead.
I have to admit, you definitely are consistent.
It will be. You can count on it.
It will be with me, and inside of them.
I have to say one thing: You do know how to dispose of problems once and for all.

Help me to find my way home.

Hullo! Me is lost. Still. Or again? Dunno. me is confused. Yes, me is. Me was out hunting with me friends! And me got lost.
They say if you lost you go straight ahead until you is home. When you come to the end of the world, the hand of God pick you up and put you down on the other side of the disc. What? You not know the world's a disc? Me been walkin' straight for days and this where I be now. Help me, please?

Ah... you're back in time, that is great! Now let's see what the alchemist has to say.

Oh, ominous thing, please move on!
Oh please spare our people, warrioress of darkness!

What, and let them drink and fight the whole day? No way!
You're right, that's a horrible thought. I don't want to think about it.
Go to the island of the Dryads and retrieve the key to unveil the hub!
You want to be a hero? Ha ha ha! Maybe when you grow up!
Don't you have anything better to do than to hang around here?
I would travel at night if I looked like that!
Phew! Everything is ok with the heads.
Thank you ... this ... is, uhm ... really nice.
You want to be a warrior, you runt? Hahaha...
You seem a little feeble. And pretty nervous.
I wouldn't know what to talk about with you.
Vermin like you don't deserve any mercy!

Bring help!

Have you come back to finish us off? Oh... no you're not one of them. We were attacked and the robbers beat us up pretty badly. Open wounds can mean death quickly in this neighborhood. Please help us! Go to Gangith the Healer and bring him here! He lives in Hissil'Ta.
Get lost! You're too skinny for me!

Help the shepherd protect my sheep!

These wolves are going to cause my ruin sooner or later! They already killed fourteen of my sheep and it's costing me a fortune! Please make your way to the river bank behind those trees. My shepherd Gildor is there with my flock. Help him to drive away the wolves.
I've arrived at the camp, but the archaeologist didn't make it. Only the strong survive out here and the Elf wasn't cut out for it.
You won't disfigure nature any more.

To Beguile Aristocrats

Princesses

“Your eyes are like the stars in the night“ or “How to beguile noble women“

Not every man who grows up with pigs and chickens plans to stay there for the rest of his life, and many a farmer's son has stood yearningly in front of a palace or a castle. These places are reserved for the people of Ancaria who became powerful and rich through the labor of others: the aristocrats.

How nice it would be to walk through the marble halls and to eat with golden cutlery. But he only sees the nobles when they gallop past him on their horses, raising dust for him to swallow. Luckily for the young farmer, and for everyone who strives for more than he has, there are some tricks that can help you get to know and to even fall in love with a noble woman.

1. To meet aristocrats

Of course you can’t meet a princess at the wine press as you would Martha, the wine maker’s daughter. They mostly look for quiet and peaceful places where their fathers can hunt and talk about politics while the girls listen to the musicians and cause confusion among their house maidens. The potential suitor has to keep in mind that the thing a young noble woman hates most isn’t the shaking plague or the war but boredom. He must entertain her to win her heart.

In the beginning it’s enough to appear near her a few times while doing an arduous job that she would never see a nobleman doing - like chopping wood or tending the fisher nets. The arduous nature of the work allows you to cool yourself by removing the clothing from the upper part of your body - do it no matter what the weather conditions are! It doesn't hurt to oil your chest and arms too.

Depending on how bored the girl is, it shouldn’t take longer than two encounters until the noble woman addresses the suitor. Many men fear this moment, but don’t worry, the situation isn’t that difficult to handle.

2. How to address a noble woman

First of all you should not greet her - wait until she speaks to you. Your answer should be as short as possible, and it is advisable to refrain from jokes, offensive remarks and too much information about yourself. The less she knows, the more interesting you are to her. As a rule of thumb you can answer every hundred words of hers with ten of your own. This may seem difficult, but you’ll soon notice that your remarks are as unnecessary as they are unwanted. Noble women are used to having the attention and not to listening to other people.

The first and of course secret meetings should take place at a small and secluded location with a romantic atmosphere. A small lake with some trees, or another similar place, to give her the impression that the simple people know secrets she never imagined. But you have to keep her away from the simple people at all costs! Marakus the swineherd may be a good companion, but he shouldn’t get to know your new friend. You should also deny her desire to meet your parents. It’s recommended to say that you were found lying in a small basket as a child, or that you were abandoned and raised by wolves.

3. How to get an invitation

Did you pass the inspection of the first meetings by showing no interest in her way of life? Ignore every reference to her wealth, and then she will think you’re not interested in mundane things and that you’d prefer to live in a simple cottage in the woods. Sooner or later she’ll find it irresistible to introduce her unpolished diamond to her friends (who she’ll see as quite decadent by now). This would be the perfect moment for some compliments! Use them sparingly and refer to natural things - but be wary of mistakes like comparing her eyes to those of Betty the cow.

If you follow this simple advice, the gates of the castle will be open for you in no time, and you’ll never have to spend another night in the mosquito-ridden forest behind the barn.
