The Poisons of Ancaria: Their Use, Effect, and Attributes

Shadow Weed - the most well known poisonous plant in all of Ancaria. It grows in caves, under rocks, and in other dark places. Uncooked the plant has a distinctively bitter taste that even strong spices can't hide. However, when cooked for several hours shadow weed becomes almost tasteless and can be easily added to the victim's meal. Adding hermit weed makes sure that no trace of the telltale taste remains. Shadow weed acts swiftly. It causes insanity, fever, finally death.

Bear Paw - a poisonous plant from the coniferous woodlands of the north. There it grows on tree tops and crutches. The fine hairs that cover its leaves are poisonous. They look like brown fur and can be scraped off with a knife. It can be added to a victim's meal without further preparation. The plant was named not only for its look, but also for the swiftness of its kill which has been compared to being struck down by a bear.

Withermilk Weed - a nasty poison. This white, sweet smelling liquid can be found in the roots of withermilk weed. One should take caution not to touch the liquid as it is absorbed through the skin and slowly poisons the inner organs. Withermilk poisoning is subtle and often only becomes apparent after many months. The weed grows in desert regions, mostly on mountain sides or between rocks. It should be applied to the sole of the foot as it causes a slight discoloration of the skin which usually remains unnoticed there.

Death Root - a herb that grows on decomposing cadavers. Drinking a brew made from the cooked leaves of this herb causes almost instantaneous insanity. It is said that death root sucks the spirit out of the dead and the living. Uncooked death root leaves can also be put in cupboards to keep away moths.
Ghost Mist - skillful administration is needed for this poison as only the fumes that rise when cooking it are poisonous. Great care should therefore be taken in windy regions. Ghost mist causes painful lumps when it comes into contact with the victim's (or the unlucky poisoner's skin). This symptom is often confused with the deadly blain fever which healers tend to exploit for their financial gain. Left untreated the lumps usually disappear after two or three days.

Farmer's Curse - grows on wheat and corn fields. Its blossoms consist of fist sized seed sacks that burst upon touch and cover the victim with poisonous thorns. These thorns cause painful swelling and can be deadly when swallowed. Poisoners avoid the plant because it is so difficult to handle.

Stumble Weed - often found near ponds. The cooked roots cause a severe loss of balance making normal movement impossible. They are mainly used in moonshine to demonstrate the alleged strength of the liquor. The dried leaves can be used as a spice and taste like cinnamon.

Cramming Moss - a poisonous, but also agricultural plant. It grows in barren mountain regions and is used by farmers to fatten cattle as it strengthens the appetite. The moss is dried, then added to the cattle feed in small amounts. Undiluted it is quite an spectacular poison as it forces victims to eat until death. Often used at royal feasts as a deterrent.

Blackfinger - grows in dark places like caves or ruins. In the south it is also known as Two-Step because after consumption death is almost instantaneous. Its black leaves are tasteless and odorless when cooked. They can easily be added to dark sauces. The remaining brew can be used to dye fabrics.

Ker - Goddess of Evil

Ker, Goddess of evil. She is the destroyer, the bringer of darkness.



Mythology

Ker is the synonym for destruction and death. She is the impersonation of evil, the origin of all chaos. She doesn't tolerate any form of order, because order is a form of stability and stability means stagnation. Chaos is the only valid form of existence and darkness is the only answer to the weak.
Ker is fighting an eternal battle against Lumen, the God of light and this battle is the great religious theme in Ancaria. But it's a battle which can not have a winner, for chaos can not exist without order and destruction is impossible without creation. Both deities are eternally bound together, depending on what they hate most. It's their fate to fight their very own counterpart, knowing that annihilating one means destroying the other.
A tenacious theory amongst Ancarian mystics says, that Lumen and Ker are actually brother and sister, who are both trying to fight the other in an attempt to be unique.

Appearance

Ker is described as a woman of unnatural beauty, with red, shimmering hair. But her eyes are so cold and cruel, that just looking into them will drive any living being into insanity. In addition to her human shape, she's got a single horn, protruding from her forehead.
Ker is usually dressed in many layers of cloth, seemingly loosely wrapped around her body.

The Cult

Although Ker has a huge amount of followers behind her, most of her temples are shrines have been erected in more or less secret places. For obvious reasons, Ker is a feared deity amongst those who're not members of her church, and people tend to avoid any contact with the believers of Ker. Therefore, the church of Ker has to operate furtively in most parts of the world.
Ker has quite a number of holy days during the Ancarian year. Most of them are celebrated with bloody, chaotic rituals, which usually include human sacrifices, torture and lots of blood. The exact reasons behind all those feasts are written down in the secret sacred books, the “Codex Ker”. Only the high priests of Ker have access to those books.
The symbol of the church of Ker is a broken chain link, which represents breaking the boundaries of order and the destruction of stability.

Opponents and Supporters

Ker is the arch enemy of Lumen, the god of light. These two are fighting an eternal battle against each other.

Nor Plat

Geography and climate: Nor Plat, land of the Orcs lies in the north of Ancaria. Mountains enclose huge frozen plains that border in the north on the Dragonsea. Looking from the mountains over the land no trees are to be seen, only the dirty brown tundra with patches of grass and moss that cling to the rock fighting against the cold winds. The river Numak runs from north to south through the land. It is frozen most of the year.

Inhabitants: Monsters and creatures roam this harsh, cold land. There are Trolls, Ogres, and Goblins, but the Orcs are the only ones who build settlements and exhibit signs of a “culture”.

Two attributes characterize Orcs: their stupidity and their enthusiasm for battle. These potentially volatile combination is best met with a friendly demeanor and short, easily understood sentences. Not many travelers make their way to Nor Plat, that's why the Orcs always welcome visitors and invite them to their mead halls to listen to stories from foreign lands. Travelers who are asked for such a story should make sure that it deals with war and death and can still be grasped after five or six jars of mead.

There is only one God in Nor Plat: Kuan, the God of war. Almost every Orc prays to him. However, this spiritual unity has not led to a peaceful togetherness. In fact most Orc settlements are at war with their neighbors. The reasons for this are complex clan hierarchies, blood feuds with long forgotten causes, and the Orcish code of honor. Every Orc, from the ice fishers on the Numak to the trappers in the tundra considers himself a warrior. A wrong word spoken under wrong circumstances almost inevitably leads to bloodshed. It is said that the major cause of death among grown male Orcs is a sudden loss of the head.

Places of interest: Orc settlements consist of simple huts and dirt holes with a large mead hall that serves as a gathering place in the center. The Orcs share these one room huts with their cattle. They have no chimneys. Instead a simply but elegantly constructed drain causes the smoke to pass through the roof while simultaneously smoking the meat that hangs from the ceiling of every Orc hut.

Passionate hunters will find many things to their liking in Nor Plat, everyone else should hope for one of the infrequent ice storms that come suddenly over the land and transform it into a landscape of bizarre forms and figures.

Practices: In Entruag, the largest settlement and the only one on the Numak a strange festival called Walrus Wrestling can be witnessed at summer solstice. At sunrise Orcs line the banks of the river and jump into the water as soon as the first ray of the sun touches it. In the water they wrestle walrus bulls thrice their size and try to pull them on dry land. Orcs come from all over the land to be a part of this festival. They are cheered on by Kuan priests. The Orcs believe that Kuan will grant them victory over the Elves should they defeat a walrus. This hasn't happened yet, but the festival still takes place every year.

Recommendations: Haggling is not a part of Orcish culture. Orcs always name the price they expect to fetch for their goods. The traveler who tries to haggle with them should have one foot in the stirrups of his mount.

Book 3

Drinking in Ancaria

Many different beverages can be found (and ordered) in the taverns of Ancaria. Unlike food, the different cultures and races of the world seemed to have influenced each other when it comes to drinks. Except for the Orcs, who have a rather narrow range of drinks (actually it´s just beer or water), all races are sharing and contributing to the variety of beverages. For example, tea was originally invented and consumed by the Dryads, but quickly adopted by other races and now, people all over the world are drinking tea in their homes.
Water is the most natural form of liquid and it is the basic ingredient for most beverages. The only exceptions are fruit juices and wine.


Mead

Mead is a brew based on honey. Quite a number of different flavors of mead are known throughout Ancaria, some of them are seasonal, others are just regional variations. However, they all have one thing in common: the combination of honey and alcohol can have devastating effects on the incautious consumer.

Dryad Lemon Mead

This mead variation originated from the southern parts of the world. The Dryads are said to have invented this special form of mead. The fresh taste is a nice contrast to the rather heavy aroma of the honey.

6 wine quarts water
1/2 ounce whole nutmegs
1 lemon peel
1 quart honey
pulp of 2 or 3 lemons
lemon juice

Time to completion : 1 month

To every quart of honey, add six wine quarts of water, half an ounce of nutmegs, the peel of a lemon and the meat of two of the three. Boil these together. When the scum does not rise any more, remove from fire and leave it to cool down. Squeeze the lemon juice into the brew. The lemon mead will be ready in less than a month.

Cloven Mead

A quite simple but tasty mead. The strong aroma of the cloves and ginger grant this mead a sweet accentuation. Cloven mead is especially popular during the winter season when it is usually served hot.

3 lbs. honey
1 gallon water
1/2 ounce ginger root
cloves
mace blades
agrimony

Time to completion : 2 to 3 months.

Dissolve three pounds of honey in a gallon of water and boil it. As soon as it starts to boil, add half an ounce of ginger, some cloves, mace and a small quantity of agrimony. Leave to boil for an hour and keep it constantly skimmed, as there will be plenty of scum rising from the pot. Strain into another vessel and leave to cool down. Wait until it is creamed over with a black cream and leave it to ripen for two or three months.

Ale

By far the most popular alcoholic beverage in Ancaria is ale. From the noble taverns of Thylysium to the quayside bars of the shanty towns, large quantities of ale are being sold everywhere. Ale is relatively easy to brew and - thus - can be sold at a reasonable price. Of course, similar to mead, there are dozens of flavor variations available and they also vary in strength.

Weak Ale

For 2 1/2 gallons of ale:
4 2/3 lbs. malt
1 1/2 lbs. oats
13 qts. water
1 cup yeast
1/4 ounces light oak chips


Boil the water, then crush the malt and mix it with the oats while they are still dry. Place the tun near the stove. Pour two quarts of water into the tun, then pour all the dry grain into the lauter tun. Slowly pour three more quarts of boiling water over the grain, then put a cover on the tun and leave it for several minutes. Add one more quart of boiling water, then put the lid back on and leave it for another 20 minutes.
Take off the lid and stir it all up. The consistency should be fairly thick. Put the lid back on and leave to cool down for two hours. Open up the tun and stir in three more quarts of boiling water. Stir it, then close up again and wait for half an hour. Finally, add the remaining boiling water and stir well.
Strain out the wort, be very meticulous and make sure that most of the liquid goes out. Close the fermenter and leave the wort to cool over night.
Add the yeast to the wort, shake and stir it. Allow the ale to ferment for a day. The yeast should have become active and the process should be well under way. Boil the oak chips in a cup of water. Remove from the fire as soon as the water is brown and leave it to cool. Pour out some of the water, then boil it again. Add the oak water to the wort and allow the ale to ferment for several days.

We are united in undead worship. We reject the idea of community, hence our refusal of names. By living apart, we live forever. To join a community you must lose your true self. Only as an individual can you fully live a life. We unite only when we must, to battle the efforts of others to put names to our undead forefathers.
To follow our ways, you must to survive an initiation ritual. Go to the top of Skull Rock and return with the hide of the creature that lives there.
Go back to planting lettuce. You're better at that than at fighting.

Who are you, creature, that you managed to come this far? You shouldn't have come. Because nothing can defeat me.
But your courage impresses me. You seem to be mostly immune to my magic. Not like this idiot Mishirla, the silly Diaanja or her sappy husband.
I offer you a place at my side. You could serve me, could be my executioner in this world. I will make this offer only this once.
Make your choice. And be quick about it!
You will not do that again!
You have invited Player "%1" to trade with you.
A brigand camp is located north of here. Several soldiers are being held captive there and they must be freed. The brigands must receive a just punishment.
The winery is located east of here. Don't be shy, just go there...
The dungeon master has gone into retirement, in a manner of speaking. Anyway I have the amulet so now I can take it to the thief.
A statue from the factory Elfstone.
Yes this is a valuable piece. How about this? You can keep it if you'll get me out of the city. I just happen to have a tiny little problem with a stuck-up Elf. Something about her parents... pfff.
What luck! I found a merchant who bought the animals. Of course I didn’t tell him that the horses were stolen.

Bring 25 Troll hearts to the big Ogre statue.

While spending the night here I had a weird dream. Wantanor, the great Ogre warrior and Troll slayer that this statue is dedicated to, appeared to me and asked me to sacrifice 25 Troll hearts. That's where you come in, get the hearts and bring them to me. I will reward you generously. What do you say?
Go ahead! Or are you afraid of a couple of bones?
I have a double hernia and arthritis, but I can still take you on!
Come here so I can bruise a couple of ribs for you!
I like to let my meat age for a while!
Have you ever considered liposuction? It really helped me!
Snazzy outfits won't help you either.
I have to warn you, I used to be a sumo wrestler!
Come on, let's get this over with. I don't have all day!
The village is safe now. That's a good feeling.
We sons of the desert are brave - not suicidal!
We don't have a chance of winning here!
If you value your life, run!
Increases the chance for double hits.
The name of the leader of the bandits is Hattmir. Obviously, he lays claim to the archaeologist's property and findings and tells me to leave the camp. He can forget about that.
The prince's ghost is understandably very cooperative.
The evil ones usually have some money. So let's see it.
Evil heroes! Now that sounds odd.
Go if you value your life.

Collect some herbs for me and take them to a witch!

I'm running a high fever, stranger. If you don't help me, I will die. Please collect some of the herbs that only grow in the mine not far from here and take them to a herb woman in the village. Only she can help me now...

The antiques dealer said that the dubious tomb raider, from whom he bought the second piece, was probably in possession of the last missing fragment. The tomb raider is ransacking the ruins near a small grotto right now.
You’re back and you have the eggs too! Fantastic! I can’t wait to see if my plan works out! Here is your reward, thank you!
There’s another one of those bootlickers! Let’s get him!
I got the bones and the lock of hair. I would've never thought of making an instrument from them.
I'll see you in the afterlife!

I have to take three cows to The Unholy Crusade’s outpost. The cows are carrying a load of obscure ingredients that the alchemists will use to destroy the walls of the fortress in the Central Province.
Just as I thought. The “scientist” is a con man and only wants the merchant's gold. Well that's even better for me. I've made a nice profit.
I hated you while I was alive, and I hate you while I'm dead!
Controller %1 was disconnected. Please reconnect it.
Just one more thing! I've been pondering it for some time now!
The Goddess wishes that I discuss the following as well!
Something else comes to mind that I've been mulling over for a while!
I can't keep this one thing to myself, and I would really like your advice!
One more thing - I can't keep it to myself! Please pardon me!
I don't want to bother you, but something else is troubling me!
I can't help myself, I have to mention this as well.
Before we go our separate ways, I have to get something else off my chest.
I have to mention this too, otherwise Kybele will never forgive me!
Kybele also instructed me to discuss the following with you, we'd better do her that favor!
The horse rears up inflicting area damage with its front hoofs and knocks back opponents.
My dear daughter, I keep hearing unfortunate things about you. Your conduct could hardly be called morally acceptable.
Who's saying stuff like that? I only want to enjoy life, while my scales are still soft.
But that's not what life is all about. You should know better.
So what is the meaning of life in your opinion?
It's about remembering and caring for the souls of the dead.
But they're boring. Have you ever had a fun time with a restless soul?
It's not supposed to be fun. You have to be more humble.
I'll think about it. I have to go meet my date now... I mean, attend a family gathering.
In the name of the Gods! Show the church some respect!
You don't seem exactly thrilled to see me. That might change.
The faithful are my children, no matter how poor they might be.
I'm really glad, whether you are or not.
I bring news of our Gods. You can at least believe that.
Meeting you seems like the work of the Gods.
I'd like to help you find your faith again.
There's no hope without faith, so my pious greetings to you.
I'm here to do the Gods' work, my child.
Believe whatever suits you, but I greet you in the name of the Gods.
You better make your will, cactus-eater!
Attack! I will support you with all my might!
Remember that I need new supplies for my lab.
I don't believe it! You're still in one piece! And you look so wonderfully dangerous! I trust your blade is still as sharp as ever?
Aha! A brother in arms! Now there's a sight to make my black heart leap for joy!
Well, now! Here I was thinking you'd been hacked to pieces in battle! It's great to see you!
It's wonderful to see you alive and well! Good luck with all your thieving and killing!
Ahoy, brother in arms! There's a sight to fill my warrior's heart with joy!
How are you, good brother? You look greener and meaner than ever!
Good to see you again! The more of us, the merrier!
Still alive and well, I see! Someone told me that you'd been slain in battle. I'm glad to see you're still alive and kicking.
Wherever we are, death and victory are never far! You know what I mean, good Goblin brother!
My good green brother with the merciless blade! Now that's what I call good company!
A joyful and bloody day to you, good brother!
Now there's a true warrior! Devious and cruel to the bone! It's enough to make the greenest of Goblins feel right at home!
There's nothing quite like the company of warriors and cutthroats! Welcome, brother in arms!
May the blood of your foes flow like a river! You certainly look dangerous today, good friend.
Now this is the type of fighter I like to meet - you couldn't look more dangerous if you tried!
Come on and fight, orc! Show me what you've got!
Thanks, you can sod off now...anything else? Give you a reward? ‘Fraid that ain’t gonna happen ... What, you’re still here? Alright then, here’s your reward, I was hungry anyway so I’ll eat you fast!
How did I wind up here?
Marakle has his genie now, and he’s happy and content.
I need some fire and brimstone topics for my next sermon. Any ideas?
I need some inspiration, I can't think of anything useful to preach to the faithful.
May I ask the topics of your next sermons? It might be a good idea to compare ours.
I have to think of a new sermon. The old one's getting stale, you know?
Any ideas for a moving sermon? I have to motivate the stupi-- um, the faithful.
I'm working on a sermon about “you all get what you deserve.” Do you have any good ideas for it?
I'm known as a good hatemong-- I mean preacher, but I'm running out of ideas.
I'm trying to work out the perfect sermon that will move everyone, but it's not working. What am I doing wrong?
My sermons are losing their edge. What can I do?
I need a sermon that would even make the Gods shiver. But what topic should I choose?
A ruthless couple meant to kill the children. Let's see if they have something to say.

The Orcs have a type of secret service as well? I always thought they were just wild animals. In any case, this Orc agent told me that the clan chief of an Orc tribe tried to get his hands on the resurrection objects. These artifacts grant the owner control over dead flesh. I should try to put a stop to that.
Damn! My scales take a long time to grow back there!
I'm slowly losing my patience with you!
You won't get a chance to hit me like that again.
I've survived worse injuries than this!
Oh! Not bad for a little toad!
Ahh! I was stabbed in that spot by another dragon slayer!
Eww! I can't stand the sight of blood!!!! - Just kidding...
You know, I could have been killed just then!

Gravestone
Food is an important part of a balanced diet.
Time out! I have sand in my shoes!
Now that's what I call a really giant scorpion...
The fishermen were impressed with how I took care of those little beasts. They gave me a considerable reward.
Why are you Humans always overestimating yourselves?
I will find him. Thank you for your hospitality.

I have arrived on the island where they have the legendary mounts. The Ogre, who seems to be some kind of a horse trader, wants proof of my fighting skills before he'll let me buy one. Alright then, I'll gladly give it to him!

Take the dagger to the guardsman!

I... I know this dagger. It belongs to our neighbor! I don't believe this! Did he really...? Please make sure that justice is done. Take this dagger to the guardsman at the port and tell him about the incident. It will not bring my husband back but at least the murderer will not get away with it!
The lady was very happy to get the letter back. It must be nice to be so in love!
Well done! That's exactly what we need for this ritual.

Gather 3 rat tails, 1 branch of the Death Tree, 2 vials of blood from the Raargon.

Help! Please! Help me! I've just excavated something in the cave over there. I think it is spores. I once read something about spores in this area. Extremely dangerous they are! Not much time to keep them from spreading. Infected persons go bonkers. Stupid. Gaga. Batty. The full spectrum.

The book said one should take 3 rat tails, a branch of the Death Tree and 2 vials of blood from the Raargon. Those reagents will help to appease Kybele, so she will - hopefully - make it rain. The rain will trap the spores. It will only work with water, not with blood. Go now, you don't have much time!

I've collected twenty freed slaves, but didn’t like Ordaurcil's idea of a reward. He wasn’t really going to pay a bounty, and when I insisted he attacked me. It worked out well for me, because I got to kill him and collected the Dragon scale I wanted. The bounty hunter is a coward but he might have some valuable information, so I should talk to him again.
It quite obvious: Life here is uncomfortable enough, can you see it?
You can run away from your enemy if you have to, but we can't run away from our poverty.
Are you able to feed your family?
Well, at least you've managed to achieve something.
A little gold? A piece of bread? I'd be thankful for anything you can give me.
The Shadow Warrior charges directly towards his target. The charge increases the Shadow Warrior's run speed slightly and his defense values substantially.
To me, q q - quite quickly!
Hey, you louse-ridden jerks! To me!
Assemble, there's work coming our way!
Temple Guardians have no use for this equipment.

Here lies harper_6w5,
she thought that knowledge would keep her alive...
But her books lay unread,
because now she's dead,
It's the lucky, not the clever, who survive!
Here rests the greatest lover of all. Now let me finally get some sleep!
Wanderers, I greet you with "See you soon" because you'll surely return to this place.
He adored his tiger... too much...
Oh no, you failed. Now they are going to torch each other's houses.

Take this basket of fruit to Urzi the bear.

Do you have time to do me a small favor? There's a little grotto very close to here. Urzi lives there. Urzi is a cave bear, but he's not like other bears. I've cared for him since he was a cub. He was hand tamed and is used to Humans.
But now he's sick and has been for two weeks. I take him a basket of fruit every day so that he can get well quicker, but I'm afraid to go into the forest lately. There are simply too many monsters and wild creatures there. Please take this basket to poor Urzi.
Nice to see you again! We decided that each of us will build our own business house, then we'll see whose is more successful in the end!
If you're reading this after I die, then my theory about the world only existing in my thoughts was wrong.
Lucretius the innkeeper is now serving one last meal - dinner for the worms!
I'm not panicking. You know, if your ship is burning the last thing you should do is to slip into panic.
I'm all for world peace... I find superior firepower works best.
Don't read the small print. It's bad for your eyes!
Advice for the day: If you have a lot of tension and you get a headache, do what it says on the tablet packaging: "Take two tablets" and "Keep away from children." --Author Unknown
I always fought for peace. Here, I finally found it.
The educated historian claimed "Red dragon eggs are very rare." Indeed. One might say almost as rare as rocking horse shi...
Grief is the privilege of living.
I met a girl with a glass eye today. She didn't tell me, it just popped out in conversation.
Here lies the late courier... pun intended!
Here lies another late courier... ups... double-pun intended.
Here lie the noble Atherton family. They told you they were sick.
Nothing to steal here - move along.
Fear the power of the Light!
As the Maker always says, don't play with Kobolds!
The mage, he stole my sword! Somehow I don't think that he plans to do good.

Damn!

That didn't work as intended. I should have been more careful during the initiating sequence I guess. Apparently, I am slacking off. Anyway. Tybor, kill this thing before it becomes too powerful.
When they're dead, we can use them as fertilizer.
We have to protect nature from them!
Big, dangerous and not alone. He didn't lie...

Explore the area around the crypt!

What? Galdar was only able to resurrect two of five brains? What kind of quota is that?! How am I supposed to work like this? The moral is low!
Could you help us out, again? Please explore the area around the crypt. We can plan out next attack better if we have more information.
That was really close. We wouldn't have been able to hold on much longer.
Talk to my friend who lives in the next village!

Grants to ability to work on items without a forge. Additionally, items above character level can be used. Rings can be forged into items with bronze or better slots, amulets can be forged into items with silver or better slots. Allows the use of exclusive enhancements.
Villages are the same everywhere ... Lots of rabble and peasants ...
I'll bet you weren't expecting that!
I need better protection from physical damage.

Chase off the rabbits!

There! Another half eaten carrot! These blasted rabbits dig up my carrots, nibble on them and then leave them lying there. They should at least eat the whole thing, but no - they only eat the tips! I can't sell them, and I can't even look at carrot stew anymore! Please! Chase off these rodents for me! I would do it myself, but those little critters are too fast!
The leader of the brigands wants me to eradicate a Dryad strike force and bring him at least seven heads.
Oh , don't worry. I've yet to regret anything.
Well, maybe I'll come back to that later. We'll see ...
Worry not, I never regret my decisions.
I admit, I didn't trust you. But I was wrong.

Fight in the arena!

You look like someone who knows how to fight. I have a suggestion. Why don't you fight some of my trainees? If you are able to survive the fight, and I'm sure you will, I will give you some compensation for your efforts.
I found a giant spider and destroyed it. Now I can go back to the poor Dryad.

Let's go down there!

I have returned from exploring Khormynth's power base. I notified the zombies in the camp and immediately came here to help you. We don't have time for explanations. Let's go down there first. I can't wait to meet Diaanja.
Back to the abyss with you, Demon!
I have severed the Kobold's head from his shoulders. Now I can take Hehog his head.

But you are a Seraphim! Your kind is the most just under the sun. Not far from here great injustices are happening every day, day in and day out. All the guards look the other way. Torguis is the owner of a huge estate and every day there are children working on his fields, and it's always different kids! People are saying he kidnaps children to misuse them as slaves.
My trunk is full of junk. Eh... The backpack is filled I mean.
I don't think that's so bad, because the blade is the bride of the warrior! I can't complain about it!

I was expecting this from the beginning! This wretch planned to kill me after the work was done, so he could keep all the profits for himself. Too bad he didn't realize who he was trying to double cross!
Let none of the unbelievers live!
Tear the hearts out of those enemies of Ker!

A guard at the Grand Inquisitor’s mansion said I was a thief and attacked me! I had to kill her in self defense. The second guard was more cooperative. She said the Grand Inquisitor can be found at the holding cells across the city.
A stationary banner which increases defense and attack values for every party member within its range.
Do you want to keep this resolution?
Please hurry! It's too late once she's said I do!
Do the world a favor and go kill yourself.
I can either pay you or kill you.
Who are you trying to impress with your attitude?
The world seems to be overpopulated with heroes lately.
Player, your character is going to keel over soon!
He loves me, he loves me not, he loves me, ...
Am I supposed to be startled?
I have crushed the band of villains. There is no more danger here, and I will go and tell the village elder.

Daniel Sawitzki
Hello Buzztard, thank you for your job offer but I think your games are stupid and I would never work for you. No hard feelings, sincerely, Beef Supreme
It's your turn now, you pathetic midget!
Whatever have you done Dundiel? I always thought there was a warm heart beating somewhere deep behind that rough exterior, but I was wrong. You deserve to die, you piece of Elven scum! Take that!
Don't rush things. Keep cool. The world will surely save itself if you stay afk long enough. I'm convinced of that.

A man asked me to recover an intercepted love letter. He’s having a love affair with a married woman, and one of her servants got ahold of one of his letters. If the woman’s husband gets the letter the whole affair will be revealed!
This chest is empty. I should look in the tents, too.

Thank you ... Thank you very much... You... Who are you, by the way? You aren't here by order of the count. Well, I don’t care. This is just a small camp. The larger camp, where they probably store all the supplies of the herb, is in that direction. Now let me go.
I can't fight ice-resistant armor with this weapon.
Be careful! Those elementalists can be tricky!
I already knew that women were evil. But you...
I would rather remain a slave, than be in your presence.
You are even more repulsive than in the stories.
The guard is the regular army. They are well trained and armed.
You have found what I asked you for. Kuan thanks you for this sacrifice. I will bless you now.
Gambling? I won’t allow any gambling in here! Although some others might turn a blind eye to suchlike.
The officer has a task for me. I should speak with him.
Korrim is getting help. I can continue my travels.
You did it, thanks! The ghosts are gone.
I hope we can find King El Leigh once we understand the text.
Ah, the boss of it all!

Bring me the head of each of the elite monsters in the region!

Greetings to you! My name is Constantina. I am responsible for breeding and preserving the T-Energy monsters in the region. Once a year I must see to the fauna's state of health. These T-Energy monsters are REALLY susceptible to sickness and epidemics!
Would you be so kind to help me? I need heads of all the monsters in the area. I happen to have an up-to-date monster index. If you could be so kind? I would be very grateful!
The opponents in this region generally use weapons for ice based damage.
What are you doing here, stranger?
Yes, I've noticed that you have the gift of gab. But I don't feel like chatting.
You aren't born a master, you learn it. So, don't worry.
Do you really think that your ancestors will approve of what you are doing?
Have you ever been to an ancestral rite before? You really should try that!
Tári is dead? No! That... That cannot be...! *sob*

Fight against a Demon!

Greetings sister! I remember you, we trained together in the arena on occasion. “Saskia“ you used to say, “If you keep at it you'll be as good as me soon!“ Well how are your fighting skills now? Are your blades still as shrewd as your eyes? How about a round in the arena with a Demon?
Let me know when you're ready then I'll send us into the arena.
ALL YOUR BASE ARE BELONG TO US!

Ah! You did it! But how does this knowledge help us? A dozen souls, and only one was willing to take possession of the body of a flaming horse. If you can ride it, you may keep the flaming horse. If not, well, just leave it. Even so, take this junk. It's of no use to me anyway.

Good, but we still won't make peace with stinking Elves! Where do you stand? Elves or nature?
I see. Here. That's our thanks. Now go. Next time you'll be back to being nothing but a jerk to us.

And who might you be? Strange people are hanging around here these days. Perhaps I should find myself another tavern...
Oh well. Excuse me for terminating this one-sided conversation. I am waiting for someone.

Bring me Grammbrain’s magic sword!

Hello, I'm Ulof. Have you heard the tales of our great Orc hero Grammbrain? My granddaddy always told me them at bedtime. Grammbrain was such a mighty warrior that he feared none but the most awe-inspiring of opponents. His end came when our land was overrun by Demons. Grammbrain took up his magic sword and threw himself into battle against the Demon hordes. As he charged toward the Demon army he cried out his final words: “I will destroy them ALL!” He never returned, but neither did the Demons. So I guess he must have been successful. His tribe buried his remains in a hero’s grave. And guess what? I found his grave! Grammbrain’s magic sword must be somewhere inside it! Fetch the magic sword and bring it to me! I’m too afraid to set foot inside the grave.
Oh no, this darkness is... ahh...
So this is what death feels like.
The women were very relieved and rewarded me generously.
The mage rewarded me well. I am very pleased.

Accompany me and pay off my debts!

You again! It's nice to see you. As you can see, I'm not really cut out for life in the city. Now I'm out on the street again, and on top of that I still have debts to pay. They're pretty old, but these sharks never forget!
Could you... couldn't you... I mean...
I would be truly grateful. It really isn't that much either. Come on, I'll take you to Varnar.
It wasn't that one either! By all the Gods, how do you play this game?

There you are again. Rina Boombastic told me that you took care of her problems. No I don't want to know how, as long as I get good merchandise from her again. I'm in your debt, here's your well earned reward.
I hear you are a very brave woman.
Did you ever fight against a Troll?
I think jewelry hampers fighting, but it's also very beautiful - don't you agree?
This area is too much of a challenge for me.
Good day, kind Sir! What brings you to me on this fine day!
I hear that you have an excellent recipe for wild pheasant.
Indeed I do, Sir. But I am not sure if your Elven stomach would agree with such a crude meal.
Don't you worry about that, Human. Tell me, how do you prepare this pheasant?
I take out the insides, soak them in soapy water, mix them with rat dung and beet syrup, and then stuff it all back in the bird.
A meal like that could kill a dozen of my kind on the spot!
Quite likely, good Sir. I did warn you!
Well, it was worth a try I suppose.
You like sand, don't you? In with you!

I've told Mekezz that Officer Marpek will pay his debts today.
I can't do anything for my clients right now.
How is one supposed to convince the starving that the Gods mean well?
Empty. Everything is empty. The pot, the Temple, everything.
I implore the Gods to help us in these hard times.
Blessed be the little that we still have.
Torches at evening prayer always puts me in a devout mood.
A ritual for a good harvest could help.
In this life one must have strong beliefs.
In the end, we are all the same in the eyes of the Gods. Hopefully.
When I get fed up, I close my eyes and imagine I'm surrounded by beautiful twins!
We need dreams here. That's the only thing they can't take away from us.
One day I'll grab the whip and lash the supervisor!
Dreams are ten a penny. I've quit holding on to them.
Even the most realistic person can't do without dreams here.
If we work hard, all this will belong to us one day. Or we wake up.
If we come that far, pinch me so I know I'm awake!
What do fantasies create in this situation? Only more problems!
My dream looks like this: I'm standing in front of a lord - and I'm completely naked!
I leave dreaming to the horses, they have a better chance of them coming true.
I can't yet use the potential of this item.

I have met a down-and-out juggler by the name of Clement. He buried his fortune under a tree in Griffinborough and now he can’t get his hands on it. Clement asked me to dig up his fortune and give it to his daughter. She has agreed to an arranged marriage, but her dear father wants to spare her this miserable fate.
That little toad! I should have fed him to the olms!
The boy wants me to help him find his tomcat.

Ancient Elven Statue
This was built in a time when heroes were still heroes

Thank you for testing! Looks like Milrinda handed in a correct result. And I almost wronged her!
Take this as compensation for your services.

Guardian of Souls
For this is the mark of a wise and upright man, not to rail against the gods in misfortune.
- Aeschylus
Look at you! Even undead, you don't have to let yourself go completely.

Go to the meadow and see what's wrong with the sheep!

My goodness! This has never happened to me before. Look at this! One of my sheep bit me, then they all chased me and I ran away like a frightened rabbit. I ran away from a flock of sheep! All I wanted to do was take them some water, now I'm afraid to go back to the meadow. Look at my hands, they're still shaking. And to think I’ve fended off wolves with my staff in the past!

What am I supposed to do now? I am their shepherd.

Hmm, you look pretty brave. Could you go see what's wrong with my sheep? I will reward you for your efforts.
You dare to put yourself above us, Inquisitor?
You will experience true pain, brother.
You dare turn against us? Then die!
Your treachery has not gone unnoticed, Inquisitor.
I'm taking revenge on the world!
Do not lose any more time! Dismissed!
There are no Dark Fairies here with me.  You will have to find them somewhere else.
Move along and don't break anything.
You make a rather disoriented impression.
Always remember - the way is the goal!
The Gods are always watching you, and one day they will judge your deeds.
This T-Energy can cause serious mutations if it gets into the drinking water. There are reports of people who went to bed and woke up as giant bugs.
This corner of the world can be travelled safely. I'm pleased.
Before you die Dragon: Where is your lair?

Go to the island of the Dryads and retrieve the key to unveil the hub

How in the name of Ker did you manage to contact me? Ah well, it's irrelevant. Did you find the machine?

I see, they moved the machine. Very clever of those Temple Guardians. Well then, this pretty much determines our next step. Go to the Dryads and acquire the key. And don't waste any time. One of my spies is on the island already. Meet him for further instructions.
How strong are you without your helpers?
I have to find ten escaped slaves, punish them and return with their heads. I hope my backpack is big enough!
The soldiers who were threatening the Temple are dead. Now I can deliver the Inquisitor's message.
The enemies, who are on the rampage around here, are still too strong for me. I should come back after I gain more experience.
Who are you and what do you want from me?

I came, saw and... heh, and beat everything to death.

Feel the holy power of the Seraphim, heretic!
A town on the shores of Bluestone Lake

Combat Values
This is an overview of your character's current values during a fight. These values change when you equip different weapons, armor or combat arts.

Move your mouse cursor over the different categories, such as character class, and tooltips will offer detailed information.

Close Combat
In close combat, the "Attack" and "Defense" values will be compared. That will determine the probability of successful hits from your opponent.

Spells
 For spells, "Spell Intensity" and "Spell Resistance" will be compared. If the attacker is not able to overcome the target's spell resistance, he will inflict considerably less damage. This damage may be decreased even further by his opponent's resistances.

What do the colored bars mean?
The colored bars show how your attack damage or your armor protection is divided in relation to the damage types.
There are five damage types:

: Physical
: Magic
: Poison
: Ice
: Fire

Throughout the game you will meet opponents who are extremely protected from or vulnerable to certain damage types. Thus, using the appropriate damage type during a fight could make the difference between defeat or victory.

Archery

“A bow is like a cat. It has its own will that you can't bend. In order to control it, you need to understand it first. And in order to understand it, you need to let it control you.”
Seribas Whitelock, Master Archer

Archery, the Science

Bows are the perfect symbiosis of different materials. The flexibility of the bow-stave, transferring the acceleration to the string, which then passes it on to the stiff and rigid mass of the arrow, made of steel and wood. It is the inherent properties of the materials, which make the bow such a deadly weapon.

Interestingly, bows can be found in the history of every single culture in Ancaria. However, it remains unclear, which race or culture can actually claim to have invented the bow. Many theories are focusing on this question. Some historians even say that bows are an Orcish invention.
One of the oldest examples for archery was found during the archaeological excavation of an ancient Human cemetery. The burial objects in the graves indicated that it must have been an extremely wealthy village. However, one of the graves was different from the others. Instead of the usual amount of burial objects found in the other graves, it just contained three arrow heads. It took quite a while for the historians to figure out that in this particular case, the arrow heads were actually not burial objects, but the cause of death.

No other weapon in the history of Ancaria went through an evolution like the bow did. In ancient times, the bow was merely a weak and unreliable instrument, used for hunting small animals. But over the centuries, the High Elves and especially the Dryads have developed the technology to perfection, and created one of the most powerful weapons ever seen. Made of a special kind of magical wood called “Nyugharii” (Dryad: “Soul of the Forest”), Dryad bows are extremely precise and long-ranged. A well crafted Dryad bow is the only missile weapon in Ancaria that's able to penetrate the heart-scale of a Dragon.

Elven bows are usually made of yew wood. The typical Elven bow is longer than it's Dryad counterpart, and almost (but not quite) as strong. But this downside is equalized by the fact that
Elven arrows are commonly considered the best arrows you can get. The expertise of Elven smiths is still unrivalled, and the quality of arrowheads made of Elven steel definitely makes a difference - as thousands of Orcs can't attest to any more.


Archery, the Art

“Are you longing for perfection? Don't fool yourself. A lifespan is not enough to master the bow.”
 Seribas Whitelock to a student

It is the most efficient way to kill an enemy. Nock an arrow, draw the string, release it and watch the arrow find it's target. Silent and with deadly precision, bows are able to kill at long distances, long before the enemy can even reach you.

But not so fast! It is a long path before this picture becomes reality.
Countless hours of practice are required before you can call yourself an archer. Only the most talented will make the cut and become a master bowman. Archery requires a combination of physical and mental skills. High dexterity, sharp eyes, the ability to concentrate and good reflexes are all equally important.


Archery in Battles

An army of skilled archers is able to decide battles and entire wars. There are many examples in the history of Ancaria, where archers have been the deciding factor for a victory. However, just having archers is not enough. It takes some tactical skills to use them to their full effectivtiy. Archers are generally weak as soon as their targets get into melee range. Therefore, protecting the archers is a key tactic in battles. It is essential to give them as much time as possible, because more time means more opportunities to fire arrows.
Archers in battle units usually wear light armor to keep them as mobile as possible, enabling them to avoid direct encounter with heavily armored troops. And even in siege situations, where most of the heavy armored troops are rendered useless, archers are a useful unit due to their ability to shoot burning arrows or take out single defenders from the distance.

Book 2

Fire Magic

“Fiery balls sped like comets across the battlefield and destroyed everything in their wake. Spirals of flames and the bright lights of explosions blinded friend and foe alike as they lit the night sky. I wielded my sword relentlessly, but wherever my blade struck, it only cut deep into charred flesh.”
 Description of the battle of An-Athail

The destructive powers of fire have been known since the beginning of time. Fire kills effectively and fast. Thus, it is not surprising that the School of Fire Magic focuses on destructive fire spells.

The most basic form of fire magic simply heats an item. The ethereal essence of the target object is transformed into energy. As this process is straight forward it is possible to reach extremely high temperatures. Although this form of Fire Magic can only be applied to inanimate matter it has a variety of uses. Some suspect that the famous alloys, which the Dwarves manufactured in their forges, were the result of strong fire magic as the temperatures required for these alloys were impossible to create by natural means.

Evoking and focusing fire in an open space is much more difficult and requires considerable experience. Once this step has been mastered, the evoker is able to stabilize and maintain fire energy, confining it to a small space until it hits the designated target, discharging its full potential upon impact. These fire globes are magically accelerated, which renders them deadly projectiles typically referred to as ‘Fire Balls’.

“My first successful fire ball required half an hour of preparation. When I finally bundled enough energy and attempted to hurl it towards the stone target in front of me, my strength faltered and the fire ball sped off in the opposite direction towards the window. There, it struck my mentor’s chest - may the Gods be merciful - and singed off his beard. I think he never forgave me for that.”
 From the memoirs of Arch Mage Jaquemart

The most complex part of Fire Magic has to be the combination of all known aspects in order to create or conjure flame beings that are able to act independently or follow their conjurers’ orders. This aspect of Fire Magic can create fire elementals or conjure existing beings such as fire demons. Only the most powerful and experienced magicians are able to deal with this aspect and control these beings. However, many have succumbed to the temptations of these powers and have lost their lives during their feeble attempts. Despite centuries of research, fire magic has not been conclusively explored yet. New possibilities to make fire effects even more deadly are constantly being discovered. Fire Magic is already consistently being used by all civilized armies and has become a tactical element during battles and sieges.

However, no mortal being has been able to compete with the annihilating powers of Dragon fire. The fire breath of these creatures is the most devastating form of fire magic. Many magicians have attempted to research the nature of the Dragons in order to reveal the secret behind their fire breath. So far, all their efforts have been in vain.

“The old Dragon regarded me with an expression resembling both boredom and concealed curiosity while I concentrated. I hurled the fire beam towards the rock and barely held on to my footing during the recoil. The impact of the beam split the rock in two.
‘Well, what do you think?’ I enquired.
The Dragon stared at the split rock for a while, then his eyes turned towards me and finally wandered back to the rock. He made a vague movement with his head and a thin, bright beam shot towards the rock, melting it down to a small puddle of lava.
‘It does make things easier, when you use fire,’ he retorted, before he rose and flew away.”
 Torquez the Elder, in “Pyrotechnica Arcana”

T-Energy

Since the beginning of systematic research on the Lore of Magic, magical weapon (and armor) enhancement has been one of the top disciplines. Simply embedding a spell or enchantment is the basic form of this art. More complex ideas include chains of spells or even spells that can be triggered by the user of the weapon. In many cases, weapon enhancing magic will just add magical damage to the damage that is already being dealt by the weapon, increasing the overall damage and avoiding certain resistances. But the variety of options is in fact far wider. Literally all kinds of spells can be embedded into a weapon.

It was only a matter of time until someone came up with the idea to replace the controlled magic energy with the most primal and dangerous form of magic energy, the T-Energy.
There is no way to control T-Energy. It is a constant flow of chaotic power that is almost impossible to channel, let alone control.

However, in the year 352 - after decades of dedicated research - the Archlords of the High Elf school of essence finally found a magic ritual that bound tiny pieces of T-Energy to a static object. The results were amazing. The T-Energy promptly took control over the object, but did not destroy it. Instead, it frequently unleashed small bits of energy with devastating effects. The ultimate weapon seemed to be born, but soon it became obvious that this was just an illusion, because the energy strikes were not targeted. Anyone wielding such a weapon would sooner or later inevitably kill himself. But the initial step was made.

Another fifty years of research were necessary before the means to concentrate T-Energy to a certain part of a weapon were found, thus ensuring that the unleashed energy would only target the intended object rather than leaking randomly. With this major advancement, the path to T-Energy weapons was clear.

A Zombie's Diary

Dear diary,
while I'm writing these lines, I am dead. Well, technically speaking, that is. They came late last night and razed our village. I can't remember any details. All I know is that I tried to find cover in the copse behind the house. They caught me anyway. When I woke up this morning, I felt empty, tired and exhausted. At first, I thought it was all just a bad dream. However, when I wanted to wash and looked at my face in the mirror, I knew what had happened. I am an undead. A zombie. One of those creatures that are hunted by adventurers all over Ancaria for a few coppers.
My heart is not beating anymore, the blood does not flow in my veins, my skin is leathery and of an unhealthy color. I don't feel pain or fear or rage. Could it be possible that my nerves have shut down, as well?
I do, however, have my ravenous appetite for brain under control. It was difficult at first. Sometimes, in the first few days, I simply couldn't stop myself. Strange, really, since it doesn't taste of anything. Or maybe I can't taste anything. Or both. But I have a grip on myself by now, thank the gods. I can stop whenever I want to.

Dear diary,
things have changed since the night I became a zombie. Nothing is like it once was. Luckily, the other villagers have turned into zombies, as well. That makes things easier, because we can discuss our problems and needs with each other. Some even thought about establishing a self-help group. A simple meeting where everybody can talk about his or her problems. I am not sure I would attend. I do feel a little ashamed of my condition.

Dear diary,
more weeks have passed. It is strange how quickly one can get used to being immortal. Of course, things still have to settle down. You must get used to peel off the worms from your skin every other day, for example. If you don't, they will dig themselves in and leave unsightly bumps on your skin, not to mention the holes when they hatch as flies.
The self-help group for undead has been brought to life (stupid pun, I know, but so what? You are just a diary and don't understand any of what I am writing anyway.) Maybe I'll attend one of the meetings again next week.

Dear diary,
I can't get over what happened to me today! A few hours ago, a few zombies from the neighboring village came over and wanted to know how last night's attack had gone. When I told them we couldn't hold back the attackers and had been overrun, they asked if I had been alone and where the OTHER men of the village had hidden! The OTHERS!? They thought I was a MAN!!! Well, I have to admit that my body has collapsed somewhat and my skin cannot be compared to that of a rose colored peach anymore. But still, it should have been OBVIOUS to them, that I am a woman! Or should it?
The self-help group will meet again the day after tomorrow. I will attend this time!

Dear diary,
the first meeting of the zombie self-help group was horrible. We sat in a circle and had to introduce ourselves to the others. When it was my turn, everyone said “Hello Amania” to me after I was finished with the introduction. And then they talked about what bothered them. The shepherd complained that his sheep would rip open each other’s heads to feed on the brains. The village elder lost his right arm in the most recent attack by the flying eyes and can't hold his cane and smoke at the same time anymore. I felt so very out of place! Then I told them about the other villagers, and that they had mistaken me for a man. At first, there was embarrassed silence. And then everybody started laughing! EVERYBODY laughed! It was so embarrassing!

Dear diary,
today, mother, who lives in the neighboring village, came over for a visit and things came to a head. I only told her that she was looking well and had not changed much since our last meeting. I had just meant to say something nice to break the awkward silence after the initial greeting!
Mother left in a huff immediately. Why do things like that always happen to me?

Dear diary,
today I found a stray flying eye. At first, I thought we were being attacked again by these monsters. But when it didn't attack me and hovered in front of me, looking at me with its large sad eye instead, I couldn't keep from caressing its eyelid. It has followed me ever since and does not want to leave my side. I named it “Blinky”.


Dear diary,
Blinky has been with me for over two months now. He is soooo cute! Every time I go to bed, he settles down on the bedpost at the foot of the bed and waits until I get up again. Okay, it was a bit strange at first to look into a big eye as soon as I opened mine. But then I had an idea - I simply cover him with a blanket at night.

Dear diary,
I taught Blinky to fetch. Well ... he can't retrieve the stick, of course, since he doesn't have a muzzle. But every time I throw it, Blinky flies after the stick and stares at it until I come to pick it up. Isn't that great?!

Dear diary,
life of a zombie isn't easy. People say that time stands still for a zombie. Days become weeks become months become years. You begin to lose track. Is it summer? Or winter? Hadn't it just been summer? I don't know how long we've been zombies now. Some villagers tried to count the days. They made notches in the edge of a table or tried to mark the days with pebbles. But even they stopped trying and resigned themselves to the fact that time doesn't count anymore.
There is nothing to talk about anymore after all this time, either. And the little that bothers me, I share only with Blinky, because Blinky is my friend. And more importantly: he won't tell anybody.
But sometimes - especially at night, when I look up to the stars - I wish I wasn't a zombie anymore. I wish I was back in my old life when time still mattered. When I could feel. When I could dream.
Why I am writing all this? Oh .... I don't know...

Psst! Can I have a word with you my friend? My name is Gemondan and I have a little job for you. The Chief Astronomer at the Celestial Dome, Nomengalus, is an agent of the aristocracy. The sooner he's gone, the better - for us and for you. I have a plan that will help us get rid of him.

Book 3

Forens - Goddess of Philosophy

Forens is the Goddess of Philosophy and Wisdom. She is the Goddess who inspires men to ask the question “why?.” She endows people with the power of speech, wisdom, and learning. She is also elusive, just as the answers to the great questions are elusive.



Mythology

Forens is a constant wanderer between the worlds. She is constantly moving around the universes, back and forth into time, but at the same time, she's omnipresent. Whenever a new universe is created, she is the first one to bring “the word” to it, which is a synonym for enlightenment and speech. Because just like living beings, “the word”needs to be created, it doesn't come naturally. For her, a world without words, without thoughts and questions is a lost world, empty and without a soul. Living beings need to learn, because that's what makes them living beings. Therefore, Forens is on an eternal quest, trying to evoke the fire of asking in every race and being.

Appearance

Like any other God, Forens has multiple forms of appearances. In the elven mythology, she's displayed as a beautiful woman, with black hair and shimmering eyes, which - if you look into them - contain the entire universe. In other regions, Forens doesn't have a human or even physical form and is just a shining halo, talking with a deep, soft voice.

The Cult

There are temples dedicated to Forens in every bigger town in Ancaria. Especially amongst the intellectual circles, Forens is a very popular Goddess. Every elven University in Ancaria has a small chapel, dedicated to Forens, where students meet every week to pray and ask for blessing and enlightenment. In the rural regions of the world, the cult of Forens is not as popular, although some local groups in certain elven areas are still worshipping her.
The symbol of Forens is the candle. It represents the light, that's being ignited to bring knowledge into the darkness of the mind. High priests of the cult wear an embroidered candle on their robes.
A side arm of the main cult follows the “Codex Forens.” It's an ancient manuscript, containing long chunks of philosophical and theological text. The author claims, that Forens herself has insinuated everything to him in long sessions of trance and meditation. However, the main cult leaders don't believe this version, so this sub section of the cult is operating independently.

Opponents and Supporters

Although Forens supports Testa and Lumen, she is actually an independent Goddess and does not interfere much in the struggle between the other Gods. She instead prefers to focus on her eternal quest.

Some weapons and armor have sockets. Visit a smith to see which items can be inserted in the socket since some items don't fit in some sockets.

Each avatar has 3 aspects. Each aspect has an individual play style. These play styles can be combined freely.
Don't forget that your avatar has received a powerful divine gift. This depends on the deity you chose during character creation. Use it wisely, because it has a long cooldown.

If you click a quest name in the quest log, the compass arrow will switch to that quest and lead you directly to the quest goal.
The chance to be rewarded with an armor set piece in addition to the quest reward increases with every completed quest.
Explore the world! Many hidden boss encounters will drop unique armor set pieces.
Use CTRL + left mouse click on another player's character portrait to teleport yourself to that player.
Quests will not be saved in the multiplayer mode “Free Game”.
In a multiplayer game, you can only pick up items with the auto pick-up key (default “Q) that are reserved for you.
You will automatically share experience points and gold with your team members in the multiplayer mode.
The compass needles at the bottom show the direction of the next quest goal. The big needle indicates the main quest, the gray needle indicates the current side quest.
Press and hold the right mouse button to move the world map. Press and hold the middle mouse button to view explored areas in detail.
A combo will trigger combat arts in succession without waiting for the recharge but the combat arts will go on cooldown after the combo.
Use combos to combine 2 to 4 combat arts. You can trigger a combo just like a normal combat art. Your avatar will automatically perform all combat arts of that combo in succession.
Use the mouse wheel to adjust camera distance. Pressing the middle mouse button will rotate the camera. Use “Y” (default) to align the camera north.
If you spend skill points on aspect skills, you will receive modification points. You can use those to unlock modifications of the aspect's combat arts.
The glowing circle around an enemy shows if the enemy's level is lower than (gray or green circle), equal to (yellow circle) or much higher than (red or purple circle) that of the player character.

In order to put combat arts in the quick slots, select them in the combat arts menu (default “E”) and drop them on the desired slot to the bottom right. It will be even quicker by right clicking on the combat art menu.
You can quick sell or quick buy items using CTRL+left mouse button.
You can also insert runes in weapons or armor. Equipping that item will enhance your combat art, but the cooldown will increase.
You can put any kind of potion and trophy in potion slots.

If your inventory is full, you can convert items to gold immediately. Use CTRL + left mouse button to click on the item or drop it on the moneybag icon above the inventory. You will get less money doing this than from vendoring the item.
You can trade runes for another class at the rune master. The more runes you trade against a new rune, the less it will cost you.
You can trade with other player in a multiplayer game. In order to initiate a trade, CTRL + left click the other player's avatar.
The enemy strength will be adjusted to the size of the player team in the multiplayer mode.
You can buy horses at a horse vendor. If your character is on horseback, he can only perform special mounted combat arts, depending on the type of horse.
A quest in Orcish Byway will lead you to an epic mount which you can buy in addition to your horse. Your character can perform normal combat arts from the back of this mount.
In the singleplayer mode, each character can accept class-specific quests. You can identify them by the special color of the qeustionmark.
Armor sets are very special and rare. A set consists of several well-matched pieces. The more pieces you equip, the more properties of the set will be unlocked.
You can find merchants all across Ancaria. You don't have to return to previous locations in order to sell items.
Use modifications to change the tactical aspects of combat arts. Some combat arts will only become really exciting with modifications.
When you character dies, he will be resurrected at the currently active soul stone. You can activate a sould stone by clicking on it.

The Dryad can loot shrunken heads from defeated enemies. Enemies will become weaker if you have a shrunken head of their species equipped, so you should chose the head depending on the current type of enemies.

The Temple Guardian changes its left arm depending on the currently active combat art. If he uses it to shoot enemies at a range, the damage will be determined by the battery. He can't use a melee arm to shoot.
You can only enter dungeons on foot.

If an enemy suddenly doesn't take much damage from your attacks anymore, check his health bar to see if he is protected against that type of damage (physical, fire, frost, magic, poison) and switch to another attack.
Creatures can mutate when they come in contact with T-Energy! They will become stronger and more resilient to damage.

If your character suddenly takes a lot of damage in combat, check your opponent's health bar to see if your character is protected by relics against your enemy's damage type (fire, frost, magic, poison).

The color at the top of an enemy's health bar indicates which type of damages he uses in an attack (physical, fire, frost, poison or magic). The color at the bottom of an enemy's health bar indicates which type of damage he is protected against.
The heavier your armor, the longer the cooldown of the combat arts. The cooldown can be reduced by armor lore.
The best protection for your character are breastplate, spaulders and a helmet. A shield will provide additional protection.

As a rule of thumb, a combat art is considered appropriate if its level equals about ¼ of the character level. If the combat art's level is lower, it will do less damage but also has a lower cooldown.
Skill or combat art enhancements on items only count if the character has already unlocked that skill or combat art.
Taking potions quickly one after the other will reduce their effect.
The “Alchemy” skill allows you to boost your trophies. This will open new tactical possibilities.
The skills “Enhanced Perception” and “Bargaining” will help you to get better items.
The vendors will make you a better price if you solve many side quests in their vicinity.
Completing side quests helps to develop and strengthen your character - they give valuable experience points, gold and items.
The defense value is independent from armor. During an attack, the attack value and the defense value will be compared to calculate whether the attack succeeds or not.
A high magic resistance protects opponents with low spellpower. It reduces the damage taken from spells and their side effects.
The player's chest consists of two parts. One that is only visible to the current character and one for all your characters.
If opponents are too tough, check their level, the quality and level of your equipment and the levels of combat arts.
You can focus the High Elf's Glacial Storm and Blazing Tempest by clicking on the ground some feet behind the target enemy.
Riding on a mount decreases the combat art regeneration. You can negate this negative effect with the riding skill.
Even though permanent combat arts (buffs) increase the combat art cooldown, your character should always have one buff active. The tactical benefits are huge.
You can easily combine combat arts using combos. You cannot use the same combat art multiple times in one combo.
If an enemy is well protected against the damage types of your combat arts, the skill “Ancient Magic” can help you to deal damage nevertheless.
All weapon-based combat arts can also be performed with a bow. They will be interpreted for ranged weapons accordingly.
A vendor's wares will remain for a certain time after your last visit. After that, the merchants inventory will be replaced with new items bit by bit.
The different damage types have fixed side effects: fire and poison deal additional damage-over-time, frost slows movement and magic reduces the target's attributes.
Some characters and foes have a technological energy shield. It functions like bonus health that can recharge quickly.

If the level of an equipped armor piece is too high, your character's movement speed will be greatly reduced. If the level of an equipped weapon is too high, your character's attack speed will be greatly reduced.
A character can use a weapon's special ability if he has learned the respective weapon skill. The higher the skill value, the better the skill.
Some combat arts are strong against individual, tough foes, others are better suited for fighting groups.
Enemies can drop trophies. With the “Alchemy” skill, you can use trophies for temporary enhancements, much like potions.
Attributes are the basic characteristics of each avatar. The automatically increase with each level you gain. You also receive free points at each level-up.
You can access important background information ingame by clicking the Help [?] (to the top right in menu).
You can distribute skillpoints to increase a skill's level up to the current character level. You can exceed that limit by using items with skill increase values.
You need 75 points in a skill to receive the master bonus for that skill. Items that increase skill value levels (rings, amulets etc.) to 75 will not award you the master bonus.
If you create a character in the hardcore mode, this character cannot be played anymore if he dies in the game.
The damage type “magic damage” does not refer to damage from spells.
Select a modification of a pair to enhance a combat art. The other modification of the pair cannot be selected anymore afterwards. You can modify each combat art up to three times.
Reading a rune increases the combat art by one at most. Higher values on a rune, e. g. +6, only apply if you insert a rune in an item.
If you read a rune to enhance a combat art, the additional attributes of the rune expire. The additional attributes only become active if you insert the rune in an item.
If reading a rune only slightly enhances a combat art, it will help to increase the character level and the aspect focus ability. The cooldown will still increase.
A horse will gain levels if your character rides on it and receives experience points. A horse levels very fast, so it will soon catch up on the character's level.
Mounts don't have their own health bar. The mount dies right before the health of its rider is reduced to zero.
The attack value does not determine the damage but the chance your weapon will hit. The higher the value, the better the chance for you to score a hit with your weapon.
Attributes or skills that are increased by items will be shown in blue in the attributes and skills menu.
You can insert blacksmith arts and runes in a bronze socket.
You can insert blacksmith arts, runes and rings in a silver socket. This socket will also give a 7% bonus to their attributes.
You can insert blacksmith arts, runes, rings and amulets in a gold socket. This socket will also give a 15% bonus to their attributes.
Since socketed blacksmith arts require recrafting of the item, you can't remove them after socketing.
The survival bonus is a reward for not dying. It increases your character's attributes and thus strengthens attack and defense skills.

If a character doesn't die over a long period of time, his survival bonus will increase. This will boost the enemy level and their items above the character level. The chance for more valuable loot is increased, as well.
The survival bonus will only increase during combat. Simply standing around doing nothing doesn't count.
“Hero of Ancaria” statues give more experience per victory. This temporary buff cannot be combined with the Potion of the Mentor.
