I am to gather blue bracken fern for a rotting army of zombies. It seems to be a highly effective poison against enemies in this region. The zombies themselves won't leave their camp since their general went missing.
Further decreses the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.

What was that? My apprentice lost and claimed you were better than me and your skills superior to mine? I can't forgive that and therefore must fight you, to the death that is. What I'd prefer is an opponent instead of a victim, but in this case my honor is at stake. DIIIEEE!
You had no chance against my magic!
You are such a good hero!
You're fighting for the wrong side!
In the end there is only darkness!
The world doesn't need any saints!

All my opponents are dead.
Time to talk to the head gladiator again.
You really found the source of all this evil and destroyed it? I don't know how to thank you. Here take this artifact, you deserve it.
Stop! Don't make it more difficult for us!
Do I look like a pack-mule to you?
The bear wouldn't listen to reason. Now there's blood on the snowman's hands, to put it literally.
I wasn't able to kill enough Wargs. Apparently, the leader of the pack is already gone.
I'm looking into a very difficult case. Have you ever dealt with possession?
No, I thank the ancestors that I have been spared that so far.
The patient is talking in tongues, moaning and twisting in pain.
Of course not, but what else could cause these symptoms?
I don't know. Maybe he ate some bad food.
Are you serious? Well, looks like I have to perform a soul cleansing ritual.
Good luck with that. These rituals can easily go wrong.
Then let's go. Did you remember to turn off the stove?
Who are you? What do you want? GUARDS! HELP!
Once the sheep have been shorn, I will give the wool to the spinners.
Is this just busy work, or a regulation?
The stall should be close to the pasture. There under the oak would be a good spot.
The dam is separating herself from the herd, she will probably give birth soon.
There must be someone who can use that ... but that someone isn't me.
Soooo, you’re looking for soldiers, are you? HEEHEEHEE
...They were all little runts like you.
...came in the evenings and stayed until dawn...
There was another thing that I wanted to talk about.
There was something else that I didn't quite understand.
I could also use your valuable advice in other matters.
I really have to change the subject now, please don‘t hold it against me!
I have to mention this before I forget it!
There's another important topic that I have to mention.
There's something else that I've been very preoccupied with:
I don't want to take up too much of your time, but I would like to discuss something else with you.
There's something else that I would really like to get off my chest.
Maybe we should just change the subject.
People talk about you a lot. Just be careful, brave warrior.
The war seems to go on, but you've already proven yourself worthy!
It's not safe here - I wish you all the best!
Waton has killed Dundiel and we are on our way to search the treasure chamber. Hopefully we will find the evidence we need to incriminate Ophtanar.
Come. Take a seat. Help yourself to a roasted cockroach.
I have faith in you. I'm sure you will be victorious.
You won’t take the ring? You... you want to give us the thread rush? That’s truly heroic.

Find my nephew!

Thread rush? Yes I have a bit, but the quality’s very low and it's old. There's not enough and I’m not even sure it’s still useful. Thread rush has become quite rare since the count started confiscating every bit anyone had in stock. There’s an epidemic in a barony nearby, and the highborn gentlemen must be getting all they can in case the sickness spreads to this area too. With the quantities they’ve already stockpiled they could heal a whole army, the scoundrels! My nephew tried to smuggle some bags of the herb from the mountains, but he never came back. Maybe you could search for him?
There's no shortage of boars in these parts. But be careful, they have a mean bite.
Even if this was your eleventy-first birthday - never!
Further enhancement of all potions' effects. Allows the use of new items.

The hunting amulet is located in the Grotto of Death!

I am Lupus Coldhand. They say you're supposed to be pretty good. Good hunters are a rare breed, and I am the best of them all! Don't even think that you can hold a torch to me. There can be only one Master of the Hunt. If you really want the title, then you will have to get the hunting amulet. I hid it a long time ago, in a cave that is crawling with wild animals. We don't want to make it too easy for the competition now, do we? You can try! Go and bring me the amulet. If you are successful then I will relinquish my title to you.
Do you think I'm a shyster? If you want a divorce you should resort to the old custom and use your knife!
Kuan won't like this! You only tie the knot to bestow him some new citizens.
I don't understand why you can't solve this problem yourself! Don't we have plenty of  perfectly good holy fires?
This isn’t a matter for a shaman! There are legally trained people who can help you!
It says: “What Kuan united no warrior shall separate!” You'll have to endure her!
Kuan won't help you with this! His ruling is that a warrior has to endure the hardest punishments.
That's exactly what Kuan means when he speaks about the agony of the hells! You just understood his words too late!
Did Kuan force you to marry her? It's your problem now!
What do you expect me to do for you? Just go to war more often, then she'll eventually forget you!
You've said the words! And life is nothing but pain! There's a reason that these words are emphasized in the wedding!
What's that? An ambush! I'll show them who they're dealing with!
Unfortunately, I have to go! But I want to thank you for your pious words!
Unfortunately, I have little time! I really have to go to a homage for the Goddess!
What a deep conversation! I thank you for it!
Thank you for your advice and your sympathy! It really did me good!
Now, that's what I call a conversation! I'm glad we ran into each other!
Praise be the Goddess for this conversation! I say exactly what I feel!
This heavenly exchange was wonderful! And of the highest level.
May the Goddess accompany you on all your journeys! What a great conversation.
If only all discussions were as good as this! I loved it!
This conversation was a real pleasure for me! I thank you for this wonderful distraction!
Latencia disappointed her. She wrote “failed” next to Latencia's name in the list.
I seem to have made this wound up artist really happy!
The jeweler was pleased. I got a ring as my reward, thankfully not a jade ring.
Do you really want to delete this character?
I’ll fry them all in boiling olive oil, if I can only get my hands on them!

Stop the enemy’s magic ritual!

A number of mages in the enemy’s service are preparing to conduct a magic ritual. We don't know what type of ritual it is, but you have to stop them from completing it - at all costs! That is your mission!
Beware! A Seraphim will be there to guard the ritual - one of the most powerful I ever laid my eyes on, not that I've seen that many.
Take a few of my men to aid you in battle.
That's not the worst of it, the biggest and most dangerous ghost is in the cellar. You have you banish him. I'm begging you!
Any special wishes for the funeral?
I can hear voices from over there! That should be who I am looking for.

Bring me five Olm eggs.

I have a brilliant business idea, Olms! They taste delicious, produce plenty of eggs and make good leather! Olms are difficult to catch though, and hunting them is exhausting. That’s why I’ve decided to start an olm farm! That’s right! I’ll breed and farm my own olms! I’ve already found a good spot for the cages. Now all I need are some olms.
Could you steal five eggs from the nesting olms? Take care, olms can be vicious creatures!
There's one more thing on my mind while I have the chance to talk to you.
This talk wasn't so successful - shall we try another topic?
I can think of something right away!
So the Ogre has been outcast for loving a female Orc belonging to a different clan? That's what I call both ridiculous and strict customs.

Fetch me the four hunting lists I forgot!

Oh! Where did I put my head? I can't believe I forgot four hunting lists on my circuit! Oh my, I'm getting old, it seems! But then, I'm not 800 anymore! I'm too old to drag myself back all the way to get them. Perhaps you could help me? Get the four hunting lists I forgot to collect.
What ghastly weather! And then I meet a person like that!
Doesn't your armor corrode if it rains all day?
The weather does whatever it wants, don't you think?
Do you like to climb trees and hide among the leaves on hot summer days too?
I love dancing in the rain. You don't have time for that, do you?
I've killed some warg now, that should attract the alpha male. I think I see him coming. Let's dance, or something like that anyway!

I met Viola in the desert, she wanted to know everything and was happy that I'd had saved Glydial. She told me of her sister Mayita. She stopped by here two weeks ago on her way to the jungle.
That's where I should go soon, but first I'll see what's in it for me around here.
You know, I do not like Humans very much - not even on my plate.

Guardian of Souls
Pale Death with impartial tread beats at the poor man's cottage door and at the palaces of kings.
- Horace
This matter appears to be easily solved.

Hahaha! Excellent! Obviously, my ritual was successful. The Grand Inquisitor will be pleased. You should make your way to the next Inquisition base.
I will take a shortcut...
Good bye and take care, old fire salamander!
Erialc isn't a Lady, she's a dead woman.
You won't bring anyone else back from the realm of the dead, magician!
Oh ... and they should be dry, too.
Armor bearers might be a good addition to our fighting strength.
Oh Kuan! Grant me courage and stamina!
Peace is dreary and monotonous - but good for one's health.
A God's reward beckons only to the brave and noble.
An old maxim of the Gods: After battle is before battle.
I spend each night before a battle in the Temple.
The smith forged me an excellent sword.
Everyday, I devote my high fighting abilities to the Gods.
Praying and fasting make one well prepared for battle.
I wonder what this doll could tell me if it was able to speak...
If you want to know about the side effects just ask me!
Intruders have been terminated. Energy source of protective shield is now accessible.
Unusable for me. Maybe I can barter it.
Suzy the Seraphim said "Where's a PlanetGuardian when you need one?"
The last thing Tharkane saw was the spine of "The Codex of Daemons" as it opened and and a Daemon plucked the heart still beating... leaving the eyes undamaged.
I've reached the entrance to the tunnel. Let's see what awaits me here.
I'll be happy to do so!
I have good and bad news for you, lizard: The good news is that you will make an excellent handbag...

Our mission is complete. You were a great help in the fight against corruption and Thylysium's Senate owes you its gratitude.
I'm going to take the prisoners to the capital city and I hope you have a good trip. I also have a small reward for you. May Lumen light your way my friend.
Thank you! We never could have repelled the cultists without your help. If not for you Aunt Hussilie’s bones would be scattered everywhere, and she doesn’t deserve that. Thank you again!
You doubt my abilities? All right, let me give you a demonstration.
I have poisoned Lavella's nightcap. If she drinks it, she will sleep forever.
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Malevolent Champion and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Yeah, you can run but I will still get my experience points from you!
Pardon me for thinking that you were a child. But with your permission, I would still like to confront the monster.
Because of you I have bad dreams every night.
No please! I'm so afraid of you!
My mother always says you are an embarrassment to womankind.
Bob was happy and will get to work now. It's nice to make people happy with simple things.
That's not going to make me die any faster...
I'm usually a very patient person - but this has gone on long enough!
You find this amusing, don't you?
Argh! Okay... I'll talk... I'll TALK!
I found a rain leaf. I hope it works.
My brothers are dead. We can’t protect the grave any longer. What a calamity!

Stefan Ruthenberg
Hey, how much is the sound of a left, male footstep on gravel when you buy it from someone else?
Ah, here it is, 2 meters 10 Euro.
Sure, it costs an arm and a leg to be one step beyond.
Did Nomengalus send you? Great! We need these parts to finish our repairs. Thank you! I’m sure Nomengalus has more work for you. He always thinks of something, doesn’t he Karol?
If a tree falls when no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?
Shank you! I had shug tebbible toofache. Take thid gold. Ids nod much, but bedder than nuffing.
Take a good look at what your brothers taught me.

I went to the Dryad island and found an Elven settlement. The priestess told me that the Elves are being tolerated on the island because they fight off repeated invasions from the Wastelands with their ships. She also said that the Queen's decision is not really popular among the Dryads. Many of them think that the Elves are destroying the island by farming, mining and cutting down the trees. In order to be allowed to go inland, I must first earn the Dryads' trust. There is a strip mine to the west. I must shut it down to stop the pollution of the air it causes by constantly belching clouds of smoke into the sky.

Amin the Slavetrader has a problem. One of his slaves ran away. Personally he doesn't really care, but he can't let word spread that slaves can run away from him without being punished. That's why I'm supposed to bring him the slave's head. It shouldn't be too hard to find a man half dead from dehydration in the desert.
Go forth and convert the unbelievers! They live here in town.
It isn't just Sophia's pets being brought back to life, the dead seem to be rising up all over the world. I have to put a stop to this!
I know all about Golems, that should not be a problem.

The cultists believe it is imperative that the novices cut all ties with their families, and leave the past behind them. They have demanded that I hand over the letter so they can alter its contents. Normally I would have hacked them to pieces, but the idea of manipulating the letter was just to tempting.
How far is it? I need to go to the bathroom, and I'm hungry!
Don't I know you from the underworld?
I have another daughter. Are you interested?
High Elves nobility. Blasé, no trained fighters, consider themselves the centre of the world.
Once again it was quantity over quality. Oh well, I am getting used to that. A little ambush like that keeps me fit and alert.
The landlord was glad I got some “garlic.” He's asked me to pick up his family, so we can have dinner. Somehow, I'm not hungry anymore.
Attention, player! I'm expecting further orders to continue the mission. Further orders expected to continue the mission...
The mages of the Dark Cult are history, and so are their protectors. It looks like they kept Humans as prisoners here.
Since I'm already here, I want to get as much out of this as I possibly can. You can understand that can't you?
It's a good thing that I ran into you! Be a good boy and carry my purchases home.
Oh, well, that won't be easy. I have an important errand that I have to take care of for my master.
Do you want my things to have to stay there?
Well, I can't help you there. My master will punish me If I don't complete his assignment faithfully.
Pish posh! Just send him my warmest regards!
What's that over there? A strange flying object between the trees. That can't possibly be a bird!
Where? Where is it? I don't see anything! Where is it?
I will have to take a closer look. Farewell, and I will see you again soon!
Respect! It has been long since someone emerged victorious from the arena. I am impressed!
That's life - you dream of a noble stag and come home with rabbit.
Boy oh boy - I couldn't even use this knife to slice an apple.
The Lords have asked that I shoot some red deer, but all I can spot are rabbits, rabbits and more rabbits!
I have to set up some new traps.
Oops - that jackrabbit was a cat!
Fine ... once more from the beginning.

Evil finally took hold of the Archeologist's soul and ultimately destroyed him in a most gruesome way.
We should get out of here as fast as we can. The Du'Rach don't like this idea though, and are showing up at an alarming rate.
I have been reactivated. Two entities are attacking me. I must dispose of them.
My destiny lies in the hands of the Gods...
I am in control over my life!
In this region, I must be prepared for enemies that inflict physical damage.
We must build a bridge between the living and the dead.
Look for locations of power and meditate.
Ah hah! When lightening strikes, it gets brighter... I will follow this train of thought for a bit.
I use barks to make small ships that carry my candles.
Negative energy is discharged in the earth.
Candles for the dead make a wonderful burnt offering.
Every magic ceremony requires a lot of energy.
I don't want to do a disservice to anyone.
I have access to another world and help others with it.

Destroy the mad Ogre!

Ssh! This way! Not far from here is a cave. My commander told me to scout it but a massive Ogre is in there! He is bigger and even more bloodthirsty than any Ogre you have seen before. Don't go in there unprepared. I will keep watch for you, then I can go back.
Chances are 1:1000 that I'll stand here for an extended period of time.
The Human’s injury looks bad, but I don't think he's mortally wounded. I think I’ll leave him to suffer a little bit longer.
You should watch your nutrition. That's at least three gross registered tons too many.
This energy - it is trying to take possession of me.
You are like Vermin: small, slippery and annoying!
Your family is over there - go greet them.
Simir is dead. I've completed my new task. Let's see if it was worth it.
Are you prepared to practice what you preach?
Hurry! Your leader is in danger.
The opponents in this region use mostly normal weapons.
I knew that my journey wasn't over yet.

You did it, we'll see morning again! That is wonderful news, the best in 500 years! It's also the only news, well, never mind... Here, take these diaries. I've written down the history of the baronies. Take them as a souvenir.
This plague of scorpions is a grave threat, especially for the most vulnerable in our society: the children. I must collect some scorpion's tails so that the healer can distill an anti-venom.
I will have to pay a visit to this village's Sacred Hall. The abbot won't be pleased ...
I found a locked and sealed cave. I wonder if it has anything to do with all this? I should talk to Ephrahim again.

Destroy five wild Dragon nests!

These wild Dragons are slowly but surely becoming a plague. They keep invading the compound and nibbling on any nearby Humans. That would be okay because we have plenty, the problem is that once they get into the compound they leave a hole in the wall and then the other Humans run away!
I really don't want to have to fix the compound every day and constantly chase after the Humans. We have to come up with a longterm solution for this problem, and you can help us! The wild Dragons have nests everywhere. Go find them and destroy at least five of them!
You've got a damn big mouth for someone who let himself get caught by ORCS.
After all, I didn't allow myself to be captured by Orcs.
And please do not get captured by some savages again.
Rest assured, I do know the way to the palace of the Seraphim.
You're still alive aren't you? The way I see it, I'm ahead of schedule!
Ah, you made it. I counted on you and you didn't disappoint me. Take this as a sign of my trust in you.
Your mockery will not save you now, Goblin!

You there! If my statistics are correct, you killed 200 crystal monsters. That is an extraordinary feat and demands an extraordinary reward. You may say what you like about us seraphim, but we always pay for good performance. Here, your reward.
The map I found shows the place where the band of highwaymen are hiding. I am supposed to wipe them out and take the head of their leader to the village as proof of my deed.
Flowers that can fight a monster? Remarkable.
And on top of everything - marigolds. What a weird place.
Fog monster... Marigolds... You guys live in quite an unusual place here.
Right, let's make sure that the lizards will keep busy.
That's it! Death to the Marigold pickers!
One thing is for certain, boredom isn't a problem in this area.
Pick Marigold? We should indeed put an end to that activity.

Inquisition Guard
I have never killed a man, but I have read many obituaries with great pleasure.
Detecting unusually large scorpion. Engage fighting mode.
Due to security reasons, trading between two heroes is only allowed if both users are logged into the PlayStation®Network.
Due to security reasons, trading between two heroes is only allowed if both users are logged into Xbox LIVE.
The scouts are dead. I can report to the soldiers that my mission was a success.
Politics just ignores what the people want!
The leading politicians do what they want anyway.
The politicians just want to spread their influence, don't you think?
Do you think that it's time for a change in politics?
Even when you're afraid of nothing - our system of fee’s will teach you some respect!
Did I just see you littering?
It was just a small piece of parchment. Nobody saw it, and nobody will be bothered by it!
Our Goddess sees everything, and she will not be pleased by it!
Do you really think Kybele would notice such a little thing? When much worse things are happening right now?
Yes, I really think so. Her eyes are wherever sins against nature are committed!
I will take that to heart, and pick up the garbage right away!
That's very laudable of you. Then the Goddess will forgive you.
One of my hyacinth's leaves are hanging terribly! I wonder if Kybele is calling it back to her?
My young trees are all a pale shade of green! Maybe I don't talk to them enough!
What am I going to do with my apple trees? They start to whine when I try to trim them!
You have one of the greenest thumbs in this whole forest. How do I restore the brilliance to my orchids?
My mushroom culture has dried up completely! Could it be because of bad soil!?
What should I do? My house has been entangled in carnivorous plants that are growing rampant!
I'm a terrible keeper of trees, right? They shake right down to their roots when they see me!
How can I get my new spruces under control? They just grow however they want to!
My ferns are growing like crazy! My mother-in-law disappeared in the thicket yesterday!
Golden clover! I wanted to get rich by cultivating it, and now it turns out to be nothing more than a weed!

Bring me some Werewolf pelts!

Ouch! My back! Oh, my back hurts so much! I can feel every single scale! That quack, er, healer recommended I try one of those new-fangled mattresses - one that’s made with wolf pelts. There’s some Werewolves living not far from here, could you kill a few and bring me their pelts?
Hard blow to the left side!
That blow was on the mark!
You're going to have to hit a lot harder than that!
That didn't really do any long term damage!
Any Hero wearing a complete armor set for the first time.
My bronchial tubes are congested and I'm coughing continuously.
Today I am supposed to process the mined material.
This work is simply too difficult for me.
The slopes need better supports in some areas.
Pick marigold? We should indeed put an end to that activity.
What was that shout? That must be the Kobold chieftain. It seems he has finally noticed that his men are dropping like flies. He's got a pretty loud voice, I give him that...
Back so soon? You're fast, but that's good! I'm going to need some time to prepare the potions.
I can't wait to see this amazing genie! I hope there’s more than hot air behind this, we have plenty of that in this region already. Hehehe!
The General is a huge Blind Guardian fan! Now we finally have all the instruments back. Now I'm excited about the concert.

Find further proof for the murder of Retga!

Murder, eh?!
Well, a letter like this is not enough evidence on its own. Retga was in agony when he wrote it. Maybe his mind was already clouded. Why don't you visit his brother Keltar? Who know, maybe you'll find some more evidence there.
The door is sealed. I should ask Ephraim about it.
Judriel sent you? I am overcome with joy! But no, my heart bleeds as I read her words. She will be soon be married to an old man!
Unable to create game: No configurable server available.

That son of a greenskin in the gambling den set his thugs on me! I killed them and whipped him within an inch of his life until he told me where to find the broker. I killed him anyway and guess what? There was a note in his pocket from the broker, with a return address of Orcish Byway! Lying swine! Glad I killed him. Served him right.

I’m finally making some progress with these pinheads. The Orcs of the Ore-Thag Clan are free, the enemy leader is dead, and I’ve earned a trip to see our exalted clanleader, who I hope is brighter than the average melon. Hi-ho, Hi-ho - it’s off to Orc I go!
40 gold bars... He wouldn't accept any less than that. Well I think the people don't have any other choice. Even so, it was still a success.
Go to the oasis south of here.
Saskia was very impressed and is now taking us back to the others. The reward was generous too.
I'm supposed to take a letter with information about the Undead Legion to Senator Nimorean while Wylmieni makes the potions.
I think there's going to be a lot of seafood soon!
I had to use force to take the teddy away from "Mother Bear" but now I can give it back to Lianara. That'll make her happy for sure.
The arena lies to the east of here. I'm sure I will find it.
You defeated him! I could hear the battle cries all the way up here, I was really scared! I can see that you were successful, that's very good.
Building a memorial? Well, I'm sure you know what you are doing.
I think I'm close. The items must be here somewhere.
Yes, dammit! Let me haunt in peace and quiet!
Don't get on my nerves, and don't even think about pointing out that I don't have them anymore!
Click me one more time and I'll come to haunt you tonight!
YES YES YES... Okay, I'll say it: BOOO! BOOOOO! Happy now?
Click as often as you want... I won't explode. That was the other game.
The behavior of these women is quite... unusual. I’ll have to watch my back until I figure out what's going on here.
I did it! All the Demons are dead. Let's see if that impressed Saskia.
The people of Eloeth-Sun need iron to ensure that new weapons are available for reinforcements. They commissioned me to order the iron in Slain Athai.
Looks like Milrinda was “mistaken”. My my .. the things that can happen ...
It was a pleasure doing business with you.

Inflicts short range fire damage and offers some resistance against fire attacks. Slightly increases the regeneration time of all combat arts within the aspect Arrant Pyromancer while the buff is active. Incandescent Skin cannot be used in conjunction with Crystal Skin.

It is better to light a single, small flame than to curse the darkness.

Indeed. Lumen once burned bright in the dark night. I had forgotten what comfort Lumen can offer. My thanks, good friend!

Love is the origin of all knowledge, just as the flame marks the birth of light.

I love the great Lumen and he has kindled a mighty fire inside my heart. Doesn't this mean that I am a part of him?

All things begin in the light.

It is only just and right for me to return to Lumen's fold. I understand.

Light enables us to enjoy the splendor of color. Light makes the world so diverse and bright.

Our world is as diverse as we mortals are. Lumen deserves my prayers. Thank you!

White is the presence of all the myriad colors within the one light. Black is the absence of color in light.

What you say is true and wise. I shall return to the fold of the great Lumen.
Back to Fisherman Gisbert at once!
It's a trap, Ambul lured me into a trap! All the spirits have disappeared, Ambul has turned into a spirit - and he's brought a few friends with him! I'll have to act quickly...
A village...Maybe I can find answers to my questions here...
Hurry! Bug carapaces have to be cleaned before anyone can drink out of them, otherwise the Thunder Gurgler goes all lumpy.
The selection process is finally over. I left all seven prisoners alive and now I'm waiting for Thylius to raid this place.

The Grand Inquisitor is not here, you will find him at the holding cells

Hehe...Nicely done!
I’m glad that old bag finally got what she deserved. Can't say I'll miss her.
If you’re looking for the Grand Inquisitor - you’ll find him at the holding cells.
There is not enough HDD space available. At least %1 more memory is required in order to create data. Exit the game and free the necessary memory.
Any Hero completing the Light Campaign.

Take the navigation crystals to Rumbolir, the director at the observatory.

Greetings sister! An astronomer from the south recently ordered some new navigation crystals for his observatory. I think his name was Rumbolir! I have finished making the crystals and I need someone to deliver them to the observatory. If you accept this task, I could teleport you to the observatory. What do you say?

Go to Clearview and speak to Officer Beniel!

I've just learned that the situation in Clearview is escalating! Many soldiers there have already fallen in battle against the hordes of the undead. We have to do something or Clearview will be lost!
In sweet... pardon me... in mage Wylmieni's letters it says that the Undead Legion can only be defeated by killing the leader, General Terus. Go to Clearview and speak with Officer Beniel first.
Don't bother me. I have to make sure that even more slaves don't escape. Come back when you have all the shackles.
TyBosso has relocated to the office, despite fierce attacks.

Gather the soul essences of ghosts!

I don't know how long we've been living like this. Decades? Centuries? Millennia even? And in all this time, the undead and the ghosts never once stopped fighting each other. I would like to know why!

Please go and kill some more ghosts for me. Maybe you can gather their soul essences. Bring me all the soul essences you collect.
You're here to collect my debt? Well then let's see if you have what it takes!
I have only done what had to be done. Now make the best of it.
All the rats have been killed. That was hard work! I should talk to the guard again now...
AAAAHH...!!! Perfect! These glands are perfect!
Is there sand under your turban?
What a discreet, friendly man. He's quite likable, even if he isn't completely honest.
My muscles, they won't obey me!

Welcome to “Ice and Blood” the Sacred 2 add-on!

Two completely new regions await adventurous explorers. There will be new quests and riddles to solve, dangers to overcome, mighty foes to defeat and new items to acquire. In short - everything a true hero can wish for!
I've seen entire forests of Aspen that trembled less than you, coward!
Please don't hesitate. He's already waiting!
That should be enough snakes to make me appear worthy in the Great Rat's beady little eyes. Now I can finally go get a rat from Dromg.
Was there anything else I had to do? Hm I can’t remember. I really must start writing a to-do list in the morning...
My qualities as an Inquisitor are not quite adequate yet for this.
Thelal royally rewarded me for my services. I will continue my journey now.
The poachers have to suffer for their crimes against nature.
Hmm.... I don't know what to do with this.
Vegetables keep disappearing from my garden, and I was wondering whether you might know anything about that!?
Vegetables? Lady, I'm not a herbivore, so your Elven vegetables aren't very tempting.
I expect a reasonable answer from you. So watch your mouth!
I won't let you to call me a thief. I don't know anything about your vegetables!
If you learn anything, let me know. A big piece of roast might be your reward!
Now, go! I do not have time to give away!
I'll report to you soon, m'lady.

Put item for forging here.
Item must contain slots.
A big city ... Many people, many tasks!
I'll wait here and cover your behind... or what's the appropriate term?
Should I wipe them off the face of the earth?

Antonio Bloise
I don't need sugar in my coffee - I am sweet enough.
Your greed will be your ruin!
This item is of no use to me.

Statue of Unity
The Elven Houses of Tyr Lysia gathered here a long time ago in order to found the empire of the High Elves. Not many High Elves care to remember this event.

If we want to prevent the Prince from taking advantage of the Devil’s Fire, we must first understand it. There is only one alchemist skilled enough to analyze the scroll. His name is Assim, and he’s living northwest of here. Would you go and bring him here?

Harr harr, come closer, I've got something for you. What do you think a pirate would do? He'd cut you open, of course, but I'm not like other pirates. I'd like to give you something really wonderful. Would you like to have it?
I should talk to the village elder.

Go into the mines and kill 10 Kobolds!

We are being overrun by Kobolds because they totally outnumber us. They've even managed to take the nearby mine. I can't attend to this matter right now, but you've already proven your bravery. Would you go into the mine and teach those Kobolds a lesson? It would probably scare them enough if you killed ten of them.
A little girl is going to get beaten by a guard, I have to step in!
Barradei didn't seem to be very bothered by his assistant's death. He'll have to work on his recipe a bit more, but luckily he was still willing to pay me.

Defeat five fire-flowers!

Greetings! If I'm not mistaken my brother sent you. My first task is to defeat five fire-flowers. Return to me when the deed is done.
There's the treasure chest! Now let's find out what's in it.
Buzz off or I'll have your tongue.
Ah, what a fine life we lead! Plenty to kill and plenty of plunder! Happy hunting my friend!
I can't wait to stand in battle with you and your brothers again!
I'm so tired, my friend... I've been out murdering and pillaging all night...
Oh but you're SO green today! And you were absolutely merciless in battle! Fantastic!
I hope all this peace and quiet will be over some day soon! All my swords are starting to rust...
Ah, my old friend - The Green Reaper! I hope you're still as brutal and merciless as ever!
Is that blood on your sword? That looks just fantastic, good brother. We should go to war again together soon!
An eye for an eye and a head for head! We are the best and bloodthirstiest of warriors! I wish you good luck in all your wars, my friend!
Death and destruction to all that is not green! Victory to us!
Ahoy! Its good to see you have returned unharmed! Our last battle was hard but full of glory!
Only the bravest are green! May all your ambushes and traps meet with success!
By all the Great Green Ones! You're still covered with the blood of your enemies... and you look fantastic!
Praise the Gods of war! You are still alive and killing! It's a sight to fill my heart with courage!
Death and destruction to all our enemies! With you on our side, we can never lose!
I'll see you at our next ambush, my friend! Cutting throats is so much fun when you are around!
Keep moving. I feel nauseous just at the sight of you.
You probably stole from the merchants when you were a child.
Take your place in the army of the dead!
Girls with guns! Strangers are so funny...
We're going to play “Crack the Elf” soon - do you want to play too?
The fairy tale lady with light weapons. Hee hee...
So large and yet so easy to kill ... a tragedy.
Could I learn the songs of cleansing I hear you spiritual people sing so often?
I would like to learn a song of healing that's loud enough to drown out the constant bickering of my wife. Can you help me?
Do you think my voice is strong enough to learn your songs of healing?
I admire your magic songs of healing. Would you teach them to me?
Is it alright for simple folk to sing a song of healing for their aches and pains?
My scales are dull and I'm not feeling well. Do you have a song for me?
Why am I not allowed to use the songs of healing for my own good?
I would like to teach myself the wise songs of the healers. What do you think?
Wouldn't it be healthier if everyone studied the songs of healing?
Would you help me learn the healing songs?
I have no time for you.
Fantastic! That’s exactly what I need! Thank you very much!
Oh! Kernforce is dead! Too bad. Now she won't be able to finish her new book.
I'm very close to the target area.
I have obtained the shackles. I hope that Brutus Plutokratio will pay me well for them!
What I'd prefer to do? Wring your neck. But that doesn't seem to be an option. So I'll just get you that magic potion!
The weapon for ice damage does not help me here.
Yes that's true, but at least I'm having one or two secret affairs. Don't tell anyone!

Do you have the head? Yes! There it is. Hey how are you, you scoundrel? You look a little funny without your body.
As for you, here is the bounty. You've earned it.
Oh, there you are. I see you found the stolen goods. Very good. I thank you on behalf of the whole village. Take this as a token of our gratitude.
By all the Gods, a real heroine! May I shake your hand?
So you killed those Kobolds? My good-for-nothing husband should take a page out of your book!
You may have killed Kobolds and wild animals, but that alone does not make you special!
You killed the leader of the Kobolds? Would you mind if I told my husband to pay you a visit sometime?
Do you still have time for feelings when you fight that much?
You seem to be very aggressive!
Your life seems to be quite dangerous!
What do you think? Sometimes emotions can be quite confusing, can't they?
Isn't it disturbing when a person gets hysterical?

Tayjun, the leader of the hunters at the camp, has asked me to take care of the Guardians of the Forest. Those Dryads are constantly disturbing the work of his hunters.
I've been promised an object that would make killing Dryads well worth my time.
When I'm done with you, priest, you'll wish to never have  left the abbey.
I have no idea why the general is so generous, but I don't care! Did you know that General Barimak has never seen a battlefield up close? They say he pulled some strings to become general.
I want to take you Humans seriously... but YOU DON'T GIVE ME A CHANCE!
Significantly increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Nefarious Netherworld. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
One has to be careful these days - the innkeeper from "The Stag" has already been locked up for watering the wine.
Soldiers often don't stop drinking until they fall down.
All you ever do now is drink - you do all your eating at home.
Bah, it's such a filthy bar-room! But the soldiers seem to like it that way...
Drunken horse riders have to give their reins to me.
The commander was satisfied with my work and he has more assignments for me.
You want my wine? I would gladly give you a bottle to try, if it weren't for those damned spiders in my basement. If you rid the basement of these creatures, I will give you a sample.
Dryads are creatures from the woods. They are closely tied to nature, live on trees and detest everything which is not natural.
The opponents in this region generally use weapons for fire based damage.
Decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Exalted Warrior and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Great, we can continue now. Ready?
Beniel sent you? I'm fine thanks. Some undead tried to get through here. I whacked them with mother's flower vase. But my family seems to be having a few problems. Please go check on them.
Sometimes, a kick to the right place can work wonders. I deactivated the collector and now I can go and tell the seraphim where to find it. It's up to them to find a way to repair it.
Some folks call us the sons of poverty.
If I got a bonus for every enemy I killed, I'd start trying harder.
I'll have to show the blacksmith my weapon - perhaps he can make some improvements.
The pay for my last battle was a bit low.
Some like to prove their worth in battle - I like to earn my pay.
I've cleansed the blade. An undead appeared, but I managed to convince him that life and death are better kept separate. He said he would do anything so that his descendants could live.
Thanks to you the road is safe again!
You can look forward to your next reactivation, warrior.
You come from shadows, you go back to shadows.
Undead thug, you dare to pester us?
Endless suffering awaits you, human scum!
You had so much potential, Shadow Warrior...
I trust that my plan is simple enough for you to follow?
Mark my words, this is but one battle won in a lost war!

Kill the ice phoenix and bring me its head!

I am confident that you can win the challenge! Yes, you really have a chance. Well then! Go to the ice region and try your luck. If you are successful, bring me the head of that creature.
When I told him everything Dundiel turned as pale as a sheet and drew his weapon!
Let us go and not waste any time! After all, we are not immortal.
Uplifted Force - Improves the energy field.
Improved Reflection - Increases the chance to reflect projectile damage.
Improved Mirror - Increases the chance to reflect spell damage.

Now I get it! Ophtanar has been planning this all along and now he is killing his own people because he doesn't want them to know that he's done a runner with the money. Scum, death is far too good for him!
Hey archer, is that all you got?
Soon you won't be able to tell who's riding and who's being ridden ...

Catch a few Orcs for my unholy experiments.

Who are you? Ah an adventurer, very good. You can do something for me. I'm transforming Orcs into undead minions and my need for fresh supplies is urgent. Soon my army will be large enough to control the whole world!
Get me a few Orcs.
There are no enemies of equal rank left in this region.
Watch out! Those folks down there have the Black Fever. Don't go near them unless you can heal the disease!

I brought the book to the historian, and when I gave it to him a letter that had been stuck between the pages fell out. The writer mentions a dispute between two baronies. He even supplied a small map. Maybe the historian knows something about this.
Body or none, you shall suffer!
By the ghosts of the ancient dragons ... how can that be?
I was already fighting back when you Orcs where still digging in the mud and ate worms.
You may have defeated the Cranach and the Golem... but if you just dare to look at my husband too long, I'll scratch your eyes out!
You must be the one who defeated the Carnach and that Golem.
Well done, that water monster business! I've always said it, it should be us women ruling the world!
Wow! Everybody out of the way! There comes the Princess who beat up the fog!
You defeated a water monster, didn't you? So what? I defeat that drunk, night after night, when he comes staggering home.
Thanks a lot! Finally, I can do my work again and the town will not be swamped with stinking sewage.
Don't be surprised if I'm still occupied!
I still need to hear your opinion, revered one.
You know the ghosts better than me, so tell me this:
I also need your wise counsel regarding another matter.
Would you give me your advice on another thing too?
I need your help again, revered one!
Then I have to bother you with another thing.
Would it be possible to seek your counsel in another matter too?
I need more advice from you. It's very important for me.
I don't want to steal your time, but I'd like to hear your opinion.
Your good deeds do not impress us!
I've been ordered to hunt you down!
We don't care about your good reputation, we have a job to do!
What you're doing for others doesn't matter. You have to die!
Ingratitude is the wage of the world!

Excellent, fantastic. That will teach them. At the very least it will be a warning to the others not to run away. You shouldn't do that. That's just bad manners.
Here is your gold.
I will not help a heretic like you! Do you want me to put your faith to the test?
Hackers will be shot, survivors will be prosecuted.
You could end up here, for breaking the law
TyBosso said I could stop by at Mayita's. She's working in the jungle at the moment.
Look at the butterflies, they're so cute.
Those who master the arena will also master life.
Didn't we meet in the underworld?
Did you find my son? He must be down at the river bank somewhere.
We don't need any know-it-alls here!
It's absurd, that you have labelled yourself the big man!
What kind of a nincompoop are you?

Antique Statue
After all these centuries still in impressive shape.
You'll be even shorter once I'm done with you!
I’ve gathered some Hydra tongues. Now maybe I can find out why these tongues are so important.
This must be it. It looks like the ruins of a large building. Something is moving over there! I must be careful.
When these beasts refuse to obey me, I take my whip to them.
This breakfast will set me up for a good day's work.
My mare is more than fair.
This job just fell into my lap really.
I prefer to purchase black horses.
I work hard to make enough gold.
My horses' strength is all in their hind legs.
Some rogue has stolen my dun-coloured horse from the paddock.
When I tried to break in my new horse, it threw me off!
I will give it a try. Thank you. And - oh! I recommend a cold shower.

Legend has it that there are many ancient and secret treasures from the first days of our civilization to be found below Hissil'Ta Fortress. Go to the fortress and see if you can find anything useful.
I always thought Dragons to be a little smarter.

Find Jana, the thief.

Not long ago I was a wealthy and distinguished man within this community, then this nouveau riche fellow named Goldman turned up. He put up a grand performance and convinced the Inquisitor that I was using my wealth to support and liberate faith in this country. The Inquisitor expropriated my possessions and exiled me from the city.

Since then I have been living in this old port. No more wealth for me, and I want Goldman to suffer for that. He is well-guarded but I know a thief, she might be able to help you.

Kill the Fury Broodmother and a dozen of the cowardly Thraconians, who have chosen to be taken to the realm of the dead by the Furies.

You... you don't look like one of us. Yet you are here and demand my guidance. I will guide you - into battles for honor and glory. First you must prove that you are worthy by crushing my enemies. They are Furies, followers of my deceased brother. They take away my Thraconians and lead them into the realm of the dead. Kill their Broodmother and kill the treacherous Thraconians who have decided against an honorable life.
The battle left its marks on this village.
My family's honor is at stake.
And just where do you intend to hide, coward?
I hate to think about it, but could we really be asked to crush the revolts of our own people?
In the east there was another one of these so-called hunger revolts! We have to take a tougher approach to such actions.
New revolts are reported from the impoverished villages. This means that someone is taking advantage of the situation, right?
I don't trust that! Especially not the peace in the villages, there's always a new agitator ready to step up with a plan!
Even if I don't believe in a revolution, isn't it true that the unhappy stir up the people up more and more?
The people are getting restless. They're starving and rebellious. That's our biggest problem.
Do you think there are insurgents in our midst? Should we be more careful?
I'm glad our superiors are finally breaking up these hunger riots. The army's not at fault here.
We have to be prepared. Our own people might stab us in the back. What do you think?
The people and the army used to stand together, but nowadays they seem to distrust and even hate us.
8... 9... 10... I have killed ten of the animals. Time to return to the gardener.
That better not leave a mark!
There are tracks from a fisherman here, but nothing else. I have to look elsewhere.
I couldn't find an illegal fisherman here either, just a few tracks. I should follow them.
Nothing again, but he can't be far.
It doesn't seem to be the first time you've travelled here.
You are very good - but far from perfect.
People already talk about you a lot.
It doesn't look like this is the first time you've gone into battle.
You seem to have fought one or two quarrels already.
The rest is up to you. Wreak havoc on Jorge and his henchmen.

Get Brutus Plutocratio ten slave shackles!

Humans! Pah! They just don't understand that they're better off here. Ungrateful rabble! Some Human slaves have escaped from me. They're practically worthless because no one will touch merchandise like them, but I can't tolerate their escape or everyone would try to run. I, Brutus Plutocratio, have to set an example.

Do you want to earn good money? Catch the fugitives and bring back their shackles as proof of your success. I've already sent men of my own, but I could still use your help.
Where are you going at this hour?
Me? I'm going to the tavern - or is it closed now?
To the tavern? You? Do you really think they'll serve you? We prefer to stay among ourselves.
I don't want to drink, I just want to take part in the competition.
Aha! A beauty contest, I assume. But don't raise your hopes too high.
No, no, no... It's an arm wrestling competition, and the victor gets a cup.
Ah, that's right, I'd forgotten about it. I should warn my neighbour, he wanted to take part too.
Warn? Why are you planning to warn him? Never mind, I have to go. I don't want to be late.

Gravestone
No woman marries for money; they are all clever enough, before marrying a millionaire, to fall in love with him first.
- Cesare Pavese
Hmph! You don't know anything about compassion!
Are you familiar with the word "friendly?"
Only the envious commit evil deeds.

Gravestone
Here rests Tim Albersmann. The poisonous herb was his nemesis!
I think my services are preferred in other regions...

Obtain 10 red garnets and give them to the Ngrunz-Narsch!

Do you know anything about garnets? No? Well then pay attention: You will find them in the Ngrunz cave. There, terrible creatures guard them. Obtaining them will bring you great honor, and Kuan thinks quite highly of those who obtain honor in battle.

But, the Ngrunz-Narsch also dwells deep within this cave. If you go up against this creature without sufficient garnets, you will be torn to shreds like a piece of parchment paper! If you have sufficient garnets however, you can face the Ngrunz-Narsch and be honored.

Perhaps you would like to find some garnets and go up against the Ngrunz-Narsch.
We will no longer be suppressed by the Elves!
I'm going to look for the "X" on my treasure map now. I'm curious to see what riches await me.
It’s the only way they'll learn!
I met Lady Mirwiell. I wonder what I can do for her and the militia.
This magic boost comes in handy.
Do go now, we have nothing left to talk about.
Creation wants to be lead, not dominated.
Every Human who dares to stand against me is making a lethal mistake
It was nice talking to you again!
I'll take your thoughts and your inspiration with me!
Thanks for this nice conversation from brother to brother!
It was a pleasure talking to you!
Please visit me again soon. It's always uplifting talking to you.
May we meet again soon so that we can continue our conversation.
The ancestors are calling me! Sorry, but I have to go, brother!
I’ll take my leave as I have some ceremonies to prepare.
I'm going to devote myself to our forefathers again! Thanks for your stimulating thoughts!
I can't stay any longer! The ancestors are probably looking for me already!
You know, the hunting season for everything below 3 feet has been recently opened

Christiane Clarenbach
Maternity Break - be right back.
The Sheik's undead adjutant made an army of skeleton warriors rise up and attack me.
Ursaron. Huge. Hairy. Like to growl and eat honey. You'll find them, I'm sure.

Gravestone
I distrust camels, and anyone else who can go a week without a drink.
I don't brake for rabid animals!
Farek, the historian, was surprised by the successful outcome of my adventure. I've given him the diaries so that he can chronicle the history of the baronies in his next book.
Mary Ann and her lover have left the underworld.
Congratulations! You are an excellent warrior.
Kindness seems to be your middle name, and no doubt you're a great warrior too.
Well - saber rattling seems to be the nature of women.
That's it for now. Seraphim Bornia can get to work.

It's you? Great! Get me out of here! These guys intercepted me just before the border, now they want to sacrifice me to some monster. You came along in the nick of time. Can you help me get out of here?
You Seraphim think we are only lowly creatures!
You angels never cared about us!
In a minute there will be one less angel!
No matter how much you fluff up - I'm not afraid.
Some unsavory characters had made the cave their home, but they were so drunk that they didn't put up a fight.

The Kuan priest of the Rock Temple has told me what is needed for Kuan's blessing. I must sacrifice the sword of a stone warrior and some clean water at the temple. Afterward, the priest will bless me.
I could only use this as door stopper.

Find Steelnose Forino and beat him!

The stolen map is more helpful than we thought! Not only does it have the landing sites, it also shows the places where they hide their ships! If I'm not mistaken there's also a mark to show where Steelnose Forino is right now. That's a strange name, I know. I heard he gets quite annoyed when someone mentions his fake nose. Once he even hung someone on the yardarm just because he said "Gesundheit" when no one sneezed...

Anyway he's the leader of the whole pack, and there's a nice price on his head. He should be at the cliffs not far from here. If you kill him it would be a blow these scoundrels would feel for a long time!
Oh, come on! I'll have your head and you go back to sleep.
You can't equip this type of mount.
The trader's son gave me a letter for TyBosso DeElfici so that he might help me.
You failed! I will never get over the loss of my family! I hope something horrible happens to you, you wanna-be hero!
Increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Devout Guardian. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.

You're the relief? Fine then we can start making our way back. Here are the goods. Nothing special, but good help is hard to find nowadays. Be careful with the big one over there. He is extremely aggressive and quick-tempered.
That's done, I've completed my assignment.
Do you work to preserve the integrity of nature too?
Unfortunately, I don't have time to chit chat.
Please pardon me for being in your way.
It's you! I will have to tell my girlfriends all about it over our next cup of tree root tea.
Keep it up! Only the courageous deserve fame!
The problems with rats will never be solved completely...
Is nothing else left of the shipment? Great. That's what you get for dealing with amateurs.
Who is ...? Take up your weapons!
I already checked. Death doesn't pay attention to names either.
You do not play with Temple Guardians!

Fetch my mop! And my bucket!

I've never seen something like it! Really! Unbelievable! This mess! And I have to clean it all up all on account of me being the camp cleaner! Unbelievable!
And now they've stolen my mop, too! Only the handle, though, the cloth is still there! And the bucket! How am I supposed to be cleaning without my mop and bucket? Huh? Maybe YOU have got an idea? No? Well, then you could at least help me to find my mop and bucket.
I’m sure that reinforcements will arrive soon to take care of the Kobolds. You don’t have to worry about them anymore.
I will destroy everything that gets in my way.
This is sad, I'm so much less inclined to pray for these worthless people.
You work like a slave for the people of Kuan, and they try to pay you with bread crumbs. That's really enraging!
I'm going to put one or two of them in the pillory if it doesn't stop! Maybe that'll help!
They think of nothing but themselves, it's true. Kuan will give them something better to think about!
In the future I'll curse everyone who thinks he doesn't have to pull out his purse!
Filthy and cursed rabble! We pray the whole day long for their well-being, and they try to betray us!
We'll handle it! After some bloody trials by ordeal, our treasury will overflow with gold again.
No worries! I already set up a donation committee, and there are some blood-thirsty fellows among the members!
If the gold won't come to Kuan, Kuan has to go where the gold is! That will be a surprise for these cheap Orcs!
We'll find ways and means, that's for sure! We hanged a lot of believers for a lot less than this.
Until I come up with better name for you, I'll call you "thing."
There's an old path leading out of the dried up river bed at this point. We have to turn east.
<pain, sharp, like pricked with a needle> Ay!
Go build sandcastles. Maybe you're good enough for that.
Even Better, we'll soon see what an Orc looks like from the inside!

Keeper of the Shrine
Slow but sure moves the might of the Gods.

- Euripides

Gnarl's stock of Goblin brains is depleted. They're not something I usually carry around, so I'll have to go get him five Goblin brains as ingredients for this... delicacy.
He also needs some livers. If the Orcs knew what they were eating...
He promised me to live as one with nature from now on and he was grateful for my help. Evidently, Humans are more tolerant than Elves.

Voralion, advisor to a nobleman, wants some shadow herb from a cave.

My name is Voralion and I am an advisor to a nobleman of high birth. You look like someone who might be interested in a rather confidential business proposition. This is good because I really couldn't make this offer to one of my blithering servants or anyone else in this town. It's very confidential.
You see, I need shadow herb, which can only be found in caves. Ten bundles would be sufficient. Unfortunately all kinds of dangerous creatures roam these caves, but should you manage to get me some herbs, I would pay you well. I also might have another interesting offer for you afterwards. What do you say?

Oh thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Oh here, this is for you. Daddy always says this orb protects him from all the poisons out here, but now he doesn't need it anymore.
He says it doesn't help if you just carry it around in your backpack, but I don't know what that means.
WHAT? You believe Blackhammer’s lies? You have betrayed the cult! Draw your weapon and prepare to die!
Even if you had 15 arms I wouldn't be scared of you.
Alms? Give gold to the poor? Surely that would be a waste of gold?
Those soldiers weren't great heroes. Resurrecting them would be a waste of time. I should speak with the woman...

Ah! You certainly killed a lot of those little beggars! Not that it will help much, they multiply faster than we can kill them! Don’t you worry about that though, here is the bounty that you were promised.
What is that supposed to be? A remake of "Trinity is still my name?"
It couldn't be avoided, I had to defend glory and honor with my heroism and my sense of justice. The fittest will always win, it's a law of nature.
So you found me, creature of the other world! You know that I won't surrender. This is my realm, and I am stronger than you think! DIE!
Very good, ma friend. Not hard, yes? Last I only need da garlic, ita new spice. Go to da market, get clove of da garlic.
How many would you like to collect?
The air's going to get thin down there pretty soon!
Schmucker was pleased and allowed me to decorate the tree.
Once I was well-fed and beautiful - but I'm not sure that it shows anymore.
Stick up for the poor women, and the Gods will reward you for it!
My children are starving. Can you live with that knowledge?
Oh, you are listening to me!
Please move along if you are not willing to give us any alms!
I don't like you. Go away!
You look like you're ready for Halloween in those clothes!
You make me think that you really enjoy being evil!
The village elder has a task for me. I should go and speak with him.
We found the dagger and Gnarler's career is back on its tracks... except for... well, let's forget about that.
Ali's setting his guards on me. I knew he would, and I doubt that they will impress me.
Interesting that scum can have a basis for comparison.
You want the map? Get me the goods!
I am on my guard. Nobody will squeeze past me unnoticed.
Don’t forget I still owe you a coffin! I'll make you one with fine woods, silver handles and your initials engraved on the lid!
Oh yeah! They say that the pen is mightier than the sword. It's lucky for me that I carry an axe.
Yeah! That sounds a lot better than an old banjo. Thanks man.
Yeah, come to me my beautiful drum sticks. NOW we can start the show, tell Hansi we're ready.
Who do you take me for?

Bettina Wegner
When the parcel express turns up send it to Peter K.

I met Khormynth. He seemed to remember me from somewhere. But from where? No idea ...
He told me the reason for the battle and the hatred between him and Diaanja. An Abishai of Dissension is responsible for it. It's a very strange creature that sows dissension and feeds on the blood spilled as a result of its machinations.
There is a cave to the north of here where the creature created a lake of blood. This lake is its fountain of life. Khormynth said that the blood of the lake must be neutralized in order to weaken the Abishai. He agreed to perform the necessary ritual, but he needs the blood of three flying eye champions and five small piles of sulfur. As soon as I have the items, I should meet him at the cave entrance.
Yeah yeah, ghosts were already boring while I was at the academy...
<pain, muffled, like hit to the stomach> oof!
Thank you for your commitment! I hope we'll be able to free the kidnapped count Gartawyen soon. The regular dungeons of the Inquisitors are pure hell, so their secret dungeon has to be a lot worse!

Greetings. A lovely day, isn't it?

I just said to my fellow sister Eukalypsia - Eukalypsia, I said, today is a day created by the Gods. We should be grateful to the Gods. Naturally, we mustn't let a day such as this go by and waste it with idleness. However, I am certain that the Gods would not object to combining pleasure with being useful. Caring for the lawn and doing general garden work does have some meditative character, don't you think? I don't know about you, but I find it very relaxing to cut back the fruit trees while singing praise to Kybele. You should try it, for sure.
I have arrived in Wargfels. Varmin should be here somewhere.
Gather around people - here comes prey!
Go, go! There's work to do!

Two brigands asked me to protect their camp from a patrol. In return they have offered to introduce me to some very influential people.
You can never make too many acquaintances.

There you are again. Rina Boombastic told me that you took care of her problems. No I don't want to know how, as long as I get good merchandise from her again. I'm in your debt, here's your well earned reward.
Follow me or I'll deactivate you.
Banishes weaker spells within its range and instills fear in nearby opponents.
You did it. I didn't think you could. I will tell our Master of the Hunt about your deeds. You can find him in Ruka.
The Priest is looking for a scroll just like that. Now he can perform the ritual.

So you're looking for jade. That won't be cheap. You'll have to buy it from our leader, Kurt the Cunning. Life's expensive, even when you live in a mine. But Kurt will surely... hey! What are you doing? ALARM!
Their camp isn't far from here. Please help us!
Lets see if we can find some fun in this town - fun for me anyway. Ha-ha!
The pleasure was all mine! I bless you my child!
So be it! May Kybele be with you and with all of us!
May Kybele's blessing lead you to safety always.
I'm glad you understood me! You are a good child.
I'm nothing and Kybele is everything. Never forget that.
Without guidance from the Goddess, I wouldn't have been able to help you. See you soon.
Kybele was my word and Kybele was speaking through me. By all holy roots.
I thank you my wonderful child. Go forth and be blessed.
The Goddess will protect you. Take her blessing.
Many thanks, my devout child! Those are the words of a true believer.
That reminds me that I can't eat anymore!
I'll finish off TyBosso with Mayita's help.
Thanks! You had our backs with that move!
A chicken crossing the road: poultry in motion.
This is the starting point for the search. Well then, let's get started ...
I'll personally take care of it.
Our troops are too weak! We need more soldiers in our ranks, don't you think?
The army needs fresh blood! Any creatures, who know their trade of killing, would be enough!
We need new weapons and even better creatures for the fight, otherwise we'll be destroyed on the battlefield!
Why aren't we equipping these people, that we call OUR ARMY, any better?
If we don't act soon and enlarge the army we'll have a lot of problems!
What can you say about our army? It's imperative that we invest in new and deadlier weapons!
Our troops are getting weaker and weaker! Why aren't we getting any better weapons?
The army's too weak, can you see it? We desperately need more suitable soldiers!
Soon the enemy will defeat us! We must reinforce the army!
Better weapons, fearless warriors! That's the only way to be victorious in the long run!
Damn ... looks like you are a serious opponent!
I'm not experienced enough to use this item.

Memorial
In memoriam of the victims of the great accident in the Ikarion mine.
Poul Brotheuse has asked me to retrieve his herbs from the robbers.
You are used to taking orders, right? Well then ... DIE!
You will find the port near the water. You can’t miss it.
The Christmas Ogre came out of his cave. While he was sleeping though, some jealous Dark Fairies stole his costume. He asked me to return it to him.
Why didn't you just fight to the death? Then they would have been spared imprisonment.
What am I supposed to do with all this junk?
I'm hit! I'm dying! - Just joking...

Find the key to the tomb!

We're right in the middle of digging for hidden treasures. Since you're here, why don't you make yourself useful? Go find the key to the tomb! Bring it to me as soon as you find it.
What kind of tricks do you have up your sleeve?
I'll tear you to pieces, Elf!
I think the opponents in this region are a bit too strong for me.
I've defeated the guardian, the entrance to the pyramid is now clear.
Watch it, curse you! No unnecessary cuts!
Let me take a guess... third sphere? Or fourth already?

Kill five Bedouin in the west camp and bring me their hearts as proof of your actions!

Listen to me stranger. The Bedouin camp with which we have been enemies for many moons is located to the west of here. No one really knows what caused this bloody feud. The only thing that matters is that we emerge victorious. You can help us by infiltrating the camp, killing five of them, and bringing me their hearts as proof of your bravery. If you succeed, a very powerful weapon will be your reward.
Tormenting harmless Elves, that's all you're good at.
You need some more blood sacrifices?
They're warming up hell for you!
One day you'll pay for everything.
There was a small reward in it for me. The Guardian doesn't seem too happy. Maybe there are more poachers around.
Thank you! Kuan will reward you, but here's something from me as well.
Back to the wadi with you!
I'd like to have a word with you, bony little creature! Somebody stole my wife's finest booty jewellery, and I've got a guess as to who.
Be careful with your guessing! We aren't thieves. And we tend to feel insulted very fast.
The culprit crawled through a very tiny window. Do you really think an Ogre could have done this?
You can't prove anything! Not anything at all!
Oh no? Could you explain to me why you're wearing a woman's ring on your finger?
This... Yes, my mother. I inherited it from her. That's why. It reminds me of her.
Everybody knows that your mothers abandon you. Just wait, I'll see through your game soon enough!
We shall see about that, stupid Orc!
I am forever indebted to you!

Education is a method whereby one acquires a higher grade of prejudices.

- Peter
Don't worry. I know a thing or two about fire.
I will help you. And trust me: Gold is of no value to me.
Fear not, I do not have my eye on gold.
Don't worry. I'm not interested in worldly possessions. I will fetch the scroll.
Don't worry, gold isn't what I'm after.
I do not understand the concept of greed, so rest assured that I am immune to temptation.
I can't kill anyone with that.
Take the amulet back to its owner now.

All human actions have one or more of these seven causes: chance, nature, compulsion, habit, reason, passion, and desire.

Now this one ... and that ... yep! Now I must find the zombie that resembles my sketch.

Further decreases the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.
My goodness! You must be the most distinctive gentleman I've ever met in these woods!
I beg your pardon, young lady?
Well, with all those muscles of yours, you're giving me a greater sense of security than anyone ever has before!
Ah, yes, that might be. But first and foremost I'm responsible for the protection of the general public.
And I'm part of the general public. Wouldn't you like to protect me in the privacy of my own home?
I'm sorry, I'm not allowed to leave my post.
That's too bad, really. Oh look, I see another handsome guard right over there! I must be going now.
Thank Goddess! I mean, good luck!
Tell old Saewald I said hi and remind him that he still has my "Succubus - Breeding and Nurturing“ book!
There's no usable cloth here. I'll search somewhere else.

Wonderful! Thank you! That old... pardon, Hanthar will be very pleased!

The Djinn is dead. Spilled milk... so to speak.
It's a shame. A Jinn who can grant wishes would be nice from time to time.
That one's tough. I've got to be damn careful.
I find taverns distasteful... but oh well.
A mage stole an artifact from the local Temple and is going to try to extract the magical energy from it. I'm supposed to find the mage and take the artifact from him. Well let's get to work!

It is impossible to defeat an ignorant man in argument.

- McAdoo

Find the missing huntress and save her!

Hopefully, you can help me solve a problem. The high priestess of Kybele's main temple is waiting for oblations that she urgently needs for an ordination. She has sent a huntress for them, but that was two days ago and we still haven't heard from her. We really need these oblations. Now I've been asked to look for her and the oblations. May I ask for the honor of your companionship on this quest?
Secret tunnel? Right from the start, this mission is taking me under the earth!
The archaeologist has gone completely mad. He is under the influence of a mysterious dark force.
What did the old man say? Fly, you fools!

I just remembered something I've been dying to ask you.
I'd like to hear your opinion on another matter.
Can you help me with something else?

Only ghosts seem to inhabit the village, and only the village elder seems to be aware of his death. All the others either don't know or don't want to know. Moreover, the village lies in eternal night. Maybe I can find out something about this permanent darkness.
Humans are all the same: Hollow inside with a soft shell!
Two for the price of one...

Al Sadim thanked me for my support and told me that because the Devil’s Fire is no longer a threat, he will certainly be elected as the new King in the upcoming tribal meeting. I should continue my journey by going to the jungle now.
This region does not challenge me anymore.
Your magic is as boring as your combat style.

Hello, I'm Shirka Alana. You don't know me, but this letter states that you knew my father. This piece of paper is all I have left of my family. Take a look at it. Do you know anything about my father?

So I have finally found them! Now I need to know what they have learned!

Yes! YES! That’s her collar! Look! Her name is engraved on it here. D-U-L-C-I-N-E-A. I’m so glad that I’ll at least have something to remember her by.
Here this gold is for you, you deserve it.
Get lost, shame of Ancaria's warrior women!
May the Gods protect your enemies!

Where should we dig next?

Show us how to hunt deer!

Oh a Dryad! Lucky us! Your people's hunting skills are legendary. Would you mind helping us? We are hunters trying to shoot a deer, but we barely have any experience in deer hunting. Perhaps you'd be able to show us a little something?
I swear, we will be waiting for you here.
The task is a good as done.

I have killed da... the five chickens and can now return to the landlord.

You Seraphim are responsible for this!
I would love to take a peek over the wall. I wonder what I'd see?
This wall is in fact the best thing that could happen to us, right?
I feel like a cooped up chicken! Shouldn't there be laws against this?
Why didn't they build this wall with glass? Animals in the zoo, that's what we are!
Somehow I feel secure behind these thick walls. Is that how they make you feel?
Another child fell down the wall! That thing is dangerous!
A wall never lasted in the long run. Why don't they learn from history?
I can hardly stand the sight of this anymore, what could we possibly do about this wall?
Isn't this wall the root of all evil? The beginning of the end?
I look daggers at that wall every day, but it doesn't even crumble a little.
Thank you for helping me. Without you we would have never been able to uncover this conspiracy. Take this as a small token of my appreciation!

Thank you very much! Now all I need is a bouquet of roses. It will be weeks before these rose bushes blossom again. Ogril lives just around the corner. He is an excellent rose grower, he has green fingers so to speak. Could you fetch me a bunch of roses from him? My legs are a bit weary, especially when the weather changes.

Find out about those kidnapped children.

Excuse me, I really don't mean to bother you but I just have to make a request. My husband doesn't like to talk about it, but I'm not willing to just accept it. About nine months ago, two of our children were kidnapped. We looked for them a long time but couldn't find a single trace. Not far from here, in the next village, there lives a good friend of mine. Her name is Elodriel and she said she would ask around. Would you mind talking to her to see what she found out?
Temple Guardians have no room in my world!
It worked, this fool is so eager to prattle on about his ideas to someone that he doesn’t suspect a thing. We should leave.
Well done! You fought brilliantly! We told you about our connections, now follow us and we'll take you to meet one of the most influential men in the entire region.
Please talk to the Captain, I've spoken to him already and he will take you to the Christmas Island. When you get there talk to the Head Engineer, Gundulph.
Would it be rude to ask how old you are?
I have to speak with you right away! Last night, my dead father appeared to me.
I suppose, you mean in a dream. What did he tell you, son?
It was far too real for a dream, I even felt the ground under my feet.
That's odd. Can you remember what he said?
He spoke of a grave danger, and warned me not to forget the names of the ancestors.
Danger, you say? What might he have meant by that?
I wish I knew. Do you think the whole thing was just my imagination?
No. The souls of the dead can speak to us. I will try to find an answer for you.
I have no time for you, stranger.
We don't like your kind here, stranger.
The opponents in this region use weapons inflicting mainly fire-based damage.
I'm free again! What should I do first?
The slave trader's camp should be at peace now.
The guard gave me some gold and thanked me for keeping this area safe
Great! This branch is perfect.  I'll start fixing the machine, wait right here I might need your help again.
The huntress has a blue orchid. But I will have to take it off her.
I'm about to pull something out of my hat! And - no, it won't be a bunny rabbit!
Now I have to take the drink to Barradei’s guinea pig... er, I mean assistant.
Andreala was overwhelmed with joy. She even gave me her nicest ring.
Names... they are nothing but smoke and mirrors.
Now you're showing your true self!
I'm not only morally superior to you...
The executioner is waiting for you already...
I'm supposed to eliminate the Inquisitor who's leading the clergy's campaign. He was seen while reconnoitering the area.
Priest, are you trying to stop me=
He was a very peculiar fellow...
The excavation supervisor needs to travel to the next village. I will escort him just in case.
I will worship reverently at the full moon.
A Dryad has asked me to kill the mighty "Earth Lord" who can be found on a Temple hill not far from here.
Is it possible, that you are somewhat lacking in experience.
The Gods couldn't love someone like you.
Pray! Turn from the path of evil. It is not yet too late for you!
The other three kids must be orphans. The farmer will take them in. I also gave him the robbers' gold.
Magnificent Sarcophagus of the DeElfici Family
Take this letter to her. She'll need time to prepare for the meeting.
That was the second wave. Not really demanding, either.
The Spy won't report anything to anyone anymore. I should go back to the camp.
The refugees are following us to the mine.
I'm still waiting for a prince to carry me away.
I think reliability is a virtue. Do you agree?
You radiate such compassion, it's very heartening.
I trusted you and this is how you pay me back? My reputation is ruined!
So, whole family dere and ma friend, too. Here, have tasty meal. And you, ma friend, take dis knife, ita sharp!
So the man with the jade is called Kurt. I should “talk” to him.
If I can't get my hands on the crown jewels, let me at least find something edible.
My wife will just love that dress I found hanging on the washing-line.
The apples I stole at the market didn't last long either.
The nightwatchman is a thief's natural enemy.

Simon Truempler
I hate stupid gravestone captions...
It is said that your blood has great powers. Why isn't it working for you?
Sounds like you've found your dream job.
Me squish Elves like yummy little bugs!
A conspiracy against me. Something needs to be done!
Why don't you say something clever? Or at least try to?

Have you checked all the fish traps? Well done! Wow! There's even a small pike among the catch! That will make a delicious soup!

Take this axe as a sign of my thanks. But take care - it’s very sharp!
