Find Barthus and his gang near Bluestonbury!

Wonderful! Fantastic! I'll put it in tonight. Well, you kept your end of the bargain, so I'm gonna keep mine, too. Listen closely!
The guys that robbed Njari are a group of criminals-for-hire. Their leader is a guy named Barthus, but he and his friends left Thylysium some time ago. They had to run when things got too hot 'round here. I heard they'd gone to ground near Bluestonbury in the north, close to the great wall that borders the human realm. It's said that you need a boat to get to the bandits' camp.
What did the Gods see in you machines in the first place?!
Elves, Humans, Seraphim and Dryads may die, but nature will never fade. I am convinced of that.
Look for these herbs in the meadows rather than in the jungle.
That is the tavern Goldbeard was talking about, I wonder if I’ll find that Stan inside. Perhaps I can allay his suspicions by pretending to be a gambler.
Gronkor and his troops supposedly camped here.
Oh, is it time to harvest Kobolds again?
Since I've been assigned to train greenhorns, I really started to wish I'd taken up a career in tree planting instead.  Can you imagine what it's like?
Our new generation of fighters is really worrying me! They apparently believe that the Goddess will protect them from any harm.
I really start to worry when I see our young warriors. They don't seem to want to fight. What do you think of them?
These young warriors lack discipline! How are they supposed to effectively defend us?
The young warriors really are a heavy burden aren't they? They fight like a bunch of washerwomen in the Goddess' name!
I don't want to put down our young warriors, but we should teach them that you don't use a weapon like a spade!
I have to train young warriors for Kybele again! But they simply lack the necessary discipline! Do you know what I'm talking about?
If our next generation of warriors were as nimble with their weapon arms as they are with their tongues, we could all sleep better at night.  Have you heard some of these kids?
How are we supposed to teach these young warriors to respect the enemy? They really think they're invincible!
Our young warriors are driving me crazy, you know the type? Romantic visionaries who don't listen to reason.
Oh, just drop dead, will you?
Maker, where are thou? Where is the guiding hand that brings peace to this world?

Officer Margathon wants to recruit me on the spot. I have a feeling though that I won't really fit in. Maybe I can help the troops in another way. If I find their missing general, it should boost the morale.
We do what we can, but we haven't got enough men! I will pass it on nevertheless.
It's not my fault, but in this land the protection of the living is considered to be much more important.
There's nothing I can do to change it, we can't have our eyes everywhere wise man.
Ask our commander! He makes the plans for our guards, not me!
Oh, I think we do enough. You shouldn't assume that we're not there, just because you don't see us.
I'm sure they do everything possible to protect them! Don't worry so much.
We've got our claws full with securing the borders, we can't be everywhere.
Even if it doesn't look like it, our fighters do everything they can to keep the thieves away from them!
We don't have enough fighters to man every post, but we do what we can.
I don't understand it, we've doubled the guards in this area.
Badawi isn't what it used to be.

Take this letter to my loved one!

You there! Would you please help me? Joana and I are in love, but our families are enemies and I am not welcome in her house. Our families used to roam the lands together by caravan, then Joana's family was attacked by Kobolds and her father was killed. My family got away with barely a scratch, so now Joana's family accuses us of being hand in glove with the Kobolds.
We don't care, we love each other and I'd like to send her this letter. But how? Would you help me and deliver the letter? They'll never suspect you.

Bring my dog back!

That silly dog simply ran away. He was only supposed to have a bath. But as soon as he hears the word "bath" he starts yipping. When I tried to catch him, he ran away. Can you please bring him back to me? It is dangerous out there and my mum told me not to leave the village by myself.

Potions, elixirs, alchemy supplies? I have everything available whether you're an alchemist, a novice or a consumer.

Collect the required ingredients to weaken the Abishai!

Greetings! My name is... is... um...Hergabol. That's right. Hergabol. Forgive me, I'm getting older and older and my memory fails me from time to time.
So... you're on the way to this... this thing? This Abishai? Not an easy opponent, let me tell you. I 've seen a number of heroes that tried to defeat it and failed miserably. But I've been studying it for all these years and I know a spell that can be used to weaken it. Be warned though! It may well be weakened by the spell, but it'll still be a strong opponent!
Well, if you want to give the spell a try then go and get some...hold on, I'll figure it out in a moment...
3 roots of the Redock plant! And sulphur! And two eyes from a Flayed One. You should get the eyes from the zombie trader, but sadly I can't remember his name right now. Go on ahead! I'll try to remember the formula in the meantime.
What a glorious day for me ... uhm ... the Inquisition, I mean.
It sounds like a worthy enemy!
A do-gooder like you makes a lousy pirate.
You would make a good pirate - if you were evil and drunk.
Being the good one all the time must get old quick.
You think you're better than us?
Your magic brought me back, now live with it!

Stop! Stay back! We're chasing a killer who has worried and frightened this city for months now. People say it's a monster but I think it's just a lunatic entrenched in the sewers.

I am supposed to chase a trio of brothers out of this neighborhood with Rinah. These guys want to dig up the body of their brother, who tragically left this world while being interrogated in the Inquisitors' dungeon.
I found a map on one of the smugglers. The meeting place with Zatina has been marked on it. I should go there, chat with her about the failed delivery, and kill her.

Go! Go! I see one over there!
Grab your weapons brothers and sisters!
What am I supposed to do with all this junk?
The case is solved. I've received an adequate reward from the commander.

Walking around in circles every night is so tiresome and dull.
A beautiful starry sky can make this job so much more pleasant...
All the thieves are grey at night.
Tomorrow I will herd the animals to the harvested stubble field.
There must always be enough grazing land to keep the animals from starving.
I stand by my animals in sickness and in health.
The sheep in my right pasture are shorn, those in my left still wear their wool.
I Need better protection against physical damage.
I have to send Geroda a birthday card!
That puts my mind at ease, Mother Superior.
They are not fit enemies for me.
I could not have expected this!
You won't get me this easily!

Seraphim Florentina is experimenting with crop seeds. She wants to make the crops bigger and more resistant. I'm supposed to test her new pumpkin seeds. For that I will have to sow them in a field.
I have no use for this thing!
Very good! This certainly is an important discovery. Take this scroll to the Queen, I'll keep looking around here. Maybe I'll find something else.
Out of my way Dragon, or we must fight.

The Seraphim ...! (sighs) Well, it's worth a try.
The spirits of the forest won't let me down during this mission!

Ahhh! Perfect! The cape will be fantastic! Thank you. Please, take this. You earned it.
I've apprehended the thief. He was still carrying the bag of turtle eggs. I should take them back to Mekeliel now.
I've been in this town many times before...
Maybe I can sell it? In any case, I have no use for it.

Book 1: Orcish Cooking

At first glance, Orcish cooking seems pretty plain and simple. There are not exactly many detailed and elaborated recipes to be found in the Orc cuisine. Maybe this is one of the reasons why Orcish food has become increasingly popular in the civilized areas of Ancaria during recent years. People are fed up with sophisticated, strange dishes and they want to experience the taste of nature and wilderness. Back to the roots! Or should we say: Back to the meat?

In every bigger town, there is at least one Orcish restaurant these days. More and more people seem to enjoy the unusual and exotic taste of Orcish food in combination with real event gastronomy like bar-room brawls, eating with hand and scimitar and beating up the cook after the meal. Of course, the food in those restaurants is slightly tweaked and adjusted to civilized standards. Orcs are occasionally eating things that many people would consider inedible. Many of them do not even have a name in our language, some not even in Orcish. This book has been written to give you an overview of the Orcish way of cooking and we would like to make you curious about this very special kind of food.

There are a few basic principles for Orcish cooking. The grand Orcish chef Gkratulak once described the philosophy of Orcish cooking in his (admittedly rather short) book “Orc Food for Every Day” (3. Ed.)

“Kill living being and cook it.”

Note, that in the Orcish language, there is no specific word for cooking. The corresponding word “hthak” describes the general process of preparing food. The condition of the food when it is being eaten does not really matter, neither does the type of animal. Also, the removal of skin, fur, feathers or scales is optional.
Although the above quote is - in the true charm of the Orcish tongue - a little short-spoken, the principle still holds true: Orcish cookery requires meat. Lots of meat! The more the better. There simply is no Orcish dish without meat. Or the other way round: it is not easy to find something in an Orcish dish that's NOT meat. There is an Orcish saying. They say: Karukh nah erak. Karuki toptzak an erak. (translation: If it doesn't move, eat it. If it moves, hit it. Then eat it. )

When it comes to beverages, the Orcish cuisine is even more straightforward. Orcs are drinking beer or - if they are too young for beer (1-3 years) - water. After a good feast however, they sometimes enjoy a liquor called "Chuke", but the recipe for this drink seems to be a secret and it is generally considered venomous for non-Orcish beings.

Kuan, god of War. This is the god who protects the warrior and fills him with the raging spirit he needs to succeed in battle.[insert symbol here]MythologyKuan is the divine personification of the perfect warrior. For him, fighting is the ultimate reason behind all things. All beings must fight and struggle for superiority. As soon as they stop fighting, they have lost their reason to live and deserve death. Because only fighting ensures the survival of the stronger, and the elimination of the weaker side and - thus - progress and evolution. Just like a gardener has to remove the dead branches from a tree and the surgeon has to burn out an ulcerating wound, war is there to cleanse the world and constantly eliminate everything that's not strong enough. All contrary aspects such as mercy, compassion and love are just symptoms of diluted weakness, leading to stagnation and poisoning the natural flow of things. There is no alternative to war!Kuan disdains sacrifices or pleas for his favour before battles. He will support the side that's strongest unto itself, without the aid of deities, although his spirit will encourage all warriors.AppearanceKuan is a tall warrior, wearing black, heavy armour, a black cloak that goes all the way down to his ankles and a full helmet that covers his entire head. Although his shape is obviously humanoid, it's impossible to tell what race he is.The CultKuan is omnipresent in Ancaria. There is literally no part of the world where he isn't known, and where his word and doctrines aren't being spread. Since Kuan doesn't emphasize prayers, sacrifices or being worshipped, the followers of his cult strictly focus on sharing his ideas of the world, war and the reason for living. For them, war is a religion and a god in itself. And Kuan is the driving force behind all this. This is a remarkable difference from all other churches and gods.There are no holy days in the church of Kuan. Amongst the believers, every battle is automatically considered a religious event.The symbol of Kuan is a sword sticking in a skull.Opponents and SupportersAlthough Kuan is in some ways related to Kali, he is actually a separate, isolated deity with his very own, hedonistic views, which doesn't leave much space for other philosophies.

No problem, my little Orcish friend. I will rid you of the Troll.
Trolls! I never did like them!
It does not seem to be easy to convince you Orcs.
I collected three samples. Two don't look all that pure to me. Let's see what the priest has to say about it.
We have enough evidence now to convict the Lord of the castle.
My equipment doesn't protect me enough from cold damage.
My gladiators are the best far and wide.
The general also asked me to inform the other two commandant's offices. That sounds easy, and it'll take me places.
Again, something that I have no use for.
Further increases the chance to evade hostile weapon attacks and lowers the chance to sustain critical hits.

Confront the trader!

The trader is selling stolen goods? On top of it all, he stole your baptismal necklace? Unbelievable!
I'll send two soldiers with you for your safety. Go back to the trader accompanied by them, maybe you'll be able to clear this thing up!

Jeremias the Wise
Patron of Traveling Salesmen.
Fusillade - Increases the number of frozen thorns.
Frost - Increases damage inflicted by each frozen thorn.
Devastation - Increases the chance for critical hits.
Pierce - Chance that thorns will continue to spear forward after hitting a target.
Fusillade - Increases the number of frozen thorns.
Pierce - Chance that thorns will continue to spear forward after hitting a target.
In this area, opponents are very strong, I have to be careful!

Inscription
Welcome to the Tomb of the Great Higliar.

I met an archaeologist in a campsite in the jungle. He told me that he has found the pyramid of the Lost City, but hasn't been able to enter yet because it's been guarded by a flying monster. If I want to enter it, I need to kill this guardian first. If only the path to the pyramid wasn't so overgrown.
I need a good right hand! Bring me one!

Spirli sent you?
It's no wonder nothing will grow on that field. About 70 years ago there was a cemetery on the same spot. It looks like the people buried there aren't happy to have crops growing overhead. You should visit the Priest; maybe he'll have some advice for you.
Lizardman, we have no use for you!

Well, at least there won't be a war between the clans anymore, because none of them possess Gronkor's right hand. This news however, will lower the morale of the Orc warriors as soon as they hear of it.
You know that war is only the continuation of diplomacy by different means. That's what I've read.
A war? I would like that, if the opponent was worthy.
I'm not worried. All is fair in love and war. I don't know much about the first though.
War is good! It lets the scales shine and makes us humble.
Blood, sweat and tears. That's what one of the great ancestors called it. And he was right.
War? Well if you can enjoy it like me, it's really quite marvelous.
That would be nice. Peace is only the time between two wars.
I wouldn't mind that. Would give me a chance to prove my fighting skills again.
Yes, the smell of victory and glory. How I would love to smell it again!
Nothing has meaning without war. Peace... that's a luxury no soldier can appreciate.
I got rid of all the scoundrels, but I didn't see a business partner anywhere. Perhaps I should inspect the area more closely.

Find Karl, the man who killed his fiancée.

MOVE ON, THERE'S NOTHING TO SEE! Or... wait a moment. Maybe you could be of use to us. A crime has happened here. The victim, Margret, received several blows to her head with a blunt instrument and died. We assume that Karl, her fiancé, killed her. He is almost six feet tall, thin and has a scar over his right eyebrow. Find him and bring him to us alive. But be careful, he's armed and dangerous.

The priestess gave me permission to enter the Dryad forest. She asked me to rescue a little girl, who has been kidnapped by some brigands. The Dryad scouts have found the tracks of the brigands north of here, so that's where I should start my mission.

On my way through the Human realm, I met a dying trader. With his last breath he told me that the DeElficis fled to the mountains. He also gave me an amulet he was able to take away from his killers. It's Marys' amulet!
When I think of my ungrateful servants my good mood suddenly disappears! Do you know what I mean?
Is it true that your serfs are stubborn, too?
Human servants! They are nothing but a curse. Do you have similar problems with them?
How are your Humans behaving? Am I the only one who's always displeased with them?
My disobedient servants! Why didn't I lock them in the cellar? What do you think I should do?
Oh, torture and pain! What can you do with these impudent workers?
What do you think about it, aren't these unruly Humans nothing but a burden?
Stubborn louts! Are your servants causing you a lot of pain too?
I heard your Humans are getting quite rebellious. Is this true?
Times and customs! Obedience from servants seems to be a thing of the past. Have you noticed this with your servants?
What a fight! The selection process is over and we have discovered 3 new fighters who have been put to the test for our arena. The Pasha will be pleased.
OK fog, let's fight! Eh, can you understand me at all?
I think, I've destroyed enough ghosts. The rest won't scare the laborers. Time to fetch my reward!
A strange Lizardman researcher suggested that a group of strong mummies is nearby. That sounds interesting...
What a nice welcome. Somebody's circuits seem to be still working. Let's take a look at his latest calculations.
I never really cared for nature.
I'm still lacking some practice in order to use this item.
One day some nutty magician will screw up a ritual and flood this world with you Demons.
Leave the game and return to main menu?
What kind of diabolical creature are you?
I thought you Guardians were long extinct... uhm, or maybe I should say... rusted?
Elven machine, you'll be scrap metal in a minute!
The soulless device has to be destroyed!

HANDS OFF!

The notes are mine. MINE! You wouldn't have come this far if it hadn't been for me! Now you want to reap the fruits of MY work! But it is MY success! And no-one will take what is mine. NO-ONE!

The path I chose is hard. The honor of learning dragon magic from the dragons themselves is granted only to few. True magic! Not the silly conjuring that people call magic these days. Just being magically gifted is not enough to reach this goal. No-one and nothing will keep me from fulfilling my destiny and taking what is rightfully mine ... the title of Dragon Mage.
Are you attempting to convert me?

Praise Lumen, you've come to save us!
The Du'Rach are attacking us. The soldiers were able to hold off the first wave of attacks, but only with many losses. The next attack will mean the end for us!

Follow me to Dundiel!

Who are you? Did Jarofein send you? Good that is his ring. I saw discolored tongues like this years ago when some newcomers mistook the local dreamberries for common blackberries, their tongues turned blue and they became very aggressive. Rabid actually! Afterwards we set fire to all the dreamberry bushes on the island so that it could never happen again. Let’s go to Dundiel and ask him for his opinion on the matter. He is our leader’s deputy.
It's astonishing to see what effects are created by this T-Energy.
Yes I have a little red doll. It's an heirloom. I'd gladly give it away if somebody would just save my son. He's was abducted by Kobolds a week ago, I'm afraid they may have already eaten him!
It'll take more than that to stop me! Of course I’ll continue on, and I’ll find out what’s behind all this!
It's just a flesh wound ... Ah, or what ever ...
Hey, Unlike you, I can't hit the space bar for a healing potion!
I got lucky that time. That would have gone right through my heart.
Ouch! That wouldn't have happened if I'd been wearing a mouth guard!
I was expecting the worst, cleric - but you outdid yourself!
Leave me alone, you walking prayerbook! I don't want your company.
Leave! Get lost! At least we're fighting passionately, while all you do is talk about damnation.
What do you want here, to soften the people even more with your cowardly stories of heaven?
I don't want to see you here! The people need strength, not pious words.
You better leave right now, or I'll answer your false prayers with my sword.
Hypocrite! Leave before I lose my patience.
What are you doing here, false prophet?
Your words mean nothing to me. We need men who can fight, not nuns.
You'd better leave right now, or I'll put an end to your hypocrisy with my sword.
Testa, God of Science, bestows a charge of pure T-Energy that will be unleashed against anyone in the vicinity. This force will damage opponents, and heal allies.
So the Djinn wants to fight, that was to be expected. I'm afraid he won't be enjoying his freedom for long.

Bring me some pieces of armor from the undead!

My suspicions are growing stronger, I believe the return of Terus' Legion is now imminent. The previous undead were probably a type of advance guard. I do need some more evidence to be entirely certain though, so that I don't get all worked up and pull out all the stops for nothing. The records also include a few diagrams of the Legionaries. Please kill a few undead and bring me the pieces of their armor so that I can compare them to the drawings.
Do not turn against the arm of the Gods!
If you need help, just let me know!
What's next? Let me guess ... you'll die.
Fangor has the trollcherries. There’s just one more ingredient missing.
So you're looking for Shirka Alana and her gang are you? Well, you'll find her...
The Desert Folk's attacks are getting bolder every day. We can't stop them. Maybe you could buy us some time by killing a few of them. Bring me their insignias as proof.
Be careful around those Kobolds, they can be vicious little beasts.

Claressa? She is with Antolian, the slave trader.

You are looking for Claressa? Well, she was here. I had to sell her because her father could not pay his debts. Or maybe he didn't want to pay up, I don't know.

Anyway, she is in Antolian's hideout now, he is the slave trader.
The herb woman offered me money for the herbs, but the hermit would have died without them. So she made the medicine which I will now take to the sick hermit.

Oh! You're back! I'm so glad you're alright! You found an amulet? Let me see...
No I'm not familiar with this either. It looks like it might be old. Maybe the Chronicler knows something. Go and ask him.
Have you given to the ancestors today? I've sacrificed half a piglet.
What would we do without the spirits of the deceased? I pray to them every night.
Just consider that the ancestors have given us everything we see. They deserve our worship.
Only the spirits of the dead protect us from the rage of our enemies. Don't you agree?
It's very important to respect the ancestors. They have great power over us.
If we were to stop worshiping our ancestors, the world would come to an end. That's what they say.
I believe that the spirits of the dead keep the world going. Wouldn't you agree?
What would happen to our world, if the ancestors were to stop protecting it?
Do you believe that all our prosperity depends on the goodwill of the ancestors and their spirits?
I admire the ancestors and am glad that they protect us.
You will have defeated me when my head comes away from my neck!
I can hardly wait! Soon I shall be the new tribal elder! HAHAHA!
For how much longer am I supposed to wait? If I don't get to annihilate organic life some time soon my joints will get rusty!

The Grand Inquisitor said that my job is over and demanded the key. I refused to give it to him, telling him that I'm no longer his servant.
He attacked me and I killed him, while his guards were running away like frightened little rabbits. Now nothing can stop me from achieving my destiny! It's time to enter the Great Machine and see what power awaits me...
The perfect symbiosis - a dumb mount and an even dumber rider.
Getaway - Chance to escape root spells.
Fend - Further increases the defense value.
Patch - Heals a small amount of hitpoints.
Adrenaline - The Shadow Warrior sustains less damage during the charge.
Routine - Decreases the cooldown of Ruinous Onslaught.
Adrenaline - The Shadow Warrior sustains less damage during the charge.
Please hurry. I want to start preparing the feast soon.
Cooome Fido - Fiiiido, come here. There's a good boy.

You have succeeded in bringing my beloved Mary Ann this far. Please help us find a way out of the underworld!
But first: Kill Orpheus!

Kill the escaped Humans... kill every last one of them!

You look resourceful, willing and able to help out a poor old dragon for a price. I've lost a clawful of Humans. They broke the locks to the pantry gates, knocked out the overseers and vanished. I want you to get them. No need to return them, do anything you want to them, as long as it's painful and fatal. To tell the truth, I'm done with Human flesh, and I advise you to follow my example. The young ones are too skinny and the older they get, the more they taste like fried jellyfish. Nothing wrong with fried jellyfish mind you, but at least jellyfish don't have bones. I'm expecting a delivery of fresh Lizardmen soon and I can't wait to try the new creations of my overseer chef. Hm.... Lizardman tongues in vinegar sauce... sounds delightful, don't you agree?
If there is one thing I've learned on my journey then it's that love only leads to pain and betrayal. Not from me though San, I'll earn my laurels honestly.

And not surprisingly, the winner is the selector!

We hope that the Lizardman's fighting abilities will make for a more exciting fight. The next fight is against the frightful hydra charming and father killing Lizardman! Get in the arena you giant salamander!
Giant, recognise the power of the Temple Guardians!
What a surprise! I haven't seen you for ages!
Good Goddess! I am honored to meet you! And you look so delightfully natural!
The forest bows down before you! You have my deepest respect!
Well doesn't that just about water my roots! Good to see you friend!
Holy tree trunks! I wasn't expecting to see you!
As always you are as graceful as the young shoots on a birch tree.
How fortunate to meet you here under the forest canopy! How are you?
How wonderful to meet you here in the safe haven of this forest.
What good fortune to meet you here. You look wonderful.
By all the Blessed Branches! Where have you come from? I haven't seen you for many an age.
That's what I expected, Lupus was no match for me. I defeated him. I guess that makes me the Ore Thag Clan's Master of the Hunt. I wonder if that will look good on my resume?
I got the candies. I should give them on to the boy.

Take me to the safety of the temple.

Please help me! I'm begging you!
My younger sister and I have been kidnapped by these horrible cultists. They've sacrificed my sister. I watched the whole thing. It was terrible! Most of my guards have gone to the woods to look for victims for their next ritual. I hit the disgusting man they left behind to guard me on the head with a piece of wood, but he ran away shouting for help!
Please take me to the temple of the gods before he comes back with reinforcements. I will be safe there, but we must hurry!
Better safe than sorry. The enemies around here are not exactly weak.

I think the reunion was more difficult than it looked at first. But one should not expect too much. After all, the two tried to kill each other until very recently. Haste makes waste. In any case - my work here is done.

Collect my mechanical eye from Nible!

Oh ... that for me? That's too kind, really! I guess this noble donation is not out of a sense of altruistic charity, right? What can I do for you?

... the sage? What was his name again? Njari, right? Yeah, nasty business. I heard about it and I might be willing to tip you off. Tell you who's behind it. But ... well ... I'm in a bit of a tight spot financially, you see. As you can see, I only got one eye. I lost the other in an accident. Occupational hazard, you might say. I already ordered a new, mechanical eye. Great things, those eyes, but they don't come cheap, you know. I ordered it from head eye-mechanic Nimble. And then ... well .. what goes around comes around, if you catch my meaning.
I owe you my thanks. Perhaps I will be able to sleep again at night now that the murderers are dead. Revenge is bittersweet my friend...
I'm looking for a tavern called The Deadly Blade. Can you show me the way?
I know it, but I don't think your kind would be welcome there.
Why not? I'm thirsty and long for a mug of nice cold Orcweiser.
If you insist, but the tavern belongs to a relative of mine. He doesn't serve Ogres.
I have many gold coins on me. Maybe that will change his mind.
That's a good start. Give me one or two, and I'll show you the way.
How dare you, woman! Orcs want money for everything.
Alright, then go look for it yourself.
You're making a mistake. And after making some mistakes, you don't get a second chance.
I hear you have a wonderful meat recipe that I should try.
What lady mean? Recipe? Troll no understand.
You're really not the sharpest tool in the shed, right? I mean meat. How do you prepare it? Troll roast? Understand?
Yes! Yum! Troll no eat all raw. Old days yes, now roast.
Well, at least you understand me now. So, tell me how you prepare it.
Great, looks like I met a real chef. Now get lost.
Orc lady mean. No like lady. Troll go.
The Priestess is dead and the magical barrier has vanished. Now we can save the family.
AH! I can finish my work! It will be a masterpiece. I don't have a buyer or a publisher, yet, but time will tell.
You really consider yourself an expert on dragons, don't you?
You're right, let's not waste any time.
Let us put this behind us quickly. If there is one thing I cannot stand, it is this horrible stench of brimstone.
That's not a half bad idea, for sure. Well then, where to?
Right, we shouldn't waste any time. Time is precious - for the living it is, at any rate.
Our chances will increase if we are two fighters.
I don't even have to power up all systems for this.
Any Hero reaches Dyr-Lain, the Isle of Dryads and accepts a quest there.
Another garema. I don't know what his talk about eyes meant. But maybe we can find something else if we search his body.
These opponents aren't really worth my while.
Your license will expire in %d days.
You have no business here, Inquisitor!
Your heretical beliefs will be your undoing!
You're not going to crusade here!
I will pierce your black heart!
These people are slaves of the High Elves. They are completely oppressed, do nothing but common work and most of them are uneducated. When they fight as a mob, all of their pent-up anger erupts.

Liosilath claims that there are more of these sites and he would like to learn more about them. At the same time I have to find the lost expedition group and attempt to help the Grurag-Clan. Not much on my plate then! I hope I will be able to handle it all.
How did you manage to get the position? Were you scratching your head when they asked for volunteers?
Up to four combat arts can be combined and the combat arts in combos regenerate even faster. Increases the damage of all combat arts.

You again?!
They threw me out of the guard because I lacked discipline. After that I wanted to try and become a mercenary, but I wasn't any good at that either. I even got robbed and now all my equipment is gone. What do you think - should we try and get it back together?
Take enough to drink with you!

Renik is dead and his gang of protection money racketeers has been destroyed. The villagers don't need to fear them any longer, and Telwan's supply of first rate healing potions is secure. Now adventurers can rest assured that the potions really deliver what Telwan promises.
You block of stone are trying to show me what T-Energy means? I will teach you it's true power!
Let's smash up the player... I mean, the player's character.
Well? What's the sixth general order?
Diddya let the Dragen owd? Noooo! I kin neva go home agin now. *hic* Barkeeper! More beer!
My trunk is full of junk. Eh... The backpack is filled I mean.
Something inside of me demands that I help you.
Soon you'll be one of us!
I destroyed four totems. Let's see if that helped.
Seeing you, face to face - now I know what fear really is.
Please move on, handmaid of terror.
Can I hope to survive this meeting with you?
You're just like me! You didn't exactly choose the easiest profession either.
I would advise you to improve your fighting techniques.
Oh no, another one acting like she's an Amazon.
Wow! The seraphim rewarded me for the 200th hunting success.
It's not a good idea to annoy me!
I helped the Demiurge's followers to defeat my mother's troops. This place looks familiar!
Great! So you were really able to deliver something. Here take this small token.
I will stand by you, as long as it benefits me.
I banish you to the underworld
We exchange smiles when we meet each other here.
I don't want to die young.
I'm so scared I can't run away...
Significantly increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Astral Lord. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
So far, I was able to sneak by every guardian creature. So, if you'll allow me, I will give it a try.
As long as we are living between the lines, the balance between the armies must be kept!

A Spy who is observing the troops of the Inquisition with the help of modern long distance communication technology will report any advancement to the nobility. He has settled down on a mountain peak and I am supposed to eliminate him.
Five trusting souls have returned to the fold. I can return to Lurana now and inform her of my success.
I don't trust this thing yet. I think I'll wait for a little while.
That's the law of nature: Only the strong survive!
Further decreases the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.
I'm pretty sure that you are a Troll.
Mama - I want the dark man to leave now!
I was counting on you and you didn't disappoint me. Take this as a reward. You most certainly have our gratitude!
I'm coming to get you, my friend...
All Orcs that oppose me are lost.
I know all your strengths and weaknesses!
I have never fought against fog. Sounds interesting.
I order you to stand down, Temple Guardian!
Stand down or you will be deactivated!
You were created to serve, not to think, Temple Guardian!
No Temple Guardian has ever dared to rise against us!
The poachers in the camp are all dead, but the Guardian will certainly have another task for me.
This town is under the control of the Grurag Clan.
Ah the roses, thank you! Now I can keep my head, and the lord's intended will get her flowers.
Phew! I can smell you from miles away! Take a bath!
This warrior wants to push up daisies again!
My what a lovely complexion you have, warrior!
You've been waiting a while haven't you?
All this sounds very complex. I will be up to the task.

Take the letter to Mayor Walenos!

That does it! I’ve had enough! I quit! Immediately! Who do these people think they are? I’ve been the lighthouse keeper here for five years now, year in and year out. Whenever that light goes out I run up those stairs like a madman to guide the ships across the bay, and how do they thank me? Here read this: “The community of Artamark wishes to thank you for five years of service as lighthouse keeper and pilot.” Is that it? No bonus, no pay increase? They’ve gone too far! I quit! I’ve already drawn up my written notice. Would you be so kind to deliver it to Mayor Walenos? I'm so angry I don't trust myself to go there in person!
An old spirit entrusted me to find the Lost Lorebook of Atherton and to deliver it to a Chronicler.
You smell worse than the plague, Goblin!
I found the camp but not the archaeologist. What I did find instead were four bandits who were rummaging through the belongings of the scientist.
I pray for the men that they may be blessed with strength.
You look so wonderful today, m'lady! The woods will envy your beauty!
Oh, you're always such a charmer! If you keep that up, I'll blush and turn the colour of ripe cherries on the tree!
Please, no false modesty, I've rarely seen a being of such grace and beauty!
Oh, stop! What if people overhear us? Or even worse, my husband?
Let him hear it! Maybe he could learn a thing or two from me about paying a lady compliments!
He usually pays his compliments in a way I don't understand, because I'm too stupid, he says.
I have to go now, but don't let your husband fool you!
I'll take your advice to heart. Be seeing you!

Take me to the Feather Halls.

I'm tired. My limbs are weak and my breathing is difficult. My time has come. I won't make it on my own to the Feather Halls, the place where we go to receive the sweet kiss of death. Would you take me there?
Any Hero completing 50 % of all sidequests.
I filled my vial with T-Energy. Now I need to get out of here. There are too many mutated creatures crawling around here for my liking.
Your path is the wrong one!
My hatred will bring you down!
You'll be dead in a minute, Horseman!

Schehera sent you? Good! She already told me she wanted to let you in on the plan. It is my job to reveal the mastermind behind the forged gladiator papers, because this isn't the only place it's happening. There are also a lot of Gladiators in the High Elven capital city who are kidnapped and forced to perform in the arena. My detective work has led me to Badawi and this must be the place where those responsible reside as well. One of them is most likely the Pascha Barazi, the other is El'Duffi.
Go to the Pascha and offer to take part in the "selection." He'll fall for it, he loves an unfair fight. But don't kill anybody. Return to me when it's done.
The thing with the blades... Ah well, nevermind. Thanks.

Check my fish traps!

I’m such an unlucky devil! It was only last summer that I fell from the roof and broke my arm. Now I cut my leg while I was chopping wood. One careless moment and suddenly there was blood everywhere!

Would you be so kind as to do an old man a favor? I’ve set my fish traps all along the river bank - please go and check them for me. My supply of fish is dwindling.
Nobody asked you to get involved!
I hear that your son wants to learn the art of Elven magic!
I was also surprised by this turn of events. I had hoped he would take over the manor.
If he truly feels that this is his calling, you may send him to me.
I am not convinced that this isn't just a passing interest - he is still very young and changes his mind often.
As you know, one must begin training as early as possible. If he truly wants to follow this path, he should start immediately.
Whatever you do, don't go filling his head with fancy ideas.
The art of magic has nothing to do with fancy ideas. And now I must take my leave.
I too must take my leave, fair sorceress. But I implore you, heed my request!
The kobolds are right to the [direction] of here, you can''t miss them. Please go and see if you can retrieve my fathers bow.
I don’t want to rush you, but the Scroll of Devil's Fire is not safe here. The sooner Assim arrives, the better.
Come here, all of you! Hurry!
Move your butts and come here!
I thank you! Now that the serum is destroyed, the Dragons are willing to accept the truce and live in peace with you.
I don't have a good feeling about this...
This is not going to work.
A reward for the one who brings me the head!
All for one, all for me!
I can tell this will be a rough fight!
Hold on. Before I kill you, let me thank you for setting me free. Alright you're thanked, and now I have no more time to waste.
Look, the number above your head...
The ritual has been completed, my duty is done. Good luck!
I didn't mean that personally, honestly.

We arrived at the Dragon’s lair, but the Dragon was already dead.
Instead, some Elves instantly attacked me, so I had to kill them. Now I should open the gate to the kennels and find out what they’ve been guarding.
Now, my secret is finally safe.
The chieftain will be able to mourn now that his brother's murder has been avenged.
I wish for my own little Temple with a bit of greenery.
I shall purchase a good altar wine at the merchant's.
I have to collect donations for the new altar.
I have to purchase some new sacrificial candles.
I have to prepare the sermon for mass.
Today I will perform the rite of consecration to gain favour with the Gods.
Kybele has enlightened me. I should preach about the dangers of lumberjacks.
Kybele keeps our world in balance.
I always find the first morning prayer terribly strenuous.

Fight your way to the top of the hill!

I’ve been waiting for you. You’ve done well, but that damn Inquisitor has always been one small step ahead. He’s taken the hill already; let’s make our way up to him. Oh, if we have to fight against him be careful! He has access to a nice bunch of magic tricks that make him almost invulnerable. I can interrupt him for a short time if necessary, but it’s risky so let’s hope I don’t need to. You ready?
Be careful, there could be elemental spirits living there. Hurry, please!
This has to be the soldier’s sword!
Move back into your miserable mud huts!
I have no time for you, stranger.
We don't like your kind here, stranger.

Go to clerk Malsen!

Greetings! My name is Migolo Fernal and I am a public servant to the King's court in Artamark. I've heard a lot about you and I hope that you can help me.

I have discovered evidence of a conspiracy that I need to put an end to. The influential House of Barimak is involved in it. Apparently money isn't enough for them anymore, they long for political power as well. They will show no scruples and must be stopped. Please ask my clerk for further instructions.
There that part of the mission is complete. I'm going to take the animals to the merchant now.
Whoops! I seem to have set off a trap.
You will be the only one to regret this!
I regret nothing. You, on the other hand, will soon be deeply sorry for this.
I am glad to have been able to help you solve the problem.
Regrets? Me? You might be terribly wrong there.
Why don't you Humans realize when to take a step back?

Prove your fighting strength one more time!

You win, good. One easy, lots hard. You show more, kill or die. New test!

Now fight big ones!
I'll loose no sleep over killing the likes of you.
Here I am, minding my own business, and a man of faith comes along.
You wear a holy robe. I hope you're not bringing bad news.
I welcome you your holiness, though I'm not sure why.
To be a keeper of the faith in times like this... I don't envy you.
Are you looking after your flock? I hear there's not much grass around these days.
I'll welcome you, if you promise not to pray for me.
Oh a shepherd of faith. I'm not exactly bursting with joy, to be honest.
Look, the true church finally showed up. I hope you bring good news.
That's what I call courage. You want to spread glad tidings?
Gods be with us. What do I owe this honor to?
Hey, you! Uhm... I... I mean, we... WE forgot our possessions! You have to go back!
Decreases the cooldown even further. Additionally increases spell level without malus.
There won't be a lot of wool this year either.
I would really like a few more goats.
I'd rather have a stupid sheep than a shrewish wife.
The lambs are early this year.
The advantage to having thin sheep, is that they take up less room in the stall in winter.

A gamekeeper by the name of Mekeliel is concerned about the spiny turtle population. A poacher looted the nests under the cover of darkness. I'm supposed to try and apprehend him and snatch the bag away from him.
I hate artificial gardens. They are supposed to be nice, but all of the things wild and free are cut down!
Thank you for saving Christmas. As a reward, you get to open your presents. Go ahead!

I, the Oracle, am ready to speak!
The ancient traditions must be respected.
The evening meal will continue to be toadquark! Go now and deliver my message!
This must be the arena the seraphim huntress told me about. Let's get started.
What is that supposed to be? I have no use for it.
The apothecary was shocked when he heard the news. He asked me to tell the guards all about this.
Do you want to apply these changes?
I have never seen you before. But I think, I can trust you.
All this walking back and forth that you are doing - it can't be good for you!
In everything that you do, think about what your ancestors would have to say first.

Go to the oasis and talk to the Prince. He must gain possession of the Devil's Fire.

Welcome, stranger. It's rare to see foreigners in this part of the world, be careful traveling here. We’ve been on the brink of a civil war since the King died. His brother took the throne, but it actually belongs to his nephew the Prince. One wrong word spoken in the right place can get you killed.
If only the Prince had access to the Devil´s Fire. With this weapon in his hands, he could create enough fear among the tribal leaders to stop them from voting for the uncle in the upcoming elections. That's what the Grand Inquisitor said the last time he came to visit us.

Bring me a burning torch!

Oh the horror, what terrible fate awaits me! I was once a well-traveled and well-liked artist and fire-eater, today I am cursed to a nonlife in darkness. If only I hadn't had the bright idea that Dragons could teach me something new. I was so naive that I wasn't even aware of the danger I was walking into. My competition already knew all of my tricks and were copying them, so I had to do something new.

Now I only have one last hope of being released from my disastrous fate. Please help me and get a torch that has been ignited with a Dragon's fire. That is the only way I can find peace.

Clear the way to the measuring stations!

Oh what a drudge! Look! I have to haul all this stuff around! It's always the same. Every other century someone asks Sophia if the maps are up-to-date. What follows is the order to map the region again. As if it weren't enough to tow the measuring instruments and the other equipment around, no, I am being attacked by monster all the time, as well! Would you please help me? Kill the monsters and clear the way!
I did it. He's dead, but the artifacts are gone. A Seraphim took them. I will have to look for her. The island isn't that big so she couldn't have gone very far.

Get me five Goblin brains and and five Goblin livers.

So Jangletooth sent you? How is the old fleabag? Does he still have that purulent rash?
He needs slimy gobs and goo? Well, let's see ... I've got Kobold eyes, frog spawn, algae, a bit of parsley, boar bristle (or the gravy won't thicken) and ... oh no! I'm out of Goblin brains! I had a few friends over last night. They must have eaten them all. Get me five Goblin brains, but please be discreet, Goblins are an Orcish race too, and we don't want to look like cannibals.
While you're at it, you can also get me five Goblin livers. I need them for a wedding cake. Would be a shame to waste them.

Find the ring!

This is all about the witch's ring... I can see it clearly now... It rests between weathered stones within ruins... It is a cursed place where fallen Dryads are striking terror into the people's hearts.
Let us go there and retrieve the ring!
I have arrived in the frosty Northlands. It's freezing here. The Thraconians are attacking Artamark by orders of their God? Well, I already defeated others who thought they were Godlike.
I am too fast for you!

Recover the Ancient Artwork from the Orc Camp

Looking for a lesson in kobold, eh? Yes, yes, the Kobold patriarch can be quite delicate when it comes to etiquette. Hmm, yes, once slew a Kobold at a feast he did, for toasting the Kobold nobility before proposing one to the king. But the coming of age has calmed his senses, though he is now a somewhat eccentric old Kobold. But fear not! Old Y´Oldah will help you. In return for a little something, of course.

A marauding band of dirty, thieving Orcs have recently stolen a painting drawn by Skowe. Yes, THE Skowe. Probably the most famous Kobold artist in the history of Kobold art. Recover this painting and return it to me, then shall I consider your request again.

The Lizardman was defeated by the selector! Now let's get to the highlight of today's performance.
A woman of unknown origin and past, quick and as silent as a jungle cat, as underhanded as a harpy and as deadly as a scorpion. Ladies and gentlemen, I give you the Blood Sister!
Three ... four ... five. I've got all the rings. I don't see why they are so valuable but then, what do I know?
You aren't even worth the air that you use up!
They are head and shoulders above us ...
We have nothing to talk about.
Patriarch Yator wasn't exactly excited, but the gesture of friendship has touched him. It's a first step in the right direction.
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Cabalistic Voodoo and increases the maximum spell level without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
It is difficult being the only intellectually outstanding Elf among all these farmers, but you wouldn't understand such things.
If your faith is strong enough there will be a place in heaven for you.
The heavens above all of us dwarf every individual in comparison!
A little seed of hope was bestowed on us. We'll plant it so that it can bear fruits!
The salvation of every Elf lies in his heart. Even if you have to cut it out to get at it.
Don't lose your way, it sounds promising!
Good is one who does well. A great philosopher said these or similar words.
Let's sing together: Give salvation a chance!
The Gods will have noticed your endeavors. And you'll be rewarded!
Don't worry about your peace with the Gods!
Everyone should follow your lead, the faithful and the unfaithful!
If you have any problems, don't hesitate to turn to me!
I appreciate that, but I'm actually doing rather well!
But this guard duty with all its dangers... You must have problems.
Not at all, I love my job. I don't have any reason to complain.
You can't fool me! A delicate woman like you! Just pour your heart out to me.
For the Goddess' sake, I am fine! Why do you need to ascribe sorrow to me?
I just want to make sure. You know where to find me. May Kybele protect you!
Yes, thank you. And now go, you're depressing me, man of God or not!
The historian actually found a document about General Terus and his Legion. A curse was placed on the soldiers and they must rise from their graves every 100 years.
We’ll rest here for a while, and then we’ll continue our travel.
A short 'swish' is soon to be followed by a 'thud'...

I found the body of a man. He must be the brother I am looking for. Someone has pried the jewels out of the amulet. I wonder if the amulet is magical? There is a mage in the military camp. I will ask him.

A group of Thraconians led by a man calling himself “Qungar the Terrible” have invaded an island in Urthak’s Bay. There is nothing on the island but a leper colony, so maybe the location has some sort of strategic value for them. I have been asked to deal with Qungar and his men once and for all.
Some folks come to me to get their firewood.
I need to find a place to store my wood.
The last storm tore up a lot of trees.
My home is on the forest edge.
So many of the trees in this forest are infected with brown rot - what bad luck.
There is only one choice for an Orc, death!

Mer-Kil kept his word and told me that the answers to my questions can be found in the High Temple of the Lost City. Once the capital of the High Elf empire, it's now a deserted place in the jungle.
The old Dragon opened a portal and told me to find the hearth of family Grackk once I'm through.
Hate? That's not the correct word. It's just your smell, it's like poison in our noses.
Troll smell much good! Clean in sheep gut. All weeks, even when not need!
Sheep bowels? That's disgusting. Now I know why you reek so much!
No reek! Smell good. Lady Troll like.
Our women would smack us! I'd never dare to come home smelling like this.
Ogre women dumb! Don't want Ogre man smell good!
I'd better go now before you drive me crazy.
I've defeated the poltergeists. Piece of cake.
I will set your soul free!
I'm really afraid of this ... hero!
This town does not have adequate capacity for both of us!
I do not see people in terms of being good or evil, but living or dead!
This is the end of you!
He was very relieved. Now he can see to his customers again.
You honor nature Dryad, but you still walk the wrong path.
And you're supposed to be a guardian of nature?
The brother of the Priest’s brother told me to slay five jungle cats. If I keep going at this rate I’ll wipe out half the population of the jungle in no time!
It's not easy for you to find suitable clothing, eh?
You put yourselves above the Gods!
I've seen this in the bestiary...
I agreed to help settle a legacy question. To do this I have to conjure my granduncle's ghost.
Sorcerer Mankaul is dead, that takes care of all the cult leaders. Wait... wasn't there something about a missing daughter? RIGHT! Where could she be?
Even the in the desert the Human scum will not leave you alone...
The path to the Crystal Cave is northbound. Follow it, sister!
I'm already carrying too much, there is no room for more.
Nobody likes to visit this island. Few will ever return.
How can I be of service?
These riders seem to think they are something better...
T-Energy pulsates around the Temple Guardian and damages opponents while it heals allies at the same time.

Ulf Winkelmann
I am not screaming. When I scream you will know about it!
Oh, there's something else that's darkening my soul at the moment.
While we're talking - there's one more thing:
Do you still have time? I'd like to discuss it if you do.
There's something that worries me, you know?
I don't want to push my luck, but something overshadows my soul!
Would you let me discuss a topic you won't find pleasant?
There is something that I have an urgent need to talk to you about.
As if things weren't bad enough, another thing comes to my mind.
We have to talk about something that could be important.
If you don't mind, I'd like talk about something else that's bothering me.
A guard has asked me to clear the path to the Gardens of the Seraphim and drive the Kobolds from the canyon.
We're a very pleasant horde of mercenaries.
I'm saving my pay for a tree house.
The art of war is a trade that will always fill your purse.
There's always one thing to hope for - to be alive on your next payday.
It's civil war to some and high season to us.

Hahaha!
That's what I thought. So, die! Your blood will make me even stronger!

The nobleman's notes indicate that a renegade captain and his men have set up camp on the coast. The Thraconians consider him and his people outcasts. With a little gold it should be possible to hire him and his men.
Be silent. No one must know about this. Have you poured the poison into Lavella's nightcap?
All the rebels are dead. I should speak to the Officer again. I hope the Inquisitors have a good cleaning staff. This place is a mess!
There'll be trouble at home when I tell them the roe buck got away again - I might as well stay out here.
I've been stalking this stag for days now. He always seems to be one step ahead.
Hunting jackrabbits is not for me. Those little beasts are too darn fast.
Hunting is tiresome work - I actually wanted to become a fisherman.
I always get so run down at a drive hunt.
Where's the sense in knocking out the same opponents over and over again? I don't suppose there is a reasonable answer.
Spare me, noble lady. I have nothing to do with all this.
I won't even try to stop you.
Have mercy on me and please keep going!
I require more experience for this.
Bring me the gall bladders, I'll make a nice claw polish with them!
Everyone whose good will get a healing spell!
What a horribly mutated creature! This T-Energy is definitely going too far!
What... what do you want? I don't know anything! It's nothing but a coincidence that I'm here today! These people forced me to wear one of their robes!
I will eliminate each of you Kobolds.
Your hero can modify a combat art. Open the combat art screen by pressing <$ID_CUI_RBBUTTON_INSERT>.

The mystery is revealed. The Demiurge is the Great Machine! He is creation, he is not a God but a divine tool. Mother is not my mother, she just calls herself that. She is the guardian of the Great Machine.
We, the Temple Guardians, protect the entryways to the Great Machine from places all over the world. Mother had the Demiurge create us. Over the millennia of her existence she came to realize that all life needs to be destroyed so it can rise again, new and strong.
Hassl'toh kept his promise and gave me the potions. Now he'll be able to go to town and sell his soup.
It's right over there, just go ahead.
*sing* I don't know what it means that I'm so sad...
Anything is better than being a slave!

Deliver six ghosts from their terrible fate.

I need your help. My name is Grenwyn. I used to work in the mine. Pirates recently ambushed us and killed all my friends and coworkers. Now the ones who were killed are haunting the mine as ghosts. Please go to the mine and deliver their poor souls.
Good work! You may call yourself a kodiak hunter
There we are! Down there will be a whole bunch of machines that will target you for termination. It will be worth the trouble, down there you'll find a lot of blueprints and spare parts.
At best, I could sell this thing.
I gathered the ingredients for the potion. Now I must give them to the combo master in the village.
No one will miss this machine!
It's time for you to return to the endless circle of life!
And you are who? Oh, sorry ... bad memory.
Please just ignore me and move along!
You might be the bravest woman of all... but this stench of sulphur...
I will go away. Even the grass trembles wherever you go!
Your self-assured attitude is a bluff. What are you doing here?
Your fighting abilities seem well provided.
We all admire you. You are the greatest of all warriors.
They planned to deceive me, incredible! There was just one thing they didn't reckon with - me!
Please hurry sister! Don't be late!
I love the smell of warm blood...
Your gaze is as dark as your soul. I hope you will never become my enemy.

Check the pile of corpses!

You must help me! For the last few days I've been haunted by terrible nightmares. A cursed woman appears before me and wants my soul every single night! She says I am the reason that her son died in the arena and she wants his corpse, but we’ve already thrown it into the corpse pit. I dream of the corpse pit every night too. Please go there and make sure everything is in order, because the cowards I call my soldiers are too afraid to visit the place.
There is an enemy, all to me!
I've killed the eight Elementals and can now return to my client.
I've taken care of the mine owner's henchmen. Let's see what he has to say.

Keeper of the Shrine
A great many people think they are thinking when they are actually rearranging their prejudices.

- James
I need better protection against damage from ice.

That scoundrel in the gambling den set his thugs on me! I killed them and whipped him within an inch of his life until he told me where to find the broker. He’s lucky I let him live. I wonder how far it is to Skook's Corner
As much as I feel sorry for you, I have to kill you.
Do you know who you are dealing with?
I have to admit that my diet is starting to get to me. I could eat a whole sow!
Let's not talk about food now. That acorn-soufflé is sitting heavily on my stomach!
I prefer the traditional cuisine of the forefathers. It's in harmony with the Gods.
A strong chestnut stew with some delicious noodles! That's what I prefer!
These last few days I've only eaten chopped herbs because I hope to please the Gods.
Natural pear marrow! A wonderful meal for me. It's always welcome!
Sometimes I'm happy to have three stomachs because I like to eat that much!
If you really want to hear it, our traditional cuisine often makes me very nauseous.
If everyone ate more innards to please the Gods, we'd all fare much better!
I've heard everyone talking about these calorie things lately, but I haven't been able to taste them yet.
Good woman, be on your guard. This isn't the best neighbourhood.
Kind lady, do you perchance, have some gold for me?
I don't use that type of thing.
Concealment - Increases evade chance inside the cloud.
Elongate - Dust Devil lasts considerably longer.
Spell Shield - Light protection from hostile spells.
Sanding - Slightly damages opponents inside the Dust Devil.
Spread - Increases circumference of Dust Devil significantly.
In the Garden of the Seraphim
Being charitable will get you nowhere here!
What does good or evil really mean anyway?
I have no time to do good deeds!
You're just pretending to be innocent!
Ho, friend! I hear there was a right-royal brawl at the tavern last night!
Yes. I expect a few of the lads had one or two jugs of beer too many.
Of course, my husband had to join in. If only he was as good at working as he is at fighting.
The way our menfolk leave their money at that tavern, it's no wonder we live in such squalor.
Now there's the truth! If mine keeps on like this, he'll end up on the street.
That's where I found mine, come to think of it!
A good man is hard to find hereabouts. Ignorant drunkards on the other hand - we've plenty of them!
Indeed! I shall see you later.
The cowardly soldier was just trying to hide. I caught him and found a list on his corpse. I'd better take it to the commander.
You glow like an entire Christmas tree!
El-Darrag is safe again. The town has something to celebrate.

What? That is none of your concern! Don’t poke your nose in other people’s affairs!
My little Shakira and I will show you how we take care of snoopers in these parts!
Fight face to face, you spineless dogs!
This is of no use to me.
Thank you! You did it! The ghosts have vanished!
No that wasn't it either. I'm dumbfounded! Maybe our chief knows what to do! He's standing outside his hut. Talk to him.

Crushed Hero Statue
Doesn't look quite so... heroic now.
My lady is really starting to get on my nerves. She's always complaining, she's never satisfied, get me this, bring me that. This is no way to live...
Hmm so the Djinn wants to be set free? I can help him with that. I'll simply set him on the laborers. They're just standing around doing nothing anyway. Some exercise won't do them any harm.
Newts with weapons - truly, a joke!
You will not find better prices anywhere in Ancaria. Go and browse my wares to see for yourself.
Aha, that doesn't sound very interesting, but I'd like to talk about something else!
Your opinion sounds familiar. Let's talk about something else.
Even though I don't want to, there's another topic we have to talk about.
Not very uplifting, that's for sure! But never mind ... what do you think about this:
At least you are not an idiot, brother. What can you tell me about this matter?
There's one other thing I'd like to mention even if it's not a very pleasant subject.
There's one other thing I unfortunately have to mention!
Although I don't really want to talk about this it has to be.
Kuan ordered me to mention one other thing. So tell me your opinion.
That's a terrible subject; let's talk about something else instead.
These strange magicians seem to lay claim to the eggs. Let's see whether they are serious about it.
Grants a chance to block close combat attacks.
Connected to wireless ad hoc network.

I tried to report to my client after the meeting.

Unfortunately the Barimaks have arrested him for high treason while I was at the meeting. The officer who made the arrest was well paid by General Barimak and wants to pay his debts at a tavern now. I have been asked to take this message to Mekezz, the innkeeper's brother.
You're bringing me a decision making potion! Should I really drink it??? I'm not so sure... Oh, what the heck...cheers!
Do not mistake me for my servant!
You would make Kuan happy if you'd come to the sacrifice rituals more often!
Why don't I see you at the celebrations for Kuan, our God, anymore? Have you been ill?
Oh, a good day to you. Kuan and we shamans have missed you.
How nice to meet you! Please tell me why you don't visit the temple more often.
Are you unwell? Kuan asked me why you're such an infrequent guest at the rituals.
I hope you are well! It's been some time that I saw you at the rituals!
What's wrong with you? Are you avoiding us shamans? Speak!
If you don't want to anger Kuan you should come to the sacrifice rituals more often.
How are you, my daughter? I haven't been able to welcome you in far too long.
Why are you denying Kuan your allegiance? Do you want to talk about it?
Well you're still alive, my daughter! Have you been very busy lately?
I'm pleased to meet you here! You rarely visit Kuan's temple! That's very sad!
Kuan would like to know if you're about to turn against him. You don't take part in the rituals anymore!
You, I'm really surprised! You rarely find your way to us believers, and I'd like to know why.
One of the mages is carrying a scroll. Maybe Wendelin knows something about it.

Inquisition Guard
We benefit from the stupidity of infidels.
You know, it's a delicate matter to kill Humans...after all - my user is probably one of them.
Hey, what is going on? First you save my life and now you want to fight? Fine, if you want to die... En garde!
Aleya has asked me to retrieve the Goblet of Light from an evil mage and bring it back to the temple.

I have slain the creature and hacked off its head. I shall take the head back to show Buddix, although I don’t think its really appropriate for children to play with such things. Maybe I should keep it as a souvenir instead.
That's not a challenge for me.

Hunters are camping at the edge of the jungle looking to hunt big game and collect some pelts. They haven't been able to work because of the Dryads. That's why they've asked me to get them the pelts of some panthers which live in the area.
Hmm... what would be a good beginning for my new book? Oh I'll think of something.
Us priests are taking the correct side!
The nether realm is waiting for you!
There is still time to repent!
There is no absolution for you!
You dare to attack a man of God?
Only a blashpemer dares to attack a priest!
The Gods will judge you - and I am their right hand!
You believe in the wrong Gods!
<Pain, as if I burnt my finger> ahhhhh
I found Rogs and put an end to his pitiful existence. Now I can go back to the guard and report to him that the traitor has been dealt with.
There's nothing like dying in style.
I'm almost there, I can feel it!

Expert Touch

If activated, combat arts regenerate faster but draw their energy from all aspects. This mode is especially useful for characters who focus on a single aspect.

I found the Rose of the Wind! The map was right!
It really seems to attract the undead. Now I can cleanse my blade. A blacksmith's fire should suffice.
All 10 undead have been destroyed. Now I should ask the commander for other duties.
Tell me about your heroic deeds!
Oh, your muscles! And your musky odor...beguiling!
What a hero! I will never forget this day!
Is my brewery free of those drunken louts?
It would be my privilege, my lady.

Admiration is a very short-lived passion that immediately decays upon growing familiar with its object, unless it be still fed with fresh discoveries, and kept alive by a new perpetual succession of miracles rising up to its view.
- Joseph Addison
Green doesn't necessarily means it's good!
Go ahead and run! I'll get your souls later ...

Gravestone
A prudent question is one-half of wisdom.

Find the bag of peas!

Our situation here is critical. The ghosts haunting the area pose a serious threat, we only leave the house if it is absolutely necessary. Yesterday I managed to buy a bag full of peas in the "Ocean View" tavern. Our provisions were almost all gone and dried peas will keep for a long time. Anyway on my way home I was attacked by ghosts and had to flee. I lost the bag of peas in the process. I don't know if I should ask you this but... would you try to find the bag and bring it to us? That would really help us out a lot!
Why I get more experience for a dweeb like you than for the others is a mystery to me...
A fruit seller is angry with her husband. He gave her the wrong basket, and now she doesn't have any fruit to sell at the market. I have to go get the right basket from her husband.
This quiet is suspicious, don't you think? We should be on guard for trouble.
Why do you say that? It's good to enjoy a few days of peace.
It might seem peaceful, but you can be sure that the Orcs are planning something horrid for us.
Oh, I don't know. I haven't seen much of them recently.
That's exactly what worries me. It's almost too quiet.
Well, if you say so... but I intend to enjoy the peace and quiet.
Let's hope you don't get an unpleasant surprise then. I've seem some bad things in my time.
You worry too much. Good day to you, my friend.

Kill thirty olms!

Fantastic! I can’t wait to have some soup, it's so tasty and nutritious. You should try it some time. It’s so good that I am allowed to sell it in town. I have more than enough ingredients here to make a few cauldrons again, if it wasn’t for those beastly olms! Could you kill some olms for me? I’ll reward you handsomely of course! I have some very special potions here!
Amethyst and Ruby, Emerald and Diamond - buy your jewels at Finebond. Mhm...I might have more work to do on the meter here...
I have to eat a couple more oyster plants before I can use that.
This Hegiman has got some nerve. He "allows" me to spar with his apprentice. I'd better not show him my entire repertoire.
I know where you parked your car, player!
The old healer needs some bat brains for his skin lotion. I have to get the brains from the bats that live near the big tree.
Do you really know what your heart desires?
You should not be ashamed of your feelings.
You don't appear to ever be bothered by any feelings of inferiority, are you?
Do you get high blood pressure when you're agitated?
Does positive thinking help when you are afraid?
You were too gullible. Thank you for your purse.
I have very modern tastes and I like it when things are a little unusual.
Why are you such a traditionalist? I simply love it when someone does something new! It's so creative.
I'm quite conservative when it comes to these matters! But I'm sure these designer trees will disappear again soon.
Some of these modern breeds just make you want to shake your head, don't they? These days everyone thinks they're an artist...
It's Dryad nature to improve the world around us. It's our way of praising the Great Goddess.
I can't say much about it: I haven't been able to see the forest for the trees for a while now, if you know what I mean?
They're barking up the wrong tree if you ask me! I think we should just leave nature alone!
That's exactly what our problem is! We're always trying to be more creative than the Goddess herself! It'll be our downfall one day.
You can never improve on what the Goddess has created! Even a fool can understand that.
What a load of nonsense! Why would anyone want to start playing around with the work of the Great Goddess?
Fantastic! I’ll start checking the results at once!
Get the loot on the ship.
I'll have a bottle of rum on you.
A putrescent undead creature is blocking my path, I’ll soon rip what’s left of his guts out of him.

Fetch me an Elixir of Souls from Quinius!

Excuse me! I am Retilynen - ghosthunter. Here is my card. Are you fascinated by the supernatural? It’s an exciting field, that’s for sure! I have recently been investigating a mysterious and supernatural manifestation at an ancient grave not far from here. I have confirmed the presence of high levels of spiritual essence at the grave site. If the ghosts actually manifest themselves, they could pose a threat to the entire region. I could hinder the manifestation, but I will need an Elixir of Souls to destroy the spiritual essence at the grave. We ghosthunters like to call the elixir: Soul-Ex.

A rather deranged alchemist by the name of Quinius lives not far from here. He knows the recipe for the elixir, but he hasn't spoken a word with me since that incident in the tavern with the liquor and the burnt hair. How was I to know that it would explode?

Well anyway, perhaps you could get some Soul-Ex from Quinius?

Fetch me the Ingredients Required to Summon a Golem.

Greetings, traveler! I am Lahrian, the Mage. Please forgive me if I do not rise to greet you, but my old bones have become weary, even more so when the weather is about to change. If only Bob were here. Silly Golem... He went too deep into the forest when he was looking for mushrooms. I presume the wolves have torn him apart. Strange, generally they avoid Golems. Anyway, I am left to my own devices again. Bob was my right hand, he would take on any task that I was unable to carry out. Sure, I could summon another Golem, but I am missing several vital ingredients. Would you mind fetching those for me? I don’t require much, just two Kobold hearts, five wild boar tusks and four stones of Earth Elementals. If you were able to acquire those for me, I’d be eternally grateful. What do you say?
I cannot do four things at once!
You'll do anything I want? Hmm... A few ideas come to mind.
I will not attack my comrade! If that means we die, then at least it will be with honor and not disloyalty.

Seraphim Nionake is dead! Not that I knew her, but Seraphim Helophia told me about the tragic fate of her sister. Now I must scatter the great huntress's ashes on the crystal field just like she specified in her last will.
I am only wasting my time here. I need opponents, not victims.
I've picked everyone out of their saddle.
There's too many foreign folks roaming about among our holy trees. We should kill them all, just to be on the safe side...
There's more and more strange folks wandering hereabouts! I wonder if they come here for the trees?
I hear that more strange creatures have been sighted in our forests recently. Perhaps it is time we did something about it?
Many strange folks have come to the land of the Great Goddess in recent times. I wonder what they are planning?
Great numbers of strange travelers have been seen here in the last months. Do you think they might be dangerous?
Strangers in our forests... One has to wonder...did the Great Goddess bid them come?
I don't think that our borders are safe anymore - there are too many strange folks rambling around in our forests.
More and more thieves and scoundrels are coming here to plunder our natural resources. Perhaps it is time we set an example?
What do you think? Are all those strangers in our forests really just harmless explorers?
I don't have anything against strangers traipsing around in our forests, but I would prefer it if they were dead!
Have a great day! It smells like victory, can you sense it?
Oh you stayed safe? That's good to hear.
Good to meet you! I thought you were dead on the battlefield.
Nice to see you here. Finally, a familiar face.
It makes me happy to see a comrade in arms here.
What a happy coincidence! I don't feel comfortable among all these civilians.
This is a great meeting! Let me shake your weapon's hand!
I feel honored meeting you. People talk a lot about your heroic deeds.
How lucky! I love meeting a brave one.
Good Gods! You're here and not on the battlefield?
Don't worry. If the child is still alive I will save it.
I need better protection against poison based damage.
Look at that, a mage. Show some respect for the keepers of the faith!
Witch, convert to the true faith or die.
Your magic won't save you from the Gods.
It's your choice, join us or fall with the others.
Now I'm going to kill Varuck. An assignment is an assignment, am I right?

Inscription
To be idle is a short road to death and to be diligent is a way of life; foolish people are idle, wise people are diligent.
- Buddha
Health potion champion! You fight rather poorly, but you're a fast health potion drinker! That's pathetic!
Pass me a number five wrench will you Karol?
Do not make fun of a magician, green-skin!

The outward appearance of female zombies is indistinguishable from that of male zombies. They all look like every other undead. Undead.
Glenn gave me a picture of his wife. With it, I should be able to find her.




And he was right. There is nothing feminine about it.
May Lumen guide you, fair lady.
What can we do? No one is safe anymore.
Go! Show your inferiors how real leaders die!
Die, you two-legged naked mole rat!
Joana's family is attacking! That'll be fun! I'll just kill them all. I'm fed up with Elves!
I've collected all five herbs. They smell really good. I should take them to the Priestess now.
Just the same, I wish you huge bounty and many successful fights!
I have to go, my days are quite packed!
Should I say it was a pleasure? That would be a lie!
I wish you no mercy and a steady hand to wield the blade. I have to go now!
Well, a good hunt in Kuan's name, and always a steady blow!
Yes, I'd better get lost. You're just slowing me down.
I have some stealing to do, so I'd better leave you alone.
Have a good fight! I'm still well-mannered, you know!
I'd better be going. And I won't miss you.
May Kuan guard us! And especially me!
A Troll. I hate these creatures, they are big and dumb. I'm surprised they can talk at all. It's time to silence this one!
TyBosso forces his slaves to lumber the forest. I should stop that right now!
Well? How do you like THAT?
He's dead, what a pity! Now the Lizardmen will have to pick flowers for the rest of their lives.
The key fit into the lock! Now I will finally see the inside of the machine.
Uses Bink Video. Copyright © 1997-2008 by RAD Game Tools, Inc.
I have delivered the elixir. I wonder what will happen next.
Romdreal and Judriel have asked me to protect them until they are safe.
Onward! They will rue the day they ever laid eyes on me!
You have the map? That's fantastic! This is bad luck for the pirates, we'll always be one step ahead of them! Thank you for your help!
Not only Human, but also mean!
What do you ask of me?
In case you don't know what they look like, yellowfoot herbs are yellow.
War and battle are not for sissies.
I think what happens on the battlefield is terrific.
There is always someone who is stronger than you.
The world belongs to the courageous.
Spectacular battles receive the most admiration, right?
Thank you for the medicine! I feel better already! Wait, I'll come with you!
An island amidst the Dragonsea formed from solidified lava.
Probably the only direct connection between the continent and Seraphim Island
Thank you for your support! I had a bad feeling about the Abbess, but this takes the cake. I hate to imagine what could have happened, had you not put a stop to it.
Say hi to your maker for me, Demon!
