Inside the caves, I found the key for the magic shield that cloaks the hub. Now that it's unveiled, I can continue my way to the Wastelands.
You are a thorn in the Gods' flesh, Dragon!
The guards are dead. Now I just have to report my success to the council's spy.
An Orc settlement in the north of the realm
I don't know why there's straw lying around here either.
Worthless? Tell me another one! I think this lass is trying to pull my leg.
At a first glance nothing seems to be out of the ordinary on the estate. I'm going to go have a look around the basement. Maybe the owner of the house is trying to hide something.
Success! I have the basilisk eyes. Now I should take them back to the Prince, so he can unleash the Devil’s Fire.

Forgive me for being suspicious. One hears rumors now and then of resurrected beings who, well, are attending to some personal business, if you know what I mean. The dog tags prove your story though, so here is the order that identifies you and grants you access to the main camp.

End the siege of the undead!

Such an annoyance! The undead are blocking the way between our village and Hissil'Ta, and there are so many of them. Some vendors just barely managed to save their skin. We have to take action! You look like you're up to this task, destroy these undead ones. You won't regret it!
It's not enough to just stammer them! You also have to prove your faith!
They are not meant for naive blockheads, and they only work in moments of great danger!
How are you to know? If they don't work then it's because your faith isn't strong enough!
They aren't meant for the weak-minded, and that's all I have to say about it!
You dare to criticize them? Instead of complaining you should be memorizing every single word!
Kuan only listens to true believers! You should look within yourself for the problem!
What do you think? These prayers are for those who really want to sacrifice themselves and not for cowards!
Then Kuan didn't answer your prayer, and I think you should ask yourself why!
They can only work if you devote your life to Kuan, understand?
No worries! The prayers work fine, but they're meant for the real warriors!
In life I feared you, but not in death!
What was the middle part again? Hey, just kidding, I'm ready.
Impressive speech. I wonder how long it has taken him to prepare that?
A perfidious plan. I never knew you had that in you.
Nice plan. I would have never believed you guys were capable of something like that..
OK, dealing with explosive powder cannot be that difficult!
You Inquisitors are a pack of murderers!
Your final hour is close at hand, my frock wearing friend!
I useda boat in Bluestonbury to cross over to the camp.
Excellent! What a wonderful trophy. I'll find a place of honor for it in our club house.
Father, please help me! I've seen an evil spirit. I'm almost paralyzed with fear.
Calm down, child. Tell me where it happened, and what the spirit looked like.
It happened at dawn, between the two giant trees in the Phantom Swamp. Suddenly it appeared out of the mist.
I was there this morning too. I was on my way home after a party...
I only saw a silhouette. It stumbled toward me, making terrible noises. I was blind with fear, but I escaped.
I ate fermented fruit... I really should have known better.
So that was you, father? That's... that's unbelievable.
I'm sorry for scaring you. I will do penance for my foolishness.
Here, take the necklace to our Clan leader in the village north of here. He will accept it as proof of your valor and a token of my loyalty. Go now.

A strange guy who wears a captain's hat has started a prosperous business selling adventure tours to wealthy High Elves. Now his business partner has vanished and he's asked me to play travel guide until his partner returns. Sounds entertaining.

The Grand Inquisitor seems to take me for granted. I‘ve done everything he asked, yet he calls me a fool and demands more. Now I am to try and pry information out of the old Dragon Mer-Kil. No thought to how dangerous the Dragon territory is. Well I can look out for myself. I’ll find out what the librarian knows about Dragons and then set out. Fool indeed!
Everyone that I have ever loved has left me. I'm going to dedicate myself to the Gods of War and fight by your side to the death, so that I can at least find happiness in the afterlife.
You can barely feed yourself, and still you bring legions of children into the world!
My children are my very own blessing, and I'm doing all I can to give them a good life.
Ha! A good life in dirt! Is that what you meant to say, Human woman?
We love them more than anything! And they will take care of us once we're old and sick.
So you put faith in your repugnant children, but not in the noble and good Gods?
Yes, and that's a good thing! Now go, woman! Your presence besmirches me.
To be honest, I prefer salad. Lizardmen tongues are not good for my figure.
You beat back the attack! Very good! Looks like you are a reliable one. Here, take this as a token of my respect.
I was victorious. Now I'll report to the general.
Choose an item to buy, using Microsoft® Points. Purchased items can be transferred to the inventory of your hero.
Choose an item to buy. Purchased items can be transferred to the inventory of your hero.
Choose an item to buy, using Microsoft® Points. Purchased items can be transferred to the inventory of your hero.
You really are small of mind!
Thank you so much for the experience points!
Great. Everybody's dead, Joana is the only one still alive.

Report our victory to the excavation site leader in the archaeologists' camp.

That was a good fight! I almost feel alive.
We have fulfilled our obligation. Go to the archaeologists now and tell them about our heroic battle. The threat posed by the Du'Rach has been averted.

An older and very forgetful zombie might have a spell that weakens the Abishai. To cast the spell he needs sulphur, three roots from a strange plant and two eyes from a Flayed One. I don't know if there's any truth to the ramblings of that crazy old man, but it's worth a try.
Please hurry before all of my produce is stolen.
As if I would be afraid of something like you!
Are you really evil, or are you just pretending?
Change of venue! I don't feel like dying here!
Not bad! It would appear that you haven't forgotten everything. Are you ready for the next round?
You defeated another wave. If I were wearing a hat, I would take it off to you.
The third fight is against a wild Orc. Let's go!
Will someone pay ransom for you?
This crew doesn't need you, mage.
You sound pretty smart mage, but I bet you don't even know the difference between windward and leeward.
Make yourself useful in the galley, mage.
Go now. I must concentrate my mind.
Look, there are the first heap clouds. There's a storm coming up soon.
When it rains early in the morning everything seems refreshed, doesn't it?
Do you like this cool west wind?
What do you think about this humid and unstable air mass? Most unpleasant, right?
You know, I think the ice crystals in the winter really are beautiful.
By the horn of the mighty dragon ... are you using a cheap copy? Better go and get the original!
By the Gods, yet another T-Energy creature!

Unbelievable! You did it! Thank you, thank you so much! Yes this is my father's shield. Do you see the crest? That is our family's pride and joy. Here take this ring, you deserve it. And once again, thank you!
As I expected, Nityahel is a generous employer and has other assignments for me.
I'm leaving soon... just one more minute.
Why did you come here again, monster?
You give Troll gold! I kill, you give gold!
How can anyone be so crazy for profit? You had a lot of fun attacking the escort, didn't you?
Fun yes. Crack skull, good fun! Much blood and yell!
Then why are you complaining? Can't you just do something for the fun of it?
Orc got much gold. Orc say Troll come next day, get share.
And I don't tend to break my word. You said it yourself: Come back tomorrow.
Troll come back! Next day Troll get gold, Orc man!
The Temple Guardian’s left arm unfolds a large parabolic mirror and fires a powerful beam of concentrated energy.
The air smells of rain, don't you think?
With nature's force I will help you!
I cannot fit this item into my inventory.
I found the poacher and we fought. I only knocked him unconscious though, my employer wants him alive.
So, taken care of. The ghosts of the deceased won't be killing anyone any more.
A farmer and his cows are being attacked by spiders. I must help him!
Bah! It's easy to be merciless, when you're free and not starving.
And now you're here too - and I thought that it couldn't get any worse.
Our children will sleep better once you have left our land.
I have agreed to the deal Keltar has offered. Now I have to get rid of both his sister and her husband.
Such a city is nothing but a stronghold against nature. I'm surprised there is life at all...
Evil heroes are dumb and stinky!
You are bad! We are worse!
You think you're evil? What a load of crap!
There can be only one evil person here - and that's me!
I'm going to kick your evil butt!
I hope your remaining lives are good ones.
Go! You don't get anything without effort my dear.
Herkar, the Priest of the neighboring tribe, doesn't seem to like Fellir. I can’t expect any help from him with this problem.
It is only you now who is standing in my way on the path to the ultimate power ...
Viola sent a High Elf soldier to be my bodyguard. What a nice gesture. It seems she cares for me.
A terminal is required for analysis of gathered data. My directional sensors indicate that there must be one right around here.

Data indicates that a Temple Guardian is about to intervene in the war against the Dragons. The truce may not be broken until a decision has been made, opposing Guardian activation required to terminate intervening Temple Guardian!
Florentina was horrified that her breeding attempts were unsuccessful. The exploding Humans were a little embarrassing too. She still has a lot of work to do.

That was the big secret? An ancient war with no meaning?
I still haven't gotten any further. Where do I come from? Where am I going? What was the serum's purpose? What good is a weapon that's not put to use?
My soldiers are ready for battle, but we lack an opponent.
Are you back, or haven't you left yet?

You know, I have been in this cave for several weeks now and it's not that bad. It doesn't rain in here, the walls are bare and it is nice and cool in here during the summer. I think I will remain here for a while.

I've been attacked by rogues again. This time though, I found a small note with one of them that proves that they acted on behalf of the DeElfici family. Now that I have some evidence to show, I may report the incident to the authorities.
I must defeat the Blood Dryad leader if I want the Dryads to help the Humans.
Do not expect any mercy, Human!

They're all dead? Excellent! Suspicion and fear will continue to govern the two noble houses, and they will retaliate and seek revenge. These are good times for us. We can afford to be generous to you.
Now that Haenir called for me I will visit and kill him.
You saved my life. You have more than earned this reward. Thank you.
I need new challenges, here, everything is finished!
The jungle isn't what it used to be anymore.

What am I going to do? “Ataya, get me some whetstones. My old whetstones are smooth and smooth whetstones won't sharpen,“ said the master. What can I say? The master's right. Now here I am, and I'm supposed to get some rough whetstones. But there are scorpions everywhere!  I don't have a death wish! Could you help me get a few rough whetstones?
If I'm not mistaken, this was the last focus point.
Now your systems will be switched off for the last time...

There is nothing new under the sun but there are lots of old things we don't know.

- Bierce
Your time has come, old man!
You have been getting on my nerves long enough with your self-righteous chitchat!
Well, I guess, that's the end of the road for you, old man.
It's time to open your eyes and face reality. You're history.
You underestimate me. That was your last mistake.
What? That's how big you are?
When I'm through with you, no one will be able to tell what was trying to attack me!
Didn't anyone ever tell you not to interfere in an immortal being's business?
Would you prefer to die slowly, or really slowly?
Seriously though, you want to take me on? Don't make me laugh...
And they say that little people aren't courageous!
Do you have anything else you would like to say before you die?
Well then, show me what you've got!
I have avenged the player's death, and now I am an honorary member of the rag doll ball team!

Guardian of Souls
Originality is the fine art of remembering what you hear but forgetting where you heard it.
This item is too much for my abilities.
You’re not angry about this are you?
Yeah, you like that, picking on simple people, don't you?
Need some more blood sacrifices, eh?
Hell is already heated up for you!
One day you'll pay for it all!
A bunch of scales with teeth... Yeah, one could reduce it to that.
Yes, yes, never mind. I'm not dim-witted. For the Grand Inquisitor himself.

Get me some dead Orcs!

I am Kragik and these are my assistants Naguz and Togasch. We are working on a truly groundbreaking project. Our research will change the world and you can be a part of it!
We need Orcs. Dead Orcs. Or alive. It doesn't really matter in this case. We're going to turn them into mindless Zombies either way. Zombie Orcs who will help us conquer the world. Hordes of Orcs that we can control at will. No kingdom or army will be able to defeat us!
Get me some Orcs!
I found a crate filled with rolls of cloth, Toriak will be pleased. I'll take the cloth to him.

This software must be activated prior usage. For activation a SERIAL is essential. If you already received your SERIAL press NEXT to proceed. In the event you have not received a SERIAL yet, please contact the software publisher.
I will destroy your black soul!
I'll show you who is the better murderer!

Tell Waton about the berserkers!

Psst, hey you! Come over here. I’m hiding from my deranged brothers. A week ago, shortly after we fed the Dragons, my brothers began to hack one another to pieces. Each other I tell you, not just the Humans that we normally beat and feed to the Dragons. They really began to kill each other! I swear by all the Holy Dragons that it's true! Something terrible must have happened. My deranged brothers all had weird blue tongues. My superior Waton must be informed, he will know what to do. Go and tell him about the berserkers. I'll stay here and gather more information.
I have to be on my guard, the monsters here are too strong!
The shepherd was not happy about the loss of his sheep, but I still got my reward.

Bring me the Potion of Bedevilment from the priestess' hut. I will exchange it for my charm!

The Crystal Caves? True enough, getting in isn't easy because of the Facetteleon, but you have bigger worries. Before you get in you need to get there and sentient trees will rip you to bits if you're not careful. Sure, you can try to fight them, but “trying” isn't the same as “succeeding” now is it? It's best to just avoid them and I know how, which I guess is why you're here. I use a magic charm to get past them, but I only have one and I need it for my work.
Now, if you were to get me a Potion of Bedevilment from the priestess' hut... Drinking that gives me temporary abilities that can be permanently transferred into an item, so I could make a new charm for myself. Oh ho, I know that look! Sure, you could kill me, but then how would you know which item here was the charm or how to use it, hmmm? Nope, I think you'll either have to try to fight your way or get me that potion, what do you say?
A gang of thieves have seized a vessel. They failed to steal it because the ship's captain took the steering wheel with him. I'm supposed to take care of the thieves.
Not even somebody like you will be able to thwart my plans.
It will be with me, and in them.

Find the source of the strange tracks!

You there! Let me inspect your boots!
Hm ... no, you didn't leave these tracks, either. But then, who was it?
I found a set of fresh tracks to the east of here just yesterday. They weren't monster or animal prints, I know that for a fact. They were left by humanoids! But by who or what exactly?
I am at my wits end. I've never been a great tracker. You can't be good at everything, can you? Would you be willing to go out there and try to find out what left the tracks?

Gravestone
Procrastination is the art of keeping up with yesterday.

Jahrin, an aritocrate who has been expropriated, has asked me to  take revenge on his tormentor - a newly-rich by the name of Goldman. Goldman is apparently well-guarded. I have to talk to a thief called Jana as she might know how to slip past the guards.
Jana's contacts will be able to assist me further.
You can really take a beating...
A perfidious plan. I never knew you had that in you.

Aha! This isn't as simple as I thought. The alchemist needs the bowels of five anemic harpies as well as the head of a special scarab. He plans to make a tincture out of them, which will allow him to visit the plane of the ghosts.
A portal to the icy region.
I have killed all the Lizardmen, now I can collect my reward from the nameless Priest.
You should have stuck to soccer, Human!

Kratos was able to discover that the scroll is used to conjure Demons. It is written in the conjurer's blood. Arch Mage Saewald is supposed to be able to find out who is behind all this. I'm going to show him the scroll.
Attention! Attention! The High Elf is entering the poxy village called...uhm...no idea and it doesn't matter anyway
Okay! I'll retreat before someone really gets hurt!
I would prefer to make a hasty retreat at this point in time.
I'll be right back! I promise!
I think it would be best if I left...
Is it okay with you if I stop this fight right now?
These catapults won't catapult anything! I think I can consider this a success.
Clean water is important for us all!
The High Elves Guard is the High Elves' regular army. They are well trained and armed.
I've killed the scientist and his two thugs.
Fresh air and healthy food can do wonders.

Day 9: We've been sitting in this ditch for days now. Magical detonations all around us. It was a good idea to dig these ditches and tunnels.

Day 10: I saw a woman standing on the moonlit hill tonight. The first woman I've seen for weeks. I wonder who she might be?

Day 11: They are everywhere! I don't think I will survive this day.

“...otion of Regrowth:
... sticklewort.
...ed dye
...ugar cube
...ood dose of superstition.
... sticklewort with dye, crush the sugar cube and stir in.
... with a good dose of superstition into a vial and shake well. The

... I accepted to command 12.000 soldiers, each of them magically gifted. Furthermore, my regiment consisted of 1.200 Squires, 600 kitchen boys, 40 trackers, 10 cooks, 5 alchemists and one herb woman. I told the general that it is a bad idea to take a woman along, even if it is only an herb woman. But 13855 men and one women can only mean ...
Lately something has been on my mind and I really have to talk about it.
I'm afraid I'm going to have to bother you with another problem.
Since you're already here, don't let me forget to discuss one matter!
I am the more dangerous predator here!

Success is the ability to go from one failure to another with no loss of enthusiasm.

- Churchill

The princess ordered a ring for her upcoming wedding and I'm supposed to deliver it now.
This ring is very valuable. I hope I'll be attacked, it would make the task a little more fun for me.
Detected enemies do not present danger.
The statue of a fallen warrior named Derfnam Labuz.
I'm looking forward to a cold beer under a shady tree when all this is over.
The Orcs may have use for something like that, but not us.
Right then... I think that’s all of them, I hope I didn’t miscount!
Come on "General," let's see who the true ruler over the underworld is.
And now I will punch you!
You should speak to the slaves.
I had to eliminate Hyderia's bodyguard. She fled so I should go look for her.
The antidote has a gradual effect. You'll probably have some bad cramps for the next two or three days.
3 parts tormentil, 1 part cardamom, a pinch of anise... This will relieve a bloated stomach.
It looks like I won't be able to just intimidate them. Well, I’ll do this the hard way then!
My righteous anger will be your ruin, Lizard!
I don't care about your matter.
Right! Death to the marigold pickers!
Ghost, feel the power of the Inquisition!
A new law every day! How am I supposed to write that fast?
Only the Gods scribe more swiftly than I.
Well now, it is complete. And well scripted.
The words are flowing out of my quill today.
The same to you, holy master.
I think I know enough about these ghosts. They attack as soon as they see me. They don't exhibit complex behavior and there is no sign of an advanced social behavior.

The farmer was surprised to hear that the mage had not been the perpetrator. He was appalled to learn that the mage had fallen victim to a zombie who had settled in the mage’s house, and that the zombie had been behind all the incidents. Still, the farmer was glad that I was able to solve this problem. He had collected several gold coins from the neighbors, which he handed me as a reward.

Do you have all three pieces? I don't know how you two managed to pull that off.
I'm going to have a quick look at the entire scroll...

Well, there are three lines that are of significance:
"The key has 3 notches on the top and 3 on the bottom."
"The 3rd notch on the top and the 2nd on the bottom could use some pressure."
"King Brurag El Leigh is receiving applicants."
It's still a little unclear, but no doubt finding the king would help. The text will probably only make sense when you are in the right place.
The shaman of the other village was willing to resurrect the shaman of the first village. I hope it will work. My job is done here.
What a fool! Did he really believe he could take on an Orc? Well at least he died in battle. Now let me grieve in peace.
I will only die my my own hands!
The gold, the humiliation... I don't care about that, only about my father.
I'm bored! E-books haven't been invented yet, and I'm finished with my Sudoku book!
What have I done to you, whelp?

Destroy the undead and General Terus!

My scouts have made an extremely important discovery. General Terus has finally crept out of his hole and is staying in the main camp, which isn't very far from here. Eliminating him would be a critical blow to the Undead Legion. It's not going to be easy to get at him though. Are you still going to make an attempt?
The troops are really gathering ... well, we don't have a choice now. We must act. It's up to me to make a plan in the little time we got.
The arena owner wasn't happy about my allegations, but he has made me an offer. He will free Heglie's husband if I fight in the arena and win.
I have no reason to say no.
I think this is the right place.
The gardener is really happy that I got him out of a tight spot. Without flowers he would have had a real problem.

Bring camp master Thorleif ten boar pelts.

Hello, stranger. Are you looking for some well paid tasks? People like you are always welcome here - if you can prove your hunting abilities. Kill ten boars and take their pelts to camp master Thorleif.
Three deer pelts, as requested! Now that's what I call success!
I should part with some of these precious things in order to make room for new ones.
There! That must be the huntress! She's being attacked, I have to help her!
A dying hermit has asked me to collect herbs in a mine not far away and take them to a herb woman in the village. He's also given me a key to the mine.
What do you want? Who are you? Oh, It doesn't matter. DIE!
It's almost time for the tradition of the combat blessing! I hope to see you there.
Will I see you at the blessing of the fighters? I think the ghosts of our forefathers will be happy about it!
Soon the blessing of the fighters will be held! That's one of our nicest rituals, don't you agree?
This year I will bless the fighters! I think the ancestors will really like that.
What do you think about the blessing of the fighters? Isn't it a moving ritual? I'm always very touched.
No fighter is allowed to wield weapons without being blessed. That's the rule of our forefathers.
Do you think there will be a lot of fighters at the blessings? After all it's what our ancestors want.
Hopefully there will be more fighters at the blessing this time! Or are you about to enrage the ancestors?
Soon I will be blessing the young warriors! This ritual always gives me great joy.
I'd appreciate if you'd take part in the blessing of the warriors this time! It's also a great celebration!
The leader of a tribe of Lizardmen has asked me to bring him the heads of five cultists. He is sick and tired of the cult and has decided to join the resistance.
Good bye! And do pass on my regards!
The downloaded data is corrupt. Press the PS-Button and delete the data in "Game / Game Data Utility / Sacred 2", then try again.
The downloaded data is corrupt. Please go to the Xbox Dashboard and delete the data, then try again.
Are you from around here? I've never seen you here before.
Become a warrior? You still have time to look for a real job.
Keep it up! This land needs energetic men!
Increased chance to detect hiding places, traps, and stealthed creatures.
The soldier's dead and his amulet mine! But ... what is this? That's just worthless junk! Well, at least I put him out of his misery. He should be grateful for that...
Fine, fine! These are great, absolutely disgusting. Let's see whether it works.
In memoriam of all those thieves, cutthroats and burglars who never really had a chance.
You could wake a dead horse with this black concoction.
We expected so much of you, mage.
Let's cut to the chase, my dear.
You turn against your own kind? Then you must die!
Aren't you ashamed of yourself, mage?
Your father should have sold you, before your magic talent awoke.
I have found the shaman and should ask her now.
Sure, it's fun, but will I get XP for these bloodbaths here?
Feel the power of the Gods!
I hope you made your will?!
The innkeeper claims that his guests are all law-abiding folks, but I think he knows more than he was prepared to tell. I will have to press him for more information.
That takes care of the undead. Now I'll take the soldiers back to the road.
Stones are my one and everything!
Ey, for real, it'd be wicked if you could totally play on here, dude, you know.
You have proved yourself worthy of the barony. You have my utmost respect! Many thanks!

You are willing to help me? Thanks! I owe you.
Here! I made this picture of her. Don't be surprised ... female zombies don't look any different from male zombies. Only the voice and the smell are different. An awkward side effect of being a zombie. But I think you should recognize her with the help of this picture.
Young DeMordrey gave me a key to the basement. I'll go down there and see what type of weapon the baron's son spoke of.
We're going to start operation “Crag Rock” soon! I can hardly wait.
I am surprised to find something that rare...
I'm getting sick and tired of orcs!

What did you say? Robbers attacked our border guard and killed Marys? I have to send a telegram to TyBosso right away. I'll also send him his son's amulet. He won't be happy. You've done a lot for us. Thank you!
There is no time for that at the moment.
If I have to wait around here for much longer my joints will get rusty!
Porr-TUAG! Enog... what? I lost my place again!
You truly are the equal of a seraphim huntress. But it's not over yet!

Kybele

Kybele is the Goddess of Nature - she is the patron of fertility and life, of flora and fauna.



Grants: Infusion

Kybele's healing hand blesses all allied creatures. Their wounds disappear, their pain vanishes. For a brief period their souls are strengthened by Kybele's divine blessing so that all attacks against them fail.
We have arrived at the spring. The shamen will now attempt to dry out the spring with his magic ritual. I better stand aside and let him get on with it.
Enough with the haunting! Now you die.
How in the world did you find me! Oh it doesn't matter anyway. Nobody will care once the crows have made short work of your remains. DIE!

Nothing is happening here any more. *grumble* I guess I'm not a Temple Guardian any more but turned into a temple statue. Just that there is no temple around. Well, I guess I'm just a statue then. *grumble*
What? Are you looking for me? Yes I'm Silmia, daughter of Theminius. How can I help you?
Mom says Kobolds stink. Is that true?
Aren't you afraid of beasts and Kobolds?
When I'm grown up I want to kill Kobolds too, just like you!
How many Kobolds did you kill? More than I have fingers?
Are Kobolds tasty? All we ever have are potatoes.

Pick up my shipment.

Greetings! My name is Innohep and I deal in gladiators. A new shipment is on the way to the crossroads up north. Take these two mercenaries and pick up the prisoners. You will be well rewarded.
Rapid Fire - Increases the skeletal tower's firing rate.
Focus - Reduces the cooldown time for the skeletal tower.
Scatter Shot - Adds another projectile to the skeletal tower.
Perforate - The arrows pierce through their targets and continue on their flight path.
My blade is thirsty for your blood, Dryad!

Jochen Hofmeier
i’ll be back
error: too many errors
insert coin!
Any Hero using a portal for the first time.

Did... did my husband send you? No I'm fine. I managed to find the place where my daughter is being held captive and I didn't want to let it out of my sight. I'm glad you're here, maybe it's not too late.
That dreadful cult that calls itself the “Shadows of Life” has Gilminga. They're all nuts! Each one is crazier than the next! The “Master” promises his followers eternal life in a happy, bodiless form - after death of course. For this they must serve him in this life.
They make much ado about nothing.
Your presence almost certainly means nothing good, dark woman.
Please move on - I already have an evil woman at home.
May Ker bless you and the path you wander along.
Cave... close... by! Devilish... machine. Must... find crystal.
Don’t let her wait. Silken thighs. Go see Sophia in the audience room.
Only I deserve the powers of T-Energy!
Wasn't it you who killed off all those Kobolds? Good work!
Your reputation precedes you! Good work, that Kobold business!
I think there's a Kobold finger still sticking to your shoe!
Aren't you the one who killed off all those Kobolds?
Good job with that Kobold undertaking! The country needs more heroes of your kind!
That's a little too big for me...
Nicole was relieved and thanked me in Sophia's name.
I found the bag with the Christmas Wishes and the key to the locked door. Now I can take the other way out of the cave.
Yes, until then my unworthy fellow.
You won't beat me like that!
First I'll kill your horse, then you!
I must to retrieve my possessions from the archives.
The adventure hungry customer has arrived. Let's start the tour.
Starting point of the Highelves' expedition in the Bloodwood.

The mystery is revealed. The Demiurge is the Great Machine! He is creation, he is not a God but a divine tool. Mother is not my mother, she just calls herself that. She is the guardian of the Great Machine.
We, the Temple Guardians, protect the entryways to the Great Machine from places all over the world. Mother had the Demiurge create us. Over the millennia of her existence, Mother went insane! She wants all life destroyed so it can rise again, new and strong.
Which way to the war? I need some money.
I was hired at the local harbour tavern.
I shall fight to the bitter end!
As long as the money is right - I'll fight anything!
I'll rest and get my strength back at our lodgings. My comrades will take care of me!
The combo master will prepare the potion. It will only take a moment. I declined his well-meant offer of cookies, though.
PA! There's the one who duffed up the fog!!!
You beat up a Carnach? Well, my father once beat up an ORC!
Everybody can beat up fog! That's nothing special - puh!
Now that you killed it, will there never be fog again?
I wasn't quick enough. The leader of the pack is probably over the hills and far away.
You were no match for me, either.
Rider, I stand for law and order!
Just a few more lines and my day's work is done.
To think that paper is made from dead trees! It's just terrible.
My style is similar to that of Grand Master En'Peeh Ze.
Folks say I just sit around inside all day. But my work is tiring and strenuous
I just can't seem to concentrate today. It's the full moon, of course...

So you refuse the gift? Yes, granted, it's a technicality, but it is still immortality. Very well, I respect your lofty goals. I only hope you don't regret passing this up, if your destiny doesn't prove to be as great as you expect.
You High Elves will never learn when to take a step back, eh?
Fight properly! You bring shame to our nation!
I have found Furia! But ... it doesn't look good.
Mary Ann has asked me to accompany her to the underworld.
Ridiculous, isn't it? We should lay down our arms so this region will become more peaceful.
What nonsense is that? They want us to disarm citizens to strengthen the army?
There will be a revolution if you make us give our arms to you!
I don't think disarming the people to strengthen our army is a good idea, do you understand my concern?
What should I think about putting down my weapons and relying on the troops?
Are you surprised that people are hostile? They're trying to take our weapons!
This pact between the people and the army is stupid, I'm not going to donate my weapons.
Are you serious about us people giving our blades to you fighters?
What's this nonsense about the new weapon law? There's no way I'm going to give away my blade.
How silly is that? We give our weapons away and make ourselves defenseless?

Kill a felon!

Well .. that ... that's a bit embarrassing. I would like to be a great huntress. But I have to kill a felon first, and I just can't seem to do it! I don't know why. I look the beast in the eye and BAM! ... all my combat arts are forgotten. Maybe it's the excitement. So far, I haven't forgotten how to run away.
Would you kill a felon for me? I would be eternally grateful!
Keeping the balance is one of the Guardian's most important tasks.

Keeper of the Temple
All the world wondered as they witnessed... a people lift themselves from humiliation to the greatest pride.
Oh really? And you think these strange Gods are superior to Kybele? Then I hope you are prepared for her judgment.
Do you want to know what happens to those who disregard the Goddess' will? I don't have to paint a picture for you, do I?
I can't believe you're that stupid! Those who turn their backs on Kybele will only experience pain and suffering.
What's the problem? Kybele can't be everywhere, but those who don't believe will experience great pain!
Kybele says: ”I am the mistress, your Goddess! Do not worship false idols if you want to keep your soul!”
You fighters must know what you want to believe, but I will cautiously remind you of Kybele's dreaded scornful wrath!
What are you talking about? False idols are nothing but an expression of blasphemy! Please proclaim this message to your fellow warriors!
Go and talk to your fighters. Tell them what Kybele says: “Turn back, for I am a jealous Goddess!”
Do you want to challenge the Goddess with your talk? That never becomes those who make an honest attempt at it.
Oh, that is naturally a bad sign! Tell your comrades that Kybele is the Goddess! Whoever doesn't believe that will die!
I can return to Lia now that I have successfully increased the numbers of the faithful.
You should teach your henchmen some discipline.
Proficiency - Decreases the cooldown of Acute Mind.
Defiant - Decreases the duration of impairments and wounds.
Celerity - Increases attack and cast speed.
Easiness - Additionally decreases the regeneration time.
The garrison is close by - you can’t miss it!
It's only for nature's mercy that you haven't become extinct yet!

I couldn’t stand the sight of Dundiel any longer, so I dashed his brains out like a rabid dog. Ophtanar is next on my list. I’ll put a stop to this evil business once and for all! I expect the cult isn't exactly poor either.

Protect me on my way!

Dealings with the enemy clan they say. Traitor to your own kind, they say. WHATEVER! Do I look like I would do business with the enemy clan? Now be honest, do I really look like I would? What nonsense! Idle talk! Now my adversaries have even sent an assassin after me. These assassins are dangerous guys. They blend in among the masses and strike like lightening.
You look like you know how to defend yourself. Would you accompany me on my rounds? I don't even trust my own bodyguards anymore.
The mayor was happy that he got the trophy. Now the gun club anniversary can go ahead as planned.
Welcome, warrior! Your reputation is not the worst one.
If you were a little more settled, I'd fall in love with you.
To some people, you are already a great hero.
I know a lot about ominous creatures.
Animal fur... Time to start looking forward to your new winter coat!
And what kind of creature is this supposed to ... Oh well, I guess I'll find out!
Okay, I'll pull the wool over that creature's ears!
Is it true that Kybele has a spirit living in every plant to guard it?
These days many don't believe that the plant spirits constantly surround us. They are real, aren't they?
Unfortunately hardly anyone believes that Kybele's helping spirits live in all our plants.
I have never met one of these good plant spirits, even though I really love our forest!
I met two plant spirits today, they live in my rose bush! Are they dangerous?
Kybele sent many spirits to help us, right? Why don't we recognize them?
My brother was being teased by a plant spirit that was living in his wild berry bush! Does he have to put up with that?
I don't really mind the plant spirits that surround us, but their practical jokes are very annoying sometimes!
Why does the great Goddess need the help of the plant spirits? I think they 're quite a useless bunch!
The plant spirits in my gorse are quite a nuisance. They giggle day and night!
Feel the power of the Gods, villain!
Zizhar was relieved to know that both his skin complaint and the itching will soon be gone. He'll smell of rotten bat brains from now on, but I guess you can’t have everything.
Is gnome the comparative of small?
We found the dead body of a garema. But what's so strange about it?
While active, Sinister Predator increases ranged attack speed and chance to hit with ranged weapons. It also adds a chance that opponents will drop shrunken heads.
If only I was just a little like you - then my husband would be in for it!
Spare me please. I have sixteen children and a sick grandmother.
Your crimes are already a part of Ancarian history, warrioress.
By the ancestors - you are real!
Your ancestors probably regard your path with pride...
Oh, you do seem determined. How remarkable!
Thank you. It doesn't seem to be very safe around here. I guess we should stay awake for a while.
The horseshoes have been delivered. The customer is happy and able to shoe the horses again!
I am familiar with the power of T-Energy...
That was harder than I expected! I guess I'll start heading back then.
Only fools are servants of evil - I'd better leave you alone.
Your appearance radiates an aura of evil.
Everyone can sense the evil in you!
Have you ever considered working in the wood business? It’s quite a lucrative branch!
My badge of rank? What about it? I... ah! I see... Guys, we have someone who needs a detailed lesson in how curiosity killed the cat.
The name you have entered is not valid. Please choose a different name.
Attack, you walking waste of space!
In my day, we had names other than "hero" for the likes of you.
Have you already fought against something bodiless?
The end is nearing, great hero!
I can already see the headline: Ghost one - Hero zero!
You want me to give you a chance by fighting with only one hand?
Your tactics are brilliant, brainless horde!
We could use more people like you.
The Bear is dead? You are worthy of respect! Well done!
There's no time! Kill the Gar'Colossus before it's too late.
The opponents in this region use weapons inflicting mainly fire-based damage.
The decision chart comes in handy once more. I have the second key now. According to the data, the next one can be found in the swamps.
The nun was very happy. She couldn't pay me, but I'm still glad I helped her.
Pax’Ram seems to be okay with the sight of blood now, even if his face still turns into a lighter shade of green. But maybe that’s normal for an Orc. We should return to his father.
I have to be careful here, opponents in this place are very powerful!
The prince's ghost agreed to accompany us into the ruins of his palace.
Alesia got her ... ahem ... well-earned trophy. She beamed like a Cheshire cat.

Gravestone
I expected more luxury from a 2-star hotel.
This is what I call fighting!
He's leaving me? Why is he doing this to me?
To kill such inferior enemies is against the law of the jungle!
There's talk about free elections again. What's your opinion on this matter?
This constant quarrel about the right to vote! We can't possibly agree to let each and every one vote!
Do you think we should let everyone go to the ballot box? That’s a funny idea!
A reformation of the right to vote, some troublemakers would really like that, wouldn't they?
The right to vote is a gift of the Gods! Nobody should even think about liberalizing it!
They're complaining again! Why are our voting rights too strict all of a sudden?
I don't think that the right to vote should be changed! It would be better if the people changed!
You were nothing and now you are still nothing.
You seem to be a remarkably unselfish person.
Do you want to accompany me to the cloth merchant?
This item is too much for my powers.
Any hero reaching the desert of Bengaresh and accepting a quest there.
Here! Apply the lotion to the affected area three times daily. The inflammation should clear up within a week. I'll give you a  plaster and some tissues as well, just in case.

The kobold chief told me that his tribe moved here to live in peace. They don't want to fight or being hunted anymore. And he asked me not to tell the seraphim about them. They would either drive the tribe away or kill them.
My equipment doesn't protect me enough against damage from poison.
Kybele has accepted the harpy egg and the clean water. I bless you in her name. May nature never turn against you.
A reward, how interesting! This is getting better and better.
I might not be able to use this now, but my time will come!
Jade! A truly divine stone, wouldn’t you say?

I'm impressed. You slew an Orc! I didn't think my son had it in him. Maybe he'll turn into a real man after all.
I'm in your debt. Let me make it up to you with this old treasure map, one of the souvenirs from the many battles I fought. I never went looking for this treasure, but maybe you'd like to try your luck.
Welcome. Please stand here, then we can begin.
The guard in the village has another assignment for me.
You aren't even worth the air that you use up!
Player, I don't want to get demolished here...
The father was shocked, but I'm not exactly sure which news affected him more.
I think this is the right place.

A pretty addlebrained priest wants me to get water samples from the wells in the temple ruins nearby. Only if the water in the wells is pure, the ground around it hallowed.

... at least I think so.
That was a good day. Let's see how much we made...
This region is at peace and my name will be spoken with great admiration.
That’s just typical, that wretched old man! Well, he can go jump in the lake! I don’t care! The cult is my family now. I no longer have any parents!
No Orc is going to get in my way!
Will you hand over your scales voluntarily?
The opponents in this region use mostly magical damage weapons.
I have to leave this town as soon as possible, or I'll go insane!
Yes, it's really pathetic brother! Sometimes it's not even delightful to pray for these losers!
It's an insult against Kuan! There's no other way of putting it. But hopefully a storm will destroy the temple.
I can only hope that Kuan's not charging us with this! It's an insult against every single believer!
What did you expect? They drink nonstop before they start working at the building site.
It's a mockery! If it least looked like a nightmare, but this is just ridiculous!
We've never been a nation of great builders! But this thing is nothing short of a disaster!
This is as bad as it gets. I hope Kuan's looking the other way so we won't have to feel his wrath.
Kuan should destroy this building with a terrible earthquake!
I was wondering what this thing was supposed to depict, all I could guess was that it might be a bad joke.
You are absolutely right! Let's burn down this insult against every single believer before HE sees it!

There isn't much left of the beer, but at least the band of robbers is gone. The tavern owner still needs to learn how to count, though. He said there were three robbers, but there were really thirty!
I have no use for this piece of equipment.
Didn't you know that it takes heroes especially long to die?
Let me try the blood of a hero...
You knocked that Kobold out, didn't you?
Was that Kobold chief taller than me, or smaller?
The Kobold ran away but you were faster, weren't you?
Did you give those Kobolds a punch on the nose?
Have you also defeated bigger monsters than Kobolds?
And they say the Gods don't jest!
I am concerned about the souls in my congregation.
I bow down in humility to the Gods.
I will have to get some more incense for Friday's prayers.
Good Priests like myself have become very scarce in these modern times.
In these times, the old traditions are a great help.

I see, this Easter cult tried to gain wealth using these eggs. The Brain Egg is behind all this. It lays the eggs and turns them into riches. Still, there is no danger of that anymore. The egg has been broken, so to speak.
Stay away from me with your sand fleas!
Hey player! If the game is too exciting for you, let your mommy play! Anything to get some action around here!

Another ghost story!
Let me thing about what I can do.

Yes it's a strange object, isn't it? Nobody knows what it is. No I can't give it to you, it has been on loan to the museum from TyBosso but the contract has expired. You could do me a favor by taking it back to TyBosso.
This ominous Pilgrim seems to be a statue. There must be a mechanism to open and close the doors.
So a promissory note. I have a debt of 250.000 gold pieces? Where am I supposed to get that kind of money? Perhaps I should complain to the local commander, that can't be right.
I really shouldn't be bothered with those weaklings.
How long do you Humans live? 60 years? 70? I'll take this attack as teenage rebellion.
I will show you where my bread is buttered!
Come here, and I'll give you a new hair cut!
You're going to get special treatment!
I hope you know a good dentist!
This is what classifies as a warrior nowadays?
This is the entrance to Burag El Leigh's burial chamber!
This large slab moved slightly! Maybe it is some kind of switch...

Yes, obviously this slab was one of the keys notches!
When I look at the shape of the burial chamber it does remind me of a key...
I have recovered the gold they got for the slaves, now I should take it to the mine owner.

You got them all? Good work, truly good work. Here is the reward that you were promised.

By the way, I heard that the inn keeper is having problems as well. Perhaps you should seek him out.
Barbara shouldn't stay here by herself. This place is crawling with undead.
What do you want? A rat? Rats are the smartest, best, and most pugnacious of all the animals! They are the Great Rat's children. I cannot simply give you one, no matter how good your reasons are.

Karl didn't want to come quietly, but I didn't really expect him to. Now he's dead, but that's his own fault.
I'll take his head to the commander. Maybe that will be enough.
I feel better already. Come back later, I'll be happy to see you again.
He came to his senses and now he wants to accompany me to his sister so he can comfort her.
That is an honor for me.
Those who sow hate, reap misery!

An Undead Legion is apparently making this neighborhood unsafe. The Thylysium Council sent a mage to look into this matter. She asked me to assist her in her research. At Blessed Rock Manor there is supposed to be a historian who might possibly have helpful documents in his records.
You might be able to hide in the fog, but I'll find and destroy you.
You're one of those devilish contraptions created by the Elves, right?
Guardian, I'm going to have to stop you!
Make sure your screws are numbered!
Where is that blasted reset button?
He is white. And his name is Bruno!
I arrived in a small High Elven settlement. I wonder if they will have anything for me to do?
There is no room here for Humans!
Unbelievable. They poison river and ocean, kill animals without being hungry and they are even proud of it. I am going to teach them a lesson!
I shall decorate the market square with a mosaic - and when I am finished people will sing for joy!
Praise the Gods - I am full of inspiration today!
I am in a very creative phase this week.
The woodcutter asked me to draw him. That will be a pleasant change.
I have a pile of bones to pick with you!

Michael Bussler
Let's go have a smoke...
Tarmas was very pleased and gave me a decent reward.
Aha... I have to take more tasks from more brothers, that WAS a surprise. I’d really like to know what they plan with this!
The grown-ups are allowed to choose - between slavery and serfdom.
No one will explain to me what subjugation really means.
I hear that now three year old children are allowed to work in slavery.
You should give these politicians a strong hit in the face!
Politics? That's when some are feasting while others go hungry, isn't it?
And I'll give you another one at the same spot!
The slave didn't get very far and he's begging for his pitiful life...
Ha, I found the Death Tree. And there's the branch!
Well done! Sophia will be happy. Take this as a sign of our gratitude.
I hope I can find a few lucrative missions in this city.
You have preached your mistaken belief long enough.
I can't achieve enough normal damage with this weapon.
Ahhh... You're... too late. Our leader... already gone... He wants to unleash... medallion's power... on statue... not far. You're too... too late, haharrr...

Here's what I know:
The cult has its headquarters at an old Temple. Everything is coordinated from there. Unfortunately the Temple is protected by a magic shield, only the cultists can pass the shield unnoticed. I know how to deactivate it.
There's a hidden cave not far from the Temple. The shield gets its magic energy from there. Deactivate the shield to get into the Temple.
Do I look like I could use THIS?
Cemil was pleased. He's asked me to get some milk now.
Remember to show no mercy! The wild Werewolves are all completely deranged, they will attack anything they see.
The camp is on the other side of the bridge! Please hurry!
I have the amulet! I'm anxious to hear what Lupus has to say about it.
The name written on this scroll shall be your name. Wear it with pride. You are now officially a member of the family Grackk. Go now, and greet your new family!
I require better protection against physical damage.
Well, that comes as no surprise...
Your existence displeases the Gods, machine.
Does your mind have enough will power to find faith?
Scrap metal from ancient times - that's all you are.
Machine you were created to serve, not to think.
No Temple Guardian has ever turned against his masters.
That's what I thought. Lupus didn't want to accept defeat and challenged me to a duel. Well let's just see what his old bones are made of.
What can I do for you my lord? I am pleased to be at your services.
Then I will be frank. My sister is still not married, and I am looking for a husband for her.
How can I be of service to you? I have no knowledge of such matters.
But you know my sister, right?
Yes, of course. She is a...well...a lady of substance, if I may say so.
Yes, she is. I am offering you the once in a lifetime chance to marry into our family.
Don't take this the wrong way, but I would rather remain a poor man for the rest of my days.
Then I will have to take my chances elsewhere. I simply must get rid of her!
You want to travel to the mainland? No problem!
So he wants to sell the women and children as slaves to the Elves. I have to hurry, or else I'll miss the negotiations.
Twenty percent off all our coffins today only - twenty percent off everything except our pet coffins!
The merchant owes the boy some candies and I must take them from him.
I am too late. Barbara is dead.
Go now. You don't make a princess wait.
Diaanja gave her heartfelt thanks for her deliverance. She and Khormynth are back together ... even if it's only in death.
Don't worry. That beast is as good as dead.
I know my way around forest creatures.
Well then, into battle I go.
I'll take a look at that monster. You better stay here, you'll just be in the way anyhow.
Maybe you should just stay here and hide behind your books.
Even his wings won't do him much good.
Well? Still not dropping dead, are we?
This clan chief will never suppress anybody again.
Soldier, do not fight a Guardian!
Even if you had 15 arms I wouldn't be scared of you.
They insulted us? Well, that's a serious problem, of course.

Take this letter to Senator Nimorean!

Creating the potions will take me some time. In the meantime, we will have to inform the Council in Thylysium about the events occurring here. I've jotted down a few points. Would you be so kind as to take this letter to Senator Nimorean in Thylysium?
I found the builders. Their building days are over! I should return to Menteriel and collect my reward now.
The Blood Dryads have kidnapped a Dryad family. If we don’t rescue them from the hands of their captors they certainly won’t live very much longer. I’ll try to save these Dryads.
Curse this day! My hit rate is terrible today.
A noose is a cruel, devious and incredibly practical way of hunting.
Just one roe buck and we could fill our bellies for a week.
Opossum hunting? How low can you go?
And then I said to the jackrabbit: "One shot and it's over."

Help with the séance, and settle the dispute over the inheritance once and for all!

I’ve finally found you! You must help me dear Aunt, I’m going crazy.

You probably know that your great Uncle Namiel died recently, and he wasn’t exactly a poor man. At any rate, he left behind a piece of property, but his will does not state anywhere whom he intended to leave it to and now they are all fighting over it.

We have decided to put an end to this matter: We want to call upon Namiel's spirit and ask him personally. But for this we will need three mages that are part of his bloodline. Will you help us? Otherwise this dispute will never end.
If I take this along, my back will start giving me trouble.

The Winning Gambler

By Husganson the Elder

They say you only need three things to win the game:

- A good knowledge of the rules
- A clear head
- Luck

But who wants to rely on unpredictable things such as luck when the table’s bending under the sheer weight of the gold and the moneylender already sent his thugs after you? Isn’t it more intelligent to have some advantages like knowing which cards your opponents have in their hands?

The successful (or desperate) gamer should buy certain skills and items, if these arguments sound reasonable to them. One thing that's helpful, especially when playing cards, is to wear clothes with wide sleeves where you can hide some cards occasionally to improve a lousy hand later on. Take heed that you don't slip and play a fifth ace or similar nonsense that will get you caught! For these occasions it’s helpful to have a swift horse, never be a miser when it comes to your mount. As the formerly great gamer Jonah No-Finger once said: “If I had paid attention to this simple wisdom I wouldn’t need another person to scratch my nose now."

Players should start with smaller games in villages, and act naive. It’s also advisable to lose the first rounds. Occasionally ask about the rules or do some awkward shuffling to give the impression of being less skilled than you are. If you should by chance win a round you should be generous. Buy a strong wine for everyone and your opponents will be more careless in the future, just don't drink it yourself.

In these circles every player can train their finger nimbleness. They should find out what kind of cards and dice are common in the areas they plan to travel, and they should buy a large supply of them. About half of them should remain untouched so they can be checked if anyone gets suspicious. Then you mark the rest of the cards with tiny symbols on their backs. Try to buy cards with an especially patterned backside, as they are commonly used in the southern provinces and marks aren't as noticeable in the pattern. You should make the symbols as inconspicuous as possible, but they shouldn’t be too small either - you don’t want to stand out by making strange movements with your eyes or your head. A good rule of thumb for this is: If you can’t distinguish a horse from a bucket when you’re twenty feet away then you shouldn’t try to mark your cards.

These players shouldn’t despair, because they can always make their own luck in a nice game of dice instead. The marking of dice was reserved for the carpenter’s guild for a long time, but since their secret was unraveled you don’t have to pay them large amounts for this service anymore. You just drill into the points on the side opposite the one you’re interested in, fill the hole with lead and paint the points above it again. Be careful because even in the country it’s common to exchange the dice before playing, or to pass them in circles on one tip to find out if they have been manipulated. Nimble-fingered players should keep their dice in the wide sleeves of their clothing and exchange them for normal ones after every round. Players whose fingers aren't nimble enough should lay the dice aside and take up the plow instead. They’ll live much longer there than if they played in the taverns.

When you're able to cheat some farmers out of harvest and home you should move on to the next city. Before you do this you should think about looking for the right partner to distribute the winnings in a discreet manner. It won’t be necessary to emphasize that this decision shouldn’t be made lightly. You should always expect the worst from others, as they certainly expect the worst from you.

Last but not least we should talk about the opponents you should pay attention to while undertaking this profession. Beware of the ones who dress and act like you, they're probably up to the same thing. Then there are the members of the so called brotherhood of honorable gamers, a society that is fanatically dedicated to the purity of gambling. You can identify them through their stern faces and though their habit of praying over their cards and dice. If you are unlucky enough to meet them, it is advisable to make a lively retreat and to rely on your already mentioned fast mount. If you want to know more about them, just pay Jonah No-Finger a visit.
