If these aren't real whetstones, then I don't know what are! I should take them back to the apprentice.

The jewels soak up excessive magic essence from the surroundings. Magic energy can be obtained from them as long as they are not set in the amulet, but they have been neutralized once again. I'm going to take the amulet to Kerry, it's a family heirloom after all.
The conflict between worldly and spiritual powers will divide our land yet.
Soulless, without scruples - and soon even headless!
Perhaps I can take a break during battle.
Soldiers? No, we're animals for slaughter!
The expect only obedience, nothing more.
Do they think it is better to do battle on an empty stomach?
My weapons are rusty and brittle.
My pay is dry bread and a quick death.
I must give life and limb for the noble magistrate.
The provisions in the field are almost good enough for livestock.
What do you mean by bribing? I won't bribe anybody!
I thought collecting old metal was out?
Yes... exactly! The bowels are perfect! I’ll prepare the tincture right away! Please wait until it’s finished.

Dirk Schumacher
I told you so... but don't worry, we can wangle it!
More gold equals more courage. That is a fact the fine lords should consider well.
These soldiers and their chivalrous ways... A nice big bag full of gold is all I need.
I'll have to show the witch these battle scars.
Tilda seems to have left herself plenty of time to make the crystals. But what are 150 years in the life of an immortal?
How will I ever breed when all the fighting leaves no time for love? Sometimes it really is a burden.

Fetch me five drinking straws from the Sword Spiders.

Good! We have the carapaces - now all we need are the drinking straws. I like to use spider legs for straws. They are hollow and rest nicely on the lower lip. But you have to use Sword Spider legs - nothing else will do. Could you bring me some?
You are reliable. Please take this as a small token of appreciation.
Wonderful! I came all this way only to find the illusion of a talking machine?
Would have been too good to be true anyway ...
Thank goodness I don't have high blood pressure anymore.
You have not entered an email address for your account. Please enter one now.
I have to gain more experience before I can use it.
It's you? And I thought today couldn't get any worse.
All my courage leaves me when I look at you.
You? Someone will have to take the children to safety!
Wave number three. I'm getting used to it.

Report the events to the commander in Khorum!

Go back to Khorum now, and report everything to the commander of the troops. I'm sure that you will receive a King's ransom for your self-sacrificing assistance in the fight against the Du'Rach and for saving the camp!

Beltario is the leader of a small investigation team that is looking into the appearance of the Golem.
He has noticed some newly created Earth Elementals and is worried about the mutations T-Energy might cause. I've been asked to kill the creatures before they get too strong.
What I can steal today, you shall miss tomorrow!
I am drawn to open windows and doors as if by magic.
A toast to fresh air! Open windows are a blessing!
... and then almost as though the Gods were guiding me, my fingers found their way into the pouch and...
Retga? Ha, I knew it! He has been missing for a month now. He wrote the letter while he was drawing his last breath and he claims that he has been poisoned - by his own brother.

Hello, little sister! Your fighting style has gotten a bit rusty hasn't it? Sophia would have brought those few opponents down with one single strike of her sword. Well never mind...
A long time ago, a fierce war raged among the people of Ancaria. The Seraphim, who were in charge of keeping the peace, had to mourn many losses. To make up for those losses they found a way to bring their fallen sisters back to life. Due to that power, they were able to win the battle. Some of those resurrected warriors might still walk among us. People say there are some powerful undead in the swamps. That's were you should try your luck!
Increases attack value as well as basic damage for all close range weapons except daggers and mage staffs.
Dude! May I pass you finger bowls for the fight?
How can I ever have a family when it's my job to wade in the blood of my enemies? Sometimes that makes me sad.

We fought back the fog monster far enough to pass through to the desert. While we were passing what seems to be the center of the fog, we saw some loose parts of the machine. My new companion said that we could fix the leak in this part of the Great Machine with those pieces, which would probably stop the fog for good. Why should we do it though, to do the Marigold pickers a favor? I think not. It would only slow us down and we won't be in this area for much longer anyway. We're going to continue our journey to the desert.
Where do they all come from?
Thank you very much! The dead can finally rest in peace and I can sleep undisturbed.
Let the novices use him as target practice.
You entered the jungle - now die!
Combat art chance to hit: Player / Opponent
I don't have time for someone like you.
My time is better spent without you.
The Grand Inquisitor has chosen me as his envoy. He already has a task for me.
I need better protection against damage from poison.
The shaman has served his last bowl of rancid soup.  I wonder if that cultist will keep his word about those potions.
Well I have something for you that is quite important to me.
I'd like to ask you something if you've got time for this.
I'm not going yet because I still have something to tell you!
Please lend me your ear for another moment because I find that quite interesting!
I still have something to say about a thing that's on my mind!
I enjoy talking to you, and I would like to tell you something else.
I would like to talk about something that could be interesting for you too.
Would you be so kind as to discuss something else with me?
I'd be happy if you'd let me say something else!
There's another thing that's quite important to me.
Facility cleansed of hostile elements. Will now examine it while Woosh repairs himself.
Down with the enemies of the true faith!
No mercy for the enemies of Ker!
How much longer will it take until animals are finally extinct?
Keltar lives in the third house on the left. Knock three times, if you don't want his mother to answer the door.
The Hippocampus was very glad that someone came to chat with it. It was very nice, it's a shame that it's so lonely there.
So... the last will-o’-wisp is history. I can return to Fiandral now.
I see my time was wasted. I should just keep fighting.
Well my questions are still unanswered. But what did I expect?
You haven't been a big help but I didn't expect it of you!
Be on your way then. I have work to do.
Give my regards to our God! That’s all I have to say.
I have to go now. My time is precious.
I have to go and whip my blades into shape.
I bid you farewell as long as we're still able to have a peaceful conversation.
It was not what I expected but I'd better go nevertheless.
I was hoping for more awareness! But never mind...
I am back! I have returned to this world! Which power summoned me here?! I will find out... but first, I will have to defend myself!
We thieves are honorable people, we don't just randomly kill people. Everyone should have their principles and stick to them.
You know what you have to do.
Alas, if only someone could save us from this hardship and wretched misery.
It appears that you have seen better days, Human!
A mockery of a Warrior like you wants to kill me?
A dead Human doesn't compel my respect either.
Shadow Warrior, now I'll send you home!
Even more work for the local undertaker!
Do you believe in the Gods, sandman?
Come on, off to the Dryads!
A guard asked me to kill a traitor. Apparently the good man has little faith in his comrades, but treachery is the most vile thing there is!
I never could stand Priests and people like you!
Aren't you a member of the Ker fan club, bogyman?
Ooh, the Inquisition ... I'm so afraid ...
Hand over everything that you have under your robe ... Oh, well, and the robe, too, of course ...
The faithful might fear you, Inquisitor. But we don't!
Those dark figures have all been defeated, but most of the soldiers are dead as well. Only one of them appears to still be alive. I'm going to try to get some information from him.
Someone has to invent a cupboard that's always cold.  It should be made out of metal so that people can stick little notes on it with magnets.
My husband has more decency and honor in his little finger than you do in your entire body!
You are nothing but a notorious murderer!
If I were you, I would disappear as fast as I could!
Some waterlogged bodies returned from the dead at the old port. It's my job to kill ten of these undead, then the town guard will take care of the rest.
Hurry! I still have to dye the cloth and make the scarves.
What is it? How dare you? I'm an experienced adventurer! ARGH!
Oh ho! An evil hero with sinister goals!
You can act as evil as you want - I am not impressed!
You're evil? What a coincidence, I'm evil too. Let's see who's evilest!
I'm not interested in good or evil. I'm only interested in how you taste!
Do evil heroes taste different than good heroes? Can I have a sample?
I delivered the message! Mer-Kil and N'kioam will be grateful.
Saskia was actually impressed by my combative skills, and why shouldn't she be? The reward was good but I was more excited about the fact that I could finally leave that cursed arena.
Now they know what a Temple Guardian is capable of in this region.
Capital of the High Elven realm.
Tell me, fur coat, are you born with these long arms or do you use weights to make them longer?
Long arms? No, no weights. Arms for war and kill.
Well, I can't deny that you are strong, but you don't seem to have a lot of brains.
Troll have much brain. Troll make fire!
A brilliant achievement. But my point is: Your warfare is only based on strength. You don't have a strategy!
No! Troll skill! Swing big, hit head! Good skill.
Overwhelming and not difficult to remember. You'll conquer the world with it.
No world! World too big for Trolls.
Very good! I appreciate understanding people.
I have the wing, I just hope it doesn't fall apart. I should slowly make my way to the next oasis.
... when see! First one grave, then another opes wide, and women and men stepping forth are descried!
Go through the Elven wall and find out what happened to the expedition in the Human territory.
I have to protect the world from you, Dragon!
The easternmost settlement of the High Elven realm. There should be roads leading to the desert from here.
Take care of our field surgeon! He’s a terrible doctor, but he's the third man at our poker evenings!
The trees have been whispering into my ear telling me that you are not using an original version. I will curse you, if you don't buy an original version of Sacred 2!
Finally I can eat the fish I caught again.
You are a shame to our nation!
Good to see you again. How are you, my dear?
Thank you, honorable father, I'm fine. But I'm worried about you.
There's no reason for worry. I live in harmony with the ancestors.
I'm glad you feel that way, but isn't life without a wife difficult for you?
Yes, but I am so connected to all the souls, that it eases the burden.
I just hoped that you might feel a stronger connection to my soul than the others.
What are you trying to say, child?
Uhm, nothing. I was only... it's nothing. I have to go.

Yes I have a little red doll. It's very unusual and my competitor has been trying to buy it from me for years now, but he's not offering enough. I say, what's that sparkle in your eyes all about? And why... What??? ARGH!

A Lizardmen caravan was attacked? That's terrible! Yes I'll help you, after all the lives of Lizardmen are at stake here! I am otherwise engaged at the moment though, there is an epidemic spreading through the city. Someone was selling some muck soup and many ate it.

Take this Dragon fern with you, it is a very potent remedy as long as you can survive the treatment.
I have defeated the Carnach. Now I must return to Mer-Kil.
There are spiders in the wood? Oh no, do not tell me that!
Are you Dryads finally fed up with all those trees?
Put on some decent clothes, Dryad!
Nice to see you, m'lady! Do you have plans to go to the concert at the sunny grove, too?
I thought one had to prove a certain... ahem, background, to be invited.
A truly wonderful tree flautist is supposed to play a solo.
I must say that traditional Elven music barely appeals to me any longer.
I am a big admirer of our great classics.
I myself appreciate the Orcish-tribal influences, and I do prefer more experimental sounds.
To me, that is very atonal and it has nothing in common with music other than the name.
If this is your opinion you should keep it to yourself!
Please, don't take offence, my noble lady.

Oller! Nur der Absatz zählt, ihr Linguisten!


Da habt ihr noch nen Absatz!
It's not far to the village. Let's set off!
I need more experience before I can survive in this region.

I finally met the clanleader of the Grurag Clan. He says the clans have called a temporary truce to try and solve a problem. Something has blocked the river that flows through the region, backing it up into a lake. A water monster called Octagolamus has risen up out of this lake and it is attacking the members of all the clans. It has become a point of honor to see who can kill the monster, and whichever clan succeeds will become extremely influential in the Orcs’ society. The clanleader confided in me that he believes the monster is strong only in the water and on swampy ground. Where the ground is dry, it's weaker and slower. I must escort a shaman to the river. He will perform a magic ritual to run dry the well.
Lumen Priest Edoras has asked me to talk to a woman from the desert. She's been through a terrible ordeal and needs my help.
You should have had more training.
Ahhhh, a body! After all this time! Now it's victory or death.
I have met a young cultist who wants to climb the cult’s hierarchy as quickly as possible. He wants to demolish a grave site nearby and has asked me to help him deal with the guards.
In nature, it's the law of the jungle!

Speak with Militia Captain Gabelte!

Oh yes good old Timotan, he didn't need to thank me! Of course I was going to help him! I'm sure that by now you recognize that the situation in this area isn't very safe. Most of the citizens from surrounding villages and farms have already moved to quieter areas. Those who stayed here founded a small militia to at least be able to put up a slightly organized fight against the Thraconians and the undead. No one expects any help to come from Baron DeMordrey anymore either. I think you could help us out with a few of our problems if you have the time for it. Speak with militia captain Gabelte. You'll find him close by, at our militia's guard post.

If you intend to go near Dragons, you will need a protective amulet made of Dragon scales

Back from the angels, are you? Did you get inside their... heads? Probably not, they have such tight... lips. Well, nevermind. It’s the dragon territory you’re bound for, eh? Dangerous plan. No armor strong enough to withstand a dragon’s fire, you know. What you need is an amulet made of dragon heartscales. Hard to come by, but before I faced an old Dragon in his lair, I’d be sure to be wearing one of those.

I would rather be a coward than brave because people hurt you when you are brave.

- Forster

Glenn, a zombie from the village was really upset and told me an almost unbelievable story. He found the corpse of his wife Lydia today. On the way to the undertaker, he saw her alive and well going shopping. She acted as if nothing was wrong. However, her corpse is still lying on the bed. Something stinks. And I'm not talking about the zombies.
I should investigate this.

The zombies seem to trust me now. That's good. I will talk to Lomba, he's familiar with the area. I hope I can remember all the zombie names. It would be embarrassing to address a zombie with the wrong name.
The family is safe now. My work here is done.

Kill the "Poison Lord"!

Welcome adventurer!
Watch out if you are traveling east. The "Poison Lord" rules there. He is the king of his element and he is extremely dangerous. I would be so relieved if someone took care of that menace.
OK, fine. I killed a bunch of the big scary monsters. Maybe if I talk to the Orc again he’ll admit me into their club.

A parcel for me? From my mother? How nice! I hope it doesn't just contain socks and gloves this time. I will open it later. Here, take this as a small compensation.
Well, since you are already here... I might have a task for you.
Ephraim was pleased with the outcome of my little spider hunt. At least it was a partial victory. Let's see, maybe I can help him some more.

In those parts of the world where learning and science has prevailed, miracles have ceased; but in those parts of it as are barbarous and ignorant, miracles are still in vogue.
- Ethan Allen
Dryad Priestess Tily Fihl needs five tooth leaves for a ritual in honor of the Goddess Forens. I've been asked to collect them.
No mercy for Dryads, I learned that in my earlier days!

Kill Blackhammer!

If what you say is true then there can be only one explanation, Blackhammer! He has always tried to sabotage our work, but he has never been this successful! We must deal with him once and for all! Go now! Crush him!
The lizards are dead, now the shaman can go on his way in peace.
You know what curiosity did to the cat!?

It is a miracle that curiosity survives formal education.
- Albert Einstein
Where did you learn your fighting skills?
Well done! When nature calls, you have to go!
Just keep going. The shade of our trees will protect you.
I must open the gates using the key!
Who do you think you are? Die!
I need better protection against physical damage.

I delivered the order. He also mentioned that I should speak with the mage who is with him. Apparently she has an assignment that she will only give to a competent hero. It seem that for her, soldiers don't fall into that category.
I have sold the medallion. I am glad that the Dryad didn't ask about the agent.

What? Still you dare to face me? Well sure ... Viola. Who else? It's exactly what I would have expected from her. Well never mind, I am the legal heir to the business house. It's nice that you agree with that.
If you insist. But I hope you'll understand one day.
Then I can't help you after all. Maybe I'll see you again.
Your attitude is disheartening. I'll go now.
There's nothing I can do for you. I hope you'll find true faith again.
I'm sorry that you're not willing to listen. Goodbye to you, too.
I wish I could help you, but that doesn't seem possible.
At least you were honest with me. That's something.
Next time, please don't be that outspoken.
Well, I'll be off myself then. The Gods await me.
Farewell, my child. Call for me, if you need me.
I don't believe in the legends of the old Gods. Where are they now in our time of need?
If all the myths about the Gods are true, why aren't they protecting us now?
Don't talk to me about Everfred and his mighty hammer! Where is he now that we're under siege?
I trust the old legends about the Gods less and less. Goodfred the God of Harvest! Who would want to be called that?
No I don't want to hear the old myths and legends. Is there really a Bannfred Ambrosia?
It's just the same old stories. Where are the war Gods in these treacherous times?
Isn't it funny that Chamomilia Teania, the Goddess of healing, is never around when you need her?
Stop bothering me with these old legends. They're legendary rubbish, if you ask me.
You're wrong if you think these old stories about the Gods will strengthen our faith.
You really think people buy the legends about the God Hammerfall, who is supposedly fighting on our side?
I don't have anything to say to you. Leave me alone!
We've found an old and shattered sarcophagus.

You say you have goldworms? Let me see them. Last time Quirash tried to sell me some earthworms that had been painted gold and...
OH! They really are goldworms, and thick ones too! I'd like to buy them. I don't care about the price. Here, take this... and this too. Take the whole bag!
Oh by the way, I noticed some peculiar piles of skulls on the coast. You might want to take a look at them.
Is fighting all about winning, or more about recognition of the fighter's skill?
What do you do in days of peace?
You have to react fast when fighting or else you are lost, am I right?
Is it correct that all soldiers are stupid and that they are only born to fight?
I wonder how one can cope with defeats in war?
I have no time for that at the moment
Come and prove to me in battle, man against man, how strong you are!
Show those guys what we're made of!
You power is no match for mine.
The mage summons a small dragon familiar which increases his stats

Falart Ungoll
Whole regiments used to serve him once.
I have razed a nearby farm to the ground. That should be enough to prove my worth.
A High Elf spy found out that the Inquisition is planning to construct a training camp in the area. I'm supposed to eliminate some guards who have set up their camp in nearby ruins.
At best, I could sell this thing.
There you are horse courier! No witnesses so far? Good then I’ll make sure it stays that way, and you’ll receive your reward in the form of my steel.
I have reached my destination, what is going to happen now?

Guardian of Souls
Success is spelled D-O-I-T!
How fortunate that we meet! I have much to tell you...
Praise the Forest Spirits! I am glad to meet you!
By the Forest Mother's bosom! What good fortune to meet you here!
By all the wonders of the forest! This must be more than a chance encounter!
It warms my heart to see you again!
Ah, how wonderful! And how are you and yours?
You cannot imagine how glad I am the Great Goddess has brought us together again!
If this is just a chance meeting, then it is certainly the most wonderful accident!
Ah, wonderful! I hadn't expected to meet you here!
It's wonderful to see you! This is a meeting as beautiful as the finest of woods!

What, just taking a break? Or can't be bothered any more? Come back or I'll get you in trouble by downloading a bunch of movies!  I have interest in your "Robocop", "Terminator" and "Transformers" ...
This item has no use for me.
Sounds wonderful, but I'm on my hunting diet, so I can only eat while walking.
Not quite my taste. When I shed my skin I prefer to eat roots and herbs.
That sounds absolutely delicious. Thanks for inviting me.
Yes, I agree. This sounds like a meal fit for the ancestors and their spirits.
Homestyle cooking is something very special. I'm just glad we never seem to run out of prey.
That's true. Let's thank the ancestors for everything they've provided for us.
Our cuisine tends to be simple and bloody, but I wouldn't want to change that.
Right now, I'm only eating berries. A spirit told me this would make me wiser and more courageous.
Our tastes are very similar. My mouth is watering already.
The ancestors were right: Food keeps body and claws together.
I send you to the Gods, ghost!

Murder? You are talking murder? That is a serious accusation. Well, now that you come to mention it... I saw someone run towards the tavern not so long ago. He seemed very agitated and obviously tried to avoid me. Still, as you can see we have by far not enough guardsmen around here. I cannot leave my post. You can take care of it - I have faith in you!
There is a present for me under the Christmas tree.
Your size does not help you, as I am the Gods' chosen one!

I just don't believe it! This is the first time ever! My handle and my bucket! That's something, I guess! I already pictured myself carrying all the rubbish in my hands!
Look around you! Isn't it horrible? How can people live in such as MESS?!? I won't lift a finger, I assure you! Not ONE finger! Let them clean up their own mess!
Alright we've taken everything of value. I think we can leave.
You've got a green thumb, huh? It'll be red in a second!
I found five nests and destroyed the eggs. Now I can go back to Gartor and collect my reward.

My new family patriarch gave me an important mission. They recovered a list of names of the undead, who are wandering around the nearby ruins. With the scroll, they can build a memorial shrine, which should lay the undead to rest. I need to take the scroll to Thazziz, the family leader in the next settlement.
Here lie gogo's pants. Found at last... and only a little whiffy!
Here lies Shoi... skirt up to his neck again.
DaGirl - She tripped, fell and was impaled on her own stiletto heels.

Get my deceased husband's notes from the ruins of our villa!

You've seen the old watch tower where militia captain Gabelte has taken up position? He's guarding an old path that leads into a remote valley. We call it the Crag Rock Valley. We want to retreat there and start a new settlement, safe from the Thraconians and the ghosts. Unfortunately the Thraconians have already discovered the entrance to the valley, so we can't settle there until they're removed and it's safe. I'm afraid I don't know what we can do to get the Thraconians out of the valley. My dearly departed husband told me that he had already considered the problem, and had written his ideas for a solution down on paper. When our villa was under attack I had to flee in a hurry, so I didn't have time to get his notes. I barely managed to escape death as it was. Would you go to look for my husband's notes in the ruins of our villa? Once you've found them take them to militia captain Gabelte.
One shot - one miss. Such is life...
One shot in honor, for the stag no dishonor!
The shepherds tell of a wolf that has been terrorizing the area.
That seems to be the last of them. Now I have to take the hearts to the coach.
Any Hero fighting alongside three other heroes in multiplayer mode.
Well, I have to run. The hunt doesn't wait.
I hate to leave you, but it's really urgent.
I have to go look after my family.
Give my regards to the ancestors who cross your path.
I don't want to go, but there's still much to do.
I wish you and your family prosperous times.
See you soon. It was a pleasure talking to you.
May your scales always shine. I have to go.
It's a shame that I have to leave now, but I'll see you again soon.

Go to the tavern in the harbor to find out more about the criminals!

Well, what did you just say? Fangil is dead? How tragic. He was a good customer of mine who always paid on time. I deciphered many texts for him. He was too lazy to do that work himself. And now he is dead. But I already suspected something like that. Those people last week didn't seem to like him very much. They came as a group and threatened to kill me if I don't hand over the data crystal I was deciphering for Fangil. I didn't have a choice.

I really don't remember what the message was about. My memory is not as good as it once was, you know. If you translate or decipher thousands of words each day, one text is much like another. I only remember that it was something about a dragon mage about to retire.

That doesn't help you much, huh? Well ... maybe you should go and find these criminals who robbed me. They spoke with a strange dialect. I am pretty sure they weren't from Thylysium. There is a tavern in the harbor where a lot of low lives hang out. A true haven for criminals. That's the place to go if you want information about those robbers.
This looks like one of these generators. Well then, I should give it a good kick.
How is this possible? One of us, a murderer? She is freely making these decisions, and putting herself above the lives of other beings? I will destroy this perversion!
If "25 hours game time" is written on the box that doesn't include being afk
The Gods have mercy on you!

I'm so happy that you helped my husband.

You helped my husband. We owe you something for that. I have an idea...
Great. 2,450,000 carat. That'll be some big rocks.
Only weak creatures around here... boooooring.
That was by far the most boring speech I've ever heard.
There is no need to use the power of the Seraphim against the opponents around here!
The outlaws won't break any more laws. I should look around the camp some more though, before I return to the officer and report my success to him.
Deprivation - Even further reduces movement speed of affected opponents.
Ire - Increases the damage inflicted upon all affected opponents.
Dolor - Adds a chance to draw life from the target opponent.
Petrify - Adds a chance to stun opponents briefly.

I must be a higher level to use this item.
Distract - Reduces opponents' attack speed within the area of effect.
Blind - Reduces opponents' defense values within the area of effect.

Cleanse - Increases fire damage against T-mutations.
Illuminate - Increases the area of effect.

Dundiel blames Blackhammer - a friend of the Humans. Blackhammer is a savior to those imprisoned to be fed to the Dragons, and has long been in a thorn in the cult's side. Now he has been marked for death and I am the one who is to kill him!
I'm never wearing Golce and Dabana again...
You have found an item that can be forged into weapons.You should visit a blacksmith.

Collect ten portions of rankweed!

I'm just about ready to explode! I’m absolutely furious! I’m so angry I could... I could... My fiancé Marga and I planned to marry. My parents have even paid for everything already! So what does the stupid wench go and do? She leaves me a few days before our wedding and runs off to marry somebody else! I’ll make sure she won’t forget her wedding day in a hurry, and you can help!
I know an old witch - an expert in weather magic. She can summon a torrential downpour with one quick ritual! She'll need some rankweed for the ritual though, the more the better. Could you gather ten portions of rankweed and take them to the witch? She doesn't live far from here. Meanwhile, I will add some laxatives to the wedding cake.
Push off, ruffian, or I'll call the guards!
Nice, such a necklace made of troll's teeth.
These two are happy and ready to begin a new life. I wonder if the father's threats mean anything. I'll find out soon enough.
The first part of the plan has succeeded. The farmers' sons are certainly happy. But will that be enough?
How do you like the taste of that?
Now it's time to bash your skull!
Doesn't it just make your bones rattle?
What have you brought me? A Troll head? Aha! That's the Nargutz ball Beni was talking about. It will take a while for me to prepare the ball, then I'll tell you all about our little plan.
You smell a little like brimstone...
I want to run away, but I can't...
The wine merchant promised me two barrels of her finest wine if I get rid of the vermin in her winery.
There is nothing like a well-stocked pantry.
My task is to protect the living!
You have a debt to pay!

Let's see ... hmm:
”Knight c4”

I should have known! Not bad ... not bad at all ...
The chef - was satisfied and will immediately get to work preparing the food. I think this would be the perfect opportunity to leave ... quickly.
What a cute little thing. It's surprising how good helping someone makes you feel.
So you want to bring us peace?
No one invited you, village deputy!
Our ideas on morality don't seem to be the same...
Is this the best you can do?

Get the second fragment from Tharum!

Well then, let's see this scroll! I can tell by the looks on your faces that you guys don't have the slightest clue about such things. You guys are so lucky to have me!
Interesting, it's about Brurag El Leigh.
The message is written in code, but it hints at a second fragment. I should be able to decipher the text with its help.
I recommend that you go to Tharum and look for Buramad the antiques dealer. If anyone knows anything about one of the missing parts, then it's him.
Playing the bad Elf is really more exhausting than I thought. If this continues I might need therapy...
Take the ointment to him, we don’t need you here. Ointment won’t help these ‘patients’ once we’re finished with them.

Fellir the Orc Priest is in a pickle. He needs a nice, fat rat that he can sacrifice to the God of the Rats for the Festival of Purity. Unfortunately all his best rats were killed off by a rat plague. If he can’t find a rat that will appease the God of the Rats, then the Law of Grizmok demands that Fellir sacrifice himself. Fellir has asked me to secretly acquire a rat from the Priests of the neighboring tribes.
These Orcs are just amazing.
I know your kind all too well! You can't surprise me.
Good, I'll slay a few more folks along the way.
The gnome has done his part. The gnome SURRENDERS!
Back to the shadow world, skeleton!
Seven poor, tired men are awaiting their fate in the arena. I'm supposed to try and not kill any of them during a fight.
Increases overall hitpoints and reduces their regeneration time.
Carry on, thank you, nothing to see here...
I can't gain anything from these opponents...
Performs a series of hits that force the target into a defensive stance. The target may be changed as long as the new target is within range.
I planted 10 trees. I don't think I did it right though, because nothing happened.
Thank you for your efforts! I hope you didn't have too much trouble tapping into the line. In just a moment I'll brew a potion that you can try out.
My equipment doesn't protect me enough from normal weapons.
How are you today? Can I help you sir?
Yes you can, you deadbeat. I have built an engine of war in my barn.
Oh, I don't know anything about such matters. I am a peace-loving man, and I despise weapons.
No matter, you will help me despite of that fact. My machine is a little larger than originally anticipated, and now I can't get it out of the shed.
What do you want me to do for you!?
We need to take off the roof and tear down the walls.
All this effort because of a stupid engine of war?
Bite your tongue and follow me, or you will feel my blade, you lout!
This young boy has lost his bag of happysand. Perhaps it would comfort him if I patted his head.
Are you really famous? I'll tell everyone that I met you!
I'll paint a picture of you. Maybe someday it will be valuable...
Are you a real warrior? They say so...
Attack! Again! This is definitely not a coincidence anymore.
I can't cause enough normal damage with my weapon.
I knew this wouldn't work out, but nobody ever listens to me...
I hate these animals! ALL OF THEM!
Scarves, flags, shirts - everything a fan could wish for!
I'm going to have to refuse.
This must be the collector. Strange machine. It looks like the controls are damaged. The thing tries to drive up the rock face. Maybe it can be turned off somehow.
Oh, my daughter! How did things go for you?
I visited my sister in the East and just returned a few days ago.
Is it really the way they describe it? Is there danger lurking behind every bush?
I had to go on this trip because my sister was expecting a child.
Many of our missionaries have been massacred there.
I love those barren lands, the raw air there whets my appetite.
It is also said that there are Orc arrows flying through the air, that cannot be healthy.
The perils of those lands are no more cruel than the high taxes the nobles demand of us here.
May the Gods bless all your ways.
This energy - it attempts to change me.
Any Hero has executed a combination for the first time.
Lord Alcander sent you? Thank you! He is truly a kind and compassionate man.
Nature is not as defenseless as you think, for I am one of nature's weapons!
My men gone, just like that!
I actually managed to find the teddy. It was in the sewers just as she said. Now it is very dirty and not a pretty sight, but I am sure the little girl won't mind. I will take it back to her now.
No perfume can hide the stench of your corruption!
Like my grandpa always says, you have to improvise.
What should I cut off first, you brainless green skinned thing!

Seamster Toriak has run out of cloth. He wants to make fan scarves for the upcoming Nargutz game, but he needs more cloth. He's asked me to search the beach for rolls of cloth that have been washed ashore. He said a ship wrecked there recently and its cargo might still be around.

Talk to Ompha.

That's the seventh caravan that's been ambushed and destroyed by these scarabs. I'll be ruined if this continues. Maybe I should start producing sandglasses instead. If we only knew where these beasts come from - a cave or something? Talk to old Ompha. He used to be a scout and knows this area like the back of his hand.
Ker, I'm coming to meet you!

Bring me 15 Essences from Will-o'-wisps!

Those Blood Dryads have lain siege to our village! We have to increase our defense and I already know how we are going to do this! I'll just conjure up an Air Elemental. Air Elementals are easy to teach, low maintenance and strong. They are perfectly suited for defense purposes. I do need a few more Will-o'-wisp essences to do this though. Would you help me and get 15 essences?
If our leaders didn't have such antiquated ideas, we'd all live in prosperity.
What do you mean by that? Nature with all its gifts from the Goddess is our greatest treasure.
That's what they keep telling us. But our greatest treasure grows everywhere around us by the ton. Just take a look!
The trees? How would they grant us prosperity?
We could clear vast expanses of the forest and sell the wood to the city Elves. They pay top prices.
Don't talk like that! The Goddess might hear you!
Kybele? I don't think she'd mind a good business deal.
I don't want to hear about it. Have a nice day!

Gravestone
I have tried to know absolutely nothing about a great many things, and I have succeeded fairly well.
I'm afraid, you are going to bring shame to your ancestors.
I don't want to stop you. I can see that you are in a hurry.

Our tax levy has been stolen! You're our last hope, please get it back!

Some robbers have stolen the entire annual tax levy of the village! It's just a small sack, but it holds gems worth a small fortune. If we can't pay our taxes, the village is doomed. Doomed!
We know the gang’s hideout is near the Endless Caves, but our fighting men are away at the war and we have no one left. Please, recover the jewels from the robbers and take them to Senator Gracchus in Thylysium. You're our last hope!
What... what's wrong with me? Where am I? I don't feel too good. I think I fainted.
I guess you Orcs don't put an emphasis on oral hygiene.
One of the nameless Priests has ordered me to bring him the hands of the Lizard Warriors at the initiation ritual. I have to kill them while they are still drunk.
<pain, hard, like hitting one's finger with a hammer> au!
Oh, I am very familiar with doing things the hard way.
What? You? You found my machine? Now you know how we enslaved the women!

Gravestone
If the High Elven capital is still called Crumbletown one of the ancient laws of software development still holds true: If it's in, it stays in.
We will help you, lead on!
I think respect is much more important than love, yes I do! So what reason do we have for discontent?
So I do have a mother. And she likes me! Interesting. And the data indicated that I had been created and was all by myself. Demiurge, Seraphim.... Weaklings, all of them!
I have got the wine but I don't think it will do Melantion much good. He already thinks he is throwing a party when he is all by himself.
I shall go to the Priest and have my new sword blessed,
Let them come - I am ready and full of courage to fight.
Many is the suit of armor that is pretty, but impractical.
Regular combat training will give you a nice figure.
Only the brave can summon fame and glory.
Oh, this army fare. My armor is pinching me.
Must consecrated armor be so ugly?
I find strength and courage in prayer.
We are well equipped, if the aristocracy rebels.
That doesn't sound interesting for someone like me.
Of course you can leave the boy here, after all he hasn't committed any crime. We'll watch out for him.
The mouse is on, but no one's home, right?
One more click and I'm going on strike!
Another village in need of a Temple Guardian's help.
Magic on the go is not really my thing!
I am studying Growth Magic for vegetables at the moment.
I read something about love potions recently.. Now, where was that?
I have one or two more magical mixtures in the cupboard.
A good potion takes time to brew.
Speed potions and spells are very popular hereabouts.
Whatever your need, there's always a herb or mixture to match it.
This mountain is the perfect height for my meditation exercises.
Have you really invited those terrible Goblins to dinner?
Yes, they were worthy brothers in arms, and I owe them.
I don't care about that. I just don't want the creatures in my kitchen.
You're unfair. Their heart is in the right place.
Really? I didn't know they even had hearts!
Why are you so mean? They haven't done anything to you.
These squeaking creatures just give me the creeps.
They are my friends. Show some restraint, woman.
Whoever uses the services of a Demon should also be able to feed it properly...
Earth, water, fire - unite in my pot as I desire!
Many a potion had another effect than was intended...
Oh what a glorious day for nature rituals.
True wisdom belongs only to we who are versed in the art of sorcery.
A conjuration can only work if there is a great fire from within.
Mandragora Officinarum. An herb grown for love.
I have yet to find an herbal remedy for stupidity.
Exotic herbs from foreign lands are difficult to acquire.
Although you claim you are doing good, we do have to stop you!
You are not above the law!
Are you the avenger of the disinherited?
Noble motives do not justify breaking the law!
An opponent within medium range is knocked back. Each additional opponent that the first opponent careens into will sustain damage. Does not affect ghostly entities.
I sold the amulet to a witch. At least I got some gold this way.
The mage's troops will be aided by catapults. I was ordered to destroy the catapults to even the scores.
I think you seriously need a breath mint, buddy.
That skin probably doesn't go over very well with the ladies!
I can see where the expression “worm food” came from!
Hey, you look like you've been dead for three days!
A Lizardman is next on the game plan.
I have located the scout. He told me where the deserters are hiding.
I delivered the shipment. The merchant was pleased.
So Ignaz is behind all this! But...who IS Ignaz? I should ask Kales.

Bring me the head of a Warg Alpha Male!

I am Jugat, my clan's Master Hunter. Only the best warriors are qualified to hunt. In battle the enemy comes to you. In hunting, you must go to the enemy.
Warg is the most difficult creature to hunt! They are strong and skillful, you must be a true hunter in order to hunt warg.
The others say that you are a good warrior. If you're as good as they say you are then prove it. Bring me the head of a warg alpha male. Kill a lot of warg, then the alpha male will show up to defend his pack.
Bring me the head!
I really hope you don't support these Priests!
Don't trust any of these servants of the Temple!
Let the women take over the power! Then you won't need your weapons anymore!
If these Priests prevail, Ancaria is done for!
I don't think that you are really interested in the women's movement.
Time for changing of the guard!
You're not even cut out to be an anti-hero!
Another one nobody will shed a tear for.
Ancaria will thank me for killing you!
I can hardly wait to see you down in the dust!
What now? Is that all the Grand Inquisitor is able to muster up?
I met a mad scientist who kills Orcs and transforms them into undead slaves. He's already caught one Orc, I can't let this happen.

Get me Swampbelly Toads.

This isn't working. My guests will be arriving shortly, and I wanted to prepare Swampbelly Toad meat in a mealworm marinade for them. The problem is that last night my son and his friends ransacked the larder and ate all the Swampbelly Toad meat. So what now? I can hardly offer my guests berries and nuts.
Maybe you could help and get me some Swampbelly Toads. You won't regret it.
Well, that's what I call rich pickings!
Yes, we do know how to murder!
That'll make us a tidy little sum!
Priests are boring. Bad orators and even worse fighters.
Thus ends my apprenticeship. It has been a long time. Now I should make my way to the capital. Maybe I will find some opportunities to use my abilities during my journey.
I'm ashamed of myself. I'm a warrior dammit!
If you wait any longer, he'll be gone!
Your trees would make good ships, Dryad.
If you hide in a tree, I'll just burn it down.
Are you up for a fair fight, pseudo-Elf?
Whoops, I just cut down your favorite tree.
Ground meat can be used to disguise many different types of leftovers.
I still have to count the peas today,
My dishes are wonderfully prepared... Do these barbarians really appreciate that?
Almost all mushrooms can be eaten. Many of them more than once.
This sauce has no added flavouring.
Kerry is okay, thanks be the Gods, but her family seems to have a few problems. I'm going to go take care of them.
Ah, another one of these Elves who think they are something special!
Something is wrong here. It doesn't look as if this machine will ever be completed.
Old Leifhard believes that a brigand called Two-Eye might be behind the burglaries. Apparently he used to have a camp nearby, I hope it still exists.
Damn it! Mishirla is dead! I'm afraid I won't get anywhere without the archaeologist.
An old desert dweller has asked me to count the beetle populations at three different locations. He claims that the population levels indicate the weather trend for the coming season.
You'll have to ask somebody else.
I hate cities. I HATE them!

The Gods too are fond of a joke.

- Aristotle
Did you hear the gossip about freeing the slaves?
People wonder which side you are on!
I really hope you have the correct opinion regarding the freedom of the slaves.
Did you hear? They plan to forbid the children to play with weapons.
At least you do something. Other people only show off.

Take these furs to Robert the Merchant!


A hunter's life does not solely consist of deerstalking and hunting! Another significant part is selling the catch. These furs must be delivered to Robert the Merchant quickly. He is already expecting them. However, our carts are a prime target for robbers and thieves. Escort Rangald on his way and make sure that the furs reach Robert safely.
Some seamen took over their captain’s ship. They’ve entrenched themselves in the port, and they won’t let the captain on board. I’ll give them a beating!
And what are you pretending to be? A monster?
Not even the Gods can help you now!
I've arrived! Let's see what she wants from me now.
The doctor has confirmed my suspicions. There was poison in that bag!
Any Hero has visited all 42 towns.
A zombie wants me to kill some ghosts and observe their behavior. When I've found out enough, he wants me to return and report to him.
A chicken like this will be missed.
The Gods will recognize the heroes in the end.
You are the leader of this gang of little rascals?
No no no, my soup won't agree with you!

Lord Gemma instructed one of his hunters to slay three deer and bring him the pelts, at the same time the hunter's betrothed is visiting. The good man asked me to take care of the matter for him, so that he can devote all his time to his sweetheart.
Well then, tally ho!
I only want to live in peace with my husband.
Holy man, I am heart-broken. The woman of my choice refuses my courtship.
I'm sorry to hear that, but how do you think I can help you, my son?
Maybe one of your potions could change her mind.
How dare you! The gifts of the Gods must not be wasted on notions of romance!
I just can't stop thinking about her shiny scales and her magnificent tail.
That's enough. You'll have to solve this problem yourself.
That's a shame. I'll just have to think of something else to try then.
How does that saying go? What goes in, must come out!
Dried cow patties are a good source of heat.
I choose the shortest path for my daily route.
At the end of May I shear the sheep. It's a lot of work.
You don't look healthy, and that's a fact.
I don't know how to use that.

Gah, did I say hare paws? Silly me. My eyes are getting really bad now. I should go and see someone who can fix that. This doesn't say HARE paws, it says HAIRY paws. Presumably hairy paws means those of Kobolds. Yes, yes, I'm sure. Bring me hairy Kobold paws.
I found the main registry, but I'm not on the list! Maybe I should have a look at the list of criminals.
Increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Mystic Stormite. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.

Juicy Carrots
Only 75 gold per pound
Buy yours now!
I pray to Kybele for the preservation of our trees.
Perhaps I should put some stones in a circle and make a cult site.
I dream of having my own seminary.
I hope for the strength and mercy of the Gods.
A ritual for our trees would be advisable.
The Gods created nature and made it beautiful and mysterious.
Serving the Gods in the outdoors is a wonderful thing.
The gold edging makes this song book very precious.
Troll lose brother Troll, Goblin see Troll? Look long, all light time.
A Troll? No, I would have noticed him. Sorry, I can't help you.
Goblin say true? Goblins lie! All say Goblins lie, all time.
Ah, that's a stupid prejudice! Actually we are very nice people but we have a terrible reputation.
Say when see brother, yes? Troll fear for brother Troll.
Holy scrap! Is he a kind of pet? Nobody will steal such a huge beast!
No, he fight much, is weak.
Don't worry. Don't you know the saying: Where one Troll is trampling the next one can't be far?
Agent Aurora is dead, how annoying! I guess I won't be able to find the amulet.
Well his life has been saved. That should be reason enough for the little Kobold to tell me his secret.

The network screen shows all players who are currently on the same server as you. When you create a server you can determine the maximum number of players for your game with the slide bar in the upper screen. Your friends can join your game any time and you can continue to play.

If you right click on another player in the screen you can interact with that player and invite him or her to your party for example. If you are playing a campaign game you cannot invite other players as you will automatically be placed into a party. The members of your party will be displayed in a small circle on the upper left screen.

Players with different alignments will not be able to be in the same party even if the server does not permit PvP.
You will bleed for my gold, you damned swindlers.
What a wonderful world this could be - without goblins!

He decided to tell me who hired him. I'll let him live and move on.
His client is a dragon mage named Varmin. He must be the dragon mage I have to ... pay a visit. He wanted to save his miserable skin and fled to Artamark. Rumor has it, he can be found in or near Wargfels.
After the Priests passed through here, apparently some of the dead in a clearing rose up. A soldier asked me to put an end to this matter with him.
%1 has %2. You only can forge items until %3.
I know a trick too: The chopped up magician!
We've reached the place. Now the pack animals need to be loaded.
Thank you again for all you have done. Farewell.
I've been on the needle for years now.
I only use the finest yarns and threads.
I invented these warm foot-sleeves myself!
It takes a good three cubits of cloth to make a robe.
We arrived in Hissil'Ta unharmed. The alchemist is safe now, and he can complete his research.
Up to four combat arts can be combined. Enhances the effectiveness of all active effects.
The last Human settlement before Nor Plat.
I enjoy beating up evil heroes!
Your kind has no business being here!
Not all evil things are scary!
Your books are not going to help you at this point.
You should only use that once you have gained enough experience.

I met an old acquaintance of mine in front of the fortress! The zombie archaeologist Mishirla decided that he hadn't had enough adventures, yet, and came here to tell me that it might be possible to use a secret entrance to get inside the fortress.
The administrator wasn’t very cooperative. I had to slay him. He was indeed carrying quite a lot of gold, with an emphasis on the “was.”

You won't get my scroll! Just the opposite, I claim the other two pieces that you have for myself!
Hand them over or I'll slit your throats!

We must obtain further blueprints. Without them we will be unable to complete the memory. The signal I am receiving appears to originate in Trolloven. I am not able to read it properly but it is definitely the signal of a Temple Guardian.
Your death is near! Ah, sod that. You are a mist, you can't understand me anyway.
Oh really? Thank you very much for your permission!
I did? You are too kind.
The boy is making progress! That's wonderful.
We have deciphered the scroll but the meaning is still somewhat cryptic. Now we are heading to the burial chamber of the King who died a long time ago.
I neutralized the spell of protection! The path into the crypt is clear. Maybe I should take a peek.

The wares on offer at a merchant change several times a day. As long as the merchant still holds the same wares you will be able to buy back items that you sold to him.

You can sell items that you don't need from your inventory to a merchant, or you can purchase items there.

Wares sold to a merchant will fetch better money than wares that you sell via the "below value" icon in the inventory screen.

You have two choices to purchase or sell wares: use the typical click-and-drop method or use CTRL + LMB.

Be careful though:
If you use this method, you will not be prompted for confirmation when you sell / purchase wares!
I'm going to bend your horns straight!
The traveling salesman's wife is inconsolable about losing her husband. Who can blame her?
Is being a hero your profession?
I heard, that you always fight to the bitter end. Is that true?
You look like you're a soldier to the core.
Many here admire your courage and fighting ability.
Evidently, looks are deceiving and you are in good shape. Maybe the Elves in the settlement will have something for a rotting zombie like you to do.
This city is even uglier than the last. And that's saying something!
A young nobleman is about to lay in the forest, all silent and mute.

Destroy the Dream Vampire!

Take a look around you! Everyone here is completely exhausted, over-tired, sick and half dead. Nuizzzir is already dead! This isn't normal, but I found out who or what is behind it all.
We are dealing with a creature that is just as horrible as it is rare, a creature that shouldn't exist and yet it has infested our village. It's a Dream Vampire!
This Dream Vampire robs people of their vital energy while they're sleeping. At first the victims are merely tired, as if they didn't get a good night's sleep. They gradually become weaker and weaker until they finally die.
Naturally the village residents can't know any of this, there would be too much panic. You are my only hope! You must destroy the Dream Vampire. Unfortunately the Dream Vampire never enters our world. He stays where he feels most at home, in the land of dreams. That is the only place where you can defeat him. Will you take on this task? I beg of you!
I'll buy all the goldworms you can find.
Tonight's speciality: Lizard on a stick!
I need better protection against damage caused by poisons.
We haven't finished our business yet!
I do not have the necessary experience for this item yet.
I don't even know who to trust anymore! You or the promises of the clerics.
A Priest was visiting and he promised me freedom if I follow his teachings. Could this be true?
I really do respect your rule, but I often wish to live my life and believe in something!
What do you think, can I really trust the promises of the clerics? They promised me forgiveness!
A pious life, that seems to be the way to eternal freedom for many people!
The clerics are promising us more rights and a better standing when we fight for their cause!
A Priest promised to pay my taxes in the future if I'd be willing for fight for him!
Some clerics were visiting me yesterday, and they gave me glass beads. They thought they could win my trust with trinkets.
I wonder if it's true that faith is the way to a better life? Lots of people are talking about this lately, what do you think?
The Gods seem to be angry with us because we're losing our religion. A pious man told me that!
All the hostages should be safe now.
Escape seems to be the best option here.
The air is just marvelous, isn’t it?
By all rusty boletus, you are getting on my nerves!
Soldier, if you ruin my hairstyle...
You said it. Punctuality is the politeness of kings, or something.
Stop complaining, I could have done this more painfully!
You can find her somewhere on the cemetry. Please, release her soul.
Law and order will catch up with you.
I have enough problems of my own.
If you have something to celebrate then you should - that's my motto!
Why is it that I can't trust any politician? And why do I think that your nose is actually getting longer at the moment?
The senate’s known for its fairy tales, so I prefer to not believe a word you say!
Leave me alone with these political issues! I've got other problems at the moment.
Who are you telling this? You are politicians and that means that you are professional liars!
That almost sounds too good to be true, and I assume that's why I don't trust you!
Oh, I don't believe in your fairy tales anymore! You've disappointed me too often!
Excuse me if I don't believe a word you say! Action speaks louder than words.
I've already heard these words, that's for sure. Isn't there a new song you can sing?
No offense but I don't believe a single word you say.
How often has someone promised these things? No this time I won't fall for your line.
If you think that I'll be considerate because you are a Dryad... you are wrong.

Bring the stolen horses back to me!

My horses! They stole them! All of them! Horse thieves robbed my caravan and stole them! One of my employees survived and overheard those villains talking! They can be found near the beach. Unfortunately we have no soldiers available to attend to this matter. It's the holiday season you know! Would you take on this task? I promise you 10% of the selling price from my middleman at the port as a reward!
Unusable for me. Maybe I can barter it.

That's life I guess, unfortunately I have to tell you that things aren't going to work out with the artifact. To tell the truth - I lied. There is no artifact! I just wanted some fool to do all the dirty work and knock off my business partner for me.
Your face is an interesting shade of red, my friend. Now please, keep calm. Don't forget that we're in a public place here, and there are sooo many eyes watching us.
In the ruins! Not far from here!
Around here lives very powerful creatures, whom I shouldn't challenge yet.
Even the animals here are aggressive!
There's the camp. That's a lot of Desert Folk in one spot... this should be a fun fight.
My scales roll up when I see those mutants.
I should be aware of cold damage in this region.
It was an honor to have made your acquaintance.

Achmed thinks they may have gone to the grave of the Dragon hunter Caling to get a Dragon’s claw as a wedding present for Jocelyn. In these parts it’s a tradition to give a Dragon’s claw to the bride, although there aren’t any Dragons left anymore!
Some of the townsfolk have lost their faith in the Goddess Kybele. Those lost sheep must be led back to the herd.
Delia has always been on my side, but how could I be so completely wrong about this idiot? Well the learning never stops.
I'm afraid I'm not yet able to use this piece of equipment.

Go out and slay... something.

I'm the chef of this camp and have no idea what to cook today. So go and get me something, I don't care what. If it moves, slay it. If it doesn't move, collect it. Just follow this compass needle and get me whatever it points at. You understand?

Take me to Waton!

Alright alright! I’ll tell you everything! Ophtanar let me in on the secret. It was all his idea! We have amassed more than enough riches to leave the cult and live a life of comfort, but that’s our problem! We can’t just take the gold and disappear, our followers would never let us! So we collected the dreamberries and gave them to a few of our followers. That way they would all be kept busy defending themselves while we made our escape. Please spare me! Take me to Waton, he'll tell you that I wouldn't hurt a flea! I will even give you the key to our treasure chamber.
One bucket of T-Energy, just what Barradei ordered. I should return to him now.
I bet he keeps the money under his pillow.
Further decreases the regeneration time. Spell levels are raised even higher without penalty.
Increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Lost Fusion. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
I delivered the bag with the Christmas Wishes. Now it can... but what's that?

Ice Magic

“But master, why should I put this much effort into learning all these ice spells, when you can kill enemies with fire?”
“Fire resistant armor, efficient use of essences, special effectiveness against certain magical beings...I could lecture you indefinitely on the countless reasons. However, just to keep it simple... Have you ever smelled a charred Orc?”
 Dialogue between Ragnoir and his disciple

The destructive powers of Ice Magic are similar to those of Fire Magic, albeit many believe that Ice Magic is inferior to Fire Magic. The reason for this misconception is probably that most beings harbor a natural fear of fire while ice - although causing discomfort - is not being regarded as ultimately dangerous. This may hold true in nature, but if you ever witness an experienced ice magician in battle, you will most likely have a change of heart. Should you ever have the misfortune to be at the receiving end of an ice magician’s wrath, you will unfortunately not have the opportunity to change your mind, though.
Ice Magic owes its destructive powers to the manifold of shapes that it may adopt, thus enabling it to penetrate even the smallest of gaps, cracks or seams of any type of armor. The magic iciness then has a paralytic or even lethal effect on almost all creatures.

On battle fields, the effects of ice spells that affect whole areas are most devastating. Ice shards are the perfect weapon to keep attackers at bay - they inflict injuries and the magic ice has extremely adverse effects on metal.

“The early morning fog was still lingering while the first faint sunbeams cast an almost surreal light on the field. The Orcs were closing ranks and stood there shield next to shield - an unusual display of discipline on their part. Rain clouds had approached from the east and when the Orc troops started to move, the first drops of rain fell, splashing onto the spiky armor of the green-skins.
Our army was by far outnumbered but we had taken up formation on top of a mound, ready to take advantage of our elevated position. When I noticed the raindrops I called for our battle mages, ordering them to spread out. Finally, the horn sounded and the Orcs began to charge. All battle mages cast their spells simultaneously. A fierce blizzard erupted and swept towards the Orcs, transforming the raindrops into icy spikes. The fight was over before it had even begun. The Orcs fell like grain during a storm. We did not lose a single warrior in this battle, but the Orcs’ casualties were devastating. Those, who survived the initial wave suffered frostbites all over their bodies and many lost their eyesight due to the icy spikes. Never again did I win a battle with such ease, never again did I have to witness such devastating injuries among my enemies. Our empire owes this victory solely to Ice Magic. No legion of fire mages would have been able to succeed in this fashion.”
 From the memoirs of Celirathian, General of the High Elves

Ice Magic is the best choice against creatures resistant or even immune to fire such as Dragons, Fire Demons or Lava Golems. Fire can not harm these beings, but they will suffer considerable damage from cold.

Hunting

Hunting is one of the noblest jobs in Ancaria. You’ll face nature alone, you’ll fight against the wildest creatures and you’ll carry their carcasses to the village to eat their flesh. It has always been this way, and it will always be the same.

A little help is always welcome though, because there are few things more embarrassing than coming home to your village after a long hunt with only a squirrel or - even worse - nothing at all.

The most important things for a successful hunt are the right clothing and the suitable equipment. The hunter who dares to enter the forest clad in colorful clothing better suited for a clown and armed only with a kitchen knife should expect to be attacked by a baffled bear, not to return to their village with prey for dinner. In the forest it’s best to wear clothes of colors that match and blend in with the trees, which means green and brown tints. If you’re not sure if your clothing is suitable you should ask a woman, they're usually more experienced with these things.

It’s also important not to wash yourself with soap and not to use fragrances as a perfume. All deer know that other deer don’t smell like rosewater. It's best to wash yourself with only plain water.

As soon as you are clad accordingly you have to choose the right weapons. You should concentrate on ranged weapons, there are very few hunters skilled enough to stealthily get close enough to a wild animal to be able to use a blade against it. When hunting animals like bears or wolves it’s generally best not to attack them at close-range, unless you're forced to because the bear/wolf got aggressive after smelling your rosewater.
In addition to your primary ranged weapon, you should also always carry a knife, and in a way that you can’t fall onto it. In the dense forest arrows and a bow are good ranged weapons, but crossbows aren’t bad either because they can pack quite a punch. For a slingshot you need a lot of space in front of and behind you, therefore you should only use them in the light forest, on the grassland and in the mountains. For the latter they are especially useful as you can find your ammunition there and don’t have to take it with you. A bag full of stones can get very heavy in the long run. Spears are good for clear areas too, but they're somewhat unmanageable. Throwing knives are a good choice when hunting small prey even though it’s not easy to hit them, but bigger animals aren’t wounded much by these weapons. It can get quite expensive to replace knives if the wounded boar or deer runs away with your knife stuck in its body. Many hunters wonder if it’s useful to poison the blade of their knife or the tips of their arrows so that even small wounds can be fatal. These hunters should keep in mind that the cemeteries are full of hunters who touched their blades with their own fingers, and that there are a lot of stories in the taverns about what happened to families who thought it would be a good idea to eat the flesh of a poisoned animal.

If you enter a forest armed with a bow and arrows, it’s best to look for a watering place with lots of tracks around it. If you don’t know which animal leaves which tracks, you should bear in mind the following: If it has hooves you can hunt it, if it has paws it will hunt you. If you manage to find a watering place with tracks of desirable prey, you can make yourself comfortable here. Consider the wind direction when you choose the place you will wait. It’s best to stand where the wind will not blow your scent, with or without rosewater, in the direction you expect your prey to come from. It can take hours for an animal to appear at the watering place. When it comes into view it’s important to stay calm and to take shallow breaths. The bow can be handled almost silently, but all animals that have escaped from an arrow once know the sound of a bowstring.

T-Energy

"What is it?"
"T-Energy."
"What does it do?"
"It glows blue."

Two constant streams of energy flow through Ancaria. They may seem similar, but they actually could not be more different: these two forms of energy - T-Energy and the Essence, are like fire and water. T-Energy is an inherently destructive power. Like a wildfire, once it is out of control it devastates anything in its path. The Essence, on the other hand, is a silent, surging force that requires a catalyst to unleash its full potential.

T-Energy is much more difficult to control than the Essence. Whereas masters of the magical arts need only to concentrate on channeling the Essence, T-Energy must be subdued before it can be used. For a long time it was believed that it was impossible to combine T-Energy and the Essence in a single spell. Various theories were put forward to explain what might occur if T-Energy and active Essence met. The theories ranged from apocalyptic visions of exploding continents to shifts in the fabric of reality and holes in time - the scholar's imagination knows no bounds, or so it would seem... What everyone agreed on was that combining T-Energy with Essence was a fatal undertaking! It was only after the emergence of the first spells, which successfully synthesized T-Energy and Essence, that such absurd theories lost ground. And thus began an era of intensive research into the potential benefits of combining these two energy streams.

In the years that followed, however, it became evident that as pessimistic as these theories may have been, they did possess a modicum of truth. At the Imperial academies T-Energy research resulted in a wave of fatalities, the likes of which Ancaria had never seen before. Unforeseeable accidents rocked the academies as experiments got out of control. Unexpected results wreaked chaos and devastation. The Academy in Lanithiain had to be reconstructed four times. No fewer than eight esteemed seers of the magical arts were either killed on the spot or transformed into hideous creatures with the intelligence of steamed broccoli following their exposure to raw T-Energy. It was eventually decided to restrict access to T-Energy research and continue it on a smaller scale in more secure facilities.

Under Grenuir IV, T-Energy research was banned from all of the major urban academies and shifted to remote regions in order to minimize the dangers to people and property. Research centers were set up throughout Ancaria, most of them in largely unpopulated areas. This development led to a series of spontaneous revolts among the rural population. Some peasants even went so far as to chain themselves to the gates of the research centers in a desperate attempt to hinder the transport of T-Energy materials. Such rebellions were swiftly quelled.
In the year 42 the now renowned researcher and mage Lanopyth made a major breakthrough in the study of T-Energy. He discovered a method of transforming and safely channeling a small amount of T-Energy. The energy was barely sufficient to reanimate a dead frog for even a short while, but his discovery marked a major turning point. In the years that followed, Lanopyth refined his technique and was eventually able to boost most magical rituals with T-Energy. This was an epoch-making development! Prior to this, T-Energy had been viewed with some suspicion, now its popularity surged to new heights throughout the magic community. New research programs were launched in academies across the Empire and new applications for T-Energy emerged by the day. The scribes and copyists of the realm were buried under an avalanche of manuscripts and bulletins.

After 200 years of scientific inquiry, T-Energy was well on its way to conquer the magic world and emerged as a serious alternative to the powers of the Essence.

Poison Magic

„How are you feeling?”
“Good, very good! My tongue is tingling a little, but otherw...”
“Very well, dispose of him and bring the next one.”
 From Varmac’s research protocols while testing a new substance on a delinquent.

The lore of creating poisons and researching their effectiveness is one of the oldest aspects of magic. These disciplines comprise more than merely mixing substances. Each traveling charlatan is able to concoct some type of poison from plants, crystals or other ingredients. The true art of Poison Magic lies within refining the effectiveness of poisons, transforming them into different shapes and finding alternative methods to apply them by means of magic. The study of antidotes is also part of this branch of magic as almost every existing poison is curable by an antidote.

The roots of Poison Magic are lost in history. Fragments of old scrolls from the era of the Dragon Wars prove, that magicians were already getting involved with this discipline. One of the fundamental and classic works of poison magic is the „Arcana Alchimica“ written by Archmage Trinysil in 78. In this compendium, all known poisons were sorted into groups for the very fist time and all effects of magic in connection with poisons were described. All these classifications are valid to the present day. Of course, Poison Magic has evolved since then. Still, “The Trinysil” - as it is lovingly called by all students - is the standard treatise for Poison Magic at all academies of the empire..

The list of possibilities involving Poison Magic is endless. It ranges from creating simple poisons to constructing complex traps that emit a deadly, poisonous cloud when they are being touched or otherwise triggered.

Despite being taught at all official academies of the empire, Poison Magic still maintains a sinister reputation; something does not taste right about it... pun intended. Far too often, Poison Magic is connected with assassinations, political intrigues leading to attempts on the regents’ lives, or perfidious murders of competitors and rivals. Poisons are the first choice when you want to dispose of someone inconspicuously; this fact does nothing to improve the reputation of Poison Magic. Of course, this is all merely a figment of our imagination. Poison Magic - so far as it is taught at our academies - is a respectable science, albeit one that took a long time to be officially recognized as a branch of magic. Long and heated debates and negotiations were required before it was finally accepted. One of its most ferocious opponents was the eccentric Archmage Gotan who was so adamant in his rejection of Poison Magic that it was almost obsessive.

“Here they are at their desks, mixing powders, grinding herbs, murmuring their ridiculous formulas and then they call it magic! MAGIC, I say! The entire quarter is contaminated by the stench of their creations. Birds are falling from the sky when they are unfortunate enough to fly over our roofs! There are not enough criminals in the empire to serve in their test series! And now these dabblers have the nerve to demand that their quackery should be called sublime magic? These fairground magicians, unable to weave a single, decent spell? If these wannabe-magicians are going to be admitted to the academy, I will resign this instant.”
 Gotan about poison magic

“May this hedonist babble as much as he pleases. His opinions are weighed down by the dust and cobwebs of centuries gone past and his outlook on the world is as boring and naïve as Fire Magic. Still, I must admit that I am profoundly impressed! Gotan is able to spread more venom in one speech than I am able to produce in one week. I recommend parsley as an antidote. Just stick it in your ears.”
 Varmac’s reply to Gotan
