Orcish for Beginners

Preface

Congratulations on your purchase of this latest work in our "Lingua Ancaria" series. The present volume is dedicated to Orcish and provides interested readers with a lucid and comprehensive introduction to the Orcish language.
We would also like to draw your attention to our works for more advanced learners "Orcish for Intermediate Learners - From Drinking Hall Anthems to Marriage Proposals", and our course book for budding experts "Debating in Orcish - The Concise Compendium of Insults and Curses". All of these works are available at a well-stocked parchment and scroll merchant of your choice.
Our scribes are currently also preparing a new edition of the companion volume, "The Complete Guide to Orcish Grammar“ (5 pages - with a wealth of explanatory pictures and plenty of room for notes) which is to be published next Garon.


Let’s get started!

The history of Orcish languages spans thousands of years. Like most languages, Orcish is distinguished by an abundance of dialects and local variants. This myriad of local variations presents an almost insurmountable challenge to even the most learned of experts in the field of Orcish linguistics. The only attempt ever made by a non-Orcish scholar to describe and analyze all of the Orcish dialects was undertaken nearly 2500 years ago by Master of Lingua Thaddeus. Sadly, he failed to complete the mammoth task which so absorbed him for 40 years. The deeper he delved into the labyrinthine complexities of Orcish, the more firmly melancholy gripped his soul. Eventually, one morning, Thaddeus was found dead in the attic of his house. In his despair, the Master of Lingua had disemboweled himself and cut short a lifetime of erudite scholarship. A note found at his lectern allegedly read: "I have no idea which dialect this is...and I do not care! HUSH NOW! SILENCE! LEAVE ME IN PEACE! ALL OF YOU!“
His life's work, encompassing 350 handwritten manuscripts, was tragically destroyed by fire the following year.

The present volume is concerned solely with High Orcish, or, as it is otherwise known, Classic Urguaz. This purest form of Orcish is spoken only seldom today, although Orcs of all tribes and clans are familiar with it. Students will soon learn to take great pleasure in the diversity of the Orcish language and will, no doubt, revel in a range of novel and exciting linguistic possibilities.

Many of the sounds unique to Orcish result from the peculiarities of Orc anatomy, and students are advised to use the false incisor teeth accompanying this volume. (Alternatively, you can substitute corks for the false teeth) False teeth are an indispensable aid for students who wish to pronounce Orcish vocabulary correctly. And now, we wish you all the best in your endeavors to learn what is perhaps one of the most colorful and vivid languages of all Ancaria! Or, as an Orc would say: Hataz Dura!


I. Getting to know Gragash
 This is Gragash! He will accompany you on your way through this book. Say 'Hello' to our Orcish friend!



You say:
Hello, Gragash! How do you do?

In Orcish we say:
Artak Gragash, etok?

Gragash answers:
Tirtak! Naturok?
(I’m good! And you?)

 Let’s take a closer look at some of the unique features of the Orcish language: The -k at the end of "artak“ is a hard, unvoiced -k. However, the -k in the interrogative word "etok“ is much softer and guttural - a combination of -ch and -g.

Note:
Greetings are an extremely complex matter in the Orcish culture. Precise rules exist on how to greet your counterpart; age, status and the intended purpose of the conversation are all important factors. Any digression from these rules may be interpreted as a sign of weakness, provocation or insult. At this stage, students are advised to dispense with the use of standard Orcish greetings. Occasionally, some Orcs may take offence at this practice but learners will usually be able to avoid any violent confrontation by clearly evincing their ignorance of the Orcish language and customs.


Now that we have successfully greeted Gragash, let´s continue our conversation.

You say:
Do you want to eat some chickens with me?

And now in Orcish:
Nghuash su kruag topa ni?

Gragash answers:
Larguok tasniz ni egul!
(I have to do something else, unfortunately!)


There are only two personal pronouns in Orcish grammar:

I = ni
Not-I = su

In some cases the personal pronoun "su" can be substituted or complemented with a more precise description as necessary. In order to make a statement more ambiguous, well versed orators may choose to dispense with such nuances.

Note:
We recommend that students eager to test their mastery of Orcish do not attempt to inflect personal pronouns - conversation partners may take violent exception to any unnecessary or incorrect references. Learners may, consequently, find themselves maimed or dismembered.

Hunting

Hunting is one of the noblest jobs in Ancaria. You’ll face nature alone, you’ll fight against the wildest creatures and you’ll carry their carcasses to the village to eat their flesh. It has always been this way, and it will always be the same.

A little help is always welcome though, because there are few things more embarrassing than coming home to your village after a long hunt with only a squirrel or - even worse - nothing at all.

The most important things for a successful hunt are the right clothing and the suitable equipment. The hunter who dares to enter the forest clad in colorful clothing better suited for a clown and armed only with a kitchen knife should expect to be attacked by a baffled bear, not to return to their village with prey for dinner. In the forest it’s best to wear clothes of colors that match and blend in with the trees, which means green and brown tints. If you’re not sure if your clothing is suitable you should ask a woman, they're usually more experienced with these things.

It’s also important not to wash yourself with soap and not to use fragrances as a perfume. All deer know that other deer don’t smell like rosewater. It's best to wash yourself with only plain water.

As soon as you are clad accordingly you have to choose the right weapons. You should concentrate on ranged weapons, there are very few hunters skilled enough to stealthily get close enough to a wild animal to be able to use a blade against it. When hunting animals like bears or wolves it’s generally best not to attack them at close-range, unless you're forced to because the bear/wolf got aggressive after smelling your rosewater.
In addition to your primary ranged weapon, you should also always carry a knife, and in a way that you can’t fall onto it. In the dense forest arrows and a bow are good ranged weapons, but crossbows aren’t bad either because they can pack quite a punch. For a slingshot you need a lot of space in front of and behind you, therefore you should only use them in the light forest, on the grassland and in the mountains. For the latter they are especially useful as you can find your ammunition there and don’t have to take it with you. A bag full of stones can get very heavy in the long run. Spears are good for clear areas too, but they're somewhat unmanageable. Throwing knives are a good choice when hunting small prey even though it’s not easy to hit them, but bigger animals aren’t wounded much by these weapons. It can get quite expensive to replace knives if the wounded boar or deer runs away with your knife stuck in its body. Many hunters wonder if it’s useful to poison the blade of their knife or the tips of their arrows so that even small wounds can be fatal. These hunters should keep in mind that the cemeteries are full of hunters who touched their blades with their own fingers, and that there are a lot of stories in the taverns about what happened to families who thought it would be a good idea to eat the flesh of a poisoned animal.

If you enter a forest armed with a bow and arrows, it’s best to look for a watering place with lots of tracks around it. If you don’t know which animal leaves which tracks, you should bear in mind the following: If it has hooves you can hunt it, if it has paws it will hunt you. If you manage to find a watering place with tracks of desirable prey, you can make yourself comfortable here. Consider the wind direction when you choose the place you will wait. It’s best to stand where the wind will not blow your scent, with or without rosewater, in the direction you expect your prey to come from. It can take hours for an animal to appear at the watering place. When it comes into view it’s important to stay calm and to take shallow breaths. The bow can be handled almost silently, but all animals that have escaped from an arrow once know the sound of a bowstring. If everything goes as planned the deer or stag will go down when the first arrow hits, but if it doesn't you should should show mercy by tracking and killing it fast. When you have successfully taken your prey, be sure to cover its wounds with mud or bandages. You'll have to convey it back through the forest, and the smell of the blood could attract bears and wolves. If bears or wolves are your prey, you can disregard this caution but it's always advisable to take some companions with you on these hunts.

If you heed all these tips you’ll be able to come back to your village burdened with prey and, more importantly, alive to entertain (or bore) the farmers in the tavern with tales of your hunting trips.

Swords

“The day I`m losing respect for my sword is the day I die.”
 Nuagin Thedoilin, Elven Swordmaster

In many ways, the sword can be considered the king of weapons. A sword in the hands of a skilled master at arms is absolutely deadly. No armor can withstand a well placed strike. If two swords meet, only the better fighter will win. There is no room for a lucky strike.
Sword fighting requires three different skills: speed, strength and precision. A good swordfighter doesn't need to be equally good at all three aspects. Any two of the three combined makes a good fighter. The choice of the type of sword highly relies on the style of the fighter. If a warrior is strong and precise, he can use a long and heavy sword. The fast and precise fighter will prefer a shorter and lighter blade.
There are many different kinds of swords.

Shortsword

The Shortsword is a small, compact weapon, that's able to inflict devastating damage to a target, simply by the force of the impact. Shortswords are usually not sharp, but pointy. Due to their reduced length, they're the perfect weapons for very close combat, like fighting indoors during a siege for example.
Shortswords are the weapon of choice for a speed-precision fighter.

Broadsword

Broadswords are bigger versions of shortswords. Like their smaller pendants they are not overly sharp, but thanks to the mass of the blade they are able to crush through any kind of armor. Wielding a broadsword requires a lot of strength and stamina, and controlling the blade takes a lot of practice and clever use of the swing momentum.
Broadswords are suitable for strength-precision fighters.

Longsword

The longsword is the longest version of all one-handed blade weapons. Unlike the short sword and the broadsword, the longsword has a very sharp blade and can deliver both, slash and crush wounds. The extra length of the longsword renders it a perfect duel weapon. However, wielding a longsword requires the expertise of a true master of swords.
Strength-speed fighters will usually choose the longsword.

Bastardsword

This weapon is also known as the 1 1/2-handed sword. It is too large for a one handed weapon and too small to be called a two-handed sword. Very strong fighters can wield a bastardsword with just one hand. However, fighting with a bastardsword is usually a very special and unique mixture between two-handed and single-handed fighting techniques. The ability to wield it with one hand highly increases the variety of possible swings. While the impact of a bastardsword cannot be compared to the damage of a two-handed sword, it is still much more severe than the strike of a one-handed sword.

Forging the Sword

Decades of research, experience and learning are essential if one intends to create a good sword. The steel must be perfect - flexible but strong. The balance point needs to be exactly in the right spot. If it leans a smidgen to either side it will turn a sword into a useless chunk of metal. The best swords in Ancaria stem from northern Artamark, which has a long tradition of weaponsmiths, all following the heritage of Turiathin, the legendary swordmaster and smith, who lived 580 years ago. Very few swords made by him him survived throughout the centuries and each one of them is invaluable.

Rumors claim that Turiathin wrote a book containing all his secrets and experiences about swordmaking, and that this book is kept in the vault of the weaponsmith guildhalls in Artamark's Gate. Others say that this book never existed, that all his knowledge was transferred by word-of-mouth. Either way, it is a fact that the swords from Artamark are of extraordinary quality, and whoever is able to afford one calls one of the most powerful weapons in Ancaria his own.

Artamark

Geography and climate: The land of the Humans is green. From the mountains that line it a cold wind constantly blows carrying rain in summer and snow in winter. Large woods cover Aramark. Beneath the trees the ground is fertile. The large variety of crops that grow here are responsible for the many tasty kinds of breads taverns serve in Artamark. This green land again and again surprises the traveler with its beauty like the view of snow covered mountain tops and mist rising from the woods and evaporating in the pale sunlight.

Inhabitants: The inhabitants are friendly and open-minded toward strangers. Artamark is almost exclusively populated by Humans. The thatched huts and houses they live in look pictoresque, but offer good protection against common winter storms. Most people in Artamark work as farmers or craftsmen, but some go to the woods and try their luck as hunters. They kill game for meat and sell the pelts to passing merchants. Brigands who also live in the woods often rob these merchants.

Strangers are welcome in Artamark, but its inhabitants generally do not care foe High Elves or Orcs. This is understandable as High Elves regard Humans as slaves whereas Orcs constantly threaten Artamark's northern borders.

Places of interest: Humans aren't particularly renowned for their architectural masterpieces. Their buildings are mainly simple and practical, and they seem to have no eye for beauty. Still, there are some places one should visit, for example Urthak's Moxie near the Orcish border. It is said that it was built over a period of two hundred years and looking at its mighty walls rising out of the woods one can almost believe this.

The market in Blackoaks in the south of Artamark should be the last stop on one's journey through the land simply to avoid being robbed further north. It is the largest market in Artamark and deals mainly in furs, meat, and craftsmanship, especially wood carvings. Human woodcraft is highly regarded in all of Ancaria and may well be the only form of artistic expression displayed in this land. The market offers all sorts of carvings from small earrings to life size warrior statues that look so real one almost expects their hair to move in the breeze.

In Artamark it is considered impolite to make a gift of something that could be of use to the giver, as it implies that the giver is better off and therefore superior to the receiver.

Recommendations: If at all possible, one should travel through Artamark in the summer. The weather is mainly pleasant then and one can also get a taste of a local delicacy: a mush of deer brain and strawberries that is served with fresh bread,

There is but one God. You may have heard differently, that there are many Gods such as Kybele, Lumen, Ker and so forth. But those are all mere aspects of the One True Creator, and we Seraphim were his angels.
How Ancaria came to exist is too long a tale for now. Suffice it to say that The Creator was less than satisfied with this world and its warring races. He decided to abandon it until such time, if any, as it could find equilibrium. He left us Seraphim behind to guard and to guide it. This we did successfully for centuries. But inexplicably, The Creator never returned. Then came the Great Dragon War in which Maria, our leader, was lost. After that, the Seraphim withdrew from the world, leaving it to its own fate. Now we wait. Frustrated, yet hopeful that one day things may change.
Enough! Your friend and mentor awaits you. Go speak with him.
The Christmas Ogre gave me a present. That was nice of him.
It must be somewhere over there. Between the old walls.
Come to me, you lazy bunch!
A businessman has given a scientist money to build a machine that will make water out of sand. He has asked me to find out how the scientist is using his money.
That's right! Kill me! Just give it a try!
I'll put and end to your miserable existence.

I found a dying dragon mage adept on the side of the road. His master had suddenly backstabbed him before he continued on his way alone. It looks like someone's in a panic.

The young dragon mage adept dissolved into ash. I'm going to bring the ashes to a suitable place and scatter them. This is the only way I can free his soul. But I hear it's quite dangerous to release the soul of a dragon mage. Hmm... I wonder why?! I'll find out.
You will certainly be a great hero one day!
Wouldn't you like to be my dad?
Do you have anything to eat with you?
If you're looking for me: I'm up here!
I found the treasure chest. It was locked and untouched!
Oh! You have returned! Did you get the material? Wonderful! I will begin construction immediately. Maybe it wasn't such a bad idea to come here after all.
I expected that to be your answer, I just wanted to test you. Continue on your way and take the boy the gifts from his father. Remember, there are things in this world that stand above the law.

What? My potions have always been of the highest quality! This is slander!
Wait, not so fast! You don’t need a weapon! Alright maybe it's because I didn't have the best ingredients. The potions still should have worked though.

I'm sorry! It's not my fault! It's this scum that's taking the last bit of money that I have. How am I supposed to make potions when I can’t afford quality ingredients? Half of the village is paying for their “protection.” Tonight I have to give them money again. I don’t know who the head of that gang is, I always leave the money in a clearing in the wood.
This game supports the Trophy system. The Trophies can be viewed by pressing the PS button, then selecting "Trophy Collection" in the "Game" tab.
The bag with the Christmas Wishes was stolen by a couple of Yeti. Go and get it back. You will find them in their cave. Watch out for Walther their leader, he's not a creature to be trifled with.
The vendor was very pleased with my success and has given me a small reward.
Warning, fatal error occurred, reset required - reset... reset...
Done with praying? Let's fight then!
Do you have any other plans for today, what are you waiting for?
I'll beat the faith in your Gods out of you!
Luckily, I don't have a body! Makes it less drafty.
Umph! Body or no body, that one hit home!
I will have to train hard, if I want to be able to use that.
Of what was once a proud village, ruins are all that remains today.

Now Shirka is asking me to escort her beyond the wall!
I couldn't refuse this request if I wanted to. Maybe she'll be more successful among the Humans. “The one-eyed man is king among the blind...”
A derelict estate in the midst of the Bloodwood
Combat program switching to defensive manoeuvres!
Turn shame program down to minimum - activate escape program!
Rosemary! That's it! Rosemary is missing!
Cumin makes some dishes more digestible.
Cooking is only an art if it can be eaten.
I alone have mastered 27 different ways to heat water.
There's no place you can run that I won't be able to catch you!
Another proud son of the desert!
Everything is alright at the tavern, but the landlord is worried about his brewery. It's in a cave not far from the tavern.

Hans-Arno Wegner
I can't think of anything now but I will consider it...
On the battlefield there will be only sturdy young men, I assume.
Which strategy do you pursue when you go into battle?
Are you able to stay calm in battle?
Sophia! Eldest of the Seraphim. She is waiting to receive you!
Do you also spit lightning when you're mad?
Cannot be used for riding mode.
Impressive wings! Do you eat worms or seeds?

The alchemist thanked me and asked if I would be willing to test his new potion. I turned him down of course - I’m quite fond of my memory! I'm not so sure that he really knows what he’s doing. My refusal must have hurt his professional pride, he tried the potion out on himself! He's not quite the man he once was, to put it mildly... I should have a word with the leader of the cult. As far as I know, he was the cult’s chief alchemist.
There are only odds and sods around here, it's not worth it.

Bring 15 identification disks to the Priest in Hisui'Sul!

A long time ago there was a huge battle in this area. Us against the Humans. Nobody knows why they were fighting or when the battle took place exactly, but the dead are still roaming around this area. Soldiers... hundreds of them! And all of them still have their identification disks. IDENTIFICATION DISKS, don't you understand? If the naive Lizardmen get them they'll build memorial shrines so the dead will be remembered for all time. We have to prevent this. Please go and destroy the undead. Bring 15 identification disks to the Priest in Hisui'Sul. He'll destroy them once and for all.

Thank you. At least I'm safe here for now. It's not so bad down here. The musty smell is somewhat comforting.
I don't have much to give you, but take this. It is of some value. Tell Ligmissy that you have slain the monster. She wouldn't have believed my story anyway. Farewell!
You want me to torture you?
By now, your finger should be bleeding.
You must lead a pretty boring life.
You should try using your stench as a weapon, green scum!
The shylock is dead. Now the Inquisitor wants to speak to me.
I have to find ten Flowers of Light. Apparently, they grow on a flowery meadow north of here.
I have to be careful with the monsters of this region. I shouldn't overestimate my capabilities.
This items is no good for me.
The Human scum must be eradicated!
How did you get yourself into such a situation? But never mind, I'll help you.
Increases the chance to trigger secondary effects (burn, freeze, weaken, poison) of the respective damage types.
Oh honorable sorceress! I beg you with all my heart - help me!
A Human heart! Hmph. That is but a worthless trinket... But never mind... speak!
It's about my pet. It was just a little worm when I got it - now it is eight meters long, and yesterday it ate my dog.
Are you mad? What kind of a monster did the pet merchant sell you?
I found it on the beach. A beautiful baby with yellow and green stripes.
Yellow and green stripes! You found an asparagus snake - the most bloodthirsty and dangerous creature to ever roam the oceans.
How could I be so blind? Do you know a spell that might banish it?
I really would like to help you, but I have an important meeting to go to.
<AlignH Value=Center/><b> You have died and respawned at the last safe position.
<AlignH Value=Center/><b> Death does not have any negative effects on the hero.
I delivered Semil to a fisherman who seems to know his way around here. They should be able to make it to back to the realm of the Humans together.
You are nothing but a freak of nature.
What do you think of the idea of selling fine timbers to foreign lands? It could make us all very rich.
You don't think much of my plan to cut down more forest and move into the timber business, do you?
I wish people would listen to me for once! All these trees could make us incredibly rich! Why don't we do something about it?
Oh, I certainly love and respect nature... but together we could make a fortune in the timber industry!
Dash it! Why don't we just cut down some of this forest? There's so much of it! We could be rich in no time!
Almighty Goddess this way or that! Surely she wouldn't mind if we just cut down a few good trees?
I love and respect nature, but poverty is such a cruel master...we could do good business in the timber trade, don't you think?
Piety is all well and good, but with a little business sense we could make a lot of money with our forests.
As if the Goddess would notice if we sold the Elves a few fine trees here and there...
We're stupid wretches! Rich and stupid! We're surrounded by priceless wood and we won't sell any of it!
Mix a bit of saltpeter with sugar, light it and when the smoke clears you end up with a whole lot of nothing.
Hm... toys! I guess this is the place where the children were playing. I'll better take them with me and then follow that figure.
Well done. Don't let me keep you any longer because the sword that you are carrying is not wanted on this island. Move along my half dead friend.
A green monstrosity like you dares to get in the way of a High Elf?
I thought you were going to the brawlerball final in Orcwitch?
No, unfortunately I couldn't get a ticket. The final has been sold out for weeks.
Brawlerball is a mystery to me. I don't understand the rules at all!
It's easy really - the game doesn't have that many rules. As long as you understand the offside rule, the rest is easy to follow.
I thought it was just women who didn't understand that rule. I guess you can never tell...
Whatever - I'd rather spend my nights in the tavern anyway. If there's one thing I know a lot about, it's beer!
Then good health to you, friend!
Praise and glory to the Gods, and to our savior!
Ahh! Good! I can get to work now. The mousse is almost done! Do you want a sample?
I can only find out where all the hatred comes from if I get a chance to examine the soul essences.
I've been asked to salvage goods from the destroyed caravan. I need to take the pack animals I've been given to the site.
Thank you for rescuing me and... well I don't really know when I can pay you back. Thank you!
I need better protection against ice based damage.
The alchemist wants to leave this place. The cult seems to have no scruples anymore, and it won't shy away from using force just to get this recipe. I have to escort the alchemist to Hissil'Ta.
At last, my spare parts! My thanks good friend! I'll order my men to begin the repairs at once.

Kill four Arch Mage Ghosts!

Gah, these ghosts are horrible! I don't dare set foot outside my house anymore! They're everywhere! And the Arch Mages are the worst of all! Can you help me? I ask that you kill four of these Arch Mage ghosts! Then the area around the cottage would at least be a little safer!
The Soldiers can now attend to their real duties undisturbed and don't have to watch their backs anymore.

Go into the wine cellar and find out what is going on down there!

My entire cellar is filled with barrels of wine, but I dare not go down there since I heard those strange sounds. It’s haunted! I’m telling you, it’s really haunted! Please help me! My customers are starting to lose their patience!
The enemies, who are on the rampage around here, are still too strong for me. I should come back after I gain more experience.
Excuse me? I can barely believe what I'm hearing! TyBosso talk! What is going on here?
Quench my thirst for blood, Elves!

Why didn't I see it coming? I have to break the spell, of COURSE! The mage is “indisposed” from the pain in his back. Riiiight ...
On the other hand ... I've always wanted to dabble in music.
Of course, I have a nice bouquet of roses. Deliver them to the gardener and give him my regards.
Praise Testa! Well done! You have such a charismatic personality - it's simply incredible! I bless you in the name of Testa and give you this ring!

What?! Who?! Where am I?
Oh .. it has all been just a dream? I saw a light. At the end of a very long tunnel. Maybe I will write a book about it one day.
Thank you for saving me.
I spoke with Rinah. The Army of the Inquisitors is always on the lookout for people who are interested in accepting assignments. If I'm ready for a assignment I should talk to Rinah!

A trap!
Agent Thylius wasn't alone, he had three other companions. One of them ran away, but I'll get him.

Ok, here's the deal: the man who lives here is my former business partner. We used to specialize in "hostile takeovers" and "risk management." I paid him his share of the profits, but he says he wants more. See to it that he leaves me alone in the future and I'll reward you with a rare and valuable artifact!
Ademaya rewarded me with the sacred blessing of Testa - and a ring.
I've obtained almost everything. I'm only missing the Rose of the Wind. I don't think I'll find this plant in some dingy cellar. I'll ask a scholar as soon as I reach the desert.
This time I will do better.
Dear woman - don't you have some alms for me?
My, if only I were a little more like you!
I'd really like to wear beautiful clothes like yours!
You have accepted the invitation of %1.
I'll pay you back for that!
You're going to have to kill me!
I will fight to the death!
You are stuck with your debt if you can't budge it.
I am still lacking the experience required to use this item.

There you are! You did a good job, now give me the artifacts. I will hand them over to the Seraphim so that they don't fall into the wrong hands again. Oh... stop by the blacksmith's. The Seraphim have something for you there.
I did not see that coming!
Ah the hermit sent you! These are unusual herbs, I'll give you a good price for them. You won't get anything from the hermit but a few pious words of thanks.
The farmer was pleases. He gave me a more than generous reward.
What's gone is gone, Mr. Hunter!
My secret hunting methods are unseen and flawless.
Oh, have mercy on my memory - Where did I hide the furs?
It takes a snare to catch a hare.
By treading lightly and against the wind, I will catch a deer and escape the hunter.
Your efforts are valiant! But there's no time for friendly chit-chat. There they come!
Will you take us back home? This is not a nice place. I want to go home to Mama! The other children didn't want to stay here either, now they are all gone.
If the Gods didn't like pleasure, they wouldn't have made food so savoury.
Oh Gods! What a blessed day!
Kuan, the God of war, has been silent for some time. Is this peace treacherous?
I pray that our soldiers may be vigilant.
Praise be Kybele! Storms have not sought us out in a long time.
An opulent, well-appointed ceremony might soothe the Gods.
A new Temple would make our village look better.
These witches, herbalists and alchemists are an abomination!
That's the contract between me and Golmar! I think I will just shred it. That should make the deal null and void, and I am free of debt again.
Ferryman Charolus has asked me to confront his rival - a fellow called Nathim. Nathim destroyed his boat and robbed him of his livelihood.
Your talk about the Gods is nothing but a pack of lies!
Well then! You can plead to your Gods on the battlefield!
You just pull the wool over the weak-willed eyes of the faithful! Begone with you!
You and the Gods? They'd spit at your stupidity!
You are the real scourge these days, you and your heresies! Fare unwell!
Oh yes, you and your idiotic teachings! The Gods are nothing but your masquerade!
Your belief is a heresy! And we'll teach you that the bloody way!
What you call the will of the Gods will just enrage them!
The power of the heavens? They've already cursed your deeds!
You don't care about the Gods! You're just interested in more power.
Stop! Don't make it more difficult for us!
Fantastic! They're a bit rusty, but we can soon clean that up! Here - take this as a sign of my gratitude.
The pleasure was all mine! I liked your words very much.
Everything will be fine if our forefathers want it that way!
Only the ancestors know when we'll meet again!
Good luck to you too! The ancestors are with us!
It was a real pleasure, my good brother!
See you soon. I'm going to devote myself to our forefathers again.
I was able to learn a lot from you. Thanks!
It was nice to spend this time together!
It was a short but nevertheless wonderful inspiration!
I'll take my leave, and I feel stronger! Thank you!
I take it you were successful? Well then money is of no object to me! Take this and go with my blessing. Thank you very much!
Not just a Human, but a cutthroat as well...
I would like to become a Priest. Would you consecrate me?
If possible I would like to be consecrated as well, to serve the ancestors.
Do you think, I would be a good and model Priest?
As a Priest I would serve the spirits of the ancestors perfectly.
I would like to choose a clerical career and become a Priest. Can you help?
What would I have to do to become a pious Priest? I'm sure I would be a good one.
Why won't you make me a Priest? I'm sure, I would be good.
I want to become a Priest. Would you consecrate me?
Becoming a Priest is my only desire, and I hope you'll help me fulfill it.
Let me join your holy service. Please make me a Priest.

Thank you for your help! We escaped from slavery with only the clothes on our backs. We don't have much to give you, but... what? You refuse to take our money? Praise be the Gods, you truly are a good soul.
And once more the guard is victorious!
We thank the Gods for another triumph!
I am supposed to free the hostages from the cargo ship "The Crane."

Go to the Orcish territory, find out more about the lost expedition, and offer our help to the Grurag Clan

I’ve heard rumors that there are other places like this so-called place where “the magic flows from the earth.” When I sent the expedition to support the Grurag Clan in their struggle against the Ore-Thag Clan, I also asked them to find out if the rumors are true. I want you to do the same.
I am proud to be an Orc. Can you be proud of your deeds?
Your injustices are even sickening to an Orc.
Thank you! Thank you very much! I would like to give you a more adequate reward, but my pockets will be empty until the next grape harvest.
I found Willybald and informed him about the latest developments.
Any special wishes for the funeral?
Alchemists? They are all charlatans and conjurors! But very well, ... if you think so.

A Lizardman has a culinary problem. A poacher is catching all his delicious swampfish, and it can't continue. That's why he asked me to bring him the poacher. First I should go and check the good fishing spots.
Fight like a warrior, you wannabe hero!
Only weaklings join forces with good!
How much did they pay you to wear those rags?
Have you already done your good deed for the day?
I will cut out your black heart and hold it into the Light.
Hmm ... so you don't celebrated name days either, I guess?
All right then, nameless one, I'll talk to him.
Ok, I got it... Death doesn't care about names either.

When I arrived at the headquarters of the cult they were leaving to raid a field of Marigold. According to the cult leader, they need to stop the Lizardmen from harvesting it. The flowers produce incense which keeps the fog monster at bay. The cult would rather the Lizardmen fight the fog monster than build memorials to lay the undead to rest. Looks like all those guys are leading a busy life.
The fog cannot be fought directly. To weaken it the summoned creatures must first be dispatched.
I will be on my way soon.
Alright - I guess I will beat some more Humans to death!
I'll personally take care of it.
Oooh, I would do anything for your gratitude.
I cannot wait - I haven't killed anyone for a while.
I wouldn't want to be in your shoes.
Are these rags in style where you're from?
Any Hero completing 50 % of all sidequests.
Gnomen est omen ... or how did the saying go?
The water still looks strange. Please hurry!
Done! Dylaith and his henchmen won't say another word. Oh we still have Glydial!
I think, that's enough. And these pelts are pretty heavy, too!
Even dead, I have more honor than you!
Go fight, win now or die!
I have gathered some herbs. Now I can return to my friend the talking herring.
T-Energy is becoming a major threat.
You miserable relic of a formerly proud race!
The swallows fly high in the sky, but I haven’t the faintest idea what the weather will be like tomorrow...
What Gronkor still has both his hands? That...that's not possible! We...We've been conned!

Jocelyn is worried about her fiancé. He’s been missing for days now, and all she knows is that Davim wanted to visit his friend Mettrick. Mettrick hasn't been seen for days either. I should talk to Achmed, Mettrick’s brother in law. Maybe he knows where the two men are...
Do you think I should go and gather new crystal dust?
But if I lose it, I will be sad again.
Will you come back to make me not sad again?
Ok, I think I will give it a try then.
I bet you never give up, either.
And if it doesn't work the first time, you start over again.
I think I'm not even a little bit sad anymore.

A message from Lazzila? Hm, too many festivals. He always finds something to get angry about. On the other hand, he is a Priest and a wise lizard doesn't ignore a Priest's message. I will have to discuss the sermon with my family.
The temptation is overwhelming! I need to know what’s behind all this.

I've heard some strange things lately. Last week, ol' Tuirik said that he went to the cemetery and found his wife's grave opened. Yesterday, the smith said something similar. And just before you came here, my wife told me that she found her father's grave open and his remains were scattered all over the cemetery. Needless to say, she fainted, fell on her back and promptly got lumbago.  If you ask me, there's a Necromancer performing his disgusting experiments here. I've seen this before years ago, when I was in the military. If it's really a Necromancer, we need to get rid of him. There's no room for abominations like that in this village. Can you go to the cemetery and slay the Necromancer if there is one? The village would reward you with quite a pretty penny.
I brought peace to this region.

The Thunder Gurgler gets its kick from a small does of pure T-Energy. I always thought that even the slightest exposure to T-Energy turned people into monsters, but then again I've heard some people consider poisonous fish a delicacy.
I have a suggestion to make, but I don't know what you'll think of it.
We guards stand at our post each day, keeping an eye on everything. There is really nothing that slips by us.
What does that have to do with me?
Well, it sure would be nice if you brought us a little snack now and then.
Oh, that's what this is all about. Well, of course, I can do that. Which do you prefer, liver or kidney?
Oh wait, I just remembered that we already get delicious food in the barracks!  Thank you very much anyway, farewell.
No problem, you can turn to me anytime. Goodbye!
Robbing a living thing of it's freedom - that contradicts the will of nature!
Never! I am NOT going to mount that!
I've heard that you also intend to take part in this disgraceful spectacle!
Are you talking about the election, reverend Priest? What's so disgraceful about it?
The queen of the forest! That's not just sexist, it's also sheer blasphemy.
Blasphemy? Now, you're overreacting a bit, don't you think?
Not at all! Kybele, the Goddess herself, is the only queen of the forest. Everything else is nothing but overbearance.
But if I remember correctly, the Goddess has not forbidden us the joy of life.
Joy of life is indeed welcome, I agree. But everything within its boundaries!
Be that as it may, I thank you for the lecture, Father!
You are damned for all eternity!
Don't take another step, you villain!
A farmer's wife asked me to look for her missing husband in the forest.
Hey, player! You are aware of the fact that an idly running computer needs tons of energy, aren't you? Think about the ozone hole and return to the keyboard.
Kids have feelings too. Do you believe me?
I always know what to do next. How about you, are you bored often?
You know, us kids aren't always happy.
My daddy says he's very angry with me. What shall I do now?
I wonder if your ancestors will approve of your deeds? I don't really know...
Can you tell me, how one achieves the qualities of a winner?
You seem so hopeful. What gives you reason to hope?
We should hurry. The ring is... strange...
The Inquisitor and his cronies are finished. Now the people in this region can finally feel safe again. They won't be deceived and turned into slaves.

Wait, hold on! I .. uhm ... we ... we was just keepin' care of the archaelogist's stuff! Looks deserted, the camp does, and for some time, too. Didn't want nothing to end up in the wrong hands, you see? You can never know. Can't trust nobody these days now, can you? But now I changed me mind. And actually - I've gotta hurry. Never have no time, you see?
Will ya let me go?
Jagged mountains and weathered rocks are neither very inviting nor hospitable.
We fought off the cultists. Nobody will tear down the graves today.

Bastian Clarenbach
Software Sales:
fast, reliable, cheap - take two!
So the Demiurge means to destroy me! Let's see what I'll find out in that repair unit, and then I will terminate this scrap heap!
And I walked all the way for this?
My ring finger was cut off during the last battle. Do you think it'll be a problem at my upcoming wedding?
War can be really dangerous.  If you ask me, it's bad for your health.
I just left the veteran's hospital. The incompetent doctors there are more dangerous than our enemies.
I hate to whine, but this nasty cut on my chest is really causing me problems.
The other day I was hit in the thigh by an arrow. I just pulled it out with my teeth.
If modern armor is really that good, how come I got stabbed in the forearm?
Don't trust the physicians, I tell you! They're more bloodthirsty than a horde of Orcs before breakfast.
I don't want to complain, but I really lost a lot of blood in the last battle.
How was your battle? Did you get maimed in any way?
I guess you could call me a tough guy, but the last time I got clubbed in the head really hurt.
I require better protection against poison-based damage.
I am very pleased with you!
We've arrived. Now I'll negotiate with the Dryads.
I actually killed the ice phoenix. I believe I've earned the reward Sophia promised. But first, I should take the head of the creature back to Mara.
Oversized pumpkins, wheat the size of trees, grapes as big as guinea pigs... Doesn't that sound wonderful?

Help me to get the candies that the merchant owes me!

You look like someone who might be able to help me. I have saved my pocket money because I wanted to buy some candies for my sister. Now the merchant says that I never gave him the money. He is lying. Please help me.
Run as fast as you can, it won't do you any good!
Good to see you. You're a nice Orc.
Don't be so sure. Why am I even talking to you?
Because we're fighting side by side. That means we're friends.
Nonsense! We pay you for your service.
But we both hate the foul Elves. That's a basis for friendship.
The enemy of my enemy is not necessarily my friend. But you wouldn't understand that.
No, I don't understand. Can you explain it?
I'd rather try to teach opera to a dung beetle. Get lost now.
Prayers can satisfy one's hunger - provided one prays for the fine nobles!
Please don't think I'm crazy. While out hunting, I believe I saw Morelia in the mist.
The phantom? Are you serious? No one who sees her lives to tell the tale.
Well, I barely escaped. The monster had already grabbed my tail.
I didn't think, I just chopped it off. Then I ran.
That's one thing our bodies are good for. You'll grow a new one soon.
True. But I'll never go hunting in these parts of the woods again.
I don't blame you. Have a long life.
I'm the right person for this job!
Bolting when things get dicey is really pathetic.

Dag Winderlich
These video games are fun.
Increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Astute Supremacy. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
Take care and say hi to the other nameless for me.
When it comes to worldly matters, like finances, our church isn't really doing well, right?
Let's be honest here: The church treasury is almost empty. How can we refill it?
If our income continues to dwindle like this, we'll soon be forced to sell our treasures.
Our income is so meager I'm afraid we're becoming an embarrassment to the Gods. Do you know of anything we can do about it?
The faithful used to literally throw money at us, but those days are gone. How can we squeeze more out of them?
Looking at our empty wallets makes me ask if the people think their faith is free.
Faith costs money. Tell this to your flock! But use subtle and pious words.
How can we keep up appearances when we're poorer than a hamster in a dungeon?
How can we end this financial crisis for ourselv-- I mean, the church? It's getting difficult.
Nobody's donating voluntarily anymore. Maybe we should threaten these misers with eternal damnation.
A giant rat ate the glasses. I sliced it open and found the glasses in its intestines. They're a little slimy, but not broken.
I found the place where the Trolls are attacking the Orcs. The local clan chief told me to kill ten of them and bring back their teeth as proof.
Summons a stationary skeletal tower that will automatically fire arrows at opponents within its range.
You underestimate the power of the shadows Dragon!

Andreas Liebeskind
Haven't got it, won't get it!
You are right! It's better to be bad and have a full stomach.
Father says, you're worse than hunger.
Oh, this mission is made for me!
This is no opponent for a trained magician!
A farmer has asked me to find a band of brigands who frequently robbed him. He wants me to deal with them and return his gold to him.
Repeat after me:"Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers."
If I cheat my customers at the market and anyone notices, then I'll surely be punished.

Kali, goddess of Evil.  She is the destroyer, the bringer of darkness.[insert symbol here]MythologyKali is the synonym for destruction and death. She is the impersonation of evil, the origin of all chaos. She doesn't tolerate any form of order, because order is a form of stability and stability means stagnation. Chaos is the only valid form of existence and darkness is the only answer to the weak.Kali is fighting an eternal battle against Lumen, the god of light and this battle is the great religious theme in Ancaria. But it's a battle which can not have a winner, for chaos can not exist without order and destruction is impossible without creation. Both deities are eternally bound together, depending on what they hate most. It's their fate to fight their very own counterpart, knowing that annihilating one means destroying the other.A tenacious theory amongst Ancarian mystics says, that Lumen and Kali are actually brother and sister, who are both trying to fight the other in an attempt to be unique.AppearanceKali is described as a woman of unnatural beauty, with red, shimmering hair. But her eyes are so cold and cruel, that just looking into them will drive any living being into insanity. In addition to her human shape, she's got a single horn, protruding from her forehead.Kali is usually dressed in many layers of cloth, seemingly loosely wrapped around her body.The CultAlthough Kali has a huge amount of followers behind her, most of her temples are shrines have been erected in more or less secret places. For obvious reasons, Kali is a feared deity amongst those who're not members of her church, and people tend to avoid any contact with the believers of Kali. Therefore, the church of Kali has to operate furtively in most parts of the world.Kali has quite a number of holy days during the Ancarian year. Most of them are celebrated with bloody, chaotic rituals, which usually include human sacrifices, torture and lots of blood. The exact reasons behind all those feasts are written down in the secret sacred books, the “Codex Kali”. Only the high priests of Kali have access to those books.The symbol of the church of Kali is a broken chain link, which represents breaking the boundaries of order and the destruction of stability.Opponents and SupportersKali is the arch enemy of Lumen, the god of light. These two are fighting an eternal battle against each other.

Our mission to protect this world was on the verge of failing. In an act of desperation, we sacrificed three of our sisters and used primitive Elven magic to create an object which we intended to use to bring the sisters back. The plan worked and we were able to win the war. We also realized however, that this object was too powerful to be left in the hands of one single person. we divided it into three parts, but the bearers of these parts were discovered and in the course of time the objects were lost.

You brought these three relics back to us today. Relics that should no longer be permitted to exist in this world. We will return the relics to their original form, so that they lose their power forever. There is only one place we can do this - the hub. I'm sorry. I don't know what came over me! I'm really very sorry. Let's go to my sister, I would like to comfort her. She lives in the capital city, which is a fair way off from here.
I did it, I got the map! Now I have to get out of here and deliver it.
I'm not interested in these pathetic humans either, but I accept anyway.
I don't care - Ker isn't going to answer these sissies' prayers anyway.
It sounds like a worthy enemy!
Actually, me too, but Ker thinks it's great to be worshipped.
Well, I don't really think that Ker wants to listen to their whining.
Looks like your adventure was pretty short, my friend.

That's what I expected. Shirka hates me. She ran away before I could explain everything to her. Well maybe there's nothing to explain. But Semil!? I know that name. I'm going to go to the monastery to have a look at the archive. He might even still be alive.
Honorary member ... hm ... Will I get a certificate or something like that?
It is your decision. But don't come running and crying when the monsters rip your head off...
Without his thugs good old Nathim was an extremely helpful and cooperative fellow. He gave me a pouch of gold as compensation for the boat he destroyed.
We must hurry or the Lord of Hell will discover our plan!
Come, Mister tally man, tally me banana...
Zere you are. And zere are my 'erbs! Let me 'ug you. Non, not you, ze 'erbs! 'ere is your reward. Everyone shall know how generous ze famous Paul Brotheuse can be!
The racketeers were already waiting at the clearing. I've killed all except their leader. Maybe he can tell me something.
The trader has given me some gold in return for slipping Zizhar the lotion. I’m not supposed to tell him where I got the lotion of course.
Gelminy is studying the old script now.
Which Orc was sleeping on the job? We're being attacked!

Narmuel's head? By the Mistress of Light and the Creator! I never thought I would live to see the day! I will examine it right away. A really interesting object. Thank you!
And now return to Mara. Sophia will be waiting for you.
I have received my reward, unfortunately the poor man was struck down by lightning. You reap what you sow.
Aurora thanked me for my help. She even gave me an object that she says is valuable.
The inhabitants don't look very happy. Comes as no surprise here in hicksville.
Well that's done - the gang has been put out of action. Now I'm going to have a few words with Shirka!

The strip mine is polluting the air! Go and shut it down!

I'm Dranaigh, the Priestess of this village. Foreigners are rarely seen these days, except for the Elves living here on the shore. They are permitted to live here by the Queen's decree, to fight back repeated naval invasions from the Wastelands. Many Dryads are not happy about them, saying their farming, mining and tree cutting is destroying the land. Still, they are doing their job.
So, you wish to enter the land of the Dryads? My tribe is suspicious of strangers so will not allow anyone unproven into the interior. Perhaps you could start to earn their trust by shutting down the strip mine. It belches smoke into the sky, day and night, poisoning the clean air of the island. You can find the mine in the west; just look for the smoke to show the way.
The wolves have been defeated, now I should look for the little girl's village.
An unfinished statue or a complete waste of marble.
Hey, woman from wood! Help must you! Mother Earth commands. We kill cows and pour blood in water!
Wearing your helmet around the wrong way is the latest craze among the young folk.
It was a relief to hear your wise words.
Thank you, you can count on me!
Indeed! He has been banned, now I have to order him to follow me.
You're pretty full of yourself, aren't you? Just know it might come back one day ...
Steal from a priestess - that's just my sort of thing!
Ok you miserable cut-throat - I will fix you up with the potion.
What I'd prefer to do? Wring your neck. But that doesn't seem to be an option. So I'll just get you that magic potion!
This fighting is getting a little monotonous - I'll take the potion!
I guess I have no choice.
So this is the blood lake. What an eerie place!
Every little helps but these creatures here are TOO small. Attacking them would be against nature.
This job stinks when it rains.
Ha-ha, I'm the barbarian..ahh. Ha-ha I'm the gladiator, ha-ha I'm the Undead Centurion..no...Ah! Now I've got it! Ha-ha I'm the Shadow Warrior!
I'm impressed! You are indeed as good as they say you are. Good work.
No one will take this away from me ... ever.
Why are they.. I... I mean: How did you do that? No, it's not what you think. I only... the children are eating me out of house and home! Go away! Leave me alone!

Get me Karra'Kh's head!

Have you heard? I put a bounty on that little tadpole Karra'Kh. He was always breaking the cult's rules, and that is going to stop now. You should hurry if you want a chance at the reward. An entire band of hunters has even come from far off lands to try and earn my money. Bring me that traitor's head!
By the Gods, fight, you washouts!
If you fought because of your beliefs, there would possibly be some hope for you!
Balance is necessary, there can't only be heroes!
Any Hero reaching difficulty level Niob.
Sadly, the ogre died. That wasn't a happy ending, even for an ogre.
I know, sometimes it's a valid tactic to just wait for your opponent to die of old age. But trust me, it doesn't work here. Go and kill the buggers.
Press <$ID_CUI_DPAD_MARK_UP_INSERT> to execute your hero's Divine Gift.
One day, Alexander will understand that I did him a favor. One day...
Be wary! There are plenty of brigands hereabouts! It’s not even safe to walk down the road these days... Things were different in the old days.

Collect 100 gold coins from these useless vermin!

Never do business with the poor, it will only bring you trouble! They spend all the gold, and then come up with the saddest stories when it's time to repay it and my modest 20 percent interest. As if I care if they have clothes for the winter, or they have to sell their children into slavery. You go and collect the 100 gold coins that they owe me!
I just want to get out of here...
Running away would be pointless, right?
Please move on. I really don't feel well.
I received a Scroll of Release from the healer. Now I must take it to the dying girl.
Time for changing of the guard!
Elves...My hatred for them increases with every idle minute.
And that! And THAT! AND THAT!

Who's that you're bringing us? A Human? There are enough foreigners on this island as it is, and now the Humans are coming to our camp too?
Stranded with his entire clan and they're peaceful you say? Are you aware of the fact that this Human has the dangerous jungle fever? You get it from eating the wrong plants. It must be treated immediately or this Human will die. A shaman has to make the antidote otherwise all the settlers are doomed. Since there are Blood Dryads everywhere, you must go with the shaman and protect her!
What are you waiting for? Bring me their heads!
No perfume can hide the stench of your corruption!
The spirits that I called upon...
Yes I know, it's only Orc beer. But it's still beer and the Dragons won't mind. So please go.
You sure are making a funny face!
When I grow up, I will probably be more evil than you.
Thank you and good luck with the upcoming elections!
Chance to Reflect Close Combat Damage

Thank you for your help.
We will not eat it all at once - promise. Here is some for you as well, but be careful, it's bad for your teeth.
In some fights you're probably on the verge of death, aren't you?
I don't think anyone will go to the next war.
You have to work hard to be a good soldier, don't you?
Isn't it frightening how many lives are lost in some of these wars?
The war is only won when the last battle's fought, is that right?

Gravestone
Julia of Urthak
Once disowned by her uncle, now she is resting in foreign soil.

An Orc shaman tried a rain spell but it was a little too effective. Now it won't stop raining and he needs a counter spell to stop the rain. He needs the heart of a Troll shaman for the counter spell. If this works I'll eat my hat.
No one can defy Kybele's will!
Nice item...if you intend to sell it.
Warriors, come to me!  Move it, move it!
The commander died in a battle against the Pasha, now Badawi has no ruler until a new social climber claws his way to the top.
Come on, "leader!" Show us what you've got!
If I have to stand around much longer I am going to sprout roots - well, I guess I would do a fairly good impression of a Dryad.
Look at that, a mage... show some respect before the keepers of the faith!
You're an educated woman. You should know who deserves to rule.
Witch, convert to the true faith or die!
Your magic won't help you against Ker!
It's your choice, mage: join us or fall with the others.

Goodness, thirty robbers? No wonder they drank everything I had! That proves just how good my beer is. I have to go to the forest right away and make some more.

Thank you. Have a beer on the house and take this. Maybe go have a chat with our priest as well.
Your perfume smells like old tombs.
I think it's better to avoid you.
The dark path doesn't improve your beauty.
Yes, that's how I imagined it. Blood! Blood!
Hey, watch it with the blood, don't stain my dress!
Let me know before you pass out, so that I can step aside.
That's done. I guess I can take the order back to the tavern now.
Here we are, and there are the rest of the musicians! I should give them their instruments now so they can start the concert.

I’m supposed to make Pax’Ram a warrior by fighting with him against his clan's enemies. His father cannot give this assignment to an Orc, because as soon as someone finds out that Pax’Ram can’t stand the sight of blood, they won’t listen to the leader any longer.

Don’t come any closer, I’m warning you! I don’t want to hurt you, but I will if I have to. Stay away from those sculpture pieces, and don’t let me catch you speaking to Mr. Giles or I’ll give you a wallop you’ll not soon forget.
There must be a nest somewhere!
I've just been to see Mr. Herburger. He is having problems with the vermin in his garden.
That's nothing special - we're all plagued by those little beasts.
That's true, but the rat plague has hit him especially hard.
Well, I could sing you a song about that. There are hordes of them in my home.
Big ones? His are as big as dogs!
What?! He should speak to a Priest about it.
Yes, he really should! They have glowing red eyes, and look like something straight out of hell.
I'll be staying well away from his property in the future! Take care!
Even if I had food I wouldn't be able to eat it, because I'm terribly frightened.
Father says women like you are dangerous.
Mother says that if I keep being bad, I'll end up like you.
I have collected all the gold. Now I am supposed to deliver it.
The opponents in this region generally use weapons for poison based damage.
The list of warrior virtues is growing longer every day! Now we have to remove bone fragments from the forest! Isn't that ridiculous?
When I look back on the old days, courage was considered a warrior's greatest virtue. Today it's cleanliness and environmental awareness!
What do you think the greatest virtue one of the Goddess' warriors can have is? Isn't humility at the top of the list?
I think that a warrior's virtues are important. You can't be victorious without remaining faithful to the Goddess!
They say the Goddess only supports the virtuous. That is why I always try to remain dignified in battle.
How can Kybele ask us warriors to always be virtuous? In battle only victory counts!
I'm not really crazy about the virtues that are demanded of the warriors. Unless decapitation is also considered a virtue in itself!
Why can't they just let us fighters pursue our trade? No, instead of that we have to prove our virtue!
I'm an honorable fighter, don't you think? But the only things that matter to the Goddess are her own notions of virtue and a love of nature.
I'd really like to know why everyone talks about the virtues of a warrior? Ultimately, we're sacrificing our lives for the people!
A wannabe-soldier tried to keep me from entering the camp. With his fighting skills, he'd have been better off practicing a speech to keep people away.

Love truth, and pardon error.

- Voltaire
Do you plan to be famous someday?
To be a noble and good person? Disgusting!
How nice! You look uglier than my father!
I should try and find the trail of the Seraphim and follow it.
A farmer asked me to take care of a strange Abbot who has apparently been up to no good at night in the cemetery. I have a pretty good idea who that is.
Even for someone like me, you're going too far!
The original evil must not win...
Thank you very much! I feel better already.
The only thing I have to offer vermin like you is a quick merciful death!
A Priest! I have an important question for you.
Even your Human presence cannot disturb my divine equanimity. What do you wish to know?
Some of my friends plan to build a tower high enough to reach our God, then to sever the chains that hold us in poverty. Is this a wise idea?
This story sounds familiar - If only I knew where I have heard it before...
Do you think such an undertaking is doomed to failure?
It is bound to fail simply because your Human God clearly does not exist!
So you may think Elven Lord, and yet I still fear the fury of God.
My time is too precious to waste on such nonsense.
I have found the poachers. Now that I have their heads, I can deliver them to Brombar.
This drought gets worse with every passing day! I ask myself why the heavens frown on us!
I wish I knew the answer to that! Our fields are like dust bowls. All the green leaves have withered and died.
It was different in the old days. The land was fertile back then.
That's what they say. They also say that the land of milk and honey lies on the other side of the Elven Wall.
Yes, but I've never heard of anyone ever returning from the other side.
Neither have I. We just have to withstand it, and try to persevere.
Yes, this is our fate. We'll have to continue our fight for survival - day in and day out.
Oh, but it can be such a soul-destroying struggle some days.
You're here? I just saw you in the underworld!
You look like a real Elf's ugly cousin!
An Elf is still an Elf, no matter what she calls herself!
They say you fell from a tree?
You look like a Forest Elf to me...
Dryads, High Elves, whatever! Death awaits you!
The boy wants another bucket of water. I feel like a water carrier!

When I found out how my grandfather does business, I wanted to go to the commandant's office right away to tell them everything. My uncle wouldn't let me, he threatened terrible things if I betrayed the family. Finally he dragged me here.
Please take me to the next village.
Just as I expected,  the novice’s father was not particularly pleased to receive the letter.

When I watch over the sleeping, dreams come true...
When dawn draws near, my bed begins to call out to me.
This job is a piece of cake on clear and starry nights.
Sometimes the dark night can be so frightening.
I like being outside at night.
I protect law and order for the citizens of the town.
The meadows are shrouded in a mysterious fog.
A thick coat keeps me warm at night.
Night is for work and day is for rest.
Now that I have finished my work I can take a look around the gardens.
What's concerns me even more is that the young are prone to blasphemous utterances that will anger Kybele, you know what I mean?
Kybele called to me recently, she believes that many of our children blaspheme her for no reason! What do you think about that?
What are we to do with those who constantly blaspheme our wonderful, praise worthy Goddess? I think they should be horribly punished for their blasphemies!
A terribly bad habit is taking hold here! The great Goddess has seldom been laughed at as often as she is nowadays, do you see it too?
How do we deal with the bawdy people among our children, who insist on performing mischievous deeds in the name of the Goddess?
The Goddess seems to be angry with us! She informed me in a vision that some of the people deny her name and ridicule her!
Disbelief seems to be noticeably increasing among our children! Maybe we should impose the death penalty on blasphemy, what do you think?
I'm reluctantly merciful with those who continue to renounce the Goddess' name! What do you think of crucifixions?
I have a hard time accepting that some of the children still misuse the Goddess' name. What about you?
The Goddess' name must never be dragged through the mud! Never! Doubters should be put to death.
The Inquisition turns against the Maker!
You can't even be used as fertiliser!
I’m sure he can shed some light on the truth.
I am supposed to accompany Dr. Faust to Mephisto.

You there! What did you talk to Mechthild about? Did you tell her about the gold? I'm sure that is the reason why she wants to call off the wedding. How does that make me look? Like I'm the village idiot's assistant!
I demand statusf... shatisfa... I want revenge! And when I'm done with you I'm going to give Mechthild a good beating!
Then I will restore our honor.
Be careful! I need living specimens.

It says on the treasure map: Propperti of highwai banditt Winnhard.

The treasure map seems to point to a nearby pond . It says “pondd” right here. I could have a look, but I'm not expecting much from a bandit who couldn't even spell his own name.
This item cannot be used yet.
The farmer's wife must have already suspected something. She is very calm about her husband's death.
Who are you? Take your fingers off me, I'm coming with you.
Now tell me: How do you like being dead?
Now we have to go and visit the location where he was cursed and take the prince along.
It goes for this village too, woe betide those who harbor heretic ideas!

Ask the commander of the northern camp about the outlaws!

Pardon me, but did I just see Shirka Alana? The leader of that group of outlaws that everyone is looking for? I'm sure it was her! The commander of the northern camp has dealt with this group on more than one occasion. If you want to know anything about them, ask him.
I am content when the houses of enemies are burning.
Militant? Of course we are militant!
During the last battle, I had to safeguard the supply line.
In the last skirmish, I didn't eat or drink for two days.
I am going to fight to defend my people.
I have good vision. I can see just as well at night as I can during the day.
Either we are victorious, or we pay with our lives.
Sadly, a few good comrades were killed in the last battle.

Find my daughter and rescue her!

I need your help, my friend. I don’t know who else I can turn to. I‘ve made a mess of things. I know that soldiers aren’t allowed to gamble, but I was a having a run of good luck at dice, so I bet all of my wages.

Then all of a sudden, lady luck deserted me. I had to borrow money, and I couldn’t pay it back. So that old crook of a usurer, Damial, took my daughter Claressa as collateral. Now I have the money, but my daughter is gone. I’m afraid that Damial has sold her into slavery.

Help an old friend and save my daughter! If I take care of this matter myself, my superiors will find out that I was gambling, and I will be dishonorably discharged.
Thank you for escorting us, we're safe now. This is for your services, be seeing you!
You can run, but you cannot hide!
More opponents, I have a five-year-plan to fulfill!

The Master is dead
I failed to keep his skin safe!
The world is so cruel!
I'll read you the riot act.
The beast did indeed exist and it was not easy to defeat. It was a great fight!
Actually, we could be partners... But I don't like to share!

There's something about the outside of a horse that's good for the inside of a man! That's nonsense, I tell you! Riding only makes your backside hurt. Selling it is the best thing a man can do with a horse.
Well, everybody! That's ... that's really touching.
Dear Gods! What have I done to deserve ... I mean ... Good to see you!
I certainly did not expect to see you here. But, well, the more sword arms there are on my side the better.
Well, okay. The more swords the better.
Maybe I should start collecting toad heads, too ...

You've brought the excavation supervisor! I feared the worst when I heard about the ambush. Thank you for saving the excavation site. Let me give you this ancient object as a reward. It belonged to an ancestor of Fahid ben Sahid. It will bring you luck.

Mark Intelman
Why am I the only normal human being on this planet?!
Sports Can Be Hazardous to Your Health
It seems like the Djinn wants to take out his newfound freedom on me. I should teach him some manners.
I've collected all five herbs. They smell really good. I should take them to the Priestess now.
I would rather accompany you, but if you insist...
They are Koremar and Lienna's children! Don't worry, I'll take them safely back to their parents. Thank you very much!
This world will not miss you.
Ker won't protect you from me.
Cowardice seems to be part of your strategy, Inquisitor.
Without the cogwheel, no diving bell.
Tree-Elves are just as bad as the others!
First of all, you should dress yourself decently, Dryad!
We like to see Dryads around here - dead ones, that is.
Hey, mummy, where are your burial objects?
Your face looks quite pale, zombie ...
You should have stayed in your hole ...
Now I'll ice you ... since you're already cold ...
In the past you might have been my kind of guy, but lately you let yourself go ...
Slave Trader Innohep has asked me to pick up a new shipment of gladiators. He will pay me well for this task.
She's like the blossom of a desert flower, beautiful with a pleasant smell.

What was Sophia thinking when she sent me into the world? It's always been quite nice with the Seraphim. Okay, sometimes it's been kinda boring. But basically, it's been ... Well, as I said, quite nice. At least better than just standing around gaping.
You do have all the shackles, but there's no blood on them. My hunters told me what you did. One of them would like to talk to you. Why don't you go to him?

Kill the Minotaurs!

Greetings traveler! Do you have time to listen to an old man's problems? You see some bad things have been happening. Some of my servants wanted to go look at a nearby cave as a sort of dare, but none of them came back. A real live Minotaur has been spotted around here, I think the beasts live in the cave. You look like you know how to take care of yourself, so it probably wouldn't be a big deal for you to pay a visit to the cave and clean it out. You will be well-paid!

Guardian of Souls
If the world should blow itself up, the last audible voice would be that of an expert saying it can't be done.
- Sir Peter Ustinov
So this is the realm of the Dream Vampire. It looks a little strange.
Not bad ... not bad at all.
I will rebuild the business house. What do you think of a Fair Trade Center?
Unfortunately, I haven't been feeling at all well recently.
Well then, I hope you get better soon.
The Priests have given me some elixirs to put me back on my feet again.
I thank the Gods, my friend. What caused your unfortunate illness?
My Orc casserole on golden spinach wasn't quite the freshest...
Yes, not all of the Orc meat on the market is as fresh as one would hope. Orcs go bad quite quickly.
It taught me a lesson, that is certain.
Well then - may your day be untroubled, and I pray that you recover soon my friend.

Only the dead have seen the end of war.

Praying to Kuan also honors the dead. I should worship this God.

Winning a battle is no proof of heroism, enduring defeat is.

There's much wisdom to your words. I will worship Kuan.

Just as earthquakes cannot be stopped, wars cannot be won.

That's very deep. Thank you. I'll visit the Temple more often from now on.

He who wants to guard the peace has to be prepared for war.

I've never thought about that. Thank you.

The biggest lies are told before an election, during war, and after the hunt.

Your words have moved me. I will worship Kuan.
Did you wait 'til the Troll teeth fell out? The leader of the Ore-Thag Clan will not fall over that easily, I assure you. Kill him!
Oh? We go back, but not love? No, stay outcast with love!

Keeper of the Temple
It is in vain to expect our prayers to be heard, if we do not strive as well as pray.
- Aesop
I agree - any attempt at resistance is futile...
I'll tell you one thing: Be careful! We are watching you!
Ha ha! Who are you trying to scare? The pigs and the chickens?

The Orcs call their brutal sport "Nargutz." Apparently the aim of the game is to carry a Troll skull into the opposing team's end zone. How you accomplish that is up to you. The local derby match between Entruag and Tharak is scheduled to begin soon, but some Trolls have set up camp in the kick-off zone. If they're not removed the match will have to be canceled. Beni Keisar the Orc has asked me to kill the Trolls and bring back one of their heads - just in case the Orcs need an extra ball for the game.
I think it would be better if I didn't ask you for alms...
You see - I was once just like you!
Humph! Keep going! At least begging is an honest trade!
The armorer was very satisfied with the metal and has paid me well.
I’m sure Hassl’toh got home safely.
I don't want to think about what will happen if you don't find the amulet.
I was unable to protect Rinarn. He is dead. I should inform Lieutenant Niran.
A town! I can't stand towns, but after all the country air, it's still a nice change.
These six furs are almost an entire month's earnings for me. If only I had them already...
Attention. Armed objects within range of sensors.
Are you hungry? We have some fish left over from last Monday...
One word of advice: Chop off the head first, and ask questions later.
Many thanks for your help! I think Perhaps I should stay in town for a while. A thousand thanks, my friend!
The air's going to get thin down there pretty soon!
In the end, they get everybody ...
Who'll take care of my son ...?
I know where you've parked your car, player!
What? I need enemies, not victims!
Hurry we have to tell the Baron.
I beat things like that by the dozen...
Back into the grave with you!

You made it! Good! Spiders deserve to die! Every last one of them!
Here. Take this rat. It’s a nice fat one.
I found the dealer's toy, it looks like a little boy. I will return it to its “father.”
Get ready to face the God of jellyfish!
Look, guys! An ostrich in armor!
We'll take care of the chick with wings!
Do you have really bad lighting in your bathroom, or did you do that to your face on purpose?

The kennels are actually pantries, where the Humans and Lizardmen? are penned up as living meat supply for the Dragon. I set them free and talked to one of the Humans. He said there’s a group of rebels trying to save the people in the breeding pens, to keep them from becoming Dragon chow. Their leader is a man called “Blackhammer”. I should go talk to him.
Repent, before I fell you like a tree!

Gravestone
If you ask me anything I don't know, I'm not going to answer.
I have collected enough heads. Chuck Latbar will give me my reward.
I have to slay some jumping-plants. That’s not very hard for the first part of the job, but what’s it good for?
And just where do you buy your shoes?
Sometimes there are subversive elements around here.
It is not pleasant to spend every day in a smoky, stuffy atmosphere.
Today we are serving a pork roast with corn cakes.
I'm on top of my game today.
I now serve Fairy Gold wine for our female guests.
He's dead and both he and the sword were absorbed by hell. The Seraphim is dead as well. I think that takes care of the undead problem.
By Forens! I should deliver more sermons about the meaning of life.
Good. That wasn't too difficult now, was it?
I glad that you found my arguments so convincing.
I knew that my arguments would convince you.
It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
It was a pleasure doing business with you guys.

You want to help me once more? Great!

The wolves must have found shelter nearby, or they wouldn't attack this often. Please chase them away, while I tend to my wounds. I didn't quite make it through the last fight unharmed.
The list shows that those who fell were from my unit, but I still need the soldiers' dog tags.
How is one supposed to work in this filth?
Mashed potatoes with poached eggs. That tastes good and provides energy.
Only the grits hear my groaning.
In my profession it isn't easy, thanks be to the Gods, to starve to death.
Shepherd's pie is being served today.

What drama! Lappsess, the innkeeper, has run out of lukewarm lumpy swill. He’s expecting more guests and he wants to serve slimy gobs and goo with traditional lumpy swill. He’s asked me to order a new barrel of swill from Fangor, the swill brewer. Now there's an Orc I can help!

Michel was reasonable in the end. I hope he stays that way.
The sword he gave me handles very well, and he said the blacksmith would be able to improve it even more. We'll see, maybe I'll be able to talk his master into doing just that by giving him a few gold pieces. At least he seems to feel inclined to take on orders again.

I hope Michel lives long enough to become a great blacksmith. He really seems to have what it takes.
Mark my words, this is but one battle won in a lost war!
