My poor Mathilda! Her restless ghost is still wandering through the ruins where she once took her own life. After fighting with her mother she saw no other way to proceed, so foolishly killed herself there. Now she can’t find any peace.
I've been looking for a way to bring her soul peace for a very long time, now I have finally found a way but I'm much too old to help her with it. Will you help me? There is a rose of oblivion growing in a secluded cave not far from here. It is said that the scent of this rose is able to release a ghost. Would you search for this rose and take it to Mathilda?
All the mutants have been destroyed. I'm being pulled back.
I am not yet able to use this piece of equipment.

Hurry to the main camp and warn the commander she’s about to be attacked!

My spies tell me the nobles are planning to attack our headquarters. If they’re right, the attack will come from the south. Get over there and warn the commander. You have my leave to depart!
In the name of the Gods, what's that?
Watch out, in front of us!
I am supposed to kill the shylock.

Obtain rare blue orchids

I have an assignment for you. A breeder of rare orchids wants to get his hands on one of the rare blue orchids. Coincidentally, I learned that an experienced huntress owns one of these rare blue orchids. I would like you to go out in search of the orchids. Find the place where they grow, or get them from the Huntress. Are you interested?
Ah! The Pilgrim is really a statue? No wonder I've never seen him before.
That was most likely the pack leader and puts an end to this task. Now I just have to bring Busta the head.
I will help you, but you have to kill the Carnach first.
My parent’s house is near Sethiaz.

What has happened? Where is my husband? You were attacked by T-Energy creatures? He died a heroic death in a desperate battle? He saved your life by knocking you out so that the creatures would believe you were dead? Oh yes that sounds like my brave-hearted Lathor! Oh what will I do without him, what a terrible calamity!
You have to be more patient with the plants, child of the Goddess! They need care and shelter just like us.
Don't be so impatient! With love, nurturing and a little help from mother nature, everything will grow as it should.
Don't worry, dear child! If you speak with your plants openly and honestly then everything will turn out as it should.
We are often too impatient with our plant brothers and sisters, understand? These things need time!
Give the plants as much time as they need! They feel your impatience and will turn against you!
Listen to my advice: The plants will only do what you want once they can sense your faith.
You simply have to make it clear to your plants that you aren't trying to pressure them. They can tell.
Plants are the Goddess' creatures just like you and me! Show them some respect, they love that!
Don't underestimate the holiness in Kybele's plants! They know whether or not you believe!
Only those who truly love Kybele can command her plants! I am happy to give you this piece of advice.
I will soon be surrounded by my ancestors...
No! It's not supposed to end this way!
That last hit was a dirty one...
A small seaport in Dyr-Lain. Ships can anchor here safely, protected by an offshore island.
Those who get too big for their britches will be exposed in the end.
I'll tie your tentacles into a knot, filthy beast!

Mahmud sent you? As you can see, I'm making progress. Well yes, you're right. Of course you can't make water from sand, that's nonsense! I never tried to build the machine, I just wanted to have the gold.

Here's the deal: I give you a lot of gold, and you let me go. I'll take a ship at once. You'll never see me again.
I see! A secret tunnel. That sounds exciting.
*sighing* I'll go to the realm of the Humans...If it is really necessary.
I am supposed to deal with Humans? *sighs* Alright.
Looking for Elves in the Humans' land. What a strange assignment for a Seraphim.
Secret tunnel? Right from the start, this mission is taking me six feet under!
All this sounds very complex. I will be up to the task.
Look up at the sky. I don't think it will rain any time soon.
Did you notice that nature seems to bloom late this year?
Have you ever seen ball lightning?
Didn't it seem like the stormy winds last week were strong enough to carry a person away?
This pleasant weather can lift the spirits greatly, can't it?
The potions are for one of my best customers and he doesn't like to wait. Bring me the scorpion’s tails as quickly as you can, alright?
The Gods of my enemy are stronger than mine!
Didn't we destroy all of your kind around here?
Where do you come from, Guardian?
You're a much appreciated challenge, Temple Guardian!
Why do you fight for the good?
Your path will lead you to death!
The dark is the warrior's path!
Look into my heart and see the darkness!

Deliver a small bag to Senator Lilath

You have proven that you are trustworthy and I would like to acknowledge that with another, rather delicate, assignment.
The governing law here forbids anyone but volunteers and dangerous criminals from fighting in the arena. The new gladiators didn't actually volunteer to come here, but it's a little easier to get those papers than ones that state they're all dangerous criminals. Senator Lilath takes care of such matters for me. Go to him and give him this little bag, then he will be happy to issue the papers.
It will all be over soon, you poor wretched soul!
Begone, demon! You can't hurt me!
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Celestial Magic and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
This hissing accent is funny. Say sea tongues in sesame sauce!

Bring me ten spider silk bags!

Thank you! That was a long journey. Walking certainly is hungry work, isn't it? What I’d like now is a nice big bowl of muck soup! I have everything we need, except for the spider silk bags. The soup tastes so plain without them. Would you gather a few bags for me? Ten bags should be enough for two people. I will give you three more magic potions in return.
I can't sleep anymore, because I'm so worried.
You seem heavy-hearted, like everyone else here.
Do you think that one is allowed to dream only occasionally?
My Gods - These strangers are everywhere!
When I hear your complaints it sounds like you don't want to be a fighter. But everyone admires you!

The Lizardman was defeated by the selector! Now let's get to the highlight of today's performance.
A woman of unknown origin and past, quick and as silent as a jungle cat, as underhanded as a harpy and as deadly as a scorpion. Ladies and gentlemen, I give you the Blood Sister!
Wackar fainted. His father wasn't exaggerating, I'm dealing with a pretty big wimp here.
I've collected the required amount of desert weed. Now I'll take it to TyBosso.
You’re not having second thoughts are you? They’re only wretched Goblins!
Damn! The shaman is dead! I suppose his destiny lay with the olms.
You look like a worm to me!
When a clock is hungry it goes back four seconds.

Keeper of the Shrine
Civilization degrades the many to exalt the few.

- Alcott
She was so happy when she saw her little girl was alive.
“T-Energy! Putting the thunder in the Thunder Gurgler!” That's a great slogan, don't you think?
Don't stand in my shadow, amphibian!
An ocean of yellow and gold.

Thank you! Thank you so much! Yes, this helmet is perfect. Can't hold as much as the bucket, either. Good for my spinal disks. Every time I carried the full bucket, my back began to ache.

What? A mop handle? No, I didn't take it. Don't know where it is. Maybe the combo master knows something.

Have you heard? Blind Guardian are playing a concert around here. My aunt is going, but I'm not allowed to. Mom always says that I can listen to that kind of music when she´s six feet under. What does that mean?

I came across a zombie. The note pinned to his chest read: “Harmless! Please bring me back to the chicken farm!”
The poor guy probably has one too many worms in his head, but he looks like a soldier. He's probably from some home for veterans. I'm going to try and take him back there.

Seek out the Mad Mage who Abducted the Girl!

We are having serious issues with a local mage. We never saw much of him other than when he came to town to buy more candles and paper. Recently he hasn't been seen at all; instead, strange incidents have become commonplace. A hunter told me that several cows and sheep have gone missing. When a little girl vanished yesterday we decided that something must be done! Unfortunately none of our weapons would be effective against a mage, nor do we have any defenses against his magic. Please seek out the mage at his residence and solve the problem for us. You will find his home beyond the bridge, when you follow the road east and then turn north at the junction.
The Gods have decided in favor of the High Elves!
Well then, you overgrown lump of potter's clay, I'm ready!
You have to do what you have to do...
Unfortunately your prayers don't put food on our empty plates.
You want to talk to me about a universal cosmic power that's all around us?
I just want to know one thing: Will your prayers feed us?
I don't feel like confessing my sins right now, I'd rather eat something.
My stomach's growling so loud I can hardly focus on my faith.
So where are your Gods in our hour of need? Tell me!
Are the Gods really testing us, or are they just playing a cruel game?
Your Gods are letting me starve to death, so they're not mine anymore.
Your exalted Gods seem to have forgotten me, if they exist at all.
Damn your prayers! I can feel the Gods laughing at me.
Unable to connect to wireless ad hoc network.
The challenge here is too great for me.
As a High Elf I am certainly superior, but this is a little too much even for me.
You can only challenge weaklings, eh?
You are nothing but a dimwitted thug.
There! Furia feels much better. She wants to rest for a bit and then return to her sisters. I think I can leave her alone now.

I heard that you have a little problem. Well I can sympathize with you. It's true, I haven't always led a life of complete abstinence, if you know what I mean. At least I was smart enough to never get caught. But I don't judge. I'll take it to my grave for a mere 5000 gold pieces! WHAT? You wouldn't attack a man of the cloth... AARGH!
Ahhh HA! Thought so! Milrinda must have made a small mistake. Well well! I will believe it was just an honest mistake and not intent. Good thing I noticed it! Thanks for your help.
What awesome remarks do you have in store for me today?
Folklore says that Elves have green blood. We can test the belief!
Elves - the most degenerate creatures in all of Ancaria.
Usually I have scruples about killing creatures. However, I'll make an exception for Elves.

I met the commander of Badawi today. Up until now I've only heard that he is crooked to the core, but he's in charge and no one here has had the guts to stand up to him. Now a High Elf agent has gathered some information about him and is on his was to Tyr Lysia with it. My task is simple: the information is not allowed to reach its destination, and there can be no witnesses.
Go on then! Off you go! That potion won't keep long.

Where's the furze essence? What?

Sorry, I'm in the middle of conducting an important experiment. Great project. Could kill off athlete's foot forever.
Why should I care about the river and some fish? This is more important. You're pestering me.

Servant! Get rid of this nuisance!

The old Dragon gave me instructions on how to cleanse my blade. I'm supposed to collect 10 undead hearts, as well as find 10 swamp herbs and a Rose of the Wind. I'm supposed to burn these substances in a fire and cleanse my blade in the flames. I also have to speak with the dead. Let's see if they have anything to say to me.
Thank you! The city is safe now!
I require better protection against cold-based damage.
The kobolds are right to the north of here, you can't miss them. Please go and see if you can retrieve my fathers bow.
Victory! We have penetrated through the Kobolds' siege!
The peace of the Seraphim has arrived in this region.
Only fools duel. But I have no choice. It's the only way to help Lady Eldredar.
Please hurry. We need the pelts right away.
Robbing a living thing of it's freedom - that contradicts the will of nature!
I merely did what had to be done. Now make the most of it.
Thank you, thank you very much. I'm happy that I was able to help you.
A warrior can show greatness through mercy. You are a great warrior!
That's exactly what I'm here for.
Customer satisfaction is my highest priority.
This location is devoted to Kybele.

Anyone who dares to insult us deserves to die. Make the Orcs pay for their insolence!

You are the new warrior! They told me about you.
You can find the Orcs who insulted our Clan to the north. Go and make them pay for their audacity! May the sword be with you!
Come here little witch, and let me beat you to death!
Your magic is no match for the skilled blade of an Ogre!
You Elves are getting a little too mouthy!
I'm going to kill you with my bare hands, Elf!
The Lizardmen weren't pleased at all about the cult's propaganda. I hope the map is worth all this trouble.
Thanks, how very kind of you.
OK. By the way: your deodorant is failing.
I’ll hand Eddie over to the Town Guard.
The guard didn't know what the symbol on the necklace meant either. I should inquire at the Chronicler's in the capital city.
The activation server is unable to complete your request. Please contact the software vendor.
Who are you trying to scare?
The undead have to be disintegrated.
That went well again. We've reached the meeting place.
If I have to lose, then I'll at least keep you from getting the kill for your stats!
I won't allow you to defeat me!
Very good! A real humdinger! Just look at those antlers! They'll look great above the fireplace. The rest of the carcass can just rot here. It'll make the bugs and worms happy. Hehe!
What? Kill me? How... but... well, you're not getting me without a fight!
We will not be oppressed any longer, Elf!
The dungeon is waiting for you, Elf!
White candles symbolize purity, blue ones power.
Never underestimate the power of words. A curse is quickly spoken and lasts for a long time.
Work faster? Those blue bloods probably think I can conjure miracles...
Toad's skin and bat wings? Only Humans and charlatans use things like that for their potions.
I mix elixirs that would make even a Troll see visions.
A protective circle against the dark powers! If you are in the center of it, you can count yourself lucky.
It's easier to conjure dragons, than to teach Humans a good work ethic.
Mountain crystals protect our guards against evil energy.
Then let's go! The evening ritual is waiting to be prepared.

I wasn't able to get a decision making potion from the Import Trader but he gave me a substitute potion. It might have the same effect if the leader believes it will help. Let's see if Hawey is fooled by it.
I can't do ANYTHING with this.
For a child, you have a very refined way of expressing yourself! Well, then, I will meet you at the capital.
The number of guards seems to indicate that the cult is trying its best to keep the shield up.
It is almost accomplished, Creator. Soon I will take the position belonging to me!

Take me to my dig.

Thanks for the water. My name is Geron. I came to the desert on an archaeological expedition, but I misjudged the harshness of the desert. My water supplies ran out fast. I'm still very weak. Could you accompany me to my camp? It's not far.

Destroy the evil ghosts!

Very well. We must not lose any more time. I can already sense the manifestation of the evil ghosts. They must be destroyed, the sonner, the better. Unfortunately, my feet don't carry me very well anymore. Comes with old age, you know. Would you go in my stead? Go and destroy them? With the help of the elixir it shouldn't be a problem for you.
I can't fight fire-resistant armor with this weapon.
Orcs are perfectly suited for a little practice!
The hunters have asked me to bring them ten boar pelts. Sounds like a solvable task.
The novice’s father was absolutely furious! He has written a letter and asked me to give it to his son. This is so much fun!

It was an honor to have fought at your side!
I feel an enormous sense of relief. A strange force is running through my bones...

The curse has been broken. Our bodies will turn to dust now and our souls will finally be free...
Go to hell, you Kobold vermin!
A healer on the island hid himself in a barrel during the Thraconian attack. Now he reeks of rotten fish! He has asked me to gather some spume herbs so that he can treat his surviving patients.
Hey, player! You are aware of the fact that an idly running computer needs tons of energy, aren't you? Think about the ozone hole and return to the keyboard.
This is driving me crazy! She can't just have disappeared into thin air!
A small village at the borders of the known world.
I met a priest at an oasis who gave me some water. Now I can return.
Go ahead and wave your magic wand around. It won't help you!
Shsh, can't you see I'm trying to fish here?
Leave the world of the Orcs, Seraphim!
Lumen is the God of the weak!
Beware the power of Kuan, angel!
There are even more tasks for me! It’s my decision, do I want to continue on or stop here?

Kill ten Trolls and bring me their teeth

You are new to our Clan. They told me you were coming. The Trolls are tough. Many brave warriors fell. A real touchstone for your capabilities. Go, kill ten Trolls. Bring me their teeth as proof. I will make a trophy out of them.
The shepherd and his sheep have been saved.
A coldblooded attacker! In the truest sense of the word!
Natural fertilizer? If that goat does his business here one more time, I'm going to roast it!
My living conditions are cramped and oppressive.
I shall ask the shepherds for some more fertilizer.
I don't know how anything is supposed to grow in this soil anymore.
The locusts have destroyed almost everything.
So it was an alchemist who conducted strange experiments? I'm glad you could stop him before it was too late. The water's already looking cleaner. Thank you!
I spoke to my uncle Gernott. He'll do the conjunction with the help of two other magicians. All I need to do is stand at a specific place.
Your courage does you credit, Orc!
A shady looking character approached me with what he called a "lucrative business proposition." He says that if I follow him he'll explain everything to me in secret. It all sounds rather mysterious.
An elven settlement. Maybe they can use some help here.
In this region, I must be prepared for enemies that inflict ice damage.
The Inquisition will take care of this matter.
I did not kill enough Wargs. The leader of the pack has probably disappeared already.
Finally! And it's about time! I had to start making speeches to get the guests to drink less. Thank you very much. Here is your reward.
I love angels like you just about as much as a stomach-ache ...
Now let's trim your wings a little ...
Hello, Seraphim, aren't you a bit far from home?
Well, if you aren't an interesting specimen ...
Seems like you're glowing with ignorance, little angel ...
Finished! I did i, I mean WE did it! I’m a hero! Oh, so are you of course! Thank you for your help! I can do the rest alone.
Ah! I just remembered something I'd like to talk about.
Now I have to ask you something else that's important to me!
Then I have to ask you something else I've been thinking about.

I'm supposed to take the tunnel into the valley that the people here call Crag Rock. An old swordmaster by the name of Theminius apparently lives there, and he might be able to aid the villagers here with his gold.
After the elves come the twelv... - No, that one's old.
Accept it, you have no chance!
I've entered Gnarl's tastefully furnished cave. Amazing what you can do even with limited means.

Mario Endlich
I look at it without any emotions.
I can hear the sound of battle coming from the grave site. The cultists want to tear down graves belonging to a Lizardman family. I have to help the Lizardmen defend the graves.
If you have any questions just ask them. I'm willing to share my knowledge with you!
I command you back to the grave!
I don't need a weapon to fight Goblins!
I need better protection against damage caused by magic.
Tormentil and water clover boost fighting power.
I am an Orc, and I will die like an Orc!
Kuan, I am in your hands now!

You say that my wife sent you? Oh... my daughter? ...She is really alive and well??? I will be forever in your debt. Here, take it. It is not much, merely a sign of my gratitude. Nothing is too expensive when it comes to my daughter’s life.

So you're onto me eh? You did a good job putting it all together! That old crank who dares to call himself a mage hung on a few seconds too long, but never mind, I'm flexible. You're saving me the trouble of having to defeat you on the battle field. GUARDS! ATTACK!
The guard is also happy that this curse is finally broken.
The user has changed. Character selection will reset.
The gamer profile has changed. Character selection will reset.
There's the bag, and it's still intact! I'm going to take it to Timotan now.
At last the laborers can continue with their work. The loss of production almost ruined us.
A village. I guess that means that those little teasers are not far...
Ah! You’re back, with 20 bug carapaces as promised! Well done! Take this gold as your reward.
I listen, but rule not change. Will talk to outcast, if no more love other clan can return.
Just thinking about what he’s going to smear all over his body makes me feel positively ill, but if it helps.
The request for peace was denied. Now I have no other choice but to fight. Let's see what Karim has to say about this.
Don't worry, it's almost over. It could be worse, believe me.
I prefer to forge the weapons used on the battle field. That is my passion.
So the patrol is over, that wasn't so bad.
Simir thinks the negotiations are going well so far. He will remain at the village. He's given me my reward, so there's no reason for staying here longer.
How do you like the taste of that?
I did it! I found a way across the plates.
What do you want, mortal?!? I will destroy you! Like all the others who came here hoping to kill me!
A man lost his glasses. They seem to have fallen in the sewers. He wants me to find them because he's nearly blind without them.
Any Hero has sold 30 magic items.
I have to make sure that I won't end up as scrap-iron for these little . What was their name again?
Thank you for all your help. From now on, I'll take better care of my children.

... iiin! Beg your pardon! Follow the drawing to find Khormynth's refuge.

I feel so ... strange! My mouth is dry and I seem to have developed a tasted for moldy cookies with fresh maggots!

Oh, it's YOU! I vaguely remember, but I really don't know what got in me in Diaanja's refuge. The only explanation is evil magic. And now I'm paying the price. I won't be of much use to you anymore, I'm afraid. You must try to fight the evil that holds this forest in its claws on your own from now on.

I actually found the entrance to Khormynth's refuge, but it won't be easy to get there! Here, take these drawings. I found it among some old texts ... maybe it will be of some assistance.

I will go to the village now and begin my new life among my fellow cursed ones. Farewell!
Just when things were getting exciting...

Kill ursaron to restore equilibrium!

I'm worried! Really worried!
About the lupan population. If my notes are correct - and I don't doubt they are - the number of lupans in the area is too low. I am afraid the number of ursaron is responsible for it. We must reduce the number of ursaron so the lupan can recover. Would you be willing to go and kill some ursaron?
Very good, very good. That will teach them, or at least show the others that you can't just run away. That's just rude. Here's your gold.
The deer is dead. And I didn't even bring my hunting horn.
I must have been playing hooky when my comrades were being trained to use that equipment.

You brought back my nephew?! Thank the Gods that he's still alive! I’d nearly abandoned all hope.
You have some thread rush too, great! It's very good quality! Take this gold as your reward. My nephew will take the poor woman some medicine for her sick husband - won’t you, Adrien? But be more careful this time!

Thank you for saving me!
I am scout Turan. Look around you. These fellows aren’t real soldiers - they're nothing but nasty gallows birds who somehow managed to get uniforms and are now pretending to be soldiers of the count. For some reason they're trying to get all thread rush there is. Only the Gods know what they plan to do with it!

I think they watched me while I picked the herbs, and when I was done they captured me. They wanted to know if there’s more thread rush anywhere else.

I overheard them a few times, it sounds like there's a larger camp not far from here. If you want to put an end to their wrongdoings, you should go there too.
How lovely to see one of our brave warriors.
That's a sign, isn't it! Greetings, warrior.
It's good to have a courageous fighter in one's company.
A warrior! Oh, how I admire you.
I hope you're well, oh brave one. I really admire warriors like you.
We would be nothing without our warriors. A good day to you.
It's an honor to see someone who knows how to handle a weapon.
It's wonderful to meet a proud warrior like yourself. How are you?
I'm honored to meet a glorious warrior like you.
Are you well, brave defender of our people?
Oh, I'm so afraid of you ...
Do you think your size scares me?
This shortcut will save us a lot of walking.

My Papa always said that the monsters would come out of the cellar at night if I didn’t finish my dinner. I always eat everything on my plate so that the monsters don’t come out. My doll fell down the stairs and is laying down there in the dark somewhere. I’m too scared to fetch it, I'm sure there are monsters down there. Would you rescue my doll for me?
I found the alchemist and should now escort him back to Al Sadim.
Increases inflicted damage, critical hit chance and execution speed of the aspect Arrant Pyromancer. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.

The landlord has taken the fake milk. What an idiot! Now he wants garlic, but I don't think he knows what it sells for. He's given me so much money that I should make a nice profit should I buy something else instead, something he doesn't know...
Fine... have it your way. You’ll see. I... can’t stop it... AAARGH!
My brother found gold? That's good news indeed! Thank you, I'll apply for the mining rights at once. Here, take this as a reward for your efforts!

Save Christmas!

Stupid damned snow machine! How could it just break on me like this?
Hello big guy! You like Christmas, don't you? Everybody likes Christmas, so that must include you. But the stupid snow machine is broken! The lever made of wood from the Tree of Wonders broke off, right down the middle, in two halves! It got wet while I was covering everything here with snow. And if it doesn't start to snow soon, the Christmas Ogre won't come out of his cave and there won't be a Christmas. You have to get a branch from the Tree of Wonders and fix the machine, I've got too much on my plate right now.
But beware: The Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future guard the tree .They're not just going to let you chop a branch off the tree.
You have no health potions left. You can find them or purchase them from merchants.
I've defeated the guardian, too bad I had to kill it. The entrance to the pyramid is now clear.
Deep inside I guess we're all warriors. Greetings!
I'm happy that you're happy and I feel fine.
Good to see you. It's been a while.
I'd like to respectfully greet you in return.
Thank you for your kindness. I needed that.
I'm glad for the chance to listen to your words.
You make our people proud. You're always kind and brave.
Don't be shy. Under my armor I'm just like you.
You're very kind. Your words honor me more than you could imagine.

If I want to achieve anything I will have to talk to the Clan chiefs. My new brother-in-arms tells me that I will be allowed to speak to the leader of the Clan if I can prove my worth in battle. Trolls are attacking a village of the Clan in the west. Killing several of them will be sufficient proof of my abilities and reliability.

Worf Thornclaw
He wanted to be a singer but his father had different ideas. That way, he still had many fans and he was able to kill his critics without getting into trouble.
Is something sneaking around over there?
Well, if you are of that opinion, that would be necessary...
This mount is too strong for me.
Get the fallen soldier's dog tags.

Guardian of Souls
Words without actions are the assassins of idealism.

- Hoover
Once again, the clerics show their true faces!
Those robe wearers have lived long enough at our expense!
Somebody will hunt you down, Inquisitor!
I'm sorry, I don't know what came over me! I'm really very sorry. Come on, let's go to my sister.
Do it. I'm sure Blackhammer can use each helping hand.
I've gone deaf from hammering on metal for so many years? WHAT DID YOU SAY?
Blast it, my bellows has a hole!
I'll have to throw a little more coal on the fire.
I need a new fire poker.
A hammer and anvil on the family crest? Let me think about it...
People come to have something repaired, and I help them.
This heat! This heat will drive me mad!
The cook wants some new cast iron skillets.
End of a Journey - A New Journey Begins
See? It's been worth stopping by Omero's again. Now he wants me to get rid of Thendra's nephew, but first I'll collect my reward for killing the slaves. Business is business.
Creep - Opponents have to get closer to detect the Shadow Warrior while he is walking amongst them with Shadow Veil active.
Avoidance - Reduces the effects of incoming detrimental spells.
Nimble - Increases run speed while Shadow Veil is active.
Fade - Greatly reduces the detection radius while casting spells.
Sinister Pact - The effect of Shadow Veil is permanent rather than temporary.
Shadowmaster - Significantly reduces the cooldown of Shadow Veil.
You may count on my help.
The cultists have offered to give me a potion that will enable me to speak with the undead. I have to bring them 20 of the dog tags worn by the undead in exchange. It sounds like a fair deal to me.
I know it is not proper of me to address such a noble gentleman, but I can't help noticing the wonderful garments you always dress in, my Lord.
Er... no, it is of course quite improper. But if my attire pleases you so, then do go on...
You have the most refined taste, my Lord.
Not like that peasant over there, eh? An opossum has a better sense of colour, what?
That man there, my Lord? He is my husband. Alas, I had no say in the matter...
I understand...the laws of our society are hard, but not without cause...

Visit a runemaster to exchange runes that you have found but cannot or do not want to use for other runes that you can and do want to use.

Note
You will not find an infinite amount of runes so you should carefully consider which runes you wish to memorize. Collect runes of combat arts that you do not wish to use and exchange them at a runemaster.

Costs
The price for the exchange of runes depends on the number of runes on offer. The more runes you offer the runemaster, the less you will have to pay him.

Trolls

Searching the libraries of the empire for works about Trolls is usually futile. The general consensus states that there is nothing worth reporting about this species. They are too basic, their mind is too dumb. Trolls are huge, aggressive beings living in the Orc territories. Most scholars and adventurers agree that this is all there is to say about them.



Admittedly, Trolls are not the most intelligent creatures in Ancaria. The average vocabulary of a Troll comprises of approximately one hundred words - most of which are variations of the basic needs: eat, drink, fight, procreate. Trolls with the ability to produce complete sentences or solve simple arithmetical problems are few and far between. Still, some individuals stand out from the crowd. The best-known example of a gifted Troll is Trugzk from northern Artamark. He wrote no less than three novels - although short ones - in his lifetime and published them. However, some claim that these novels did not stem from his chisel and hammer but instead, from a mediocre Ogre author.

Trolls love to fight. They love to crush their opponents and to devour the dismembered body parts afterwards. Fighting gives the Trolls some kind of purpose in life. Other than that they are peace-loving, even gentle beings underneath. When Trolls are unable to fight - let's say in captivity - they become wistful, withdraw and die. In fact, Trolls never survive for longer than a few years in captivity while they can reach the age of 150 in freedom. Grotz, who used to live in the area around Orcish Byway for many years, was reputedly 184 years old when he was battered to death in a fight against brigands.



Similar to Ogres and Orcs, Trolls feed predominantly on meat. They are able to consume enormous amounts of meat at once and within a very short amount of time. Additionally, they eat pebbles and they will not refuse the odd rock or two either. Their teeth are perfectly adapted for this kind of diet. Troll teeth are amongst the hardest materials known to man.

Trolls boast an excellent sense of smell as opposed to their atrocious sense of vision. The short-sightedness of Trolls is proverbial and it is the subject of many jokes and metaphors.

Combat Arts
 Each character has three individual tactical orientations called aspects. Each aspect offers five special combat arts and these will represent a certain fighting technique.
Combat arts offer advantages during fights and they can be enhanced throughout the game with modifications.

Improving Combat Arts
Throughout the course of the game you will find runes. Each rune will raise the corresponding combat art by one level. Right click on the rune in your inventory in order to improve the combat art. If you don't find the runes you desire, you will be able to swap those you found when you visit a Runemaster.

Equipping Combat Arts
(
You can equip combat arts similarly to equipping weapons, by dragging them from the overview screen into a slot to the right of the compass. Another way to equip a combat art is to select a slot and then right click on the combat art you want to equip.

Executing Combat Arts
 (You must have a combat art equipped)
Right click on a target.

Recharging Combat Arts
 Every combat art (with the exception of buffs) requires regeneration time before it becomes available again. The "Focus" skills of the respective aspects will decrease that regeneration time, whereas reading runes, which increases the potency of combat arts, will increase the regeneration time.
Wearing armor has a detrimental effect on the regeneration time of combat arts; the heavier the armor, the more the regeneration time will increase.
Some combat arts have a predefined cooldown, which is added to the regeneration time. Only special modifications or bonuses are capable of shortening the cooldown.

Buffs

Buffs must be placed in the buff slots to the bottom right of your screen. You need to click on them if you want to activate them. They will remain active until you cancel them with another left click.
While a buff is active, the regeneration time of all other combat arts will generally be increased.

Modifications

If you raise the skills that are associated with an aspect (Focus and Lore) by distributing points to them, you will receive points to enhance the combat arts of this aspect. A bar will display how many points are required for the next modification point. The tooltip of that bar will explain further details.


Once you have unlocked a modification point, you can switch to the modification overview by clicking on the button next to the aspect.

Dryad Cooking

Of all living beings, the Dryads have the closest bond with nature. Their connection with the trees is of such closeness that they refuse to eat anything that does not live or grow in the woods. Although the range of food supply seems rather limited, Dryad cuisine is far from boring or repetitive. Over the centuries, the Dryads have developed their culinary art to perfection. Dryad cuisine is one of the most interesting cuisines of Ancaria with many nuances, different flavors and exotic recipes.

For Dryads, cooking is a collective and social activity. Since they are living in wooden tree houses, they usually do not have fireplaces inside the house. Instead, there are usually several safe fireplaces in the central areas of the villages, where all the cooking takes place. The Dryads prefer to cook in larger amounts and they are used to preparing their food in big cauldrons and huge pans. There are no exact recipes in Dryad cooking. Mostly it consists of the combination of certain basic ingredients and spices.

Meat plays an important role in the Dryad cuisine. There are many different kinds of animals living in the forests and most of them are edible. Amongst the variety of venison, there are deer, boars, small bears, but also fish, such as wild salmon and pike. The Dryads are hunters and they exclusively hunt and eat wild animals. You will never find domesticated animals in a Dryad dish.
Dryads traditionally do not grow plants. Instead, they reap what the forests have to offer and that is quite a lot. There are all kinds of fruit and berries available. In addition, there are many forms of wild vegetables, such as potatoes, rice and wheat.

The most unique element of Dryad cooking is the variety of spices and herbs. Dryads are using an amazing amount of different herbs and spices for their dishes. Some of them only grow in their homeland regions, some are not even recognized as useful in other parts of the world. The herb lore of the Dryads is unmatched in Ancaria and a skilled Dryad cook is able to create something unique even out of a simple rabbit.

Pike in Wine-vinegar Sauce

1 large pike
1 1/4 cup wine
2 tbl. vinegar
3 slices of bread
1/4 spoon wild cinnamon
1/8 spoon ground white pepper
2 onions
fat
wild parsley
salt

Place the pike in a pan, pour in wine and vinegar and add parsley. Add enough salted water to cover the fish and poach it until the flesh is white. Lift the fish from the pan, then put the bread into a bowl. Add some of the wine-vinegar liquid until the bread is covered.

Skin the fish and take out the spine and other bones. Cut the fish into small pieces to make a manageable dish.

Strain the cooking liquid into a clean pan. Pour 2 cups of it into the bowl with the bread, add cinnamon and pepper and mix it together until smooth. Return the mixture to the liquid in the pan. Fry the onions in a little oil until soft, and add them to the liquid as well.
Taste for seasoning, add the pieces of fish and re-heat gently to serve.

Deer Roast

4 - 6 onions
4 - 6 wild chili
4 - 6 garlic cloves
salt
red pepper
lemon juice
water
fat

Cut the onions, chili and garlic into small pieces. Cut small holes in the deer meat and insert pieces of onion, garlic and chili into the holes. Mix salt and pepper and insert the mixture into the same holes.
Mix lemon juice and water. Pour over the meat and marinate overnight. Cook the meat in a large saucepan. Melt the fat in the saucepan and add some water. Leave to cook for 4 to 6 hours on low heat. Remove the roast and thicken the gravy with some flour.

Dryad Stew

short ribs of wild boar separated by rib
1/4 cup flour
1/4 cup oil
5 cup beef stock
1/2 spoon cinnamon
1/2 spoon ground cloves
1/2 spoon ground mace
2 spoon cardamom
4 peppercorns
1 onion
6 sprg. parsley
1 spoon sage
1/4 cup vinegar
1/4 spoon saffron
whole wheat bread

Chop the parsley and sage, cut the onion into small pieces and crush the cardamom.
Dust the ribs with the flour, fry it in the oil until it is brown. Add the stock as well as the spices and herbs except for the saffron and leave to simmer for two hours. Soak in the vinegar and saffron with the bread, purée it and stir it into the stew. Check seasoning, then simmer for another half an hour.

Dual Wield

"Shields are overrated."
 Armantin, in his book “The Art of Two Swords” (written in 529).

The oldest document of a dual wielding fighting style is dated 1300 years ago. It's a small image in the Elisithian manuscript and shows a Seraphim defeating a Carnach with two longswords. Numerous Heroes and masters at arms are known to have used this style in battles, duels and tournaments. The most well known of all is certainly Armatin Tarabath, Warlord under Emperor Turiam III in the times of the Six Wars. Every student of dual wield sword fighting is still following his techniques and principles, as described in his famous book “The Art of Two Swords”. Because of this huge influence, dual wield sword fighting is commonly known as armantin-style or armantin for short.

Wielding one weapon in each hand is without any doubt the most aggressive fighting style. The armantin fighter dismisses the protective element of a shield in exchange for an extra sword. This automatically determines his fighting style and tactics. The lack of blocking capacity makes it impossible for him to fight defensively. Instead, he will try to kill his opponent as quickly as possible by covering him with enormous amounts of combined swings at an incredible speed, keeping his shield and weapon constantly busy. A good armantine fighter will try to force his opponent to move his shield, thereby leaving gaps in his defense.

Fighting armantin requires lots of practice. Both arms need to be equally skilled and trained. If the off-hand isn't able to deliver swings, blows and thrusts at the same speed and precision as the main-hand, the offensive advantage of the extra weapon will vanish and leave the fighter with a poor shield in the form of a sword. Only truly ambidextrous fighters can fight armantin to its full potential. But armantin is not only about training the arms. Movement and balance are of equal importance. While fighting with a single weapon and shield can be quite static, the armantin fighter needs to be able to move around and readjust the balance of his body, which is constantly changing during the combinations of swings.

“Your arms may deliver the deciding strike. But your legs win the fight.”
 Armantin in this book “The Art of Two Swords”

Of course, armantin is not limited to fighting with two swords (although Armantin himself never used a weapon other than the sword). There are many possible combinations, such as sword and axe, sword and dagger, two axes, mace and sword and so on. While the combination of a crush and a slash weapon certainly can be helpful in some fights, most fighters tend to use weapons of the same kind, because it's a lot easier to master the flow of motions.

“The two-weapon fighter should always try to use the longest weapons he can comfortably swing. It's essential to attack the opponent before he gets a chance to get too close to you. You should always aim for the initiative, and kill your opponent as soon as he's into your weapon range”
 Passage from “The Art of Two Swords”

Kratos is going to try to decipher the scroll. I'm wound up tighter than the spring on a crossbow!

Did you see how strong that wolf was? He was really tough, even for a black wolf. Thank you for helping me.
Would you please take me home? I'm still afraid.

Help me to solve the mystery about my dead wife.

Help me! Please, help me! I think I'm going crazy! My wife, Lydia, is dead! Truly dead. Not semi-dead like me. I found her like that in bed this morning.
And when I went to see the undertaker, who do I see? Huh? Riiiight! My wife! Shopping, as usual! As if nothing had happened. But she is also lying dead in bed. What should I do? There must be some explanation!
A dying soldier has asked me to deliver this talisman to his parents, so they'll have something to remember him by. How could I not honor such a wish?
Crawl back into your swamp, lizard.
I do many things, but I will not sit on that thing.
Do your limbs grow back when they get cut off?
How wonderful to see you! How are you?
Praise the ancestors! We haven't met in a lifetime!
Wonderful! You are truly a gift from our forefathers!
Ah, it's you! I really crave a conversation right now!
I wondered if you were well! What a nice coincidence!
Unbelievable! It's been much too long.
I'm really lucky to meet you! We have much to talk about.
This is a nice surprise that our forefathers seem to have planned for us.
Good ghosts! I really wasn't expecting to see you!
How nice, my spiritual brother comes to see me!
The General's plan has been approved. Thank you very much for your efforts. I hope we can count on your assistance in the future as well!
May Lumen's light illuminate your paths!
I'm curios about what will happen next. I have to admit I'm still very skeptical.
Oh, you look pretty battered, my dear! What happened?
An embarrassing mishap, I have to admit. I spotted a seemingly divine piece of fruit and tried to pick it in honor of the Goddess.
Don't tell me, you fell off the tree when you tried getting to it?
If it had been just that... no, I climbed both safely and deftly.
I climbed up to the fruit and reached for it. Only then did I realize that it was a hornets' nest!
Please, spare me the rest of your tale!
That might be best. I bid you a pain free day, without a mistake like mine.
Reduces the cooldown of the elemental magic aspect and increases the potential spell level without a malus. Allows combat art upgrades in the elemental magic aspect.
Is the rumor true? Did you really sell branches of the sacred Oak to unworthy Humans?
They weren't unworthy, my brother. A mission of their God led them to us.
Kybele won't be very pleased by that. What did they want the branches for?
The Humans intend to make pointy stakes from them. They'll serve a just cause.
That sounds strange, you have to admit at least that much. What will the stakes be used for?
The sacred stakes are supposed to be driven into the undead hearts of dark creatures. They call them vampires.
I've heard of them, but I assumed they were merely legends.
You see now that we are supporting a just case. I must be going brother.
I hope you're not an arochna... arachni... I hope you’re not afraid of spiders.
It brings joy to my murderous heart!
I am a Seraphim, a creature of the Light! But sometimes I just feel like beating up somebody ...
That's a good opponent ... maybe too good.
Heals a considerable amount of hitpoints of the Seraphim or a chosen ally.
Harrr, I've escaped my watchers! Harr harr. Have you got the medallion? Give it to me. Are we smugglers? Sure we are! Harrr!
May your ancestors guard you, stranger.
Looks like we beat back the first wave! Let's see how many more follow.
Even a blind fighter strikes it's target sometimes.

An Elixir of Souls? What in the world do you want with an Elixir of Souls? Oh well... it’s none of my business really. Here take this, but be careful! Incorrect use of an elixir of this caliber can result in some very unpleasant changes to the spheres of reality. Oh I’m sure you know all about that.

Now if you please, I shall continue with my work... That was enough conversation to last me another decade.
An aura of power emanates from this item.

Gravestone
Famous last words of Anca Adelina Finta:
weeeeee bb done...
Why is nothing happening here any more? Why am I still standing here? I'm a Temple Guardian, not a temple statue!
At ease! Very well done! I see I can rely on you. I might have another assignment for you, if you are interested.
If you want to help us, find out more about the eternal night.

I've met a cult of Lizardmen who worship the undead. They're following a bizarre philosophy. They don't use names, because names establish relationships, which then form communities. They think communities stifle the individuality that is essential for a fulfilled life. To join their cult I need to kill the creature on top of the Skull Rock. They may be useful to me, and the fight could be entertaining so I'll face the challenge.
The water in this lake has been frozen since the dawn of time.
Protective Shield - Protector casts damage reduction on caster
Save your hocus-pocus for someone else!
We're almost at the Temple. I wonder what we'll find there.
I delivered the branches. Now the zombie can start to burn the armor.
I met a mushroom collector in a small forest. She told me about a terrible werewolf called "Bloodclaw" who is in this area. That sounds like a challenge.
Something is hidden beneath this stone.

Welcome to my humble home! Yes it's true, I used to be a great swordmaster. My eyes aren't what they used to be though, and my reflexes are also slowing down. I will teach the citizens of this area how to fight with a sword.
How many times have I told you not to call me shnookums in public? You did it then and I hated it! I don't call you “little muffin” where strangers can hear, either!

But shnoo ... darling! We are practically alone. It's only us and our savior!
Besides, we should let the past rest and stop bringing up all these old stories. I for one will never again accuse you of having forgotten my birthday. Or that you used my darling cat Minky as a target for your “absolutely safe” teleportation tests. Bygones! Honestly!

Yeah, right. Bygones. And then it will be brought up again at the first opportunity. It's always the same! Even so, you are right. We should not argue in public.
I am very grateful for your help, as well! Without you, we couldn't have escaped our fate! But now we will withdraw if we may.
Or did you want to add something, my sweet little muffin?
I wonder if there is a shoe store in this village...
I have defeated the Carnach. Now I must return to Mer-Kil.
I see, skin bruises, scales don't!
I'm not shy about hitting the more sensitive parts!
You'll get another one right after that, because the first one felt so good!
I'll manage to beat some respect into you yet!
They were very pleased with my work.
You won't find any cheap, foreign swords among MY wares!
Please take us to our mother.
The farmer was satisfied, the reward was appropriate.
What? I don't understand a word. SPEAK UP!
Things won't get done by themselves. I accept the quest.
The coast is within easy reach from here.
I want to take you Humans seriously... but YOU DON'T GIVE ME A CHANCE!
Well ... I have enough crystals for now!
Significantly decreases the regeneration time for the aspect Arrant Pyromancer and raises maximum spell levels without penalty. Enables the use of modifications for this aspect.
I defeated the Earth Elemental with the strange name. The Sisters of the "Women of the Sweet Seraphim" order will be pleased.

Break up the gang of thieves barricaded near the docks.

Halt! You cannot enter the docks! A gang of thieves are barricaded there after they tried to steal a sloop. Fortunately, the captain took the steering wheel with him, so they couldn't cast off. After that the cutthroats barricaded down at the docks. We're blocking the only exit, so they can't escape, but we're still awaiting reinforcements. Maybe ... maybe you could help us with this problem.
I don't want to seem impertinent, but I would really like to talk about something else!
Since you're already here, there's something else we need to talk about.
There's one thing that I almost forgot! Please lend me your ear!
I must take the dagger to the guardsman and tell him what happened. I hope the truth will be revealed!
I'm finally rid of those flea bags. Gross, they took a dump in my knapsack!! I would love to skin them alive - but the tailor is going to do it for me .
One cannot choose where to spread the word. So let it be this village ...
Don't pointlessly run around - fight for freedom!
Fight against the aristocracy - they strip us of our liberties more and more!
A demonstration for freedom! Join in!
Politics is nothing but the organization of legalized injustice.
Mr. Metal, please report to the trash compactor!
How can something like you exist in a place like this?
Shouldn't you be guarding the Temple, instead of stumbling around here?
I thought that you guys were just a legend used to scare little kids.
A garbage can with legs - what a great idea!
I wonder what will happen now.
This scratch won't shake my faith!
I think I must have halved the local tortoise population! Those fishermen certainly won’t have any more problems with them!
That should not pose any problems.
He never was the smartest guy, but he was always very sensitive. Here take this and help him.
A guard in the village told me that a patrol has been missing for several days. He has asked me to go and find out what has befallen them.
Was there something about the word “kill” that you didn't understand? Go on, you know what to do.

Put an end to the Lich that is calling the dead out of the other side.
There you are at last. We've been waiting for you. We felt a deep tremor in the fabric of the world. The wall of the realm of the dead is threatening to collapse, but you managed to stop it just in time. Now a powerful mage has arisen as the Lich for the undead, and he is calling them to him and contaminating our island. Go and put an end to the Lich.
I assume you are not interested in a conversation?
Your luck ends here...which means that you end here as well.
And I'll give you another one at the same spot!
Nobody here any more? Shutdown initiated.
It looks like this is the final challenge of the competition. I have to find a perfect crystal which can sometimes be looted from the crystal monsters.

Free me from this ice block!

Do something! Do something, please? I've been inside this ice block for two days now! I can't feel my toes anymore! Damn it!
The cave was such a brilliant idea! How could I've known that monster was living here? It knocked me down and froze me. Maybe it was storing supplies for harder times ... Help me! Quick!
Animal fur...then start looking forward to your new winter coat!

Welcome, brother. We all died as criminals and then were resurrected as a kind of punishment. They don't even allow criminals to die, instead they use them as puppets for all sorts of power games. Kill this General! Then we will accept you into our circle. What? You don't want to? Then you will die here, once and for all.
The server has reached its maximum capacity.
Well, this is done. Let's get on with the rest.
Can you fight too - or just bark orders?
Any Hero has forged something into an item for the first time.
I have the glands, I hope there’s enough testosterone in them. Now it’s time to return to Libatta.
You have returned! Congratulations! How are you? Would you be interested in more tasks? It’s your decision!
I have arrived in the Kobold village. Now I must kill oodles of these disgusting little critters...OODLES!
Something had been hidden in there!
Spices! Souvenirs! Imported goods! Come, have a look.
I'm fascinated by this flying object. Its pieces could be useful for me...

The smuggler fell for it, and took a good gulp of the poison. With the poison slowly draining the life from his body, he became much more cooperative. He even lowered the price of his precious charm. All of a sudden he was willing to sell it for the small vial with the antidote. I could have let him die of course, but the humiliation of him giving me his precious charm in exchange for his wretched life was more satisfying. I now have the charm and can make my way to the Crystal Caves at the center of the island.
By the horns of the ancient ... a town!
Zeus is the God of thunder and lightning. If you choose Zeus as your deity you can expect his powerful help on your quest.
Do you want to be a real hero some day?
My father says that nowadays, everyone is trying to be a hero.
Are you the new saber rattling tutor?
This blacksmith should be hanged! My new blades are jagged and lousy quality, how are yours?
When Kuan sees our pathetic new blades he'll cry out loud! The material is lousy!
Ha! When I see the new blades from the forges I have to wonder how we're supposed to kill with them, by bludgeoning?
There are only a few good local blades! It's really sad that we have to rely on the weapons we capture!
Our blacksmiths are pathetic, don't you think? They can't even forge one straight sharp blade.
Perhaps it would help to torture our craftsmen! Did you see the pathetic new swords they made?
We are great warriors but lousy weapon smiths! Why do we have such plump hands?
If we had to rely on weapons we make ourselves we’d be beaten in all fights, don't you agree?
Why aren't we able to forge good swords? Are our blacksmiths that incapable?
Incredible! Nobody's lousier than our weapon smiths! Would it help to whip them?
Mishirla has regained consciousness after his near death experience. This herb is amazing. Maybe I should gather some more rain leaf ... just in case.
Ha! That'll teach those little pests! Thank you! Here's your reward!
Your old bones will rest in peace soon. Trust me.
Now I have to escort the family home safely.

Take this ring to the princess.

Just one small thing... Take this valuable wedding ring to our princess. She'll get married soon and this is to be her ring. After that, come back to me.
I should have known. Thieves never do anything without asking for something in return. I suppose I will have to do as they ask if I want to help Jahrin.
Har har! That'll teach them landlubbers!
You wouldn't last a day at sea.
You turn on your C64 and load Bruce Lee. You grow a long beard. You are dead.
A magically enhanced weapon attack that converts physical into magic damage.
What ? A tree takes 10,000 years to mature? I probably won't be around then, so tell me who I'm planting these trees for?

Hmmm... very interesting. I've seen this before. Yes, I'm sure... but what was it?
AH HA! I remember! It belonged to a family, but the last of them died more than 50 years ago. The last patriarch's name was Kulghar. He committed a felony and was executed. Shortly before his execution, Kulghar threatened to return. It seems like he's made his threat a reality.
If you see a light, just head straight for it.

It was horrible! We were separated from the main squad and as soon as they were out of reach we could hear it come. It ran past us like a black shadow. Please find the main squad and support them the best you can.
The hunter is still not convinced of my abilities. What else does he want me to do? Well, at least my reward was fair.
As expected, the Pasha had no papers for the Gladiators. How could he? He called for his guards, so it's going to get interesting now!

Fight each other to the death.

This is the warrior's land. If you want to pass through here, you must first prove your skill. You will fight each other. Only when one of you is dead may the other move on.
You're bringing me gold? I don't believe it! Today's my lucky day! Did you meet with my father? How is he?
I'll beat the last bit of reason out of you!
Right then. I’ll take the quack, er, field surgeon to the fisherman!
Merciless - The threshold for the maximum effectiveness is raised to 35 % of remaining hitpoints.
Eradicate - Greatly increases the chance for critical hits.
Inure - The Inquisitor sustains less damage.
I am glad you returned this disobedient good-for-nothing! Come on, Alexander. You have to catch up on a lot of homework.
First the mount, then the rider.
Search the corpses. Maybe they carry something useful.
You are not signed in to the PlayStation®Network. Some online functions - such as playing with other users - are not available.

Welcome to my refuge!

Do I know you from somewhere? I could've sworn I do. Along, long time ago. Hmm, maybe it's just a kind of déjà vu. Who knows ...

Whatever.I am sure you are here because you want to know more about this forest and the battle raging in it? The battle between me and Diaanjathat is stoked by the fires of hatred. Yes, it is true. Even afterall these years, the hatred is still there. If I could, I'd show this little bit ... beg your pardon, that's not what I wanted to tell you.

Of courseI know our hatred isn't real. We are victims. Victims of our hunger for knowledge. We just wanted to summon a demon and bind it to our dimension. Instead of the demon, though, an Abishaiheeded our call ... and Abishaiof Dissension! He is the source of all this hatred! No living being can get away from the hatred this creature sows.Diaanjaand I know this. Butwe are helpless against it.

The only way to end this battle and the useless, eternal killing is to destroy the Abishai.It won't be easy. The Abishaihas been in this dimension for a long time now and all the blood strengthened it. To the north of here lies an underground reservoir of blood. It is the Abishai'sfountain of power. If we can destroy the reservoir, it would weaken the Abishaiand might make it vulnerable.

The problemis, you can't just dump blood lakes. The blood must be removed in a magic ritual. A powerful and dangerous ritual. I have never performed it, but it is the only way. I am tired. Tired of the fighting and the hatred. Don't get me wrong: If I could put my hands on Diaanja,I would wring the little bitch's neck! ... beg your pardon.

Anyway.I am willing to perform the ritual, but I will need your help. I need the blood of three eyes. Champions of course, not the infantry. And yes, that's a big difference! I will also need five small piles of sulfur. It won't be easy to find, but you should look in the farthest reaches of this region.

As soon as you have everything I need, meet me at the entrance to the cave complex.
You need to be signed into an Xbox LIVE Gold Membership with the correct permissions to access all Xbox LIVE features.
I can return to Farrim now that I have successfully increased the numbers of the faithful.

The Grand Inquisitor is very intimidating, but he did say he might employ me if I can prove myself in the arena. It looks like I’ll have to impress the head gladiator by killing a few prisoners in single combat.
By the horn of the mighty dragon ... are you using a cheap copy? Better go and get the original!
I used to protect or wipe out villages, depending on my orders.
I'm going to pay that human a visit.
You think so? We shall see...
*sighs* Of course! I should have known that.
You have my gratitude, good man.

Raises the souls of fallen corpses.  These will surround the Inquisitor for a while before they disappear again. Each fresh soul provides an additional boost to the Inquisitor's attack and defense, as well as resetting the souls' lifespan.
Lumen has accepted your sacrifice. I bless you in the name of the light. Continue on your journey and please Lumen with your deeds.
The sack with Christmas Wish lists was stole by Yetis. I have to go and get it back. I'm supposed to watch out for Walther,  the Yeti leader.

Ah there you are again! I suppose you think that you've thwarted my plans?
I'm afraid you’re wrong! The instrument of my power still lives - not even killing me can change anything now! Too much has already been set in motion, nothing can stop us!
Let’s also not overlook the fact that I’m not dead yet, nor do I intend to die today! Now take up your arms, you fool!
Licking Flames - Fire can jump over to enemies that are further away
Smoldering - Fire is weaker but lasts longer
Hunger - Increased chance to jump over to nearby enemies
Panic - Chance that burning enemies will flee
Death Blow - Fire damage against badly wounded enemies is doubled
Bone dust falls softly in the night!
A Dryad agent asked me to help her. A cursed medallion was stolen from her and she must get it back before the thieves can cause any damage with it.
Thank you too! It was really very enlightening!
That conversation was like a tree! Sound and magnificent!
You're a wonderful conversationalist! I really do have to rush off now though.
I think I'd better be on my way. This calm is a little spooky.
I still have some errands I have to run! I bid you a good day as well.
Time flies when you're having a stimulating conversation. May Kybele grant you wonders!
It's time to say goodbye, just like in that nice song.
It's too bad that I have to leave already. But it was a real pleasure.
See you soon! I enjoy talking to you.
My equipment doesn't protect me enough against damage from cold.

What a nuisance they were. Well, I'm happy it's over and that I can reach my good old wines again. You won't go away empty-handed of course.

I will give you one of my best wines, the Ancaria Cuvée XX.
By the gods! And I thought the Orcs were crazy.
That is the banished juggler’s old house. The tree that he buried the treasure under must be nearby.
There's the treasure, there’s not much left of the tree though! Well, you know what they say: It is more blessed to receive than to give! Or was it the other way around? Hahaha...

Speak to the smuggler of the crystals. If anyone knows his way into the caverns, it's him.

You're looking for the key to the hub shield, eh? I might have a useful hint or two. One hand washes the other, right? If you do a little job for me I'd consider telling you what I know ...

Ok ok, let's not be hasty, I was just kidding! Ask anyone, I'm a kidder, really! Of course I'll tell you what you want to know. No need to kill me, really.

The key is in the Crystal Caves. They're hard to enter, but if you talk to the crystal smuggler he might have some tips. He lives over that way.

Well, well, well, What have we got here? You're not carrying a message to one of our novice's families are you? Novices are forbidden to contact their families. It is vital to their spiritual development that they break all contact with their families and devote their lives to the cult.
Give me the letter. I will make a few changes to it, then the whole matter will take care of itself.

You will find a hero chest in some towns and villages. Everything that you store in there will be accessible from hero chests anywhere in the world.
 
If you play different heroes they will all have access to this chest.

Throughout the game you will find runes. You can memorize runes that are suitable for your hero's class and improve your combat arts that way.
 
Runes for other classes can be traded at a Runemaster. Offering more runes in trade will reduce the cost of the rune you want to buy.

When you memorize a rune, the corresponding combat art's efficiency will increase. Please remember that this will also increase the regeneration time of that combat art!
 
You can also forge runes into weapons or armor. When you wield that weapon the combat art will improve but the regeneration time will not increase.

Some weapons feature a number of sockets. When you visit a blacksmith, you can forge special items into these sockets depending on their quality (bronze, silver, gold):
 
Bronze: Runes and Blacksmith Arts
 
Silver: Rings (in addition to the above)
 
Gold: Amulets (in addition to the above)
 
Additionally, each weapon will feature a gray socket for a damage modifier.

Each weapon has a gray socket for a damage modifier. This will change the weapon's damage type (fire, ice, poison, magic).
 
For example, a weapon that will inflict only physical damage will also inflict magical damage when a pearl is forged into it.

You can remove items from a weapon at a blacksmith. Doing so will remove the item you want to retrieve from the weapon, but at the same time it will destroy all other items which may also be forged into the same weapon.

Relics increase your armor's resistance against fire, ice, poison and magic. Available artifacts can be found under the "Relics" tab in your inventory.
 
If you want to benefit from an artifact you need to activate it first. You may activate up to six relics but only three of the same type.

Every hero can learn up to fifteen combat arts - five per aspect. However, it is not advisable to learn all of them because you can only become a true master of a combat art if you advance it consistently.
 
You should also choose combat arts from several aspects, because each aspect has a different recharge time. Learning combat arts from different aspects will enable you to use several combat arts in succession during a fight.

You can place weapons, combat arts and combat art combinations into the four action slots. Additionally, you can switch the action slots and assign various other actions to them.
 
The potion slots may contain all variations of potions. The most important ones are health potions, concentration potions and potions of the mentor.
It would be best if they still have their arms and legs. One-legged Zombie Orcs have limited use as soldiers.
Any Hero has visited all 42 towns.

Bring us a decision making potion!

Psst! you there, I need a word with you! We have a slight problem with our leader. Don't get me wrong, Hawey is a good leader but he has trouble making decisions! It's always: "hmm... we'll see,“ "let's discuss it,“ "wait and see,“ "one could“ or "how about...“ This has to stop! That's why we decided to give him a decision making potion. You can get them at the Import Trader. Would you get the potion for us? We can't go because someone might see us. This matter must be treated with the utmost discretion of course. If someone heard that the leader is consuming obscure potions...
Attention. Wild animals within fighting range.
My lute is as out of tune as a Human.
My stories are about small miracles that could happen.
Praise be the Gods, for they are perfect!
I have no strength, how am I supposed to lend it?
I sing about sadness, because people can no longer find joy.
I'd rather die by my own hand!
In this area, opponents are very strong, I must be careful!

Ah. A fellow believer! Well, what do you think of our little ritual site to honor Kuan?
Oh, the surveyor sent you? Surely we can count on your discretion, can’t we?
Why are you poking your nose into things that don’t concern you? Aha! I get it! Well then, we'll soon see whether you have what it takes to be an instrument of revenge!
The Gods give strength to your strikes, so strike harder.
The sea shall swallow you, if you lose.
Better hide yourself somewhere in the Temple!
Everyone here wants to see you dead!

I found the spy while he was fighting off a pack of wolves. I may have saved his life, but perhaps not. No matter. He told me a friend of the broker’s runs a gambling den in the village north of here.
I am always glad to see my savior!
You should be more careful next time.
At least TRY to fight back, human!
Ah! My pelts! Now I can start work on my mattresses, thank you!
Care for something to drink? Some potato stew maybe? Or would you rather go find Jaftar now?
Kendrel has been made to pay for his crime. I guess he picked a fight with the wrong person.
Death to all chunks of cells!
That was just in time ... thank you!
Excellent! I'll perform the ritual at once. Thank you!
Gods of the Sea, protect me!
Stop! You will be married lady Judriel, but not to this man.
What doesn't kill me makes me stronger!
My destination should be somewhere in this area.
What a shame, the Lizardmen are dead and there isn’t much left of the graves either.

How does the saying go again?
"The horizon of some people is a circle with a radius of zero. They call it their point of view."

Yes you are right. I should turn back to Forens.

Hmm... When we were put on this planet we had everything we needed to live. If you've ever watched an alchemist then you would realize how stupid people are. We are the ones who have made our lives so difficult.

Yes you're right. I've made things difficult for myself. Forens has always given me strength, I should turn back to him.

What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us. And when we bring what is within us out into the world, miracles happen.

I think I should find my faith again.

The desire to seem clever often prevents us from being clever.

Wooha far out dude, what now? Dude, I'm like, not smart, you know? Wooha, I'm like, goin' to work for Forens, to like, learn stuff, okay? Like, thanks dude, you're awesome.

When thought and action are unified, then body and soul will be more closely connected to each other.

You are sensible and wise, I will think about your advice.
You glow like an entire Christmas tree!
This creature will certainly throw me, I have to practice first.

Franz Stradal
I stepped up to create something beautiful.
The nobility is getting more brutal every day, how can we possibly fight back?
Do you think that everyone who abuses his power this way is trying to compensate for something?
Now they are starting to use us for gambling! I wonder what's next!
Don't these animals feel pity for us at all?
What else are they going to come up with? Will we have to pull the horses in their carriages?
Have you heard of Genghis Khan? It would be a relief serving him!
Yesterday, I broke a plate. I wonder what punishment I should expect...
Have we lost all Humanity for them to treat us this way?
Have you ever heard of a well-tempered ruler? I haven't!
Hey, what's up player? Being a child of nature I can't wait around for too long or I'll sprout roots!
Don't worry. The priest will heal me.
What an arrogant guard! He could have at least told me where I might find a blacksmith around here. Well it shouldn't be too hard to find one.
Thanks for rescuing us. We were outnumbered, there was nothing we could do. Some of us are sick or weak with exhaustion. Take us to our families please.
I'm going to have quite a feast!
That's what you get for messing with a dragon!
I'd really like to get married, but who would want me when I'm always occupied with killing?
A Kybele priest has asked me to help her look for a missing huntress. She's been sent to get some oblations for an ordination, but nobody has heard from her in two days.
I got the head and the chest. I'd better take the head to Emiliane now. I hope she'll believe me.
This is our house! We're not leaving!
The officer sent me to the commander. I'm supposed to speak with him about a “special problem.“ Sounds pretty mysterious!
Claressa is back with her father. My task is completed.
The General has been informed. I wonder what's going to happen next.
You still got a chance to run, poser.
Greetings and good day to you!  Say, how are you doing with your donations to the Gods these days?
I am afraid I cannot be a joy to the Gods right now.
You do know that a devout Elf has to give to the Gods, don't you?
Taxes leave me barely enough to live on...

Let's go! I don't want to waste any more time.

I will head off right away and stand by his side!
